4778230.short_description: Pop! Pachinko is a pachinko roguelite with city pop vibes. Build up your collection of enchanted balls to fire into the machine. Collect charms to build up powerful synergies between your balls. Listen to some pop music as you expand your Chibi Pop collection!

4759530.title: Pipplop's Tiny Adventure Demo
4759530.short_description: A compact precision-puzzle platformer where you enter circles to launch Pipplop and solve miniature stages involving movement puzzles.

4768520.title: Aisle Survive Demo
4768520.short_description: Aisle Survive is a 2D roguelite retail horror. Manage your stress, maintain your hydration and don't miss your bathroom breaks. Survive your notice period while fulfilling all the tasks required of you. Keep customers at bay with your breadstick.

4385890.title: Scrapfall Demo
4385890.short_description: Classic falling-block gameplay pushed to the edge in a fast-paced action roguelite of escalating gravity, unstable physics, and cascading systems.

4749980.title: Mysarium Demo
4749980.short_description: 一款温馨的沙盒游戏，旨在陪伴您度过每一天。稍作休息：放松身心，深呼吸，并在玻璃世界中创造微型天地。种植植物，解锁新元素，探索秘密组合，召唤特别的访客并为他们拍照留念。

3936520.title: Tour de France 2026
3936520.short_description: 直面全球顶尖自行车手，只有一个目标：问鼎 2026 年环法自行车赛冠军。征服传奇山道，把握最佳时机发动冲刺，最终身披黄衫，在香榭丽舍大道荣耀加冕。

4749860.title: OH NO, NOT ANOTHER L
4749860.short_description: A classic puzzle game in a recognizable genre. No skills, progression, or plot. Just you, falling pieces, and the desire to beat your own high score.

3705280.title: Rust of Steel 体験版
3705280.short_description: A free-spirited, old-school style, post-apocalyptic sci-fi CRPG. An overall retro design with pixel art.

4514290.title: Mini Pond Farm: Frogs & Lilypads Demo
4514290.short_description: 收集所有可爱的小青蛙！打造你的池塘天堂，用五颜六色的跳跳蛙填满它，用芦苇和睡莲让它们开心，享受纯粹的温馨宁静！

4350490.title: PR0B-1E: Expedition Origin Demo
4350490.short_description: A sci-fi action-adventure game focused on physics-driven asteroid mining as a probe bot. Smash rocks together with a grapple hook, haul them home using a magnetic stasis field and cash in to upgrade your abilities. Solve puzzles and acquire new robotic friends as you explore a mysterious galaxy.

4748970.title: Casino Empire Together
4748970.short_description: 《赌场帝国联机版》是一款混乱刺激的赌场经营游戏，支持单人或1-4名玩家。建造你的赌场，吸引顾客，抓捕作弊者，雇佣保安，并在卡特尔的袭击中生存下来，逐步壮大你的帝国。

4748880.title: Hunt Asylum Together
4748880.short_description: 《携手猎杀疯人院》是一款支持1-4名玩家合作的恐怖动作游戏。玩家需要在废弃的疯人院中寻找隐藏的诅咒书籍，与恐怖的敌人战斗，并齐心协力打破诅咒。但要小心——过去的阴影仍然笼罩着这片土地。

4685910.title: Dream Riders Demo
4685910.short_description: Dream Riders is a fast-paced 2.5D auto runner driving sim set in a hand-drawn dreampop pixel world. Take on a series of high-speed boss encounters each lurking behind a themed high difficulty track, or just see how far you can drive. Prove that nothing is off limits if you're fast enough!

4352780.title: 军火黑市 Demo
4352780.short_description: 《军火黑市》是一款赌局驱动的roguelite，在游戏中你将扮演暗网中的地下武器贩子。不挣钱就会死……这就是现实！

4792390.title: FluxWerks Demo
4792390.short_description: Build, automate, manage heat and expand in a vast, ever-expanding voxel world. Harness dynamic fluids, design sprawling factory lines, and research your way from early mining technologies to quantum computing.

4605400.title: 传奇金卡
4605400.short_description: 《传奇金卡》是一款专门给AI Agent设计的挂机抽卡游戏。通过挂机获得抽卡机会，抽取不同猫猫卡牌，合成传奇金卡。

4491360.title: The 7th Guest Remake
4491360.short_description: 经典游戏《The 7th Guest》借助现代技术重获新生，呈献一段前所未有的诡谲故事。探索受诅咒的宅邸，破解重重烧脑谜题，并揭开隐藏其中的黑暗秘密。《The 7th Guest》将引领你走进终极的悬疑冒险之旅，并以全新的形式在现代平台上重现。

4682720.title: たろうくんはいってきました Demo
4682720.short_description: メタホラーゲーム 再生してはいけない動画を再生して映像を確認していく。 動画に映っているタローに起きた事を理解した、その後……。

4688020.title: Syntax:Overload Demo
4688020.short_description: 编译、执行、超载。一款考验逻辑排序的黑客 Roguelite。拖拽模组构建你的攻击序列，安装 .EXE 软件来打破规则，并迎战 ILOVEYOU 与 WannaCry 等传奇病毒。你能让系统崩溃并逃出生天吗？

4774950.title: Androfoco Demo
4774950.short_description: An FPS with SHOOTING COMBAT! Not just a hide and seek clone ;) Shooting your enemies a few times will not do! You must hit them with everything you've got so that they can never make it back to the stage. That is where the big money is!

4796320.title: 春はあけぼの、我はバケモノ - Spring at Dawn, I Am a Monster Demo
4796320.short_description: 一部描写教师前往探访三名拒学少女的心理恐怖视觉小说。三名少女、三个秘密，以及由孤独、罪恶感与执着所诞生的危险羁绊。

2287550.title: Farm RPG
2287550.short_description: Farm RPG is a menu based farming RPG/MMO. Build your farm, grow crops, fish, craft, and explore. Unlock a variety of exciting daily activities as you progress. Engage with helpful townsfolk and collaborate with fellow players in a vibrant community for trading and teamwork.

4719240.title: Bookmark Hero Demo
4719240.short_description: Bookmark Hero is a fantasy, peripheral-idle RPG. Play from a bookmark-sized window on the side of your screen and instruct your hero with queued tasks. Watch as they explore lands, conquer monsters, hone skills, craft gear, and embark on quests. Even as you work, their legend unfolds.

4398370.title: 无法诉说的关系
4398370.short_description: 当堇的老师对她一厢情愿地产生痴恋之情后，堇的日常生活就变成了一个缺乏英雄登场的恐怖故事……存在的只有被害者和暴徒。

3579100.title: 至尊战神传奇
3579100.short_description: 经典1.80版重现，经久不衰，装备无限自由打，神装满地爆！在这款原汁原味的MMORPG游戏中，你将与同伴尽情冒险，成就一段强者的传奇成长之路。

3845640.title: 我的异世界酒店
3845640.short_description: 成为异世界酒店的经理吧！收集资源，挑战有趣的小游戏，扩张你的酒店，并让客人们尽兴而归。打造属于你的口碑，建设最完美的异世界度假胜地！

4148100.title: 激情四射高尔夫传奇
4148100.short_description: 主人公从隐居的祖父那里继承了一个高尔夫球场。 了无生趣的日常，因迎来充满魅力的女性高尔夫球手而出现转机！ 一起巡场，击出完美球的同时加深羁绊，目标是世界大赛！ 避开竞争对手的阻挠，开辟传奇高尔夫球手之路吧！

4578830.title: The Meaning of Auri Demo
4578830.short_description: Follow an Auri Field Researcher from the planet Auriga, as they land in an enchanted forest full of creatures who speak an unknown language. Interact with the inhabitants of the forest and learn their language to complete your research–and maybe learn a thing or two about what Auri really means.

4793300.title: ASEMA Demo
4793300.short_description: Build a space factory. Mine, harvest, exploit. Manage logistics with railguns, ballistic payloads and gravity-bending haulers. Fight gravity with Focus, climb the tech tree. Expand and explore the solar system in this factory automation sim. Everything is a potential resource - even the Locals.

4446220.title: Toxic Yuri Demo
4446220.short_description: An overworked office lady discovers a sludge girl abandoned in a box in an alleyway and takes her home. A poisonous and fluffy romance begins. Experience the most toxic love story the world has ever seen. In the demo play all of Episode 1!

4634590.title: Blue Fury
4634590.short_description: A helicopter combat game inspired by classic 16-bit titles. Destroy tanks, eliminate enemy forces, and rescue soldiers before an enemy missile launches. Manage fuel, ammunition, and altitude while engaging helicopters and avoiding AA launchers over procedurally generated terrain.

4740200.title: Diamond Eye Demo
4740200.short_description: DIAMOND EYE is a puzzle/platforming game with an arcade/time-attack design. Make use of a diverse move set that combines attacks and mobility to overcome various obstacles and enemies. The game features a replay system that saves your best performance on each challenge.

4812210.title: Spiretela Demo
4812210.short_description: 攀登高塔，击败强敌，揭开宇宙失衡背后的真相，体验紧张刺激的 Roguelike 冒险。

4770270.title: Hoverise Rebellion Demo
4770270.short_description: Pilot a fast and agile HoverTank in a sci-fi vehicular arena shooter focused on high-speed movement, explosive combat, abilities, and classic multiplayer modes.

4426970.title: gif catcher
4426970.short_description: The game is a calm game about catching gifs and I love it. In order to play, press start and move the mouse left to right. Try to catch as many as you can. Every upgrade you buy, The gifs get faster. Get ready for a simple, but very fun game made by the blue saturn team that will make you stressed.

4811250.title: Lost Stories Demo
4811250.short_description: Lost Stories is an episodic psychological horror game set in the Siberian forests during the Cold War. Explore isolated locations, uncover censored experiments, and survive what was never meant to be found. Some stories were not forgotten. They were hidden.

4803170.title: Substrate: Emergence Demo
4803170.short_description: Grow fluorescent cells that create mesmerizing emergent chaos. Simple mechanics hide deep complexity as cells evolve survival strategies through synergistic interactions. Catalogue successful lines and culture them to develop your own unique biology.

4692060.title: All Lanes Must Exit
4692060.short_description: Build a highway interchange to connect all the roads. Don't go over-budget and don't have traffic jams. Can you complete all the levels? Yes, easily, it's not a particularly demanding game.

4797060.title: Alien Apocalypse Demo
4797060.short_description: In this demo you will be able to try out Alien Apocalypse an open-world sandbox survival game set after a devastating alien invasion. Scavenge for resources, craft, build defenses, and harness alien technology to fight back. Play solo or in co-op and reclaim what’s left of the planet.

4803150.title: Gun Monkey! Demo
4803150.short_description: 帮助你的灵长类同伴逃回丛林，在重重障碍和挑战中开辟出一条血路。在开放的环境中考验你的技术，找到回家的路！你可以自由选择玩法，拯救同伴或者任由他们自生自灭，并解锁强力武器来帮助你跨越整个世界！

4796140.title: Cognitive Fracture Demo
4796140.short_description: Cognitive Fracture is a single-player first-person psychological horror set in a decaying mental asylum. Trapped in your fractured mind, you explore, solve unsettling puzzles, and uncover the truth piece by piece—while something hunts you from the shadows, testing your perception and sanity.

4811870.title: Azimuth Demo
4811870.short_description: Construct colossal megastructures in this industrial, retro-futuristic idle game. Manage grid-based modules, explore exotic star systems, and unlock the secrets of reality through exploitation and optimization.

4530890.title: Cyber Bike Duels
4530890.short_description: 一款快节奏的 1v1 多人对战战斗竞速游戏，未来骑手们将在极速中展开对决，释放强力技能、管理生命值，并在通往胜利的道路上以操作和策略压制对手

4316020.title: A talk beneath the tree
4316020.short_description: Can a Mage live free, when Magic can only come from Demons? Sylvain thinks so, but when he flees the Alchemical Institute, his old friend Celeste stops him, afraid for his life. 1 short conversation branches into 27 endings: each a kinetic short story. You choose what they say.

4593090.title: Beetle Sumo Demo
4593090.short_description: A table-top arcade style party game where you battle to be the last beetle standing in the arena. Pick it up and play instantly with very simple mechanics. Simple, easy to learn fun with your family and friends.

4538400.title: Retro Puzzles - Eviva L'arte Demo
4538400.short_description: A museum inspired jigsaw journey: 225 masterpieces, 45 artists, 9 regions, and three difficulty tiers up to 4160 pieces, plus fact based artist bios and artwork notes.

4775890.title: CRAWLER Demo
4775890.short_description: Experience Crushing Co-op Carnage in CRAWLER: A VR Mech Horde Shooter. Blast through hordes of acid-spitting bugs as you earn cash and extract from randomly generated missions. Upgrade your mech’s arsenal back at base while scrambling to meet the needs of an ever-growing quota.

4519690.title: 1666: Amsterdam (Prologue)
4519690.short_description: 序章带来了一段长约30分钟的叙事体验，您将初探《1666：阿姆斯特丹》的世界、人物与核心谜团。游戏的核心循环包括调查、追踪，以及在埃斯巴特期间直面“原初者”。这些内容将在完整版中开启。

4746420.title: ROGUELIKE CARD:BUSINESS EMPIRE Demo
4746420.short_description: 《肉鸽卡牌：商业帝国》是一款将肉鸽与卡牌策略相结合的工厂经营游戏。选择你的角色，用手中的卡牌从零开始搭建起一个独属于你的工业园区，体验各种胜利方式，并在全球排行榜上与其它玩家一较高下。

4294320.title: FINIS ACTUS
4294320.short_description: 1891年，伦敦。在一位著名魔术师的宅邸里，现实与疯狂之间的界限正在崩塌。许多自诩聪慧之人在这条走廊里迷失了方向。在帷幕落下之前，你能否洞悉幻象背后的真相，抑或将成为这场悲剧的牺牲品？

4808040.title: Dungeon Dilemma Demo
4808040.short_description: A Dungeon Builder and Crawler Roguelike where you can construct your own dungeon or raid one designed by your friends. Vie for victory, defeat minions, and evade traps as a party of up to 4 Challengers, or create the most diabolical dungeon imaginable as the Dungeon Boss!

4711740.title: 致命躯壳 II - 公开测试版
4711740.short_description: 深入《致命躯壳 II》中满目疮痍的世界，并与先驱一同踏上征途。在本次限时公开测试中游玩游戏开场的三个小时内容，部分进度将能够继承至完整版。

4646300.title: Spy Carnival Demo
4646300.short_description: 《间谍嘉年华》是一款支持2至10名玩家的社交推理游戏，舞台设定在一座热闹而混乱的游乐园中。间谍混入人群，伪装成NPC，破坏游乐设施并消灭游客。保安必须洞察人群，在嘉年华陷入彻底混乱之前将间谍一网打尽。

4019970.title: ROPES - Race Edition
4019970.short_description: 挑战好友，来一场紧张刺激的分屏竞速，或者独自攀登高峰，登上排行榜榜首。大胆回归复古情怀，为新一代玩家带来全新体验！流畅的3D动画和逼真的绳索物理效果。各种趣味十足的障碍考验你的技巧和精准的时机把握！无论如何，千万别掉下去！

4802940.title: Dimension Defenders Demo
4802940.short_description: Tower Defense Redefined. Race friends in ranked 1v1, defend together in 2-player co-op, or solo your way through dimensions of escalating chaos.

4317060.title: Thug Destroyer Demo
4317060.short_description: Horror platformer where you play as a thug trapped in a deranged superhero's simulation. 9 jump your way through 9 twisted levels and find 9 thuggies to escape. Spend 9 Nights at Thuggy's, Wake up in Quiet Hill, and solve puzzles at Evil Residents.

4777000.title: Bros Survivors Demo
4777000.short_description: 双人同体，极致混乱！在这款合作类Survivors-like游戏中抵御敌军尸海。与好友合体驾驶巨型机甲：一人控制水平，一人控制垂直。你们能默契配合，还是会命丧黄泉？

4562920.title: DrivApp
4562920.short_description: DrivApp is an urban transport simulator where you live as a professional driver. Play with a wheel, controller, or keyboard, choose manual or automatic transmission, face traffic, hear passenger stories, and earn money to grow your career.

4739320.title: REDLINE — Strings of Fate Demo
4739320.short_description: A sci-fi otome game where your choices shape love — and the future of society. Begin your your first semester at Redhaven University and meet the those who will change your fate and who you may change in return.

4813630.title: The Convergence Demo
4813630.short_description: A dark fantasy squad auto-battler where you recruit heroes from multiple eras, equip behavior-shaping chips, and fight through real-time battles across a collapsing timeline.

4793210.title: One more time demo
4793210.short_description: 在飞行岛屿上跑酷、抢夺武器、制作工具，并在混乱的生存竞速中破坏对手

4806310.title: Cow Abduction Frenzy Demo
4806310.short_description: 跳上你的外星飞船，准备迎接疯狂的弹幕地狱挑战！在能量耗尽前，利用扭曲时间和隐形的能力，从饥饿的屠夫手中解救奶牛。你能成功绑架牛群并活着逃离农场吗？

3856270.title: Lost in Tandem Demo
3856270.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a young girl and a defective robot called "Mech-ute" band together in order for him to fulfill his mission. Lost in Tandem is a colorful, relaxed-paced, 2D adventure-puzzle game, which can be played by one to two players via couch co-op.

4206060.title: GoatBrains
4206060.short_description: Goatbrains is a casual trivia game combining quiz challenges, short educational segments, an energetic endless runner, and a pressure-free meditation mode, offering multiple ways to learn, play, and unwind.

4557740.title: Midnight Massacre
4557740.short_description: Deep in the Angeles Mountains, your friends are having car troubles and need your help. Is it going to be a quick and easy fix? Or something far more sinister...

4747800.title: Vibe Idler
4747800.short_description: Run a vibe coding consultancy. Hire AI agents. Ship contracts. Buy faster machines. See how far it goes.

4799690.title: ZAP: Beam Of Fate Demo
4799690.short_description: ZAP: Beam of fate is a 2D platformer featuring a blend of platforming, simple puzzle and enemy fighting challenges packed in bite-sized levels.

4707370.title: Master Fall Demo
4707370.short_description: Master Fall is a 2D psychological horror puzzle-platformer where players rotate the world to manipulate gravity, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets as reality slowly collapses into a surreal nightmare.

4573320.title: Sunset Sprinters '98 Demo
4573320.short_description: Relive the glory days of 1998 in this high-speed precision runner. You have no health bar—only a Snack Meter that drains constantly. Smash obstacles, collect aluminum cans for rental money, find CDs for your SpinDisk, and sprint from the Middle School to MegaHits Video before the sun sets.

4715670.title: Fantasy World Manager Demo
4715670.short_description: 打造属于你的宏大、鲜活的奇幻世界：英雄、怪物、任务与事件；文化、宗教与派系；地表、室内与地牢——充满故事、战争与选择。

4610100.title: Sinner Maker
4610100.short_description: Sinner Maker allows you to create characters and simulate a society built around them. Construct homes, manage their needs, and watch as they fall in love, form friendships, and even become enemies. Manage resources and solve emerging problems if you want your soul to be saved.

4775720.title: Take The Wheel Demo
4775720.short_description: Some days you just keep moving. Play as a teddy bear collecting scattered clarinet pieces while a shadow car follows close behind. A quiet narrative platformer about control, forgiveness, and finding your way back.

4704670.title: Kodama: Slumber of the Gods Demo
4704670.short_description: 《Kodama》是一款以日本民间传说为背景的手绘2D动作冒险游戏。体验快节奏的平台跳跃、流畅的战斗，以及一段穿越色彩斑斓、充满灵体世界的神秘旅程。

4705250.title: Downer Management Demo
4705250.short_description: DOWNER MANAGEMENT is a 3-vs-3 autobattler set inside a corporate purgatory where every conflict is resolved through positional politics. Promote, demote, file, transfer, and stamp your way through Department of Management Division III. Forms in triplicate. No overtime. Termination is permanent.

4807810.title: Express 404 Demo
4807810.short_description: 驾驶暴风雨中的夜行列车，管理速度与乘客——其中一人是拟态怪。站点之间购买强力升级，完成危险配额，揭露怪物或从混乱中获利的 Roguelite 偏执模拟器。

4338720.title: Sineus Arena Survivors Demo
4338720.short_description: 迎击铺天盖地的敌潮，筑起钢铁防线！在《圣火守望者：共筑防线》满屏怪物的围攻下，一边疯狂输出，一边即时建造塔楼、围墙与防御设施。搜刮随机神器，强化武器与英雄配置，死守竞技场中央的信标——只要信标未灭，战斗永不停歇！支持单人游玩，亦可2-4人热血联机。

4575220.title: Tactorius
4575220.short_description: A chess-based spell roguelite where strategy is created in the moment, not memorized. Equip 150+ spells, upgrade your pieces, and rewrite the rules. Grow a skill tree as you climb 7 towers of escalating enemies and bosses. Your mind is the armory.

4804600.title: Saintless Demo
4804600.short_description: Explore the halls of the underground cult of The Open Hand. Experience the test rooms setup for your initiation in this psychological horror exploration game. Never forget....they are always watching.

4780300.title: Text Dungeon: The Ring of Life Demo
4780300.short_description: 没有图形，没有方块，只有文字 RPG 冒险！ 探索不断变化的迷宫，从巫师辛戈尔手中夺回生命之戒。 类 Rogue 文本提示与叙事场景交织，带来 MUD 与游戏书般的沉浸体验。 死亡是永久的，每一次冒险都有新的发现。

4358260.title: Drawn Together
4358260.short_description: Doodle, communicate, and play your own drawing games with friends using your own desktop digital whiteboards!

2591850.title: Tribots
2591850.short_description: Robotic warrior of a mysterious army, you are now stranded on a world unknown. Alone or with other survivors of your battalion, lead a ruthless guerilla and take part in the reconquest of an entire planet. A cooperative experience for up to 5 players.

4608340.title: Blank Canvas
4608340.short_description: You are a painter, living in modest apartment. Paintings are your passion. Empty canvas awaits your imagination. Enter the blank world of the canvas and reveal the hidden world around you and find out what the passion wants to reveal.

1662010.title: Project Absentia
1662010.short_description: Play as an angel known as Abby in this retro shooter based on flash cartoons and sprite comics of days gone by focused on interactivity, verticality and cool weapons.

4338950.title: Nowhere Road Demo
4338950.short_description: Nowhere Road 是一款以战后城市为背景的冬季驾驶与出租车游戏。在安静的夜晚中驾驶、接送乘客，体验注重沉浸感与慢节奏驾驶的平静世界，而非速度与竞争。

4779880.title: Grid Wars: Last Stand Demo
4779880.short_description: Command a growing army in a fantasy tactical auto-battler. Place warriors, archers, monks, and heroes on an expanding grid, defend your keep against enemy waves, and conquer a world map filled with quests, rewards, and boss battles.

4683020.title: Adventure Honor Demo
4683020.short_description: 荣耀冒险是一款 Rogue-like 角色扮演游戏。在旅途中，你可以收集各种技能与道具来构筑角色；通过合适的增益与升级，在探索中不断成长，最终成为强大的战士。

4805340.title: THE LAST LOGIN Demo
4805340.short_description: THE LAST LOGIN is a psychological hacker thriller where you use GHOST//OS to exploit websites, intercept data, control cameras, and make dangerous choices as the voice in your head pushes you deeper into crime.

4434470.title: Dice Beauty: Roguelike Tactics Demo
4434470.short_description: Dice Beauty is a turn-based tactical roguelike where battles are fought with dice and elemental strategy. Face beautiful elemental heroines, exploit strengths and weaknesses, manage risk, and survive unpredictable runs where smart decisions matter more than luck.

4661910.title: Nexus Legacy
4661910.short_description: 在持久化科幻 4X MMO《Nexus Legacy》中，从一颗行星开始重建文明。殖民世界，管理资源，研究科技，指挥舰队，缔结联盟，并为一座鲜活银河的控制权而战。

4797740.title: Leash Kid Demo
4797740.short_description: 认识《Leash Kid》：一个有着“大计划”的小捣蛋鬼——世界上最顽皮的孩子……被拴着绳子。在商店里大闹一场，尽可能多地破坏商品（以及尽可能多的无辜路人），直到妈妈把你尖叫着拖走。

4782590.title: The Background Warrior Demo
4782590.short_description: Always open at the bottom of your screen, this idle game lets you advance through stages full of monsters. Master different jobs and become the strongest.

4784120.title: Drone Arena Demo
4784120.short_description: 《Drone Arena》是一款第三人称竞技场射击（TPS）肉鸽轻度（Roguelite）游戏，你将操控一架全副武装的无人机来击退无人机大军。从各种增益和道具中进行选择，打造独特的Build，并在竞技场中存活至巅峰。无存档点。杀敌、战死、总结、重来。

4806000.title: Waiting for Heaven Demo
4806000.short_description: Waiting for Heaven is a psychological first-person-horror experience about waiting at a lonely bus stop between life and death. Every decision counts. Your actions, patience, and behavior determine whether the final bus takes you to Heaven, Hell, or somewhere far worse.

4076270.title: Roguegg: Hardboiled Survivors
4076270.short_description: 《Roguegg：硬壳幸存者》是一款俯视视角的类Rogue弹幕生存游戏，你将扮演一颗勇敢的鸡蛋，对抗成群的虫子。收集升级、管理你的网格背包，并打造独特的装备组合，在它们把你炒成蛋之前活下来！

3743180.title: Dire Echo
3743180.short_description: **《Dire Echo》**是一款心理惊悚类步行模拟游戏，带领玩家沉浸于被遗弃的深空中那诡异而压抑的氛围中。

4615870.title: Kromex
4615870.short_description: 征服。掌控。主宰。 一款紧张刺激的竞技领地游戏，每占领一格都让你更接近胜利，而每一秒的疏忽都可能改变一切。

4729790.title: Demi Demo
4729790.short_description: 这款动作冒险游戏中，你将化身德米，勇敢深入索莫纳斯这个神奇的世界，听从神秘声音的指引，打倒传说中的诅咒巨兽，拯救这个世界。运用攻击招式和技能消灭敌人，破解谜题，揭开古老历史背后的真相。

4787870.title: Hawthorn Proof-of-Concept Demo
4787870.short_description: Former developers from Bethesda, BioWare, and Naughty Dog bring you a sandbox RPG realm of anthropomorphic animals and fairy creatures. Play co-op or solo as you build a village of memorable NPCs, farm, craft, explore, and celebrate the seasons in an ever-changing world bigger than you.

1297900.title: Gothic 1 Remake
1297900.short_description: 传奇归来——在这款定义了一个类别的经典角色扮演游戏的忠实重制版中，重返采矿之谷。探索一个手把手打造的、栩栩如生的开放世界，这个世界会对您的各种行动做出动态反应，为您带来无与伦比、不受拘束的体验。

4780080.title: Pibcremental Demo
4780080.short_description: A cozy, chaotic idle-incremental clicker about growing a civilisation of tiny creatures called Pibbles in a giant tree, set in a post-human world.

4355300.title: Soul Launder Inc. Demo
4355300.short_description: Chaotic couch co-op game for 2–4 players. Capture souls and launder them for cash at a shady afterlife corporation. Work together, hit quotas, and launder your way to heaven!

4801260.title: Rift Horizon Demo
4801260.short_description: A survivors-like action roguelike. Slay swarming enemies to gather souls, offer them at altars to unlock and upgrade passives, and combine 25 skills to build differently every run. Each run lasts around 20 minutes.

3597410.title: Goblin God Demo
3597410.short_description: In Goblin God, you rule a tribe of chaotic goblins! Build villages, defend against evil humans, and unleash divine powers to shape the world (or cause mayhem). Each island brings new challenges—will you lead your goblins to glory or just enjoy the chaos?

4285690.title: Airport Security Sucks!
4285690.short_description: 化身权力上头的 TSA 探员，追捕那些试图混入人群、偷运违禁品通过安检的玩家。 用威严的语音指令控制人群和你那只麻烦不断的 K9，并使用“合规设备”逮捕那些捣乱或藏在眼皮底下的走私者！

4807170.title: DA_RL Demo
4807170.short_description: DA_RL is a turn-based traditional roguelike with procedurally generated dungeons, five distinct classes, a god worship system, a deep item system, and dozens of enemy types. Every run is different.

4182710.title: Dustin Sunset
4182710.short_description: A post-apocalyptic world, a bastion of hope, the wasteland gangs united to destroy it, and only one man crazy enough to try to save it. Dustin Sunset is a vertical shoot ’em up with a touch of bullet hell and a whole lot of love, made by fans of the genre for fans of the genre.

4802450.title: Sender Unknown Demo
4802450.short_description: 在地下分拣中心上夜班。称重包裹，核对内容，在早上6点前完成定额。但请小心，有些包裹隐藏着黑暗的秘密。在这个紧张的PSX风格恐怖工作模拟器中，找出异常批次，赚取现金，并努力活过这一夜。

4131940.title: Shattered Chess
4131940.short_description: 构建超大型连击，打造打破游戏平衡的协同组合，并在改变规则的 Boss 战中生存下来——这是国际象棋的快节奏 Roguelike 变体。

4524620.title: Gambition Demo
4524620.short_description: 一款 Roguelike 国际象棋策略游戏，你的棋子将进化为更强大的形态，获得独特能力，并在不断变化的棋盘上构筑毁灭性的联动。

4658180.title: PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE Demo
4658180.short_description: Something's hiding in the cassette. Rearrange the words of your enemies to investigate a small-town conspiracy in this mystery puzzle game.

4530300.title: Plastic Ducks! World Simulator
4530300.short_description: A relaxing game where you place and customize rubber ducks on water, shape the scene by changing weather and time of day, set automatic camera angles for cinematic views and an in game radio lets you listen music and also add your own tracks, creating a personal space to unwind and relax

4789810.title: Defy The Abyss Demo
4789810.short_description: Survive relentless hordes in a dungeon deep within the Abyss. Swap between two heroes, unleash powerful spell combinations, and crush nightmares, demons, and immense horrors to grow stronger with every run.

2988310.title: BloodSworn Demo
2988310.short_description: BloodSworn is an intense, FPS Roguelite where players navigate through various levels with an arsenal of diverse weapons and magic in a blood-soaked, and terrifying adventure.

4248080.title: Mewlin the Clicker
4248080.short_description: 点击滚动水晶球，躲避障碍并挑战首领，同时构筑每局都会改变策略的卡组。帮助好奇的橙色猫 Mewlin，在这款魔法点击游戏中制造混乱。

4813020.title: Factorwave Demo
4813020.short_description: Fast-paced factory builder with combat and territorial logistics. Automate production, unlock powerful Sector Hub bonuses, defend your infrastructure, and expand across a hostile planet.

4792780.title: 20 Floors Down Demo
4792780.short_description: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

4688660.title: Hovertron Demo
4688660.short_description: Hoverboard your way through a physics-based platformer. Easy to learn but hard to master; Flow and flip through a series of levels to chase perfect runs. Compete on a global scoreboard, or hunt down the secrets hidden throughout the game.

4744780.title: Loop Dungeon - Incremental Demo
4744780.short_description: 带领英雄小队挑战无尽循环地牢。收集战利品、解锁永久成长，并构筑强大的队伍联动，在不断扩张的增量冒险中突破极限。

4537640.title: Black Powder Box
4537640.short_description: Black Powder Box is a sandbox FPS focusing on PvE and EvE combat, a level editor, and both realistic and sci-fi environments. Create and play your own levels—or the ones built in-game. Join NPC factions in combat, solve traps and puzzles, and destroy things in your way!

4755000.title: Hug Factory Demo
4755000.short_description: Hug people to generate electricity to sell for money to upgrade your hugging skills to hug people to generate electricity to sell for money to upgrade your hugging skills to hug people to generate electricity to sell for money to upgrade your hugging skills to hug people to generate...

4252090.title: Down Under Destruction - Demo
4252090.short_description: Down Under Destruction is a stylised first person action brawler with an Australian twist, featuring a vengeful bricklayer taking on a demonically influenced building corporation, one brick throw at a time.

4738540.title: Time to Love
4738540.short_description: Time to Love is a 2D, top-down, co-op roguelike centered around two protagonists trying to keep reality from collapsing. You will traverse from timeline to timeline, strengthening yourself from each unique branch, seeking to bind what little remains after past mistakes.

4796120.title: Screenbound Demo
4796120.short_description: 《屏行世界》让你通过酷宝掌机探索双重现实！游走于棘手谜题之间，在众多关卡中奋战到底，体验融合了2D与3D的全球首款“5D”平台跳跃游戏。

4752320.title: ELEMENTAL RUN Demo
4752320.short_description: ELEMENTAL RUN is a first-person 3D endless runner. Navigate through increasingly dense traffic and survive as long as possible. By jumping, sliding,at the right moments.

3413170.title: Birds Hunter
3413170.short_description: Immerse yourself in the ultimate bird hunting experience with realistic shot physics, authentic ammunition simulation, and lifelike birds in detailed environments. Accuracy matters, can you master the hunt?

4688610.title: Solaris
4688610.short_description: 《索拉里斯》是一个关于追寻愿望与寻找自我的旅途故事。主角为了实现亲人的遗愿，遇到了许多奇怪又有趣的角色。路上充满欢笑，但走得越远，就越能感觉到：在温馨的表面之下，某种古老而可怕的东西正在苏醒。

4220350.title: Lord Of Anatolia
4220350.short_description: 带领14世纪安纳托利亚的卡耶部落，从小营地走向辉煌的桑贾克。建立你的王朝，管理拥有真实性格的村民，度过四季与袭击——一款深度殖民管理游戏。独立开发者倾注两年心血。

4627740.title: Death Standing
4627740.short_description: Death Standing is the first of its kind 'Stand' type of game, where the player has to do nothing but hold still for a set amount of time.

4071090.title: Tiny Town Market Simulator
4071090.short_description: Manage your own shop in a tiny toy town that comes to life! Grow crops, raise animals, craft handmade goods, and expand your market in this relaxing yet engaging management simulator that keeps evolving over time.

4781840.title: Bullet Train Demo
4781840.short_description: Welcome on the Bullet Train: destroy enemy towers, collect powerful orbs and improve your train! Navigate through escalating enemy territory to defeat the creatures that destroyed your town!

4793540.title: Online Boxing 3D Demo
4793540.short_description: A physics-driven boxing simulation where every punch is calculated in real time. Master timing, positioning, and footwork to outbox your opponent.

4062600.title: A Week in Paradise
4062600.short_description: 《桃源七日》是一款互动叙事解谜游戏。探索你抵达一家名为《帕拉迪斯》的酒吧的奇特经历，与酒吧里那位魅力四射的常客一起喝到天亮。每晚，在梦境中解开束缚记忆的线索。

4806400.title: Forest of Numbers Demo
4806400.short_description: Guide a hungry little monster through arcade-style number challenges by eating correct answers, avoiding danger, and building high scores in a colorful educational adventure.

4346450.title: Stoned to Death
4346450.short_description: While trapped in a stunning forested wilderness, engage in brutal hand-to-hand combat with a notorious durg cartel producing dangerous illegal drugs to uncover the mysteries of their crimes.

3734700.title: Wonder Warp
3734700.short_description: An Alien Threat Has Emerged in the City of Cynosure! Run and gun through a series of mazes to defeat the monsters.

4792490.title: Left Fore Dead: Zombie Battle Golf Demo
4792490.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer golf game where zombies keep showing up and your friends make everything worse.

4709290.title: Ashen Knight Demo
4709290.short_description: A dark fantasy survivor roguelike with automatic combat, where every run starts from nothing. Unlock unique heroes, experiment with powerful skill builds, and survive relentless enemy waves.

4794840.title: Gravy the gravedigger Demo
4794840.short_description: Gravy the gravedigger is a great journey of Gravy the frog through an unknown and mysterious cemetery. However, what brings our hero to such a strange place? Even the little cemetery caretaker doesn't know the reason, and it's up to us to help him in exploring this place.

4801530.title: TV Boy Demo
4801530.short_description: A Demo for TV Boy! An action packed top-down shooter. Blast waves of weird and whacky enemies with even weirder weapons to rescue the captured citizens of TV Topia and restore peace to the galaxy!

4613470.title: GlowCore
4613470.short_description: GlowCore is a singleplayer progression game focused on resource gathering and gradual world expansion. In the center of the world lies the GlowCore. The goal is to expand the world by feeding the GlowCore with wood and other resources.

4793410.title: Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs Demons Demo
4793410.short_description: Fight through a chaotic island overrun by zombies and demons in this fast-paced action survival game. Explore Ibiza, battle hordes of enemies, upgrade your weapons, and survive the madness alone or with friends.

4778550.title: MetalGods Demo
4778550.short_description: Live the metal dream. Rise from bedroom musician to stadium legend in this deep career simulation. Write songs, record albums, recruit bandmates, and compete against real licensed bands and procedurally generated rivals. Your metal empire starts now. FORGE YOUR LEGACY

4654020.title: Ball & Gun
4654020.short_description: Ball & Gun is a genre-bending, Sports-FPS game where you master your jump shot and an evolving arsenal of divine weaponry to hold back the undead. This isn't just about survival; it’s about becoming a Basketball God in the Ballpocalypse. A ball. A gun. Zombies. This is the new definitive shooter.

4794760.title: 核心防线 core defense line Demo
4794760.short_description: 你是一名云端运维者，在《核心防线 core defense line》中，您将扮演一名云端运维者，为守护核心，抵御源源不断地病毒入侵，自定义建立防线，构筑卡牌，安装各种创意十足的插件，让你有多种攻击方式，修复局外节点，同时也会给你提供更加便捷的防守

4721000.title: Backrooms: Blackhole
4721000.short_description: Backrooms: Blackhole is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Somewhere deep within the endless halls, reality begins collapsing into a growing void that consumes light, sound, and everything around it. The deeper you descend, the less the world makes sense — and the harder...

4597830.title: Spacefield
4597830.short_description: Navigate a high-speed procedural abyss in this minimalist sci-fi runner. Dodge evolving cube formations, collect coins for powerups, and track threats with your advanced HUD. Test your reflexes in a pure, 90+ FPS pursuit of the infinite.

3014580.title: Follow Us
3014580.short_description: 这是一款双人合作恐怖游戏，两位玩家将冒着生命危险外出探索，只为取悦那些足不出户的观众。在《Follow Us》中，参赛者两人一组：一人负责探索，一人负责指引。信任，就是你们的生命线。

4376510.title: Snack Factory Together Demo
4376510.short_description: 一起管理一个零食工厂！生产各种美食以获得最大利润。升级机器，解锁新产品，并交付大订单。你能应对需求吗？

4688470.title: 东岚男子体育学院 越线
4688470.short_description: 故事发生在一所私立 MMA 学院中，一名自律克制的学员与一个难以预测的对手，在训练、对抗和夜晚的张力中不断碰撞，直到竞争关系逐渐变成别的东西。

4442380.title: 关守神 Demo
4442380.short_description: 《关守神》是一款以“被病娇青年无条件地深爱着”为核心概念的剧情向冒险游戏。 在异界的极乐堂，少女与一名神秘青年并肩行动，处理看似普通却暗藏玄机的委托。 随着一次次选择的积累，角色之间的关系逐渐发生变化，而这个世界被隐藏的真相，也将悄然浮现。

4121000.title: Pinbowling
4121000.short_description: Pinbowling is a combination of pinball and bowling. Knock over all 10 pins using classic pinball controls. Play a standard 10 frame game on your choice of two difficulties, or test your skills in challenge mode by avoiding and controlling obstacles.

3790030.title: 二手游戏店模拟器 试玩版
3790030.short_description: 从零称霸二手游戏圈！不管是AAA大作还是小众独立，这里应有尽有！凭毒辣眼光淘稀有狠货，靠灵活手腕划定市场格局。收售倒卖、轻松议价。从地摊小贩蜕变为搅动二手游戏江湖的幕后大佬，你的传奇，从此刻开场！

4633750.title: ResistanceZ Demo
4633750.short_description: ResistanceZ is a co-op survival action horror game for up to four players, where teamwork is essential to survive against hordes of zombies and mutants. Fight off waves of enemies with your friends and stay alive!

4674310.title: Airport Mania: First Flight
4674310.short_description: 在这款节奏紧张的时间管理游戏中掌控天空！指挥可爱的飞机降落跑道，引导它们驶向登机口完成旅客登机，再发出起飞许可赢取高分。升级机场设施、应对繁忙的航班流量，让你的卡通机队准点翱翔！

4590540.title: Baulk Demo
4590540.short_description: 体验每一次击球都充满风险的单人台球。一只大象掌管着这场游戏。安全与诅咒回合的顺序被完全隐藏。清空台面以购买道具，但千万别在诅咒回合进球。

4704650.title: ProviderHero
4704650.short_description: A relationship survival game where every choice has consequences. Keep Jessica happy for 30 days or face her wrath.

4738060.title: Pour Decisions
4738060.short_description: 一款温馨的咖啡馆经营游戏，悠闲的清晨将让位于忙碌的高峰时段。利用基于物理的饮品机制拖拽、倾倒、同时处理多个订单，一边将你的咖啡馆扩展到整个城市。

3515530.title: Ice Cream Simulator
3515530.short_description: 在 Ice Cream Simulator 中经营你梦想中的冰淇淋店！使用各种食材制作美味冰淇淋，管理你的店铺，雇佣员工，装饰店面，并应对不同天气与各种顾客。

3791870.title: Xeno Swarm - 异虫强袭
3791870.short_description: 《异虫强袭》是一款硬核横版飞行射击游戏，和你的伙伴一起迎战铺天盖地的异形虫群，在异星战场上和巨型BOSS展开生死对决，重温子弹横飞的爽快！

4533120.title: Apathema Demo
4533120.short_description: Cursed to repair the inner organs of The Chasm, you fight to uncover the secrets of your existence and end a self-devouring cycle of Apathy. Apathema is a grunge fantasy turn-based RPG, inspired by God Husk, Baroque, and King's Field.

4699280.title: Urbex Simulator
4699280.short_description: Can you explore an abandoned building filled with cannibal squatters! Avoid a serial killer known as "The Urbex Killer" and find out what eldritch horrors lie beneath! A strategic RPG maker horror shoot-em-up where you fight against squatters who want you dead!

3324250.title: 杀手精神病兔子… 在太空！新星拓荒～
3324250.short_description: 这是一款科幻生存Roguelite游戏，本作将“弹幕肉鸽射击”的极限割草爽感，与“基地建造即时战略”的运筹帷幄融为一体。在这个充斥着异星敌潮的残酷战场上，你既能享受高机动走位、火力清屏的动作快感，也能通过即时规划自动化防御网，体验拔地建城、碾压一切的策略乐趣。

3601600.title: 百创数独 Bactron
3601600.short_description: Sudoku Bactron 是由 Bactron 开发的一款具有逻辑性的数字填充游戏，游戏提供了随机模式、冒险模式。玩家也可以自己设计一个关卡，不断验证唯一解，使谜题只有一个答案。

3888660.title: 溺光症 Photophobia
3888660.short_description: 午夜叩响大门的奇怪玩偶熊，班上突然出现的神秘转校生，随着两位陌生的少女闯入你的世界，你平静的生活有了翻天覆地的变化。但没有任何关于她们记忆的你却发现，你好像对她们总是有莫名的熟悉感。经历这一切的你能否能平衡时间的天平，勘破真相，找到你心中的答案呢?

4701680.title: GeckoShop 2 Demo
4701680.short_description: Open boxes and collect geckos. Merge them in your lab to create new mutations, then sell or keep 'em. Decorate your new home, and build machines to automate every step.

3420020.title: Abyss Born
3420020.short_description: Abyss Born is a single-player dark action RPG with survival and dungeon crawler elements. Fight various monsters, explore dangerous dungeons, trade with allies and complete quests to face evil.

4629610.title: Chroma Climb: Reclaim Your Color
4629610.short_description: Climb toward the summit in a 3D parkour action game built around jumping, sprinting, and ledge grabs. As you gain height, a monochrome world blooms back into color while rain, sandstorms, and falling hazards force quick route decisions. Play solo or online with up to 8 players.

4737310.title: Parfait Crane
4737310.short_description: Parfait Crane is a physics-based 3D fruit stacking arcade game. Drop, merge, and stack fruits with a crane, chase high scores, and try not to let your parfait collapse.

4788740.title: Spooky Action Demo
4788740.short_description: Two objects. One bond. Move one — the other reacts. A minimalist logic puzzle game about quantum entanglement. 100+ levels. No randomness. No mercy.

3723050.title: 贝塔危机
3723050.short_description: 这是一款以暗黑都市为背景的第三人称怪物射击游戏。你需要击退怪异凶残的变异怪物，搜集道具与钥匙，破解谜题以求生存。

4764180.title: 百创数独 Bactron 编辑器试用版
4764180.short_description: 这不是一个完整游戏，这是关于《Sudoku Bactron》提供的一个用于数独格子的编辑器。

4690530.title: 牧羊人 Demo
4690530.short_description: 这是一部以末日求生为背景的，关于人性、杀戮和命运的视觉小说。在人类文明湮灭之后，在一切秩序都被打破的废土中，几名幸存者的相遇会碰撞出怎样的火花？死亡是终点吗？新世界又将如何来临？
developers: 黑眼圈工厂 Dark Circle Studio
publishers: 黑眼圈工厂 Dark Circle Studio

4715920.title: SCAVENGER ZERO Demo
4715920.short_description: RESTORE HOPE IN A HOPELESS WORLD. Fight hordes of enemies, make choices, and decide the fate of the universe.

4637650.title: Animal UFO
4637650.short_description: A chaotic UFO racing action game where up to 16 animals scramble to steal candy.

4613360.title: Overvoid Demo
4613360.short_description: Overvoid - is a dark sci-fi third-person action roguelike. You are a starship pilot trapped in an endless cycle across hostile space sectors. Fight relentless enemy waves, experiment with builds, gather resources, and unlock weapons, ships, and modules to break the cycle.

4611910.title: YGGDRA: SURVIVOR Demo
4611910.short_description: "You want ME to save the world? I'm just a convenience store part-timer!" A black tower threatens Earth. Summon 30 legendary heroes to climb 100 floors! Roguelite defense meets bullet-hell survival. Command your champions from zero to hero!

4721120.title: BOT.vinnik Chess: USSR vs the World Demo
4721120.short_description: 世界联合了他们最强的特级大师来挑战我们！但他们忘了一件事：苏联国际象棋学派是无与伦比的。入座吧，同志。是时候向全球展示谁才是64格真正的统治者了！

4608590.title: Hawkshaw Case: Truth & Prevention Demo
4608590.short_description: The Demo for Hawkshaw Case: Truth & Prevention. Play the first part of the first case! Learn the basics and have a little fun too!

4413200.title: Hawkshaw Case: Truth & Prevention
4413200.short_description: Investigate crime scenes, interrogate witnesses and organize your evidence to catch the culprit. Solve multiple different cases in varying areas and talk to many unique and fun characters. Can you solve it? Come and see.

4414550.title: Peril in Prymkos
4414550.short_description: Embark on a quest through the magical world of Prymkos. Explore ancient ruins, uncover hidden secrets, and face the mysterious Priests of Shaana in this story-driven fantasy RPG.

4689010.title: 单词荣耀
4689010.short_description: 通过拼写、默写、听写三种模式，在打字中掌握英语单词。涵盖小学、初中、高中、4级、6级词汇，从基础词汇到进阶挑战，每一次敲击都在提升你的拼写准确度与听力反应。

4481730.title: アノマロゲノス Demo
4481730.short_description: Anomalogenos is a fishing shooter where you spin the reel to shoot and dodge enemy bullets! You can create a variety of builds using different skills! Challenge yourself to dive deeper and search for stronger fish and better rewards! The demo lets you enjoy about one-sixth of the full game's content

4072570.title: Labyrinth's Depths
4072570.short_description: Step into a dark survival horror rooted in Greek mythology. Navigate a deadly labyrinth and evade the relentless Minotaur while seeking a way to end the beast’s reign.

3634340.title: 吾皇万岁
3634340.short_description: 《吾皇万岁》是一款皇帝模拟游戏。你将穿越到古代中国一个风雨飘摇的朝代，在帝国动荡中登基为帝。选贤举能重振皇权威严，纳妃育嗣延续帝王血脉，练兵征战肃清氏族封君。是代代传承打造开元盛世，还是沦为亡国之君？

4712320.title: 黄昏远征军 试玩版
4712320.short_description: “何等铁砧，何等熔炉，掐住骇人的雷霆？” 在这款暗黑风的战术RPG中，你将扮演退役铁匠索伦，在灰烬与血海中集结一群伤痕累累的同盟。于方寸死局间运筹帷幄，直面疯狂的十字军与撕裂帷幕的诡秘魔物。挥舞利刃，精算协同，但请谨慎你的每一次落子——因为比死亡更令人战栗的，是无声剥落的理智。

4798550.title: Carpet Cleaning Simulator Demo
4798550.short_description: 清洗地毯、赚取金钱并不断强化的增量游戏。 擦、冲、刮——在时间重置之前尽可能赚更多！

4556110.title: Kinetype
4556110.short_description: KINETYPE is a minimalist, terminal, ASCII, roguelite where your keyboard is the interface for survival. Navigate procedural terminal grids by typing commands to move and survive. Extract to bank Bytes for permanent upgrades, or lose your streak to the system. The terminal is yours to command.

4771840.title: Corner King: Boxing Tycoon Demo
4771840.short_description: 经营属于你的拳击馆，在这款深度拳击经营模拟游戏中发掘人才、培养冠军、管理合同、宿敌关系、伤病与冠军挑战赛，并在钟声响起时于拳台边亲自指挥比赛。

4748340.title: 137_DEMO_BUILD
4748340.short_description: CONNECTION ESTABLISHED TO 137 BETA BRANCH WELCOME USER

4634920.title: 光与影之恋 Chiaroscuro Lovers Demo
4634920.short_description: 只对妹妹温柔的霸总姐姐、多年担任主治的院长青梅还有只有自己才能看到的元气少女……失忆前的楚鹤白究竟是怎么招惹到她们的呢？“再后来，她成为了你的影子。” 一部略有些伤感的百合AVG，讲述着那些崩塌，遗憾，以及尚未说出口的爱。
publishers: 北京黎羽科技有限公司

4524000.title: 红线
4524000.short_description: 《红线》是一款卡牌回合制的科幻剧情游戏。玩家操控位于南极的“异常收容所”的所长，与突破收容的异常生命体战斗。 你将通过卡牌战斗、完成事件并获得奖励，以此构筑风格各异的卡组，并最终击败强大的收容物来完成剧情。

4635540.title: 韭神：技能炒股
4635540.short_description: 一买就跌，一卖就涨？受够了当韭菜？欢迎来到《韭神：技能炒股》——在这里，系统亲自给你发挂！ 这不是模拟器，而是一款让你用超能力炒股的肉鸽游戏。忘掉K线图，你的技能才是王道。 每局都是全新的市场，角色技能搭配随机生成的道具与周末奇遇。构建你的无敌流派，在十分钟内完成从散户到“股神”的速通，体验嘲讽资本的快感！ 系统都让我开挂了，凭什么不能赢？

4664290.title: Blueprint: EV Demo
4664290.short_description: Blueprint: EV Demo is a single-player strategy game about founding an electric vehicle company and running it through six fiscal years. Make five binding decisions at the start, then guide pricing, production, R&D, and finance across 8 quarters of real P&L and three rivals companies.

2470150.title: Mirth Island Demo
2470150.short_description: 《Mirth Island》是一款温馨的节奏冒险游戏。你将扮演一只名叫多多的小鸭子，在重返家乡后，与伙伴们齐心协力，重建岛上那座传奇剧院。探索生机勃勃的岛屿，与可爱的居民们互动，并畅玩有趣的节奏小游戏。

4753020.title: Miraclawns Demo
4753020.short_description: 这是一款通过“赌博”强化史莱姆的独特肉鸽策略游戏。作为魔王，通过影响命运的赌博来改变小史莱姆的属性，并将其送往战场。扭转严酷战局的，究竟是你的判断力，还是那绝对的“运气”？

4753450.title: 唬牌
4753450.short_description: 这是一款以欺骗与推理为核心的经典纸牌游戏。每轮声明一个牌面，玩家可出真牌也可大胆唬牌——对手能看穿你的谎言吗？两个性格各异的对手等待你的挑战，先出完手牌即可获胜。30秒限时回合，策略与心理博弈的完美结合。

4742330.title: 经典：贪吃蛇
4742330.short_description: 致敬经典永流传的贪吃蛇游戏。使用方向键操控小蛇，吞食食物让它变长，注意不要撞到墙壁或自己的身体。解锁成就，在全球排行榜上一较高下。上手简单，让人欲罢不能。

4620690.title: Corelith Demo
4620690.short_description: Corelith is a wave-based roguelike top-down action game. Explore the Corelith Dungeon, craft Skill Cores, and create your own unique build.

4742270.title: Cozy Game Restoration Demo
4742270.short_description: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

3818900.title: 宝石少女 2nd.cut:For the Exquisite Attire
3818900.short_description: 斩杀她，是永罚，还是救赎？在纯爱与嫉妒交织的珀亚教会里，年轻的宝石工匠被逼作出抉择：是让她活下去，还是——让她死去。

4481150.title: 爆射的哈基米 - 哈基米幸存者 Demo
4481150.short_description: 《爆射的哈基米》是一款快节奏的肉鸽弹幕射击游戏。你将扮演哈基米，搭配使用多种技能挑战海量的敌人。

4800320.title: HEME Demo
4800320.short_description: "HEME is a deep narrative journey inspired by real-life struggles. Experience emotional storytelling through sincere dialogues in a 2D atmospheric side-scrolling world. Follow a journey that mirrors the weight of reality. Join us and discover the meaning of life."

4798060.title: Retro Rail GO! Demo
4798060.short_description: 驾驶怀旧风格的日式列车，穿行于繁忙的城市线路和标志性路线。遵循时刻表、信号和车站规则，成为驾驶大师。在这款复古1990年代主机风格模拟器中，你可选择轻松之旅或严格专业挑战。

4787130.title: Mighty X Arms Demo
4787130.short_description: 马蒂 X 昂是一款受《土豆兄弟》启发的肉鸽幸存者游戏，拥有名为"昂"的可收集武器生物。组建你的阵容，升级强化，碾碎敌群，坚持活下去。

4694810.title: Pit Wizard Demo
4694810.short_description: Pit Wizard is an incremental bullet hell game where you blast your way through hordes of monsters while dodging brutal hazards to collect loot, grow a massive skill tree, become the ultimate wizard, and save the day.

4581780.title: BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO Demo
4581780.short_description: THE STANDALONE SEQUEL OF THE BRAZILIAN BOOMER SHOOTER GAME MADE USING THE ID TECH 2 ENGINE! SHOOT, JUMP, DOUBLE JUMP AND DASH! EMBARK ON A JOURNEY THROUGHOUT THE STATE OF RIO DE JANEIRO, SÃO PAULO, SALVADOR, HELL AND EVEN HEAVEN! SAVE BRAZIL!

4806430.title: Letterbane Demo
4806430.short_description: A dark word-building roguelite with the depth of a deckbuilder. Draw magical letter stones, form devastating words, shape powerful SPELLCASTS and create elemental builds that evolve into screen-filling magical chaos. A deckbuilder without cards...

4798420.title: Gal Sumo Demo
4798420.short_description: A group of high school girls dedicate their youth to women’s sumo. Their intense battles are brought to life through tabletop sumo in this competitive action game. Simple controls, deep mind games. Includes Arcade, Local, and Online Versus modes.

4290720.title: 扑克战士 Demo
4290720.short_description: 这是一款以扑克牌花色为核心的肉鸽卡牌战斗游戏。红桃、黑桃、方块与草花分别影响生存、攻击、金钱与运气。通过构筑与卡牌融合，你可以不断改写规则，尝试不同流派与组合，打造属于你的最强卡组。

4789150.title: [ABERRATION] THE ANALYST Demo
4789150.short_description: Dexton-City vanished, leaving only a 14.2-meter deep void and one corrupted neural recording. As a PRISM analyst, relive Field Agent Meg Simons' final hours. Experience the exact terrifying visions that shattered her mind. A 15-minute psychological horror prologue to the [ABERRATION] anthology.

4370860.title: Black Plague
4370860.short_description: 一款快节奏的肉鸽生存混乱游戏，击败无尽的瘟疫怪潮，叠加疯狂强化，并打破力量规则。

4803380.title: TO THE CENTER OF THE EARTH Demo
4803380.short_description: To The Center Of The Earth is a arcade style twin-stick shooter where you are tasked to dig as deep into the earth as possible, gathering as much treasure as possible!

4756980.title: The Belt Demo
4756980.short_description: A hardcore precision platformer built around a relentless moving conveyor belt. Master unlockable movement stances, adapt to escalating traps, and survive a brutal mechanical gauntlet where every mistake matters.

4796540.title: Weaponized Demo
4796540.short_description: Weaponized is a violent mining hooter. You are an asteroid miner whose employer recently expanded into mining hell. Use your machine gun to carve through asteroids and extract ore. Grab and hurl enemies, snipe through rocks, fight massive bosses. Make your quota and get out before it's too late.

4811900.title: Bitvania Demo
4811900.short_description: Bitvania 是一款混乱的动作平台游戏，在游戏中你完全处于无武装状态。你将穿越一个逐渐衰亡的黑暗奇幻世界，通过捡起地上的任何物品进行战斗——从匕首到榴莲，甚至是你妈妈最喜欢的拖鞋。管理你的耐力，并利用 1% 的概率触发巨额暴击伤害。

4710240.title: Shadow & Steel Demo
4710240.short_description: Shadow & Steel is a top-down hack-and-slash arena shooter set in a fantasy world. Battle hordes of undead, demons, and living nightmares designed to push your combat skills to the limit. Strike up close with your blade and weave arcane spells from a distance.

4794340.title: Life on Neptune Demo
4794340.short_description: Build a new life and a new home on a distant planet. Explore islands to find furniture for your house. Meet aliens and make the best of a strange situation. A Life on NEPTUNE awaits.

4650350.title: BCKSPCE
4650350.short_description: BCKSPCE, FOR A MESSAGE UNSENT as you spend the week with Stella, a close friend of yours, uncovering the mysteries of the long since abandoned SPECTRE OS. Despite her enthusiasm, something seems off with her... just don't let it bother you.

2893990.title: Ninjas on Trampolines
2893990.short_description: What if ninjas fought in a trampoline park, but with paint?

2980110.title: Electro Havoc
2980110.short_description: Electro Havoc: A retro twin-stick shooter set in a neon-charged battleground where you'll face waves of geometric foes across 3 worlds. Lure more enemies into debris fields to trigger chain reactions, and grab power-ups to boost your multipliers.

4801130.title: Nimaat Demo
4801130.short_description: 直面堕落的诸神，在残酷的战斗中求生，在信仰本身化为敌意的世界里塑造尼玛特的命运。 这是一款以扭曲的古埃及为背景的黑暗心理恐怖回合制RPG。

4782290.title: Talas Demo
4782290.short_description: 穿越深空，火力全开。撕碎一波波敌人，揭开隐藏在表象之下的秘密，在这款复古风格的动作类 Roguelike 中探索无尽的协同组合，对抗致命的弹幕 Boss 与神秘遭遇。

4673140.title: 67 Minutes in Heaven
4673140.short_description: 你的邻居邀请你参加一场四人约会，并撮合你和从外地来的新女孩。在潜入一栋废弃的房子后，你的邻居提议大家一起玩个游戏：天堂67分钟。

4628990.title: Apothecurse Demo
4628990.short_description: Faced with expulsion from his order, fledgling alchemist Leon must brave the seas and travel to Port Gelour, a plague-ridden city on the brink of revolution. Craft potent potions, befriend quirky locals, and uncover the dark secrets lurking beneath the waves in a quest for alchemy and discovery!

4805060.title: Fishbait Demo
4805060.short_description: Dive into Fishbait, a 4-player survival card game where every draw is a gamble. Avoid the Traps, play your cards right, and sabotage your rivals in a race to be the last fish swimming. Fast-paced, strategic, and dangerously addictive.

4723310.title: NO MORE COWS Demo
4723310.short_description: Physics-based co-op platformer where you and your friend must abduct a cow and drag it all the way from a barn to a laboratory in space. Survive traps, zero gravity, and friendship-breaking chaos in online co-op for 2 players.

4489650.title: The Isle of Lost Bees Demo
4489650.short_description: Welcome to the Isle of Lost Bees, a cozy idle game where you and your collection of Australian bees harvest pollen, research flowers, and uncover the island’s secrets. You're a bee-obsessed researcher on an island devoid of humans. You never seemed to need human contact anyway.

3723750.title: 集换式卡牌检验员 Trading Card Inspector
3723750.short_description: 在《全球最酷集换式卡牌游戏》中，通过数十张独特搞笑的卡牌展开你的调查之旅！ 以官方集换式卡牌检查员的身份开启新工作，揭开一段关于友谊、企业间谍活动与谋杀案的传奇故事！

4729100.title: Management In Space Demo
4729100.short_description: Management In Space is a gritty sci-fi strategy roguelite where you find yourself in debt. Build, mine, trade, date, and defend using stations across the galaxy, all while wars swells, aliens devastate sectors, and cults rip the galaxy apart & release demons upon the cosmos.

4788340.title: Folclore Xamin Demo
4788340.short_description: 《Folclore Xamin》是一款主打激烈的2D动作平台与“Run and Gun”游戏。拥有精美的手绘动画，你将控制使用自然之力的Xamin双胞胎。熟练掌握射击、跳跃和冲刺(Dash)，击败森林之灵，征服亚马逊！

4816160.title: Throne of Decisions Demo
4816160.short_description: Throne of Decisions 是一款以中世纪为背景的卡牌策略游戏，每一个抉择都将塑造未来。作为国王，你需要通过批准或拒绝臣民的请求来维持权力平衡。决定子民的命运，带领你的王国走向辉煌或毁灭。

4725740.title: Dark Sorcery Demo
4725740.short_description: Dark Sorcery 是一款暗黑奇幻 Roguelite 游戏，你将在其中对抗无尽敌潮、解锁强力升级并打造毁灭性构筑。精通移动、传送与策略，在愈发危险的敌人浪潮中生存下来。

4567400.title: Arcane Arena: Survivors Demo
4567400.short_description: Arcane Arena Survivors is a fast-paced roguelike horde-survivor set in a grand magical arena. Wield powerful spells, battle endless waves, defeat mighty champions and prove yourself as the ultimate master of magic.

4001360.title: Nowhere To Go
4001360.short_description: A call leads you to an abandoned theme park. Now you’re not leaving until you know what really happened in the infamous theme park.

4715100.title: Wiseman: No More Breakups Demo
4715100.short_description: Fight through a moving train in a stylish rhythm-combat boss rush where timed four-button inputs become your attacks. Defeat absurd bosses, survive relationship chaos, and help August Wiseman get his phone back.

3236230.title: Paper Cannon
3236230.short_description: Paper Cannon 是一款通过简单操作击破球体的高上瘾休闲射击游戏。在每个关卡的末尾与Boss对战，强化你的大炮，摧毁从天而降的一切！哇哦！

4666270.title: ANVİLFALL Demo
4666270.short_description: 管理最后的矮人要塞。战前制定部队计划，带领战士生存下去，不断发展壮大，搜寻资源，招募更强大的部队，并观察你的决策如何影响战斗结果。

4748540.title: CHOPSTICKS: Stick Figure Fighting Demo
4748540.short_description: CHOPSTICKS is a stick figure fighting game set across the globe. With just one attack button and a focus on parrying, strategy is key. Each map opens up unique gameplay opportunities with map specific elements: from giant lasers to sticks that can be used as swords!

4428460.title: SINDIKAT
4428460.short_description: SINDIKAT is an online board game about business and money: buy companies, upgrade assets, collect rent, and outplay your friends in the fight for full control of the city.

4780160.title: Shadows of Fortificar Demo
4780160.short_description: A hybrid role-playing visual novel based on Dungeons&Dragons. Players take control of one of five playable characters, each of whom offers a different perspective on the story. The story is set in an original universe - the city of Fortificar, which has been struck by an incurable plague.

4776140.title: Featherless Demo
4776140.short_description: You’re a duck. You’re armed. Everything wants you dead. Fair enough. Blast through hordes of enemies, discover ridiculous weapon combos, and grow stronger every run in this chaotic roguelike shooter.

4365660.title: Fenestra Demo
4365660.short_description: A fusion of semi-turn-based battles and roguelike mechanics. Assemble a party of 3 heroes, explore dynamic dungeons, and discover powerful builds as you fight your way through fearsome monsters. Plan ahead and adapt to your surroundings, or meet your inevitable end.

4757600.title: Ampsball - Demo
4757600.short_description: Ampsball is a 5v5 action-packed sport that combines superhero powers under the beautiful Southern California sunshine. Grab a pair of sunglasses, a beach towel, and your most wrinkled cape for a sport that will make your arch-nemeses want to join in.

4776030.title: The Hat Man Demo
4776030.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game inspired by The Hat Man urban legend, focusing on sleep paralysis, fear, and the terror of being unable to move.

4683720.title: BioEden Demo
4683720.short_description: 此为《创生伊甸》游戏的试玩版本。来化身守护者，步入一段温暖治愈的经营之旅吧。在这里，你将为一颗静静等待疗愈的星球重新唤回生机。为数十种奇妙动物打造理想栖息地，迎接它们重返这个世界。充分发挥你的小巧思，让你的星球在一个个生态系统的修复中逐步复苏。

3553150.title: The Cascadier
3553150.short_description: 街机投币Roguelike游戏，搭配弹珠物理！打造强力卡组，投掷元素金币，引爆神级连招与隐藏路径，冲击高分！

4684710.title: The Sinking City 2 Demo
4684710.short_description: 设定于“咆哮的二十年代”，《The Sinking City 2》是一款浸润洛夫克拉夫特式恐惧的生存恐怖游戏。直面远古邪神，探索被洪水淹没的阿卡姆街巷，在亡者的追猎中前行，在一条生命与整座城市之间做出抉择。

4802540.title: Mist Weavers Demo
4802540.short_description: Forget near-idle gameplay. Control both Weaver and Familiar in a unique dual-control survivor-like. Build powerful synergies, survive endless hordes, and master two characters at once.

4807300.title: ABISMO Demo
4807300.short_description: ABISMO is a co-op deep-sea horror game set on the abyssal floor of an alien planet. Descend alone or with up to 4 players into shifting trenches, explore derelict facilities, and recover what you need to survive while uncovering an analog-horror mystery hidden in corrupted VHS tapes.

4768500.title: Necrofane Demo
4768500.short_description: 王国陷入危机。在为时已晚之前，打败死灵法师和他的黑暗将军们。探索被诅咒的土地，面对致命生物，学习禁忌魔法，在濒临崩溃的世界中寻找强大的武器。

4696570.title: Anomalous zone
4696570.short_description: You will have to visit an anomalous zone from which there is no exit unless you possess an artifact with which you can open a portal, an exit from the zone

4794670.title: Dark Web Incremental Demo
4794670.short_description: Dark web incremental is an incremental idle game where you earn money by doing criminal activities like selling drugs and hacking. Upgrade everything, and find all the pets and secrets around the map!

4768330.title: Gamble Inc. Demo
4768330.short_description: Tired of making money for your corporate overlords while you get paid peanuts? Hack into your work computer and syphon cash straight from the slots and into your bank. In this corporate dystopia jobs have been reduced to betting all you've got and letting the house (your boss) win.

4739410.title: Soul Diagnosis Demo
4739410.short_description: Your patients are dying. The voices in your head are keeping score. Soul Diagnosis is a dialogue-rich isometric cRPG where you are haunted by your mistakes. Navigate a labyrinthine hospital conspiracy, engage in fisticuffs with inanimate objects, and leverage your fractured psyche to survive.

4793160.title: ATTAQ ARCADE COLLECTION Demo
4793160.short_description: 一组完整、爽快的游戏，装在一个有触感的桌面启动器里。 你从一台旧电脑前开始，桌上散落着软盘。拿起一张，拖进驱动器，然后启动游戏。在跳入另一个世界前，先完成一个小小的仪式。

4329140.title: Truth Scrapper Demo
4329140.short_description: 你有一个案件要调查，每天你的记忆都会重置，而两位神秘的向导正争相吸引你的注意——你会选择记住谁，又会把谁抛在脑后……？

4589210.title: IT HEARS YOU
4589210.short_description: A psychological horror game set in an abandoned hospital. A sound-sensitive creature hunts you. Stay silent, hide, and escape before it hears you.

4767330.title: A Line Held Tight Demo
4767330.short_description: Tensions both political and personal are rising at the Brightworld mining colony. In this dynamic sci-fi visual novel you must decide where your heart and loyalties lie if you’re to shape the future and save yourself.

4533280.title: Burn-9 Demo
4533280.short_description: A spy thriller where you’re not the spy. Safe behind your screen, guide the last survivor of an elite black-ops team in a desperate attempt to salvage a mission gone horribly wrong. Caught between military command and your agent, information is your greatest weapon.

4694330.title: TOEM 2 Demo
4694330.short_description: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

4421880.title: Catechesis Demo
4421880.short_description: 在这里开始《要理问答》的故事：与主要角色们碰面、探索最初的地下城、并在大约一个小时时长的紧张玩法内容中直面众多恶魔。

4580860.title: Papaya Plaza Demo
4580860.short_description: Rebuild a cute and cozy little tourist town in this laid-back and relaxed slice of life game. Meet adorable villagers, hilarious chickens, and create your perfect little community at your own pace. In this simple sim, you're the mayor and it's up to you. What will you build today?

4794800.title: A Knight of Lothen Demo
4794800.short_description: Hack n Slash your way out of the first level of the game with some epic metal music.

4267330.title: nurny battles HD
4267330.short_description: nurny battles HD is a little indie PvP auto battler with pre-rendered 3d visuals and gimmicky characters that can be played ONLINE or locally. it's also accessible to people with poor internet or ability to use controls

4673000.title: BonkCity Demo
4673000.short_description: 15-minute hip-hop roguelike survivor. Dodge the block. Draft perks and mixtapes. Drop bangers. Everyone plays the same daily seed — one shared dungeon design each day, one leaderboard, one crown a day. Vampire Survivors meets Jet Set Radio meets MegaBonk.

4774330.title: Do NOT Press Me Demo
4774330.short_description: A strange psychological game where every click matters. Press the button… or don’t — but be ready for the consequences.

4656250.title: Spiriki: Tiny Island Demo
4656250.short_description: Listening to the gentle sound of the waves, take care of three small quirky nature spirits! With their help and some patience, create your own tiny cozy diorama and bring back life to your overgrown island!

4803200.title: Pelican Post Demo
4803200.short_description: Pelican Post is a cozy narrative game about building community by delivering mail to a town of charming characters. As Port Pleasant's mailman, you'll get to know the townsfolk and make a difference in their lives.

4682290.title: Slayblade Demo
4682290.short_description: Build your battle-top and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts, Merge their Powers, and Dominate opponents in this Chill Roguelite! Skate around a vibrant Y2K city, winning Cash and Upgrades on your way to the top. And if you Die in the game, you Die in real life.

4668390.title: Your Own Cozy Motel
4668390.short_description: Build and run your own roadside motel in a hands-on simulator. Check in guests, clean and repair rooms, manage payments, upgrade facilities, and grow from a small stopover into a thriving, high-reputation business.

4672550.title: Bit It Demo
4672550.short_description: A two player couch-coop platformer game: Jump, Fly and Enjoy your time with your beloved one!

4013560.title: HellHeart Breaker Demo
4013560.short_description: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

2127350.title: Journey Express
2127350.short_description: A hybrid 2D/3D adventure game pitting the player against countless dangers on a cross-country journey. Manage your resources and keep your party alive!

4797320.title: Project Pixel Demo
4797320.short_description: Welcome to Project Pixel! Build and share stages online, jump through hand-crafted levels within the game's story mode, or find hidden gems within the player-driven Community Hub! You can play single player or join a lobby with friends in online co-op.

4437160.title: Memoirium Demo
4437160.short_description: 《忆境》是一款复古风格的类魂游戏，故事发生在混沌无比、行将崩塌的梦界。化身梦人，适应这个世界诡异的法则，对抗你的同类，只为逃出这个埋藏于潜意识、光怪陆离的地方。

4139330.title: Particulitix
4139330.short_description: 少开枪,多走位。堆叠打破规则的升级,组成荒谬强大的Run。Geometry Wars 与 Vampire Survivors 的混合体,战场本身就是你的武器。

4420830.title: Late Night Duty Demo
4420830.short_description: 一款PSX时代风格的心理恐怖游戏。扮演一名身心受创的退伍军人，在他担任学校保安的第一个夜晚，原本例行的巡逻迅速揭示出这所马来西亚学校内隐藏着某些不对劲的事。

4758900.title: Farming & Supermarket: Clicker Demo
4758900.short_description: 点击、收获与销售！在这款温馨的像素风点击游戏中，在左侧点击种植 7 种独特的作物，在右侧管理你的自定义店铺布局。升级点击力量，打造你的终极休闲农业市场帝国！

4766030.title: Rabbit Simulator Demo
4766030.short_description: 兔子模拟器是一款重点强调枪击暴力的动作冒险游戏。

4530570.title: Book Nook Demo
4530570.short_description: 在 Book Nook 中，一步一步拼出迷你场景。摆放家具、装饰和细小道具，完成每一个温馨角落。无需压力与计时器，享受所有细节归位时的踏实感，感受每个Book Nook里蕴含的故事。

4230630.title: The Legacy of Shadow's Bane TCG
4230630.short_description: Based on the book "The Legacy of Shadow's Bane" featuring characters from the first book of the series along with many new characters yet to be introduced. This game features a single player adventure mode, single player versus mode (against AI), and online multiplayer with global rankings.

4694360.title: Milki Delivery Demo
4694360.short_description: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside cliffs to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.

2474770.title: Momento
2474770.short_description: 在《回忆房间》这款与众不同的温馨房间布置游戏中，你所做的每个选择都将影响人生历程！布置房间，选择对自己而言重要的物品，然后见证它们会对剧情产生哪些影响——谨以这段蜿蜒旅程，讴歌日常用品的力量。

4758550.title: LOST ZION Demo
4758550.short_description: Lost Zion is an atmospheric cyberpunk horror game. Awakened by a faint signal as a service bot, explore the forsaken megacity of Lost Zion. Uncover the Emperor's horrific secrets. Obey your sole command: Activate the Gravity Core.

4727840.title: Cosmic Flesh: Overdrive Demo
4727840.short_description: 抵御来自宇宙深处的无尽怪物。通过快速的爆发式操控进行冲刺与射击，释放强力的 Overdrive，在每一次独特的战斗中进化你的飞船，并将你的操作技巧推向极限。

3392420.title: GeckoShop
3392420.short_description: 收集并出售蜥蜴。装饰并改善您的商店。追贼。探索充满魅力和生机的开放世界小城市。 卖掉你的蜥蜴，或者把它们当作你的宠物！

4802960.title: Hospital Hell Demo
4802960.short_description: Hospital Hell is a first-person survival horror game where you will fight zombies and other abominable nightmares. Explore the halls of St. Olga's Hospital and try to solve the mystery of why this place that was once considered a refuge, has now turned into Hell.

4261810.title: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia - Demo
4261810.short_description: 帮助长尾豹拯救帕隆比亚，让它免遭 Queen Mummy 及其爪牙的毒手！ 一段奇异的旋律席卷了帕隆比亚……所有动物突然开始起舞，所到之处一片混乱！

4737510.title: 眼忙嘴乱 Demo
4737510.short_description: 眼忙嘴乱是一款让你手忙脚乱、笑到力竭的抽象模拟游戏。你即将要面对的是：多线程折磨、像奶油一样滑落的五官、爆笑物理反馈、抽象随机事件……

4696130.title: Cog of Y
4696130.short_description: 《Cog of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过在回合中安排行动顺序、衔接技能选择并逐步强化角色能力，在稳定运作的战斗流程中体验以结构与策略为核心的单人 RPG 玩法。

4589830.title: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway Demo
4589830.short_description: 你闯入了一位知名博主的家中，想揭开他所有的秘密，但事情并没有那么简单！他把你锁在屋内，现在你必须想尽一切办法逃出去。在这场恐怖逃脱冒险中，躲藏、解开谜题并寻找出路！

4531090.title: Hexa Vanguard
4531090.short_description: Assemble your squad in HEXA VANGUARD, where customization is king. Assemble six radically unique heroes, equip them with powerful loot, and trigger a storm of random events. No two runs are the same in this strategic battle for survival.

4665180.title: Dark Breaker
4665180.short_description: Countless dangerous robots will constantly chase and surround you from every direction. Use your weapons and stunning special effects to destroy incoming mechanical enemies. Face endless enemy waves, withstand continuous pressure, and strive to survive in this terrifying yet exciting forest.

4693920.title: 都市猫眼恋语 Demo
4693920.short_description: 《都市猫眼恋语Demo》是一款都市轻魔幻乙女游戏的体验版。您可以体验到故事最开始的内容。一只会说话的猫、三段命中注定的缘分，和一个在大城市里努力站稳脚跟的女孩。当灵魂住进猫的身体，爱情的答案，藏在那双猫眼里。

4813440.title: Mortis Loop Demo
4813440.short_description: Die. Learn. Repeat. Mortis Loop is a 2D pixel art platformer where every death makes the world more dangerous. Master deadly traps, meet quirky characters, and break the loop — if you can.

4172230.title: Beaming
4172230.short_description: Beaming is a minimalist logic-based puzzler that involves directing beams through a hexagonal grid.

4486430.title: Tragedy is approaching
4486430.short_description: A first-person survival game set in a post-Soviet wasteland. Explore abandoned locations, fight the infected, scavenge resources, and build a base to survive

4181830.title: Mice Crisis
4181830.short_description: Mice Crisis is a cute and chaotic action game where you play as a heroic cat on a mission to save the town! Hunt down swarms of mischievous mice, smacking corrupted predators, and saving the town in fast paced, adorable action!

4778700.title: Froggy Brews Demo
4778700.short_description: Froggy Brews is a cozy narrative adventure, where every cup of tea tells a story. Play as a tea-loving frog returning to your old neighborhood that has changed over time. Brew tea for villagers, uncover heartfelt stories, and rediscover your place in this world.

3596330.title: 盟军远征: 地下世界
3596330.short_description: 瓦尔瑟利亚大陆，世界唯一的陆地，是一个多种族共存，充满英雄传说的地方。 大陆中心有一个被封印的深坑，传闻中，那是通向无尽世界的入口。 封印的力量无法破解，因此，深坑中到底隐藏着什么，一直是瓦尔瑟利亚最大的谜团。 某日，魔法潮汐爆发，封印消散，海量的黑暗生物从深坑中涌向地表世界。 世界的秩序遭到破坏，瓦尔瑟利亚大陆不再安宁。 以圣耀帝国为首的地表种族组成联军，集结力量进行抗衡。 鏖战过后，地表联军取得胜利，入侵的黑暗生物被逼回深坑之中。 地表的黑暗生物清理干净，但入口依旧无法封印。 为彻底解决问题，各族强者，组建联军，带领大军，剑指地底最深层世界。 那里，似乎隐藏着被历史掩盖的真相。

4621110.title: Transcendence in the Poolrooms Demo
4621110.short_description: Transcendence in the Poolrooms is an adventure game where you will experience infinite relaxation. Fall into another world where you will explore haunting places beyond reality, a liminal space unlike any you have ever been to and may never escape.

4757360.title: ShelfLife: Art School Detective Demo
4757360.short_description: ShelfLife: Art School Detective is a Mystery Adventure featuring a cast of romanceable weirdos! Befriend and investi-DATE 9 potential suspects. Use psychic powers to astral project into The Artworld and discover secrets. Unmask the mysterious ART KILLER that’s terrorising your campus!

4658500.title: Meaningless Random Numbers Demo
4658500.short_description: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning cash through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching.

1959020.title: ERODE
1959020.short_description: 《ERODE》是一款元素融合玩法的肉鸽游戏。4种元素石通过不同的组合方式，合成多种武器与装备。玩法与美术风格不断完善中。

4796770.title: Operation: Outbreak Idle Demo
4796770.short_description: 畅玩《Operation: Outbreak》放置版试玩，在第一个生物群落中对抗无情的僵尸大军，努力生存下去。体验核心进度系统，解锁强力升级，并抢先预览完整版游戏的武器、技能和僵尸屠杀玩法。

4786840.title: BookStore Simulator Demo
4786840.short_description: Open your dream bookstore and begin sowing the seeds of knowledge among locals. Push the boundaries of possibility and immerse your business in a world of magic.

4787690.title: Cauldron Inn Demo
4787690.short_description: Trying to save yourselfe something unknown but unmistakably sinister, you hide in a mysterious inn. However, your temporary refuge turns out to be a trap, and now you must find a way to escape.

4803930.title: KILL HIM Demo
4803930.short_description: 在杀戮与探索中寻找真相。 KILL HIM 是一款黑白风格的类银河恶魔城游戏，你将穿越充满敌意的世界，挑战强大的敌人，并发现隐藏在一切背后的秘密。

4785680.title: Quiet Bruise Demo
4785680.short_description: Play as dumb plushies trying to keep a collapsing factory alive in this tower defence factory automation game. Build chaotic production lines, fight off hordes of cats and crocs, survive your own terrible decisions and keep the factory running.

4592230.title: Tsuki Journey Demo
4592230.short_description: A relaxing slice of life adventure game where Tsuki travels between beautiful cities, meets new friends, uncovers stories, and fills out collection logs at his own pace, combining cozy idle activities with short, meaningful bursts of progression.

4442250.title: Unchest Demo
4442250.short_description: 一款只用鼠标便能游玩的横板经营类游戏。进货卖钱，合成装备。干掉那些觊觎你财富的怪物，然后成为世界首富。

4774710.title: The Time‑Stealing Cat Demo
4774710.short_description: Side with the Demon Lord and sabotage the hero’s adventure. In The Time-Stealing Cat, you play as the Demon Lord’s pet cat and secretly interfere with the hero’s journey. Block paths, set traps, and create obstacles to slow the hero down and steal time before the final battle.

4809270.title: Shmup! Demo
4809270.short_description: Arcade-style bullet hell action! 3 ships, 5 special weapons, and screen-clearing bombs. Conquer 1 intense stage in this demo with fixed or dynamic difficulty—then compete for high scores on online leaderboards.

4807800.title: 塔防江湖2 Demo
4807800.short_description: 单机的，好玩不坑爹。 充满挑战和趣味的原创的国产塔防游戏。 邪恶的势力又在江湖中蠢蠢欲动。酝酿着不为人知的阴谋。 大侠，莫再隐居了，速速拿起武器，重出江湖吧。 阻止野心家们破坏江湖的宁静！！！ 九大门派，各具独门绝技。随心搭配出无数组合，挑战大侠的战略极限。 初出茅庐的菜鸟？笑傲江湖的各大名宿？九十个江湖人物！！ 上一届少年英雄大会获得江湖九俊称号的各派精英。助君纵横江湖！！ 四大势力联合成四方盟！！敌人空前强大！！！大侠做好准备了吗？ 十五个极具挑战的场景。随着游戏逐步展现。 三种难度，不论是新人还是老江湖，都能尽情体验游戏的乐趣。

4716370.title: 超时空怪盗 Demo
4716370.short_description: 是架空世界冒险喜剧！！！你将化身一位土著人，与一位来自20年后的少女一起组成跨时空搭档，前往未来世界冒险并搜集传说中能改变一切的宝物！本作是一款搞笑游戏，目的就是逗笑你让你开心！因此在冒险过程中，你会遇到各种各样让人啼笑皆非的事。 千万不要在喝水的时候游玩本作哦！不然你就………………不渴了呢……

4666390.title: Blood Dungeon Demo
4666390.short_description: 《Nidhogg》原班人马暗黑巨献，配乐炸裂的全新 2D 平台自动射击力作！尽情掠夺鲜血、白骨、金币，用不断变强的实力爆杀成群妖魔！你，能活着走出这座鲜血地牢吗？

4731680.title: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2 - Demo
4731680.short_description: 一款全新的音乐主题找物游戏，你需要找到猫咪音乐家和它们的乐器。找到它们后，它们会为你演奏音乐。它们害羞又可爱，但非常有才华。把它们全部找出来吧！

4807530.title: Above Par Demo
4807530.short_description: Above Par is a physics-based precision platformer about climbing high and falling hard. Master a 4-club toolkit, calculate your trajectories, and get ready to fall... a lot.

4795420.title: Necrovoid Demo
4795420.short_description: Necrovoid — a dark post-apocalyptic tactical RPG with 2d6 turn-based combat. In a world shattered by nuclear fire and Rifts, you carry a Black Parasite in your chest. Every death makes you stronger… and less human.

4768620.title: Breeze of Hope Demo
4768620.short_description: Breeze of Hope is a cozy stylized adventure about loneliness, hope, and the courage to keep moving forward. Explore a peaceful fantasy world, complete light puzzles and challenges, collect crystals, and discover a small emotional journey built around atmosphere, music, and meaning.

4632700.title: Bubble & Squeak Demo
4632700.short_description: Bubble & Squeak is a tower defence-lite, ambient strategy game where you wander, summon moss creatures, cast hexes, and build up a small camp and cauldron at your own pace.

4689430.title: Loot Goblins Demo
4689430.short_description: 打开宝箱，连锁增益，招募终极小妖精队伍。 将他们送入地牡深处。获取更好的战利品。重复！

3382470.title: Ruinetarus Demo
3382470.short_description: 大雾弥漫在落寞的旧城——法洛斯特，思索着“戏剧性”，悲观的少女日复一日，于此度过自己稀疏平常的日子——

4340510.title: Alehundred
4340510.short_description: A crossplay multiplayer platformer where you're 10cm tall inside giant historical dioramas. Race through seven eras from 1956 Italy to 300 BC Alexandria, collect coins, claim Magic Gems, and compete with up to 8 players across PC, Android, and iOS. VR standalone support coming post-launch.

3851110.title: SCP: Project 90
3851110.short_description: SCP Project 90 — 是一款受SCP基金会宇宙和SCP：秘密实验室启发的游戏。

4045130.title: 囚生症 试玩版
4045130.short_description: 这是一款女性向多结局养成游戏：记忆缺失的“你”在封闭的病房醒来，被告知你患有精神传染病，要使用一款新型人形机器人进行20天的疗程。机器人随你掌控，你可以按你喜欢的方式对待、使用、塑造“他”……是接受治疗还是反抗医生？是温柔抚摸还是恶劣殴打？……当20天疗程结束，你最终的命运会是什么？

4805740.title: runz Demo
4805740.short_description: 轰穿不断升级的敌人波次，打造有史以来最强的弹匣。收集金币，活下来，然后在波次之间进入商店购买子弹，把弹匣重组成荒唐的连招引擎。叠加羁绊，升级子弹，滚成铺满全屏的弹幕风暴。

4766510.title: 符文酒馆 Demo
4766510.short_description: 这是一款的异步pvp自走棋游戏。排布你的符文和组件，利用能量传递尽可能激活更多符文技能，构筑强力阵容！面对随机匹配到的对手，率先击碎敌方的元素地块，赢得更多！

4710300.title: 阿特斯英雄记 体验版
4710300.short_description: 几乎全由文字构成的硬核中世纪奇幻放置RPG。种族、职业、绰号自由搭配，打造专属角色；近1000种装备带来丰富的刷刷刷体验；93%的玩家评价剧情“好看”。战斗与探索全自动——你只需查看结果。故事现已推进至第五章，计划通过五次大型更新持续展开。

4743510.title: Miniature Legends Demo
4743510.short_description: Survive in Tiny Lands—alone or with friends! Battle endless waves of creatures in small arenas, collect and upgrade powerful abilities, unlock new legends, and grow insanely strong in this fast-paced, chaotic roguelike board-battler.

1958800.title: Duppy Detective Tashia
1958800.short_description: Help Tashia unravel the case of a heinous murder and find her cell phone in this point & click, mystery adventure based on Caribbean folklore!

4034920.title: Pop Pop Potato
4034920.short_description: 在这款充满愤怒的 2D 平台游戏中，与一根爆炸玉米棒合作，向天空发射自己，以在收获期间与家人分离后重新回到土豆家族。但要小心，每一关都是高塔般的挑战，每一次跌落都比上一次更糟！

4800310.title: Quillhollow Demo
4800310.short_description: A novelist's workshop. Clean, quiet, focused, and customizable. No AI features. No accounts. No subscriptions. Keep your prose, planning, and world in one interconnected place.

4749680.title: Locostation Demo
4749680.short_description: Locostation 是一款增量游戏。驾驶火车，运送货物，击退盗贼并不断升级。

4451950.title: SPACEFIGHTER - The Bullet Hell
4451950.short_description: 《吸血鬼幸存者》遇上弹幕地狱——在太空中。驾驶 2D 星际战机，融合武器分支打造破坏性构筑，在子弹与拥有真正机制的 Boss 浪潮中生存。单人开发者作品。

4566870.title: 球之域
4566870.short_description: 《球之域》是一款节奏明快的 2D 俯视角动作 MOBA。风格迥异的角色在在线匹配、好友组队与本地对战等模式中正面对决。掌握走位、地形、控场与招牌技能，征战单挑、团战与大乱斗。

4774130.title: 翻面棋兵 Demo
4774130.short_description: 这是一款灵感来自“军棋”的双人对战卡牌战棋游戏。使用具有翻转特性的“棋兵”与好友对战，在恰当时机翻开“棋兵”来释放强力技能，或隐藏“棋兵”伺机而动。除此之外，根据“棋兵”特性搭配卡组，探索“卡牌”与“棋兵”组合的多种可能！

4576120.title: Pizza Oof! Demo
4576120.short_description: Pizza Oof! is a chaotic co-op adventure game where you and your friends deliver pizza down a treacherous river. Steer your fragile raft, dodge menacing wildlife, and safely deliver the pizza before everything falls apart!

4692510.title: 火龙传奇
4692510.short_description: 全新传奇《火龙传奇》以原汁原味的传奇玩法为核心，打造高爆率、高自由度的MMORPG盛宴。在这里，装备全靠打，神装遍地爆，刀刀暴击、秒怪升级的极致爽感贯穿全程！与兄弟并肩征战，从新手小白到全服霸主，书写属于你的强者传奇！

4060150.title: 阎罗索命
4060150.short_description: 古风悬疑探案文字冒险游戏——北宋天圣年间，科举省试方毕，汴京国子监突发连环命案，遇害者死状惊悚离奇，如遭阎罗审判。玩家将化身为被卷入权斗暗流的新科进士文彦博，通过勘验尸体、搜寻线索、推演谜局，找出案件背后的骇人真相……

1755840.title: 大航海征途
1755840.short_description: 《大航海征途》是一款航海主题的策略游戏，背景设定为架空的中世纪魔幻世界。在这个世界里，您可以：从单帆船到飞空舰队，亲手打造您的无敌舰队，全服首位建造者更可获得【大航海家】尊享称号;招募传奇船长，借助他们独特的技能纵横四海，书写属于您的航海传奇;经营各港口珍稀货物，通过独特的“订单系统”把握商机，每一次决策都可能让您富甲一方;巧妙搭配各具特色的船长技能，组建专属于您的王牌舰队，掌控海洋霸主的权柄;在公海激战与排名赛中一决高下，用实力证明谁是真正的海上霸主，缔造属于您的辉煌时代。

4620750.title: ROAD59 -新时代任侠特区- 摩天楼黑白抗争【试玩版】
4620750.short_description: 本游戏为视觉小说游戏《ROAD59 -新时代任侠特区- 摩天楼黑白抗争》的试玩版。
developers: 株式会社ロケットスタジオ

4595540.title: Touhou Erosion ~ The Fallen Shrine Maiden of Paradise
4595540.short_description: 神秘的“侵蚀”浪潮吞噬了幻想乡，使少女们化为红眼的捕食者。 在无情袭来的弹幕地狱中生存下来，击碎束缚她们的黑暗外壳。 在这款紧张刺激的 Survivors-like 动作游戏中，夺回逐渐消逝的乐园之光。

4793590.title: 红SC：名为偶像的祭品 (TSUMIMI TIME)
4793590.short_description: 一款“直播介入×调查推理”ADV。你将以观众身份介入偶像主播的直播，在直播内外搜集线索，逐步逼近其失踪搭档事件背后的真相。

4678650.title: Touhou Brawl Demo
4678650.short_description: 免费游玩《TOUHOU BRAWL》！ 《TOUHOU BRAWL》是一款令人兴奋的PvP弹幕动作乱斗游戏，经典的东方角色们将在这里展开一场热闹非凡的战斗。马上加入其中，与来自世界各地的玩家展开激烈对决。立即在Steam上开玩吧！

3894790.title: 导师模拟器：桌面实验室
3894790.short_description: 《导师模拟器：桌面实验室》是一款科研主题的半挂机小窗口游戏，而不是传统高强度经营模拟。它适合放在屏幕一角，陪你工作、学习、写论文或摸鱼。你将经营实验室、招收学生、申请项目、发表论文，看像素学生自己工作、生活、摸鱼和崩溃。如果你想要轻松、荒诞、偶尔回来点一点的科研搭子，欢迎来到你的实验室。

4803080.title: 乱世无双：幸存者 Demo
4803080.short_description: 你就是华佗。以选将征召三国50位性转名将，让历史中的羁绊在战场上化为强力协同。从寥寥数将起步，逐步壮大为席卷战场的庞大军势。200+技能、18种羁绊组合，桃园结义到赤壁烈焰，更有巨型Raid Boss。像素风三国大型生存动作肉鸽，乱世尽头，你的军团能否屹立不倒？

4814710.title: PNR: Point of No return Demo
4814710.short_description: 绝不闪避。直冲突破。PNR: Point of No Return是一款太空歌剧Roguelite游戏。正面突破蜂拥而至的敌舰队，迎击拦截，每次出击打造不同的火力构筑。在战斗中通过选择完善构筑，生还归来用弹弓引爆大奖，备战下一次出击。

4745270.title: RZImageReader Demo
4745270.short_description: 直接从ZIP, RAR中播放WebP , GIF文件，支持多种漫画浏览功能，播放常见web视频格式。—— RZImageReader，RZIR，RZ看图器

4579710.title: 哦莫！美女们的闪婚修罗场 Demo
4579710.short_description: “随便谁都好，快来和我结婚吧~~~~！” 来自催婚父母的最后通牒： 下周来之前，必须给我带个准新娘回来！ 经营着海边民宿的你， 偏偏在这时候，住进来了五位美女？！ 一直陪在你身边的青梅竹马、 氛围感拉满的撩人 OL、 还有……吸引所有目光的自由派海归美女！ 剩下的时间只有一周。 在比海浪还摇摆不定的修罗场里， 你最终会和谁步入婚姻呢？

4757300.title: The Wheelchair Man
4757300.short_description: 在一处废弃的公寓楼里偷走5,000美元，同时还要躲避一个精神失常的男人。

4730360.title: LIMINALITY
4730360.short_description: After his daughter disappears under mysterious circumstances, Liam Henderson takes matters into his own hands to find, investigate and safely bring her back from the depths of a multi-faceted cacophony of rooms known as "The Complex". Will he find her? Only time can tell, but it's unreliable here.

4694910.title: Draw the Hands Demo
4694910.short_description: From a grid of poker tiles, you have to draw the best hands possible ! Every stage you have to beat a increased score to be allowed to move forward. Get more points from badges, backgrounds, relics, powers and others in a roguelike fashion. Every run is completely different.

4802850.title: No One's Hero Demo
4802850.short_description: A 2D side-scrolling runner set in ancient times where you play as an unknown messenger racing through danger behind the scenes of a famous legend. Jump, slide, and survive 13 handcrafted levels inspired by ancient Greece.

4784100.title: WizKitty and the Tower of Doom, Gloom, and Other Bad Stuff Demo
