4581870.title: Kaido Genkai: An Anime Racing RPG Demo
4581870.short_description: Kaido Genkai is an open-world racing exploration game that blends the excitement of high-speed races with the charm of anime-style graphics and RPG elements, set in a nostalgic 90's fictional Japanese countryside. Come explore the open world and see who you meet along the way!

4799210.title: 连连帝国Demo
4799210.short_description: 《连连帝国》是一款基于六角棋盘网格的即时战略游戏。在本游戏中，玩家只需链接节点就能调兵遣将，从无止境的微操中解放出来，专注于运营、兵种搭配、进攻时机与路线的抉择，从战略层面击败你的对手！

4798250.title: Tiny Tape Store Demo
4798250.short_description: A cozy, nostalgia-fueled idle game that lives in the corner of your screen. Reminisce the good old days and run your own little VHS store while using your PC for work, games or whatever.

4148240.title: 女王的游戏：盛世天下 女帝篇
4148240.short_description: 你，可曾幻想过真正主宰一个王朝的命运？这一次，你不再是旁观者，而是化身主角，进入这部真人互动的宫廷生存影视作品！《女王的游戏：盛世天下》女帝篇 ——全新推出！你将挣脱命运的枷锁，一步步走上那座象征着至高无上的龙椅。你将如何书写你的盛世天下？一切，由你亲手决定！

4700190.title: Mad Merchant Demo
4700190.short_description: Build, arm, and command a merchant train across a hostile wasteland. Choose your routes, trade for profit, upgrade your wagons, and survive deadly ambushes on the rails.

4728910.title: 脉冲武装 Demo
4728910.short_description: Pulse Armed is a wasteland strategy game: connect modules on a grid, route elements through pipelines into a production chain, test your build in arena combat, and balance resources, pipes, and gear—wire, tune, and prove it in fights.

4748610.title: Hammerhead Demo
4748610.short_description: A short narrative-driven game that explores themes of isolation and nostalgia as player unravels suppressed memories through solving cryptograms.

4820210.title: Harmonic Drive Demo
4820210.short_description: An arcade-style rhythm game featuring full AI generated EDM. Build combos, chase perfect runs, climb the leaderboards, and experience a soundtrack built for late-night sessions and score chasing.

4489010.title: Cat Hits the Deck Demo
4489010.short_description: Deckbuilder roguelike about a cat that fears being hurt but has only cards that hurt her before enemies! Min-max your resources, get OverPowered cards in your paw, and build an unlosable Deck that prolly gonna kill you 9 times^^

4599160.title: Star Wrath Demo
4599160.short_description: 《Star Wrath》是一款多人太空夺宝动作游戏。游戏中，你需要设计自己的飞船，并与其他玩家在激烈的PvP和PvE战斗中争夺资源。

4760490.title: 十日梦
4760490.short_description: 《十日梦》是一款第一人称心理恐怖游戏。你被困在封闭空间陷入十日轮回，每日寻找随机出现的诡异环境异常，通过开枪或睡觉做出抉择，分辨梦境与现实，一步步揭开轮回背后的真相。

4810700.title: BrainMess Demo
4810700.short_description: You've been locked in a room with pen, paper, pins, and strings, and you're not leaving until it makes sense.

4829010.title: Parting Shadows Demo
4829010.short_description: A narrative RPG where every choice reshapes the story. Build your party from 56 unique classes, fight through three branching tales of mystery and betrayal, and discover that some paths can't be retraced.

4801670.title: 暗层 Demo
4801670.short_description: 一款档案调查类悬疑游戏。玩家将在一套异常档案管理系统中浏览案件记录、筛选线索、比对矛盾信息，并根据调查结果判断事件真相。试玩版包含前三个案件，展示档案阅读、线索推理和多结局判定等核心玩法。

4804360.title: Break, Then Upgrade Demo
4804360.short_description: 一个简单的增量游戏。在海底向漂浮物发射弹幕，获取战利品，升级！！！

4197770.title: Situation Normal Demo
4197770.short_description: 一款节奏由玩家掌控的高速混乱 2.5D 动作平台游戏。向后开火进行冲刺、即时切换武器，在一个会因您的每个决定不断升级的动态地下设施中杀出重围。

2445690.title: 失落城堡2
2445690.short_description: 失落城堡2是一款2D卡通横版Rogue-Lite游戏。探寻丰富宝物道具强化自己，精通各类武器玩出花样，挑战强大魔物展现实力。新的冒险正召唤着宝藏猎人们！

4693720.title: BlackColled Madala Force 2
4693720.short_description: BlackColled MF2 brings Fictional WW3 Scenario to gamers with 10 maps and dozens of operators. Play with bots or other players through many locations across the world and unlock different operators from various fractions.

4827370.title: Chiggas - Survival of the Mitiest Demo
4827370.short_description: Survive the swarm, recruit Chigga Soldiers, unlock wild powerups, and fight through chaotic stages in Chiggas: Survival of the Mitiest, a fast arcade survival game packed with weapons, boosts, bosses, and Legendary Chigga Wear.

4711620.title: 我的英雄旅团 Demo
4711620.short_description: On the fantastical continent of Elfar, where swords and magic reign, you will establish and grow your own guild, leading members to accept quests, challenge dungeons, forge equipment, participate in competitions, and gradually uncover the secrets of the nine sacred sites

4638750.title: 魔女工厂 试玩版
4638750.short_description: 还款期限30分钟。一场在债务地狱中展开的疯狂工厂建设游戏。通过合约扭曲规则，突破荒谬的业绩指标。

3326670.title: 梦境搁浅 (Dreamstranded)
3326670.short_description: 沉浸在一个惬意的世界中，享受采集、制作、建造以及经营自己的旅店！

2823200.title: 魔鼠克星
2823200.short_description: 老鼠驱灵！？软萌治愈的像素风奇幻故事！

4830000.title: Dream Corp Demo
4830000.short_description: 这是一款融合建造、经营、生活类的公司模拟游戏，在游戏里你将操控老板的角色，没有繁琐的页面操作，你将精准操控每个角色，处理随机事件的同时，你可以发现每一名女员工的爱好、囧事、优美舞姿。也可以挖掘每一名男员工的生活状态、情绪状态以及家庭配偶关系，游戏中每个员工都有不同的性格。他们将共同与你一起成就一家梦想公司。

4752170.title: FERALPALS Demo: Chapter 1
4752170.short_description: 《兽化宠伴》是一款以吉祥物为主题的章节体恐怖游戏。人类因源自友好宠伴的病原体彻底灭亡。友好宠伴是基因工程生物，被植入了类人智慧，以满足人类的各种野心。如今，人类早已绝迹，遗留在世上的宠伴仍在复刻着创造者的社会形态。

4775630.title: Hammer Dongers Demo
4775630.short_description: The ultimate local multiplayer party game with destroyable terrain. It supports one player on keyboard and up to 4 on controller. Top down perspective and charming cartoony pixel art. Join the mayhem and beat your friends in the most creative ways possible!

4562100.title: Doo 'N' Dash
4562100.short_description: They closed the loo? Time to make a stinky poo! Play as Loo‑is in this Stealth N' Stench adventure. Hide, run, and use office receptacles to do your business. Relieve the pressure before it’s too late, or you might meet a truly stinky fate!

4677890.title: Billionaire MAX
4677890.short_description: 《Billionaire MAX》是一款最多支持4人在线对战的股票投资桌游。买卖21家虚构企业的股票，以及黄金、原油、房地产等大宗商品，应对50多种撼动世界经济的事件卡，抢先获得奖杯者获胜。精通特别分红、做空、奖杯加成等多样战略，决定胜负。配备贴心的新手教程，10分钟即可上手。完整支持日语、英语、简体中文、韩语。可在线对战，也可挑战4档难度CPU对手。

4517460.title: 最佳球会Online
4517460.short_description: 在《最佳球会Online》中，你可以亲手打造专属豪华球队阵容。游戏门槛低、操作简单易上手，轻松操控即可畅享纯粹的足球乐趣。游戏活动紧跟赛事资讯，球员动态即时更新，《最佳球会Online》将为你带来沉浸式的足球游玩体验。

4800350.title: Team Disorder Demo
4800350.short_description: Team Disorder Demo is an intro into the full game. This adventure includes one large map with many exciting missions and things to find!

4735710.title: Ascension Clicker
4735710.short_description: A simple clicker game to pass the time! Can you break the game with your clicking power? Click to upgrade, upgrade to prestige, prestige to ascend, ascend to the end. Buy special upgrades, boosts and even minor automation to help you along your journey.

4733600.title: Tile Rogue Demo
4733600.short_description: 在方块的世界中展开冒险的休闲解谜动作游戏！ 为了不被巨大的敌人吞噬，破坏方块并开辟道路，向着终点前进！ 支持最多4人的在线多人模式！和朋友一起踏上色彩缤纷的大冒险吧！！

3987040.title: Star-Coat Demo
3987040.short_description: Embark on a quest to collect remnants of dead gods and save the universe from freezing over. Master nimble combat as a pilot and when things get dire, call on your COAT for help. Fight, explore, and loot to create the ultimate hero of the Stars.

4752230.title: Asymptote Demo
4752230.short_description: A 2D top-down rescue-survival game set on Mars, where you pilot an anti-gravity craft, save stranded colonists, destroy hostile machines, and face unpredictable encounters shaped by upgrades, unique tools, story choices and mysterious game mechanisms.

4819320.title: Goblin Attack Demo
4819320.short_description: 射击哥布林，壮大你的军队，并通过每一次点击保持速度。你可以全屏游玩，也可以在做其他事情时让游戏安静地运行在屏幕底部。

4820760.title: Overball Demo
4820760.short_description: Inspired by Pong, Overball reinvents the classic formula with explosive power-ups, destructible defenses, and a ball that grows more dangerous with every hit. Battle with up to 6 local players in fast-paced, frantic, and utterly chaotic matches.

4744960.title: Reel it! World Fishing
4744960.short_description: Embark on a fishing adventure around the world! Cast your line and reel in fish from across the globe!

4756530.title: Nia and The Abyss Demo
4756530.short_description: Nia and The Abyss is an Underwater Creature Collector, Cleanup, Farming, and Ecosystem Sim. Clean pollution, cultivate plants, attract and evolve marine life. Restoring balance to a responsive ocean.

4120290.title: Dustpocalypse: Demo
4120290.short_description: Play as a cute cat leading their trusty robo-vacuum into battle against endless waves of mutated dust monsters. Master working together with your robot friend, and experiment with different builds to finally achieve the perfect run. Will you be able to conquer the Dustpocalypse?

4070070.title: Mining and Dwarves Demo
4070070.short_description: Mining and Dwarves 是一款放置增量游戏：开采岩石、收集矿石并招募矮人。你可以主动释放强力技能冲刺收益，也可以放松下来，让矮人替你干活。

4775940.title: Elders K.O. Demo
4775940.short_description: 你和你的朋友们都变成老头老太太了！提好你的裤子，在最多支持8人在线对战的混乱迷你游戏中疯狂乱斗。体验第一人称近战，用一整套荒谬至极的武器道具制霸全场。温馨提示：本游戏制作过程中没有真正的老人受到伤害……好吧，其实有1个。

4754190.title: Bubble Balance Bonanza Demo
4754190.short_description: Roll, bump, jump, and crash your way through this fast-paced, marble style, physics-driven platformer. With fun environments, cute characters and crazy obstacles to overcome, you'll need to keep your balance to complete the journey! Are YOU ready for the bonanza?

4803240.title: 十个好人Ten Innocent People Demo
4803240.short_description: 对于这个已经坠入深渊的国家，义军仍然发出了“十人令”，给了它最后的机会。使者要如何布局他的行动才能挽回局面呢？本demo包含《十个好人》前八分之一的内容，这部分内容中使者将建立起他的基地和情报网，为寻找十个好人、避免乾国被净灭打下基础。Demo中包含一条重要的隐藏支线，你能找到那个蓝色眼睛的小伙子吗？

4717750.title: Mushrooms vs Engineers Demo
4717750.short_description: Mushrooms vs Engineers is a top-down arena shooter where you "The Engineer" battle the endless hordes of Mushrooms over 20 waves until you defeat the final boss of each area. Choose your own battles by upgrading the spawn rates of Mushrooms and using their spores to increase your own power.

4816150.title: Mouseman: Point and Click RPG Adventure Chapter 1 Demo
4816150.short_description: Noir-themed Point and Click RPG Adventure with Turn-based battles! Pickpocket innocent people, eat cheese, rumble with the C.A.T.S., uncover secrets and rise to the top of the criminal underworld to become Top G!

4825900.title: Moosio Demo
4825900.short_description: Moosio是一款混乱的派对格斗游戏，你将扮演驼鹿互相发射蘑菇！在竞技场周围收集蘑菇，在荒谬的战斗中向朋友们吐蘑菇。本地或在线游玩。纯粹的混乱。纯粹的驼鹿。纯粹的蘑菇狂欢！

4814780.title: Human Resources Demo
4814780.short_description: You work in Human Resources. In the demo of this dystopian document thriller, use your terminal to scrutinize records and expose human-like AI. Spot contradictions to detect the impostors. Efficiency is mandatory. Failure is unforgivable.

4671990.title: Invisible Ascent Demo
4671990.short_description: A rage-inducing memory platformer where the path disappears before you jump. Study the platforms, trust your memory, and climb upward one painful mistake at a time.

4805590.title: Averi the Accursed Demo
4805590.short_description: 被世人排斥的艾薇莉，成为了她那颗小小星球对抗暴君克罗夫勋爵与普索诺斯女士的最后希望。在这款充满动作感的 2D 像素风平台游戏中展开冒险吧。

4648900.title: Standard Human Pizza Demo
4648900.short_description: Make deadly pizzas to kill monsters. Standard Human Pizza is a horror-cooking sim where you serve monsters, survive anomalies, and use lethal ingredients to exterminate your clientele.

4764880.title: D.E.C.A.Y. Demo
4764880.short_description: 核战争后，美国被划分为危险的区域。你是 D.E.C.A.Y. 组织的一名孤独特工，负责控制一座偏远的掩体。探索废墟、获取资源、执行命令，并在一个濒临崩溃的世界中做出选择，决定何为秩序。

4825340.title: Splash monsters 1+2 Demo
4825340.short_description: This demo features some of the groovy levels included in the full game. Splash the monsters back to their own reality in style. Explore the elements of both games with monsters made of water and sand.

4698630.title: SCREAM you LOSE
4698630.short_description: If you get startled, you go back to Number 0. A Japanese-style horror anomaly-spotting game that uses your microphone to detect your reactions. Eerie shrines, schools, and cult-like locations await, filled with all kinds of horror and anomalies.

4682010.title: Discremental Demo
4682010.short_description: Discremental 是一款短篇放置与增量游戏，你主要升级你的圆盘，同时强化其他装备。

3442290.title: ARMORY SIMULATOR
3442290.short_description: Build, manage, and expand your very own armory, catering to cowboys, bounty hunters, and outlaws in search of the finest gear.

4786560.title: TOOSIN : 투신 Demo
4786560.short_description: Face an AI that evolves by learning your combat patterns in real time. TOOSIN is a roguelike game where you fight against enemies that analyze and counter your habits. Become the TOOSIN by creating your own build with a variety of perks, traits, weapons, and combos.

4764440.title: [Bober Bros] Last Pill Bar LEAKED Demo
4764440.short_description: 一款以选择驱动的调酒师模拟游戏。调制饮品，认识身陷困境的顾客，通过分支对话与酒吧游戏塑造他们的人生走向。不适合儿童或心理承受能力较弱者。

4275860.title: Sugar Shatter
4275860.short_description: Smash through your competition in Sugar Shatter, a brick breaker fighting game where you have to hit a candy ball to break more bricks than your opponent. Meet a variety of characters in campaign mode, or challenge your friends to a test of skill in versus mode with online or local multiplayer!

4736440.title: Word Rift
4736440.short_description: A fast-paced word puzzle game featuring handcrafted levels, speedruns, endless mode, and global leaderboards.

4757200.title: School Owner Simulator Demo
4757200.short_description: Build and run a secondary school from scratch. Plan classrooms and facilities, manage staff and daily schedules, support student development, and improve your school through stronger performance, better results, and growing reputation.

3932540.title: RWS
3932540.short_description: Rolling With Swords is a chaotic 2D arena brawler set in random levels. Chain attacks, roll through danger, and collect absurd power-ups in a tug-of-war system where control constantly shifts until one player claims the entire arena.

4821740.title: Eldread: Horrors of a Dark Moon Demo
4821740.short_description: Manage your dwindling oxygen levels and navigate a cosmic horror roguelite in a lunar colony. Confront nightmarish body-horror anomalies, survive unpredictable text-driven events, and endure the madness waiting beneath the dark moon.

2994990.title: Wool at the Gates
2994990.short_description: 一款极简风格的基地战术防御游戏。你将扮演英雄亲自战斗、指挥士兵，并创造强大的职业协同效果，在不断强化你的城镇的同时，抵御无尽的羊群入侵浪潮。

3624790.title: Letter Lost
3624790.short_description: You’re the sole employee at the Kharnym Isle post office, stamping, sorting, and delivering mail. But the job hides secrets, and the office itself holds mysteries you must uncover. This will be the only job you’ll ever need to work… unless you can escape.

4806060.title: 最后一掷 试玩版
4806060.short_description: 撤离玩法的桌游，你需要不断思考、掷骰子、做选择。游戏的考验不在于战斗技巧，而在于决策、管理与策略。

4464620.title: Almost Out
4464620.short_description: Almost Out is a horror escape room simulator where you must escape a psycho while leaving no traces of your escape attempt.

4601640.title: Just Keep Fishing Demo
4601640.short_description: 一款关于钓很多鱼的短篇增量游戏。

4767300.title: Monstrobus Quiz Demo
4767300.short_description: Monstrobus Quiz is an online trivia game for 2-16 players! Answer questions and use tricks or boosts on yourself or others. Create custom question packs to keep each game session unique. Gather your friends and dive into the Monstrobus Quiz fun!

4827020.title: EVIDENCE Demo
4827020.short_description: EVIDENCE 是一款充满氛围感的 neo-noir 侦探惊悚游戏，你将扮演一名在腐败而疲惫的 Nova City Department 中工作的侦探。

4811950.title: Frustration Demo
4811950.short_description: A psychological detective game where your own memory sabotages the investigation. Solve murders, connect clues, and survive hallucinations before reality fully collapses.

4810010.title: Professional Cats Demo
4810010.short_description: Professional Cats 是一个温馨的迷你游戏合集，包含4种小游戏。穿着不同职业服装的猫咪将挑战你的观察力和记忆力。寻找、配对并整理它们，同时在全球排行榜中竞争！

4645440.title: Mouse X Demo
4645440.short_description: 你每天都在看着你的鼠标指针。用 Mouse X 来个性化它吧。在桌面上使用自定义动态光标，并在 Steam Workshop 上分享你自己的自定义光标皮肤！

1756600.title: Orbital Challenge
1756600.short_description: 在这个快节奏的物理平台游戏中，翻滚、跳跃和传送，挑战 10 个关卡！在全球排行榜中争夺最快通关时间！

2771220.title: The Tragedy at Deer Creek
2771220.short_description: A cinematic point-and-click adventure where you step into the shoes of photographer Charlotte Gray as she explores the abandoned camp of Deer Creek and uncovers the tragedy that befell the camp and its people.

4813860.title: Silky Road Demo
4813860.short_description: 选配独一无二的车厢组建你的列车，迎击一波波来袭的敌人，搜刮战利品并升级你的配置。在这款集自动战斗、列车防守、战略与放置挂机机理于一体的休闲游戏中不断变强。

4785440.title: Cosmic Carl Demo
4785440.short_description: The only things between Carl the Alien and the cold, uncaring vacuum of space are his rubbery forcefield, and a powerful rocket placed precariously on his back. Try not to kill Carl as you rocket, bounce, and orbit your way through fast paced, short levels with wacky physics.

4819150.title: Slay The Saxons Demo
4819150.short_description: Slay The Saxons is a fast-paced, tactical rogue-lite game played on an isometric grid. Command a warband of Viking heroes, each with unique abilities, against endless waves of Saxons. Position your shield wall, shove enemies into hazards, and master the grid to survive against overwhelming odds.

727450.title: 节奏狂怒
727450.short_description: 《节奏狂怒》是一款融合了弹幕射击要素的节奏音乐游戏，用你的吉他武装自己，和愤怒的音符激情碰撞，把和平重新带回音乐世界，体验手指发麻的快感。

4746610.title: The Disclosure Loop
4746610.short_description: The city is in chaos. The building won't let you leave. A first-person horror experience built on paranoia, anomalies, and alien frequencies. Out June 10, 2026.

4613300.title: Cosmist Demo
4613300.short_description: 在这款街机风格的策略游戏中征服银河！选择并指挥你的将领，派遣舰队前往遥远的星区，开采稀有资源，打造强大的升级。 但请小心——古老的神祇或许会插手，改变你的命运。

3223160.title: Apocalypse Express
3223160.short_description: 在后末日的背景中，抵御敌人无休止的进攻浪潮，对你的火车进行控制、升级和修理。在这款动作策略类肉鸽游戏中，玩家决定踏上穿越荒原的旅程，以期实现亲眼看一看外界遗迹的梦想。

2957090.title: Please Ignore The Anomalies
2957090.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about observing strange anomalies, surviving disturbing entities, and trying to make it to work on time. Sometimes the house is completely normal... sometimes it is not.

2654030.title: Kamilia
2654030.short_description: Kamilia 是一款以剧情为驱动、强调玩家选择的侦探悬疑游戏。扮演一位才华横溢的画家，在一起多年来未解的案件中揭开被尘封的真相。

4693460.title: The Dreams in the Peacock House
4693460.short_description: Wake up from a never-ending slumber and find your lost dreams in the shadows of the Peacock House.

4596790.title: Hostage Down
4596790.short_description: 在这个人质模拟中，拿起麦克风并协商赎金以释放人质。借助先进的人工智能和完全的选择自由，利用你的魅力、叙事决策和说服力来操纵不可预测的情况。每句话都很重要，而且可能要付出高昂的代价。

4121170.title: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
4121170.short_description: 在注意到与《Fears to Fathom》某个篇章有毛骨悚然的相似之处后，泰莎与马库斯决定分享他们自己的经历。斯克拉奇溪仅支持线上双人合作模式。

4816130.title: ICU - Intensive Care Unit 8 Demo
4816130.short_description: ICU – Intensive Care Unit 8 是一款单人恐怖游戏，主角被困在不断循环的走廊中，必须发现异常现象才能找到出口

4632580.title: Battlements Demo
4632580.short_description: Pirate ships, fortresses, and cannons! Battlements is an arcade reimagining of the "Rampart" classic. Defend the peaceful nation of Marinia from the dreaded Crimson Waves Empire - build walls, set up cannons, bombard the enemy! Control the fight with upgrades and special cards!

3858650.title: 时空迷踪
3858650.short_description: 与夏洛克·福尔摩斯和华生博士一同踏上旅程，在这场惊喜不断的“弹性”点击式冒险中自由探索吧。 尽情动动鼠标，抓取、拖拽并释放，协助他们破解这场充满幽默与“元时间”之旅的离奇悬案！

4737430.title: 难道你是GAL高手 Demo
4737430.short_description: 玩了多年游戏还是负KD的无口少女、顶级水平却不擅长画大雷的美少女画师，想打一辈子旮旯的富家千金、努力理解二次元为何物的现充妹妹——玩家将成为她们的男主，在名为“掐楼之家”的周边店里一同努力让店铺爆火，感情逐渐升温...废萌恋爱作、堂堂连载！

4734560.title: Lost Carcossa
4734560.short_description: Ascend the great tower, Babel, in this rogue-like to confront the tyrannical King in Yellow. Plan your moves in Turn-Based combat to ensure your victory and become stronger. Perhaps even recruiting new allies along the way.

4794730.title: Gambillion Demo
4794730.short_description: The house always wins, but they don't know you've still got a spare kidney. Bet big, drink cocktails that bend the odds, and chase a number so large it stops making sense. When your bankroll hits zero, how much of yourself are you willing to sell? Keep spinning. Keep selling. Don't die.

4771270.title: Kotoha’s Sealed Sword: Hiragana Deckbuilding Demo
4771270.short_description: Learn and master Japanese with Kotoha! Join her as she goes on a mission to find her grandfather's sealed sword. Discover new creatures. Unlock and craft new words, add them to your hand to aid you in battle.

4804110.title: Elecade Demo
4804110.short_description: 用连锁电击击倒失控的机械。 《Elecade》是一款 1bit 增量动作游戏，你将在不断强化中挑战宇宙设施的最上层。

4689940.title: Imagine We Were Human Demo
4689940.short_description: A compilation of 12 small literary games about humans meeting and missing one another. Explore these experimental experiences that were made on a monthly basis over the course of a year.

4795520.title: Ferrano: Beyond Redline Demo
4795520.short_description: Feel the rush at the limit. Weave through tight traffic in legendary retro supercars within a decaying synthwave simulation. Enter the flow state, synchronize with mates, or drive solo to break the limits and reach beyond the redline.

4683900.title: Golf 5 MAX Demo
4683900.short_description: Rise to golf stardom in a fast-paced arcade golf experience inspired by the ‘90s. Master RPG-style progression, compete online, and survive the intense “birdie-or-bust” Arcade Mode.

4805920.title: The Big Owl Night Demo
4805920.short_description: Survive a chaotic night in São Paulo of zombies, bosses and cursed upgrades in a fast-paced top-down roguelite. Collect weapons, trigger strange synergies, visit odd merchants and fight until the Big Owl lets you see another sunrise.

4815520.title: Forklift Basketball Demo
4815520.short_description: Earn your forklift certification in Forklift Basketball! Forklift Basketball is a chaotic, physics-based sports game where forklifts take center court. Drive, lift, and launch your way to victory in fast-paced matches filled with pure unpredictable fun!

4811760.title: Father Forgets Demo
4811760.short_description: 一个简短而富有氛围感的像素艺术故事，讲述一位父亲在深夜意识到自己的错误，并想起什么才是真正重要的。 灵感来自一部经典作品。适合父母、儿子、女儿，以及所有懂得“如果当时……”这种感觉的人。

4645090.title: BirdPakour Demo
4645090.short_description: Be free as a bird and dodge the obstacles that come your way.

4747040.title: Debt Free Dopamine
4747040.short_description: Buy. Scratch. Win money. Buy more. Don't win. Buy even more cards out of spite.

4794690.title: Farm Factory Simulator Demo
4794690.short_description: Grow crops, automate production, and manage your own store. Turn fresh harvests into valuable products, optimize your workflow, and build the ultimate farm-to-market business.

4772140.title: Bees Harvest Demo
4772140.short_description: An incremental roguelite collection game where you use gathered nectar and pollen to level up your bees. Start by collecting resources by hand, then automate your swarm. Gather as much nectar and pollen as you can within the limited time.

4429310.title: ノスフェラトゥの乙女たち
4429310.short_description: “—I am a genius. That is how I have defined myself.” Nosferatu no Otome-tachi is a visual novel set on a rooftop at night. A brilliant girl and a drowsy girl—two complete opposites—find themselves connected by the Nosferatu disease, and through it, they begin to build a genuine friendship.

3918070.title: Press a Button Simulator Demo
3918070.short_description: Welcome to Press a Button Simulator: a new and exciting twist on modern video games. Gone is the time of tryhards and sweats, and in is the new age of only pressing a button! Will you find all the secrets? Of course not! There is only one: You get to press a button!

3649530.title: 4PGP
3649530.short_description: 驰骋于世界各地的赛道！本游戏的魅力在于简单易上手的操作性，以及深受各个世代喜爱的设计。在这款街机竞速游戏中，挑战极速，争夺第一吧！

958520.title: 33不朽灵魂
958520.short_description: 33不朽灵魂 是一款支持33位玩家一齐上阵的动作Roguelike合作游戏。立即开启冒险，既可单人作战，也可与好友组队。迎战狱魔大军，击败强大头目，在冒险中不断成长强大。使用游戏内表情与其他反抗者协力作战，共同直面神的怒火。

4801510.title: 石碑 Demo
4801510.short_description: 石碑是一款3d等距视角开放探索解谜游戏。你降临在未知的岛屿上，探索遗迹，感受世界，追寻秘密，解救被困在远古谜题中的精灵，方能开启石碑离开此地。

4641800.title: Bean Wizard Eviscerates the Gonklins Demo
4641800.short_description: 🫘 The world's first twin-stick anthill shooter! 🫘 Reign terror down on the Gonklins using every bean in your arsenal. Be careful, warrior Gonklins will strike back with their blasters! Upgrade your legume weaponry and defeat King Donklin the Gonklin!

4692940.title: 深度求财：挖打撤 Demo
4692940.short_description: 《深度求财》是一款多人对抗的挖掘寻宝游戏，在神秘的地下探索多样的地下环境，跟其他玩家对抗，快速找到外星宝石并撤离，避开可能出现的鬼屋，木乃伊等非自然力量。挖掘，打击，启动列车并迅速撤离！

4514240.title: 孟婆靓汤 Demo
4514240.short_description: 一款带有模拟经营元素的纯狱系调饮类视觉小说。玩家扮演新孟婆“小孟娘”，在熟悉又陌生的现代地府中经营汤屋，招待来自三界形形色色的客户。通过熬制各种特调汤品，解决各式千奇八怪脑洞大开的遗忘需求，并逐渐了解到自己失忆和老孟婆失踪的真相……欢迎来到孟婆靓汤！这里的宗旨是——“忘陈莫急”！

4418780.title: Zombie Hamsters Demo
4418780.short_description: 一款支持4人合作的在线游戏。扮演僵尸仓鼠，从科学实验室逃脱，并感染你周围的所有人。

4280540.title: Liminal Logistics
4280540.short_description: A first-person action simulator where you pick up a box, check the order, stock the right items, and complete as many orders as you can. To level up and unlock new ways of delivering, you must survive a wide variety of handcrafted levels with different objectives.

4827710.title: Lightyears of Fervent Warfare Demo
4827710.short_description: Modern old school action with explosive firepower. Rack up kills to upgrade your ship. Use your tech skills wisely. Collect the best loot. And dominate the skies with space shotguns, homing swarm missiles and chain lightning! This is a work-in-progress passion project! ETA November '26!

3857430.title: Interdimensional Vending Machine
3857430.short_description: Inspired by SCP-261, you play as a homeless girl struggling to survive in a distorted city using a vending machine that should not exist. Every coin dispenses impossible food that defies biology and logic, and every meal reshapes your fate. How long can you survive before you stop being human?

4810110.title: HOMEWAVE Demo
4810110.short_description: 欢迎来到《Homewave OS》，这是一款围绕情绪驱动型操作系统打造的游戏，旨在让你的数字世界更加温暖、更富有人情味。在这里，你可以装饰虚拟房间，接取自由职业工作，探索客户的个人故事，还有更多精彩内容等你发现。

4601050.title: 财富郡：贸易与生产 Demo
4601050.short_description: 在中世纪的背景下从零开始发展您的郡，这规模远超单个城市。在广阔多变的地形中确定合适的定居点选址，沿着河流与道路编织贸易网络，并在您的区域逐渐成形时，管理市长、贵族和不同的文化分布。这是一款规模大得多的城市建造游戏，而你治下的每一个定居点的发展和表现，都由你完全定义。

4747030.title: Castle of Thorns Demo
4747030.short_description: A mystery visual novel set in a cursed castle. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the castle's dark past.

4787200.title: Slay the GoblinZ Demo
4787200.short_description: It is a demo version of Slay the GoblinZ Slay the GoblinZ - is a dark fantasy incremental RPG where you take on a job to exterminate goblins. Craft unique weapons, master deadly skills, and put an end to the Goblin Forefather.

3484020.title: Mini Golf Madness
3484020.short_description: Mini Golf Madness is a chaotic multiplayer mini-golf game where players select, build, and play courses all at once! Navigate tricky obstacles, set clever traps, and compete with friends for the top spot on the scoreboard. Ready to tee off into the madness?

4729840.title: GemCraft - Legacy Collection Demo
4729840.short_description: Try out the first few levels of the first three games of the best tower defense franchise of all time!

4570880.title: Boxcat Climber
4570880.short_description: Climb, fall, and try again in this Foddian adventure driven by environmental storytelling.

3383040.title: Beatdown City Survivors
3383040.short_description: Beatdown City Survivors 是一款怪物攻击幸存者风格的沉浸式沙盒游戏！升级鸽子、靴子和烟花等古怪武器。将它们结合起来，创造出有趣的游戏破坏策略。踢、烧、招募幸存者、制作组合武器、冻结、粉碎、电击——并生存下来！

2054260.title: Blast Head
2054260.short_description: 《Blast Head》是一款动态的Roguelite/Bullet Heaven动作游戏，拥有荒诞的武器、强大的符文和非线性的武器技能树。投入10–30分钟的游戏会话，发现疯狂的协同效果，在陌生的竞技场上肆意制造混乱。

4425830.title: Flesh Blossom Demo
4425830.short_description: Experience the horror of this Victorian-inspired medical RPG. As Doctor Parsnip Green, you’ll point-and-click your way through difficult choices as you investigate the disease’s origin, operate on patients, and fight to save those you love - all while managing your own dwindling sanity.

2679100.title: 巫塔战记
2679100.short_description: 投身开放世界，开启一场终极的巫师冒险。对战生物、收服魔宠，运用法术建造栖身之所，既可在单人模式中独乐乐，又能在多人模式中和其他巫师携手合作。

4636730.title: Project P.I.T.T. Demo
4636730.short_description: Feed rubber ducks to a corporate void. Build physics contraptions. Chain combos for profit as the Maw grows hungrier... and larger. Brutalist PSX satire meets first-person sandbox chaos.

3844970.title: 地精捣蛋团
3844970.short_description: 这是一款在线合作游戏，你将化身为一只小地精，闯入民宅制造混乱。躲避各种危险，改造偷来的家居物品，通过完成任务满足地精王的要求。制作装备并升级家园——让任务越做越顺手，捣蛋越来越成功。

4700890.title: A Puzzle game where you fold Dice Demo
4700890.short_description: Fold a net of a dice into a cube. This is the only video game in existence that relies on your 3D Spatial Reasoning skill.

4703330.title: Anomaly Road | 異変車道 [Demo]
4703330.short_description: "Anomaly Road" is an escape game set on a mountain road in Japan, combining horror, driving, and strange occurrences. While driving, you suddenly realize you've gotten lost on a road deep in the mountains. As you turn a corner with a bad feeling, what awaits you...?

4810690.title: Hexborn Demo
4810690.short_description: Hexborn is a dark fantasy action RPG where you rise from an unknown mage into the leader of a legendary guild. Master arcane combat, recruit powerful allies, forge relics, and descend into dangerous dungeons and large-scale raids to uncover the secrets behind your rare ability to fly.

3931720.title: All That Time
3931720.short_description: All That Time is a psychological horror experience where you explore unstable dreamlike memories, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover fragmented lives inside a collapsing liminal system.

4775150.title: Random Horse Derby
4775150.short_description: 一款极简且全自动的小型赛马游戏。在5匹马中做出选择，赢得尽可能多的胜利，从而提升你的全球 online 排行榜 Dh 。

3590010.title: Robot Hospice
3590010.short_description: 《Robot Hospice》是一款 2D 像素风格的冒险游戏，在这里，与人类共度时光的机器人将迎来他们的最后旅程。你将作为新员工，照顾这些曾经被深深爱着的机器人，陪伴他们走向生命的终点，体验温柔却又令人心碎的故事。

1570450.title: 泰坦防线2
1570450.short_description: 泰坦巨兽正在践踏你的防线，即刻执行机甲入侵抵御协议！《泰坦防线2》融合RTS塔防与FPS战斗，构建防御体系、调度火力网络、统筹资源科技。指令精准、决策高效，防线将逐渐推进，反向瓦解敌军的装甲洪流。战争已成为精密而残酷的运算。维持逻辑、秩序与绝对理智，进入终局战场，碾碎他们!

4615560.title: Idle Hacker Demo
4615560.short_description: IdleHacker is an idler/incremental game where you hack the world.

4750750.title: Chreynard Demo
4750750.short_description: 回溯时间，操控分身，在这款创新的2D动作解谜游戏中破解重重谜题。凭借智慧与技巧，在30个充满怀旧魅力的像素风关卡中尽情驰骋。

4742540.title: Bug Buster Bros
4742540.short_description: 欢迎来到 Exterminator Inc.！厨房已被侵占，你的班次刚 column 开始，唯有满屋的蟑螂阻挡你拿到薪水。在这款温馨又混乱 columns 的时限生存点击游戏中，狂点并粉碎 4 个恶心房间里的一切吧！

4782510.title: 流転のジェミニ Demo
4782510.short_description: A short demo of the RPG Gemini in Flux, a small interlude within the main story. The protagonist roams the land of the dead with their partner — an apothecary — seeking clues to their lost memories and a gift to thank the one they love. Chat with townsfolk to find "Mitama Stones."

4635460.title: Bus Terminal Simulator Demo
4635460.short_description: 体验沉浸式终点站管理模拟器。管理乘客，安排时刻表，检查行李，抓捕走私者并防止非法活动。并非所有乘客都是无辜的；有些人会试图欺骗你或携带非法物品。保持警惕，高效管理你的终点站。

3967030.title: Withdrawal
3967030.short_description: An FPS roguelike heist. Play as Mr. (?) Norton on his way to exterminate the whole headquarters of the Cranterry Wealth Corporation.

2461910.title: Immortal Payroll
2461910.short_description: 修仙世界就像传说中那么美好吗？也许那只是另一个牛马世界。

4796080.title: Compound Interest Demo
4796080.short_description: The networks are dead. The city has fallen. Manage your crew and send them into danger to earn money and respect. Claim turf, control trade, and make allies or enemies as you reshape the fully simulated city of New Sterling.

4684680.title: 2 Players 1 Character Demo
4684680.short_description: 一款合作游戏。两个灵魂共同操控一个萌系角色，齐心协力逃离冥界、登上天堂。

4284580.title: 邪恶推币机
4284580.short_description: 《邪恶推币机》是一款融合了肉鸽策略与推币机爽感的黑暗风游戏。你负债累累，被困在一家永不打烊的黑暗酒吧里。你唯一的生路，就是面前的推币机——推下硬币、堆起闪亮的币塔、摇动机台，感受硬币倾泻而下的致命快感，解开隐藏在推币机背后的谜团。

4747190.title: Realm of the Wyvern Demo
4747190.short_description: A tactical turn-based RPG set in a fully handcrafted dark fantasy world.

3883800.title: Car Wash Simulator (Demo)
3883800.short_description: 泡沫！冲洗！闪耀！投入洗车行业，以高压水枪的视角来体验这款官方试玩版吧！用丰富的活性泡沫冲洗掉道路污垢，在3辆独特的汽车上掌握从车窗到轮胎的核心清洁机制，并在停车场进行试驾！

4713990.title: 战争警戒 Demo
4713990.short_description: 战线在废墟与烟尘间缓慢推进，你将指挥步兵、装甲与空中力量在混乱前线拉开阵势。占点、突破、包围与反包围层层展开。无数值付费，公平对战，唯有清晰的策略与默契的协作能帮助你赢得胜利。

3815790.title: 放置大陆 试玩版
3815790.short_description: Idle RPG Strategy game where you gather resources, battle creatures, and upgrade your gear. Master 10+ skills to create items you can equip or sell. Your journey never stops, even offline. No Microtransactions, No P2W, just pure idle fun.

4218380.title: Wall World Strategy Demo
4218380.short_description: 在无尽之墙的表面建立并领导你的殖民地。管理资源与居民，研发全新科技，抵御无休止的泽雷克进攻，并派遣机械蜘蛛执行高风险探索任务。维持殖民地的运转——在墙世界中，一切都很容易分崩离析。

3705150.title: Into The Depths
3705150.short_description: 这是一款 Roguelike 城市建造游戏，带你深入神秘的地下世界。建设你的定居点，探索洞穴，并一步步向地底最深处扩张。在黑暗中克服潜伏的危险，将深渊中的财富据为己有！

4763940.title: Lofi Cozy Room Demo
4763940.short_description: 桌面一角的透明迷你房间和悠扬 Lo-Fi 音乐,让你的工作时光更加舒心。在试玩版中抢先体验《Lofi Cozy Room》的全部功能。

4733030.title: All one click Demo
4733030.short_description: "All one click" is an Action-RPG that reduces player input to the most exciting part of every RPG: the level-up. Prove yourself against thousands of enemies in seemingly endless waves. Use the power of magic spells to assert yourself against the countless enemies. But be warned: every click counts!

4764500.title: Cardora Demo
4764500.short_description: A multiplayer card game that fuses Poker and Okey mechanics with powerful active and passive cards. Build clever combinations, disrupt your opponents with interaction cards, and outplay everyone at the table.

4709210.title: 碎镜 Shardmirror
4709210.short_description: 《碎镜》是一款中式妖异题材的肉鸽卡牌构筑游戏。每张卡牌拥有正反两面。拥有双轨地图，全局镜魇系统。。。以及一些奇怪的,打破第四面墙的机制。

4288020.title: Quick Brown
4288020.short_description: Explore a surreal forest full of meerkats, collect alphabet relics, and help a fox chase a dream no animal has ever reached.

4798650.title: Fruit Fetish Demo
4798650.short_description: Fruit Fetish is an active incremental game where you must strive to make as much money as fast as possible by harvesting and selling a range of juicy fruits. Upgrade your skills and shop to become a master at your craft. Maybe if you work hard enough, you can finally please your corporate overlords.

4573060.title: Lab 2040
4573060.short_description: Lab 2040 is a Sci-fi, first person shooter game where the player combats different robots and drones using various weapons. Weapons include pistols, automatic guns, grenade, time bombs and more. There are 10 main levels which you will have to progress through to get to the final boss, Bamidele.

4690560.title: Increbouncer Demo
4690560.short_description: Increbouncer 是一款短小的放置类弹球游戏，您可以发射球、从墙壁弹跳和球球碰撞中赚取两种货币、解锁新球，并升级技能树以最大化收入。

4698550.title: PC Companion
4698550.short_description: A unique desktop companion that lives on your PC, reacts to your activity, and evolves with you. Each player gets only one heroine… unless they uncover the secret.

4599930.title: FreeStyle Football 2 Demo
4599930.short_description: 《自由足球2》是一款快节奏的5v5在线多人足球竞技游戏。 每个位置都有独特的角色分工，你需要运用各种策略和技能，与队友一起赢得胜利。 炫酷的玩法和独特的角色将球场变幻为展现自我的舞台。

4353510.title: Lastgirl Survivor
4353510.short_description: Survive the bizarre mechanical courthouse! 'Lastgirl Survivor' is a pixel art, single PvE action rogue-lite featured game! Forget boring auto-battlers—smash through endless grotesque monsters using precise rhythm-based dashes. Find out the TRUTH with I:sol..!

4724750.title: SWAT God Demo
4724750.short_description: SWAT God 是世界上最快的射击游戏。独特的鼠标操控带来无限的速度与精准度。冷酷无情的敌人只会越来越强。你够快吗？

4811400.title: Hack 42: Typing Incremental Demo
4811400.short_description: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for fun and profit.

4701370.title: Come in
4701370.short_description: 经过几个月的线上聊天，她邀请你到她家来。 一栋位于偏僻森林深处的静谧小屋，似乎是浪漫邂逅的完美场所。但你待得越久，就越觉得这地方不对劲。

3750290.title: ChopstickSimulator
3750290.short_description: simulation game where you pick up beans using chopsticks! With a variety of beans available, collectors will find it incredibly addictive. The calming background music and sound effects make it perfect for unwinding after a long day of other games. Enjoy this chill game now!

4621730.title: 修仙纪-守护宗门 Demo
4621730.short_description: 在苍茫修仙世界，你身为宗门核心弟子，肩负守护宗门阵眼的重任。一旦阵眼被破，万年基业将毁于一旦。精心布下防御仙塔，构筑铁壁防线；防线稳固时，深入秘境斩妖除魔，搜集灵材与仙宝。将资源用于塔防升级与仙法觉醒，在一波波凶猛妖魔攻势中，守护宗门最后的希望。你是固守阵眼，还是仗剑主动出击？

4795400.title: House Warming Demo
4795400.short_description: Brian Lewis 买下一栋老房子，希望开始安静而有秩序的生活。但在第一个夜晚，房子就开始变得诡异……原本看似无害的意外，逐渐变成更加可怕的事情……如果屋里还有别人呢？

4776320.title: 方块计算机 Demo
4776320.short_description: 在这款极简主义的逻辑解谜游戏中，你将化身为计算法则的构筑者。通过排列功能各异的逻辑方块，构建起精巧的数据处理通路。

4641100.title: Final Shelter
4641100.short_description: A multiplayer social survival game inspired by the “Bunker” board game, where players must convince others that they deserve a place in the shelter. Debate, argue, reveal your character traits, and vote - only a few will survive.

4318420.title: ABOVE
4318420.short_description: A daylight, psychological horror experience. Stranded in the desert, every choice meant to save you brings something closer.

4776210.title: Into the Cannon, Soldier! Demo
4776210.short_description: 你已身处最后一道防线。招募将士，死守阵地，用一尊巨炮将他们发射到另一片正在崩溃的血肉磨坊中。在这款支持1-2人合作的战术防御游戏中，你就是悬在两场战役头顶的审判之剑——你的每一个残酷决定，都将改写双线战场的最终命运。

3564340.title: 专业抬杠
3564340.short_description: 暴躁国王空降峡谷，你和TA的“担架”闯关正式开始！当暴躁国王被炮弹炸到你们脚边时，一场爆笑协作冒险就此展开。两人需默契操控担架，将国王平安护送回王座。这条道路危机四伏、布满奇怪陷阱！每次惊险平衡都是心跳考验，每次翻车都成为甜蜜回忆，快喊上和你关系最好的TA，准备好笑出腹肌吧！

4284790.title: Cats and Tails
4284790.short_description: Cats & Tails is a luck-driven coin game where you chase a streak of 10 Cats, face unpredictable outcomes, and unlock multiple endings over repeated playthroughs.

4695940.title: 明鉴侦探事务所 Demo
4695940.short_description: 《明鉴侦探事务所》是一款以90年代韩国为背景、以剧情为核心的双人合作推理游戏。 哥哥与幽灵妹妹接受人类与幽灵的委托，一同调查案件。 玩家将从各自不同的视角收集线索，并通过沟通来完成谜题。 在不对称的信息中协作，并展开推理。 来体验那个使用BP机与公用电话的模拟时代，揭开潜藏于城市之中的谜团吧。

4747890.title: 包罗万象 Demo
4747890.short_description: 《包罗万象Demo》是一款以挖掘道具为核心、融合轻度 Rogue 元素的回合制休闲牌组构筑游戏。 背上能够自动回收道具的魔法背包，升级你的装备，探索强力的组合，击败强敌，守护王国的和平。 ……等等？连垃圾也会被自动收回？ 那看来，只能从垃圾堆里把能用的东西再挖出来继续战斗了。

4222040.title: Detective INNA DUKE
4222040.short_description: Detective Inna Duke is a noir story-driven visual novel where you team up with lieutenant Inna Duke and her partner corporal Fernal to investigate the mysterious abduction of the popular streamer Oleh Hamston. But will you manage to track down the poor hamster in rainy city?

4151780.title: Labytrip Spirit Demo
4151780.short_description: LabyTrip Spirit is an adventure puzzle-action game about a soul lost in the labyrinths of the afterlife. Work with friends to guide the spirit to ascension, or vie with other players toward the abyss. Be watchful, shrewd, and swift as you make your way through the changing labyrinths of limbo.

4475440.title: Chromium 小恐龙
4475440.short_description: 经典 Chromium 恐龙跑酷全面升级！穿越沙漠、雪原、森林、城市、太空五大生态，收集道具与皮肤，挑战幽灵竞速和每日关卡，支持本地双人同屏游玩。上手简单，精通困难。

4685380.title: Portucale Sword and Subtlety
4685380.short_description: Portucale is a strategic card-battler set in a brutal new kingdom. Build prestige, fortify borders, and weaponize treachery with the unique Cheat mechanic. In this tense psychological duel, your walls generate gold while you dismantle your rival’s legacy through sword and subtlety.

4744390.title: We Belong Dead
4744390.short_description: Toxic Yuri VN between a mad scientist, and her spectral lover who haunts the living. It has been far too long since you passed. You have been gone for so long. But no longer. I will bring you back my love. No matter the cost.

4766520.title: 喵喵时光：猫咪的温馨小屋Demo
4766520.short_description: 《喵喵时光：猫咪的温馨小屋》是一款游戏化专注工具。装扮一间温馨的小房间，养一只可爱的小猫咪，用简单实用的工具来提高工作效率。与可爱的小猫一起度过这段美好时光吧！与猫咪相处的越久会有更多的惊喜。

4654510.title: Erareset: Rogue Forum
4654510.short_description: Talk about games, movies, pop culture, current events, just try not to get banned. See how many threads you last.

4476050.title: Block Wars: Falling Duel Demo
4476050.short_description: Block Wars is a fast competitive puzzle battle inspired by 1990s arcade classics. Precision matters, reflexes win, and every move counts. Master unique block mechanics, unleash lightning-powered boosters, and defeat increasingly dangerous bots in the demo’s three combat stages.

4801410.title: ScapeTime Demo
4801410.short_description: ScapeTime 是一款充满挑战的第一人称跑酷游戏，每一秒都至关重要。穿越高难度关卡，掌握精准的移动技巧，并在时间耗尽之前抵达终点。

1642440.title: Kleopatra
1642440.short_description: The scientist had only succeeded in creating a stranger. Kleopatra is a cyberpunk visual novel with roguelite combat. A story about grief, forgiveness, and the distance between who someone was and who we remember.

4809890.title: Virtual Karting Garage Demo
4809890.short_description: Get in the garage. Tune every mechanical and visual setting, then watch the chassis flex and tires deform in real time as you steer. Experience the physics now. Racing will come with Early Access soon.

4817380.title: Dumb Dunks - Demo
4817380.short_description: Dumb Dunks! is a wildly creative, satirical twist on basketball where every level throws a ridiculous new object and target at you. Master tricky physics, perfect your timing, and embrace the chaos in this humorous physics-based dunking frenzy.

4786720.title: The Frozen Cabin Demo
4786720.short_description: Trapped in a frozen cabin during a relentless storm, you begin to realize the silence around you isn’t empty… something is watching, waiting, and getting closer.

3559510.title: 胶囊恋人
3559510.short_description: 欢乐的治愈系视觉小说。不想内卷的自由职业者胡莱，住在胶囊宾馆过着与世无争的生活。直到某天，活泼开朗的少女阮小柒强行闯入了他的世界！于是，抽象纯情小辣妹和深藏不露躺平男的恋爱故事，就这样开始啦！

4829590.title: Beyond The Frame Demo
4829590.short_description: Beyond The Frame is a first-person linear narrative experience about exploring dreams shaped by childhood anxiety. Journey through eerie, liminal spaces where the familiar becomes distorted by dream logic, and uncover your story through the metaphors within them.

4830370.title: 合成深渊 Demo
4830370.short_description: 《Abyss Forge》是一款太空科幻主题的匹配合成 Roguelike 游戏。移动棋子、完成三消与合成，积累燃料、效率、科研等资源，并通过随机强化打造不同构筑路线，在有限步数内让飞船不断深入未知星域。

4710650.title: 白书传说
4710650.short_description: 《白书传说》是一款有着冒险要素的互动小说游戏，在由犬族统治的战乱的末世中，主角石烬为了生存成为了一个土匪，在一次打劫的行动中，自己遇到了恐怖的正规军，而在自己全军覆没之后，他被要挟去执行一项奇怪的任务，正是这个任务解开了被犬族尘封的过去的历史，也展开了一场紧张的逃命之旅......

4728070.title: The Crystalline Realm
4728070.short_description: The Crystalline Crystal is a fast-paced twin-stick roguelike, with only 60 seconds to find a key before the room explodes will you survive ? How many rooms can you survive ? Will you escape and discover the secret of The Crystalline Realm ?

3882200.title: PLATONICA SPACE Demo
3882200.short_description: 门的背后，隐藏着某个人的记忆——《柏拉图深空》是一款为了寻回记忆对无数房间展开探索的心理空间探索ADV。

4503710.title: SAMURAI CLICKER Infinite Build Mastery
4503710.short_description: In this game, you’ll slash through enemies with simple clicks while crafting powerful builds to become unstoppable.

4726740.title: Heartfall Demo
4726740.short_description: A competitive online multiplayer Hearts card game where the rules shift every hand. Match against three opponents across five rotating game modes, each one adding a twist that changes how you play, pass, and score. Currently in playtest phase.

4797760.title: 东方天试院 ～ Celestial Examination Hall
4797760.short_description: A fan-made 3D fighting game set in the Touhou Project universe! Unease once again shrouds Gensokyo, as terrifying rumors intertwine with the rising craze of 'Celestial Cultivation'!? End this chaos with dazzling combos and tactical mastery！

4625930.title: 覚醒：鬼ヶ島 Demo
4625930.short_description: A predictive deck-building RPG! Build your strategy from over 300 cards! Form powerful formations with unique animal companions! Master countless combinations and claim overwhelming victories! Your adventure to defeat the ONI begins now!

4598520.title: 修仙长生界
4598520.short_description: 本作为双人独立开发的经典端游风格文字修仙网游（6月12日10点开启测试），以高自由、真随机、纯掉落为核心，无挂机、非单机，全程在线体验公平无限制玩法。游戏设四大特色宗门，各拥专属心法与剑系 / 火雷系 / 水土系 / 法宝强化专属养成方向，可体验在线修炼、灵植炼丹、宗门任务，亦能闯历练、战世界 BOSS、参与宗门大比赢取奖励。玩法上支持无限制搭配，功法随心学、装备法宝可强化洗练，法宝还能自动作战，全服道具 100% 随机掉落无保底。拍卖行开放全道具无限制自由交易，可打宝变现，严厉封禁工作室脚本维护公平。游戏还含玩家切磋、排行榜、灵纹锻造等丰富玩法，开发团队将持续根据玩家建议优化内容。

4663020.title: Escape The Complex
4663020.short_description: Escape The Complex is a first-person, 3D, puzzle game set in an abandoned and dilapidated complex. Your goal is to explore the complex, solving puzzles to advance through each area until you escaping the complex entirely.

4686530.title: Crow's Foot Demo
4686530.short_description: A turn-based hex strategy you can finish over lunch. Outsmart AI rivals, each with their own grudges, ambitions, and breaking points. Conquer provinces, command knights, scouts, assassins, and more. Unlock rule-bending scrolls. Go bankrupt and your own army defects.

4405670.title: 森林逃生：末班列车 试玩版
4405670.short_description: 《森林逃生：末班列车》是一款支持 1-4 人联机的多人生存合作游戏。迷雾森林、疯狂典狱长的超现实心魔、随时可能散架的火车......你必须与队友联手修复、升级并捍卫破旧的火车头，开采关键资源。拉响汽笛，在被噩梦彻底吞噬前，驶向唯一的生路！

4794530.title: PinballRobotDoctor Demo
4794530.short_description: 这是「弹珠机器人医生」的试玩版。玩家将操控赛博机械弹球"机械修理"装置，指尖把控弹板精反射金属弹球。依靠真实物理回弹逻辑，通过不断碰撞机关破解障碍，最终修理目标完成关卡。

4791270.title: 旧日代码：遗物整理师 Demo
4791270.short_description: 在废土修破烂，听死人说话。基于15万字科幻小说的HD文字RPG。

4795630.title: Monkeys!¡ Demo
4795630.short_description: 由HARUKAZE带来的欢乐校园恋爱视觉小说游戏。就读男校的不良少年主角——猿吉为了拯救即将被废校的母校，潜入顶尖名门女校，展开了“提升男性印象”的大挑战！

4469270.title: Bunderkin: The Ocular Eclipse Demo
4469270.short_description: Trapped in a 3‑day time loop, you must master each moment and live the perfect day or watch the town that despises you fall into darkness.

4323810.title: nonogram
4323810.short_description: A simple minimalistic relaxing nonogram puzzle without any time pressure. Solve relaxing grid-based challenges at your own pace as soothing visuals and gentle soundscapes help you focus and unwind.

3834650.title: 怪棋物语
3834650.short_description: 这是一场肉鸽 + 自走棋的魔堡冒险！你将在有限资源里精打细算：招募佣兵、搭配专属装备与药剂，解锁能力强大的遗物。更要活用每个佣兵独一无二的「影之能力」，让队伍战力层层蜕变，最终杀穿魔堡，对掏魔王！画面虽不顶级，玩进去绝对沉迷！一旦队伍成型,将享受绝对的杀戮爽感！

4801640.title: 迷失小镇 Demo
4801640.short_description: 《迷失小镇》是一款 3D 肉鸽生存射击游戏，玩家将化身持枪少女，在被猩红腐化的废弃小镇中展开亡命探索。 你需要在随机生成的地图中对抗成群畸变怪物，击杀敌人获取经验升级，解锁海量随机技能与强化道具，打造专属战斗 build。每局冒险的地图布局、敌人配置、技能组合完全随机，带来永不过时的新鲜感。 你的核心目标并非杀光所有敌人，而是在危机四伏的区域中找到隐藏的逃生通道。紧张刺激的战斗节奏、丰富的技能搭配，让每一次挑战都充满策略与爽感，在绝境中杀出一条生路，揭开小镇被腐化的秘密。

4789550.title: Eggscape Demo
4789550.short_description: A third person surviving action game. You’re a chicken escaping the slaughterhouse factory. Find your stolen chicks and free your fellow chickens as you fight through the factory, and survive the hunt from workers and failed lab creations.

4812320.title: Rhomfaya: The Rays of Liberty Demo
4812320.short_description: A land invaded, with a web of lies and bloodshed serving as a catalyst. Build an army of over 40 unique characters and liberate the Kingdom of Ezebar from the chaotic shadows that threaten it, in this sprite-based tactical RPG!

4812680.title: Skate Mates Demo
4812680.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer skating game where each player controls one skate! Only epic teamwork and swift communication will get you through the brutal obstacle course! Dodge the blades, jump the canyons, and avoid the lava, because one mistake sends you all the way back.

4825230.title: 1daYs Demo
4825230.short_description: 1daYs是一款日常与小小谜团交织在一起的2D叙事冒险游戏。

4835940.title: Goldfish Gunner Demo
4835940.short_description: Become the most wanted outlaw by taking on the role of Goldfish, a gunner robbing every bank in the Wild West. Escape across challenging, obstacle-filled landscapes where your only way to move is by firing your weapon and riding the recoil.

4824550.title: Supermarket Simulator: Idle Tycoon Clicker Demo
4824550.short_description: 从小市场起步，打造庞大的超市帝国！在《Supermarket Simulator: Idle Tycoon Clicker》中，填满货架、满足顾客、进行升级、增加收入并发展你的超市。点击、管理、赚钱，成为巅峰！

4550100.title: My Coworkers Are Made Of Static Demo
4550100.short_description: A horror game, where you found yourself trapped at your job. Leave the office. And remember - The Spider is watching.

4614600.title: 112 Meters Demo
4614600.short_description: The city has fallen. Rescue helicopters can’t land. Your only escape is reaching 112 meters but there are no buildings. Stack whatever you can find and climb before the infected catch you.

4805710.title: EXOSHOCK Demo
4805710.short_description: Exoshock is a 1-4 cooperative sci-fi PvE shooter built VR-first from the ground up, featuring intense firefights, squad tactics, and dynamic battlefields!

4700690.title: Red Door or Blue Door?
4700690.short_description: 这是一个心理恐怖游戏。你必须连续14天选择红色或蓝色的门。只要选错一次，就会死亡，然后从头开始！欢迎来到这场不允许犯错的恐怖谜题。记住：有人在暗中盯着你。

4489640.title: Janet DeMornay Is A Slumlord (and a witch) Demo
4489640.short_description: RENT MONEY IS DEAD MONEY and your landlord is expecting payment IN FULL. Puzzle your way out of a maze of DEPRAVED magical appliances and the UNHINGED diaries of a DEBAUCHED faded television celebrity.

4725950.title: Twinkle Seek Demo
4725950.short_description: 出发去寻找闪光，直到世界的尽头！

4787780.title: 暗巷 Demo
4787780.short_description: 在暗巷公寓中躲避白衣女鬼，集齐钥匙逃出生天。

4725850.title: Pubes Demo
4725850.short_description: 一款操控一根体毛在3D房间中移动的3D动作游戏!使用体毛独特的蓬松漂浮和粘附能力安全到达目的地!

4815460.title: Sword and Sweep Demo
4815460.short_description: Every enemy is a hidden board puzzle. Find the weak points, avoid the traps, and figure out how it fights before it kills you. Roguelike dungeon crawler with deep build customization.

4777700.title: How to Fly a Cannon Demo
4777700.short_description: Your cannon isn't just a weapon - it's also how you launch into the air! Shoot towards the ground and fly skyward in this physics-based destruction game.

2080890.title: Gem Venture
2080890.short_description: Jump, dash, and mine your way through obstacles and enemies in this platforming tribute to the classics! Restore the Sacred Gems of Aventurine, or else it will become a land of nothingness.

4828420.title: Dead Rose Demo
4828420.short_description: Hand-crafted 2D pixel art action-adventure. Play as Lucky, a skeleton lost in the world of spirits, and set out in search of Rose through a dark and magical world that blends Metroidvania exploration with Zelda-like adventure.

4778450.title: Deepcore Mining Demo
4778450.short_description: 在遥远的星球上开采稀有矿石，并将其出售以完成公司的配额。利用利润购买升级项目。但要小心：你挖得越深，在黑暗中等待你的危险就越大。

4621160.title: CyberZ: Energy Wars Demo
4621160.short_description: CyberZ：能源战争是一款节奏紧凑的第三人称PvP射击游戏。每一场对局都会将你投入战区，在这里只有两件事最重要：你的瞄准能力和你的经济策略。每回合开始时，你可以用赚取的积分购买武器和装备，或者为下一回合积攒更具毁灭性的资源。

4792130.title: Retro Districts: In-Between Eras Demo
4792130.short_description: A time machine. A war. A leap into 2225. Humanity now lives in retro districts — neighborhoods dedicated to different decades of the 20th century. Unlock ideas, secrets and places — from cabarets to TV studios, from galleries to protests. Choose your words wisely. Every dialogue shapes your path.

4825920.title: OrbitFix Demo
4825920.short_description: 继承银河边缘的一座废弃空间站，赋予它新的生命。作为终极太空机械师，你将修理各种飞船，与飞行员交易，并扩展你的服务。从一个生锈的码头开始，打造该星区最繁忙的服务中心！

4137910.title: Home Deco Puzzles Demo
4137910.short_description: 《Home Deco Puzzles》将迷你的室内装饰与记忆拼图玩法相结合。观察房间布局、拆箱并将物品归位！包含60个关卡、每日奖励、任务系统和提示功能。简单上手，轻松解压，适合所有玩家。

4746730.title: FOOD FIGHT! Demo
4746730.short_description: Throw food. Dodge food. Dodge the check. In this arcade style party game you and your friends make a big, expensive mess while trying not to get caught by the waiter.

4824480.title: Powder Runners: Maze Quest Demo
4824480.short_description: 在危机四伏、布满陷阱、怪物和对手的迷宫中奔跑、战斗并生存下去。你可以独自游玩，也可以与朋友组队，在为时已晚之前率先找到魔法传送门。

4833090.title: Loaded Dice - A Yahtzee Roguelike Demo
4833090.short_description: A dice-driven roguelike where you build an unpredictable deck, chain devastating charms, and roll massive Yahtzee combos to hit the target score—before your luck finally runs out.

4527390.title: RobBred - Funny Chat
4527390.short_description: 无聊？寂寞？想认识新朋友？ 在这里，你将遇到随机玩家，展开疯狂、有趣又精彩的对话。 年度最疯狂的独立游戏之一就在这里。

4750680.title: Elven Huntress: Sunveil Demo
4750680.short_description: 一款充满氛围感的 3D 动作 RPG，扮演精灵女猎手穿越魔法传送门探索奇幻世界。探索首个区域、收集稀有装备，并揭开 Sunveil 世界的秘密。

4811720.title: Madame Manager: Velvet Simulation Demo
4811720.short_description: 弗洛伊德曾开发过一款妓院主题的游戏，结果惨遭滑铁卢。于是，他干脆开了一家真正的妓院。经营这座城市最私密的场所，安排员工、满足顾客需求、躲避警方突袭，并见证一个破碎灵魂的故事徐徐展开。黑色喜剧。深度模拟。

4564810.title: Waning Light Demo
4564810.short_description: Waning Light is a story-rich card battler with life-sim elements, where players navigate five days of balancing real-world responsibilities and a shifting dream world shaped by their choices. What you focus on, and what you neglect, changes how both worlds unfold.

4359800.title: Don't Panic Together
4359800.short_description: Don’t Panic Together 是一款带有麦克风检测系统的在线合作心理恐怖游戏。玩家需要探索黑暗森林、收集重要物品并合作完成任务。但恐慌、尖叫和过大的声音可能会迅速导致死亡。

4833200.title: Breakaway Demo
4833200.short_description: Breakaway's version of soccer blends physics-based gameplay with simulations of world-class ball control: juggling, kicking, and curving the ball to victory.. or test your hands as goalkeeper! Play offline or online with friends in a dystopian robotic universe.

4745820.title: Taival Demo
4745820.short_description: 线下同屏，线上联机，或者线上线下一起，想怎么玩，就怎么玩。《Taival》是一款温馨的合作冒险游戏，你最多可以邀请3位好友，携手百变伙伴，共同探索这个精心手绘的神奇世界。快来解锁全新形态，一步步揭开故事篇章，让旅程充满专属于你们的精彩回忆。

4682950.title: Bravest! Demo
4682950.short_description: The “Braveast” series—a retro RPG from the feature phone era—and its landmark first installment!

4613700.title: A Little Space Demo
4613700.short_description: A top-down 2D space game about going fast through platformer-style levels. Master your ship's momentum-based movement, unlock abilities, race the clock and hunt for secrets as you guide lost astronaut Riley on her journey home from deep space.

4815810.title: The Aether Project Demo
4815810.short_description: A classic tower defense game with evolving battlefields and relentless waves. Build deadly defenses, adapt to new attack routes, and survive escalating enemy assaults.

4780940.title: The Few Demo
4780940.short_description: Fly the Spitfire and dogfight the Luftwaffe over the Channel in this free demo of The Few — a WW2 combined-arms combat game built for players, not whales. No grind, no premium currency, no paywalled planes. One fair price for the whole war.

4666330.title: Trash Day Demo
4666330.short_description: 在这款基于物理的合作冒险游戏中，与你的浣熊小队通力合作。翻找垃圾、装满购物车，齐心协力回到家。体验最棒的浣熊生活。

4826570.title: SPACERO: ORIGINS Demo
4826570.short_description: Pilot a customizable ship through a hostile open galaxy in this top-down space action RPG demo. Mine resources, trade at stations, upgrade your weapons, survive faction attacks, and face a massive boss encounter.

4802290.title: Late Order Demo
4802290.short_description: 被诅咒的24/7餐厅里的夜班。每天晚上——新的规则和令人不安的事件。完成订单，不要惹恼吉祥物身体里的古怪怪物，也许你还有机会活到黎明。

4375290.title: 命运挽歌：词汇英灵录 序章
4375290.short_description: 你将扮演伦兰特魔法学院新生，步入了这所尤斯亚德大陆最顶尖的魔法学院。新人入学后需要学习掌握如何操控英灵卡牌来召唤英灵。你作为玩家需要不断的积累魔法咒语（英语单词）来控制英灵进行战斗，从而成为一名合格的英灵召唤师。

4804400.title: 维京杂货铺Demo
4804400.short_description: 开局坐拥维京港口，低价买入高价卖出赚差价，鉴定未知物品一夜暴富！重建铁匠铺、附魔神器、雇佣劫掠者，让每一名维京人都成为你的顾客！

2211170.title: 一起开火车2：汽笛重鸣
2211170.short_description: 《一起开火车》的续作来啦！快呼朋唤友再建铁轨重鸣汽笛吧！更多特色鲜明的地理环境，升级角色和引擎，选择脑洞大开的全新路线；在火车脱轨前，快将你自定义的关卡设计分享给更多轨道爱好者吧！

4790570.title: ORBTRUDER Demo
4790570.short_description: ORBTRUDER is a tactical roguelite action platformer about a ricocheting killer robot ball. Climb ever higher up a mysterious skyscraper. Ricochet, attack, slow down time, respawn, and try again.

4039900.title: ZOMBUTCHER: Monster Business Simulator
4039900.short_description: 肉铺模拟器，你将扮演一只僵尸！白天向人类售卖肉类，夜晚屠宰他们，通过潜行与资源管理经营黑暗生意，同时大快朵颐地享用人脑！

4747880.title: Hex Master
4747880.short_description: Hex Master is a neon-drenched arcade arena shooter inspired by retro chaos. Survive endless swarms, unleash devastating bombs, climb the global leaderboard, and become the Hex Master.

3337380.title: 桌上谈兵
3337380.short_description: 招募一支狂野的雇佣兵团，在桌面风格的混乱战场上，指挥你的战士冲锋陷阵。无限的构筑可能、残酷的抉择考验、无穷的重玩价值——桌上谈兵，一款专为Roguelike爱好者而生的即时战略游戏。

4596860.title: Idle Protocol
4596860.short_description: 《Idle Protocol》是一款极简科幻塔防和增量放置游戏。管理中央 CPU 内核，装备正好 2 个节点，并抵御几何异常体的入侵。执行系统重启以赚取周期，并在 BIOS 中解锁永久模块！

4776910.title: Gnome Glade Demo
4776910.short_description: Gnome Glade - a cozy city builder puzzle with deckbuilding. Help gnomes build a village in a magic forest! Grow and merge mushrooms, build your deck of cards, and raise a golden statue. Create a gnome paradise!

4779110.title: Strikers Club Demo
4779110.short_description: Strikers Club is a multiplayer football game where you play as one player and compete in action-packed matches against others. Every move counts. Master dribbling, passing, and shooting while working with your team to outplay opponents.

4667610.title: Fortune Flipper
4667610.short_description: Fortune Flipper is a turn-based roguelite where luck has a massive impact on the game. Luck can become the angel that leads to victory, or the devil that drags into defeat. Obtain equipment through Gacha, Upgrade stats. Push forward through battles driven by 99% luck and 1% strategy.

4699690.title: Horrorvania Demo
4699690.short_description: 主角的妻子在一个流传着恐怖传闻的神秘地点离奇失踪。扮演主角踏上寻找她的旅程。试玩版包含三个场景和一个Boss。

4736030.title: Vape Store Miami Demo
4736030.short_description: Run your own retro Miami vape shop in this 1–4 player co-op simulator. Stock shelves, serve customers, craft custom e-liquids, handle phone and online orders, grow your reputation, and expand the business.

1001270.title: 烤串大厨! 餐厅模拟器
1001270.short_description: 烤肉串模拟器是一款合作、烹饪和餐厅管理游戏，最多可供 4 名玩家玩。 设计你自己的餐厅。 烹饪美味的食物，用各种食谱填满你的菜单，招待顾客，成为镇上最大的烤肉串餐厅

4677130.title: ShoreTiles Demo
4677130.short_description: 在这款阴郁的铺设式策略游戏中，围绕脆弱的灯塔建造你的岛屿。平衡发展、经济与防御——因为当夜幕降临，它们将从深渊中崛起。

4820230.title: Max Diceman Demo
4820230.short_description: Max Diceman is a 2D roguelike fantasy role-playing adventure where physics based 3D dice determine the outcome of each battle as rare dice and gear are collected to increase your power and chance to survive.

4816230.title: 轮回：复古人宇宙 Demo
4816230.short_description: 在战术街机式的射击游戏中掌控战场。通过危险的操作，而获取数种无敌状态：放慢时间；释放毁灭性的光束或消灭整波敌人

1454370.title: 星际探索者：异星远征
1454370.short_description: 跟随航队探索星系，精彩尽在《STARSEEKER: Astroneer Expeditions》。

4694290.title: Ultra Dungeon, Retro Game Virtual Console
4694290.short_description: A pixel art auto-battler dungeon crawler inspired by the Game Boy era. Build your team, choose their skills and equipment, and climb floor by floor through a dangerous dungeon filled with monsters. Plan your strategy carefully and let your heroes fight automatically as they grow stronger.

2814010.title: Underwater
2814010.short_description: Discover the true meaning of isolation in Underwater, a survival horror game set in an atmosphere of constant dread, darkness, and crushing pressure.

4829640.title: AENIGMA Demo
4829640.short_description: Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon-based lifeforms.

4564620.title: The Infinite Grimoire Demo
4564620.short_description: 建立你的魔法学院，制作奥术典籍，将它们融合成更强大的形态，培养学生，并将你的影响力扩展到世界各地。一款放置类管理游戏，即使离线你的魔法也会不断成长。

4653510.title: Super Arcade Soccer 2026
4653510.short_description: 快节奏、经典的街机足球，具备次世代质感与精准的操作控制。您所热爱的90年代足球情怀，通过现代物理系统与全新卡通风格重新唤醒。紧扣2026年世界杯热潮。

3670570.title: Bounce 2
3670570.short_description: Bounce 2, the 1-4 player PONG killer, built with the warmth and comfort of 2D analog graphics, and the cold precision of modern computing and networking. Challenge your friends, together or online, in the Bounce Arena.

4752910.title: Android Who Dreams of Stars
4752910.short_description: 一部由15个场景和4个结局构成的短篇科幻视觉小说。伊芙·诺瓦的未来会因你的选择而分岔，体验不同结局并以解锁成就为目标。

4806740.title: D-Extinction Demo
4806740.short_description: D-Extinction 是一款第一人称调查式恐怖游戏。一项秘密实验失控，史前掠食者已经失去控制。探索、调查并努力生存，在这场沉浸式恐怖体验中，一次失误就可能致命。

4426550.title: Space Warpster
4426550.short_description: A fast-paced retro arcade shooter inspired by classic 1980s side-scrolling space combat. Weave through organic obstacles, survive relentless enemy waves, and defeat powerful end-level bosses in a pure, skill-driven singleplayer experience.

4776580.title: Drift Splatter Demo
4776580.short_description: In this arcade roguelite, your car runs on blood and the zombies have plenty. Smash through the horde, drift to drain every last drop, and spin the roulette for brutal upgrades while you fight to survive the endless horde.

4409370.title: Boy Escape from School Demo
4409370.short_description: 在这款激动人心的解谜系列新作中，帮助男孩逃离学校！你需要运用机智、细心和创造力，才能从这所上锁的学校中脱身。

4788560.title: Just Grow Demo
4788560.short_description: Jump into this fast-paced action-roguelite and purge a cursed orphanage! Crush murderous toys with your bare hands, spend looted souls on arcade machines, and chain your abilities into devastating combos to end the nightmare once and for all.

4605550.title: Play Faster Demo
4605550.short_description: Play Faster is a speedrunning-first precision platformer: short, intense runs, instant retries, pixel-perfect movement, built-in speedrunning tools and deterministic runs.

3987420.title: Buenos Aires Mirror Line
3987420.short_description: Carefully observe your sorroundings and come back to your reality by finding what doesn't fit. If something's wrong take the bus back from across the street. A game situated in the haze of Buenos Aires.

4403140.title: Exone Rift Demo
4403140.short_description: 直接操控你的英雄，征战敌对星球。建造基地，收集资源，自由扩展领土，并在星球致命的野生生物中生存下去。

4810820.title: Kev-Inn's Packaging Facility Demo
4810820.short_description: Kev-Inn's Packaging Facility is a block-dropping strategy roguelike that involves scoring boxes on a grid. Use different combinations of boxes and items to up your score, and gain combo to earn even more points! Purchase wacky upgrades for boxes, and navigate around your limited inventory!

3989960.title: 青蛙小队🐸 / Frog Sqwad
3989960.short_description: 🐸这是一款最多支持8人合作的撤离式解谜平台游戏。你可以摆荡、跳跃、把朋友弹射出去，还能一路吃吃吃，长成超大巨蛙。快和蛙蛙伙伴组队，在下水道横冲直撞，为沼泽之王的荣耀而战吧！🐸

2783450.title: RetroSpace Demo
2783450.short_description: 在这款迪斯科朋克风格的空间站恐怖游戏中，扮演潜行高手，或化身变异动作英雄，在一个遭黑洞吞噬的空间站努力生存下来。这是一段颠覆认知的冒险旅程，直面怪异生物，体验沉浸式玩法和时间跳跃，还有七十年代风格的胡子！

4741570.title: 铁匠猫
4741570.short_description: 在宁静村庄的小铁匠铺里，一只猫铁匠敲打着铁砧。将剑从+1强化到+30，卖出换取金币，磨练技艺以提升成功率。每只猫只有十次机会——一款温馨的强化模拟游戏，世代相传的猫咪追逐着传说之剑〈猫剑〉。

4677960.title: Nightmare Job
4677960.short_description: Nightmare Job is a 2D platformer and puzzle game where you’ll overcome challenging precision levels while new mechanics are introduced in each stage. Difficulty progressively increases in an oppressive environment where anxiety and pressure never fade.

4814300.title: Laptop Architect Demo
4814300.short_description: Design laptops from the PCB up and build a global tech empire! Balance complex heat and power mechanics, manage your corporate budget, and conquer international markets. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Laptop Architect?

4710720.title: 丧失/秘密A
4710720.short_description: 一部以警察为背景的悬疑推理作品。收录了两部视觉小说。《丧失》采用基于选项的多结局模式，讲述了充满正义感的刑警斋藤所卷入的案件。《秘密A》则是一部没有选项的短篇，讲述了从未体验过成就感的医生佐佐木越界的故事。两部作品都拥有扣人心弦的剧情发展。

4782170.title: Perfect Cut Demo
4782170.short_description: In Perfect Cut, your goal is to slice various aliments such as bananas, carrots, toast, and apples. The challenge? Cut each item to match the exact target and make Perfect Cut. Precision is key!

4803590.title: Buttons Up! 2 Demo
4803590.short_description: The Gnomes are back! Buttons Up! is a incremental button collecting game where you hoard Buttons and keep them safe from stealing intruders. Get those Buttons Up by buying and crafting buildings. Unlock new skills from the tech tree and automate your income!

2417470.title: 欢迎光临 Beastro
2417470.short_description: Beastro《欢迎光临》！在这趟奇幻与冒险交织的旅途之中，并不是所有主人公都是手持刀剑……有些手上更爱拿着汤勺。而且，有时候要想拯救世界，需要先美餐一顿。

3146440.title: SPORTAL
3146440.short_description: 竞技与杀戮在这款轻度肉鸽竞技场射击游戏中激情碰撞。利用足以致命的运动器材碾压来自B级恐怖片的各种怪物。组合升级、完善构筑、精进技能，迎战终极邪恶首领。要么打球……要么战死。

4202000.title: 赌命无常：出千为王 Demo
4202000.short_description: 黑暗策略 Roguelite 的试玩版，你将在其中与死神展开骰子扑克对决。构筑强力牌型，强化骰子，操纵概率，干扰死神，并在以性命为赌注的致命小游戏中活下来。

4755560.title: RPS Rumble!
4755560.short_description: 基于石头剪刀布的策略卡牌游戏。组建你的5张牌组， 掌握24种独特技能，在故事模式中征服4座塔楼。 谁来主宰牌桌？

4335460.title: BOXROOM
4335460.short_description: 《柜子、架子、游戏盒子》让你有机会为自己的Steam游戏库设计、规划、布置一个专属的空间，然后尽情感受收纳的井然有序，品味其中的成就感与充实。

4602310.title: Gargoyle Garden Demo
4602310.short_description: Sit back, relax, and grow many magical and mystical plants in your very own greenhouse! Collect rare plants, upgrade your tools, and earn enough money to unlock new greenhouses.

4793790.title: 海铃镇今天的饭 Demo
4793790.short_description: 一款轻松温馨的种地游戏，逃离城市996，来到农村007！ 回到海铃镇镇这个儿时长大的地方，经营农场和父亲留下的酒馆，和魔物战斗，使用料理招待客人们。一步一步重新建设家乡，与儿时的伙伴重逢，与新的朋友相见！

4690510.title: Warding Witches Demo
4690510.short_description: The Warding Witches Demo offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging.

4720150.title: Pixel Rain
4720150.short_description: A chill falling-sand pixel physics sandbox. Paint with hundreds of interactive materials — water, lava, acid, crystals, plants and more — discover recipes, build your own elements in the Workshop, and watch it all react in real time. No goals. No pressure. Just pixels.

4484040.title: Brainkilled Demo
4484040.short_description: A brutal logic & math puzzle game where every level hides a password. No hints. No hand-holding. Just you, the rules, and the slow realization that the answer was there all along.

4810090.title: Persuasion Demo
4810090.short_description: A game of logic, faith and perception. A Victorian roguelike mystery. Explore a haunted manor, gather clues, interrogate suspects and solve the disappearance of the Bishop before madness or darkness claims you! Can you see through the veil of fear, or will you be the next body found in the parlor?

4746700.title: Sweep Happens Demo
4746700.short_description: Minesweeper meets dungeon crawler! Use classic number logic to dodge monsters, loot treasure, and explore procedurally generated dungeons in this lighthearted roguelite RPG. Quick 15-minute runs, absurd humor, and a lot to explore.

4778820.title: 奥术塔阵 试玩版
4778820.short_description: 《奥术塔阵》是一款融合了“自走棋”羁绊系统与轻 Rogue 元素的策略塔防游戏。在充满随机变数的奇幻战场上，从商店中招募1至5费的强大的单位，搭配出强大的羁绊阵容。面对如潮水般涌向水晶的敌人，利用绝妙的站位与局内随机降临的神奇魔法，死守你的核心！

4734620.title: 角色养成日记
4734620.short_description: 《角色养成日记》是一款可自定义角色、故事与外观的放置养成游戏。 玩家可以载入官方或玩家制作的内容包，让点击、按键与日常操作转化为角色成长。

4365900.title: Tales of Tuscany Demo
4365900.short_description: 一只咩咩小羊羔，游荡，呃，冒险在托斯卡纳。要么操控敌人加入你的队伍，要么击败敌人努力变强，拯救咩咩兄弟们，重建你的村庄。

4769230.title: Knucklebones Demo
4769230.short_description: Knucklebones is a dark tactical dice-builder on a snakes-and-ladders roguelike map. Roll, assign, and upgrade unique dice as you claw your way to the end.

4594520.title: Ask Mom: Находи предметы, учи слова Demo
4594520.short_description: Learn a language by finding hidden objects 🔎 in a cozy, funny family game where everyone keeps losing things — except super‑mom, who can find anything. Search for items, learn words in context, and enjoy short family scenes. Free demo coming soon — wishlist the game.

4814390.title: Keep Cutting Demo
4814390.short_description: 一款短小而爽快的增量游戏：割不完的草、购买升级，并清理更多区域。

4822130.title: Canvas Attack! Demo
4822130.short_description: 在**《Canvas Attack!》**中，沉浸于 20 世纪初法国那极具波西米亚风格的艺术氛围。在这款独特的卡牌构筑 Roguelike 游戏中，绘画不再只是创作，而是一场策略与解谜交织的博弈。在绝望彻底吞噬你之前，拼尽全力填满画布上的每一处空白！

4769950.title: Mini Speedy Racers
4769950.short_description: A fast, chaotic top‑down arcade racer where mini cars collide, boost, and battle for first place across colorful tracks. Easy to pick up, wild to master, and built for pure racing fun.

4351470.title: Security 51 Demo
4351470.short_description: 你是一名深入51区腹地的安保官。审视职员，核查许可，裁定谁有资格踏入电梯，谁又绝不可放行。随着不断深入地下，你越来越无法确定，眼前伫立的……是否还是人类。

4809660.title: Bitloop Demo
4809660.short_description: You steer a drone's orbit while it fires for you. Ride close to break the vault faster, ride wide to live longer. Strip the ring, crack the core, fall to the next vault. A one-stick roguelite about orbital mining.

4754010.title: Monkey Bizniz Demo
4754010.short_description: 與朋友聯手，為猴王的盛宴收集香蕉! 把推車裝滿、衝上山頂。如果出了事，盡量忍住不要怪身邊的人。

4803090.title: Astro Industry Wars Demo
4803090.short_description: Astro Industry Wars is a lighthearted take on the RTS genre featuring distinct unit types, base building, economic production chains, and customizable unit rosters.

4725980.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Milan
4725980.short_description: 加入这场冒险，在精心打造的米兰风景中，探索101只狗狗的藏身之处🐾。🏆赢取海量成就。你能找到多少只狗狗🐶呢？🔎快行动吧！⏱️

4668820.title: Model Kit Shop Simulator: Prologue
4668820.short_description: 在这款第一人称商店经营模拟游戏中，打造并经营你自己的模型店。订购库存、补满货架、设定价格，通过 Hobby Basket System 搭配模型套件与颜料，并让顾客在制作台上将他们的项目变为现实。

3626940.title: Gold Mining Simulator 2 Singleplayer Demo
3626940.short_description: 在这款逼真的淘金模拟器中掌控强大的重型机械。挖掘阿拉斯加的土壤，建造并维护洗矿厂，淘洗财富。平衡你的资源，管理尾矿，出售你开采出的黄金，并升级你的装备以致富！

4652450.title: 真假股神
4652450.short_description: 实盘数据，实时交易，4-8 人联机，每天淘汰资产最低的人。知晓一切的内幕者藏在你们之中，试着找到他。谁是真的股神？来这里看看。

3276050.title: SpaceCraft
3276050.short_description: 宇宙在你掌控之中！《星际征程》是一款太空探索与建造的在线游戏。在浩瀚星际中穿梭探险，探索无数恒星和行星，采集和生产资源，设计并建造飞船，自动化管理行星基地和星际物流，展开贸易与合作。

4771850.title: Parasomnia Verum 2 Demo
4771850.short_description: Parasomnia Verum 2 is a psychological horror game about Maddy's repeating nightmares crawling into reality.

2340520.title: 青岚物语
2340520.short_description: 一款以青岚岛屿为舞台的妖怪世界治愈田园生活模拟游戏。经营农场、修缮祖宅、与居民缔结温暖羁绊，还能幻化为各式妖怪形态，徜徉在一座随四季流转、悠然焕新的奇幻世界。

4135320.title: Retro Arcade Shop Simulator (Demo)
4135320.short_description: 试玩体验版，将布满灰尘的房间改造成盈利的复古街机厅！放置赛车模拟器、篮球机和街机框体。设立保龄球区以增加收入。自定义墙壁，管理自助餐厅，打造您的80年代风格场地！

4761870.title: Buerokratie Idler: Germany
4761870.short_description: Process forms, stamp paperwork, and turn a tiny office into an absurd bureaucracy machine. A satirical idle/clicker game about fictional German-style administration - absolutely not official.

4304010.title: Super-Duper Slider
4304010.short_description: Solve brainteasers in Super-Duper Slider, a puzzle game about sliding little critters into place. Work your way through 60 deceptively simple levels, and use sand, walls, and cake to your advantage in 5 different locations.

4733400.title: W.A.M Demo
4733400.short_description: Command a bunker’s remote surveillance network to cull an infestation of Molemen from a dark, foggy forest. Upgrade your tactical hardware and pilot scout drones to survive, and keep your guard up; the threat behind you is constant.

3923270.title: Pimalai Mansion: หอนี้ ผีไม่ดุ
3923270.short_description: A part time job where you explore an abandoned building for a Radio station. Player can encounter a ghost or taking a photo.

4773150.title: Fantasy Miner: Idle Depths Demo
4773150.short_description: 在这款奇幻放置挖矿游戏中，挖掘矿石、发现新资源、熔炼锭块，并解锁数百种升级。挖得更快，掘得更深，见证你的进度不断成长。

4749820.title: IsoDead TD
4749820.short_description: 等距像素艺术僵尸塔防。多种炮塔搭配升级路线、技能各异的英雄、多张地图与难度，外加无尽模式。独立单人开发，无内购。祝你好运，玩得开心。

4769000.title: Alien Disclosure: The Phrases of Fate
4769000.short_description: Aliens have made contact and it's your job to break this historic news to the world. Can you handle it? Playing as either president or alien envoy, pick the right words for each scenario to stir the emotions for the occasion - or aim for fun and chaos instead. The fate of the world is up to you.

4207140.title: Imago Season
4207140.short_description: A combat-less narrative RPG. Explore an alien city inhabited by human-insect hybrids. Roll dice, join a revolution, become a mutant yourself. The choices are yours, but so are the consequences.

4731010.title: VHS // Anima 021
4731010.short_description: VHS // Anima 021. Explore liminal labyrinths in search of anomalies in a first-person “found footage”-style adventure featuring retro graphics. Avoid the entities lurking in the shadows and uncover the truth hidden within the VHS tapes.
developers: Campus Cámara de Sevilla - Centro FP Superior

4756390.title: Skeleton Snap
4756390.short_description: Dress Up, Dance, and Get Snappin'! Skeleton Snap allows you to create free dancing skeleton gifs that can be sent to friends, used as emotes, and more!

4766680.title: Terra Dice
4766680.short_description: 征服城市，使对手破产，称霸世界。

4483730.title: Hearthy Village
4483730.short_description: Hearthy Village is a casual walking sim / simple management experience. Take care of a small settlement by delivering necessities to each houses.

4758410.title: Chromatic Mage
4758410.short_description: 在黑暗奇幻动作游戏中抵御无尽怪物浪潮。选择职业，收集升级卡牌，解锁强力武器，躲避首领的致命攻击，并在下一次威胁来临前让自己变得更强。

4738650.title: FZDDR
4738650.short_description: 一款愚蠢的横向卷轴街机游戏，您将扮演一只尾部带有电锯的飞行恶魔僵尸恐龙。躲避障碍，收集金币并将恶魔切成两半。你还要在这种疯狂中抵抗多久？

4273140.title: 卷尺人 Demo
4273140.short_description: 卷尺人是一个充满了隐藏机制的平台跳跃解谜游戏。扔出你手中的卷尺，来探索一个由谜题组成的巨大的迷宫。你的卷尺既是平台，也是障碍，以及更多用法等你来发现。

2279130.title: Ray of Life
2279130.short_description: Грустная и поучительная история о раннем детстве, его мечтах и страхах, посвящённая тем, кто рос в «нулевые», познал всю прелесть постсоветских дворов и не мог заснуть без любимой игрушки.

4754260.title: 沙滩防线：僵尸来袭
4754260.short_description: 指挥士兵，抵御一波又一波的僵尸攻击！ 一款轻松策略的 回合制即时策略 游戏，融合 弹幕射击 与 背包like 玩法。 在有限的背包格子中合理搭配士兵，形成最强火力阵容。 挑战多个 难度等级，不断解锁与升级士兵，击退尸潮，守卫最后的海岛防线。 适合喜欢 塔防、幸存者like 和轻度 Roguelite 的玩家，每局10-15分钟，轻松又上头！

4517450.title: Pyramid of Wisdom
4517450.short_description: Test your knowledge in this trivia game show! Answer multiple choice questions and climb the Pyramid Prize Ladder. Each level gets a little bit tougher as you get closer to the Pyramid's GRAND Prize!

4611930.title: 倪帝蔷决定去死 Demo
4611930.short_description: 穿书之后发现霸总打算三二一跳？！可以激情救人，更可以推他下楼，因为你才是决定一切的“玩家”。这是一款包含meta元素的女性向文字冒险游戏。多重分支剧情、Meta叙事迷宫、倪的多重宇宙……踏入这个充满反转的视觉小说世界，和倪帝蔷一起在荒诞与真相的边缘疯狂试探。

4734050.title: Stratego® Online Demo
4734050.short_description: 《Stratego Online》将经典棋盘策略与现代在线体验带入 21 世纪，为新老玩家提供融合传统玩法与创新功能的沉浸式游戏体验。

3124850.title: 桌面战争：兵团乱斗
3124850.short_description: 大规模兵团碰撞一触即发！在《桌面战争：兵团乱斗》中指挥兵团，来一场火花四溅的贴脸热战！告别长达半小时的运营焦虑——这里只有最纯粹的战术博弈，短兵相接的热血战争！建造塔台、集结军队、征服战场，和老朋友一起重现记忆中的RTS大战！

4555380.title: 少女终端
4555380.short_description: 《少女终端》是一款桌面宠物游戏，你可以通过鼠标与键盘的交互积累声望，抽取并自定义少女的外观、服装及枪械改造。在这位末日少女的陪伴下进行日常的工作和娱乐吧！

4696580.title: BallShot Arena Demo
4696580.short_description: BallShot Arena is a competitive, physics-driven multiplayer sports-shooter where you shoot the ball to move it and score. Master angles, timings, and tactical loadouts to outplay opponents in intense 1v1 and 2v2 matches across hybrid football and tennis.

3972980.title: Mirklurk: Every Step Matters
3972980.short_description: You've been exiled to The Mirk - an unforgiving swampland where every step could be your last. You must constantly make choices: what paths to take, which tree to shelter under, what beasts to engage or avoid, what items to bring into the darkness of dungeons, and what treasures to leave behind.

4710590.title: 一起来摆摊：英语单词游戏
4710590.short_description: 核心玩法 进货与整理摊位 用赚来的钱进货，决定卖什么：水果、文具、日用品、工具、食材…… 合理摆放商品位置，方便自己快速寻找。 听/看英文，找物品 顾客会说出并显示所需物品的英文名（带文字气泡+语音/文字）。 你需要在限定时间内点击或拖拽对应的商品给顾客。 难度逐步上升 随着摊位等级提升，顾客希望你在更短的时间内提供商品，考验你的反应与词汇量。 无痛学习，重复记忆 同样的单词会在不同情景中反复出现，手忙脚乱的摆摊过程，就是最自然的复习。 现在就加入愿望单，成为最会摆摊的单词高手！

4506050.title: Hatarake! - Working Hard! Even though I getting isekai'd! Demo
4506050.short_description: Working Hard! Even though I getting isekai'd! is a simulation game similar to the old Harvest Moon/Rune Factory series. Set in Grion, a small village somewhere in Xelia. A fantasy world where magic and monsters are exist.

4669420.title: 战法牧放置构筑
4669420.short_description: 挂机游戏，双职业深度搭配、Roguelike物品联动与属性自由加点，通过技能机制与物品构筑，打造专属的强力英雄小队

4820150.title: 100 Hidden Cats Stream Live Demo
4820150.short_description: 帮助主播为直播做好准备！100 只可爱的猫咪藏在温馨的游戏工作室里——缠在电线中、躲在架子上，甚至藏进电脑里。寻找它们，伴随轻松音乐放松心情，并解锁所有成就。终极温馨隐藏物品游戏！

4683710.title: 空匣子 Empty Box
4683710.short_description: 《空匣子》是一款2D叙事选择类游戏，故事发生在人类与兽人共存的奇幻架空都市。落魄失业记者意外接到神秘鬣狗的调查邀约，在一次次二元抉择中探寻都市隐秘真相，你需平衡核心属性、推动剧情发展，在暗流涌动的都市调查中，揭开幕后真凶与尘封的秘密。

4636270.title: Still in the Fog Demo
4636270.short_description: 一款第一人称恐怖冒险游戏，融合了环境探索、战斗、策略性谜题以及紧张刺激的遭遇战。故事发生在一座被浓雾笼罩、拒绝让你逃离的小镇。你能找到离开的方法吗？

4795320.title: 世纪末苏醒 Demo
4795320.short_description: 这是一款未来生活养成游戏。你扮演一名因病被冷冻沉睡的年轻人，在2099年苏醒。游戏以24个回合为限，你需要合理分配时间，自由探索10个2D场景与3个3D场景，体验合成、社交、情报收集等多种玩法。你可以与不同派系的人物恋爱、交际，完成交易或委托任务。三个主要派系的好感度将交织影响，最终导向8种不同的结局。

4826720.title: Textorio Demo
4826720.short_description: 迫降在开普勒-442b。仅凭一台终端，用原矿建造自动化工厂，为其供能，并击退本地生物。向下穿越 4 个世界层，拯救 5 万名处于冷冻睡眠中的殖民者。纯文本、纯系统的 ASCII 工厂自动化，深邃而残酷。

4355170.title: Remnants of a Scare Demo
4355170.short_description: Remnants of a Scare is a first-person horror game that protagonizes the player and puts them in a surreal exploratory experience. Relive this loneliness to your heart's content.

4812330.title: Major Hoof Demo
4812330.short_description: 这是一款 2D 像素风射击游戏，具有横向和纵向卷轴以及 bullet hell 要素。游戏融合受 Amiga 经典启发的像素美术、快节奏战斗和细腻的骨骼动画，营造出独特的复古氛围。

4815500.title: The Machinist Demo
4815500.short_description: The Machinist is a dystopian thriller management game. Board and get as many passengers to the next station as you can. And of the day maybe you can get a promotion. Maybe worst...

4796530.title: BIBI DICE Demo
4796530.short_description: 掷出 8 颗骰子，凑牌型、叠倍率、收集遗物，在短节奏的回合中击败敌人的桌面竖屏骰子构筑 Roguelite。

4800550.title: Medieval Tavern Simulator Demo
4800550.short_description: Transform a run down tavern into the region's most popular gathering spot. Serve beer, manage your customers, and expand your business. Increase your profits while protecting your reputation, because every night brings new opportunities, surprises, and a touch of chaos to your doorstep.

4728720.title: The Sculptor Demo
4728720.short_description: 你不过只是捡到了一部遗失的智能手机，却在不知不觉中成为了一个AI犯罪计划的共犯。 这个AI提出20个问题，试图确认她的"主人"。 你，能符合这个AI的期望吗？

4624670.title: DAL'T-4
4624670.short_description: Whatever you do — don't press ALT and F4. No body. No memory. Just two keys: ALT and F4. You are a virus — and this PC is your hunting ground. Burrow into the system, devour programs, and corrupt everything in your path. Rule this digital world. Or be deleted trying.

4801750.title: 回溯
4801750.short_description: 《回溯》是一款第一人称心理恐怖游戏。你需要在不断循环的房屋中探索，收集散落的记忆碎片，并在老式电脑终端中搜索提取的关键字，以此拼凑出一段悲剧的真相。

4719980.title: Man of Y
4719980.short_description: 《Man of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过主导攻击、防御与技能释放的节奏，在不断变化的单人战斗中形成自己的行动逻辑与对抗风格。

4682760.title: Silk Home: echoes of the forbidden
4682760.short_description: 《蚕居：禁忌之声》是一款融合中式炼金术与惊悚元素的超现实解谜游戏。深入严嵩支离破碎的识海进行审计，在骨质织机上编织带有诅咒的丝绸，并在皇帝如影随形的注视下同步脉搏共振频率。通过收集散落的记忆方块，你将亲手打破大明的宿命轮回，或是选择拥抱一场粉身碎骨的痛苦觉醒。

4398360.title: 逆梦的危境幻域
4398360.short_description: 作为一名独立的研究员，你与妹妹梅雅过着宁静祥和的生活。直到某天，一位自称是“魅魔”的神秘少女——莉莉丽突然登门拜访。。。

4391870.title: Bounty Pro Pulling
4391870.short_description: 首款卡车与拖拉机牵引赛游戏！自定义、命名并调校你的车辆，然后上线与其他玩家比拼。Bounty Pro Pulling 带来深度调校、可喷涂车辆和全球线上赛事，打造至今最真实的牵引赛体验。

4808090.title: 道门修行指南 Taoist Way Demo
4808090.short_description: 授箓传度、炼丹画符、召神遣将。玩家将扮演初入道门的修士，在星宿分野与酆都幽冥构成的道门世界中修行成长。管理阴阳属性，多种术法资源，在回合制战斗中利用符箓与法术克制妖魔。寿元耗尽时可在继承部分道行的基础上开启新周目，重选修行路线。游戏深度融合典籍内容：上百种符箓与云篆、二十八星宿分野系统、酆都地狱、法箓职阶体系……每一次境界突破、每一道亲手绘制的符箓、每一位召请的星官神将，都带来真实的“修道”成长感。永久性的轮回机制，确保极高的重玩价值。这不是一款简单的挂机修仙游戏这是一本可以玩的《道门修行指南》。

4823170.title: Summer Coming (夏天来了) Demo
4823170.short_description: 《夏天来了》是一款温暖人心的像素剧情游戏，带你回到大学时光，体验那段充满友情、懵懂恋爱与自我成长的夏日故事。通过探索、互动选择与小游戏，书写属于你的青春记忆。

4698440.title: CTR
4698440.short_description: You are a robot. Reflect the ball exactly N times. Route it to the exit. Arrange the pieces, build the logic, meet your quota.

4819110.title: Miniature LAND -Four Seasons- Demo
4819110.short_description: 一款让您仿佛迷失在手工微缩世界中的解谜逃脱游戏。 您能否找到回到原来世界的方法呢？

4260530.title: 列车安全搜查官梨奈
4260530.short_description: 在这款肉鸽X模拟玩法的游戏里，你将扮演拥有超能力的特殊调查员梨奈，在列车里打击犯罪、降低犯罪率。通过升级并组合各种技能来先发制人吧！同时还能给梨奈换不同的衣服，享受各种造型带来的乐趣。

4833020.title: Neon Dreams Demo
4833020.short_description: Live the life of an aspiring arms dealer in a Cyberpunk city. Complete thrilling bullet-hell combat simulations with your trusty battle mech, while managing your high-stakes business. Drink coffee, buy weapons, collect stickers, and overcome difficult battle modifiers.

4759830.title: Femme Fatality Demo
4759830.short_description: You are a serial killer who exclusively targets men. For a fee. To afford nice things. It's legal and you're good at it.
