3935130.title: Folklore Reloaded
3935130.short_description: Nothing beats a few brewskis on a temperate summer evening while camping in northern Ontario, however a rustle in the bushes reveals an onslaught of monsters who seek to separate your beer from your hand! Respond the natural way by taking up arms and defending yourself from this travesty!

4816790.title: Level Up, Tiny King! Demo
4816790.short_description: Level Up, Tiny King! is a solo survivors-like auto-shooter platformer. After being kidnapped and thrown into the dungeons, you must fight your way upward. Survive relentless waves of cute enemies while climbing. Grow stronger, recruit magical buddies, and reclaim your throne.

4714340.title: TimelineTown-タイムラインタウン Demo
4714340.short_description: Invite friends to TimelineTown and grow your SNS together! Enjoy a relaxing sandbox-style simulation where numbers keep rising and new features unlock as your SNS levels up. Create trends, chat, and make posts go viral!

4744340.title: Scrap Isle Demo
4744340.short_description: Scrap-Isle is a short, incremental game where you sell trash to make loads of money, you earn levels and increase your trash production while fighting off enemies that want to take your trash from you, you can even hatch a variety of helpers to automate your money production!

4811050.title: Death's Life 2 Demo
4811050.short_description: In this demo you can try a physics-based puzzle game where you play as Death, creating “accidental” deaths through chain reactions. Solve scenarios in multiple ways or survive and escape from deadly trap-filled environments.

4830040.title: The Quiet After Demo
4830040.short_description: You play Ava, a would-be adventurer whose guild registration is only the first step into something far more dangerous, on the road ahead and beneath her own skin. A psychological, choice-driven visual novel where every decision shapes who she becomes.

4709650.title: Agrocracy Demo
4709650.short_description: A farming management game focused on planning and numbers. This is not a farming sim - no driving, animals, or role-playing. Manage weather, labor, capital, and time on a large isometric map.

4718390.title: 異世界転生したおっさん、不遇スキルでもめげずに戦乱の島で傭兵に転職する。 Demo
4718390.short_description: A game-over-free Action RPG where you reincarnate as a new character every time you die. Survive a war-torn island where battles between factions unfold in real time, and adapt to new skills, traits, and combat styles with each new life.

4813890.title: 黯渊崛起 Demo
4813890.short_description: 这是一款RPG刷宝冒险游戏，内容丰富，多职业多次转职和觉醒成长、门派势力选择、宠物进化培养、宝石镶嵌——构建专属的深渊冒险。 几百种装备和独特道具自由搭配自由冒险，数百种技能机制各异玩法丰富，大量新的冒险地图等你来探索。

4820750.title: Cielle is Not Happy Demo
4820750.short_description: Cielle is Not Happy is a Psychological Horror RPG that redefines the adventure genre through a deep, haunting narrative and unconventional combat mechanics, delivering a masterfully immersive experience.

4644600.title: BitRoca
4644600.short_description: Grab a pickaxe and stake your claim. Bitroca is a sandbox survival MMO where your machine fuels every swing, every wall, every win. Mine, build, defend, and trade on a living frontier where the power of the players shapes what the world can become.

4817190.title: Demon Touch! Demo
4817190.short_description: 在这款模拟游戏中，你会与一位惹上麻烦、性格有点嚣张的小恶魔西缇莉并肩作战。通过共同修行来强化能力，在不断的对话中加深彼此的羁绊，同时讨伐魔物，帮助她恢复失去的力量。随着剧情推进，击败强大的敌人，最终与西缇莉一起迎来幸福的结局。

4763730.title: Hunk Battle Gems
4763730.short_description: 在这款回合制三消 RPG 中，挑战一众健硕劲敌。交换元素宝石，积累 MP，释放技能，不断再战，在羁绊加深的过程中解锁画廊场景。

4827600.title: SLEDGE Demo
4827600.short_description: Take your explosive sledgehammer to the skies to pulverize the machines that killed gods and usurped the heavens.

3521030.title: 混世元婴
3521030.short_description: 游戏内容为主要的轻度“Roguelike”和一些小游戏。你将扮演一个寻找记忆的灵魂，穿梭于不同的空间去了解主角的故事、挑战丰富的关卡、解锁不同的角色、发现隐藏的世界。

4788290.title: Reason and Rhyme Demo
4788290.short_description: Birds of a feather…solve puzzles together in this short two-player online co-operative puzzle adventure!

4831480.title: 宝石我来捡，你只管揍人: Blood & Blessing 试玩版
4831480.short_description: 这是一款快节奏的2D生存动作Roguelike游戏！你流血奋战，她却边治疗边抱怨。消耗你的生命值去砸碎无尽的敌群，与贪婪的AI牧师在极端的资源置换中求生，并靠兼职‘赏金猎人’来赚钱购买你的技能！

4800580.title: SHADE WALKERS Demo
4800580.short_description: A 2v2v2 horror escape royale set in a haunted school. Team up with your partner, gather ritual dolls, use items, avoid deadly entities, and outplay rival duos. Only one team can escape.

4828970.title: SYSTEM_REBOOT Demo
4828970.short_description: Dive into the heart of a compromised mainframe in this psychological, meta-narrative bullet heaven. You are the Icarus Protocol, an advanced system cleaner tasked with purging catastrophic malware. But as the glitches intensify you'll soon realize that this is far more than just a simple simulation.

4815910.title: Monster Adventure Studio Demo
4815910.short_description: Your time has finally come! Create the creature-collector RPG you always dreamed of with Monster Adventure Studio. Design monsters, build worlds, and realize your ultimate adventure in this game development tool that captures the magic of classic handheld monster games. No Coding Required!

4826500.title: The Murder Of Yesterday Demo
4826500.short_description: A psychological horror crime experience featuring Story mode and Anomaly mode. Where time is your only weapon.. travel back through fractured moments to stop a brutal crime before it happens uncover the truth, alter the outcome, and face the consequences of changing fate in a haunting reality.

4523540.title: Arc Salvo Demo
4523540.short_description: Arc Salvo is a fast-paced online turn-based artillery game featuring explosive team battles, a growing arsenal, and deep character customization.

4828400.title: BLORBIT Demo
4828400.short_description: 翻转重力，向上攀爬。BLORBIT：可爱生物竖向平台游戏，穿越6个生态群落，从草地到深空。翻转平台仅在重力匹配时稳固。无尽、每日任务、禅境或10人在线竞速。你能爬多高？

4611470.title: HexTrial A C.O.R.E. Cognitive Test
4611470.short_description: HexTrial is a casual sci-fi word puzzle where you build words on a hex grid, survive spreading Cognitive Failure Tiles, and adapt to shifting test phases under the watchful eye of a cold, sarcastic AI.

4775970.short_description: 0.5% is a hand-drawn black and white visual novel. It features two college students June and Tai. June's choices and discovery will uncover Tai's secrets.

4818080.title: SCP: Antimemetics Division Demo
4818080.short_description: No, it's not your first day. The Amnestics have kicked in, and Site-48 has locked down. Scavenge restricted gear, gain clearance to forgotten levels, and bend reality to escape lethal SCP anomalies. Tactile survival horror where remembering too much will get you annihilated.

4578580.title: Iris Grid Demo
4578580.short_description: 连连构筑 是一款 Roguelite 连连看策略游戏。表面是连连看的休闲小局，实则是一套由你亲手搭建的深度策略引擎。35+ 特殊规则不断改写游戏，120+ 种核心、道具、重塑任你组合——究竟是你凭策略拆穿每一局的谜题，还是被每一把的纷繁变化吞没？下一局，见真章。

4590220.title: The Unnatural Leap Demo
4590220.short_description: 在这款基于物理的合作平台解谜游戏中，探索破碎的时间线。精通独特的特殊技能，在每项挑战中寻找属于你自己的路径。但要小心：虽然合作是关键，但队友可能会为了制造混乱而破坏你的行动，在他们独自前进时将你送回上一个存档

4787560.title: Cubic Spree Demo
4787560.short_description: Cubic Spree is a fast-paced 2D shooter - Play locally and online with your friends, choose your weapons, and blast your way to victory with colorful chaos!

3779710.title: CINESCAPE VR
3779710.short_description: CINESCAPE-VR 是一款虚拟现实逃脱游戏，你需要在电影制片厂的场景中解谜，利用“影变术”的力量——一种可以改变你周围物体形态的能力，揭开 Cinetech 公司的秘密。

4759390.title: Hellbridge Demo
4759390.short_description: 在无情的地狱围攻中，守护通往生者世界的最后一座桥梁。抵御不断升级的敌人浪潮，选择强大的法术，每一次挑战都变得更强，并踏入被诅咒的传送门，从源头阻止入侵。

4815290.title: Train Set Code Demo
4815290.short_description: Build a train set layout where everything runs on its own. Automate points and signals to direct the trains and keep them moving. Get creative and design a huge network that carries a fleet of trains.

4809770.title: Dice Tech Dominion - Enter the Shadow Circuit Demo
4809770.short_description: Build your dice deck, shape the dungeon board, and command monsters in a 3D tactical dice battler.

4800690.title: Streets of Miami VR Demo
4800690.short_description: Streets of Miami VR is a gritty 1980s crime-action VR game where you fight, drive, spray paint, shoot, hustle for money, and survive the streets of Miami in a open world sand box experience built for physical VR gameplay.

3804330.title: 循环战机
3804330.short_description: 《循环战机》是一款节奏紧凑的 2D 弹幕 Roguelite。驾驶风格迥异的战机，在不断加速的星际战场中收集经验、构筑流派、挑战随机 Boss，并用每一次远征解锁新的角色、永久成长与更高难度。躲过红色弹幕，压住连击节奏，打出属于你的最快通关。

4838820.title: 旅行家：后日时光 Demo
4838820.short_description: 拥有自己的移动城堡！这是一款集成了效率工具的全屏氛围挂机游戏。生活在火车房屋里迷人的世界中游历。是学习、工作、创作和辅助睡眠的好伴侣。

4799600.title: Arcana, Gas & Waterworks Inc. Demo
4799600.short_description: The full set of game features through the first six levels of your fantasy utility career.

4821340.title: Magic Fairy Fun Blast Demo
4821340.short_description: Magic Fairy Fun Blast is a challenging and fast paced arcade style bullet hell arena wave based shooter. You are a fairy that just wants to have fun but your version of fun is different than the rest of the world.

3234920.title: Hexpand
3234920.short_description: 在真实世界地图上对战的实时多人策略游戏。扩张六边形领土，占领城市增加收入，跨洋派遣飞机，与人结盟——然后必定背叛他们。每局5到20分钟。

4807760.title: TowerBits8 Demo
4807760.short_description: Towerbit8 is a tower defense game with platformer mechanics, where you must defeat waves of enemies to build your defenses using directional turrets and defeat the 8 bosses that rule the invading monsters.

4739170.title: Fruit Golf Demo
4739170.short_description: Can your friendship survive Fruit Golf?! Fruit Golf is pure party chaos disguised as mini golf! Putt a pineapple down a pirate ship while your pals go full sabotage with sharks, exploding barrels, and even flying pigs. Friends without headsets can play with VR headsets on iOS and Android for free!

4807690.title: Idøle Demo
4807690.short_description: Idøle is a casual, open puzzle building game with a dark turn. Take the lead of a cult and perform rituals to gain ever-greater esoteric powers from a strange meteor that fell from the sky. Is it truely a Blessing ?

4836690.title: Feed the Cat: Gravity Puzzle Demo
4836690.short_description: Move platforms, manipulate gravity, and solve relaxing physics puzzles to guide the food safely into the hungry cat's bowl. A cute, logic-based casual game where your main goal is simple: make sure the feline gets its treat!

4763100.title: 十戒 2
4763100.short_description: 一款回合制 RPG。每个角色都由 10 枚可自由组合的戒指构成。属性、技能、职业定位，甚至敌人的能力都来自戒指。更换戒指，就能自由重组你的队伍。

4618160.title: Lobotomy
4618160.short_description: James, a freelance journalist, breaks into the notorious "Lobotomy" asylum to expose decades of brutal experiments. Armed with a camera and flashlight, he must navigate the suffocating darkness. Record the truth, survive the shadows, and escape before the asylum’s dark history claims you next.

4558080.title: Mass Edge - Gravity Ball Demo
4558080.short_description: Mass Edge Demo is a vibrant 3D puzzle-platformer inspired by the cult 90s classic Game, bringing back that unforgettable feeling of rolling, balancing, and thinking your way through impossible spaces.

4835570.title: Big Golden Rock Demo
4835570.short_description: Big Golden Rock 是一款像素风增量点击游戏，主题是一块巨大的金色岩石。收集资源，雇佣射手和弓箭手，建造塔楼，发射火箭，召唤 UFO，并解锁越来越强大的升级。

4821010.title: Taddius and the Forbidden Bog Demo
4821010.short_description: In "Taddius and the Forbidden Bog", manage an inn for lost travellers, restore a ravaged bog, and find purpose in the most unexpected of places.

3421050.title: Keepers of the Keep
3421050.short_description: When a thief comes to The Keep, only to be captured and forced to work off their debt, they must now make a new life for themselves in a strange new town.

4225020.title: SILVARN
4225020.short_description: 家人的求救把你拖入一个每秒都至关重要的噩梦。一个残忍的杀手逼迫你不停前进。收集线索、解决诡异谜题，并揭开隐藏在恐惧背后的真相。

3459400.title: Tell Me Owl
3459400.short_description: Embark on an exciting journey in a top-down western shooter inspired by classic NES action games. Battle through handcrafted levels, buy abilities, upgrade weapons to face multi-phase bosses in a world where a man's best friend is his revolver.

4762360.title: Decline Demo
4762360.short_description: Welcome to your new night shift inside an abandoned underground drainage facility, you should handle the power problems nobody else wants to deal with. Your main task is simple: monitor the security cameras, manage your limited electricity, and survive until dawn. But don't HIDE, they see you.

4791640.title: KOTAMON: My Sis Found A Super-Rare Card In Her Cereal Box, So I Became A Garbage Man To Find The Entire Collection And Earn $1,000,000 Demo
4791640.short_description: 清理垃圾的感觉更棒了，因为你不仅让世界更干净，还能找到价格突然飙升的超稀有卡牌！翻找破烂，完成垃圾场女老板的任务，寻找隐藏的宝藏……然后收集全部的 Kotámon！

4811660.title: WARD: Descent Demo
4811660.short_description: WARD: Descent is a 2D dungeon-crawler roguelike where you pilot an armored combat suit. Explore an overrun research laboratory, manage your suit's upgrades, and complete sequences to destroy anomalies. Descend to the bottom, pilot, and complete your mission! This demo features the first 2 floors!

4836400.title: Infernal Survivors Demo
4836400.short_description: Infernal Survivors is a dynamic top-down action roguelike where the player fights against hordes of demons, upgrades abilities, and tries to survive increasingly dangerous waves of hell.

4796250.title: Smokey Mike Demo
4796250.short_description: In stand-up, talent isn't always enough. In this point and click adventure you have to improvise, survive and fail with style until you craft the five minutes that could change everything.

4816260.title: Nytherra Demo
4816260.short_description: A cozy 2D adventure where you explore, gather resources, turn them into profit, craft, and battle enemies to save a fading world before time runs out.

4768420.title: Argonauts Agency: When Spring Withered
4768420.short_description: Persephone’s illness troubles Hades, and the heroes descend into the underworld to uncover the cause of her suffering.

4474030.title: 4th & Goal Demo
4474030.short_description: 4th & Goal combines roguelite deckbuilding with American football. Make cuts, additions, and upgrades to your team through the Gauntlet Challenge!

4519340.title: Unknown Operations : The Habitus Demo
4519340.short_description: Unknown Operations: The Habitus is a story-driven WWII FPS. Play as Eduard Penkava, a soldier and later an agent of the secret organization Habitus, as you fight Nazis and carry out dangerous sabotage missions in a story inspired by real events.

4797090.title: Tileland Demo
4797090.short_description: Tileland 是一款回合制肉鸽游戏，每一次掷骰子都将决定你的命运。在这片策略与运气交织的世界里，穿梭于充满魔力的地块，升级你的武器库，运用强大的符文与药水，并智取致命的敌人。

4169770.title: Slice the Crops!
4169770.short_description: 切割、赚取、升级、循环。在这款令人上瘾的增量游戏中，尽情切割变异水果！消灭成群的独特变异作物，深入研究庞大的天赋树，解锁新关卡，并研发强大的水果突变，最大限度地提高您的收成，主宰整个农场。

1829470.title: Melody's Escape 2
1829470.short_description: 化音乐为赛道，跑出你的专属节奏！《Melody》华丽回归，音频分析算法迎来史诗级提升。每一首MP3都能实时生成独一无二的谱面赛道，带给你与音乐节拍、强度完美同步的纯粹律动！

4829460.title: Mythic Kart Maker Demo
4829460.short_description: Mythic Kart Maker is part level maker, part fantasy kart racer. Vehicular combat, whimsical characters, & a vibrant 64-bit pre-rendered art style come together to create a chaotic, creative playground where you build the race - and then survive it.

4768070.title: Invaders Loop Demo
4768070.short_description: 在融合了经典街机精神和 Roguelite 机制的《入侵者循环》中，你需要抵御从太空深处倾泻而下的无情敌人浪潮，躲避子弹，从市场购买各种物品，并击败史诗级 Boss。

4777440.title: Bone-Bound Demo
4777440.short_description: Bone-Bound is a turn-based roguelite strategy game where you summon creatures, evolve cards, conquer castles, and build your deck across 12 species in lane-based combat with quests, fog of war, and castle upgrades.

4808330.title: The Fish Corner Demo
4808330.short_description: 经营你自己的温馨鱼店，收集独特的鱼种，照顾你的鱼缸并装饰你的家。繁殖稀有鱼类，服务顾客并扩展你的店铺。建造、定制并创造你梦想中的水族生活。

4806630.title: Hostile Entity Demo
4806630.short_description: A reality breach has unleashed something terrible. Fight through 30+ levels, deadly enemies, and brutal boss fights in this 2D top-down horror action game to stop the entity behind the anomaly.

4829270.title: After End Demo
4829270.short_description: This is the playable demo for After End, a First Person ARPG currently in development.

4785030.title: Wreck Runners Demo
4785030.short_description: （简体中文） 百慕大三角从来不是单打独斗的地方。抱紧队友，等自然法则开始跟你们作对时，尽量别笑——也别尖叫。《Wreck Runners》是一款4人合作游戏，融合了撤离式恐怖、物理驱动的混乱玩法，以及围绕载具展开的协作体验。

4768730.title: Petganza
4768730.short_description: Build meaningful bonds with 12 unique animals in a relaxing, heartwarming experience centered around care and companionship. Pet, feed, and play with each animal while raising their happiness through soothing gameplay and a peaceful original soundtrack.

4330960.title: Object Impermanence Demo
4330960.short_description: A first person puzzle game where your vision defines reality, and only the things you can see exist. Learn and master the strange behaviours of objects outside your vision. Traverse the ancient structures of a world forgotten by the universe.

4786680.title: Pro Soccer Manager 27 Demo
4786680.short_description: 成为一支足球队的经理，全面掌控你的俱乐部。管理球探、训练、设施以及阵容发展。选择你的经营理念：专注于教练与战术，或投资培养下一代球星。成功取决于你的决策。

4743670.title: Wobble Ops! Demo
4743670.short_description: Wobble Ops! is a fun, physics-based co-op platformer. Complete the course as fast as possible and lead your team and country to the top of the leaderboard.

4802280.title: Gargadusa's Tower Demo
4802280.short_description: D&D meets Franchise Manager, Gargadusa’s Tower is a supremely deep guild management simulation that spans generations. Build your adventurer guild from nothing. Recruit heroes, complete quests, and descend the mysterious tower to confront the power that lies within.

4790680.title: Life Sim : Shape your city (DEMO)
4790680.short_description: Build the city. Shape the society. Live the life. Wield absolute power over economy, trade, and demographics in this high-fidelity city builder sandbox demo. Prepare the ultimate living metropolis before stepping down to the pavement as a simulated citizen in Life Sim!

2806030.title: Terrarium.live
2806030.short_description: Terrarium.live is a livestreamed elimination gameshow.

4622530.title: Cat Mail Co. Demo
4622530.short_description: 经营一家温馨治愈的猫猫邮局。分检并派送邮船每天送来的包裹，按你自己的方式将一切安排得井井有条。而当夜幕降临之后，月光将揭开包裹背后隐藏的真相。清理积压的神秘包裹堆，帮助当地局民，解锁全新能力与收件地。

4777190.title: Gnomads Demo
4777190.short_description: Drift, boost, and auto-blast through monster hordes in a kart-driving action roguelite. Build absurd weapon combos, smash bosses, rescue lost gnomes, and rebuild your mountain colony between runs.

4081170.title: 手机倒爷模拟器
4081170.short_description: 在贫民窟经营二手手机店，攀登顶峰！说服顾客，低买高卖。你会成为一名诚实的商人，还是与高利贷和赌博为伍，步入地下世界？每个决定都有代价，并导向不同的结局。

1601330.title: Survival Machine
1601330.short_description: 在移动机器上建造你的基地，穿越拥有不同资源的生物群系，并为僵尸威胁远高于白天的夜晚做好准备。你会一个人去还是和你最好的朋友一起去探索这个新世界?

4731790.title: GRAIN ROT Demo
4731790.short_description: 一款设定于焦土废土世界中的恐怖合作撤离建造游戏，在这里，万物皆会燃烧。与你的好友一同深入不断变化的地下遗迹，搬走家具、搜刮战利品，并在被腐化者逼近之前逃出生天。活着返回哨站，重建据点，为下一次出征做好准备。

4838410.title: Lightspeed Demo
4838410.short_description: Reach 299,792,458 m/s to save humanity. In this minimalist incremental simulation, dodge hazards, harvest cosmic matter, and aggressively upgrade your starship's chassis. Turn every hard stop into an explosive launch as you break the ultimate speed limit and push toward Proxima Centauri.

4130870.title: Pinball Bounce 2d
4130870.short_description: Bounce and fly through the air.....until gravity brings you back down. Play different levels and Gamble your hard earned gold away.

4789100.title: SANGUINE CYCLE; REDUX Demo
4789100.short_description: A narrative-driven thriller about missing people, stagnant towns, and the fact that even if you love someone, you can't always see the good sides of them when push comes to shove.

4733630.title: Mechgrave Overdrive
4733630.short_description: Mechgrave Overdrive is a sci-fi arena shooter where you pilot a mech, fight enemy waves, collect materials and credits, extract your resources, and upgrade weapons and equipment to survive increasingly dangerous runs.

4680960.title: Fire Lookout: Abandoned Post
4680960.short_description: Fire Lookout: Abandoned Post is a first-person psychological horror and narrative-driven mystery game. Where you play as a newly stationed lookout in Summit Ridge National Park.

4819920.title: Aleef: Desktop Pet Collector Demo
4819920.short_description: 在后台孵蛋的同时，完全不耽误你工作、浏览网页或畅玩其他游戏！收集300多只属性各异的宠物，解锁强力升级，打造你的专属战斗小队。

4830310.title: GammaBoost+ Demo
4830310.short_description: 为玩家、主播以及所有长时间面对屏幕的人打造的#1伽马控制工具。GammaBoost+实时调整伽马、色彩、亮度和对比度——一键预设、精密滑块、多显示器支持、OBS同步以及内置护眼模式。

4765580.title: Brainrot Autobattler
4765580.short_description: Brainrot Autobattler is a chaotic roguelite auto-battler/autochess where you buy brainrot units, evolve them into stronger forms, trigger trait synergies, and survive a run full of shops, bosses, boons, and bad decisions.

673560.title: IOSoccer
673560.short_description: IOSoccer is a free non-commercial competitive third-person online multiplayer soccer game that offers unparalleled freedom in ball control and gameplay depth.

4014340.title: 100 Railway Cats
4014340.short_description: 🐾 加入充满猫咪的主题地点，展开最可爱的冒险！ 😻 探索特别场所迷人的手绘艺术作品，尝试在整个游戏中找到隐藏的100只可爱猫咪。 🐈🕵️‍♂️ 你能找到它们全部吗？ 🕵️‍♂️🐈

4032930.title: ChessRPG Demo
4032930.short_description: ChessRPG is a revisited chess game in pixel art. Each player chooses a medieval fantasy people, gaining access to pieces with various characteristics that turn every match into a fresh tactical battle.

4466640.title: 迷因残响-致漂流于碎片中的你 Demo
4466640.short_description: 欢迎来到迷因空间！这是一个由无数迷因碎片编织而成的数字梦境，穿过风车平原，乘坐电梯来到深海电子城，通过怪猫石像连接过去和未来，乘坐古老的列车抵达遥远的银之河。尽情去享受这款电波系漫游文字冒险游戏！

4717350.title: Carnival Runner
4717350.short_description: Carnival Runner is a colorful arcade side-scrolling runner where you jump, slide, dodge obstacles, earn bonus points, and chase per-character high scores. The current build includes 2 playable characters, with more planned in future updates.

4390620.title: Strange Finds Demo
4390620.short_description: Discover the ancient Archipelago as the director of the archaeological excavation of the century. Dig up ruins, restore your finds, and answer research questions to piece together the timeline of a lost civilization.

4731900.title: Draco Blade Demo
4731900.short_description: Draco Blade is a “Dragon-Action” game that combines exploration and combat within a land inhabited by dragons. Slash your way through the world, slice your foes, and discover where you came from in this blazing adventure!

4750290.title: Liminal 98
4750290.short_description: Navigate four procedurally generated liminal spaces. Reach the exit. Beat your time. Something may be watching.

4775190.title: BlassHole
4775190.short_description: A space action, looting and ship progression game first made over 25 years ago while I was studying programming, now remade: explore systems, fight, collect loot and upgrade your ship module by module.

4673920.title: NEVEREND
4673920.short_description: First-person parkour. Run, fall, get back up. Chain wall-jumps and boosts to crush the times of other damned souls. No enemies—only time can judge you.

4642570.title: Desktop Detective Demo
4642570.short_description: 一款放置侦探游戏，会在你做其他事情时待在屏幕一角运行。

4673080.title: Sloperator Inc.
4673080.short_description: 欢迎来到 Neo-Uryupinsk——这里没有出口，只有更新。在一个企业取代国家、AI取代良知的世界里，你将扮演 Gleb，在现实逐渐崩坏之际做出生死抉择。一部真相不断崩塌的心理赛博朋克视觉小说。

4622670.title: Sweet and Sour: Subway Romance Stories. Demo
4622670.short_description: How to meet a girl on the subway? The protagonist has few stops to decide which girl to approach or whether it's better to play it safe. A comedic erotic story about an indecisive guy and several attractive women in a subway.

4773660.title: Hypatia Demo
4773660.short_description: Play the opening of Hypatia, a romance visual novel set in a café that is closing next week.

4508600.title: 奇迹魔法师：元素觉醒 Demo
4508600.short_description: 《元素觉醒》是一款三消类策略角色扮演游戏，混沌魔王撕裂了屏障，使得世界原本平衡的元素流转紊乱，混沌蔓延，扭曲了野兽、植物和人类的心灵。作为一名刚毕业的魔法师，你肩负着唤醒元素让世界重归秩序的使命，集结签订了契约的精灵伙伴们，勇敢踏上荆棘之路，在黑暗吞噬世界之前恢复秩序。

3424930.title: Tome of the Damned
3424930.short_description: Tome of the Damned 是一款黑暗风格的俯视角 Roguelike 游戏。你是一名不死者。击败城堡守卫，强化武器与法术。附魔武器、元素魔典、数十个区域与残酷无情的首领正等着你。死亡、适应、再次挑战。

4798940.title: Magical Hellhound Lust Demo
4798940.short_description: 化身灭魔师，让魅魔大军血流成河。在这款活泼灵动、节奏紧凑的轻度Rogue-like动作角色扮演游戏中，发掘你的本性，夺回你的力量。走敏捷流灵活劈砍、挥舞大锤大杀四方、施展五花八门的魔法，或者将三种风格融为一体，掌握成神的真谛。

3547880.title: FeeBay Simulator
3547880.short_description: Flip fake trading cards for real profit in FeeBay Simulator, a comedic marketplace tycoon game. Snipe underpriced cards from clueless and scammy sellers, grade your best pulls, crack open mystery lots, and run your own storefront to build a reselling empire.

2661490.title: Magia y Demonios
2661490.short_description: Old-school isometric RPG game. 6 character classes, skills and various types of weapons. Monsters, champions and bosses in semi-procedural levels.

3545150.title: Fuck's Quest II
3545150.short_description: in this game u play as Fuck and u get to use crappy weapons and talk to horrible NPCs and find the bible crystals and explore my game and find secrets and play further to see what the next part of the game is

4541910.title: Agari — Riichi Mahjong
4541910.short_description: Authentic Riichi Mahjong. No gacha. No fan service. No login walls. No in-game payments. Buy it once, play it anywhere. Full ruleset, 3D table, private online multiplayer, Japanese voice acting, and a daily challenge mode.

4810610.title: SpiritVale Demo
4810610.short_description: A class-based action MMO inspired by classic RPGs. Explore a fractured world of monsters and ruins, build your own playstyle, and fight alongside friends in real-time, cooperative combat.

4515880.title: Pixelwave Off Episode 1 Demo
4515880.short_description: 《Pixelwave Off》是一款以2000年代为背景的后室（Backrooms）吉祥物恐怖游戏。为了寻找几年前失踪的朋友，你再次回到了这里。找到他，并揭开隐藏在 Pixelwave Entertainment 公司背后的黑暗秘密。

3930510.title: Don't Let It Starve
3930510.short_description: 恐怖+肉鸽+烹饪大混搭。你被困在地下的神秘厨房里，被迫制作便当、投喂一个口味相当刁钻的怪物。赌上性命、巧妙组合，去制作了不起的便当吧！无论如何，不能让怪物挨饿。

4727630.title: Sudoku Infinity
4727630.short_description: Sudoku Infinity 是一款经典数独游戏，包含无限生成的数独、四种难度、存档、笔记、颜色、统计、历史记录、Steam 成就和可选辅助功能。

4811260.title: HarvestCo. Demo
4811260.short_description: HarvestCo is a farming incremental idle game where a small field turns into an increasingly efficient money-making machine. Harvest crops, buy upgrades, grow passive income, automate production, and discover rare golden crops and strange field events.

4769510.title: Can I Take Your Order Demo
4769510.short_description: You and your friends play as part time waiters in different restaurants. Use your bare hands to deliver food, taze a raging cowboy who just shot someone and dispose of the body before it starts to stink. Keep your customers happy on your own, or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

3864450.title: Goblin Company
3864450.short_description: 作为 WHAAG MINING INC 的地精矿工，挖掘、铺设轨道并在地下求生。点亮前路，否则黑暗会榨干你的生命。探索完全可破坏的生物群系，对抗敌对生物，单人或在线合作猎取传说中的巨型金块

4806410.title: Grit Shot Demo
4806410.short_description: 为你的灵魂打篮球。用贴纸改装篮球，搜寻增益，并逃离风扇。成功是一种选择，失败是致命的。

4746430.title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes: PROLOGUE
4746430.short_description: Paris. One night at the Opéra Garnier. Somewhere in the audience sits a man the Camarilla wants dead, and Alice Lytelton was sent to collect him. So was her rival. Only one walks out with the prize. Play the opening scenes of a Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness.

4824360.title: Lugal: Bronze Age Survival Game Demo
4824360.short_description: 生存工艺游戏，带有RTS元素。建造基地，成为部落→村庄→城市→国家的领袖。征服邻近定居点，成为国王。

4645430.title: うさぎとたまきはお休みちゅー！3
4645430.short_description: A novel game where a rabbit girl and various characters spend time together.

4824990.title: Elevator Wars Demo
4824990.short_description: Elevator Wars is a steampunk strategy roguelike that takes place from the comfort of your very own elevator. Fight, loot, and trade your way to the top - or die trying.

3237030.title: Black Zen White
3237030.short_description: Black Zen White is a relaxing puzzle platformer where the world flips between two versions: black and white. Think, time your moves, bend time, and interact with strange creatures in this contemplative, hand-drawn journey inspired by East Asian ink paintings for 1 to 2 players.

4780120.title: MythGotchi Demo
4780120.short_description: 升级家园。踏上冒险。抵御恶魔。 挑战小游戏。去钓鱼。训练与战斗。

4690650.title: Dog in the Machine Demo
4690650.short_description: Help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city in this turn-based tactical roguelite! Trigger devastating chain reactions on interactive combat grids, draft powerful synergies by crafting your own attacks, and plan your moves stress-free using a real-time preview timeline.

4695730.title: Hard Edge - War Zone Demo
4695730.short_description: HARD EDGE is back as a 4v4 real-time tactical card battler! Combine strategic deck-building with simultaneous team actions. Every turn, draw cards to shoot, throw, or defend. Sacrifice cards to move in a high-stakes tactical "WAR ZONE."

4840400.title: Golfish Demo
4840400.short_description: Golfish is a cute single-player puzzle adventure where you roll, flop, and splash your way from ice hole to ice hole as a little fish on a big journey!

4660770.title: Gridlords Demo
4660770.short_description: Gridlords is a strategic async-PvP autobattler set in a fantasy pixel-art world. Build your ultimate castle, command legendary heroes, and outsmart rivals to prove your strategy reigns supreme.

4672380.title: H-Virus: Succubus Outbreak
4672380.short_description: H-Virus: Succubus Outbreak is a third-person shooter where you fight off infected succubi. As one of the last humans left, you are forced into hunting across decaying environments. Fight through relentless waves of succubi and survive the nightmare that has claimed the rest of humanity.

4609400.title: Errata
4609400.short_description: Survival Horror with first-person exploration in a dark, isolated forest. Flashlight-based gameplay; manage limited visibility as your light fades. Environmental storytelling through notes and subtle clues. Simple objective: find the key and unlock the door… before something finds you.

4353780.title: Knave Craps
4353780.short_description: An authentic casino craps simulator with realistic 3D dice and 40+ bet types. Place bets, take odds, press and regress, chase Fire Bet and All Tall/All Small payouts, and customize house rules to match your favorite table — with built-in help for beginners and no real money required.

4798790.title: 李商隐：青袍玉珂传 Demo
4798790.short_description: “涧底群松难见日，衰世文章不值钱。”这款古风恋爱文字冒险游戏，在晚唐历史的基础上进行了戏剧化改编。你将扮演李商隐这位才华横溢却命运多舛的贫寒少年，在恶劣的世道挣扎求存，在寒门与豪门的斗争中进行艰难抉择，一路上也会有红颜知己相伴。本作对于角色的塑造复杂立体，而非分出绝对的正邪。

4784710.title: Lone Voyage Demo
4784710.short_description: You are the last living organism in the galaxy. Adrift and alone in a cold dark world you must scavenge for resources to keep your ship running, and arm your ship to prepare for the swarms arrival.

4693020.title: Planet Harvester: Incremental Odyssey Demo
4693020.short_description: Planet Harvester 是一款轻松休闲的低多边形放置游戏。驾驶你的采集车穿越美丽的星球，吞噬资源，解锁新工具，雇用无人机，升级你的机器以获得越来越丰厚的收益。将小数字变成庞大的数字！

4746790.title: Moonlit Horizons Demo
4746790.short_description: After you start seeing and hearing things, you receive an invitation to the First Continent. With only a small shack, a few seeds, and a handful of coins, a new life begins. Uncover Moonlit Cove’s secrets in a farming sim with surprise elements, where no two playthroughs are the same!

4803920.title: Who Haunts The Haunters? Demo
4803920.short_description: "Who’s real when the air starts to rot? Who Haunts The Haunters? is an Eastern horror social deduction game. Don't just watch for movement; listen for the whispers and watch the candles flicker. Purify the manor before the intruders’ greed consumes every last spirit."

4828660.title: Pixel Darts: From Pub to Glory Demo
4828660.short_description: 一款洋溢90年代街机气息的温馨像素风飞镖游戏。畅玩501、Cricket、Shanghai与Bermuda；在街机模式冲击全球最高分，或在生涯模式接手父亲的酒馆、击败72名劲敌登顶联赛，也可自创联赛。再来一局就好！

4720060.title: Going my way? Demo
4720060.short_description: 这是一个失眠症肆虐的世界，它无法无天，濒临崩溃。你驾驶着一列嗜血的列车，穿越无尽的暴风雪之夜。喂养车上的乘客，揭开列车的秘密，并在被冰雪覆盖的深渊吞噬之前，在时间循环中生存下来。

4810390.title: 五年B班事件簿 - The Grade 5B Case Files Demo
4810390.short_description: 本试玩版可体验《五年B班事件簿》第一章前九幕的游戏内容。玩家将跟随主角二人在学校生活中展开调查，接触一件看似日常却又有些不寻常的事件，并通过对话、观察与推理，初步体验本作的剧情氛围与叙事节奏。

3391920.title: Teddy Roller 2
3391920.short_description: 泰迪熊又准备好迎接一场精彩刺激的冒险了！这只小熊将骑着他心爱的毛线球，在危机四伏的地图上翻滚、跳跃、飞跃。在超过150个独具特色的关卡中，你将遭遇意想不到的惊喜。奇幻而怪异的生物将阻挡泰迪熊的去路，让他继续在魔法世界中遨游。

4792790.title: Euphorbia Milii Demo
4792790.short_description: 一座被自然重新占据的废弃研究站。日子流逝，资源逐渐消失，而每一个决定都会留下持久的痕迹。Euphorbia Milii 是一款叙事型、文字驱动的 roguelike RPG，在这里，存在的代价高于生存。这就是植被……

4754650.title: Space Pew Pew
4754650.short_description: Aboard your ship, destroy the hordes of aliens attacking you by choosing your weapons and upgrades as you play, and defeat the final boss! In this roguelite, each ship has a different weapon layout, giving each one its own unique playstyle. Then create your ship and develop your own strategy!

4389360.title: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog Demo
4389360.short_description: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

4802250.title: 鸥鹭罔继 Demo
4802250.short_description: 《鸥鹭罔继》是一款基于架空世界的幻想系视觉小说，玩家可以通过不同选项决定故事走向，体验中二幻想与狗血感情交织的故事。

2555390.title: Xanthiom 2
2555390.short_description: Play through the next chapter in the Xanthiom saga, now bigger and better than before!

4671850.title: Medieval Juice Crafter Demo
4671850.short_description: Craft your special recipe juices and sell them in medieval villages. Expand your business with new recipes, machines, properties, and workers. Play online with your friend or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your business. You can play the early game on the first map in this demo version.

4703940.title: 越过山丘 over the hill 试玩 demo
4703940.short_description: 在《越过山丘 over the hill》的首个区域开启你的越野之旅。无论是独自一人还是与友结伴，翡翠湖的大门已向你敞开：去征服那些考验操作的技术性越野赛道，在荒野中寻觅野生动物，并揭开地图每一个隐藏角落的秘密吧！

4799120.title: Touhou Sousenkyou ~ Land of Oracular Zeitgeist Demo
4799120.short_description: 苍仙京大乱斗现已席卷村落的黄砖小道！ 舞台帷幕背后暗流涌动。是时候让演员与幕后人员携手并进，共同揭开这场人气竞赛背后的真正目的了

4718570.title: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival Demo
4718570.short_description: 在一款以AMC《The Walking Dead》世界为背景的残酷街机格斗游戏中，扮演Rick Grimes、Daryl Dixon和Michonne与丧尸战斗。面对Saviors等无情的敌人以及汹涌如潮的尸群，施展猛烈无休的连击、标志性武器攻击和毁灭性的终结技。

4770000.title: Chosen Anyway: Card Game Demo
4770000.short_description: Chosen Anyway 是一款回合制 Roguelite 卡组构筑游戏，拥有永久成长系统。每次冒险构筑新的卡组，挑战强大的首领，并随着 Ryn 的 RPG 属性成长，让你的卡牌不断变强。

3061560.title: SKIBIDI
3061560.short_description: SKIBIDI is a clicker game where you click on toilets! Click more on the toilet and get even more toilets!

4367820.title: Trust Your Gut Demo
4367820.short_description: A rogue-lite roulette game. Born unlucky; your life is tied to this game. To survive, buy mementos you want, bend the odds, and return to each spin a little stronger.

4701520.title: Dreamer's Wake Demo
4701520.short_description: A stylized third person collectathon set in collapsing dreamscapes. Play as a Haniwa clay figure — conjure projectiles, rewind time, and explore surreal worlds to restore them from static.

4707380.title: Jolly and Whimsy
4707380.short_description: 'Jolly & Whimsy' is a short, experimental picture-book style visual novel. When her best friend, Whimsy the cat, suddenly returns to the Cat Planet, Jolly will try any spell to bring him back.

4754670.title: Japanese with Mayu
4754670.short_description: A short Japanese-learning visual novel where you play as an exchange student in Japan, learn vocabulary through everyday conversations, and check words instantly with a hover dictionary.

4560630.title: Pantomime Horse Obstacle Course
4560630.short_description: Pantomime Horse Obstacle Course is a wacky, slapstick, co-op platformer. Grab a friend and two gamepads, and show off your teamwork - or drag your partner to the finish line (sometimes literally). Filled with chaotic levels and tough challenges for you to complete, get out there and break a leg!

4783040.title: 镜格裂变（试玩版）
4783040.short_description: 在16×6镜格拖放底片卡：走位、朝向与染色决定落点。回合明牌补牌，行动阶段排始/即/末三时机；54层分支路线连战、事件与BOSS。四位相机旅者，约百卡三十遗物，胶片UI构筑连段。

4684440.title: Cannon Clicker Demo
4684440.short_description: Build your army from nothing to military supremacy! Cannon Clicker blends addictive idle clicker action with real strategy in a WWII setting. Expand your skill tree, juggle three currencies, and command infantry, tanks and aircraft. Crush the enemy base and dominate every battlefield!

4737190.title: Duper Demo
4737190.short_description: Duper 是一款 5 人实时 PvP 社交策略游戏。玩家需要发展经济、交易资源、缔结联盟并攻击对手。每一局都融合了谈判、欺骗与战术决策，争夺最终的优势地位。

4370360.title: ShiroboTanks
4370360.short_description: 击败Shirobo！ShiroboTanks是一款色彩鲜艳、轻松有趣的3D坦克射击游戏。 操控坦克穿越充满敌人的关卡，躲避攻击，瞄准射击，击败敌人并完成每一关！ 操作简单、节奏爽快，带来满满乐趣！

3428570.title: 囚徒的柜台
3428570.short_description: 1980年，身处多事之秋的你好不容易获得了一份银行出纳员的工作。荒唐的政策、严苛的制度、难缠的上司，以及形形色色的客人成为了你每天所打交道的对象。这小小柜台既是避风港，也是修罗场，每日埋头于单据文件和处理交易的你究竟该如何扛起家庭的重担？自我良知和对待他人的善意，又能够在权力和金钱的诱惑面前坚持多久？

4556880.title: Heave Ho 2 Demo
4556880.short_description: Get a grip, it’s Heave Ho 2! The insane 2-4 player party game sequel takes the couch co-op mayhem online for the first time. Grab what you can and swing to win!

3943490.title: Island Keeper (Demo)
3943490.short_description: 开启一段温馨的环保冒险：让被污染的岛屿重获新生，收集垃圾、制作装备、打造属于你的据点，并见证大自然在一个充满活力、不断变化的世界中重新繁荣。欢迎来到 Island Keeper DEMO。

4668960.title: Loot Gobblin' Together Demo
4668960.short_description: 一款在线合作游戏，你和好友将扮演贪婪的 Gobblin，入侵人类住宅，偷走并吞下战利品。攀爬、伸展并管理体力，在混乱的劫掠中生存下来，喂饱你的 Gobblin 国王。

4481710.title: Restitutor: Empire Restored Demo
4481710.short_description: 光复者是一款以历史为背景的放置式大型策略游戏，核心聚焦于治国、外交与精心筹划的战争。强化你的经济实力、研究新科技、缔结联盟，并通过高层次的战略决策在无须微操的前提下巧妙压制对手。

4788790.title: DODGE-AND-RUN! Demo
4788790.short_description: 忘了给雷神大人供奉祭品！？快去向他道歉吧！化身为忍者在幻想世界中奔驰！幻想高速动作游戏！

4737700.title: Tempo Tabbies
4737700.short_description: Tap to the beat and swipe away notes in competition with your opponent in this 4 column rhythm game. Add in optional special effects to hinder your opponent or ease your gameplay while competing for the highest scores

4685220.title: Low Effort Romance Demo
4685220.short_description: Low Effort Romance is an otome visual novel about two tired adults who accidentally fall for each other between quarterly reports. Can you juggle deadlines, nosy coworkers, group projects, and a romance that keeps almost happening on company property?

4739880.title: フリと忘れじの都 -FRI the Unforgettable City- Demo
4739880.short_description: An adventure game where your choices change the world. Fri, a girl working at a coffee workshop, lives in a town that feels strangely mysterious. What will she encounter in this town while suffering from amnesia, and how will the world changing?

4761270.title: Card Night at Gigi's
4761270.short_description: Pull up a chair at Gigi's table. Six classic card games — Setback, Hearts, Cribbage, No-Limit Hold'em, Spades, Euchre — wrapped in a cozy cocktail-lounge hub.

4827630.title: みちくさワンダラー Demo
4827630.short_description: The Demon Lord and the Hero are gone. With no mission to fulfill, no world to save, you hunt as you please, eat as you please, and travel as you please. It’s an RPG where you are free to do anything.

4110280.title: Block In
4110280.short_description: Shoot, smack, RUN or metal pipe yourself out of endless waves of enemies. Level-up to unlock weapons, classes and perks to create the most bricked-up build. It's time to Block In!

4696950.title: The Sphere
4696950.short_description: A grieving mechanic. A sphere that fell from the sky. A mystery that was never meant to be found. The Sphere is a short, atmospheric point & click adventure about loss, wonder, and the unknown.

4762620.title: 物理超度
4762620.short_description: 《物理超度》是一款视觉小说，融合中式民俗恐怖、灵异探案与分支叙事，玩家将化身龙虎山道士王踏青，与阴阳眼女警林梦竹搭档，以科学顾问为伪装，深入水潭命案、老楼地缚灵、网吧怨灵等灵异现场，用符箓、阵法与 “科学话术” 完成物理超度，追查赊刀人唤醒千年凶兵、开启酆都鬼门的阴谋，在关键剧情中做出抉择，联手司马玄、雷豹对抗冥界入侵，决定现实世界的命运。

4762630.title: 尸皇贴贴
4762630.short_description: 《尸皇贴贴》是一款视觉小说，在末世红雾笼罩的废土世界，你将扮演林风，觉醒「越危险越安全」的反套路系统 —— 必须贴紧 S 级尸皇红叶才能保命。用火锅、布丁驯服这位灭世女魔头，把恐怖尸皇寝宫打造成末日和平饭店，收编怪物当保安、忽悠人类送晶核，软饭硬吃、反差装逼，一边经营末世度假村，一边守护粘人尸皇老婆，对抗尸帝、称霸末世！

4762610.title: 魔主归来
4762610.short_description: 《魔主归来》是一款重生复仇题材互动小说。你将扮演两世遭背叛的魔主残魂，绑定红颜天命系统，在玄幻世界里探索秘境、闯关战斗、破解阴谋、与六位天命之女建立羁绊，一步步重铸魔躯、提升实力。 在剧情抉择中揭开替身骗局与灭世阴谋，最终决战陨魔崖，逆转宿命、守护所爱，直面高维世界的终极试炼。

4769400.title: Just a stroll in the forest
4769400.short_description: Your girlfriend went missing during a weekend treasure hunt. Arriving at her location, you discover the "game" was a trap. To save her, you must find the scattered gems and return them to a cursed, gold-filled coffin—before the forest traps you both forever. An atmospheric survival mystery.

4782540.title: How Empires Work Demo
4782540.short_description: An incremental strategy game about history, expansion and development. Grow from humble beginnings to take your place on the world stage!

4795170.title: Bounty Trail Demo
4795170.short_description: A short Wild West bounty hunting RPG.

2854210.title: 獬豸: Guardians
2854210.short_description: 这是一款3D俯视视角的动作冒险游戏。通过翻滚躲避敌人的攻击，并击败敌人。成为被黄龙选中的世子，与海太一同拯救陷入混乱的朝鲜。挑战强大的首领，学习或强化他们的技能，体验交织展开的故事与冒险。

4831460.title: Plumbo Demo
4831460.short_description: A playful desktop companion that reacts to everything you do to him. Pet, toss, or annoy Plumbo... just don't push your luck.

3559840.title: 樱姬6
3559840.short_description: 踏入这个世界，风情各异的美少女们正渴望着你的滋润，逐一俘获她们的芳心，开启一场蚀骨销魂的异世界之旅！

4767840.title: Escape the Marine Lab
4767840.short_description: Your first day as a new hire at a marine laboratory begins on the boat that takes you to the lab…

4732870.title: 汐时弦音
4732870.short_description: 《汐时弦音》是一款集成了桌面动态壁纸的UGC下落式音游。关卡由玩家自定义创建，同时提供简易创建功能，玩家只需要设置本地音乐即可生成随机关卡。

4745450.title: Cradle of the Dark Brood
4745450.short_description: A dark fantasy incremental breeding game where you cultivate a monstrous brood, inherit stronger traits, unlock mutations and automation, then send your evolving creatures into conquest across a hostile corpse-world.

4681140.title: MeloDancer Demo
4681140.short_description: A turn-based roguelike with rhythm-infused elements. The melody and pulse rising from the depths grant you strength, empower your choices. With every step, the darkness grows heavier and more enemies emerge from the shadows. Gather power, seek relics

4366540.title: Shadow Rush Demo
4366540.short_description: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. CAN YOU BEAT THE SPEED OF DARKNESS?

4617200.title: 灰色视症 Demo
4617200.short_description: 男主角沈默作为硬派猎奇插画师声名鹊起，但他仍饱受创伤和药物的折磨...而现在，他又被卷入一件离奇的事件——早上用尽犀利言辞将他骂倒的女朋友，晚上却对他展示从未有过的爱意和温柔...事情真有这么简单吗？关于幻觉，记忆，意识，思维，运动，疯狂，分裂和生存斗争的故事开始了...

4766540.title: MatchMaker95 - Programmer Test
4766540.short_description: The programming simulator. MatchMaker95 is a cozy(ish) coding tycoon where you write real C++, grow a chaotic dating app startup, unlock game-changing upgrades, and turn lines of code into profit — all inside a lo-fi Win98 desktop.

3566690.title: Children's Garden Demo
3566690.short_description: 欢迎来到轮回伦理计划“儿童乐园”。这是一场寻觅永恒安息的解谜游戏。

4818750.title: A Simpler World Demo
4818750.short_description: 一款温馨的小型建筑游戏，让你能整理并装饰自己小小的岛屿之家。

4793800.title: 奔跑吧 糊塗蛋: EX Demo
4793800.short_description: 《奔跑吧 迷糊蛋: EX》是SUN SOFT于1994年发布的超级任天堂平台竞速游戏《奔跑吧 迷糊蛋》的现代重制版。在游戏中，你可以从个性丰富的可爱角色中选择一个，在遍地道具和障碍的赛场上享受竞速的乐趣。

4292880.title: 萌禽争霸：鸡飞弹打 Demo
4292880.short_description: 《萌禽争霸：鸡飞弹打 试玩版》是一款画风Q萌、极具策略深度的物理弹射防守游戏。在这颗被遗忘的“原羽星球”上，魔法与科技的碰撞引发了史无前例的物种战争。玩家将操作身怀“鸭力”（魔法）的鸭鸭英雄，利用远古图腾作为助推器，横跨六大极端地貌，对抗机械化的小鸡军团。

3765700.title: Clown Camp
3765700.short_description: First-Person Survival Horror, 90’s style. Hostile clowns lurk the woods. Fight-or-flight to uncover their gruesome secrets throughout a chilling Single-Player Story. Clever inventory management and resourcefulness are your only hopes to escape the Summer of 1999 alive.

4685560.title: 引擎坠落 Demo
4685560.short_description: 《Enginefall》是一款玩家主导的制造射击游戏，背景设定于末日后的巨型列车之上。从列车尾部展开冒险，单打独斗或与友人携手，搜刮、制作、建造，一路杀进头等舱。在各节车厢夺取高等装备，携带珍贵战利品撤离，用以升级你铁轨上的家园。

4539460.title: Fragments of Fear
4539460.short_description: A VHS found-footage horror anthology where everyday chores become your worst nightmares. Experience a growing collection of bite-sized analog horror episodes, from a late-night trip to the laundromat to a terrifying walk home. Can you survive the mundane?

4229600.title: DON'T STOP SMILING
4229600.short_description: 微笑，否则死亡。实时监控你表情的第一人称“强制微笑”恐怖游戏。 需要电脑摄像头。

4694380.title: Today Tomorrow and the Next
4694380.short_description: A simple game about using a crane to crushing scrap metal into cubes to make money. Use the money to buy upgrades like crane speed and scrap value.

4782490.title: Match 3 Labyrinth Demo
4782490.short_description: 这是一款结合了三消与推箱子机制的益智游戏。把三个箱子连在一起使其消失，并朝着终点前进！

4381330.title: Disharmony
4381330.short_description: 1899年。一位作曲家粉碎了宇宙交响乐。2099年。他的后裔们穿越时空试图修复它——但其中一人已不再是人类。在支持多达6人联机的协作模式中集结力量，但要小心：不谐者就在你们中间。

4755390.title: Cozy Coasters Demo
4755390.short_description: Welcome to your cozy coaster island! Unlock new lands, fund the construction of scenic rollercoasters, and hop in the driver’s seat. Use simple accelerate and brake controls to safely guide your passengers through loops and drops. Upgrade your rides, earn stars, and build a relaxing park paradise!

4125810.title: NZ78
4125810.short_description: A short atmospheric sci-fi story told through text and ink-wash images, as New Zealand faces strange events beyond explanation.

4164090.title: 永劫之阿比斯 Demo
4164090.short_description: 在2D像素风肉鸽平台动作游戏中即时切换两名角色（圣骑士/法师/刺客/半人马射手），利用永久成长的暗黑式装备系统（200+词缀组合）征服轮回重生的深渊迷宫，揭露净化仪式背后的致命谎言。

4406550.title: 猫愿日记 Demo
4406550.short_description: 🐾 埋藏在幼猫心中的小小愿望，是否能传达到呢？这是仅有一室、一人、一猫娘的一场温馨且治愈的同居故事。让猫娘用恋慕之心温暖您的冬天！

4734610.title: Reactor Critical
4734610.short_description: High-stakes starship combat on a hex grid. Outmaneuver your enemies, unleash devastating firepower, or swarm their capital ships with fighter squadrons. Every decision counts.

4735860.title: Slime Soup Demo
4735860.short_description: Run a grimy fantasy soup kitchen where you drop and link bouncing slimes to trigger messy chain reactions. Build wild combos with strange ingredients, serve bizarre customers, and turn your filthy cauldron into a chaotic score machine.

4701420.title: Trust Me
4701420.short_description: Please repair the broken spacecraft according to the AI's guidance. AI is something that helps you. You don't have to doubt it. Trust me.

4804350.title: Omnidice Demo
4804350.short_description: An online 1-4 player co-op island game about collecting, rolling, and merging dice. Explore the island, trigger chain merges, and unlock new tools and mini-games to keep the collection growing.

4767920.title: Friendly Fire
4767920.short_description: 你必须设法存活 20 分钟,并随着时间流逝迎接各种新的敌人。强化武器是必然的 —— 但如果这武器也会对你造成伤害呢?

4715660.title: Cursed House 16
4715660.short_description: Strategic Match-3 puzzle game featuring handcrafted levels, thoughtful gameplay, and challenges that reward logic over random moves.

3798940.title: Sigil Arena
3798940.short_description: Sigil Arena is an online 1v1 card battler set in a magical academy, where every duel is a test of strategy and resource mastery. Build your deck, control your mana, and outsmart your opponent in fast-paced matches. Climb the ranks and prove you’re the academy’s most powerful student!

4807940.title: 烘焙糕手 Demo
4807940.short_description: 欢迎来到《烘焙糕手》！这是一款画风温暖治愈的合作类肉鸽模拟经营游戏。化身可爱的动物厨师，与好友本地或在线联机，共同经营一家忙碌的面包店。在不断提升营业额与声望的同时，你需要应对不断上涨的“心率值”，并通过“天使祝福”和“神秘商店”构筑你的经营策略。默契配合，揉好面团，努力打造最繁荣的烘焙小店吧！

4267710.title: Seeing Double
4267710.short_description: In this puzzle platformer, your screen is split down the middle. Control Pitter and Patter simultaneously as you jump, dash, and climb through two parallel realities in this atmospheric adventure on your quest to reunite them.

4822280.title: TankFall Arena Demo
4822280.short_description: TankFall Arena is a fast-paced top-down tank combat game where precision, ricochets, and weapon mastery decide every battle. Fight solo or with a friend, adapt to changing arenas, and outmaneuver opponents using unique weapons and environmental strategy.

4705370.title: 一方降妖录 试玩版
4705370.short_description: 《一方降妖录》是一款仙侠题材的不可思议迷宫风格RPG！每次踏入迷宫，地形、怪物、道具与机关法阵均不同。在迷宫中，我不动、敌不动；我一动，敌全动！即使在迷宫中被击倒也不用担心，利用时间回溯回到指定回合，免费赎回重要的装备，强化它们，你一定能降伏妖怪还一方平安！

4620740.title: Storage 8
4620740.short_description: Storage8 是一款以安静自助仓储设施为舞台的短篇观察步行模拟游戏。仔细查看四个敞开的储物间、人体模特和箱子。若感到陌生，就返回；若没有变化，就继续前进，寻找出口。

4687700.title: Idle Asteroids
4687700.short_description: 一款結合經典復古太空戰鬥與深度永久成長系統的增量式街機生存遊戲。 在激烈的戰鬥回合中生存、收集資源、購買武器升級，並將你的基礎戰機逐步打造為全自動放置型小行星採礦無畏戰艦。

4771190.title: Storage 8 VR
4771190.short_description: Storage8 是一款以安静自助仓储设施为舞台的短篇观察步行模拟游戏。仔细查看四个敞开的储物间、人体模特和箱子。若感到陌生，就返回；若没有变化，就继续前进，寻找出口。

4782160.title: Lawnmower Game Horrorland
4782160.short_description: Lawnmower series are back. Collect skulls in different apocalyptic levels. Try to find all skulls under limited time and avoid zombies in this horror driving simulation

4758120.title: RR
4758120.short_description: Fight to the beat in a cyberpunk nightclub where movement is your weapon and rhythm is your health. Move, attack, and dash on the beat in this top-down rhythm action roguelike. Chain precise actions, build combos, and survive escalating waves as the music speeds up and the arena grows more chaotic.

4765440.title: Rat Musou
4765440.short_description: 俯视角灭鼠生存动作游戏。手持喷雾枪对抗无止境的庞大鼠群，横跨五个主题场景——地下水道、夜市、赛博朋克街区等。喷洒强力灭鼠剂、挑战 BOSS 大鼠，看你能撑多久。

4785480.title: Assassin Of Spider 2: 2099
4785480.short_description: Assassin of spider 2: 2099 is futuristic third person/first person sci-fi shooter where player mission is to kill space spider and collect skulls

4300920.title: 她于深渊 Demo
4300920.short_description: 你收到一条濒死求救 ：屏幕那头的少女，正独自闯入禁区。你们的时间完全同步，你睡眠时她可能正在探险。72 小时内，你的每一次选择，都将决定她能否找到亲人、活着归来。主动发问解锁她的过往，追查禁区背后的真相，揭开这场跨时空链接的秘密。

4288830.title: UNKNOWN CONQUEST
4288830.short_description: Skilled, strategic, and fast-paced action game. Extremely intense, extremely unique, and extremely honest dialogue about philosophy, psychology, and morality.

3400030.title: 消除吧！十二神姬退魔传
3400030.short_description: 《消除吧！十二神姬退魔传》是一款结合了【三消】与【构筑】的Roguelike策略游戏，你要携手12位生肖娘，帮助她们抵御来自上古凶兽的入侵。游戏中有丰富的随机事件、战斗、强化等选项，谨慎地选择前进路线、合理地分配资源、让生肖娘变强是打败敌人的关键。

4779620.title: am I STILL me：デッキ構築ローグライト Demo
4779620.short_description: 黑暗之力会让你变强——但每一次交易，都会侵蚀你的心智。 一款黑暗奇幻卡组构筑类 Roguelite，你的选择将决定你的力量，以及最终的结局。

4812750.title: Against the Horde Demo
4812750.short_description: A PvE roguelike deckbuilder where you can customise your deck with thousands of unique cards. Upgrade, draft, and buy new cards to field a respectable army on unique battlefields that favour tactical movement and card play. Master the five factions and stand Against the Horde.

4796260.title: Creepy Shift: Deer Farm Demo
4796260.short_description: Run your farm, take care of your animals, and survive the storm. Try a demo that mixes farming sim with horror and throws you right into weird events from the very first minute.

4800810.title: Desperate Gambling Demo
4800810.short_description: Win to survive. Dive solo into a cursed casino where every chip delays your end, or join forces in a terrifying cooperative labyrinth. Brave the horrors of the corridors to scavenge loot, sell it to the merchant for upgrades, and bet your earnings at the tables to escape misery.

4387480.title: R.E.G.O
4387480.short_description: R.E.G.O is a first-person psychological horror and narrative investigation game. On an isolated farm, the nights reveal clues tied to disappearances and an ongoing police investigation. The deeper you investigate, the further you are drawn into a mystery that was never meant to be uncovered.

4819020.title: Satan's Fall Demo
4819020.short_description: Satan has fallen. Now fight your way back up. A brutal top-down bullet hell roguelite where you play as the Devil himself. Upgrade your arsenal, unlock demonic powers, and face relentless hordes of Heaven's finest. Apparently, running Hell isn't as easy as it looks.

4808880.title: Who's Got the Legs Demo
4808880.short_description: Control a single character together in this chaotic co-op platformer where each player handles a different action. Coordination i key... or everything falls apart

4705790.title: Night Shift SC
4705790.short_description: You have a job Taking care of the graveyard. Checking every dug-up hole, locking all the doors, Keeping the Giant Candle lit, Checking the lookout. Once you've done you leave until the next day. understand some nights will give you a little twist.

4806580.title: Save Humanity.exe Demo
4806580.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder based around designing a microchip from a pile of junk circuits to out compute incoming viruses trying to crash your system. Combo hardware with software programs to chain multipliers that overflow your FLOP meter before the glitches overwhelm you.

4623920.title: Philly Ball
4623920.short_description: Aracde soccer meets classic Philadelphia chaos. Pick a country, hit the couch, fool your friends, and kick them into oblivion as you unleash ridiculous power-ups across iconic locations inspired by the City of Brotherly Love.

4654940.title: 斗笠江湖
4654940.short_description: 《斗笠江湖》是一款 3D 硬派国风武侠 MMORPG，以明朝万历年间为背景，融合朝堂纷争与江湖恩怨，主打写实武侠画风与高自由度开放世界。游戏设有六大特色职业，采用无锁定即时战斗，浮空连招打击感强烈。核心包含侠客助战、装备养成、秘境探索等玩法，同时主打跨服团战、阵营对抗、公平竞技等强 PVP 内容。游戏福利丰厚，支持自由交易，整体偏向硬核养成与热血竞技，适合喜爱经典武侠 MMO 的成年玩家。

4781120.title: Killer Chase Demo
4781120.short_description: Killer Chase is a fast-paced retro quick time event arcade action game where every input matters. Complete rapid input sequences under pressure to outrun a relentless Killer.

4663690.title: WHERE IS MY CAT? Demo
4663690.short_description: Your cat is missing. This is terrible! It was kidnapped and hidden by an unknown, evil Entity that terrorizes the tenants of your house because it is bored. Finding the cat is now your unsolvable problem. You will go crazy before the end. This is not a threat. It's a statistic.

4607880.title: 蛹月
4607880.short_description: 《蛹月》是一款美少女箱庭逃生游戏。一觉醒来苏璃发现自己处于一个陌生的房间，周边徘徊的怪物，奇怪的符咒...强压心中的恐惧，在这萦绕诡异的空间里探索、解谜，与步步紧逼的怪物周旋对抗..只为抓住—线生机，逃离此地！

4812250.title: BugFixer Demo
4812250.short_description: BugFixer 是一款支持 4 人联机的合作恐怖社交推理解谜游戏。作为一名特工，你的任务是收集现实中出现的“漏洞”。在对抗神秘怪物的同时，还要揪出潜伏在团队中的漏洞使用者。收集所有漏洞，并努力生存到最后。

4694090.title: Typomagical Demo
4694090.short_description: Type and cast your own spells! Typomagical is a spell-casting roguelike with a twist: create and cast spells by typing incantations! Spells and the elements are at your fingertips, literally -- creative synergies are the key to victory!

4828460.title: Deep Breach Demo
4828460.short_description: Deploy orbital defenses, fuse experimental turret technologies, and engineer devastating weapon builds in a tactical sci-fi horde survival roguelike.

4306300.title: Saint George's Tavern
4306300.short_description: Saint George's Tavern is a hilarious tavern simulator set in the early 1800's during the ending of the reign of King George III (the Mad King). This game is about more than just pouring ales and cooking food, It's full of fun, laughs and mini games!

4730330.title: CacaClicker
4730330.short_description: The most absurd clicker on Steam! Click, produce, prestige, and dive into Corrupted Mode. Face bosses, challenge the casino, unlock 25 skins, 33 wallpapers, and dozens of achievements. A wacky universe for hundreds of hours of gameplay.

4790540.title: Buddies to Death DEMO
4790540.short_description: Buddies to Death - A fast-paced, turn-based, 4X strategy set in a medieval fantasy world with asymmetric factions, amazing lore, and FISHHH!

4487850.title: Unattached: City of Shadows Prologue
4487850.short_description: Freshly-graduated detective James Arnold is sent on a mission to investigate the death of the mayor of New Eastbrook, a little-known city where corruption is tradition. Investigate crime scenes, interrogate suspects, and fight criminals in a city where every choice pulls you deeper into the shadows.

4248780.title: Pinball Bounce 2d Demo
4248780.short_description: Bounce and fly through the air.....until gravity brings you back down. Play different levels and Gamble your hard earned gold away.

4826080.title: Wadi Karma - وادي كرمة Alpha Demo
4826080.short_description: Wadi Karma is a 2D sandbox adventure game inspired by Arabian folklore, blending farming, exploration, and story-driven mystery in a forgotten desert world. Uncover the past. Reclaim the valley. And awaken the legacy of Jourya—before it’s lost forever.

2258380.title: Pact of Steel
2258380.short_description: A WW2 Tower Defense game, with minor aspects of an RTS game.

4843620.title: NECHTO: Infection Protocol Demo
4843620.short_description: A card party game for 4 players with hidden roles and infection. One laptop on a shared screen, phones as controllers. No installs — just a browser and Wi-Fi.

4824230.title: Hangin' Off! - Teaser demo
4824230.short_description: You’re sitting on an 80s racing motorcycle at the starting line of the Beginner Course. Your objective? Ride as far as possible before the timer reaches zero. How far can you make it?

4829140.title: Boreworks Demo
4829140.short_description: Build bots. Figure out logistics. Automate yourself out of a job. A chill, top down automation game about mining asteroids down to the core.

3300600.title: Till the End Demo
3300600.short_description: Earth has fallen. Recruit survivors in the ruins, activate their unique Power Suits, and fight back against endless alien hordes in this solo-developed sci-fi rogue lite wave shooter. Master Bushido blades, Centurion tanks, or Magi blasts — become unstoppable.

4257900.title: 棋桜
4257900.short_description: 気軽に、だけど本格的。『棋桜（きおう）』でキャラクターと一緒に将棋を楽しもう。初心者には学びを支えるAIサポート、実力者には純粋な読みと一手の勝負を。あなたの一手から、対局が始まる。

4350460.title: Embers of the Uncrowned Demo
4350460.short_description: 《Embers of the Uncrowned》是一款以爽快等角视角动作为核心，融合残酷血腥战斗场面的暗黑奇幻MMORPG。 在被精灵侵略、浸染人类鲜血的宏大史诗中，点燃家族最后的希望之火，踏上属于余烬者的征程吧。

4762280.title: MINESTRIKE SURVIVORS
4762280.short_description: Your keyboard is a machine gun. Type words to unleash a storm of bullets, mow down endless waves of mineshaft mobs, and survive as long as your fingers hold out. MINESTRIKE SURVIVORS is a bullet heaven roguelite where every keystroke fires a shot.

4829500.title: Asteroid 69 Demo
4829500.short_description: Demo version limits all Game Modes to 20 levels. Master the controls for the unique ships and flex your aim against waves of diverse Asteroids while using a variety of special weapons.

4841050.title: Grandpa Nightmare Demo
4841050.short_description: 在一个由古怪但危险的爷爷掌控的奇怪房子里展开紧张的逃脱游戏。解开谜题，避免被抓，并经历刺激的追逐。你的选择将带来不同结局。你能智胜爷爷并逃离这座房子吗？

4757010.title: MechShell Demo
4757010.short_description: Pilot S.H.E.L.L., a weaponized snail mechsuit, and defend the Overgrown Realms. Customize your shell, and squad up in 4-player co-op side-scrolling combat. Activate Battlefield Clarity to shift into first-person warfare.

4543430.title: Florence Mirror Demo
4543430.short_description: Florence Mirror is a dark fantasy Action RPG set in modern Florence, where a hidden mirror dimension unleashes monstrous reflections of human sins. As Leonardo Tornabuoni, fight through 30+ bosses, master arcane powers, and choose between a story-driven path or a brutal Souls-like challenge.

4687330.title: Ultimate Blacksmith Tycoon
4687330.short_description: An appraiser-shopkeeper conquers the blacksmith trade. Read materials, decode Modifiers, bend rarity. ~70M gear combos; Artifact 1-in-1,270. Send adventurers from 55 jobs into dungeons of 1,270+ monsters. Dynamic rarity, compound-interest debt, 80+ tech nodes. For shopkeepers who watch the numbers.

4816830.title: The Milgram Experiment Demo
4816830.short_description: The Milgram Experiment is a first-person psychological horror game where you must make difficult decisions when lives are put into your hands. Explore 10 encounters with unique consequences by investigating evidence and deciding who to trust.

4831350.title: Fishing Party VR Demo
4831350.short_description: Stop clicking, start casting! Experience the most immersive physics-based VR angling where every flick of the wrist and every fight matters. Master 3 fishing methods across 5 stunning locations, hunt 20 unique species in dynamic weather, and dominate tournaments. Just... watch the ceiling fan.

4796420.title: cenker's mod Demo
4796420.short_description: cenker's mod 是一款拥有许多 Mod 的多人物理沙盒游戏。每个 Mod 都有不同的体验。与朋友一起游玩内置的、社区制作的以及您自己的 Mod。

4685090.title: Hold'em Fold'em Poker
4685090.short_description: The casual, no-nonsense Texas Hold'em Poker game you can play with your friends!

4769320.title: Kernelbay Demo
4769320.short_description: A tiny, cozy idle fishing desktop companion about quiet progress, handcrafted islands, and stories hidden beneath the waves. Discover new species, upgrade your gear, customize your gears and let your fisher work peacefully in the background.

4810860.title: Neverwood Demo
4810860.short_description: You journey through the haunted forest of Neverwood in board game orchestrated by a dark and mysterious game master named Bella. The game blends grid based combat with deckbuilding roguelike mechanics in a dreary yet somewhat cozy Halloween themed atmosphere.

4788600.title: Cheap Screamer Demo
4788600.short_description: Try to survive the experiments being conducted on you while you attempt to uncover the truth about why you are there.

4766570.title: Anomaly Watcher
4766570.short_description: They told you it was a simple security job. They lied. Stare into the static of vintage CCTV monitors, report procedural anomalies before they escalate, and conserve your limited resources. An unforgiving psychological horror game where paranoia is your only defense.

4788690.title: Gathera Demo
4788690.short_description: 收集材料来制作，制作工具来收集更多！解锁新地点，探索世界，建造温馨小屋，并用收藏品装饰它。打造生产设施，优化采集与制作。想挑战的话，就在怪物袭击中生存下来！

4800480.title: Kings of Antikva - Demo
4800480.short_description: Turn-based strategy with hidden information. Position your army, outsmart your opponent and capture the enemy flag before it’s too late. Easy to learn, hard to master. Ranked online multiplayer and offline mode versus AI.

4410040.title: 天气骰子 Demo
4410040.short_description: 《天气骰子》是一款回合制rouge卡牌游戏。你掌握着罕见的玛娜之力，能唤醒各具特色的可爱植物娘以对抗春夏秋冬四季轮番入侵的怪物大军，还可以通过金手指回溯时间改变天气，在绝境中逆转战局，守护最后的家园！

4622850.title: Hot Shot: Robot Attack Demo
4622850.short_description: Take on missions to fight the robot uprising and bring peace to the world. Chose your targets carefully to build combos and manage your heat level in this retro on-rails shooter. Every shot you make counts!

4799910.title: Silency: Cube 666 Demo
4799910.short_description: 体验《CUBE 666》试玩版：读取门上的计数器，推导安全路径，在旋转机械魔方的限时流程中打开下一扇门，并从钢针、电击、火焰与坠落等死亡威胁中活下来。

1888760.title: Tower Defense Monster
1888760.short_description: In Tower Defense: Monster, you'll have to defeat the army of invading monsters.

4594170.title: Masked Mayhem Demo
4594170.short_description: Masked Mayhem is an online party game (Friend slop) where players blend in with friends and NPCs, tricking each other with clever disguises, special items, and weapons. Outsmart your friends, collect points, or be the last one standing to claim victory!

4436310.title: Limit Breaker Demo
4436310.short_description: An idle clicker about training and breaking your limits! Gain power with every press, evolve into stronger forms, and push beyond your boundaries. Limit Breaker is currently in development — this is its official demo version on Steam.

4843410.title: The Glitch Prison Together Demo
4843410.short_description: Find bugs with your friends, exploit them, and escape!

4759210.title: Isles of Arcana Demo
4759210.short_description: 你是一名守护者，被派往一个被腐化吞噬的世界。探索日益危险的生物群系，收集资源，打造强力工具，并发掘失落的科技，为拯救阿卡纳而战。支持单人游玩或最多4人合作。

4747690.title: Pirate İsland Demo
4747690.short_description: "Cook by day, defend by night! Trade your cutlass for a kitchen knife in this unique blend of restaurant management and intense combat. Feed the hungry, fight the past, and survive the legacy of Pirate Island."

4660490.title: Decked Out Demo
4660490.short_description: It is a 2D Rouge Like Deck Builder, where you need to open packs to gain more cards to use in your own run! Be aware as difficult enemies are there. Do not worry or give up, you will start winning slowly, and maybe not in your first turn!

4282490.title: 雾影猎人 Demo
4282490.short_description: 《雾影猎人》是一款黑暗奇幻动作搜打撤游戏。 根据不同职业精心搭配技能、天赋、装备，领略第三人称视角下的精彩动作战斗！或与队友密切配合，或孤身一人加入战场，唯有杀出重围，方能满载而归。猎金人，祝你好运。

4414480.title: Logissey
4414480.short_description: A top-down puzzle game where you explore a dense interconnected island trying to find your way home. Solve puzzles in your path by guiding boulders, luring bulls, raising and lowering walls and much more! Enjoy the cozy hand-drawn graphics and wildlife but beware -not everything here means you well!

4626540.title: 23:61-Demo
4626540.short_description: “你想救谁？或者说，你准备抛下谁？” 午夜的撤回键将她们困在时间的夹缝，也唤醒了本该死去的“你”。 化身寄宿于屏幕与监控后的“幽灵”，隔着手机给出指令、窥探她们的秘密。 选择、解谜、救人……然后抛下其中一个——亦或者将她们全部留在这座监牢。

4761660.title: HELLEVATORS Demo
4761660.short_description: HELLEVATORS is a fast-paced action-roguelike where you must jump, dash, slide and BLAST your way through Hell's public transit system. Make friends with weirdos, amass mystical knick-knacks and get frighteningly rich as you battle your way out of eternal damnation.

4566920.title: The Blackwood Project
4566920.short_description: You're an agent investigating a distress signal, armed with your trusted flashlight and revolver. Creep through the horror infested darkness of Blackwood Manor to uncover its secrets. A Short and sweet game made by students over a 9 week period

4829950.title: 2DOM! Demo
4829950.short_description: This is the DEMO for 2DOM! A Chill 2D sidescroller physics-based chain reaction puzzle game featuring dominoes!

4810400.title: ZrOth Demo
4810400.short_description: Use your resources to capture locations in this management game. Each location will give you different resources and effects. Create your own build to gather as many resources as possible to pay ZrOth’s tribute, but be careful, he’s getting greedier and greedier.

4816940.title: Stardust Aces Demo
4816940.short_description: Stardust aces is a six-axis space dog-fighting game with arcadey weapons and a semi-realistic flight model.

4686610.title: Gooblings Demo
4686610.short_description: Fish a cozy pond with friends. Reel in creatures with randomized species, colors, patterns, and rare mutations — some wear tiny hats, some glow, some sprout wings. Breed new combos, display them in aquariums, and chase fish nobody has ever seen.

4705620.title: WHERE the F$CK is my BITCOIN ⁉️
4705620.short_description: 你把Bitcoin弄丢了，它现在埋在垃圾场里。挖掘、收集、出售并升级。每一次发现都可能是垃圾……或改变一切的关键。

4815630.title: Speak Demo
4815630.short_description: Speak is a diplomacy game for 2–10 players (up to 6 in the demo) where your phone is your only weapon. Call in secret, strike deals, spread lies, trust no one as you fight for control of the city.

4162640.title: Super Billards Maker
4162640.short_description: A creative mix of billiards, Kirby’s Dream Course, and Mario Maker, offering both skill and imagination. Sink all balls within the time limit to earn shiny medals, then unleash your creativity by designing and sharing unique levels with the built-in editor.

4823500.title: Unlucky Day Demo
4823500.short_description: 一款关于在讨厌你的日子里努力生存的点击游戏。面对糟糕透顶的概率，Mika 能连续挺过十场灾难，并最终在酒吧见到她的朋友吗？

4788770.title: Hired Blade Demo
4788770.short_description: 《雇佣兵》是一款回合制战术角色扮演游戏。你将成为自己雇佣兵团的首领，招募雇佣兵，接受委托，与强盗和怪物战斗。体验真正冷酷无情的雇佣兵的艰辛生活！

4841720.title: Last Button Demo
4841720.short_description: 按下按钮。可怕的事情发生了。最后存活的玩家获胜。2–8名玩家。零规则。纯粹的混乱

4673910.title: 进化：欲望代码 Demo
4673910.short_description: 这个游戏试图回答一个问题：人类需要什么样的欲望才能活下去？ 在这款独特的人类进化模拟游戏中，你将扮演一位神明，在六边形世界中播撒生命的种子。每一个被你创造的人类都拥有独特的六欲望基因组：色欲、善欲、食欲、共情欲、求知欲、求胜欲，这六种欲望将决定他们的行为模式和命运走向。 你可以选择静观其变，也可以运用神力干预。实时统计图表让你洞察种群动态，见证基因如何在自然选择中演化。每一次模拟都是独一无二的故事。 一场关于生命、选择与命运的沙盒实验，等待你的开启。

2830880.title: 湮灭之地Demo
2830880.short_description: 在跳跃、探索与战斗中，踏入一片被遗忘的文明。 《湮灭之地》是一款带有类银河恶魔城元素的 2D 动作平台游戏。

4575980.title: CLAWS: Command Line Advanced Warfare System
4575980.short_description: CLAWS is a real-time battle simulator where you command the chaos. Orchestrate massive fights, deploy powerful abilities, and experience cinematic action—brought to life in a bold retro command-line aesthetic.

4824510.title: Wordy Space Demo
4824510.short_description: Type words to blast incoming space threats, upgrade your ship and powers, master different dictionary packs, and climb global or language-specific Steam leaderboards.

4591970.title: Warfront Vanguard Demo
4591970.short_description: An action-packed tower defense where you face waves of enemies with unique strengths and weaknesses. Build and upgrade towers, adapt your strategy, and overcome increasingly powerful enemies in a dynamic mix of action and strategy.

4655660.title: Phantasma Hotel Demo
4655660.short_description: Мрачная и безжалостная хоррор‑RPG с элементами roguelike. Пошаговые бои сталкиваются с истощающими ресурсами, а каждое возрождение меняется меняет окружение и цену ваших решений. 1980‑е, Пилигрим‑Сити, заброшенный отель, который помнит каждую смерть и каждую вашу ошибку.

4832250.title: Rogue Elements Demo
4832250.short_description: Unique traditional Roguelike, in which every move counts as the environment is constantly shifting around you. Grass burns, poison clouds seeping into water, water vapors spreading dangerous effects throughout the dungeon. Can you master the elements?

4711650.title: 几何守护者
4711650.short_description: 几何守护者 — 操控几何核心，在霓虹战场上抵御几何敌人的入侵！ 玩家位于屏幕中央，鼠标瞄准，左键射击。躲避敌人弹幕，享受"子弹时间"般的精准走位。 武器升级：多弹道、威力强化、散弹、导弹、护体子弹，多种路线自由搭配。 敌人来袭：3-8边形几何体、精英六角星、Boss级立方体与邪恶笑脸，挑战逐步升级。 四种模式：经典模式闯关、生存模式极限挑战、无尽模式永无止境、掀桌模式随机刺激。 成长系统：10级动态难度，10级称号从"见习守护者"到"几何之主"。 特色内容 极简几何美术风格 流畅射击手感 丰富武器升级路线 紧张Boss战 自定义音乐、音效、颜色

3066110.title: Bladefall
3066110.short_description: BladeFall is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game featuring fluid melee combat, 2.5D movement, and challenging battles against varied enemies and powerful bosses. Master timing and skill-based attacks as you fight through an evolving system built to test your abilities.

4784240.title: Jiu‑Jitsu Hero! Flow Roll Demo
4784240.short_description: A Guitar Hero meets Brazilian jiu-jitsu rhythm game! Drop onto the mats and feel the flow in Jiu-Jitsu Hero Flow Roll! The rhythm game where you time falling white belts to the beat of Neffex style tracks, while live BJJ matches play on screen. Sync your hits perfectly to get that perfect score!

4822690.title: Chain of Command Demo
4822690.short_description: Chain of Command is a top-down arena shooter roguelike, where you control a snake-like chain of fighters that attack automatically. Choose your Commander and build your party to create high-synergy builds to crush the invading demon armies.

4794260.title: 天下太平 Again Demo
4794260.short_description: 《天下太平 Again》是一款由童年纸笔游戏启发的 1v1 战略卡牌游戏。结合卡牌构筑与「剪刀、石头、布」的心理博弈，你必须看穿敌人的心思、善用武器卡牌的独特效果，摧毁敌方城池，让天下再次太平！

4222060.title: Girl with gun
4222060.short_description: A dating simulator, but... The girl has a shotgun, and if she doesn't like how you answer her questions, you die. Your date takes place in a living, watching cave where every element of the environment actively reacts to your tension and tries to break you.

4787720.title: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 Demo
4787720.short_description: The follow-up to Lawn Mowing Simulator! Check out this level that features brand new grass tech, the addition of leaf-blowing plus reworked systems based on player feedback to the original - plus licensed equipment from Kubota!

4725030.title: Gun Goose Demo
4725030.short_description: 有史以来最真实的鹅模拟器……《枪鹅》是一款节奏紧张的射击游戏，你将扮演一只手持武器的鹅。使用你的武器库和技能，在疯狂的地图上横扫同样疯狂的敌人群，在多种游戏模式中挑战最高分——直到你的鹅被烤熟为止！

4652970.title: Pool Demo
4652970.short_description: 体验轻松又有技巧性的台球游戏。🎱

4653010.title: Tennis Demo
4653010.short_description: 踏上球场，感受每一次回合的紧张节奏。从快速比赛到完整赛事，体验流畅网球动作 🎾

4652910.title: Apple Shoot Demo
4652910.short_description: Apple Shoot 将每一次射击变成紧张又搞笑的挑战。失误就会一片混乱！🍎🎯

4652880.title: Phantom Town Demo
4652880.short_description: 被浓雾笼罩的废弃城市，每一步都充满危险。在寂静中探索并生存。

4813830.title: Kwad Demo
4813830.short_description: Kwad is a snappy, grid-based puzzle game where you play as a square. Jump, snap, and merge with other Kwads to morph your way through clever spatial challenges.

4652850.title: Penguin Demo
4652850.short_description: 化身企鹅🐧滑行、跳跃并使用喷气背包，在冰雪世界中展开混乱又欢乐的冒险。❄️💨

4652570.title: Sewer Demo
4652570.short_description: 《Sewer》是一款生存恐怖游戏，玩家作为1915年被困在阿拉斯地下的英国间谍，在黑暗中求生并尝试逃脱。

4652510.title: Burger Demo
4652510.short_description: 制作美味汉堡和饮料，把你的餐厅发展成城中最受欢迎的地方。🍔🍟

4652480.title: Ranch Demo
4652480.short_description: 《Ranch》邀请你放慢节奏，享受照料动物、收获土地以及经营小农场的宁静生活。放松身心，体验温馨乡村的简单快乐。🌿🐑

4652420.title: Battalion of Tanks Demo
4652420.short_description: 《Battalion of Tanks》让你化身二战指挥官——冲向据点、将敌人炸成碎片，感受每一次BOOM!!带来的混乱与震撼。

4814150.title: 破夜者 试玩版
4814150.short_description: 《破夜者》是一款独特的"骰子"驱动的回合制卡牌RPG,收集材料,卡牌,锻造强大的武器,构筑传奇团队,探索令人绝望的圣城,经历事件,直面那些噩梦般的强敌

4652240.title: TNT Bomb Demo
4652240.short_description: TNT Bomb带来快节奏爆炸竞技场体验 💣🔥

4652220.title: Mancala Party Demo
4652220.short_description: Mancala Party 是一款轻松策略游戏，在每一步中挑战思维并击败对手。

4651950.title: Barman Demo
4651950.short_description: Barman是一款轻松的调酒游戏，你可以为顾客制作鸡尾酒，享受海边的惬意氛围。

4525230.title: Supermarket Life Simulator Demo
4525230.short_description: 经营您自己的超市！购买、存货、销售和扩展商店，同时管理顾客并应对新挑战。

4525200.title: F1 Simulator Demo
4525200.short_description: F1 Simulator 带你进入驾驶舱，每一个弯道、每一次加速、每一秒都至关重要。感受肾上腺素飙升，追逐疯狂速度，将你的名字刻入纪录，成为终极赛车传奇！

4525190.title: Mini Golf Simulator Demo
4525190.short_description: 平静温馨的迷你高尔夫体验，享受宁静球场与完美一杆进洞的成就感。

4525160.title: Bar Darts Simulator Demo
4525160.short_description: 在 Bar Darts Simulator 中，與朋友喝幾杯啤酒，講幾個笑話，並在 10 款有趣的飛鏢遊戲中互相挑戰。瞄準、投擲，同時小口啜飲飲料，享受熱鬧的酒吧氛圍。

4525120.title: Retrowave Highway Demo
4525120.short_description: 驾驶你标志性的80年代座驾，打开点唱机播放你最爱的复古电波曲目，在夜空下穿梭于霓虹灯闪烁的街道。躲避交通，感受风的吹拂，让发光的高速公路带你穿越纯正的深夜80年代怀旧时光！

4525090.title: Eagle Demo
4525090.short_description: 展开翅膀像一只鹰，滑翔在温暖的山风中。捕捉鱼类，飞越山谷，与其他鹰竞速，同时享受在宁静世界上空飞翔的平静自由感。

4525070.title: Wukong Fights Demo
4525070.short_description: 化身悟空，征战奥林匹斯的四大领域。神圣之力在你体内奔涌，挥舞手中的长棍，勇往直前。每一次攻击，每一次跳跃，都让你更接近最终的胜利！

4524970.title: Roach with Bike Demo
4524970.short_description: 骑上罗奇先生的自行车，全力踩下油门！触发野兽终极涡轮，躲避街道上的混乱，完成最精彩的前空翻，追逐最高分，成为你社区最快的骑手！

4524960.title: Farm Demo
4524960.short_description: 在农场醒来，启动那台生锈了20年的拖拉机，耕种你的田地，照料你的动物，并在炎热的一天里，在宁静的农场享用一杯冰镇柠檬水。你接下来要收获什么作物？

4524910.title: Battleships Simulator Demo
4524910.short_description: 指挥强大战舰—攻击、击沉对手并赢得胜利！体验回合制海战的刺激！

4524900.title: Hunting Pro Simulator Demo
4524900.short_description: 心跳加速，手在颤抖……砰！在《Hunting Pro Simulator》中完成完美爆头！

4524840.title: Boxing Pro Simulator Demo
4524840.short_description: 投入拳击赛场！释放无法阻挡的拳击和猛烈勾拳！

4524780.title: Spaceship Pro Simulator Demo
4524780.short_description: 投身混乱太空战！躲避敌人、攻击并生存！

4524740.title: Pilot Force Simulator Demo
4524740.short_description: 投身混乱太空战！躲避、攻击并在子弹浪潮中生存！

4760980.title: 匣中少女的第二次末日 Demo
4760980.short_description: 无限流 x 微恐 x 群像视觉小说，和少女们一起加入这场末日狂欢～

4594000.title: Dino Goodbye
4594000.short_description: 一部荒诞喜剧视觉小说：科学家恐龙拼命警告陨石将至，而政客、媒体红星和有钱蜥蜴却忙着把世界末日搞成一场大型闹剧。

4696530.title: KRYONULL
4696530.short_description: Kryonull is a branching sci-fi visual novel about a landing on Europa, a fragile link to Earth, and a first contact that may begin with silence.

4701920.title: After the Hero
4701920.short_description: The Dark Lord is dead. The Hero left. Now you must govern the aftermath: refugees, broken roads, unemployed orcs, cursed land, noble outrage, and a budget that whimpers. A political management satire about cleaning up after destiny.

4738350.title: Velvet Emergency
4738350.short_description: You are a waitress at a sealed political dinner when a dam failure warning hits. Decide who hears the truth, who gets lied to, and what can be carried from the kitchen before the wave reaches the glass.

4814230.title: Mr. Nice Guy Demo
4814230.short_description: Play as the Final Girl and explore a haunted children's hospital in this PSX-style fixed-camera survival horror inspired by "Fatal Frame" and "Resident Evil". Hunt anomalies through a CCTV camera loop similar to "I'm on Observation Duty". Unravel an unsettling mystery, and escape a glitching entity.

4677640.title: Lootborne Demo
4677640.short_description: Lootborne 是一款黑暗奇幻桌面自走棋（autobattler）。打造你的角色，搜刮装备，攻克 PvE 关卡，在屏幕一角战斗持续进行的同时，于异步 PvP 决斗中挑战其他玩家。

4637860.title: Lonely Planet Demo
4637860.short_description: A Sci fi looter shooter. You have crashed on a strange planet, your spaceship parts scattered across the mystical world. Collect weapons, explore the world, clear dungeons, interact with NPCs and fight bosses to save the planet's inhabitants and repair your ship!

4285580.title: Retrowave Barro Crazy Drift
4285580.short_description: Retrowave Barro Crazy Drift is a racing game with small cars and challenging tracks.

4804500.title: ねこ巫女怪猫仕置ノ絵巻 体験版 -Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki demo-
4804500.short_description: "Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki" is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats. Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

4825350.title: 弹珠百万富翁 Demo
4825350.short_description: 《弹珠百万富翁》是一款基于物理引擎的弹珠模拟游戏，利用弹珠攻击敌人的同时根据造成的伤害得分，让弹珠尽可能多次在各种物体之间来回反弹不断扩大分数，最终让弹珠落入最高倍率的结算区中，用赢得的奖金继续强化和升级地图。

4813180.title: Tomo Cafe Demo
4813180.short_description: Tomo Cafe is a cozy, narrative-driven productivity game set in a relaxing study cafe. Set your real-life to-do list, work alongside energetic and chaotic focus buddies, and unlock heartfelt stories as you check off your goals.

4825190.title: Black Border 3 Demo
4825190.short_description: 边境从不眠 — 你亦如此。 🌙 检查文件，揭穿谎言，并做出关键决策。在 Black Border 3: Night Shift 中，每个选择都可能改变夜晚。 🚨

4834140.title: Cursor Kingdom Demo
4834140.short_description: 记录你的行动并将它们转化为工人。建立一个由鼠标克隆人组成的自动化王国，优化生产链，并在敌人的突袭中幸存下来。

4548850.title: Beyond Hatred Demo
4548850.short_description: Beyond Hatred (Demo) is a 2D ARPG where you follow Daran on his quest to rescue Alexia. Fight enemies, overcome obstacles, and gear up to survive in a hostile world filled with danger and challenges at every step.

4406250.title: 锁链王冠
4406250.short_description: 从一无所有到传奇巅峰，书写属于你的逆袭史诗。 这是一个关于绝地反击的故事。你将扮演一名跌入人生谷底的落魄者，在命运的十字路口，通过结识志同道合的伙伴，不断壮大自己的队伍。在充满未知秘密与奇妙际遇的旅途中，想尽一切办法克服绝境，一步步夺回失去的荣耀，最终重返人生巅峰！

4811930.title: ThunderTop Legacy Demo
4811930.short_description: 《雷霆之巅遗产》是一款第三人称动作冒险游戏，玩家将在游戏中探索世界，拯救自己的家乡，对抗神秘生物，穿越史诗般的传送门。

4730950.title: BrightGlade Tales
4730950.short_description: A two-player card game set in the land of Brightglade. Build your crew while sabotaging your opponent — steal and destroy their resources, eliminate and bribe their crew. Every match is a short, intense race to seize control of one of three locations drawn at random from the deck.

4827690.title: Bottanics Demo
4827690.short_description: An automation farming game where you teach a robot through demonstrations instead of writing code. Train its neural network, then watch it adapt to similar situations. Teach. Train. Deploy. Fix. Expand. Repeat.

4814100.title: Van Tich Legends Demo
4814100.short_description: Vạn Tích Legends is a high-speed 3D beat ’em up that brings Vietnamese folklore to life through intense solo and co-op combat. Battle as legendary heroes across stunning landscapes inspired by traditional Vietnamese culture.

3976220.title: Tollway Tycoon
