3976220.short_description: Potholes. Breakdowns. Zombies. Just another shift at the Tollway. Hire Staff, upgrade your tollway, appease HQ and keep traffic flowing before the cursed highway bankrupts you.

4815860.title: ReactFuse: Stolen Minds - Tech Demo
4815860.short_description: Originally developed to push the limits of a custom FPS engine, This is a playable technology showcase demonstrating real-time simulation of thousands of NPCs, a projectile-based ballistic system, and a dynamic sound system.

4137110.title: Secrets in Stone Demo
4137110.short_description: First-person digital escape room set in a fantasy environment for you and up to three of your friends. Explore fantastical items, setups, and puzzles as you dive deeper into the dungeon and claim your rightful inheritance.

4776430.title: Geometrical Demo
4776430.short_description: Geometrical is an addictive hybrid of a survivors-like and an incremental endless progression. Face waves of enemies, improve your stats after each round, and get ready to battle a final boss every 7 days. Will you be able to defeat the 5 great bosses?

4838210.title: Cozy Pages: Find & Color Demo
4838210.short_description: A cozy hidden object game inspired by coloring books and “Where’s Wally?” Find adorable objects from simple clues, and watch each discovery bring the page to life with color.

4230070.title: Boli Demo
4230070.short_description: Boli is a retro-style JRPG with hand-drawn ASCII art. Venture forth into the wilderness to find a cure for a rare disease that is decimating your village.

4776050.title: Endless War Demo
4776050.short_description: Endless War —— 一款快节奏的俯视角射击游戏，在这里，战术与反应力才是生存的关键。 闪避密集的子弹，利用掩体，智胜敌人，在残酷的二战战场中不惜一切代价活下去。

4693210.title: Hyper Glee Semik
4693210.short_description: Hyper Glee Semik is a first-person shooter where you play as Glee, a teenage girl who has to survive a horde of candies. Keep the pace, and shoot them all!

4785430.title: 一意孤行 the bloods way Demo
4785430.short_description: 改编自中国的古老传说的短篇剧情向2D横板动作游戏。一切都从一场梦开始，似乎有人操纵，又或许是，宿命？

4483660.title: WitchOver Demo
4483660.short_description: 12:00 AM – 6:00 AM. Your job is to manage the “witches.” As the caretaker of a quarantine facility, monitor the witches who possess dangerous powers and resolve any anomalies that occur within the facility.

4833160.title: Shadey's Quest Demo
4833160.short_description: Shadey’s Quest is an autobattler roguelike featuring character building. Shadey is a cute monster who wants to be a hero, but the only thing he is good at is eating. Guide him through the enchanting fantasy world, feed and equip him and help him defeat the fearsome King of Shadows!

4805470.title: Lizard Simulator Demo
4805470.short_description: Try the free demo. You're a lizard, the town's having a normal day, and you are about to fix that. Tongue-grab people, climb buildings, go ragdoll off a roof. No goal. No rules. Just chaos. This is a slice — the full game has more to ruin.

4160880.title: Ember Seeker
4160880.short_description: An atmospheric exploration game set in a Dark Fantasy world. Explore the ruins of an ancient civilisation and uncover it's forgotten past through a short nonlinear story with timeless retro graphics.

4659370.title: The Last Elf
4659370.short_description: A dark-fantasy action RPG where the last Elven blade rides to save the Kingdom of Men. Explore for hidden gold, buy weapons, and level up by slaying demonic monsters in stamina-based combat - then face a golem, dragon, and Demon Lord across 4 chapters.

4536080.title: BanPick
4536080.short_description: This is a ban-pick and turn-based draft strategy game. Find your own strategic picks to raise your team's score and ban troublesome counter picks. Plan your mastery according to your build and perfect skill combos to increase your score or weaken your opponent to win

4563060.title: LUBA Demo
4563060.short_description: LUBA is a walking simulator with platforming elements. Explore a mysterious place and find your way using light and shadow.

4674040.title: Eternal Exorcism
4674040.short_description: Build your deck. Choose your faction. Destroy everything that stands in your way. Eternal Exorcism is a dark fantasy card battle game where every decision could be your last.

4779450.title: 仙武除魔录：幸存 Demo
4779450.short_description: 《仙武除魔录：幸存》是一款像素风格的Roguelite游戏，在类型存者的经典架构上，融合卡牌的技能组合、数值爆炸，每次通过对数十种功法的选修与构建、对体内星斗图的构筑填充，不断升级变强，以面对更强大困难的挑战。 选择你的仙修或武修江湖角色，降妖除魔，拯救天下苍生！

4784460.title: H.I.M. - Hobo’s Infernal Mayhem Demo
4784460.short_description: H.I.M. - Hobo's Infernal Mayhem is a single-player, high-octane top-down twin stick arena shooter in neon-soaked near-future Italy. Make a pact with the Devil, stack risky Pact Boons, and shred the Syndicate's armies to get your stolen white cat back.

4794390.title: Asteroid Cruncher Demo
4794390.short_description: Smash asteroids. Collect ore. Fight enemies. Buy upgrades. Come back stronger!

4727060.title: Street Workout Challenge
4727060.short_description: Arcade Fitness. Highscores. Trophies. Can you beat the Street Workout Challenge? Master 8 street workout exercises, chase highscores, unlock trophies, and prove your skills in fast arcade-style fitness challenges and compete against other Steam players on the leaderboard.

4811040.title: Caved In Demo
4811040.short_description: Caved In is a co-op action puzzle game for 2-8 players. Play online or local as you try to find your way out of the cave!

4093630.title: Crime Shadows : Stolen Spotlight Collector's Edition
4093630.short_description: Uncover a chilling mystery in this Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure. Search eerie scenes, solve puzzles, and survive a deadly movie come to life.

4782000.title: Glamour Photographer Demo
4782000.short_description: Fulfill your dream of becoming a glamour photographer, meet beautiful women from different cultures and backgrounds, and maybe even marry one of them!

3267640.title: Daimyo Reign Demo
3267640.short_description: Unify Medieval Japan in this real-time tactical grand strategy game. Build your domain, recruit armies, plan your attack, and fracture your enemies with rebellions to win!

4752080.title: Manifest Moonfall 月球坠落 Demo
4752080.short_description: 《月球坠落》是一款融合宇宙恐怖与赛博朋克美学的 Roguelike 卡牌构筑游戏。管理情绪值，在横卷探索与策略战斗之间做出抉择，突破永恒的时间循环。

4787800.title: Turnflower Demo
4787800.short_description: Turnflower is a survivors-like where a small Flower becomes the last line of defense against swarms of insects! With just ONE button, spin and shoot through this intense and adorably chaotic challenge.

4777870.title: Fellwood Demo
4777870.short_description: Build a wild fantasy lumber empire that bombards a forest across the valley with axes, ballistas, cannons, and magic. Harvest flying logs, stack absurd upgrades, and automate your way to unstoppable woodcutting power.

4585460.title: Killer Aces Volleyball Demo
4585460.short_description: The ultimate 6v6 indoor volleyball game! Build a powerhouse from the ground up to challenge the greatest teams in the world!

4783950.title: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind! Demo
4783950.short_description: A light-hearted lesbian romance between a tired office lady and a gyaru foxgirl. Make choices as Sasami and pursue a relationship with the cheerful Mirai, or risk ruining it.

4833190.title: Cakey & Tanaka : CandyLand Adventure Demo
4833190.short_description: Protect the world’s sweetest cupcake! Cakey & Tanaka is a 3D roguelite shooter where you lead a fated duo. If either falls, it’s Game Over! Combine unique spells and unleash Rapid Fire to blast through candy monsters and survive the perils of CandyLand in this high-stakes, sweet adventure.

4739990.title: IronWood Demo
4739990.short_description: IronWood is a First Person Shooter that takes inspiration from many of the older games that first popularized the genre, like Blood, Quake, and Unreal. Travel across a variety of levels, find powerful weapons and artifacts, and use them to your advantage against the enemies prevalent in each area.

4780530.title: Method Of Entry Technical Test
4780530.short_description: Method of Entry redefines the 5v5 slow-paced tactical shooter. This is the golden age of first-person shooters, reborn with a modern aesthetic. Expect classic strategy and combat echoing past iconic titles from the genre across dynamic and realistic environments.

4690460.title: Bet On It - The Demo!
4690460.short_description: Step up to the table for a high-stakes game of intense survival where every pull of the trigger could be your last. Wager your life for chips against friends or AI, and unlock rare loot. Will you walk away wealthy, or lose it all?

4835470.title: Resort Simulator Demo
4835470.short_description: Run and manage a seaside resort! Take care of guests and handle daily operations. Grow your resort step by step, create the perfect vacation atmosphere, and enjoy a calming simulation experience.

4789310.title: Everything Mart Demo
4789310.short_description: Clock in, meet your productivity quota, and survive your shift. Divy up tasks with your coworkers... or at least make sure they are being useful as bait.

4799520.title: Volley Guns Demo
4799520.short_description: Welcome to Block City! Bump, Set, and Spike your way to the top in bombastic Volley Guns matches with up to 4 players.

4836230.title: AM I OK? Demo
4836230.short_description: An FPS horror game inspired by Exit 8. Discover anomalies occurring in confined spaces and report them to the auditors.

4788920.title: Pillar Of War Demo
4788920.short_description: 一款快节奏的实时策略游戏，灵感来自国际象棋，单位遵循经典移动规则，但拥有生命值、基于冷却的攻击和强大的柱子能力，比赛通常持续1-2分钟,

4810190.title: Totally Rigged Demo
4810190.short_description: A Totally Rigged incremental game about mining to the center of the earth. Upgrade your drill, hire workers, and collect rare minerals until your fuel depletes.

4739810.title: Don’t Pull Me! Demo
4739810.short_description: 《Don't Pull Me》是一款基于物理的1到4人合作跑酷游戏。你和朋友们会被一根绳子绑在一起，需要一起攀爬、摆荡、搬运物品，并在混乱的布娃娃物理灾难中活下来，同时还不能把整个队伍拖垮。

4789740.title: Fractal Flyers Demo
4789740.short_description: Fractal Flyers let's you fly through Real-Time 3D fractals using FPV drone controls (or traditional winged controls) — Lose yourself in the music across multiple hand-animated challenge levels and soar through the leader-boards.

4625030.title: Ultraquarium Demo
4625030.short_description: ULTRAQUARIUM is a casual aquarium sim that lets you create your own fish and decorations. Purchase fish, satisfy their needs and they shall repay you in kind. Want two Gregs? You can't have two Gregs.

4285630.title: 太吾异世劫 Demo
4285630.short_description: 《太吾异世劫》故事是基于《太吾绘卷》世界观衍生的平行 if 线：太吾未至，伏虞剑惜败于相枢，天地崩入黑暗。在此危局中，玩家将化身不同门派的幸存者，在剑灵焕心的指引下，与挚友拔剑同袍，共赴极境，集十柄神剑以挽天倾。诸位侠士，让我们风雨同舟，共破魔劫！

4816890.title: 三国志BOND Demo
4816890.short_description: 「集结群雄，以智略决胜天下！」 混乱战局，谁能推演“最优解”？唯有你的智略！ 从随机百余名武将中组建最强阵容，洞悉战局，决胜沙场。 短期决战的卡牌构筑型肉鸽军势大战，等你挑战。 【Steam 新品节】试玩版现已上线！ 在挑战正式版的残酷战场之前，先在试玩版中检验自己的极限吧！

3761910.title: 鬼打墙-完整版
3761910.short_description: 基于中国千年民俗传说“鬼打墙”，以沉浸式解密+生存恐怖为核心玩法，融合国风美学与前沿MetaHuman技术，带你穿越诡异森林，破解千年诅咒。

4689470.title: Cloud Sculptor Demo
4689470.short_description: Sculpt your way through puzzles and platforming using a frog, a laser beam, and other classic sculpting tools!

4687520.title: 侦探R和预言者J Demo
4687520.short_description: 收集证据，与多方周旋，揭开真相。 过去与现在交错的案件，沟通型的悬疑冒险游戏。

4839120.title: Deep in The Mine Demo
4839120.short_description: In a fantastic universe, form a group of up to 5 dwarves. Choose a class then set off on an adventure in mines. Be careful, one of you will have become a monster, born to hunt you. Your goal is to extract materials there. Survive by working as a team but also using many gameplay features

4786850.title: Agaric Demo
4786850.short_description: Agaric is a 2D action-adventure game, about a sole mushroom set on an quest to resolve an imminent problem.

4692470.title: 嘿，牛马！ Demo
4692470.short_description: 这是一款反乌托邦黑色幽默节奏游戏。 你扮演小马，一名初入牧原集团的“牛马”员工。脖子上戴着“幸福项圈”，头顶是电子牧长永恒的微笑，面前是灰绿色的营养糊。 你没有选择。你只能——跟着节拍，活下去。

4574840.title: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur Demo
4574840.short_description: Experience the first 2 days of Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur. Wake up, prepare for work, and watch an ordinary life turn into a disturbing nightmare filled with strange events, impossible spaces, and the first signs of Sahur.

4429810.title: The Magical Orb Demo
4429810.short_description: 一款俯视角动作角色扮演游戏，拥有瞬间传送和快节奏的战斗。跨越维度挑战敌人，解锁独特技能，打造你的魔法角色，征服终极宝珠！

4759150.title: 彼方的她-Aliya2 曙光 Demo
4759150.short_description: 这是一次跨越时间的真实通讯，联系上一个名为Aliya的少女，接触到一千年后的各式各样的人。在现实时间同步的冒险中，你将协助Aliya从庭院逃离，并与众人一起发现巨型公司背后的秘密……

4733680.title: ZENONIA Demo
4733680.short_description: 各位，还记得吗？ 曾在2000年代风靡全球的浪漫RPG——《泽诺尼亚》重磅回归！ 从掌上开启的冒险，那些通宵成长的记忆，现在就在Steam平台再次重温。

4770950.title: 元素奇兵：英雄集结令 试玩版
4770950.short_description: 这是一款策略放置游戏！拥有大量各具特色的英雄，4大元素阵营，12个转职职业，可构筑成百上千种不同流派，例如：脆皮爆伤流或灼烧/中毒流。如果装备、转职、奥术、符文、遗物、灵兽等策略方向不同，构筑的队伍也会有较大差异；除了挑战主线章节，还有荣耀之战、魔潮入侵等多重玩法，让你专注于有趣的战术决策及队伍构筑！

4781360.title: Cycho Demo
4781360.short_description: 在这款混乱的 6 人在线骰子对抗棋盘游戏中，相互背刺吧！ 在《Cycho》的世界里，你需要操纵动态经济、打造你的商业帝国，运用角色的独特技能，成为最后存活下来的团队。 在这里，没有永远的友谊。

4800000.title: Vatan Demo
4800000.short_description: Vatan is a narrative-focused historical drama set in Sivas in 1892. In young Ahmet's life, caught between family, love, and homeland, every decision you make changes relationships, atmosphere, and the path to the finale; every scene carries an emotional cost

4412350.title: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters Demo
4412350.short_description: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

4667600.title: Don't Knife Me! Demo
4667600.short_description: 飞刀大师是一个欢乐的飞刀游戏.玩家使用飞刀击中目标.在你通关之后你一定会哈哈哈地笑出来

4711370.title: 月之冕 Demo
4711370.short_description: 《月之冕》美术全面焕新登场！全面重构的场景美术及地图生态等待提灯者探索！从古老神殿中睁开双眸，开始这场冒险吧！在暗黑风格的箱庭世界中进行RPG冒险，并通过卡牌构筑解锁超过40种职业。 探索神秘的莱恩哈特公国，收集神秘卡牌，构建多样组合，做出命运抉择，在这片王权与教廷暗斗，神恩与诅咒共存的土地上寻找失落的真相和救赎。

4641950.title: 妹控计划 Demo
4641950.short_description: 你的妹妹「诗萌」，不想仅仅只是与你在一个游戏里经历一段不虚此行的时光，她想和你一起度过更加漫长的人生。但你们所处的世界隔着屏幕彼此相连，为了实现陪伴在哥哥你身边的目标，你的妹妹诗萌启动了「妹控计划」。

4745190.title: 病娇病毒 试玩版
4745190.short_description: 最多支持4人一起游玩的在线合作恐怖游戏。 无论是单人还是与同伴一起，收集“柏拉图南瓜”，拯救感染了恐怖病娇病毒的珍贵朋友吧。

4325840.title: 塔防山贼模拟器 Demo
4325840.short_description: 这是一款"塔防战斗+山门经营+放置挂机"的游戏。从无到有，建立一座土匪山寨。以塔防(TowerDefense)为核心模式。拦路抢劫、狩猎妖兽、探索地图，招募华夏名将！职业、装备、修炼境界，培养强力角色！研究、建造、锻造、炼丹、种田、采集等技艺，不断发展山寨，最终攻伐城池，占领天下！让"上头爽快"与"简单轻松"并存！

4677160.title: A Mountain Called Hope Demo
4677160.short_description: Explore a hauntingly abandoned late 1800s mountain coal mining town afflicted by a violent winter storm.

4667590.title: Bouncy Ball Demo
4667590.short_description: Your goal: hit the red button with the ball! Each click teleports the ball across the screen, jumping between all four corners. Time your clicks, control the movement, and land every shot.

4584770.title: 象棋三国志 Demo
4584770.short_description: 汉室衰微，群雄并起。诸侯拥兵割据，豪杰逐鹿中原，昔日天下早已如残棋崩散，再无定局。 江山为局，众生为子。你将亲身踏入这片烽烟四起的三国乱世，统率麾下兵团，于刀兵交错之间排兵布阵，在风云变幻之中运筹落子，以铁血杀伐撕裂敌阵，于群雄环伺之下夺城、破局、争天下！

4816310.title: PetrolHeads Demo
4816310.short_description: 从零开始打造你的梦想车库！ 凭借深度改装选项，自定义从举升机到引擎的一切物件。设计独一无二的宽体猛兽，主宰漂移对决或赛道日，并在全球车友聚会中大秀风格。你的车库，你的规则，你的赛车传奇在此启航！

4833690.title: Hacker Cats Demo
4833690.short_description: Hacker Cats is an idler game about hacking and cats. Hack servers, download data, sell it on the dark net and buy new upgrades for hacking.

4623040.title: Rext Demo
4623040.short_description: Rext is a turn-based strategy and exploration game where you learn how the world you've been dropped into works as you move through it, slowly grasping the more intricate details of the world and how it functions.

4089110.title: Seal of Shadows
4089110.short_description: Shatter the darkness in this 3-player co-op ARPG. Master 3 unique classes, loot epic gear, and battle through a 20+ hour hand-crafted campaign. Inspired by classics like Shadows of Mystara—grab a controller and forge your legend in Banesmeire today!

4736620.title: 亡愛之夢
4736620.short_description: Search for the truth within a fantastical dream. Play as a world-weary office worker drawn into a beautiful illusion. Is it a heavenly gift, or poison wrapped in sugar? Begin your adventure, uncover its secrets, and find your answer.

4816960.title: Sovereign Hand : The Last Enclave Demo
4816960.short_description: Build and defend your fantasy city in a strategic roguelike deckbuilding experience. Manage resources, upgrade your enclave, and choose your cards wisely to survive the encroaching darkness. Every decision shapes the fate of your sovereignty in Sovereign Hand: The Last Enclave.

4801290.title: 绝色侦探:爱丽丝 Demo
4801290.short_description: 艾青公寓发生了一起命案,1802号公寓女主人离奇死亡,没有任何挣扎,没有打斗痕迹.为何会在深夜死亡,为何男主人不在家中.一切的谜题等待着侦探:爱丽丝破解.真相只有一个,找到最终的真相吧!

4562420.title: KimuNote Demo
4562420.short_description: 在一个地方组织您的项目和生活所需的一切。

4816330.title: Hostile Takeover, Inc. Demo
4816330.short_description: Fight as the CEO, hire employees, and build offices to survive waves of disgruntled enemies in a top-down action tower defense about corporate "leadership" at its most predatory — and least competent. Maximize shareholder value, then fend off the hostile takeover before the board forces you out.

4785520.title: Before the Tee Demo
4785520.short_description: Before the Tee is a top-down golf course management sim. You run the links, not the round. Design the course, set tee times, manage the cart fleet, drive the maintenance cart around to fix issues, and watch groups arrive to play their way through a full day from sunrise to sunset.

3828610.title: 末日降临！被美女们关进避难所!?
3828610.short_description: 在失去意识后醒来，你发现自己身处五位美女的避难所。 与废墟世界格格不入的她们，却因强大的力量与若隐若现的“尾巴线索”，让你逐渐陷入怀疑之中。 是捕猎？信任？还是相爱——最终的选择，在你手中。

4841340.title: The Confined: Basement Demo
4841340.short_description: 在阴暗地下室中苏醒，成为失去记忆的受害者。你能否通过搜集绑架者留下的神秘便签，揭开真实身份并解开过去之谜？直面残酷真相，找到从这场噩梦中死里逃生的出路。

4772490.title: Betrot Demo
4772490.short_description: A dark roguelike where you bet everything on a cursed roulette. Drink, smoke, break the rules, build insane synergies, meet brutal quotas — and survive the spin. Did I mention you smoke?

4824840.title: rook Demo
4824840.short_description: rook is a chess deckbuilding roguelike. cover your board in stickers and stack spare tiles to supercharge the cascading chaos and watch your scores go exponential, maybe then you might just survive the gauntlet.

4770500.title: 失序之地 Demo
4770500.short_description: 《失序之地》是一款垂直生态开放世界沙盒MMO。您将作为冒险者来到魔法与造物交织的世界“艾顿大陆”，书写自己的传奇。 忘掉墨守成规的主线吧！这里打破一切既定，冒险由您自己定义。您可以穿行尘世，见证五大文明围绕“天石”的角力，也可以进入深渊，在法外之地谋求一夜暴富。

4811990.title: Studio Sim Demo
4811990.short_description: Build a film and television empire in a living entertainment industry beginning in the 1980s. Create and manage productions, cast unique talent, outmaneuver rival studios, climb the box office and grab television ratings in this immersive, old-school tycoon sim.

4796630.title: Civica: Italian Renaissance Demo
4796630.short_description: 在这款真实的中世纪即时战略游戏中，建立你的意大利帝国。游戏融合了真正有机发展的城市建设与沉浸式角色扮演：城邦们争夺影响力，美第奇家族等权贵家族暗中分衅，艺术家们则创作定义整个时代的杰作。

4791700.title: DarkNet99 Demo
4791700.short_description: An incremental game about selling drugs on the dark web in the 90's. Secure supply lines, stockpile products and scale your marketplace to make a fortune and build an empire.

4800830.title: Khaldun: Text Based Strategy Demo
4800830.short_description: Khaldun is a medieval-themed ASCII graphics kingdom management game. Take part in realistic war simulations and decide every detail of your kingdom, from its economy to its demographics! Your decisions will shape the life of a nation. Rise or be lost to history...

4686760.title: Vivid Intrusion Demo
4686760.short_description: Survive as long as you can in this retro-styled movement shooter roguelike. Imbue your weapon with unique effects as you fight against a never-ending onslaught of enemies

1416380.title: Luna's Adventure: The Overlord
1416380.short_description: 一个特殊的朋友来营救。从一开始就可以访问的最终老板。要探索世界，直到您可以击败他。在这部3D和实时战斗的奇幻冒险RPG中，冒着生命危险拯救对您最重要的人。

4806020.title: Cloudpaws Demo
4806020.short_description: CloudPaws 是一款温馨的空中贸易冒险游戏，你将驾驶飞艇，进行交易、种植、钓鱼，并探索漂浮的岛屿，同时帮助当地居民并揭开他们的秘密 ✨

4827840.title: 限界集落 Demo
4827840.short_description: Rebuild a collapsed remote village in this crafting–farming–settlement game. Gather resources, cook, manage fields, survive raids, and run a small stall to restore the community.

4824580.title: Deep Space Miner Demo
4824580.short_description: An incremental mining game where you scale your power until the screen explodes! Hit quotas to unlock new planets and tools with custom passives. Deploy helper bots, invest in a massive skill tree, and unleash chaotic procs.

4793400.title: Fatal Train Demo
4793400.short_description: Murder on the train? It doesn't matter, it's no longer our concern! Ladies and gentlemen, don't worry, we have four detectives who can handle this! After all, there's nothing complicated about murder investigations, right?

4299160.title: Atomic Synthesis
4299160.short_description: A game about collecting, upgrading, and discovery, using the periodic table as a basis. Start with gathering Hydrogen and use the Atomic Synthesizer's automatic conversion system to generate energy and use it to stabilize the machine back to working at a 100% efficiency.

4634800.title: Ultravibe Demo
4634800.short_description: Ultravibe is a match3 roguelike where you build powerful synergies through vibes, powerups, and upgrades. Face tricky bosses, use unique powerups, perform special combos and craft unique builds in a unique, endlessly replayable fun loop.

4817320.title: Economy Bros Demo
4817320.short_description: Build your dream city from scratch in this sandbox tycoon: start by working or gathering resources, trade businesses and real estate based on market demand, expand your land, and grow your empire—all while surviving and stacking up cold hard cash from your strategic moves.

4809840.title: Chicken Escape Demo
4809840.short_description: 一起合作，互相帮助（或者不小心把队友推下去），努力找到逃离农场的方法。每一步都可能变成一场大混乱！

4831990.title: Abandon West Demo
4831990.short_description: A hand-drawn tactical roguelike where every encounter is a gamble. Trust or shoot.

4811070.title: Prehistoric Adventure Demo
4811070.short_description: DEMO This is a DEMO of the game. As such, only a small subset of the functionality of the full game is available.

4747110.title: Not A Customer
4747110.short_description: Good job! you just got hired at your local grocery store and have to serve customer, it's simple as it sounds but theres a twist, make sure you serve real humans and not dopplegangers or it might be your last shift...

4813320.title: The Maze Demo
4813320.short_description: Escape an ever-shifting procedural labyrinth. Loot legendary armor, overcome challenges in crafting zones, and survive deadly traps in this fantasy Roguelite. With progressive difficulty and unique enemies, can you find the exit before the Ghost finds you?

4236490.title: Trauma Pets
4236490.short_description: Trauma Pets is a videogame about managing a newly found race of violent critters however you'd like. Don't let moral qualms distract you from becoming the very best, like no one ever was.

4736100.title: Sibir Demo
4736100.short_description: Sibir is an intense survival exploration game set in the unforgiving depths of an abandoned Soviet bunker. Every step you take could be your last.

4801760.title: Crownbreak Demo
4801760.short_description: Build your army, conquer castles, and dominate tactical battles. Earn gold, upgrade your gear, and defeat powerful elemental bosses.

3898970.title: Better Minesweeper
3898970.short_description: A modern take on classic Minesweeper, focused on quality-of-life improvements, flexibility, and customization.

4539610.title: Luvu: Your Desktop Pet Demo
4539610.short_description: An interactive digital pet that lives on your desktop. It watches, reacts, and keeps you company. No scores, no pressure. A calm, playful experience that turns your screen into a more alive and personal space.

3991220.title: Kill Code Demo
3991220.short_description: 在被战争撕裂的世界中猎杀人类最后的残余。掌握残暴的近战武器，释放强大的遗物，并将你的致命机器人伙伴 ORB 改造成终极毁灭武器。

4798580.title: Oil Island Hustle Demo
4798580.short_description: An Empty Island, Full of Oil, and you're ON IT! Build your Oil Empire and Dominate the World Market! Create oil factories, produce oil barrels and sell them to different countries and earn Lots of Money! Hire workers to automate and remember to pay your 1 million loan to your co-worker

4774270.title: RE_ALLOC
4774270.short_description: 掌控机器。在 RE_ALLOC 中，你是执行的架构师。设计复杂的硬件电路，编写自定义的汇编代码，并优化内存节点间的数据流。效率是你唯一的指标。你能触及内核吗，还是你的逻辑会崩溃？

4815710.title: Rough Draft Demo
4815710.short_description: Try the timed typing roguelite — free. Words flood the screen, type them down before the countdown hits zero. Chain combos, earn coins, and taste the upgrade grind. Your fingers vs. the clock. Wishlist the full game if you make it past the rough draft.

4036520.title: Vertigo Rush Demo
4036520.short_description: Vertigo Rush is a virtual reality racing experience that combines speed and parkour in an intense physical challenge. Players control agile robots, propelling them through vast, detailed environments by moving their own arms in a heart-pumping race.

4633950.title: Lassen's Loop Demo
4633950.short_description: 在这个温馨怀旧的录音室里，用8秒音频卡片创作歌曲。无需任何乐理知识。每首作品都归你所有，永久保存！Y2K风格的音频可视化效果、每周挑战、3,500多张音频卡片。致敬作曲家贾斯汀·拉森。

4799880.title: The Black Shift Demo
4799880.short_description: In this AI-powered thriller, your phone is the gateway to a dark past. As a mine chief, you receive messages from a mysterious stranger demanding you put your workers in danger in exchange for uncovering forgotten historical secrets. Who will pay the price for the truth?

4781100.title: Candles Aren't Eternal Demo
4781100.short_description: Candles aren't eternal, and you need to light them up again to find lost objects in this casual, single player adventure rpg. Get missions, make candles, go on adventure! Those old dark dungeons and caves are waiting you.

4344190.title: Sushi Sewers Demo
4344190.short_description: A fast-paced cyberpunk bullet-heaven where neon chaos, dark power, and endless enemy swarms collide. Survive the waves, create the strongest builds, and become unstoppable.

4717670.title: Don’t Trust Demo
4717670.short_description: DEMO BUILD ! This is an early access version and does not represent the final product. Content, gameplay, balance, and performance are subject to change based on player feedback.

4829550.title: Circus Survival Demo
4829550.short_description: Kidnapped and forced into a deadly game show, survive a brutal obstacle course filled with swinging traps, snipers, mines and precision jumps. Reach the end of Circus Survival and win $1,000,000… or become part of the show.

4433200.title: Sweet Boom Demo
4433200.short_description: 一款明亮的卡通派对街机游戏，包含疯狂战斗、团队模式、陷阱以及不同时代风格的地图。和朋友在线开战，成为 Sweet Boom 的赢家！

4815740.title: Project Sakura Demo
4815740.short_description: An unknown outbreak has erased people’s good emotions, turning them into hate-filled Kagebito who can still use their intelligence. Asumi, journeys through a world in chaos to save her friend Yuna.

4710220.title: Turbo Loop Demo
4710220.short_description: Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game focused on simple, fun gameplay - easy to learn, but hard to master. Challenge AI opponents or race a friend in head-to-head matches, unlock and customize cars, compete across dozens of tournament tracks, or create your own with the track editor!

4814860.title: KOROD Demo
4814860.short_description: Breathing his last on a bloody battlefield, Kor awakens in the underworld of Tamag. In this ruthless Action-RPG born from Turkic mythology, wield abilities that evolve with your playstyle and carve through endless dungeons! Death is only the beginning.

4590650.title: Leap Frog Demo
4590650.short_description: A lone frog, flushed from its home in the laboratory atop the mountain must make its way home! Climb your way out of the sewer, and up perilous heights to reunite with your friends and family at the peak! Meet new friends along the way, solve mysteries and unlock your full potential!

4806490.title: Boil Cabbage Make Soup Demo
4806490.short_description: A cosy idler starring an Onion who makes soup anywhere on your desktop! Watch him grow and harvest cabbages to make delicious soup for a cast of colourful customers. Decorate your island and customise your Onion with your hard-earned gold to level him up, and build your very own soup making empire!

3223170.title: ChessRPG
3223170.short_description: ChessRPG is a revisited chess game in pixel art. Each player chooses a medieval fantasy people, gaining access to pieces with various characteristics that turn every match into a fresh tactical battle.

3983220.title: Rick Henderson: Eternal Arena Demo
3983220.short_description: Rick Henderson is back! Join the endless arena battle, upgrade your ship, upgrade your guns, upgrade your drones. Fight, upgrade, die, repeat.

4781580.title: Vision Quench Demo
4781580.short_description: 这是一款暗黑奇幻风在线合作刷宝射击游戏，带你深入某消费品巨头那庞大地下城的幽秘腹地，直面一系列远古的宿敌与当代的噩梦。你能否笑到最后，登上巅峰？

4838430.title: Rutrum Demo
4838430.short_description: Rutrum is a physics roguelike about dropping gems, popping rocks, and unlocking chests. Build a deck of gems, inscribe them with runes, merge them together to cause damage, touch them to acquire loot from enemies. DROP, POP, UNLOCK!

4805640.title: Star Trek: Warp Demo
4805640.short_description: Command the lanes. Control the outcome. Unlock iconic characters, starships, and locations as you play to complete objectives and earn legendary cards worthy of any captain's deck.

4750640.title: DODECIUM Demo
4750640.short_description: Solo Indie delivers a local 1-4 player split-screen physics-based create and combat sandbox with scientific tools for PvP or PvE. Replay dozens of unique campaigns. Master your hex build strategy, microscopes, and chemistry skills. Be clever to achieve victory and learn as you go. June NEXT FEST.

4791300.title: XenoFeels Demo
4791300.short_description: A space customs simulator. Every day, spaceships from different galaxies fly past your tiny asteroid. Tourists, truckers, travelers... Bad news: There are terrorists among them. If you miss even one, your home planet will explode. Good news: You carry a shotgun!

4826590.title: You're Alive, Phil Demo
4826590.short_description: Get a taster of the full game. Help Phil work out what it means to be alive. Guide our rocky friend through 100 levels of relaxing, grid-based puzzle platforming, accompanied by atmospheric music and narration.

4776950.title: Pizza House Simulator🍕 Demo
4776950.short_description: 烹制正宗披萨、管理厨房、招待性急的顾客，初次品尝《Pizza House Simulator》的滋味。正式版将拓展至合作模式、自动化、自定义、灾难、经济系统以及餐厅帝国的打造。

4802590.title: Symbols Demo
4802590.short_description: Every clue tells a different story. Investigate intriguing cases, uncover hidden details, and piece together the mystery step by step — alone or with someone who sees what you can’t. Each player uncovers different clues, so follow every lead until the truth reveals itself.

4705240.title: Dragons Die Demo
4705240.short_description: Permadeath strategy about a flight of named dragons, a small dragon named Peggs who minds the eggs, and the long table that remembers everyone who didn't come home. Every dragon falls. Their names stay carved. Their bones arm the next flight. Hunt the reach. Carry them home.

4716360.title: Black Plague: Survival Demo
4716360.short_description: Experience the brutal start of Black Plague: Survival in this single-player demo. Explore the infected Oakshade Village, scavenge for resources, and master the power of "Devil's Mushrooms" to fight the undead.

4817260.title: Sacred Angel Crossnia Heart Demo
4817260.short_description: 在这款融合RPG要素的冒险游戏中，少年拔司意外转生为女英雄克洛斯妮亚之心。赶紧变身对抗德斯帕科伊亚这个邪恶组织吧，吸收他们的力量来强化自己的战衣，保护这座城市免遭罪恶侵扰吧！

4811150.title: Cheat Line: Checkpoint Demo
4811150.short_description: An app exposed everyone’s cheating history—and society collapsed. In Cheat Line: Checkpoint, guard the last safe city with friends in co-op multiplayer. Inspect survivors together, detect lies, expose killers, decide who enters, and uncover the mystery behind the app that caused the chaos.

4809440.title: Bee Space Demo
4809440.short_description: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!

4500120.title: Colosseum Demo
4500120.short_description: In this Fast Arena FPS, you play as a prisonner in hell, forced to battle for eternity to please the crowds of the Colosseum ! Wave after wave of enemies, you battle ancient warriors to the rythm of their songs.

4799170.title: Four Lights Demo
4799170.short_description: This is a grand tale of revenge - waged by God and Us against Lucifer.

4402020.title: EMPULSE Demo
4402020.short_description: EMPULSE 是一款即将上线的高速6v6移动射击游戏。跑墙、钩爪、Holojump、驾驶机甲、用 P.A.I.N.T. 征服 Freehold 的垂直街道。比对手跑得更快，否则只能被打倒。

4744250.title: Online: 404 Demo
4744250.short_description: 开放世界生存模拟器，即使是经验丰富的老玩家也必须重新思考他们惯常的生存方式，以及如何与周围的世界互动。你可以单人游玩或与朋友一起，跟随剧情或自由探索——只是别忘了你最重要的装备。

4566720.title: Pumpkin Survivor Demo
4566720.short_description: 一款单人独立开发的游戏肉鸽生存游戏，存活二十分钟打败boss学习技能变强，尝试解锁各种武器组合。

4646820.title: 国王的游戏（King'sGame） Demo
4646820.short_description: 国王的游戏（King'sGame）是一款策略Roguelike游戏，玩家需要充分利用手上的资源，招募士兵或英雄，合理排兵布阵，战胜敌人，最终登上藏着神秘宝物的高塔塔顶，揭开国王游戏背后隐藏的真相。

4735730.title: Make Burgers: GRILL UP Demo
4735730.short_description: Embark on a burger-filled adventure with chef Bobby Grill and his bright yellow food truck! Get ready to serve unique burgers not only to regular customers, but also to sweet tooths, robots, zombies, and even aliens!

4680820.title: Night Record: Thin Walls Demo
4680820.short_description: 瓦迪姆是一个破旧后苏联公寓楼的管理员，他离开城市去照顾生病的母亲，把工作交给妻子。当她逐渐适应日常工作时，这栋楼开始变得不对劲 种不正常的寂静。

3772770.title: Cars 'n Guns Demo
3772770.short_description: Burn rubber and pull the trigger! Drift, race, and blast your way through artistic tracks in gorgeous customizable cars. Challenge friends in split-screen or LAN/online multiplayer. Replay recorded races from cinematic angles and playback speeds to create unforgettable videos.

4323610.title: Carbon Compliance Demo
4323610.short_description: A simulation game about experiencing the very mundane job of a government official, rummaging through paperwork. Make sure all the paperwork is free of any errors. Deny applications that are not up to the specified requirements. Bored of working, play mini-games to relieve stress.

4816710.title: Limited Space Demo
4816710.short_description: Frantic 1–4 player co-op space survival. Build defenses, repair your ship, and hold out as endless asteroid waves tear everything apart.

4814010.title: Infinite Crosswalk Demo
4814010.short_description: Infinite Crosswalk is a psychedelic walking simulator and horror game in retro 3D style. You get hit on a zebra crossing and trapped in limbo. Uncover the victims' tragic stories to escape — or pay with parts of your own body.

4796580.title: Billionaire in the Greedy America Demo
4796580.short_description: America, 1850. Fortunes are made and destroyed in a single day. Will you be the predator — or the prey? Trade stocks, crush rivals, seize companies, and claw your way to the top in the most ruthless financial arena of the century.

4697490.title: 只坤：影逝2.5度 Demo
4697490.short_description: 《只坤：影逝2.5度》是一款操控二次元美少女对抗魔性“坤潮”的硬核Roguelite动作游戏。面对中分头、背带裤、篮球满天飞的疯狂攻势，你将凭借“只狼式”完美弹反与华丽处决华丽破敌。丰富的随机局内Buff与深度局外养成，助你解锁超多美少女，杀穿这片玩梗荒诞的世界！

3547410.title: World of Eggs: Idle Adventures Demo
3547410.short_description: 《World of Eggs: Idle Adventures Demo》——尝试一个世界，在这里你可以建立自己的文明，与玩家交易，而这一切都在放置模式下完成。游戏会自动化所有的日常事务！

4711530.title: Moon Fishies Demo
4711530.short_description: Moonfishies is relaxing desktop fish simulator. Customize your dream aquarium, catch new fish and breed unique hybrids!

4343980.title: 守卫魔窟 试玩版
4343980.short_description: 一款简短的增量点击游戏，融合了塔防策略与庞大的升级树深度。建造你自己的蜿蜒迷宫，击退来袭的部落！

4805360.title: LOOK UP AND GO Demo
4805360.short_description: A fast paced, fps, score attack where every run is a risk. Use your points to bet on your own survival or make other players' runs harder. Get combos by stabbing, shooting, and doing tricks. Ascend the tower. Climb the leader board. Play the demo and Wishlist now.

4643670.title: Mosaic Garden: The Flower Game Demo
4643670.short_description: A relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where flowers spread and mutate in real time. Shape their growth, clear space, and transform one pattern into the next on a colorful 10×9 grid.

4581680.title: Rogue Drone Demo
4581680.short_description: A sci-fi mining and base-building game where efficient mining is the key to survival. Gather crystals, expand your colony, upgrade your defenses, and withstand increasingly dangerous nightly attacks.

4750040.title: Gumball Hero Demo
4750040.short_description: 一款快节奏的3D动作Roguelike游戏，你将扮演一个泡泡糖机，射出弹跳的糖果以在敌人浪潮中生存。打造你的装备，并在为时已晚之前收复你的购物中心。

4679680.title: SiN Reloaded Demo
4679680.short_description: SiN: Reloaded is a completely remastered experience of the 1998 shooter. This diamond-in-the-rough, story-driven FPS features memorable characters, horrific enemies, and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits. Now with remastered graphics and overhauled control schemes.

4734900.title: Totally Normal Meat Co. Demo
4734900.short_description: Raise adorable monsters and process them into profit in this dark-humored idle management sim. Designed as a desktop companion, it runs at the bottom of your screen while you work. Optimize your production line, unlock rare species, and automate your way to a morally questionable empire.

4743420.title: ELLA in da room Demo
4743420.short_description: A cozy 2D platformer where a little girl’s imagination turns her room into a magical world. Jump across pillows, race toy cars, and explore nostalgic adventures where every object becomes part of a story.

4755450.title: FleetLord Demo
4755450.short_description: A space RTS about decisions, not menus. Conquer planets, link them to fuel your war machine, and level up your empire with randomized perk cards. Crush all opposition.

4503540.title: 疯狂交易
4503540.short_description: 疯狂交易：一款以市场博弈和风险管理为核心的多人交易对战游戏。你将在 8 人历史行情对局和 7x24 实时交易中穿梭于加密货币、美股、A 股和期货市场，读盘、下单、控仓，争夺收益、排名和长期成长。

4811170.title: Moorhaven: Boat Builder Demo
4811170.short_description: Customise a narrowboat, live aboard, and slow right down. Fish, forage, befriend a floating community and build your dream floating home with - one very needy cat along for the ride. A heartwarming life sim about shaping your perfect floating home and community.

4761820.title: Runerock Arena Demo
4761820.short_description: 在符岩角斗士联盟中缔造你的常胜王朝！在这款融合了 RPG 元素的回合制策略游戏中，招募并用装备和法术武装你的角斗士，率领他们冲锋陷阵。将新兵培养成竞技场传奇，为你那不朽的荣耀伟业培养新的接班人！

4744770.title: Luminous Jigsaw Puzzles Demo
4744770.short_description: Ignite your imagination with breathtaking fantasy jigsaws! Uncover epic myths and rebuild stunning hand-drawn realms piece by piece. Whether you crave a relaxing escape or an immersive story adventure, Luminous Ages transforms every puzzle into a portal of wonder.

4646490.title: 趋光本能 Pygmalion Demo
4646490.short_description: 这是一个恋爱故事。“你”将会探索一栋神秘的公寓，并与性格各异的女孩们交谈、收集线索并建立联系。你的抉择将导向不真实的圆满，或是具有代价的真实。

4816240.title: Divorced Dad Rock Demo
4816240.short_description: Divorced Dad Rock is the unhinged trading card game with tactical depth. Manage volume, summon Bandmates, and weaponize emotional Baggage to reduce your opponent's Ego to zero before you're forced to sell out. Can you keep the band together?

4753320.title: The Rusted Demo
4753320.short_description: 世界如今属于机器。陪伴一只忠诚的机器狗，穿越阴森的末日世界，踏上寻找失散人类家人的旅程。《THE RUSTED》是一款手绘风格的2D动作解谜平台游戏。

4821840.title: Hide and Sink Demo
4821840.short_description: 《Hide and Sink》是一部恐怖短篇故事集，讲述了一系列童年时期发生的种种怪谈故事。 本作《PAPERENTS》是该系列的首个故事。一名瘫痪在床的男孩目睹了父母日渐变得愈发可怕陌生。无法行动并独自困在昏暗的卧室里的他该如何逃离这场最深的噩梦？

4664190.title: The Lucky Hive Demo
4664190.short_description: Play poker with your friends in The Hive! Relax, enjoy yourself, maybe you'll get a royal flush? Who knows what else you might get? Lots to uncover in this simple game of poker...

4744890.title: Save Princess Torosso Demo
4744890.short_description: Save Princess Torosso 是一款奇幻 3D 动作冒险游戏，结合远程魔法战斗、技能卡成长和 3D 平台障碍关卡。无需复杂构筑，专注于直观操作与经典街机式关卡通关。

4822940.title: 桌宠奶茶店：放置大亨 Demo
4822940.short_description: 一款融合了桌宠功能的可爱风奶茶店增量游戏。挂机赚钱，自由摆放，支持中英文切换，让你的桌面不再孤单。

4793010.title: AMEN: The Quiet Exodus Demo
4793010.short_description: 受诅咒的子宫，在心底孕育着虚无。因为孩子带着面纱降临世间，而他的灵魂在无神的苍穹下孤独飘荡。为何灵魂不前往命中注定的归处？ 启示就在这部视觉小说之中。

4802480.title: Wade Demo
4802480.short_description: Wade is a realistic fly fishing simulation with carefully crafted rod and line physics, river currents, and fish fights that demand all your focus to catch and not lose a fish.

4777430.title: Neurorunner Demo
4777430.short_description: Jog in place to move through SteamVR games. NeuroRunner turns your real steps into left-stick locomotion, so you can play, stay sexy, and get fully immersed in the game world.

3772140.title: Beggar's Life
3772140.short_description: 你扮演一个乞丐，在一个闲置增量游戏中乞讨食物。成为一个牧师、一个小偷、一个爱老鼠的人，或者一个虐待狂的纵火狂。但首先，你能施舍一些食物吗？

4769620.title: Isle Of Nexaryth
4769620.short_description: Explore a dangerous fantasy island as a young dragon. Hunt creatures, grow stronger, defeat powerful bosses, and uncover the secrets of Nexaryth.

4826950.title: Coffee Masters! - Multiplayer Cafe Simulator Demo
4826950.short_description: 欢迎来到咖啡香气与混乱交织的地方！你可以独自游玩，也可以与最多 4 名玩家合作。经营属于自己的咖啡馆，和朋友一起扩大业务。接取订单，制作咖啡，服务顾客，并提升收入。

4566360.title: Dead Head Drive
4566360.short_description: Drive for your life in a city keeps you trapped. Dead Head Drive is a short horror arcade taxi racer set in a nightmare city. Streets twist, routes change, and something is always watching. Drive through shifting routes, chase high scores, and uncover hidden secrets.

4369930.title: Octoportals Demo
4369930.short_description: A roguelike shooter where you're an octopus that shapeshifts mid-fight. Shoot ink, phase through bullets, stop time, swing a giant sword and more! Hunt the keys, close the portals and see how deep you can go!

4806110.title: Arctic Roll Demo
4806110.short_description: Step into a turn-based tactical roguelike adventure in the frozen Canadian Arctic. Lead your team of explorers, survive deadly encounters, uncover mysterious artifacts, and unravel the secret of a strange signal.

4828650.title: GenoCube Demo
4828650.short_description: GenoCube是一款实时动作Roguelite：扫描生物、窃取DNA，并在Run中途进化。构建基于物种的能力，实时适应，并在生态系统反向猎杀中决定撤离或孤注一掷。

4115690.title: Macrolens: The Slimes
4115690.short_description: Macrolens: The Slimes simulates a camera’s perspective observing a slime in a small garden. The yellow slime plays mini-games to collect Earth Energy. With its cute visuals, the game can sit in the corner of your screen and includes a Pomodoro timer to help you relax and work more efficiently.

4801710.title: Afterglow Fortress Demo
4801710.short_description: 一款可爱手绘风 2D 中世纪 RTS 游戏。采集资源、建造基地，在白天发展建设，抵御夜晚怪物的围攻，守护你的领地。

4645720.title: Hemobloom Demo
4645720.short_description: 一款心理恐怖游戏，你将探索一个扭曲的噩梦世界，面对怪诞的怪物，并拼凑出 [血花] 的秘密。

4755810.title: Breeze Of Adventure Demo
4755810.short_description: Explore a sprawling archipelago of islands, each boasting its own unique biome, dangerous foes, and hidden treasures. The demo contains only a small portion of the future game's content: two islands with all their contents.
developers: Mikita Lubtsou, Danila Lubtsou,Aliaksandr Saburau,Raman Smalianchuk.

4593910.title: Last One Breathing Demo
4593910.short_description: Scavenge ruined locations, manage a grid backpack, barter, craft, and keep your shelter standing through the night in a survival adventure where every item you carry can change the run.

4737750.title: Problem Solved Demo
4737750.short_description: “《Problem Solved》，一场你与好友共同化身故事英雄的合作冒险。”你们是每一套方案的缔造者。

4065490.title: The Last Hope: Exodus
4065490.short_description: 在这款紧张刺激的第一人称射击游戏中，使用真实感十足的武器，对抗致命的僵尸，在亡灵末日中努力生存。

4747420.title: Citytrip Treasure Hunt Demo
4747420.short_description: A cozy walking mystery set in the city of Warsaw. Walk the streets, piece together torn map fragments, read a guidebook full of city secrets, scrape together cash like a local, and solve a dead historian's treasure hunt before your hotel reservation runs out.

3822040.title: RouletteCircus
3822040.short_description: 最多4人参加的俄罗斯轮盘致命对决。 你的命运取决于牌和运气。 你有三次机会，空包弹将考验你的勇气。 概率对所有人都是残酷的，而在这里，你只是一个小丑。

4791360.title: Indebted Duke Demo
4791360.short_description: Indebted Duke is a deckbuilding management game where each villager owns unique cards. Generate profit through production chains, and grow stronger cards through promotion, marriage, and inheritance. Overcome battles and random events to rebuild your domain your way.

4828410.title: Folklore Fishing Demo
4828410.short_description: Folklore Fishing is a story driven fishing game that is fully playable without visuals.

4803490.title: 我独自建造升级 Demo
4803490.short_description: 喜欢玩塔防？喜欢玩类幸存者？来玩点不一样的

4625560.title: 寻味记
4625560.short_description: 高棠作为高记茶楼的继承人经历了种种艰辛终于成为了茶楼的一把手，可上天偏偏要和他开个玩笑。现在的他貌似被卷进了混乱的因果空间里，回到了寻得真味前的开端，同时也解放了更多的可能性。接下来需要你来做出的每一个会影响故事走向的决定。共有四种不同的结局，请试试合理搭配选项，看看最后会抵达哪一个结局…… 《寻味记》是一款以广式早茶为主题，轻松治愈向的短篇多结局视觉小说，剧情分支丰富，内含精美CG。愿你在一盅两件的温暖故事里，卸下生活的疲惫，找到属于自己的安宁与治愈。

4345320.title: Harpoon Arena Demo
4345320.short_description: 快节奏的3D团队射击游戏。直接接触受限，用磁爪将敌人拉到你这边并与队友一起消灭他们！精准和冷静的计算将带你走向胜利。小心来自四面八方飞来的鱼叉…

4448110.title: Merry’s Seven Wishes Demo
4448110.short_description: A touching visual novel about love, loss, and hope. After Merry’s death, Richard’s world turns gray—until her seven final wishes begin restoring its colors. Through heartfelt storytelling, music, and mini-games, every fulfilled wish paints life in new shades of meaning.

4485110.title: A MAZE IN UNDERGROUND Demo
4485110.short_description: TOMEA提供的这款迷宫将让您和家人度过一段美好的时光。 在这个充满谜题的无尽迷宫中，您将体验到人生中最欢乐的时刻。

4619540.title: Uprising: Toys for Oppressors Demo
4619540.short_description: As an awakened "toy" with no memory and a newfound purpose, manage an autonomous nightclub to recruit allies, dodge corporate suspicion, and orchestrate a city-wide revolution against the very people who built you.

4748760.title: Crownhold Demo
4748760.short_description: Noble Rulers — grow your realm and expand your castle in this short incremental game! Manage resources, discover foreign lands and build up an army to lay siege to your enemies.

4416560.title: 女仆咖啡厅模拟器 Demo
4416560.short_description: 成为破旧女仆咖啡厅的新经理。与个性十足的兽耳女仆们一起将它从零重建，每位女仆都有自己的秘密与个性。管理食材、接待顾客、扩建店铺，追逐终极梦想：传说中的美雪林三星! 立即试玩Demo,开启你的旅程!

4701140.title: Flame, Forest & Flood Demo
4701140.short_description: A cozy three-player strategy showdown where simple rules meet surprising depth. Easy to learn, endlessly re-playable, and built so everyone can play, and anyone can win.

4550160.title: Happy My Friends Demo
4550160.short_description: Happy My Friends 是一款8人竞技多人游戏。在这里，可爱的角色们盲目地消灭彼此。试玩版（Demo）中为您提供主要的游戏模式。 提升您的排位，解锁全新的角色和武器皮肤。

4785870.title: MINERALS: Deep Core Mining Demo
4785870.short_description: Mine the vast underground and collect ores and gemstones—collect! collect! collect like crazy! “MINERALS: Deep Core Mining” is an over-the-top mining game with roguelite elements. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your abilities and take on an endless underground that changes with every run!

4807770.title: 捉迷藏 - Hide and Seek Demo
4807770.short_description: 长泽小学的一年级女生结奈，和青梅竹马的好朋友真也约好了一起玩捉迷藏。但是，最近他们的身边似乎出现了可疑的人物，街道的氛围也变得紧张了起来。即便如此，今天放学后也要去公园玩捉迷藏哦……

4445980.title: Educational Family Games Demo
4445980.short_description: Try the Steam Next Fest demo of Educational Family Games! Play Candy Land and 30 selected quick games from the full 80-game collection in a 1-4 player local multiplayer family party game, fully voiced in 19 languages.

4569020.title: Star Hero
4569020.short_description: Star Hero is a 2D space arena shooter where every kill counts. Survive against endless waves of enemies, earn points for every destruction, and use them to upgrade your ship’s power. The void grows more dangerous every minute—how long can you hold the line?

4800710.title: The Letter Demo
4800710.short_description: The Letter is a narrative-driven psychological adventure set in a forgotten town. Explore abandoned streets, follow scattered notes and hidden messages, and uncover fragments of a story inspired by real events as you piece together a mystery buried in the past.

4822180.title: Salt and Soul Demo
4822180.short_description: Awaken as a fragile porcelain salt shaker in a colossal, shadowy kitchen. Guided by your grandmother’s spirit, retrieve the key ingredient and master manual cooking mechanics to revive lost recipes. In this atmospheric adventure, every jump is a risk, and every dish tells a story.

4616810.title: Loot Dungeon Demo
4616810.short_description: "Loot Dungeon" is a dark fantasy incremental roguelite ARPG where death is progression. Crawl deadly dungeons, collect loot, pick perks, and die... to get stronger. Go deeper, unlock new characters, upgrades and features. Will you make a deal with Death?

4775400.title: Lucky Break Demo
4775400.short_description: In this roguelike deckbuilder you’re an addict. Deep in debt to the mob, a little drunk, and out of time. Just one more spin, and then you'll quit.

4580620.title: Deskavator Demo
4580620.short_description: The queen calls you to grab a pickaxe and start mining for the hive! Watch as your mining buddy collects ore without invading your working screen space! Collect ore, earn achievements, mine for your hive, and most importantly, relax and enjoy the ride!

4778900.title: Blades of Four
4778900.short_description: A fast-paced fantasy action roguelike where 4 unique heroes battle through dangerous maps, unlock powerful items, and master devastating abilities with swords and bows

4787850.title: Sad Virus Up & Up
4787850.short_description: New part for sad virus game series. now mission go up and up and avoid traps and collect beer bottles

4785050.title: Bonk Market
4785050.short_description: Real Time Stock Trading Simulator with Stock Options! Over 1000 unique Bonks with unique industries and company profiles. Customize your Bean Person and climb to the top of the Leaderboard to make it to The Board! Only the best traders get their Bean Person displayed at The Board's table.

4716710.title: Necromancer Delivery Service Demo
4716710.short_description: A 3D physics-driven action racing game where players take on the role of a struggling necromancer forced into a delivery job in a chaotic city. Deliver packages, collect money and souls as tips, and use chaotic spells.

4798160.title: Retro Pond Demo
4798160.short_description: Design your dream pond, breed fish, discover rare mutations, share them with friends and let them compete in contests.

4724150.title: THE DEEPEST CASTLE Demo
4724150.short_description: You are a mighty knight - how powerful your blows are! And in the very center of a vast forest lies a fortress filled with evil and black magic. There, they raise the dead and hide great artifacts. You decide to explore the fortress and see what the black magicians are hiding.

4829890.title: 食刻 Demo
4829890.short_description: 《食刻》是一款极具挑战性的时间管理与逻辑解谜游戏。游戏核心灵感源自经典的“华罗庚沏茶问题”，你将化身统筹全局的主厨，巧妙穿插安排“有人值守”与“无人值守”的烹饪任务。挑战统筹规划的极限，找出完美的时间轴，以最短的时间端出所有美味佳肴！

4782350.title: SkyVeil Demo
4782350.short_description: SkyVeil 是解谜类型的优雅进化，也是一个完全以插画讲述的动人而富有艺术感的故事。排列并组合插画画面，唤醒隐藏在云端的古老城市，揭开它守护了数百年的秘密。

4819460.title: Robo Rig Demo
4819460.short_description: Robo Rig is a 3D, top down, Extraction Bullet Hell where you play as a fully customizable robot. You build your robot, enter battle and destroy enemies, gain coins and collect parts, then you must extract and build an even more powerful robot with the newly acquired parts!

4808220.title: EVEN OR ODD 1 Demo
4808220.short_description: “偶数？奇数？算题什么的最差劲了！” 数学界终极未解之谜“考拉兹猜想”，竟要靠“肌肉脑”魔法少女“Ichi”凭反射神经硬刚到底？！瞬间闪现变线，蓄力痛击飞来的魔法数字！为你带来极致爽快、挑战极限的全新反射神经肉鸽动作游戏！

4834130.title: Gods' Gate Demo
4834130.short_description: Gods' Gate is a relentless isometric shooter where elite operatives plunge through ancient portals into procedurally generated mythological hellscapes. Survive escalating hordes, and extract before the Gate seals—leaving you trapped with the gods who want you dead. Solo or 4-player co-op.

4442390.title: 夜班护士模拟器 Demo
4442390.short_description: 在这款心理恐怖护士模拟器中存活30天。在执行日常医疗任务与严格的时间管理之间寻找平衡，同时躲避潜伏在黑暗病房中的恐怖异常。赚取薪水，控制你不断下降的理智值，在成为医院的下一个永久病人之前拼死逃离。

4773640.title: PNG BATTLE
4773640.short_description: 某一天，有人突发奇想。 "霸王龙和有智慧的自卸卡车打架，谁会赢？" 你那些荒诞又伟大的幻想，我们统统帮你实现。"PNG BATTLE"

4839500.title: Forge Clicker 2 Demo
4839500.short_description: Forge Clicker 2 is a pixel art idle clicker game where you manage your own forge. Tap to gather materials, craft weapons through a forging minigame, sell your creations, and unlock stronger materials, upgrades, and new blades.

4463660.title: oooÖ
4463660.short_description: 《oooÖ》是一款闯关冒险解谜游戏。你将从死亡中醒来，化身为一只独特的毛毛虫。 探索趣味关卡，体会倒霉小夫的遭遇，是黄泉路上走一趟还是重生校园奇遇！ 你一无所知，但本能告诉你——逃离这里！

4583580.title: 妖刀传 Demo
4583580.short_description: 妖刀现，血雨落…… 人人都知道的童谣传唱了百年， 而如今，妖星祸起，妖刀于名剑会现身…… 这摄人心魄的嗜血之刃，又将掀起何等的腥风血雨呢？

4625470.title: Pixmox
4625470.short_description: Collect unique pets, build powerful teams, and unleash strategic Match-3 combos to defeat epic bosses. Unlock new companions, strengthen your roster, and discover endless battle synergies on your adventure.

4627580.title: Wall Brawl Demo
4627580.short_description: Hold the line! Team up in this tactical multiplayer castle‑brawler where players raise fortresses, set up defenses, and smash through enemy strongholds with physics‑driven destruction. Heroic last stands! Questionable tactics! Bricks moving at unsafe speeds!

4844690.title: Who Clicked My Bones Demo
4844690.short_description: Who Clicked My Bones? is short Incremental Game about ruling a massive amount of skeleton army to sacrifice in order to Summon Lich King. Upgrade your skeleton in Skill Tree. The Game is designed to be finished in 4 hour playtime.

4842030.title: Whale Cleaner Demo
4842030.short_description: 准备好迎接海底最硬核的保洁工作了吗？接管深海清洗站，为脏兮兮的鲸鱼、海豚和其他神秘巨兽提供终极清洁服务！在这款极度解压且充满氛围感的清洁模拟游戏中，你需要使用贝壳刮刀、海绵等奇特工具，清理厚重的淤泥、远古海藻和危险的水母。收集隐藏在污垢中的红宝石蟹来升级装备。顶住黑心资本家“钳老板”的压力，努力将客户洗得闪闪发光！沉浸在独特的生物工业世界里，洗净千年的污垢，发掘意想不到的深海秘宝。

2489950.title: 哇咔纳传说
2489950.short_description: 《哇咔纳传说》是一款充满奇幻与挑战的童话风动作冒险游戏，带你踏入神秘广阔的童话大陆。在这里你将面对各种各样的怪物和场景，灵活运用你的魔法技能来对抗这些敌人。最终在追寻生命的真谛、家庭纽带和自我认知的探索中，收获独一无二的心灵体验。

4846940.title: Aaron Drake: Ace Detective Demo
4846940.short_description: Become Aaron Drake and experience the thrill of the hunt as you interrogate suspects, spot contradictions, and corner killers across three murder cases — alongside a rookie partner who is trying her very best.

4674910.title: Woke Up In a Dark Nightmare Demo
4674910.short_description: You fell asleep in your own bed but woke up in a dark nightmare. Explore a shifting house haunted by paranormal activity, uncover disturbing secrets and uncover the truth behind your arrival.

4833880.title: BURNTCRUST Demo
4833880.short_description: Drive across randomly generated galaxies, deliver pizza, upgrade your ship, and plan your route to avoid hostiles. Or get drunk, gamble away your life savings, and crash full speed into an asteroid field. I won't judge.

4146680.title: ReStory: Chill Electronic Repairs Demo
4146680.short_description: 在2005年左右的东京开一间古朴的电子产品维修店，通过认真修复标志性的电子游戏主机、手机、音乐播放器及其他怀旧设备来扩大经营。与顾客交谈，聆听他们的故事，见证你的决定将如何影响他们的人生以及你的店铺的发展。

4755410.title: The Adventure of Spyke Demo
4755410.short_description: Join Spyke where the worst day of his life suddenly takes a turn and becomes an epic adventure. Solve challenging puzzles, use mystical tools, and fight robots, venom-spitting organ harvesters, terrifying creatures, and much more in this low-poly, top-down, action RPG puzzler.

4621320.title: 猫咪列车长 Demo
4621320.short_description: 《猫咪列车长》是一款 2D 像素风的暖心系桌面放置游戏，让你的屏幕化身为会动的超可爱猫咪乐园！

4748040.title: 我的修仙日志 Cultivation Journal
4748040.short_description: 《我的修仙日志》是一款融合了文字MUD美学与深度修仙模拟的挂机游戏。你将扮演一介凡人，从炼气期踏上漫漫仙途，在挂机中积累修为、炼制丹药、锻造法宝，在心魔幻境中突破境界，最终渡劫飞升。游戏拥有超过数百段心魔叙事的突破系统、百余本可参悟的功法、完善的炼丹炼器体系，以及独创的“修仙书架”功能——让你在修炼之余，读一本小说，静待道成。

4824320.title: PS Maker Demo
4824320.short_description: Create 2D top-down story-driven exploration games without writing any code! PS Maker lets you build maps, add characters, write dialogue, set up puzzles, and trigger cutscenes to tell your story. Once it's ready, share your games instantly with friends!

4837920.title: Dungeons And Animals Demo
4837920.short_description: Dive into dungeons in a 1–6 player co-op souls-like experience, gather resources, craft powerful gear, and survive in a world where risk determines everything.

4480690.title: snaze Demo
4480690.short_description: Snaze is a snake game. Eat the green dots and go to next level.

4562360.title: Light From Within Demo
4562360.short_description: Light From Within is a top-down action-adventure focused on exploration, dungeon crawling, and discovery. Traverse a handcrafted world, solve puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and collect relics that expand your abilities, boost your stats, and alter how you interact with the environment.

3882270.title: 放置模拟国
3882270.short_description: 《放置模拟国》是一款国家模拟类放置游戏，您可以轻松的获得各类资源，并使用获得的资源进行国家养成，最后实现统一天下的目的。

4674720.title: Royal Signal : The Prince’s 5 Days Demo
4674720.short_description: Four princesses gather before the Crown Prince of the mightiest kingdom — you. Wield your royal gift — Telepathy — to peer into their hidden hearts. Behind every dazzling smile, each princess hides her own truth. Five days. See past the masks and choose the one to stand by your side.

2391770.title: RAX
2391770.short_description: RAX 是一款关于光路、逻辑与模块化构建的益智沙盒游戏。放置并旋转不同光学元件，控制光线的方向、颜色和时序，点亮目标，并将复杂结构封装成可复用的蓝图芯片。 这是一款基于网格的逻辑解谜游戏，核心操作是选择、放置、旋转和组合光学元件。玩家通过反射、分光、合色、延迟、阻断和条件触发来构建稳定的光路。随着谜题推进，游戏从直观的路径规划逐渐扩展到信号时序、状态保持和芯片封装，主要吸引力在于用简单规则搭建出复杂而可复用的系统。

3987580.title: 盛夏离与合 试用版
3987580.short_description: 毕业自驾游？不，是「心动修罗场」！ 《盛夏离与合》是现象级互动影像系列《完蛋！我被美女包围了！》IP的全新篇章。本次我们将填补“完蛋宇宙”时间线上的关键一块，带你回到那个承前启后、充满无限可能的毕业季，体验一段关于成长、抉择与命运交织的动人故事。 这段承前启后的夏日篇章，都会因你每一次的抉择，导向独一无二的盛夏结局。

4778860.title: 真弓-Mayumi-
4778860.short_description: This is a Japanese horror game that features a woman who works at a hospital as the main character.

4788840.title: The Big Owl Night
4788840.short_description: Survive a chaotic night in São Paulo with zombies, bosses and cursed upgrades in a fast-paced top-down roguelite. Collect weapons, trigger strange synergies, visit odd merchants and fight until the Big Owl lets you see another sunrise.

4809780.title: Gingerbread Wonderland Demo
4809780.short_description: Decorate your own gingerbread cookies, and organize your scene. And share it with your friends. How about making my own scene this Christmas ?

4736940.title: 玛丽编辑器
4736940.short_description: 一款功能强大的玛丽机主题编辑器与游戏平台，让您自由定制主题图标、配色、音效与玩法规则，打造专属的街机体验。

4840490.title: Volcano Logistics Demo
4840490.short_description: 一款令人满足的第一人称渐进式物理游戏，玩家需经营废弃物处理厂，并为饥饿的火山提供燃料。赚取灵魂球并解锁地狱级升级。扩展你的平台，焚烧并摧毁各类物体。为恶魔上司效力，并揭开可疑货物背后的黑暗真相

4676100.title: 灰度决策 Demo
4676100.short_description: 程序员救下一名老道，获得残破古籍《万符真解》。你惊讶发现——制符和开发软件一样，不过是平衡各项参数。于是你开了家“赛博符箓”公司，研发数字灵符，在道德与暴利之间反复横跳。 是坚守正道，还是拥抱灰色？每一次选择，都将改变公司的命运。

4659440.title: 黑帆王座·Galactic Loadout Demo
4659440.short_description: 在《黑帆王座·Galactic Loadout》中，堆叠离谱联武器，赌出逆天搭配，让战舰战力无限膨胀。每一次选择都在失控边缘狂飙——直到你碾碎整片星海。

1222540.title: Gastova: The Witches of Arkana
1222540.short_description: 《女巫史诗》是一款轻松愉快的2D平台冒险遊戏。作为阿尔卡那的守护魔女，加斯托娃必须维持魔法的平衡、解开与泉源守护者相关的谜团、揭开隐藏的真相，并在为时已晚之前，从邪恶势力手中守护这个世界的未来……

4797700.title: Hunt And Peck Demo
4797700.short_description: Turn your index fingers into the brave Eagle Brothers! 'Hunt & Peck' is a typing defense game where you don't type words—you strike keys. Smash the specific keys where enemies appear with speed and precision to defend the cyber world.

4798870.title: 桌面蚂蚁 Demo
4798870.short_description: 在电脑桌面模拟喂养蚂蚁，搬运食物。还原现实中观察蚂蚁的体验，还可以投喂不同食物以及使用各种道具捉弄它们。平时它们在屏幕上四处觅食，时刻陪伴你并且不会影响你的工作。

4808080.title: Toxic Trains Demo
4808080.short_description: Toxic Trains is a strategy simulation game about optimizing rail routes. Build tracks to transport passenger and freight trains to their destinations. Choose upgrades to modify the land and your network. Switch tracks to avoid collisions and spills. Can you keep the trains from exploding?

4848980.title: Slice To Meet You Demo
4848980.short_description: A cozy idle incremental game about the satisfying rhythm of chopping ingredients. Unlock new produce, upgrade your knives, and grow your earnings — all at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

3121810.title: ALARIC
3121810.short_description: May your wrath conquer the cursed beings and save the land. Fight like hell and avenge your father. Explore a giant castle filled with monsters and get stronger to withstand the forces of hell in this boomershooter, metroidvania adventure.

4579750.title: Idle Knight
4579750.short_description: Idle Knight turns every click, keystroke, and controller input into XP. Level up your warrior, build your stats, fight in ranked duels, conquer dungeons, join guilds, and crush seasonal events all from your desktop.

4793520.title: Good Hands Demo
4793520.short_description: In Good Hands, join Nia as she helps her neighbor Aunty Zubeida tidy up a tangled garden. Tend, sort, and restore calm in this cozy puzzle about care and connection. Unwind with uniquely crafted puzzles, made for anyone who finds joy in gardens.

4600670.title: Life in Tudorofka
4600670.short_description: Life in Tudorofka is a game where you, find a rusty broken junk, restore the junk, buy parts for the junk, build your car, work and enjoy your life at country

3423390.title: My Donut
3423390.short_description: Unleash your imagination in a world of sweets! Create your dream donuts from shaping the dough to decorating with colorful toppings. Experience a relaxing creative journey focused on making and sharing your unique masterpieces.

4598110.title: The Wild Demo
4598110.short_description: Step into the wild, the untamed world of Earth, where you'll take control of a wide variety of animals. Survive the harsh environment, hunt, forage, breed and fight through an ever changing ecosystem.

4545200.title: Broken Crown
4545200.short_description: Broken Crown is a fantasy RTS where you build a settlement, gather resources, research powerful upgrades, and command hundreds of units in formation-based battles. Advance troops through five visual tiers, preserve Bronze-to-Gold veterans, and conquer tactical maps shaped by Fog of War.

4756840.title: Mage Madness Demo
4756840.short_description: Mage Madness is a first person multiplayer party game where mages compete in spell-fueled minigames. Cast spells, duke it out in chaotic minigames, and settle grudges. Play quick rounds in Playlist Mode or go all in with Block Party where every point earned earned fuels your power.

4727570.title: Endless Roll Demo
4727570.short_description: Your dice are your health in this endless survival roguelite. Pick a lane, manage wounds and corruption, draft omens, climb the leaderboard, and push for one more floor.

4714220.title: Elacoria Demo
4714220.short_description: Explore an endless open world — vast in width, length, and depth — filled with mysteries to uncover. Join up to 8 friends to survive, farm, mine, build, and fight together in a living world with day-night cycles, seasons, and dynamic weather.

4670790.title: Stone to Stove Demo
4670790.short_description: 白天收集资源，服务他人赚取金钱；夜晚购买防御塔，保卫基地。优化你的定居点，承担风险以获取更多利润，每天抵御日益艰难的攻击，这将为你带来丰厚的回报。

2583820.title: Planet Arcade Demo
2583820.short_description: A light-hearted, casual adventure game in the style of a retro RPG. In place of traditional battles, key plot points are advanced through minigames, some of which are stylistic tributes to classic arcade games.

4677950.title: Autotelic
4677950.short_description: mess about with a unique array of tools, items and characters in a stylized homemade game engine.

4734450.title: Shoot Until You Rest Demo
4734450.short_description: Shoot Until You Rest is an arena-shooter rogue-lite where you can choose from a large range of weapons and other gear to fight your enemies. Survive waves, fight powerfull bosses and get rewarded with new upgrades and characters(yes you can play the bosses).

4210920.title: Schedule Store Simulator Demo
4210920.short_description: 从小毒贩一路崛起为令人畏惧的毒枭，在 Hyland Point 的黑暗地下世界中制造并分销毒品。 通过购置物业、经营业务、雇佣员工并掌控街头来壮大你的帝国。

4751870.title: Play and Learn English
4751870.short_description: 先让你开口说,再让你说得更好。仅用1000个单词,让你的日常英语流利起来。在故事驱动的RPG中,麦克风与你同在,游戏会倾听。完全离线,无订阅。

4832490.title: 《美少女旅馆：可爱即是正义，但正义需要处刑》
4832490.short_description: 一间神秘的旅馆，一群彼此怀疑的美少女，一场无法停止的猎杀游戏。在谎言与处刑之间，找出真正的狼人，每一个选择，都会改写她们的结局。

4833980.title: lone.AI Demo
4833980.short_description: lone.AI is a space RPG roguelite. With challenging, relentless gameplay, each run has the potential to boost your ship's power, speed, and more. As a lone AI, fight your way through the solar system and uncover the secret behind the ZOSMA, an alien race that holds power over the system.

4531040.title: With A Heavy Heart Demo
4531040.short_description: A cozy 2D platformer on what it means to truly live, laugh, learn, and lift someone up

4765650.title: Watamari Part2 - A Fake Marriage? Demo
4765650.short_description: 化身“恋之天使”，引导少女们走向爱情的百合游戏。 在悉心照料主人的身心之余，倾听她们的心声，推动故事前进。 加油吧，小天使——你的选择，或许将改变她们的命运。

4502020.title: Sneaky Bimbuls
4502020.short_description: One team hides among a crowd of NPCs. The other has to figure out who's a player before the map gets sabotaged. A chaotic local party game for 2-8 players on a shared screen.

4822530.title: 五七之桐：通向首相之路 Demo
4822530.short_description: 这是一款以经济泡沫破裂后的大不况事件为背景的政治模拟文字冒险游戏。您将扮演新当选的县知事折木一马，在故事中利用有限的预算解决县内经济、安全与福祉的诸多问题，并妥善处理议会政党与政府成员间的关系。最终一步步迈向总理大臣的宝座。

4832980.title: Eightfold Blocks Demo
4832980.short_description: Rotate, place, and rethink every block in a focused 8x8 puzzle game. Solve 1,000 spatial boards, keep finished solutions visible, reset freely, and use optional hints when one stubborn piece refuses to fit.

4803100.title: SkateFPS Demo
4803100.short_description: When the system hates you, hate the system! Experimental FPS about shooting magic from your hands with a skateboard + text adventure with multiple endings about being cursed in your own land.

4822200.title: 蒙古之岚 剧本1：崇正学堂篇 Demo
4822200.short_description: 内蒙古喀喇沁的崇正学堂，1900年代。在真实历史人物交错的校园里，通过累积少女萨仁的选择见证五段真结局——一部史实视觉小说。收录约 7 万字剧本、30项成就、传统蒙古文竖排显示。

4027780.title: ArmOut
4027780.short_description: ArmOut is an old slot machine. It just sits there doing nothing... However, it might spin whenever you press a key with chosen amount of credits. Punch that keyboard to earn those credits!!!

4782810.title: Welcome Demon Demo
4782810.short_description: Judge otherworldly creatures, determine their sentences, and assign them to the correct dungeons using your rulebook. Keep Tempo above zero and Chaos below 100 as you struggle to survive 666 hours as the prison’s new warden.

4410980.title: Backburner
4410980.short_description: Cook, serve, and manage your food truck while exploring a handcrafted open world. Upgrade your equipment, unlock new recipes, and turn your small food truck into a thriving business.

1395930.title: Break The Chain
1395930.short_description: You are bound by a chain — every step matters. Break the Chain is a physics-based solo and co-op puzzle game where precision, timing, and teamwork are everything. One mistake can pull everyone down. Fall, restart, and fight your way to freedom.

4639020.title: The Crimson Contract Demo
4639020.short_description: Every contract pays. Some cost what’s left of your humanity.

4095440.title: Bit Mine Clicker
4095440.short_description: Bit-Mine Clicker is an incremental mining game where you click to earn BIT, build automatic miners, upgrade your grid, react to changing market prices, and defend your base. Catch helpful bonuses, avoid dangerous traps, unlock talents, and turn a single coin into a powerful BIT empire

4719350.title: A DAY TO REMEMBER
4719350.short_description: Play as aino, she has secret feelings for her childhood friend name Rain, can she possibly confess her feelings to rain before the day ends or will it be to late and will she lose her childhood friend Rain forever?

4817100.title: Birds of War Demo
4817100.short_description: You are a bird. You have a nest. Other birds want your eggs. Birds of War is a team-based aerial PvP game. Raid nests, steal eggs, fight beak-to-beak in fast, chaotic matches built around flight and combat. Your mic is always hot. Your enemies can hear you. Plan accordingly.

4836130.title: More Deaths, More Fun (Lie) Demo
4836130.short_description: More Deaths, More Fun (Lie) is a brutal 2D platformer where every death makes the game harder. Face evolving levels, precise challenges, and climb the global leaderboard. Fail fast, adapt faster - or lose your sanity trying.

4820810.title: Echo Core Demo
4820810.short_description: Fight the machines. Survive the ruins. Uncover the truth. Echo Core is a top-down sci-fi action-adventure where you awaken in a forgotten underground facility. Explore awe-inducing locations, battle hostile machines, and uncover the truth of this place across chapters.

4797480.title: LampMan! Demo
4797480.short_description: LampMan! is a 2d action-platformer featuring three playable characters you can switch between at any time. Master their abilities, conquer vibrant levels, and restore light to LampWorld!

1009410.title: Eternal Exodus
1009410.short_description: 一款以来世为舞台的捕怪 RPG。在这场探讨深刻哲学与形而上学主题的剧情向冒险中，捕捉并融合神话生物，踏上将来世从暴政统治中解放出来的旅程。

4772570.title: The Refuge Demo
4772570.short_description: Serve the A.R.C organization. Infiltrate infested zones, complete contracts, and extract with your resources. Upgrade your facilities and complete quests to unlock new services. An intense PvE extraction where the difficulty increases with your ambitions.

4800190.title: KAON : Fragmented Core Demo
4800190.short_description: KAON: Fragmented Core is a 2D action-platformer with a metroidvania feel. You play as Kaon, an android awakened in a world where no one lives anymore, neither humans nor animals. Mostly what’s left is plants, ruins, and robots, a good chunk of them turned hostile

4730890.title: Aghia Demo
4730890.short_description: The Dark Voievode has unleashed his beasts to violate your homeland. Eradicate these creatures from the face of the Earth as you make your way across the country in this ’90s-inspired FPS.

4674970.title: Cheese Stack
4674970.short_description: Cheese Stack is a cozy puzzle game where you need to arrange falling pieces of cheese into perfect rows. Simple rules, delicious graphics, upbeat music, and a highscore table you'll be tempted to beat. It's the perfect way to unwind for 5 minutes or get lost in the game for an hour.

4822720.title: 1 AM MOSCOW TIME Demo
4822720.short_description: A 2D adventure about rescuing magical creatures in Moscow and the role of a design bureau employee in this whole story.

4806720.title: Clawless Coin Demo
4806720.short_description: 经营您自己的抓娃娃机帝国，收集奖杯毛绒玩具，解锁升级，并在这款温馨的街机放置游戏中获得声望以赚取巨额利润。

4833970.title: 暗神话:露西 Demo
4833970.short_description: 中世纪一处废弃城市出现了很多变异僵尸,之前军队在这里研发过毒气.上级怕僵尸入侵到周边的城市,所以派露西过来探查情况,最好能够消灭所有变异僵尸.上级给了露西6把高科技武器,但这里的僵尸实在太多了,露西可能需要在这里呆很久,准备好,任务开始!

4067990.title: Please, Spin Demo
4067990.short_description: 在这款赌上性命的“命运轮盘”Roguelike游戏中，转动轮盘决定生死！自定义你的轮盘，搜寻能打破游戏平衡的遗物，在疯狂的小游戏中求生。智取暗箱操作的Boss，击败疯狂的主持人，活着逃离这场死亡直播！

4769220.title: Kick Demo
4769220.short_description: 《Kick》是一段充满怀旧情怀的旅程，你在上学的路上不断磨练自己的足球技巧，穿越充满独特挑战的关卡。你准备好大显身手了吗？

4658270.title: The Calling Past. Demo
4658270.short_description: 杰布生活艰难，决定回到故乡。想在亲友身边逃避坏念头，却开始做噩梦——不仅睡梦中，醒来也纠缠他。找到并了解杰布噩梦的源头。

4815080.title: Football Pitch And Arcade Simulator Demo
4815080.short_description: 经营您自己的五人制足球场和街机中心！升级设施，吸引顾客，打造您的娱乐帝国。

4834940.title: Arcany Demo
4834940.short_description: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

3944200.title: Nekopedia: Find Her Tail Demo
3944200.short_description: 与猫娘们一起踏上旅程，在温馨多彩的地点寻找隐藏的猫咪。阅读猫娘百科，与她们交谈，深入了解猫娘及其种类，也许会发现超出你预期的事情。每位猫娘都有自己独特的魅力和个人故事。

4659800.title: 炼金秘术 Demo
4659800.short_description: 《炼金秘术》作为一款解谜叙事类游戏，你将扮演一位重返故乡的炼金公会书记员，并在一些机缘巧合下临时成为了一名值岗炼金师。被赶鸭上架的你不得不回忆起过去习得的炼金术知识来解决本地居民的需求，并与自己的同伴们在这个逐渐崩溃的世界中生存下去。

4612970.title: A.V.E.N.A Demo
4612970.short_description: Pilot disposable combat drones through the Primal Portal in a sci-fi action roguelike. Customize your drone, fight through various missions, recover research data and alien technology to enhance your drone setup for the next session.

4612560.title: FLESHBREAK Demo
4612560.short_description: A story-driven survival visual novel inspired by SCP-610. Face a flesh-spreading outbreak, make brutal moral choices, protect the people you can’t let go of, and uncover the terrifying truth behind the disease.

4833890.title: Vermin Protocol - Demo
4833890.short_description: Take on pest control contracts and hunt infestations across abandoned warehouses, barns, and other contaminated locations Track, eliminate, and contain the vermin before they spread.

3540400.title: bang shoot demo.
3540400.short_description: A fast-paced arena shooter where you wield two weapons at once across unique battlegrounds. Each round is different: new map, teams, weapons, and modifiers.

4028730.title: Beerhouse Simulator Demo
4028730.short_description: 第一人称家庭酵造模拟器，每一批次都可能精彩地失败或出人意料地成功——嗝的人或许会注意到其中的差异，也或许不会。酵造、实验，或者就此展开一届啊啊大乱。

4793510.title: SNAP JAW Demo
4793510.short_description: A thrilling rogue-lite horror fishing experience. Pillage the sea, upgrade your boat, and FEED the increasingly hungry colossal-mechatronic creatures of the deep. All in an attempt to reverse the rapture of your adorable dog Jeremiah.

3347920.title: Loot List: 小偷模拟器 — DEMO
3347920.short_description: 《Loot List》是一款以劫盗为主题的盗窃模拟及动作游戏。但有一点不同——在这款游戏中，盗窃行动必须有一份清单。

4766650.title: PICK A BOO Demo
4766650.short_description: PICK A BOO是一款用磁力吸附家具并进行搬运的线上合作动作游戏。

4465540.title: Reapers Reception Demo
4465540.short_description: Manage a hotel for criminals, spot anomalies, and find out who killed your sister 15 years ago.

4785140.title: Neofold Lite
4785140.short_description: 一款无限生物收集游戏，每只生物都由你的GPU实时生成，独一无二。孵化无穷无尽的奇妙物种，收养你喜爱的那些，在桌面上培育一个只属于你的活力生态园。

4783090.title: Deepscape Inc. Demo
4783090.short_description: A 2 to 4 player co-op horror game. You wake up marked with an ID number you can't see on your own back. Only your fellow inmates can read it. Find each other, share your numbers, reach your validation rooms, and get out before whatever roams the halls finds you first.

4541070.title: Empire Eleven 2026 Demo
4541070.short_description: Build your football empire. Scout talent, manage finances, develop tactics and lead your club from obscurity to glory in a deep football management simulation.

4754760.title: CyberSushi Demo
4754760.short_description: 体验 CyberSushi 的精炼试玩篇：这是一款高速街机 roguelite，小小寿司英雄冲过崩塌维度，延续连击，积满 Sushi Surge，选择改变本局节奏的 Sushi Hacks，再追一次不可能的挑战。

4484980.title: Ghostslayers Demo
4484980.short_description: Ghostslayers is a wave-based top-down coop shooter where you slay the ghosts with magic and couple thousands of bullets... Or punches, or slashes, or explosions. Use the varied weaponry, spell cards and abilities, combine them together and obliterate absolutely everything.

4683040.title: Estancia Protocol Zero Demo
4683040.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in Neuquén, Argentine Patagonia. Venture into a remote estate in Cerro Ocaso to search for your missing partner. Face hordes of the undead, manage your resources, and solve classic puzzles to survive the nightmare.

4592180.title: MOLOKAUST Demo
4592180.short_description: 在这款第一人称生存恐怖游戏中，深入一个残酷的被诅咒的小镇。凭借超写实的氛围和极端的生存机制，你必须合理分配你的物资，直面你最糟糕的梦魇，以拯救你的妻子和女儿。

4564000.title: Taxi Simulator (Demo)
4564000.short_description: Jump into the Taxi Simulator Demo! Drive a classic yellow cab through a vibrant city district. Complete your first missions, refuel, clean up your ride, and avoid traffic tickets. Experience the shady, wild life of a streetwise cabby. Your shift starts now!

4802050.title: Outrange Strike Demo
4802050.short_description: 《Outrange Strike》是一款逼真的空战游戏。驾驶战斗机，控制能量和迎角，发射导弹，并躲避诱饵攻击！

4779810.title: DODGEBRAWL Demo
4779810.short_description: An FPS reimagining of the best gym class sport, DODGEBRAWL is a transformation of iconic shooter game modes into the context of an athletic activity. Play for free today!

4811520.title: Tiny Train Adventures Demo
4811520.short_description: Set off on a tiny train adventure! Build your railway and drive through the mountains in this cozy exploration adventure.

4754440.title: Drained Creatures Demo
4754440.short_description: Drained Creatures is a multiplayer 3D arena brawler for up to 8 players locally, playable using gamepads only.

4806750.title: Increment Isle Demo
4806750.short_description: Increment Isle is an incremental game about plundering a mysterious island. Destroy everything, discover new resources, strategically buy upgrades and avoid scurvy to become the richest person in the universe!

4806200.title: Ironfall Demo
4806200.short_description: Ironfall is a high-octane Action Roguelite where medieval steel meets futuristic firepower. Mow down thousands of mechanical demons, collect powerful loot, and craft unique builds in a world of burning metal. Can you survive the descent and reclaim the shattered fortress?

4597250.title: Order of the Sinking Star Demo
4597250.short_description: 由《时空幻境》与《见证者》制作人 Jonathan Blow 领衔打造，《沉星之序》是一款以魔法与谜团交织世界为背景的解谜冒险游戏。破解环环相扣的手工设计谜题，发现各具特色的可操作英雄，掌握不断演化的游戏机制，并逐步揭开隐藏于世界背后的宏大谜团。立即体验 Demo！

4806530.title: Bato Battō - Demo
4806530.short_description: Bato Battō is an online multiplayer 3D platform-fighter. Each weapon has a unique move list. Fight in every direction with weighted & athletic movement, and multi-chain combos using stylized physics. Demo modes - Free for all & Team slayer. Release to include CTF, King of the Hill, Race & more

4724950.title: Cave Clicker Demo
4724950.short_description: Mine rocks to collect rare ores to become the richest Mole alive, and looking good while doing it too!

4812640.title: All Hallows Demo
4812640.short_description: Survive a shifting, brutalist nightmare. In this high-fidelity psychological horror demo, manage a systemic economy of decay as you navigate the Ithris Cemetery. Explore, adapt, and confront an evolving threat tailored to your personal fear profile. Can you anchor your reality?

4700660.title: Banban Isle Rangers Demo
4700660.short_description: 跟随班班和他的朋友们，踏入一个充满32位辉煌的奇幻世界！与你那位超棒的新飞行伙伴一起探索班班群岛的独特土地，帮助朋友们解决问题，并拯救你的暑假！……哦，对了，大概还要拯救世界，免遭“淘气鬼”的入侵。

4750570.title: CHUNKS Demo
4750570.short_description: Once you start, you won’t be able to stop! Mine entire galaxies dry, blast through hazards, and craft insane machines to dominate every session.

4148250.title: 艾恩葛朗特 回荡新声 DEMO Version
4148250.short_description: Step into Aincrad, a world of beauty and danger where every battle could be your last. This Demo version allows you to play the Beta Test chapter. Save data from the demo can be carried over to the full version.

4805580.title: Rebel's Ascent Demo
4805580.short_description: Defeat waves of enemies using everything from sticks to exploding throwing axe. Rebel's Ascent is an incremental roguelite RPG where you acquire and upgrade weapons, improve skills, and fight your way to freedom.

4775690.title: LarsGadiel Demo
