4775690.short_description: LarsGadiel is the prequel to Xenon Valkyrie, a game originally created for Nintendo's 8-bit console that was never released (at least for now), but is now coming to Steam. It's a classic Metroidvania, featuring the original maps and design from that era.

4457640.title: Fiets-Together Demo
4457640.short_description: Fiets-Together is a chaotic co-op racing game in which 2-4 players control a bicycle together. Each player controls one shoe on a pedal, together you accelerate and steer the bike. The goal is to chase best times, unlock customizations, and keep your friendship.

4705430.title: Water You Doing? Demo
4705430.short_description: 你们的座驾抛锚了，前方还有恶浪等着！在一艘霉味冲天的破船上，展开彻底失控的混乱合作。收集废料、堵住漏水、用渔获换冰啤酒，再用鱼叉打破物理法则！

4019470.title: Melted Time Demo
4019470.short_description: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.

4832830.title: Root Scourge Demo
4832830.short_description: An open world crafting game where surface is occupied by a mutated plant species. Humanity has been exiled and is living under the surface for hundreds of years. You are one of the few professionals that can roam the surface. As a mercenary, you take on jobs and face the root scourge on surface.

4833400.title: 心动发条 试玩版
4833400.short_description: "为了拯救你，我重复了数千次死亡。" 生日那天收到的告白信，竟变成了死亡预告函。 在这部无限流悬疑恋爱视觉小说中，你将使用“回溯之戒”，在不断循环的一天里揭开杀人魔“X”的真面目。 阻止注定的悲剧，改写你的命运吧。

4568400.title: Nomad Drive Demo
4568400.short_description: 修复您破旧的房车，单人或1–3人合作驶向程序生成的末日后世界。收集资源，定制您的房车，并尽可能长时间生存。

4802610.title: A Hard Game About Reaching Valhalla Demo
4802610.short_description: Swing your axe, master momentum and overcome impossible obstacles on your journey to Valhalla, alone or with your friends

4806920.title: Lost in Art Demo
4806920.short_description: Explore a surreal, twisted version of real-world art gallery in this atmospheric puzzle adventure inspired by classic survival horror. Use creative thinking and a mysterious power to solve puzzles, evade a sinister threat, and uncover the secret of a cursed artwork; before it traps you for good.

4791220.title: Broom Racer Demo
4791220.short_description: Broom Racer is a first person, multiplayer party racing game on flying brooms. Race your friends or players world wide through mountains, tight tunnels, forests and more. Fly risky maneuvers to gain a speed boost but don't fall of your broom!

4713050.title: Bladebound Demo
4713050.short_description: 使用一个角色在不同战斗风格之间切换，与怪物战斗。在每次冒险中收集物品，塑造你的背包，构建你的流派，并通过单人或与好友合作来制定策略。每一个选择决定你的力量，每一局挑战你的技巧。

4806080.title: Miniature Painter Simulator Demo
4806080.short_description: 开始这个令人惊叹的微型画画爱好吧！ 经营自己的在线商店，出售你画的迷你模型，并处理客户的各种订单。 创建最惊人的微型模型，几乎没有限制，甚至可以导入你自己的自定义模型！ 坐下，拿起画笔，放松一下。

4756540.title: Truck-kun is Supporting Me from Another World?! Demo
4756540.short_description: 你的卡车拥有魔力，而你现在还欠着一笔灵魂债，债主是一个肌肉发达的异世界精灵女孩，住在你的脑子里。化身“卡车君”碾压路人、送货上门并击败骷髅王，在两个世界之间自由穿梭，一切尽在这款混乱的单局制动漫风驾驶游戏！

4813590.title: Ripper Demo
4813590.short_description: Ripper is a top-down shooter with fully destructible environments, fog of war, and Steam multiplayer. Break through walls, survive enemy waves, and battle your friends.

4795050.title: 無人島哪有這麼爽 Demo
4795050.short_description: 全实景拍摄，金钟团队倾力打造影视级规格体验，新生代潜力演员联手飙戏！！你将与四位风格迥异的美女展开难忘冒险，每次选择都可能改变命运。失去记忆的你意外觉醒神秘能力，让岛上的生活充满惊喜。这不只是求生，而是一场浪漫又甜蜜的旅程，再加上创新的沉浸式陪伴系统，让你忍不住喊出：《无人岛哪有这么爽》？！

4812080.title: Ashes of Darkness Demo
4812080.short_description: Ashes of Darkness 是一款设定在黑暗中世纪世界中的 2D 类魂动作 RPG。掌握快节奏战斗，击败强大的敌人，收集稀有神器，并打造属于你的角色构筑，在变得更强的同时挑战致命的 Boss。

4054060.title: O.B.O.L Demo
4054060.short_description: Play a high stake game of head or tails against a mysterious opponent, trapped under the ocean in a claustrophobic, eldritch, Lovecraftian horror atmosphere, all while slowly losing your sanity.

4831100.title: Avelins Journey Demo
4831100.short_description: Stranded on a mysterious alien world, you must climb ever higher through a surreal parkour of floating ruins, ancient structures, and magical forces. Every fall costs time. Every move requires skill. How fast can you reach the top?

4835970.title: FootBall Card Battle Demo
4835970.short_description: 一款实时策略足球卡牌游戏，你将直接对抗对手。构建战术，用魔法卡强化球员，并在对手之前打入5个进球。每个决定都很重要——管理体力和有限卡牌以赢得胜利。

4785020.title: Code-Black Demo
4785020.short_description: A First-Person Single-Player Zombie Survival game where you, "Rugir J.z" live through the initial events of a mass zombie outbreak, shoot, kill, upgrade, explore. Do you think you can survive, or possibly escape…

3748850.title: Endwell Demo
3748850.short_description: One determined cat, one big backpack, and a whole lot of deliveries to make! As a Cat Courier, it's your job to deliver packages across a cozy town on the eve of the world's end. Help residents find connection, hope, and meaning before the last sunset.

4805320.title: Cloudrooms Demo
4805320.short_description: 你被困在一个悬浮在云层之上的走廊中。在这条走廊尽头有一扇门，探索一个每次开启都会变化的环境，识别异常，使用警报，并打破循环。

4820660.title: BREKEKEKEX Demo
4820660.short_description: Hunt frogs, clash with cultists, and survive close-range arena combat in this short, skill-driven swamp adventure.

4814070.title: Brazen Demo
4814070.short_description: Wield ancient elemental power in this first-person rogue-like and descend into a cursed labyrinth of escalating chaos, deadly spellcraft, and brutal ritual combat.

4776680.title: Backrooms Protocol Demo
4776680.short_description: Backrooms Protocol Demo is a walk simulator designed to showcase the atmosphere and environments of the full game. It contains three different levels to explore, each featuring its own unique atmosphere.

4799780.title: Sunrise Isles Demo
4799780.short_description: Drive goods, chop wood, catch fish, cook food, design clothes, or just chill in a spacious island with your friends!

4655260.title: Lab 1995 Demo
4655260.short_description: A psychological narrative horror game where you explore an abandoned government lab while an AI imitating your father guides you.. Would you rather sit quiet OR discover the truth with Noah!!!

4816110.title: Bar Simulator Demo
4816110.short_description: This demo contains a limited portion of the full game experience. Additional content, features, bar types, and systems will be available in the full release.

4815100.title: Watch Yo Plane Demo
4815100.short_description: 与好友一起驾驶一架混乱失控的飞机！在这款合作向“折磨游戏”中齐心协力，穿越重重障碍，挑战各种小游戏，看看你们的默契究竟能走多远。

4799220.title: My Favorite Store Simulator Demo
4799220.short_description: Start with a small shop and work your way up to a huge supermarket! Manage prices, serve customers, catch thieves, hire staff, and much more. Play solo or in co-op with up to 4 players.

4527690.title: Launch Them All Demo
4527690.short_description: A high-stakes turn-based missile duel where every shot matters. Spy, bluff, and deploy powerful tactical abilities to destroy enemy military assets while avoiding civilian casualties.

4779570.title: S4NCTU4RY Demo
4779570.short_description: 坐落在赛博朋克都市中心的酒吧——S4NCTU4RY。 外面的世界喧嚣、疲惫、永不停歇。你的工作是在这片混沌中提供一处栖息的避风港，调制出那杯能让人们暂时忘却一切的佳酿。

4391930.title: La Cosa Nostra Demo
4391930.short_description: La Cosa Nostra is a story-driven 2.5D side-scrolling action game set in 1920s America. Play as an immigrant navigating the world of organized crime, combining melee combat and shooter gameplay within a gritty mafia-themed narrative.

4280000.title: 星渊勇者 StarAbyss Heroes Demo
4280000.short_description: 《星渊勇者》是一款类暗黑类型的冒险刷宝动作游戏，玩家将作为“星陨之灾”后的幸存者，在探索和战斗的过程中逐步发现这场灾难背后的真相。玩家可以扮演不同风格的角色，在战斗中爆出各式各样的独特装备，并借助各种有深度的辅助功能构建出专属于自己的流派！（官方QQ群 297937881）

4814540.title: 仙岛丹田 Demo
4814540.short_description: 这是一款模拟建造类型的游戏。你将扮演一个掌管天空之岛的管理员，你需要在这片原始的岛屿上种植、建造、冶炼、采集，获得拥有神秘力量的仙丹，你交易这些仙丹获得更丰富的资源，并将这个岛屿建设的更加美好。

4746920.title: Forest of Deceit Demo
4746920.short_description: 风暴将至。如果不能在接下来的数日里建成避难所，你们一群人就都会丧命于此。但这片森林似乎被诅咒一般，已经让你的几个朋友变得疯狂、丧失了心智。如今他们的唯一目的就是害死你们其余所有人。来《密林疑云》这款社交推理游戏里，找出是谁背叛了团体吧。本游戏支持4-8人共同游玩。

4487780.title: Liminal:Childhood Memories Demo
4487780.short_description: 厌倦了成年人灰暗的现实，一个21岁的年轻人醒来时发现自己回到了被遗忘的过去。《Childhood Memories》是一款没有解谜元素的忧郁探索体验，由“阈限空间”与“Kenopsia”的怀旧氛围所驱动。这里没有怪物，只有回忆。

4811590.title: The Money Pit Demo
4811590.short_description: 尝试在一场扭曲的电视节目中活下去：收集宝藏、偷窃其他参赛者，并在怪物或对手击倒你之前存入战利品。只有最富有的史莱姆，才能活到明天。

4820580.title: Miss Rosen's Wowtastic! Marching Band Demo
4820580.short_description: The band is in town, and it’s time for some fun! Join Miss Rosen, a clockwork majorette escaped from her music box, as she travels the world solving mind-bending puzzles that’ll allow you to put things where they belong!

4815590.title: Koatl The Defender ULTIMATE Demo
4815590.short_description: 在《Koatl The Defender ULTIMATE》中，深入墨西哥圣路易斯波托西市地下隐藏的隧道。揭开远古秘密，挥舞强大武器，在融合 2.5D 平台跳跃与 3D 战斗的电影式动作冒险中挑战史诗级首领。

4793370.title: Among Us Story: On Guard Demo
4793370.short_description: Live life as a Crewmate in this dangerous narrative adventure through space. As Guard, you're in charge of shipwide security and everything is fine. Until there's a MURDER?! Prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you.

4776100.title: Dust Front RTS Demo
4776100.short_description: Dust Front is a classic RTS with 4X/grand strategy elements. In this demo, you will try out the RTS side: lead a triumphant siege of an industrial city. Command strike groups and crush one of two enemy factions.

4792330.title: Witchworker Demo
4792330.short_description: Study hard, keep your atelier tidy and cast magical spells.

4792450.title: Super Slots Demo
4792450.short_description: An incremental combo-chasing casino builder about rigging a tiny slot machine into a jackpot-printing empire.

3411220.title: Dreadline Express Demo
3411220.short_description: Dreadline Express 是一款第一人称心理恐怖类银河恶魔城游戏，背景设定在最后一列人类列车上。揭开这列神秘列车的谜团，直面诡异的乘客，并通过独特的卡牌叙事机制塑造你的旅程，完全掌控故事走向。这已不再是我们的世界。

4678000.title: One Song, One Life Demo
4678000.short_description: 【DEMO Ver.】《One Song, One Life（一曲一生）》是一款带来全新体验的节奏冒险游戏，敲击不同类型的音符，“乐曲”和“故事”的走向会产生变化。在游戏中，你将通过演奏，改变一名女孩（纯恋酱／雾岛纯恋）的人生。她正努力成为一名顶尖的网络音乐人，只为有朝一日能与喜欢的偶像同台演出。

4769270.title: Flock Off! Demo
4769270.short_description: 《羊群大逃亡！》是一款支持 1-4 名玩家的第一人称动作冒险游戏。与好友组队，在偏远的苏格兰高地，对抗一场诡异的羊群起义，努力求生。利用各种奇特的武器，抵御僵尸羊的攻击，并揭开意想不到的剧情转折。你们能否在这场羊群末日中幸存下来？

4058470.title: UFOntastic Demo
4058470.short_description: 杰诺有债要还，而最容易弄到钱的地方就是地球！使用你的飞碟：从环境中绑架物品、人、敌人等，在地牢和迷你游戏中不断前进，赚取财富！

4586460.title: Megaris Demo
4586460.short_description: A casual classic puzzle game with lots of modes and extras.

4806320.title: Hollow Ground Demo
4806320.short_description: Top-down shooter inspired by 90s arcade games. You and up to three friends play as four mercenaries as they descend into the Epsilon 9 bunker. Navigate 70+ handcrafted labyrinthine levels, purchase upgrades, and destroy chaos manifest: The Machine.

3972840.title: Furry Adventure Club and the Temple of Pawsion 🐱 Demo
3972840.short_description: 🐱 与 Indica 和她的兽耳伙伴们一起踏上全新的冒险！「爪与激情神殿」中充满了秘密、谜题，以及在最意想不到的地方邂逅爱情的机会。现在是加入 Furry Adventure Club 的时候了。

4419040.title: Protocol:Terminate Demo
4419040.short_description: 一款合作生存恐怖射击游戏，玩家需对抗通过学习玩家行为来进化的AI。它会变得越来越危险，不懈追击玩家，并将错误转化为致命陷阱。玩家需要躲藏、破解安防系统并协同作战才能生存。

4797770.title: INTO THE AETHER Demo
4797770.short_description: The first half of INTO THE AETHER: Chapter 1! Explore the magical oceanside town of Starry Hill, and meet the magic users that live within it...

4288150.title: Haunted Bar Simulator 🍻 Demo
4288150.short_description: 白天与朋友一起经营一家温馨的酒吧。 夜晚招待奇怪的顾客，并在恐怖中努力生存。

4747510.title: BOMBANANA! Demo
4747510.short_description: 你们是一支由三只猴子组成的3人拆弹小队：盲猴、聋猴和哑猴。在你们改造成移动拆弹工坊的小型厢式车里，你们必须在有限时间和有限沟通条件下，在炸弹爆炸前完成拆除！

4816540.title: Oreguard Demo
4816540.short_description: A mining, building and resource managing game. Get to upgrade your gear as you fulfill contracts and discover all kinds of minerals and resources. Not the final version.

4849610.title: RED FLAG Demo
4849610.short_description: A global catastrophe has struck the world. A small group of survivors is trapped in an isolated shelter with resources too scarce for everyone. Take your seat at the table, convince the others you deserve to stay. Lie, pressure, manipulate – and decide who gets thrown out!

4681100.title: Guardians Hand Demo
4681100.short_description: Harness the elemental powers of fire, wind, ice, and lightning to enhance your defensive turrets and hold back relentless waves of enemies. Strategically build your deck and adapt your tactics to survive increasingly challenging encounters.

4832610.title: Liminal Agent Demo
4832610.short_description: A psychological liminal space horror experience set across surreal backrooms, empty shopping malls, endless tunnels, retro locations and haunting hotels. Something is always watching you.

4670620.title: Trader's Life: Medieval Shop Demo
4670620.short_description: Step behind the counter in an immersive medieval trading simulation. Buy low, haggle hard, and sell high! Upgrade gear at the blacksmith, infuse your goods with elemental magic, and research new skills to transform your humble stall into the realm's most famous marketplace.

3792530.title: Playback
3792530.short_description: 一款心理恐怖游戏。你将探索一栋闹鬼的建筑，观看被诅咒的VHS录像带，解开谜题，并在模糊了记忆与现实界限的恐怖超自然事件中努力求生。

4818570.title: Click Roulette Demo
4818570.short_description: Click Roulette 是一款点击游戏，每一次尝试都可能让你付出生命。点击越多，风险越高，奖励也越大。权衡概率、升级、下注，并智胜其他玩家。受《Sin City》启发的黑暗黑色电影风格。懂得冒险的人才能获胜。

4198530.title: 盒体派对 Demo
4198530.short_description: Cube Party is a 2-8 player co-op puzzle and adventure game! Team up with friends, stack your box characters into walls, solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and find the key to clear 40+ unique levels!

4779020.title: Mobius Demo
4779020.short_description: 如果空间没有终点，出路又在何方？《Mobius》是一款带你打破常规认知、宛如穿行于无尽循环中的几何解谜游戏。穿过屏幕边缘以颠倒重力，在中心对称的空间中寻找视角的盲区。解开物理机关，一步步抵达“门”的另一侧——而门后等待着你的，究竟是什么？

4756720.title: Grandma's Golden Boy: Sheep Shear Madness Demo
4756720.short_description: 抢先感受你未来冒险的起点！在免费试玩版中，试着修剪各种不同的绵羊，解锁升级，并建造一台酷炫的纺车吧！

4732880.title: ZipRush: Surf the Void Demo
4732880.short_description: Experience the single-player adrenaline of VR parkour racing. Build, upload, and download custom tracks, master multi-surface movement, and compete on the global leaderboards in this feature-limited Demo.

4809020.title: Unbelievers Demo
4809020.short_description: A psychological horror FPS where time fractures between 1986 and an alternate 1919. Fight nightmarish creatures, uncover a dark conspiracy, and struggle to reclaim your place in time.

4753480.title: Forensics: Crime Scene Detective Demo
4753480.short_description: 在真实的犯罪实验室模拟器中成为法医专家。调查犯罪现场，收集微观证据，并在实验室中通过DNA和数字分析识别犯罪者。基于莱茵兰-普法尔茨州刑事警察局（LKA RLP）专家的经验与见解。

4839870.title: Pact Warden Demo
4839870.short_description: As a Marchwarden, you travel the southern roads to protect pilgrims and travelers. You will fight multi-phased bosses, shape the storylines of characters, and explore an interconnected world.

4742770.title: Viscereality Demo
4742770.short_description: Visual novel in crystal punk genre, In the recent past, humans discovered a new mineral—Visceralite. Its unique feature lies in its ability to integrate with the human body.

4808450.title: Stack Up Demo
4808450.short_description: A multiplayer tactical shooter focused on realistic weapon handling and special forces tactics. Work with your team, master authentic firearm mechanics, and fight through intense close-quarters combat across multiple game modes.

4606310.title: VoidHue Demo
4606310.short_description: 《VoidHue》是一款俯视角解谜游戏，将经典的推箱子玩法与色彩斑斓的光影机制完美融合。你需要为物体上色、混合光线并匹配颜色，以此来破解各式各样的炫彩谜题。将红、蓝、黄三原色融合，可以调配出紫、橙、绿等间色，从而激活对光线有反应的机关

4329110.title: Our Wonderland Demo
4329110.short_description: A horror-fantasy visual novel following the trials of a dysfunctional friend group thrust back into the wish-granting wonderland of their youth. Either they face the issues plaguing them or risk dying in horrific ways again… and again… and again.

4807710.title: Clay Crusade: Night of the Necromancer Demo
4807710.short_description: Hack N' Slash zombie survival horror game featuring a claymation art style set in fantasy world. Upgrade your arsenal and fight through hordes of zombies to stop the evil necromancer and return peace to the kingdom!

4675140.title: DUAL PROTOCOL: The Case of Eva & Miles Demo
4675140.short_description: 扮演特工Eva追踪线索，或扮演分析师Miles掌控全局。《Dual Protocol》是一款仅靠对话推进的非对称黑色解谜游戏。在看不到对方屏幕的情况下，结合彼此的数据，揭开Castellari谋杀案 confirm 背后真相。

4826540.title: Frutz Demo
4826540.short_description: Blast through five worlds, claim the Cosmic Gems, defeat Lord Zorkannan, and master every run in this fast arcade shooter.

4804000.title: Sol One Demo
4804000.short_description: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.

4792710.title: Procelio Demo
4792710.short_description: Procelio is a multiplayer vehicle builder/shooter set amidst a proxy war on the red planet. Build and refine your custom machines from orbit, then pilot them in a distant war against CPU and enemy players.

4756200.title: Stick A Round Demo
4756200.short_description: 在《Stick A Round》中重温童年的快乐！ 寻找独一无二生成的木棍，它们会根据真实形状变成武器。与好友开战，体验紧张刺激或轻松休闲的小游戏，并探索一个不断变化的世界——在这里，想象力就是规则。

4352240.title: Truck Simulator 2026: USA Demo
4352240.short_description: Step into the driver’s seat in Truck Simulator 2026: USA Demo! 🚚 Drive across selected American highways, haul cargo, experience realistic trucks, and get a first look at building your transport empire. 🌎

4803790.title: Rogue Kingdom Demo
4803790.short_description: 一个持续模拟、彼此相连的在线 Roguelike。你的行动会留在世界里：占下地下城、安置 NPC、守住据点。单人或和好友一起刷掉落、采矿、制作、放魔法、升级，深入怪怪的深层，遇见其他冒险者。

3821000.title: A Lighthouse Tale Demo
3821000.short_description: Return to the island of your childhood and relive fragments of your lost memories. Discover what your grandfather wanted you to remember.

4801850.title: Golden Hand Demo
4801850.short_description: 进入危险的探索区域，回收黄金与珍贵遗物，并活着返回的合作恐怖游戏。 你可以与其他玩家合作，也可以为了获得更多金钱而选择背叛。 越深入、越危险的地方，等待你的奖励也就越丰厚。

4812240.title: GRID_HACKER Demo
4812240.short_description: Guide your signal to the target while hacking into the grid network. Challenge your mind with 26 puzzles while accompanied by an immersive original soundtrack.

4712100.title: 驱灵天师 Demo
4712100.short_description: 一款融合国风民俗、神话志怪的多人联机PVE搜打撤游戏，你将化身神通各异的天师使用各类法宝，符箓，道具，完成各类民俗事件任务，与队友探索被邪祟入侵的场景降妖捉鬼，收集物资道具宝物，诛灭各路妖魔鬼怪，体验沉浸式中式除祟冒险。

4807240.title: Room Craft Demo
4807240.short_description: Room Craft 是一款创意模拟游戏，让您可以将梦想中的房间变为现实。使用各种家具、装饰品和室内细节设计独特的空间。

4574260.title: Oops Unit Demo
4574260.short_description: Oops Unit 是一款最多支持6人的在线合作游戏。解开谜题、收集资源，突破致命陷阱与敌人，拆除每一颗炸弹。活下来、购买新装备并重复任务——因为任何事物，甚至朋友，都可能破坏任务。

4380140.title: Yots Demo
4380140.short_description: 一款最多支持四名玩家的合作生存恐怖游戏。完成指标，与迷雾之城中的怪物战斗，并利用古代遗物打造独一无二的战斗流派。

4715170.title: ZAIBALY Demo
4715170.short_description: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault.

4805730.title: Fix & Flick Demo
4805730.short_description: 恭喜！您已被选为今年 SICRED SYSTEMS 游戏周的负责人。您的任务是买卖和维修二手游戏机，同时管理您的店铺。服务顾客，发掘游戏机的秘密，完成您的各项职责。我们期待您的出色服务。

3987550.title: 让帝国再次伟大 Demo
3987550.short_description: 这是一款模拟经营+回合制自动战斗游戏。“黄昏末日”即将到来，帝国危在旦夕！您的子民需要裹腹的食物，体面的工作，最好再来点刺激的娱乐，但怪物们霸占着您的土地，掠夺着您的良田与矿产！拔剑吧，为帝国收复失地！建设吧，打造最繁华的帝国城市！子民们，不必害怕“黄昏”，因为新的“太阳”已经升起！

4753190.title: Tomboy Adventure 2 Demo
4753190.short_description: 和你的（女）朋友一起开始一段轻松的冒险吧！

4752290.title: HYPER DETONATOR Demo
4752290.short_description: HYPER DETONATOR is a chain-reaction bullet hell shooter set in cyberspace. Blast through the virus spreading across the mainframe, and detonate bombs to set off devastating chain reactions. How long will you survive?

4575290.title: Stuck in the Sewers Demo
4575290.short_description: Stuck in the Sewers is a chill puzzle game about finding your way out in a maze of pipes.

4813370.title: Limerence Demo: Gen's Story
4813370.short_description: A side story from Genevieve's perspective. A branching narrative about having fun with an AI companion...

4805500.title: Dirty Laundry Demo
4805500.short_description: Unable to hold down a job, Emily tries her luck on the night shift at a local laundromat. However, what starts as an ordinary job quickly turns into a nightmare as bizarre customers arrive, and the dark secrets of one particularly suspicious nightly visitor change her life forever.

4466840.title: The Burning Owl Demo
4466840.short_description: Michael Clow is a freelance photographer living a quiet life in his childhood home. Troubled by his strange and creepy neighbor, he starts noticing unusual things. As he looks deeper into what's going on, he discovers secrets that were never meant to be found.

4623780.title: Save Our Queen Demo
4623780.short_description: 一款短小的递进式点击游戏，你将击败怪物并保护女王之塔。

4730020.title: 超翼战骑 ESTIQUE 试玩版
4730020.short_description: 精彩刺激、超燃刺激、超耐看的防御战！ 诞生于21世纪的终极8位元射击游戏《超翼战骑 ESTIQUE》现已登陆Steam！

4769640.title: Ascend6 Demo
4769640.short_description: Scoundrel meets Poker in this score-attacking roguelike card game! Multiple classes to choose from. Buy unique skills, equip game-altering items, and conquer the round!

4803220.title: Last Drone War Demo
4803220.short_description: 你输掉了战争。驾驶 FPV 无人机、直升机和战斗机，释放毁灭性的火力——成为现代战争中真正的王牌。

4712870.title: Tavrik Demo
4712870.short_description: A hex-grid deckbuilding roguelite where every card you play reshapes the land beneath your feet. Lay roads, raise bridges, outrun storms and wolves, and push one more hex before your energy runs out. The journey is the dungeon.

4835910.title: Banana Life Sim Demo
4835910.short_description: Banana Life Sim is a game in which you can become a banana.

3131940.title: The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian Demo
3131940.short_description: 本作是一款剧情向角色扮演类游戏，故事围绕着圣阿卡尼亚帝国的王储展开。你掌握着巨大的权力，但也肩负着责任。你能否在坚持自我的同时改变世界？每个决定都将付出相应的代价。

3811280.title: BRAMBLEFORT Demo
3811280.short_description: BRAMBLEFORT is a VR survival horror game built for exploration, immersion, and weighty combat. Journey through a desolate North Atlantic island, where rotting huts gradually give way to towering Victorian mansions as you make your way toward its center.

4771960.title: Hitchhiking to Hell Demo
4771960.short_description: 在空荡荡的道路上搭便车旅行，每辆车都可能成为你的救赎……或者你的终点。走过荒凉的地方，一路上遇到奇异的陌生人。随着路边杀手的谣言不断传播，在不可预知的遭遇中交谈、做出决定并生存下来。在奔向未知的同时。

4712180.title: Thanks for the Soup Demo
4712180.short_description: The job's simple: Go around town and satisfy your customers with some nice and hot soup. Hop on your bicycle and go around town, make some money, buy items, take care of your cat, and much more in this immersive horror simulator.

4799410.title: Crime: 1997 Demo
4799410.short_description: Newport, 1997. Waterside gang member Henry Gallagher is thrust into a lethal spiral after a failed deal. Trapped between a police crackdown and the Sorvino Mafia, Henry must navigate a city ignited by "Pulse"—a volatile new drug turning every street into a warzone.

4599410.title: Cat Life Simulator Demo
4599410.short_description: Cat Life Simulator Demo is a realistic simulation game that allows you to see the world through the eyes of a cat. This demo version lets you explore part of the world, interact with the environment, and start creating your own cat’s story.

4777580.title: Astracolypse Demo
4777580.short_description: Astracolypse is a survival-driven, turn-based RPG set on a hostile alien desert world where exiled humans must hunt, feed, and fight to survive. Build a party of outcasts, manage an ever-growing hunger, and uncover the truth behind a world that hunts you on sight.

4646870.title: The Last of RAM Demo
4646870.short_description: Play the demo of The Last of RAM, a fast-paced first-person action game about a gamer girl fighting through robots, drones, and security systems to get RAM for her dream PC.

4773110.title: 动物小超市（试玩版）
4773110.short_description: 在屏幕底部经营一家由可爱动物打理的温馨放置类超市。生产商品、补货上架、实现店铺自动化、招聘员工，并不断扩展你的小小超市。

4746580.title: Bonki D Bonk Demo
4746580.short_description: 杀穿无尽怪物波次，拾取战利品，不断升级并叠加强力强化，组出在屏幕清掉你之前先清掉全屏的疯狂Build

4756620.title: Booty Demo
4756620.short_description: Booty's a swashbuckling, arcade-y 2D platformer game with Rocket Jumping at its core! Aim, charge, jump, shoot and fly across many islands! Loot treasure, blast enemies and climb to the top! Destroy blocks, speedrun through stages, increase your bounty and unlock gameplay-altering curses! Demo Ver!

4769030.title: Masters of Mayhem Demo
4769030.short_description: A vibrant social‑deduction with roguelike twists, wild abilities, monsters, and nonstop mayhem.

4821640.title: Blood Moon Serenade: Complete Edition Demo
4821640.short_description: Enter the secret world of vampire aristocracy in this otome visual novel. Read, choose, and shape your heroine’s fate in the Complete Edition, including all three Blood Moon Serenade titles.

4776310.title: Depth:Origin Demo
4776310.short_description: Battle against "music" in a rhythm x shooting x adventure game. To quell the cursed object "Depth Origin," which has been reported to devour people, play a game within a game and uncover the "truth" hidden within the cursed object.

4669520.title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu Demo
4669520.short_description: 最多可四人合作，组建探险者小队，踏上寻宝之旅。这片被诅咒的丛林危机四伏，怪物扭曲了现实。保持冷静，在丛林吞噬你之前征服它……...

4829240.title: BUDGE Demo
4829240.short_description: A co-op movement game. Lift heavy golden offerings to a mighty altar and please the gods, or simply ride along as your friends do all the lifting. Falling often is part of the journey. Success comes from picking yourself back up and mastering coordination.

4019510.title: Edge of Memories Demo
4019510.short_description: Avaris 的人口正遭受 Corrosion 的肆虐，这是一种可怕的瘟疫，会将所有感染者突变成诡异的怪物。扮演年轻的游牧者 Eline，与盟友并肩作战，共同拯救世界免于毁灭。

4799300.title: Island Wolves Demo
4799300.short_description: You are a wolf. Hunt prey and gather materials to build your camp, decorate your den and grow your pack. Fight off rival wolves or avoid combat altogether by using the environment to your advantage. Explore the islands and discover the truth behind the lost packs.

4407150.title: Outpath VR Demo
4407150.short_description: An experimental VR base building game. Craft, gather & manage resources, build your base and buy more islands to exploit and expand!

4656740.title: Real Car Market Simulator Together Demo
4656740.short_description: Start from nothing and build your own car trading empire in Real Car Market Simulator Together Demo. Buy, inspect, negotiate, repair, and sell vehicles solo or with up to 4 players. Every deal is a risk, and only smart teamwork leads to profit in this Demo.

4732620.title: Paw Pew Pew Demo
4732620.short_description: A fast-paced 3D roguelike shooter set in a world where nature and hostile technology violently collide. Customize your heroes with unique professions, collect devastating weapons, and adapt your build each run to rescue your friends from the Robo-Beast army!
developers: PT Sangnila Interaktif Media dan Teknologi
publishers: PT Sangnila Interaktif Media dan Teknologi

4683950.title: Prison Life Sim 2026 - Survival Demo
4683950.short_description: Survive the harsh reality of prison life in Prison Life Sim 2026 - Survival Demo. Manage resources, build relationships, sneak, fight, and make choices that shape your fate in a world where every decision matters in this Demo

4699110.title: Crococo
4699110.short_description: An urban legend says there are alligators living in the sewers of New York. Go down there… and see for yourself. A 90s-style comedy horror game featuring classic single-voice VHS dubbing.

4753120.title: SUMMER ROAD 10-Minute Auto Roguelite DEMO
4753120.short_description: 10分钟就能享受的Roguelite RPG。 “自动战斗” × “换装” × “Roguelite”

4683970.title: Airport Manager Simulator 2026 Demo
4683970.short_description: Take full control of a busy international airport in this Demo. Manage passengers, baggage, aircraft servicing, and flight schedules while operating real ground equipment. Balance efficiency, safety, and satisfaction in a fast-paced aviation experience. ✈️

4719090.title: Budget Renovation Simulator Demo
4719090.short_description: Turn "Trash" into "Cash" in Budget Renovation Simulator Demo! 💰 Buy a wrecked house, hunt for the cheapest materials, repair instead of replace, and maximize your profit. Experience the core mechanics of the full game and see if you can finish the renovation without going broke.

4706680.title: You Within Me
4706680.short_description: Indie single-player 2D narrative-driven yandere horror game with hide-and-seek and puzzle-solving mechanisms, as well as multiple endings. After unknowingly and unintentionally gaining the romantic attention of an unhinged individual, will you survive, or will you be... consumed?

4626460.title: The 4 Masked Demo
4626460.short_description: A 4-player co-op FPS adventure where you swing through trees using vines, escape wild animals, and survive dangerous biomes. Each player has a unique role, and teamwork is the key to survival.

4125090.title: PACOSTEP Demo
4125090.short_description: PacoStep is a hardcore platformer set in a tree world consumed by darkness. Join Paco, the last surviving spirit, and explore the ruined forest to uncover the source of corruption and reveal the truth hidden in this dying world.

4807360.title: Excalibur's Swordstone Idle Forge Demo
4807360.short_description: Excalibur's Swordstone Idle Forge is a cozy little medieval clicker with a big appetite. You're a blacksmith pulling legendary swords from stones, handing them to knights, and stacking gold higher and higher

4254970.title: 鹰派大统领 Demo
4254970.short_description: 好评如潮的《时空叛客》制作组最新力作！在这款动作肉鸽游戏中，你将挑战邪恶的现任总统！白天，建设基地、争取选票；夜晚，化身西装暴徒，深入敌后，击溃犯罪组织，拯救毛茸茸的外星生物。随心搭配数十种异能与武器，在千变万化的关卡中构筑你的专属流派！

4064510.title: MOLE
4064510.short_description: 驾驶战后打造的钻地巨兽——“鼹鼠号”钻探船，深入斯拉夫地底。修复系统故障，追随亡者的呼唤，与同处这具“深渊铁棺”中的未知存在对峙，祈祷自己能活下来。在这地底深处，率先崩溃的，究竟会是这钻地铁躯，还是你自己？

4555230.title: Crunchy Bear: Dig Dig Pals Demo
4555230.short_description: 养一只脆饼熊吧，它正等着陪你一起上班！ 你每按下一个按键，脆饼熊就会跟着敲敲桌面。打字、点击、玩游戏还是工作，全都会变成它的收获。 快来看看脆饼熊今天又挖到了什么好东西！

4772540.title: Floppy Desk Demo
4772540.short_description: Try the core Floppy Desk match experience for free: a fast retro card game about matching colors, numbers, and wild specials. Play solo against bots or online with friends on a neon desktop.

4613520.title: We’re In Trouble Demo
4613520.short_description: A CO-OP stealth game about a problem that can’t wait until morning. 🕵️‍♂️ An empty office, a body, and absolute silence. Work together, avoid guards and cameras, handle unpredictable physics, and escape unnoticed. One mistake can ruin everything in this Demo.

4816690.title: Hello Operator Demo
4816690.short_description: Zài zhè kuǎn fēnwéi nónghòu, jùqíng fēngfù de xuányí yóuxì zhōng, bànyǎn bù lì sī wéi'ěr wéiyī de jiēxiànyuán. Zài hūn'àn de jiēxiànyuán xíwèi shàng, jiētīng diànhuà, jiāntīng tōnghuà, jiē kāi zhèn mín zhī jiān jiūchán de mìmì, yǐjí tāmen lǐmào wèizhuāng xià de hēi'àn.

4635100.title: SCP Foundation: Universe Horror Demo
4635100.short_description: Survive inside a secret SCP facility in this Demo. Explore dark corridors, avoid or confront anomalous entities, manage limited resources, and outsmart unpredictable AI to stay alive in a world where containment can fail at any moment.

4613580.title: Are We Sinking Yet? Demo
4613580.short_description: Are We Sinking Yet? Demo is a chaotic co-op rafting game for 2-4 players where teamwork is the only way to survive. Paddle together to steer your raft, dodge dangerous river obstacles, solve environmental puzzles, and try not to throw your friends overboard in this Demo.

4635060.title: Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator Demo
4635060.short_description: Investigate a deadly conspiracy in Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator Demo. Search for clues, sneak through dangerous locations, solve environmental puzzles, and make choices that shape the fate of a corrupt 1950s border city in this Demo.

4670200.title: Mosaica: Goblin Girl Demo
4670200.short_description: 轻松视觉小说 • 放置点击 • 益智 RPG 走进一个充满奇趣、Cozy 氛围与治愈美学的奇幻故事。

4635610.title: 8 Ball Pool: Play Together Demo
4635610.short_description: Step into a lively bar and experience classic 8-ball pool in 8 Ball Pool: Play Together Demo. Play locally with friends, challenge players online, or test your skills against AI. Master realistic mechanics, manage your cue with the chalk system, and rise through the ranks to unlock new customization

4816140.title: Formic Fortress Demo
4816140.short_description: Formic Fortress is a local co-op tower defense party game with rogue-like elements. Scavenge and throw blocks to build your anthill and fend off waves of nasty bugs! Protect your queen, survive the swarm, and unleash the dormant strength of your ammo through powerful upgrades resetting every run.

4660550.title: Bloody Cleanup TOGETHER Demo
4660550.short_description: Clean up the aftermath of terrible events in Bloody Cleanup Together Demo, a co-op horror cleaning sim for up to 4 players. Remove blood, hide evidence, carry bodies, and restore every detail before anything is discovered in this Demo. 🩸

4832320.title: 孤岛求生指南试玩版
4832320.short_description: 与挚友合作生存，探索充满未知的海洋孤岛；伐木采矿、搜刮建造，通过战术分工打造出抵御暴风雨的温馨营地。面对黑夜海怪侵袭，和伙伴并肩战斗守卫家园！在喂养巨兽的温馨日常里，勇敢守护相依为命的巨龟伙伴，搜集迷失的动物神灵并供奉于图腾神庙，将孤岛改造成充满生机的移动避风港！

4626990.title: Greed Party Demo
4626990.short_description: Demo of a co-op party game where you collect coins, gamble for weapons in slot machines, and fight a boss together in a cursed world of greed.

4844890.title: Antidote Demo
4844890.short_description: 30 minutes. That is all the time you have left before the infection consumes you. Bitten and lost in the heart of a procedurally generated bunker, your only chance of survival is to locate and inject the antidote hidden within its depths. The countdown has begun.

4707230.title: Cozy Offroad Simulator Together Demo
4707230.short_description: Explore harsh wilderness together in Cozy Offroad Simulator Together, a relaxing co-op driving adventure where teamwork, smart preparation, and realistic offroad mechanics help you survive mud, snow, storms, and dangerous terrain 🚙🌲

4750500.title: Fractured Realms Demo
4750500.short_description: Train classic RPG skills, build and upgrade your own outpost, and progress through a handcrafted fantasy world in this idle-style, UI-driven pixel RPG inspired by RuneScape and Melvor Idle

4802620.title: Satawn Demo
4802620.short_description: Satawn aims for a more complete village life experience: farming, building, inventory, scene-based exploration, transitions between zones, day and night cycles, cinematics integrated into gameplay, and a task system ranging from simple requests to neighbors

4798400.title: Air Hockey: Magical Heroes Demo
4798400.short_description: A magical roguelite twist on air hockey! Battle forest animals, collect power-ups, and survive a series of intense air hockey matches.

4810220.title: 回圈Loop Demo
4810220.short_description: 你独自醒来于深海钻井平台，唯一的同伴是正在退化的 AI——LUMEN。20 分钟后，这里将化为火海。寻找线索，规划路线，逃出生天。死亡不是终点，记忆才是你唯一的武器。在这个关于孤独、时间与意识碎片的心理恐怖游戏中，每一次循环都让你离真相更近一步……但那真的是你想要的吗？

4779080.title: 宇宙丰收：无限成长 试玩版
4779080.short_description: 《宇宙丰收：无限成长》是一款轻松休闲的放置增量游戏，带你展开星际旅行。探索全新星球，收集稀有资源，发展科技，并不断解锁更多可能性！

4799460.title: 王国大战僵尸 试玩版
4799460.short_description: 《王国大战僵尸》是一款融合了策略、塔防和 Roguelike 元素的游戏，你将守卫自己的王国，抵御无穷无尽的亡灵大军。

4779070.title: 神威之境：第八位神 试玩版
4779070.short_description: 俯视角 肉鸽 自动战斗游戏，每位英雄都使用魔法阵作战。组合七位神明的力量构筑流派，解锁拥有稀有能力的角色，带领你的英雄穿越数百敌人的浪潮。

4816020.title: VeilStalker Demo
4816020.short_description: 一款支持单人和合作游玩的奇幻生存游戏。作为一名现代猎人，你被困在一个残酷而充满魔法的世界中。建造基地、搜寻稀缺弹药、猎杀传奇生物，并在巨型怪物、游荡亡灵和严酷环境的威胁下努力生存。

4534640.title: Wobble Mayhem Demo
4534640.short_description: Wobble Mayhem throws you into chaotic wobbling battles where staying on your feet is half the challenge. Funny physics control every move, turning fights into pure chaos. Throw enemies off the map, lose balance, or knock out teammates. Every match is unpredictable and never the same.

4074970.title: Cinema Manager Simulator Demo
4074970.short_description: 🎬 管理并扩展你的影院。升级设备、安排电影、设定票价、雇佣员工并处理维修，打造终极观影体验！ 🍿

4821810.title: Scratch the Ticket Demo
4821810.short_description: Scratch the Ticket 是一款围绕彩票刺激感展开的增量游戏。打印彩票，刮开格子，然后决定：现在收钱，还是赌上一切。结果只取决于你的选择。

4292150.title: Songtail: Whiskers of Destiny
4292150.short_description: You play as Felina Songblade, a whimsical bard who is invited to perform at various cozy and magical venues. Explore three distinct acts, meet a cast of colorful characters, and find out how to affect destinies through song. Featuring cute pixel art, quirky writing, and a lot of charm.

4830150.title: Hollowforge Demo
4830150.short_description: Manage an expedition of dwarves as they build out a colony under the surface in this incremental game. Assign your dwarves to farm food, forge runes, hunt trolls and mine ore!

4809910.title: Via Sudoku Demo
4809910.short_description: Sudoku is about logic, not guessing. Experience the classic puzzle in its purest form, enhanced by an interactive system that teaches you advanced techniques. Master logical patterns, use intuitive tools, and solve puzzles of any difficulty in a calm, minimalist atmosphere.

4627870.title: FEED IT Demo
4627870.short_description: A first-person, PSX-style horror game about living with a monster. Do as you're told... or don't. Just be ready for the (demo-sized) consequences.

4765960.title: Trivia Murder Party 3 Demo
4765960.short_description: Your favorite trivia-obsessed serial killer is heading to summer camp to put you through a sinister new set of minigames and murder. Take a stab at answering questions correctly, engage in luck and skill-based activities, and sabotage your fellow campers in order to survive the summer.

4285950.title: Key Clover
4285950.short_description: 键盘四叶草帮助你进入心流状态，小猫陪着你打字，每打一些字，你就能转动一次幸运机器，获得更多的金币！看看今天你能赚多少金币吧。每天关注你的金币和按键数，与全球玩家共同比拼谁更卷！

4602080.title: Frontiers Reach : Mercenaries Demo
4602080.short_description: Step into the shoes of a mercenary on the edge of human occupied space as you engage in an immersive world of survival, faction warfare, and a fight to stop an alien empire from destroying human life on the frontier of outer space.

4642290.title: Expandaball Demo
4642290.short_description: 球越大，挑战就越大。在这款令人上瘾的物理平台游戏中，利用熊猫的成长达到新的高度。

4844850.title: Unbound Pioneer Demo
4844850.short_description: 这是一个2D俯视角生存游戏，在游戏中，玩家将在一个丰富多彩又充满挑战的世界中生存下去，在不断的探索收集和合成建造中不断变强。探索矿洞，开采更强大材料，强化装备，探索遗迹，战胜强敌，获取宝藏，制作法杖，建造法术塔与领地，挑战维度入侵事件，获取更多更好的资源。还可以进一步建造一些自动化设施实现资源的高效获取、通过祭坛转换获取人物特殊能力、在无限可能性的各种独特维度穿梭并进一步掌控空间和资源。

4774900.title: 南京大屠杀：拉贝日记-Nanjing Massacre: John Rabe's Diary Demo
4774900.short_description: 这是一款以南京大屠杀真实历史为背景、基于约翰·拉贝人道主义事迹及其日记原文的文字互动类游戏。你将扮演德国商人约翰·拉贝，置身于南京安全区的绝境之中。每日面对的历史突发事件与沉重抉择，都将随着你的选择，化为纸面上字字泣血的日记篇章，你的笔触将直接决定千万中国难民的生死存亡。

4751400.title: GUTTED: Infested Crypts Demo
4751400.short_description: 深入被诅咒墓园下方遭虫灾侵蚀的地下墓穴，在这款充满冲击力的动作恐怖FPS中杀出生路。使用沉重而 brutal 的枪战、血腥肢解，对抗腐烂怪物，而你与黑暗之间只剩下一支濒临熄灭的手电筒。

4822620.title: Top Bins Demo
4822620.short_description: 一款放置类游戏，你需要射门击中移动球门来赢取金钉。用金钉进行强力升级，这样你就能获得更多金钉，并在任意球挑战中击败守门员 Boss，从而提升联赛等级！

4640010.title: Pizza Man Simulator Demo
4640010.short_description: 披萨烤焦了？直接用番茄酱淹没它！在你的餐厅里，把冷冻夏威夷披萨放进微波炉加热简直就是日常。服务挑剔的顾客、升级你的披萨店，并在厨房里即兴发挥。最重要的规则？没人食物中毒……而且钱要对得上。

4643280.title: CLAW - Cosmic Legendary Animal Warfare
4643280.short_description: Build modular ships, send them into autonomous battles, and survive through smart planning and resource management. Destroy enemy bases by outlasting their fleets and breaking their defenses with drones.

4709320.title: Corporate Entropy Demo
4709320.short_description: Climb the ladder while burning it down. In this satirical management sim, you work for a corporation rolling out ARIA — an AI that's replacing your coworkers. Balance your performance cover against quiet sabotage, organize your resistance, and survive 8 quarters with your soul mostly intact.

4709640.title: OIL.EXE
4709640.short_description: Drill the wells. Run the refinery. Read the market. OIL is a free text-based simulation of running a petroleum operation, played at a 1980s green-phosphor terminal. End each year richer or bankrupt. Mind the bear market. Climb the leaderboard.

4272720.title: Pickupbal
4272720.short_description: A simple game all about picking up a ball.

3205520.title: Kooeh: A Timeless Delight
3205520.short_description: Kooeh: A Timeless Delight is a heartwarming cosy narrative-driven restaurant management game about rediscovering lost family recipes and reviving the family restaurant.

4837160.title: Spheromania Demo
4837160.short_description: Bounce, blast, and outlast in Spheromania. A fast-paced arena shooter where drones duel with blasters, mines, and mid-air hops. Manage your energy, dodge the shrinking arena, and be the last sphere hovering. Solo mode or online multiplayer.

4706400.title: Going Once!
4706400.short_description: Going Once! is a cozy art gallery / auction house management game. Appraise and buy art, display it in your gallery and auction it off to the highest bidder!

4853550.title: Roses In Concrete Demo
4853550.short_description: Inspired by a famous poem from a legendary deceased American rapper, Roses In Concrete is an exercise in distilling a literary work into gameplay mechanics that reinforce its core message.

838350.title: 太吾绘卷：天幕心帷
838350.short_description: 《太吾绘卷》是一款以神话和武侠为题材的独立游戏。玩家将扮演神秘的“太吾氏传人”，在以古代中华神州为背景的架空世界中，通过一代又一代传人的努力和牺牲，最终击败强大的宿敌，决定人世的命运。

4248870.title: Incremental Ragebait
4248870.short_description: 一款受《Nodebuster》启发、轻松休闲的增量式游戏。拖动凡人来激怒他们，夺取他们的灵魂。 购买新武器。解锁升级。建造炼狱。激怒上帝。

4855540.title: Expedition Idle Demo
4855540.short_description: An idle auto-battler ARPG where you create one-of-a-kind items with crafting materials you pick up from the ground, customize your adventurers with different abilities and stats, and strategize your way through difficult bosses, unique scenarios, and dynamic monsters!

4846900.title: 陋室与猫 Demo
4846900.short_description: 《陋室与猫》是一款放置玩法的暖心小游戏。风雨交加的夜晚，你在一间破旧屋子里遇见了流浪猫们。你可以什么都不做，只是听雨、休息、听猫咪打呼噜；也可以拿起刷子帮它们清理毛发——刷下的毛团，就是它们给你的报酬。用这些毛团，把这间破屋子一点点变得温馨。每只猫都有真实的流浪故事，我边画边哭。希望它们，也能触动你。

4180860.title: Nacho Chihuahua: The Movie: The Game
4180860.short_description: Join Nacho as he pursues his true destiny: to return to his homeland, South of the Border!

4813100.title: Fast Lap Racing Demo
4813100.short_description: In Fast Lap Racing, you drive street cars on challenging tracks, improve your car’s performance, customize its look, and compete for positions on global leaderboards for each circuit and layout.

4356100.title: Null Hørizøn
4356100.short_description: Survive the void in Null Hørizøn. Trade, fight, and explore a retro-futuristic 3D galaxy with 2D sprites. Upgrade your ship, smuggle goods, and travel across the universe. Tactical Real-Time combat meets Grid-based exploration in this atmospheric space sim. The Null Hørizøn calls, Captain.

2695710.title: God For A Day
2695710.short_description: 在这款叙事型模拟游戏中，您扮演上帝之子。您的使命：决定、祝福或谴责城市居民。在做出决策之前，通过他们的物品和秘密揭示他们的故事。您的选择将改变城市的命运，并影响您在审判日的启示。

4716080.title: DEATH PENALTY Demo
4716080.short_description: YOU ARE SENTENCED TO DEATH... Slither your way through an impenetrable fortress crawling with devils faster, stronger, and more cunning than any human. By sheer luck you've slipped through the cracks, but discovery means certain death. How long are you going to delay the inevitable?

4747060.title: GobboQuestIdle
4747060.short_description: Help Gobbo escape a mysterious cave, grow stronger, collect pets, fight strange bosses, fish, farm, mine, craft, upgrade gear, and continue the adventure in an endless fantasy world.

4689130.title: [Room Escape] April First
4689130.short_description: This is an escape room game. Recommended for players who have experienced at least 30 escape rooms.

1963590.title: ME_iON
1963590.short_description: ME_iON is an online multiplayer shooter game with offline base-building mechanics, that's weird wacky and funny there are also funny little watermelons with banana guns so what's not to love about that :D

4766420.title: Uncle Otto's Mansion
4766420.short_description: You play as Audrey, who has just inherited a mansion from an uncle she never met. Step inside and explore the mansion to unveil the story of what happened to your uncle Otto, his butler, and this kinda creepy place. 😬

4836200.title: Future Fab Heroes Demo
4836200.short_description: Future Fab Hero, your mission begins now! Team up with your robot companion, CHIP-E, to complete hands-on technology and manufacturing simulations, earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and defend the Mars Innovation Zone from alien threats in a unique educational adventure.

4850900.title: Blightsilver Demo
4850900.short_description: Dark urban fantasy + hidden-grid strategy card game. Investigate liminal places. Duel on a secret 5×5 board where every face-down cards might be a lie. Nex Crowmont—a university nobody—is pulled into a conspiracy beneath ordinary life.

4843650.title: if you stay demo
4843650.short_description: Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together.

4036160.title: Backrooms Lost Dimension
4036160.short_description: Backrooms: Lost Dimension is a single-player horror game with puzzles, survival, and an original story. Explore mysterious levels, journey through unknown dimensions, and uncover hidden secrets along the way. Play the first chapter for free and continue the adventure by unlocking the next ones.

3235330.title: KYRO Demo
3235330.short_description: In this 30-45 minute demo, play as Aiden. Explore the Forest of Ka'a, solve puzzles to uncover ancient ruins, and use your slingshot and the KYRO system to conquer early bosses in this top-down, pixel art action-adventure prologue.

4667320.title: PolyDogfight Demo
4667320.short_description: Prepare to Fly, Dodge, Shoot, and Destroy in PolyDogfight. Unlock all the planes and maps to find your style. Obliterate waves of planes in an open-air arena as quickly as possible to get the high score and top the global leaderboard!

4828790.title: Mystery of Prophecy Demo
4828790.short_description: Myst of Proph is a pixel art Metroidvania based on biblical prophecies, health, and parkour.

4045010.title: Meowtabolism - Examining Feline Behavior within Unicellular Algae
4045010.short_description: 化身猫咪，在藻类细胞中展开冒险。探索微观尺度下的广大世界。

4712350.title: HypnoTiles
4712350.short_description: HypnoTiles is a puzzle game of the falling blocks variety. Its psychedelic graphics, hypnotic soundtrack and absorbing gameplay put the player in an almost trance-like state. Features 3 game modes and online highscores.

4718580.title: LIMICORE Demo
4718580.short_description: LIMICORE is a dark and narratively driven experience containing uncovered mysteries. Traverse the world through various realities and solve engaging puzzles to discover the truth behind the organization's objectives.

4762100.title: Life Core Demo
4762100.short_description: Life Core 是一款探索未知星球的 Roguelite 动作游戏。战斗吧，消灭你的敌人！当你倒下时，在新躯体中释放“核心”的力量。但请记住……系统时刻在注视着你！

2613890.title: Icaria
2613890.short_description: Icaria is a robot colony builder where everything can be programmed. Build factories, design logistic networks, terraform the landscape, and explore an unknown alien world.

4859470.title: Fibula Demo
4859470.short_description: Embark on a dark fantasy action RPG adventure alone or with friends. Master combat and magic, explore dangerous dungeons, build a home, and create your own path through the world of Fibula.

2430020.title: Infinium
2430020.short_description: Discover a new adventure with every playthrough in this unique fantasy RPG. Every choice matters as you uncover what secrets Infinium is hiding. Will you become a daring adventurer or a rich mogul?

4692970.title: Lockdown
4692970.short_description: A short vehicle driving horror game

4787940.title: Directive: Intercept Demo
4787940.short_description: Protect Earth's last cities from an alien fleet in fast-paced aerial combat. Upgrade and customize your aircraft to dominate the skies.

1627060.title: Karting4Fun
1627060.short_description: Jump into a race full of adrenaline, sharp turns, and wild contact. Bumping and shoving opponents is not only allowed—it’s encouraged!

3719540.title: TOTAL DRIFTIN': Touge Dreams
3719540.short_description: Master each corner, burn rubber, and become a legend high in the Japanese mountains. Total Driftin’: Touge Dreams is a tribute to classic '90s drifting, with precise arcade physics, retro aesthetics, and a cult-like soul. Do you have what it takes to become a touge god?

4588680.title: Sumo Fumble: Physics Party Demo
4588680.short_description: 《Sumo Fumble》是一款搞笑的本地多人物理派对游戏。抓住对手，将他们举起并扔进各种疯狂陷阱，或者扒掉他们的裤子博君一笑。在不断变化的竞技场中跌跌撞撞，一路翻滚迈向胜利！

3588170.title: Daughter of the Rift
3588170.short_description: Daughter of the Rift is story-rich card-battling adventure with an RPG-like deck-based upgrade system.

4840820.title: Best Streamer Demo
4840820.short_description: 这里是为您翻译的简体中文版本，同样保持了紧凑、吸睛的宣传风格： 一款残酷的主播模拟游戏，在这里，为了登顶你将不择手段。你可以通过优质内容合法搞钱，也可以用武器直接抹除竞争对手。管理生存需求，动用非法手段碾压同行，躲避警方追捕，最终成为全球第一的主播 !

4625820.title: Chaos Dice Survival
4625820.short_description: 8 characters clash on a 5x5 map! A unique simultaneous turn-based survival board game where dice decide your fate upon contact. Survive the chaos and become the ultimate champion!

4759400.title: Atelier's Key
4759400.short_description: Atelier's Key is a dark-fantasy FPS set in a root-bound Victorian world inhabited by puppets. Severed from a hivemind and armed with a mysterious weapon; shoot, grapple, and unlock your way through this world to save a Father from his own damned creation.

4322960.title: Trail & Error
4322960.short_description: A chaotic co-op survival game for 1–4 players where you travel the trail, manage supplies, survive disasters, and argue with friends. Work together to keep the wagon moving, adapt to random events, and try to make it to the end in one piece.

4796550.title: Super Money Ring Demo
4796550.short_description: A twist on the classic Super Monkey Ball series, this time with a ring. Race ghosts and compete on the online leaderboard for the fastest time on any of the 100 carefully crafted levels.

4599080.title: .VXE Demo
4599080.short_description: 化身觉醒的恶意软件“矢量领主”，在这款散发着90年代微电子美学的高能动作肉鸽游戏中大开杀戒！体验零摩擦的极速高压战斗，通过主板与实体电路板硬核改装你的副手武器。你不是来拯救这个数字世界的，你是来把它彻底格式化的！

2327720.title: City Car Driving 2.0
2327720.short_description: City Car Driving 2.0 is a driving simulator designed to help novice drivers master driving in a setting as close to reality as possible.

4668480.title: Downer Management
4668480.short_description: DOWNER MANAGEMENT is a 3-vs-3 autobattler set inside a corporate purgatory where every conflict is resolved through positional politics. Promote, demote, file, transfer, and stamp your way through Department of Management Division III. Forms in triplicate. No overtime. Termination is permanent.

3294170.title: 格阵工坊
3294170.short_description: 《格阵工坊》是一款结合 8×8 棋盘佈局与卡牌构筑的策略对战游戏。每一场对局不只是出牌，更是站位、时机与资源分配的精准博弈。 你需要在有限资源下选择落点与出牌顺序：是提前佈局，还是直接压制？每一次部署都会改变棋盘局势。透过构筑与操作累积优势，最终击败对手。

2483130.title: Cube Kingdoms
2483130.short_description: 你将在一个奇幻世界里建立属于你的中世纪定居点，不断经营经济，壮大防线，迎战地精、亡灵、恶魔和史诗级Boss怪物，用自动战斗，将一切来犯之敌悉数击溃！

4803580.title: SOLID STATE HIVE Demo
4803580.short_description: Solid State Hive is a turn-based "JRPG" inspired adventure, wherein stealth may be used to sneak up on enemies or avoid them altogether and solve various types of puzzles.

4832090.title: 颅骨战争：测试场
4832090.short_description: 提供了基本全面的试玩版本

3760100.title: Pokerist™ 的 8 Ball
3760100.short_description: 体验具有绝美画面的最逼真台球游戏！与来自世界各地的数百万玩家一起免费畅玩！

4749470.title: SongSurfer
4749470.short_description: SongSurfer is a simple and relaxing rhythm experience where you control a small airplane using your mouse as it glides along a dynamic music-generated track.

4718940.title: Riftbound Survivors Demo
4718940.short_description: 《Riftbound》是一款主打法术组合与海量敌袭的类幸存者弹幕天堂游戏。消灭成千上万的敌人，尝试元素连锁反应，利用叠加的状态效果打破游戏平衡。支持单人单机或双人联机。

2210520.title: COPA CITY
2210520.short_description: COPA CITY《足球大亨》 ：首款让你化身顶级足球赛事组织者的游戏。不是教练，也不是球员，而是幕后全局的掌控者。你的荣耀之路，从哨声未响时就已开启！

4830140.title: Lost Exit Demo
4830140.short_description: A first-person psychological horror experience set in a forgotten shopping mall. Explore, investigate, and survive as reality twists into something far more sinister.

4756570.title: Darkness Has Eyes
4756570.short_description: Survive the dark in this tense atmospheric horror game. Face your fears and explore abandoned floors while searching for key items to escape the dark.

4765120.title: Dechamel Chess
4765120.short_description: Dechamel Chess is a variation on a classic chess game. The same rules apply with a few more caveats. Moats, peace times, close combats and a campaign are what makes this chess game unique and fun to play.

4623350.title: Chicken Miner Demo
4623350.short_description: 一款单人俯视角矿山经营游戏。 捕捉小鸡，并与它们一起开采矿物。 使用采集到的资源解锁更多研究、制作武器，打造更加高效的矿山。 和小鸡们一起发展你的矿山吧！

4674210.title: Foreign Rim Demo
4674210.short_description: A rich Turn-Based Strategy with deep mechanics, big armies and complex balance. Lead an expedition to explore the vast desert expanses. Play campaign, custom game, PvP, or create custom experiences with built-in scenarios and map editors!

4735560.title: The Order of Things
4735560.short_description: The Order of Things is a short first-person horror memory puzzle game. New objects appear one by one. Remember what was added, choose them in the correct order, and escape before your mistakes run out.

4726010.title: 101 Cats in Munich
4726010.short_description: 加入这场冒险，在精心打造的慕尼黑风景中，寻找101只小猫咪🐾的藏身之处。🏆赢取众多成就。你能找到多少只呢？😺快来抓紧时间！⏱️

4725990.title: 101 Cats in Sydney
4725990.short_description: 加入这场冒险，在精心打造的悉尼风景中，寻找101只小猫咪🐾的藏身之处。🏆赢取众多成就。你能找到多少只呢？😺快来抓紧时间！⏱️

4828430.title: Hidden Sheep Puzzle Demo
4828430.short_description: Can you find every sheep and solve the Sheep Puzzle? Looks simple. Isn’t.

4005490.title: Nightmares
4005490.short_description: Nightmares is a combination of a classic collectible card game and a roguelike deck builder. Race against the clock to defeat your opponent before your sanity runs out. Win or lose, you'll get the opportunity to upgrade your deck. Can you craft the ultimate deck for an undefeated run?

4756320.title: 魔導少女イバラ
4756320.short_description: "A true classic side-scrolling action game! Magical Girl Ibara, born here."

4736200.title: Dial Z to Zombie: Zombies Attack the Beach
4736200.short_description: Dial Z to Zombie is a retro-inspired old-school FPS where zombies have invaded the beach. Use ridiculous weapons, rescue survivors, discover secrets, and blast your way through a weird ’90s-inspired zombie apocalypse.

4567370.title: Rotary Knights Demo
4567370.short_description: A text-based RPG spanning the entire arc of WWI aviation. Fly 37 historical aircraft, survive dogfights against the Red Baron, manage your aerodrome on the Western Front, and make choices that determine whether your pilot lives to see the Armistice.

4365170.title: Fascist Demo
4365170.short_description: As National Guard, stand defiant against relentless hordes. Unleash righteous fury. Old Glory waves eternal and America endures because YOU fight!

4747910.title: Spitter
4747910.short_description: Your tongue is your engine. The table never stops. The pockets are waiting.

4534760.title: 盲心：伪装的幻想 Demo
4534760.short_description: 《盲心：伪装的幻想》是一款AVG游戏——不知何时，我平常的人生变得没那么平常了......那些只在网上所谓的恐怖故事里看到的伪人竟然出现在了现实，还没消化完这段消息，我的爱人林诗语敲响了我的门......

4794150.title: 极光 Demo
4794150.short_description: 《极光》是一个科幻风的fps类游戏，在游戏中，你将与艾诺一起逐步探寻自己的记忆，通过枪械，黑暗力量，智慧来应对出现的威胁或打通前进的道路，在最后找到前进的理由。

4696900.title: Escape Wheel
4696900.short_description: Escape Wheel is a 2D puzzler using time inversion mechanics. Solve half the puzzle while time moves forward, enter The Escape Wheel, and solve the other half while time moves in reverse. A whole new way to look at time travel and puzzle solving.

775620.title: Fight or Flight
775620.short_description: Battle Royale and Extraction that blends PvP and PvE, You are a operative that will drop into the infected region and attempt to recover artifacts and eradicate the infected. Each player is pitted against Zombies, Monsters and each other. Online or Single player for practice with bots!

1675860.title: Junkster
1675860.short_description: 《Junkster》是一款拥有出色建造机制的3D动作平台游戏。勇敢的小建筑机器人UM-13坠毁在一个危险的垃圾星球上。UM必须修理飞船并找回遗失的人类珍贵文物。

4745770.title: DreamRace
4745770.short_description: DreamRace is a high-speed arcade racing runner where you blast through 30 levels across six unique worlds.

4407460.title: 扑克迷阵
4407460.short_description: 在这款扑克牌回合制策略游戏中，你需要与电脑先后从棋盘上选取五张位置临近的牌，通过比较牌型判断胜负，赚取筹码。将每局游戏的筹码转化为得分，解锁更多游戏模式吧!

4791100.title: KNEE SLIDE
4791100.short_description: 一款通过膝盖滑行在宇宙彩虹赛道上飞驰的短篇计时竞速游戏。 灵活运用漂移与加速，在避免掉出赛道的同时挑战最快通关时间。 游戏共包含5个关卡，适合短时间内反复挑战。

4745530.title: Again：Loop
4745530.short_description: Find anomalies hidden within a repeating hallway. Miss one, or make the wrong choice, and everything resets back to the beginning.

4694800.title: ハコ入りユウシャ ポルックス
4694800.short_description: Charge ahead with “INVINCIBILITY”! A Unique 2D Action Game set in a Weird World, brought to life with Retro Pixel Graphics!

4773680.title: 喵喵便利店
4773680.short_description: 可以在你在娱乐、工作甚至是学习的时候让你放松的一款挂机游戏。它不会挡住你的区域，它还可以很方便的随意移动窗口，不会影响到你的工作区域，你需要做的只是在需要放松一下、喘口气的时候，拖拽一下商品，然后奖励一下猫猫就好了。

4731470.title: Astropath
4731470.short_description: Draw your path through the stars. Dodge asteroids, survive encounters, and chart a course across each level in this fast-paced skill-based game.

4848300.title: Ultimate Sportsball Championship Demo
4848300.short_description: Ultimate Sportsball Championship (USC) is the mixed sportsball game your mom warned you about. You are not ready for this. Keep scrolling.

4758660.title: Vegas Hold'Em: Ultimate Casino Hold'em Poker Collection With Strategy Trainer
4758660.short_description: The ultimate single-player casino poker collection. 7 Poker Hold'em variants vs the dealer, Live AI Strategy Advisor that runs fully offline, Hand Lab analyzer, step-by-step tutorials, up to 3 hands at once. No real money. One-time price — no microtransactions, no energy bars, no ads.

4314500.title: Waste Runner: Critical Waste
4314500.short_description: 扮演城市垃圾收集员，直面潜伏在街头的各种危险。游戏采用俯视等距视角，你需要穿梭于多个城市街区，收集、运输并安全处置垃圾。

4754000.title: I FORGOT TO TAKE THE CHICKEN OUT OF THE FREEZER
4754000.short_description: You forgot to defrost the chicken. Now there are zombies. Aim, shoot, sprint, and reload through a stormy graveyard in this single-player survival shooter, dodging a relentless boss named Um Fatima while reflecting on the dinner that could have been.

4693630.title: KILL LOOP Demo
4693630.short_description: 反弹！击杀！加速！这是一款极简高速动作游戏！在无尽的反弹和循环里不断杀戮，在极简的世界里感受击杀带来的快感吧！

3935190.title: Doom Party
3935190.short_description: Doom Party is a fast-paced parkour and mini-games experience featuring vertical challenges, obstacle gameplay, climbing mechanics, and stylized environments with more content coming soon.

4776790.title: Puzzle O´Matic
4776790.short_description: 探索舒适的小岛，拍摄可爱的动物和美丽的地方，并将每张照片变成手工拼图，您可以立即完成，也可以保存起来以后再拼。

4835960.title: Dungeons and Treasure 2 Demo
4835960.short_description: Dungeons and Treasure II is a voxel action roguelike for 1-4 players. Brave endless, scaling floors with 100+ items, buffs, and permanent unlocks. Explore procedural zones with unique bosses, secrets, and traps. Features full controller support and mid-run saves for desktop play.

4835580.title: Find Cats 7 Art & Alchemy Demo
4835580.short_description: 180只彩色猫咪散落在三幅中世纪画卷：挂满药瓶的炼金房、塞满油画的画家阁楼、繁花深处的哥特花园。每只都看得见但藏得隐蔽：花瓣背后、瓶罐阴影、油画角落……每只都有专属提示。27种喵声+4首BGM，治愈又考眼力。

4787030.title: Merge Hidden 合成寻物
4787030.short_description: 每一个隐藏物体都被一分为二！在精美制作的场景中找到两半、拼合还原，才是真正的「找到」。五大主题场景，脑洞大开的合成组合（草帽+雪人、盾牌+剑），简单上手，适合所有爱解谜的人。

4777050.title: 末日逃离Demo
4777050.short_description: 在崩塌的后末日世界中搜集资源、躲避怪物，并在黑暗吞噬一切之前成功撤离。死亡将失去你带出的所有物品。

4727120.title: 无效化 Demo
4727120.short_description: 温妮娅是疗养院里唯一的孩子，每天沉浸在自己的幻想世界中冒险。凯则是这里一位冷漠严谨的医生，负责治疗病人、诊断问题患者的病情。一个天真烂漫，一个理性实证，两人运行在截然不同的轨道上，却又彼此相互影响……

4845760.title: Hey Tom! Demo
4845760.short_description: Stranded on an abandoned island hunted by the terrifying creature Tom, you must fight, scavenge, and manipulate your environment to survive

4790940.title: Vibe or Dare
4790940.short_description: Vibe or Dare is a party card game where friends reveal truths, complete dares, vote on outcomes, and compete for the strongest vibe in the room.

4796850.title: LIMINAL ESCAPE
4796850.short_description: LIMINAL ESCAPE is a Backrooms co-op survival horror game for up to 4 players, where you and your friends will fight to escape from the unsettling, endless depths of Liminal space.

4694070.title: Roses In Concrete
4694070.short_description: Inspired by a famous poem from a legendary deceased American rapper, Roses In Concrete is an exercise in distilling a literary work into gameplay mechanics that reinforce its core message.

4788390.title: Cyber-Nanotech Horde Survivor
4788390.short_description: Defend the system core in this fast-paced cybernetic roguelite! Fight a self-merging digital virus, decrypt firewall nodes for powerful real-time subroutines, and defeat giant boss kernels. Spend credits on persistent hardware upgrades to survive the endless purge.

3739720.title: Obscuris
3739720.short_description: 以现代日本为背景的1–6人合作恐怖游戏。扮演日本女高中生，探索诡异地点（部分为程序生成），夜间收集Obscure，完成致命配额并在黎明前逃离。自定义角色。剧情模式尚未开放。

4796680.title: Scratch your Luck Demo
4796680.short_description: Scratch tickets, upgrade your odds, and pay deadlines before you go broke.

4827580.title: Astral Boost Demo
4827580.short_description: Astral Boost is a fast-paced endless runner where players build and maintain momentum by striking clouds and chaining boosts together. Set against vibrant skies and accompanied by an energetic soundtrack, the objective is to travel as high as possible and achieve the highest score you can.

4742780.title: Through Ash
4742780.short_description: Through Ash is a first-person tragedy where you control a logistics rover from a failing bunker. You never leave the bunker, only guide the rover via terminals. As mistakes mount, the rover’s “critical package” reveals a deeply personal truth.

3814380.title: Mini Lucy
3814380.short_description: A move. A shared room. And suddenly... everything feels huge. Lucy wakes up feeling tiny in her own room. Explore your surroundings as you’ve never seen them before, collect crystal shards, and return to your normal size with the help of Bob, a mysterious little magical creature.

4657450.title: Wing Walker Demo
4657450.short_description: 在这款快节奏、考验技巧的平台游戏中，你需要奔跑、跳跃，并在移动的飞机上生存下来。你需要在飞机之间跳跃，掌握精准的时机，并努力在速度和混乱程度不断增加的情况下保持平衡，因为你知道，一个错误就会让你坠落。

4766460.title: Grapixo Arte em Guerra Demo
4766460.short_description: Scratch in a 2.5D world that blends hip hop aesthetics with action/platforming, where urban art has come to life. Explore dynamic environments, face cleaning robots, and uncover secrets of this vibrant world as you reclaim your identity in this intense and colorful adventure.

4680400.title: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe Demo
4680400.short_description: 你的妹妹15年前失踪了。你回来了，带走她的东西还在。第一人称心理恐怖，无战斗。每个实体有独特的猎杀方式，设法生存。重温她的记忆。连接真实手机来探测并面对威胁。

4740180.title: Prison Gambit Demo
4740180.short_description: Welcome to the Prison. A social party game for 4-12 players. Trust, bluff and manipulate your way through different social minigames. No teams, only alliances. No traitors, only betrayals. Only one walks free.

3524580.title: Becoming Pablo Demo
3524580.short_description: Rule the underworld in Becoming Pablo. A grand-strategy city-builder set in the gritty 70s-90s drug trade. Lead a cartel, conquer territories, manage operations, and outsmart your rivals. This isn't just about building an empire. It's about surviving it.

4804260.title: 不佳乐队 Demo
4804260.short_description: 这是一部以校园高中生乐队为背景的视觉小说。性别认同，自由理念与传统观念的一次激烈碰撞。你将扮演乐队的贝斯手，选择你对这些问题的答案，去体验这个特殊乐队的故事。

4512220.title: Beatlow Demo
4512220.short_description: A fast-paced rhythm game where every mistake costs a life. Hit the right keys in time with the music, survive escalating mutators, buy power-ups, and push your run as far as possible.

4815090.title: FILENDS Demo
4815090.short_description: 《FILENDS》是一款暗黑风格的多人解谜游戏，支持2-7名玩家共同参与。玩家需通力合作，破解充满凶杀谜案与悲剧故事的关卡。通过环境线索与实时聊天功能，逐步揭开真相的面纱。你们究竟能解开谜题，还是会成为谜题的一部分？

4004940.title: Race! Then Retry...
4004940.short_description: A fast paced, difficult, arcade racing experience. Race through over 30 unique tracks as you try to survive and beat the clock.

4846750.title: World Order: Global Power Demo
4846750.short_description: Rule any nation in one of the most detailed geopolitical simulations ever created. Balance economics, diplomacy, military strategy, public opinion, and global power as you guide your country through an ever-changing world shaped by your decisions.

4018020.title: 天使之恋Online：国际版
4018020.short_description: 《天使之恋Online 国际版》是一款2D可爱奇幻风格的线上 MMORPG，主打高度自由的养成、多样玩法与跨国共玩体验，让新旧玩家都能轻松投入、长久游玩。可自由选择阵营、搭配技能来培养角色，创造出专属于个人的游戏风格。国际版更提供四倍速练等，加速角色成长，优化背包空间，让收集与探索更无负担。同时支援即时聊天翻译，可与全球玩家一同冒险。游戏装扮可由副本直接掉落，并追加分解、融合系统，将外观转化为实力。

4710790.title: 科提玛洛 Demo
4710790.short_description: 新的冒险已经出现，冒险的脚步怎能停滞不前，扮演你喜欢的角色，去赢取怪物守护的宝藏，你的每次键入都会为科提玛洛的世界带来新的希望与转机，去科提玛洛的世界里，书写永恒的冒险传说。

4552860.title: Illustack
4552860.short_description: 赛博迷幻风爬塔俄罗斯方块，微像素质感 + 多风格精良音乐+关卡轮换，用属于你的节奏叠出你的专属构筑在不同的境界中遨游，并最终登到最高点吧。

4849340.title: Magma Karta Demo
4849340.short_description: Magma Karta is a satisfying strategy card game with roguelite and gambling elements. The rules can switch at any turn, challenging you to adapt your builds and your playstyle.

4823760.title: Diamond-Die Demo
4823760.short_description: Diamond-Die is a baseball dice game where every at bat can turn into glory, disaster, or something pretty goofy.

4850160.title: EVIL Agribusiness Simulator Demo
4850160.short_description: Here at AGRO agribusiness we see the potential in anyone. So we decided to turn what we do into a video game. Teach them young and to believe in our brand and-wait that was the confidential part I wasn’t supposed to type. Oh, here it is- learn how to drive a forest destroying combine in 46 levels.

4714810.title: 再战大极品+255
4714810.short_description: 一款自由打装备免氪金的传奇对战游戏，以其独特的游戏玩法和丰富多样的内容，吸引了众多玩家的关注。在游戏中，你将进入一个充满挑战和竞争的世界，与其他玩家展开激烈的对战，争夺珍贵的装备和资源，成为传奇战士的最终王者。

4566370.title: 空跃之旅：像素天穹（SKY LEAP PIXEL SKY)
4566370.short_description: 空跃之旅：像素天穹 是一款可以1-4人合作挑战的 3D 像素跳跳乐休闲冒险游戏。在天空悬浮平台间跳跃闯关，体验多人联机、全球排行榜与全成就系统，有这各种具有挑战和神奇梦幻的挑战关卡，向着像素天穹之巅不断攀登。

4196050.title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok Demo
4196050.short_description: 【碧蓝幻想Relink 无尽黄昏 Demo 内容】 ※《碧蓝幻想Relink 无尽黄昏》免费版 可使用以下3种模式： 1.剧情模式 2.任务模式 3.教程模式

4856880.title: Reclaim Demo
4856880.short_description: Reclaim is a fantasy visual novel following a peculiar elf and a dying god trying to free the world and themselves. Choose wisely and help them study, create, and escape.

4812610.title: The Drylands Demo
4812610.short_description: The Drylands is a Car party-based RPG. Fight for loot and explore an ever-changing procedurally generated world as the shifting sands reveal lost secrets

4839270.title: 쌀먹의 시대 Demo
4839270.short_description: Age of Gold Farmers is a black comedy sim about a NEET youth surviving on in-game currency. After failing at life, he discovers "gold farming." Grind for items, track market prices, and grow your channel—all while dodging your parents' glares and managing your health.

4754140.title: ENDLESS SIGNAL
4754140.short_description: 可在屏幕角落游玩的放置刷宝射击游戏，享受高速成长与爽快养成的乐趣。

3569560.title: The Escape to the Afterlife | この世からの脱出
3569560.short_description: The Escape to the Afterlife is a short horror experience (about 1 hour) where a deceased protagonist searches for a path to the afterlife.

4315850.title: 白荣大学 0号馆
4315850.short_description: 『从大学地图上消失的校舍—0号馆』 白荣大学0号馆是一款以日本大学为舞台的废墟探索恐怖冒险游戏。 你将化身为灵异社团成员，前往禁止入内的「0号馆」进行采访。 在诡异的气氛中，0号馆的真相将逐渐浮出水面……究竟是什么？

4851530.title: らしん探偵録 CASE01 : 最後のページ Demo
4851530.short_description: A strange request arrives at the detective agency, concerning a missing homeowner. Explore a silent mansion and unravel the intricate puzzles hidden throughout its rooms. Why did the homeowner vanish? A mystery adventure where you pursue the truth.

4841970.title: Crescent Creek Survival Demo
4841970.short_description: Crescent Creek: Survival Demo plunges you into a desolate farm, cut off from civilization and steeped in mystery. As you explore its winding corridors and ominous rooms, you’ll need to make critical choices, as each path could lead to salvation or peril.

3504980.title: MuteX+
3504980.short_description: MuteX+ is a challenging hack-and-slash that focuses on enemies that merge mid-fight. Make the most out of an unconventional moveset built around a slash, punch, and dash to cleave through the six Anobrite nests -- each ending with their own boss -- while mastering smooth mouse-controlled movement.

4749050.title: Tetrabeasts Demo
4749050.short_description: 在 Tetrabeasts 中指挥一支怪物战团，这款游戏是经典下落方块解谜与激烈战术怪物战斗的爆炸性融合。组建致命的战斗阵线，清除行以释放对敌方城堡的毁灭性攻击，并在无情的反击中生存。锻造你的军队。掌握方块。征服王国。

4812110.title: Rasek Demo
4812110.short_description: 在这款像素风动作MMORPG中，体验经典网络角色扮演游戏的辉煌与冒险。选择你的职业，自定义你的技能，加入氏族并肩作战或独自探索，以你自己的方式游玩，在拉塞克大陆上战斗，成为传奇。

3403590.title: Glimvale : My Mini Overworld
3403590.short_description: 《格林威尔》是一款融入了放置机制的温馨单人城市建造游戏。你可以管理、 装饰和发展一座迷人的多人在线游戏风小镇。 让冒险者们保持快乐， 按自己的节奏塑造这个世界。 作为这款游戏的GM， 这里由你说了算！

4577880.title: Mechanical Defense Line Demo
4577880.short_description: 这是一款塔防卡牌肉鸽游戏，可组装改装炮台、搭配装备挑战关卡、体验剧情。通过多种功能强化自身，战斗中选择不同天赋取胜，每次战斗可获得不少于 10 件装备，更多内容请在游戏内体验。

4824500.title: Eternal Decay Souls Demo
4824500.short_description: Explore a dark world filled with cursed creatures, solve ancient puzzles, and confront powerful bosses on a journey where each relic discovered reveals the secrets of eternal decay.

4816580.title: ALONE: Mnemophobia Demo
4816580.short_description: Play the prologue of ALONE: Mnemophobia. Face "The Presence" in a disturbing interrogation, survive the darkness that drains your sanity, and solve macabre puzzles in this psychological horror demo with a gritty VHS aesthetic.

4653460.title: Gravora
4653460.short_description: Tilt a 3D cube. Roll the ball. Find the path. Gravora is a physics-based puzzle game where gravity is your only tool and your greatest enemy. Use precise controls or your own hand via camera tracking to manipulate the world in real time.

4646980.title: Captain Corgi: Planetary Problem Solver Demo
4646980.short_description: Hop aboard your cosmic sailboat and seek out folks in need of help in this storybook universe.

4617450.title: VectorSmash!
4617450.short_description: VectorSmash is a fast-paced retro arcade space shooter. Pilot your artillery battery to defend the planet, blasting waves of incoming meteorites and using warps to survive. Classic 80s action with crisp vector visuals, simple controls, and addictive high-score chasing!

4771360.title: Trail of Gods: The Cursed Island
4771360.short_description: A compact, cursed action RPG that lingers long after you put it down. Fight through a dying world armed only with precise timing and whatever gear you can scavenge from the fallen. One button + movement is all you need.

4772770.title: Wild Climbers Peak Panic
4772770.short_description: Get ready for absolute chaos in Wild Climbers: Peak Panic! Battle it out in fast-paced 2-10 player online matches where you have just 3 minutes to reach the summit. Dodge crazy obstacles, outsmart your rivals, and survive the hilarious madness to become the ultimate climbing champion!

4341690.title: How Much Is ?
4341690.short_description: Test your math skills in an exciting FPS! Find the correct door to move forward. 100 islands await you with addition, subtraction, division, and multiplication. Hurry, the clock is ticking, and watch outeach island holds new challenges.

4021730.title: Bee Streamer Idler
4021730.short_description: Bee Streamer Idler 是一个为主播设计的叠加层！通过把聊天观众变成蜜蜂来增强互动，一起收集花粉并建造蜂巢！聊天观众通过指令控制自己的蜜蜂。看看你们能一起收集多少蜂蜜！赚取足够资源来解锁所有升级！

2095440.title: Beat The Markets
2095440.short_description: 一款基于金融的数字棋盘游戏，以围绕股票市场的真实投资策略为基础。

4854580.title: LiTTLE SYMBiO Demo
4854580.short_description: Be the (un-)natural Selection! In this cozy little Action Arcade game you play as a giant alien trying to survive on a little planet alongside even smaller ones. They get on your nerves? Just slap them off the planet! But be careful, you need them as much as they need you...

4850000.title: Not My Son Demo
4850000.short_description: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

4721140.title: Knight Paths Demo
4721140.short_description: A minimalist battle of movement, memory, and mind. Inspired by the timeless strategy of Chess, Knight Paths distills tactical gameplay to its purest form. Two players. One knight each. No second chances.

327070.title: Gloria Victis: Medieval MMORPG
327070.short_description: 《Gloria Victis》是一款侧重真实性的开放世界大型多人在线角色扮演游戏，背景设定为略带魔幻风格的中世纪。本游戏战斗系统无目标锁定机制，依赖玩家操作，玩家可在开放式的PVP战斗中争夺领土控制权。游戏的制造系统有深度而无所不包，经济系统由玩家主导，剧情成熟而宏大，画面写实而绚丽，向玩家呈现沉浸式的游戏体验。 游戏有两大阵营：居住在大草原上的自豪的中土人，以及住在寒冷北方又复仇心切的伊斯米尔人。玩家将选择一方加入，然后奔赴战场！

3072120.title: Backrooms Lost Runners
3072120.short_description: Backrooms Lost Runners 是一款合作生存恐怖游戏，拥有团队玩法、语音反应 AI 和沉浸式谜题。这不是“散步模拟器”：探索边缘空间，智胜实体，并记住——即使是耳语也可能暴露你。

2943740.title: Prologue: Go Wayback!
2943740.short_description: Prologue: Go Wayback! is a single-player open-world emergent survival roguelike where every journey is unique. Traverse a new wilderness that is generated for you every time you play. Chart your path, overcome the elements, and write your own story of exploration.

2790700.title: SWAPMEAT
2790700.short_description: Rip through hostile alien worlds, harvest mutant body parts mid-combat, and adapt faster than your enemies. Every alien you harvest gives you new body parts with unique powers, like triple-jump legs, turret-dropping torsos, grenade-launching turkey heads. Steal, swap, survive.

4710210.title: Arcade Architect
4710210.short_description: Build and run your own retro arcade—where every machine is fully playable. Design your layout, master the games, and grow your neon empire.

3405460.title: Melon Clicker
3405460.short_description: Click the melon to accumulate points. Ideal for short breaks or unwinding.

4846760.title: Gridfire Demo
4846760.short_description: A top-down shooter with action packed PvP combat. In the full game, engage in FFA or team based combat with game modes like capture the flag, control points, or team deathmatch. In this demo, you can play CTF to to get a taste of Gridfire. If you enjoy it, please give the full game a try.

4857480.title: Potions & Passions: Therapist for Monsters Demo
4857480.short_description: Manage your spooky potion shop and meet monsters! Solve the tragicomic problems of vampires, werewolves, ifrits and trolls, or pit them against each other. Scavenge ingredients, craft volatile brews, and enjoy this chaotic management simulation!

4657290.title: Galactic Patrol
4657290.short_description: A lost 1998 arcade-style shooter returns! Fight through 25 levels and 300+ waves of alien attacks inspired by classic shoot-'em-ups like Space Invaders and Galaga, featuring top-down, side-scrolling, and rear-view gameplay.

4574350.title: Firedrip Arcade
4574350.short_description: A collection of 4 arcade games to help scratch that nostalgic itch.

4856270.title: Blades of Four Demo
4856270.short_description: A fast-paced fantasy action roguelike where 4 unique heroes battle through dangerous maps, unlock powerful items, and master devastating abilities with swords and bows

4844950.title: Crustacean Station! Demo
4844950.short_description: Work a day job at Crustacean Station checking identification and sending a vibrant cast of sea creatures to their desired destinations!

4851690.title: Void Signal Demo
4851690.short_description: An immersive sci-fi space shooter where you pilot a ship through an anomalously expanding region of space. Analyze real-time scientific data, survive encounters with mysterious alien entities, make ethical decisions, and uncover hidden truths as the universe around you transforms.

1944040.title: goblinAmerica
1944040.short_description: 这是一款快节奏的枪战类游戏，背景设定在一个低级的地精化美国。占有妖精总统，获得黄太阳的美丽勋章，让自己迷失在鲜艳的生活色彩中。

2599230.title: HeartCore Descent
2599230.short_description: Fly to the center of the planet to destroy its core! A simple yet challenging 2D Precision Platformer Indie game about flying a rocketship through various terrains, progressively getting harder and harder.

4701630.title: Incense Nook
4701630.short_description: 在桌面角落经营一座小香炉，插香、燃烧、收集香火，慢慢解锁新炉与新香。

4349160.title: STROZOWKA
4349160.short_description: Operate the gate, let the cars in, and make sure the generator doesn’t die before dawn. People park here because it's cheap, but it’s their fuel that keeps your generator running. No cars means no fuel. No fuel means total darkness and trust me, you don’t want to be here when the lights go out.

4247110.title: Bind
4247110.short_description: BIND is a slow-paced metaphysical puzzle journey set in the liminal realm between death and rebirth.

3795760.title: Burger Bots Inc.
3795760.short_description: An online co-op burger flipping game with scary and strange customers that you shouldn't anger.

4842980.title: Not Quite Dead: Open World Survival Demo
4842980.short_description: Open world zombie survival Coop game with base building, looting, crafting, vehicles, and exploration.

4853890.title: The Lost Within Demo
4853890.short_description: A paranormal investigator enters an ancient forest shrouded in rumors of a mad woman. In this first-person horror, players explore dark thickets for clues and hidden evidence. Solving atmospheric puzzles reveals the truth as the boundary between sanity and madness collapses.

4682460.title: G-MODEアーカイブス+ パックマン
4682460.short_description: The timeless masterpiece that has taken the world by storm is here! Eating all Pac-Dots while dodging the ghosts!

4602320.title: Brazzante Demo
4602320.short_description: Featuring a unique doodle aesthetic, this world is entirely hand-drawn. Your goal? Use classic 'Rock, Paper, Scissors' mechanics to survive never-ending rounds.

4795080.title: Retro Clicker
4795080.short_description: Retro Clicker — simple idle clicker with retro style. Destroy enemies, upgrade stats, use prestige for permanent power-ups, and enjoy endless perks & progression.

4843560.title: Neon Shifter Demo
4843560.short_description: A high-speed arcade racer where road rage fuels chaos. Smash traffic, build boost, and tear through neon highways in this Savlonic-powered thrill ride.

3551190.title: 最终夺回小分队
3551190.short_description: 『最终夺回小分队』是一款2.5D单人FPS游戏。你将面对与早期SF作品中常见的外星武器极为酷似的敌人，与它们展开激烈交锋。

4710580.title: Rocinha Wars
4710580.short_description: Um jogo de guerra urbana ambientado na América Latina.

4708610.title: PixelBoss: Shattered Depths
4708610.short_description: PixelBoss: Shattered Depths 是一款硬核 2D 像素风平台游戏，每一次失误都至关重要。战斗、躲避陷阱，并通过考验精准操作、反应速度和沉着判断的关卡。

4708650.title: Blockmind
4708650.short_description: 在方块世界中解决空间谜题。找到形状背后的逻辑，并搭建出完美解法。

4854710.title: A Good Deed On Harris Avenue Demo
4854710.short_description: 在这款简短的PSX风格解谜冒险游戏中，理清哈里斯大道居民们错综复杂的愿望与期许。沐浴在夏日午后的灼热阳光下，探索精心打造的复杂环境，并揭开《哈里斯大道上的善举》所蕴含的深意。

4575270.title: Deep Enough
4575270.short_description: Dig deep, discover rare ores, upgrade your gear, and uncover the mysteries hidden beneath the surface in this cozy first-person mining adventure.

4828050.title: Chemicalizer Demo
4828050.short_description: Chemicalizer is a music game that you play on your PC using your smartphone (Android) as a controller.

4766600.title: Total Simp Death
