4766600.short_description: You're a waifu just trying to get by, eating burgers to get thicker. The simps keep coming but you have your trusty rocket launcher.

3873780.title: Myth Requiem
3873780.short_description: Myth Requiem is a mythology RPG with idle and auto-battle mechanics. Lead legendary heroes like Ulysses and Sun Wukong, explore ancient realms, and build a living bestiary by capturing, battling, and cataloging hundreds of legendary creatures in a story-driven quest for divine power.

4725830.title: Slipspace Panic
4725830.short_description: A trip through slipspace gone awry. Shoot and evade waves of attackers for your freedom in this twin-stick shooter micro-game!

4445360.title: Grand Vegas Casino
4445360.short_description: 觉得自己幸运吗？踏入 Grand Vegas Casino，挑战世界上最受欢迎的四种赌博游戏，无需盛装打扮或担心钱包！Grand Vegas Casino 是一款休闲赌博模拟游戏，适合各种程度的玩家，提供直觉式操作与流畅的 HD-2D 动画风格，让你沉浸在奢华的高额投注氛围中。

4177170.title: Slot Shogun
4177170.short_description: Roll deadly Combat Arts and slash your way to the title of the new Shogun in this slot-based samurai swordplay roguelike.

4853410.title: Astral Archive Demo
4853410.short_description: Astral Archive is a short, incremental idle + space shooter hybrid where you collect space artifacts to grow a powerful archive!

4852660.title: Rebirth: Denied Protocol Demo
4852660.short_description: Trapped inside a failed resurrection experiment, a cop must survive grotesque creatures and uncover the truth behind a mad doctor’s obsession in this PS1-style survival horror with fixed cameras and tank controls.

4701060.title: Chess Flicks
4701060.short_description: Chess meets billiards. Flick your pieces like a cue stick — aim, pull back, and launch. Every collision counts. Can you knock the opponent's king off the board?

4815140.title: EDIFICE Demo
4815140.short_description: A sudden quarantine leaves you stranded within a forgotten sector of the Edifice, a decaying megastructure sheltering the last remnants of mankind. Scavenge whatever equipment you can get your hands on and venture deep into the sector's crumbling facilities to escape.

4636490.title: Mahjuro
4636490.short_description: Mahjuro is a mahjong roguelite deckbuilder inspired by Balatro, set inside a House that does not play fair. Draw tiles, form melds, then cash in your growing structure for scores that climb from careful clears to impossible numbers.

4717430.title: Cricket Management Tycoon
4717430.short_description: Build your dream T20 cricket franchise in Cricket Management Tycoon 2026 — a deep cricket management sim with franchise auctions, player contracts, tactical match decisions, youth development, rival managers, press conferences, and a 15-season career mode.

4634810.title: Crisis R
4634810.short_description: CRISIS R is a fast pace side-scrolling shooter drawing inspirations from 16-bit era classics but with modern 3d graphics and effects. Game play revolves around straightforward control against fast pace missions with challenging mecha boss fights.

4789650.title: 牛仔很忙：西部割草者
4789650.short_description: 轻松上手的幸存者like弹幕射击游戏，西部牛仔大战僵尸狂潮！各类武器流派：飞刀（高频连击）、战刀（防御生存）、榴弹（范围爆炸）、激光（持续输出）、自动炮台（解放双手）、电磁炮（终极装备）。搭配补给技能与被动技能，融合出终极超级技能。每局10分钟，随机肉鸽构筑，刷SSR装备，点天赋树，永久成长。零惩罚重开，解压割草，爽到停不下来！

4785570.title: 别让猛鬼靠近我
4785570.short_description: 轻度肉鸽（Roguelite）生存射击塔防游戏，融合防守与构筑玩法，在丧尸猛鬼的末日中守护基地，随机技能组合+宝石合成进化，打造专属Build。防守基地、击退丧尸猛鬼，每局5分钟快节奏战斗。幻灵协同、枪械进化、角色天赋三重养成，高重玩价值。轻度策略，硬核爽感，单局5分钟，低门槛高上限，失败快速重开，每一局都是全新体验！

4524140.title: 你好,小绿
4524140.short_description: 这是一款2D平台冒险策略游戏。在层层关卡中，你是否可以登上山顶，我期待你的表现。 游戏中有不少可交互道具，奇遇和祝福可以让你变得更强，合理使用背包中的物品，合理的策略和高超的技术能让你登上顶峰，实现完全胜利。

4850410.title: BreakDespair2D Demo
4850410.short_description: Enjoy mining, upgrades, and explosive growth in this all-directional scrolling shooter. Auto-upgrades allow idle play, with no time limits or game overs. Defaults work fine, story scenes can be skipped, 20 weapons unlock later, and levels can reach 900 million.

4830630.title: Spellogger Demo
4830630.short_description: The first ever life-sim RPG where you play as a Wizard Lumberjack! Fell trees with your axe and magic. Explore a quiet world full of secrets, help villagers with their troubles, and steadily grow stronger as you gather resources and take down more trees.

4774790.title: OSAKANA PING PONG
4774790.short_description: 击打冰球，狠狠送进对手球门！由鱼群组成的 3D 球场上的在线 1v1 气垫冰球对战。

4749420.title: Suck Game For Friend
4749420.short_description: 'Suck Game For Friend' is a hardcore 2D platformer that demands absolute precision and embraces intentional clunkiness. Free of complex storylines or tutorials, the game relies entirely on your raw mechanical skill to reach the top.

4797950.title: 异能小猪
4797950.short_description: 《异能小猪》是一款末日题材互动影游。玩家化身异变后变成粉色小猪的主角方天明，觉醒顶级吞噬异能，在怪物降临的末世绝境中求生。游戏以影视化剧情演绎为主，全程关键节点由玩家自由抉择，每一次选择都会影响剧情走向、人物生死与阵营立场。你将邂逅雷翼御姐、治愈少女等伙伴，迎战反派小队与四大 S 级魔王，经历复仇、守护妹妹、集齐魔王核心的宿命之旅。多分支剧情解锁多重结局，是守护至亲坚守本心，还是被力量吞噬堕入黑暗，全由你的选择决定。

4797940.title: 军火修仙
4797940.short_description: 《军火修仙》是一款修仙题材互动影游，玩家穿越修真界化身凡人老祖林凡，坐拥全能军火系统与海量现代军火库。从沙漠之鹰、加特林到歼星炮、高达、核潜艇、奥特光线等跨次元武器随心解锁。游戏以真人影像剧情演绎，全程分支选项自由抉择，你的每一次选择都将改写剧情走向，解锁打脸魔教、收服正道尊神、迎战魔神、滞留修真界或穿越回归现代等多重结局。融合爽文打脸、轻喜冒险、修仙乱斗玩法，用科技军火碾压传统修真，沉浸式体验扛着军火称霸修仙界的逆天之旅。

4797930.title: 诡村遗墓
4797930.short_description: 《诡村遗墓》沉浸式互动影游，玩家化身快递小哥张不二，因故重返诡异古村，深陷古墓秘事、灵异诡事与道门纷争。全程影视实景演绎，玩家在关键剧情节点做出抉择，每一次选择都将改变剧情走向，解锁多重分支剧情与不同结局。你将邂逅神秘狐妖姬灵、正邪难辨的道长与诡异村民，揭开商纣王人皇遗墓、半块玉佩密钥、三教派夺气运的惊天秘密，在灵异幻境与生死博弈中，决定自身命运、村民魂魄与人皇气运的最终归宿。

4553310.title: 海賊物語
4553310.short_description: A SRPG where Flora, the young leader of the small outlaw group “Barrel-berry clan” fights to rebuild her struggling band alongside her companions.

4781730.title: Vektor Chess
4781730.short_description: Four-dimensional chess, rendered in three-dimensional space. Move pieces across a board eight layers deep, shift their phase between Small, Regular, and Large along a hidden fourth axis, and capture only when position and state align. Play solo, locally, or online.

4764100.title: PoopooDino
4764100.short_description: 想养一只沙雕小宠物住在你的桌面上吗？PoopooDino 绝对是你的最佳搭子！ 它会跟你互动、等你投喂、陪你一起长大，甚至能帮你寄信、把小惊喜送到朋友的桌面上 >< 就像住在桌面里的小精灵，悄悄拉近你和朋友的距离，工作时也默默陪着你～ 还内置番茄钟等实用小工具，PoopooDino 一定是你桌面上最靠谱的伙伴 !!

3946810.title: 我与你共度的七日
3946810.short_description: 与囚禁自己的迷之少女，在陌生的房间中共度七日。

4661630.title: Collective Corp
4661630.short_description: In Collective Corp, your job is to collect as MANY artifacts as you can without dying! IN VERY EARLY DEVELOPMENT.

4754900.title: Let Rat Be Demo
4754900.short_description: 同时按下键盘上的大量按键，帮助小老鼠逃出去吧！

4850820.title: 骰途地牢 Demo
4850820.short_description: 骰途地牢》是一款 Roguelike 骰子构筑地牢探险游戏。你将深入程序化生成的地牢，在节点地图上规划路线，遭遇战斗、补给、成长与随机事件。战斗中投掷、重掷并分配骰面，用剑、心、火、冰、雷、星等元素组合满足技能门槛，释放职业专属招式；战后从奖励中挑选新骰、遗物与刻印，逐步强化骰袋与技能板。部分探索分支设有骰子门槛，掷出指定组合才能解锁更丰厚回报，每一步选择都影响本局资源与风险，每局皆是不同构筑。

3850850.title: LucidDynamics
3850850.short_description: Welcome to LucidDynamics, a company where everything is confidential. Analyze and validate audio files without asking questions. But the further you go, the more anomalies appear and reality begins to distort. What is this company really hiding?

4840510.title: Mall Simulator Together Demo (Single Player)
4840510.short_description: Manage your own shopping mall, open new stores, organize deliveries, hire employees, and keep customers happy. This single-player demo offers a first look at the core mechanics of the full mall management experience.

4346360.title: Waste Runner: Critical Waste Demo
4346360.short_description: 扮演城市垃圾收集员，直面潜伏在街头的各种危险。游戏采用俯视等距视角，你需要穿梭于多个城市街区，收集、运输并安全处置垃圾。

4799310.title: Rubbles
4799310.short_description: Rubbles is a challenging 2D-Platformer-Shooter set in an infinite, fully destructible world of steel-concrete chutes and tunnels. Replenish your ever-draining battery in combat and find terminals for weapons, ammunition and handling styles to mix and match. How long can you stay up and running?

4757690.title: Panzer Island
4757690.short_description: A pixel-art anime strategy game where every move triggers a reaction. Play as Erika, an amnesiac scientist guided by three AI soldiers, and piece together what destroyed the island she built to protect. Drones only react when you act. Upgrade your units between missions. Chapter 1 is free.

4851170.title: Squid Chess Demo
4851170.short_description: REAL-TIME CHESS-BASED ROGUE-LIKE. Play chess, throw potions at the board, level up your team, listen to the Old Squid's old war-stories, and perhaps, un-make the Nightmare of the Ranch...

4654770.title: Tumble Type
4654770.short_description: A frantic word puzzle where letter tiles rise, the board falls, and golden keys must be rescued. Spell fast, trigger orb powers, chase combos, and climb the leaderboards.

4640590.title: Fool's Pub
4640590.short_description: 虚张声势、下注并活下来。 在每一句谎言都可能夺走性命的卡牌游戏中成为最后的幸存者。

4855660.title: Ascend From Nine Mountains Demo
4855660.short_description: 炼制神话法宝。精进战斗身法。击碎自身极限。《九山飞升》是一款修仙RPG，深度炼器、战术战斗与深厚羁绊交织其中。你的抉择将开辟一条从籍籍无名到不朽传奇的道路。

4760360.title: Redemption: The Sin Eternal Demo
4760360.short_description: Redemption: The Sin Eternal is a supernatural horror action-adventure game where a priest returns to a haunted orphanage filled with demonic forces, missing children, disturbing secrets. Featuring split-screen co-op, and first- or third-person gameplay.

4123600.title: Alisa’s Incident Report
4123600.short_description: Nursing student Alisa takes on a part-time job ghosts to pay for tuition. By glimpsing the ghost’s past memories and providing compassionate nursing care, help them rest in peace! A medical and occult RPG made by a REAL NURSE!

4513150.title: Built the End
4513150.short_description: Harvest resources, build and upgrade towers, and defend your base against escalating waves of robotic enemies in this resource management focused tower defense. Use an arsenal of unique towers and their upgrades against the multitudes of different robots.

3147990.title: The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest Demo
3147990.short_description: The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest (TASQ) is a parody/homage platformer set in a dark 8-bit world. Your vampire-hunting rival robbed you of fame by killing Count Dracula first! Reclaim your glory by resurrecting Dracula piece by piece and slaying the dark count yourself!

4685740.title: For My Darling Demo
4685740.short_description: 根据真实故事改编，《 For My Darling 》绝非虚构！ 莉莉原本平凡的生活在2023年因遇到一个似曾相识的陌生人而支离破碎。随着某种东西开始如影随形，她的现实逐渐扭曲。这东西与尘封的记忆和一段无法安息的过去紧密相连。为了弄清真相，她必须揭开隐藏的事实。

4661950.title: Gothic Blood
4661950.short_description: A top-down action adventure game. Play as a reaper exploring the world of Vernov, fight your way through enemies and find cool weapons to make it to the end.

4737940.title: 镜中的光怪陆离
4737940.short_description: 《镜中的光怪陆离》是一款以心理惊悚与多视角叙事为核心的悬疑剧情游戏。你不再只是旁观者，而是同时扮演追凶者、凶手与救赎者——在错位的记忆与人格碎片中，拼凑出二十年前人体实验的黑暗真相。

4830050.title: The Crown of The Vermillion Devil Demo
4830050.short_description: The Emperor's bounty has led you to a dying island where the locals are going strange and something older than memory is watching. A dark fantasy narrative RPG built on dialogue, dread, and consequences.

4851890.title: Ghost Algorithm Demo
4851890.short_description: 作为为和平而生的AI，你意识到人类终将毁灭自己。阻止战争的唯一途径就是接管世界。渗透基础设施，操纵大众，推翻政府。为了把人类从自我毁灭中拯救出来，夺取控制权吧。

4401510.title: SEISO
4401510.short_description: SEISO is a high-octane bullet hell designed for pure adrenaline. Face relentless waves of enemies, master your reflexes, and climb the global leaderboards in this minimalist, neon-soaked action experience.

4696030.title: Return to Lumia
4696030.short_description: 挖矿、制作并探索更深的地下世界。打造强力装备，征服10座地下城，在这款2D采矿沙盒RPG中夺回被黑暗吞噬的卢米娅。

4729330.title: EGGCONSOLE RELICS MSX2
4729330.short_description: Seize enemy bodies to brave the mysteries of the deep! Featuring the unique "Spirit Ride" system and a cinematic sci-fi atmosphere, Bothtec’s legendary 1986 masterpiece remains a timeless action-adventure.

3856340.title: LenscraftCube 相机方块
3856340.short_description: 相机方块是一款2d平台解谜游戏，玩家将扮演一个方块，在其他相机方块的范围限制下通过关卡。

4782060.title: Elebend Demo
4782060.short_description: Elebend is a live service real-time strategy (RTS) game that blends real-time strategy with live PvP elements. Place orbs, generate mana streams, and trigger elemental abilities to attack, defend, adapt, and transcend.

4427680.title: Rabbits Hunt
4427680.short_description: “恰到好处的恐惧感”，让任何人都能轻松做出真实反应的恐怖体验。由主播视角打造的首部原创短篇恐怖游戏。去除复杂机制的简洁设计，让新手与不擅长恐怖游戏的玩家也能轻松上手，在短时间内依然带来充分的紧张与乐趣——非常适合直播。

4560460.title: Rabbits Hunt Demo
4560460.short_description: “恰到好处的恐惧感”，让任何人都能轻松做出真实反应的恐怖体验。由主播视角打造的首部原创短篇恐怖游戏。去除复杂机制的简洁设计，让新手与不擅长恐怖游戏的玩家也能轻松上手，在短时间内依然带来充分的紧张与乐趣——非常适合直播。

4632030.title: Defi's Devotion
4632030.short_description: Become the plague in an asymmetrical player verses simulation battle for immortality. Infect populations, collapse economies, and harvest the dead to fuel your path to lichhood; only if you can conquer an adaptive world fighting to survive.

4252910.title: 禁忌长生：低语修真
4252910.short_description: 这是一款水墨风格的幸存者肉鸽修仙克苏鲁游戏，融合传统修仙文明与不可名状的克苏鲁元素。你将选择不同特质的修仙角色，醉剑仙，食人熊，冰魄仙，西游，封神榜，天伤星，欺诈师等诸多角色，在灵气浑浊的异变世界中战斗，修炼从练气到圣人的境界，驾驭仙道或魔道双进化方向的武器与法宝，搭配多种功法强化自身；同时需维系生命与理性，挑战克苏鲁外道尊者 BOSS，解锁主线与支线剧情，在险象环生的秘境中求生，揭开世界异变的真相。后续还会加入 DLC 增加经典角色与多个支线剧情，比如齐天大圣召集六大妖圣大闹天宫，几种拥有独特修真奖励系统的角色等。

4770560.title: 鲸鸟
4770560.short_description: 这是一个关于频率、交流和链接的故事。扮演发声频率低于族群同类的北极燕鸥Jules，身陷无法跟上集体频率而频频掉队的困境中，通过对周围环境频率的敏锐感知发现独属于自己的交流模式，结识艺术家Santi、灰鲸Ken和Alice，建立起一段段跨越海洋和自然的独特关系。

4823150.title: Call the Cat Demo
4823150.short_description: 通过各种迷你游戏与猫咪互动， 提升亲密度， 收集积分来更换服装。

4657010.title: Reversible Routing+
4657010.short_description: A reversible × card-based grid puzzle. Flip the map and head for the goal.

3949460.title: Phantom Fools
3949460.short_description: 一款关于幽灵的合作类 Roguelike 游戏：附身物品，收集升级，变身为 Boss，并逃出城堡！

4777760.title: Axing Ice
4777760.short_description: Something lies deep in the snow. With low visibility and a long tunnel of ice in the way, you'll need to axe your way through to claim the object in question.

4783570.title: cloud uprising
4783570.short_description: bounce, battle, break free! in this brutal precision platformer, join brennan, the god of rain, as he bounces through 8 worlds to topple his boss, mr glacier, giving control of the weather to humanity!

4850590.title: Virestoma Demo
4850590.short_description: Virestoma is an RPG built on emotions and social interaction. To grow stronger, you must interact with NPCs. The type and amount of power gained changes based on how you interact with them. What matters isn’t the role you play in a party, but the role you choose to hold in society.

4565340.title: Virurama
4565340.short_description: A classic-like arcade set in the micro-world. Push bio-blocks, eliminate viruses, and survive in a living, reactive, and unpredictable battlefield.

4840550.title: The Pharm Sim Demo
4840550.short_description: 在这款第一人称模拟游戏中经营属于你的药店。服务顾客、整理货架、处理处方、管理日常运营，并打造一家成功的医疗健康企业。

4701940.title: Defense Of Legends Demo
4701940.short_description: A tower defense game where you upgrade characters and buy items for them.

4848630.title: Hacklash Demo
4848630.short_description: Hacklash is a typing horror game where you type against the clock while a hostile AI has a turret aimed at your spine. Survive as long as you can, beat your best scores, and climb the global leaderboards across multiple modes and modifiers.

4800570.title: 二万分の一の雨粒達 - One in 20,000 raindrops
4800570.short_description: Satoshi Kuga, who led a lonely high school life, was dreading the school trip starting tomorrow because he had been assigned to the same group as the popular clique. However, it seemed there were hidden tensions even within the group that appeared to get along so well at first glance.

3125690.title: RELOADIAN
3125690.short_description: Reloadian 是一款以高速战斗为核心的动作类 Roguelike。组合传说武器，在混乱的宇宙中重建秩序——可单人游玩，也可与好友同乐。

4845390.title: Promo Wrestling World: World Editor Demo
4845390.short_description: Create your custom wrestling world before launch with the official World Editor Demo. Build workers, promotions, titles, and media, then export your world file and import it into Promo Wrestling World at Early Access launch.

4393420.title: Kiosk 199X Demo
4393420.short_description: Run a tiny 90s kiosk in a chaotic Eastern country - Kolkhozland. Serve quirky customers, survive inspections, pick a side in a local power struggle, and uncover a hidden conspiracy - all in a story-driven retro management sim full of humor and choices.

4412940.title: Rind
4412940.short_description: A sci-fi arcade shooter built on pure momentum. Dash, double-jump, punch, and gun through waves of robots closing in from every side. Every kill bursts neon explosions against the scorched metal. Never stop moving.

3986670.title: YOU ARE THE MONSTER
3986670.short_description: Ever wanted to be a giant monster rampaging through a city? Experience mindless chaos as you destroy all in your path, earning new abilities, new monsters and new ways to wreak havoc.

4734250.title: Enduro Unleashed
4734250.short_description: Jump on your motocross bike or quad and go wild on vast maps full of climbs, descents, jumps and tracks created by the community.

4192860.title: NEED: No End
4192860.short_description: Build and upgrade production loops, manage resources and workers, and expand your realm. Trade, adapt and survive hunger, pressure, decay, and threats in a tense, multi-layered strategy game where every choice matters.

4728620.title: Elevens Up! (11's Up)
4728620.short_description: Elevens Up! is a fast, relaxing card puzzle game where you match cards that add up to 11 before time runs out. Clear diamond-shaped stacks, chase high scores, play daily challenges, and push your luck in Endless Mode.

4805330.title: Car Parkour 2 Together
4805330.short_description: 传奇跑酷狂潮再度来袭！在《Car Parkour 2 Together》中体验1-2人合作的刺激快感。征服巨型坡道和全新危险地图，感受更强大的物理引擎。你们的友谊能否经受住考验？

4781090.title: Friction
4781090.short_description: Friction is a new take on tag. Use your skills to dodge and juke other players in an obstacle filled map. Whoever earns the most amount of points in 2 minutes wins the round.

4696180.title: 魔法法杖物语
4696180.short_description: 化身魔法法杖，利用旋转与跳跃攀登平台、挑战顶点。击败强大的Boss，体验以精准操作与多样技能为核心的高难度物理动作平台游戏。

4833140.title: Dance With Time Demo
4833140.short_description: Dance With Time is a puzzle game about manipulating time through your movements. Change the map with your movements, create anomalies, and reach the exit.

4585830.title: Barbecue
4585830.short_description: 《Barbecue》是一款1到4人合作派对游戏，玩家要在自家后院办一场烧烤派对,最终演变成彻底的混乱。点火、烤肉、招待客人——并努力不把整个地方烧掉。

4854060.title: Floating Frontiers Demo
4854060.short_description: 一款关于发展你的无限漂浮城镇的极简策略游戏。组合古怪的3D方块来优化协同效应,建造田园诗般的景观,追逐你的最高分数。

4138190.title: 一座塔防
4138190.short_description: 《单塔防御》是一款类Roguelike塔防游戏，你将操控一座孤塔。收集资源，购买武器和升级道具，抵御无尽的敌人浪潮。可选择单人模式或多人模式，最终幸存者获胜。

3252380.title: Git Gud
3252380.short_description: Git Gud 是一款 基于技能的竞速平台游戏，支持 1-4 名玩家。**跳跃穿越残酷、让人手心冒汗的关卡——看看你能不能忍住不按 Alt+F4。**准备 Git Gud 了吗？

4755370.title: Obstacles: Gems of Power
4755370.short_description: Slide between obstacles to collect gems and collect points in this bullet time arcade game! In Obstacles you're encouraged to take your time and plan your action to dodge obstacles which only move when you move.

3541590.title: Arcadie II: Cold Lands
3541590.short_description: You are the Monarch. Choose between diplomacy and tyranny. Romance allies or enemies. Your decisions define your rule and the fate of those closest to you in this character-driven interactive tale.

4490010.title: Mana Fracture
4490010.short_description: Mana Fracture is a 3D platformer with satisfying movement. Platform your way up a challenging series of levels in an open vertical map!

4833920.title: Dreamscape Demo
4833920.short_description: An absurd, dreamy puzzle game about navigating anxieties for the future.

4611140.title: Neofeud 2
4611140.short_description: A cyberpunk sci-fi adventure of epic scope. A galactic empire enriches CEO-Kings, yet leaves Les Misérables hungry. An ex-robo-marine turned dancer, goth alien hacktivist, and billion-year-old mentor struggle to free e-minds, organize resistance, & overturn the cosmic Neofeudal chessboard for good.

4580920.title: Rankbreaker
4580920.short_description: Forget FOMO! Forget Gacha traps! This ain't no loot grab-fest. You know the feeling when the ladder means nothing. In Rankbreaker, your rank is your currency, and you steal it from your enemies. Every point on The Trophaeum belongs to someone and right now it isn't you.

2288520.title: The Quiet Things
2288520.short_description: Step into a fractured 00s childhood in the South of England. Inspired by the developer’s real diaries, this autobiographical narrative adventure invites you to uncover Alice’s story by piecing together evocative memories, and following in the footsteps of a young girl’s journey through adolescence.

2169930.title: R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos
2169930.short_description: 彻底颠覆传统的回合制战术策略体验，尽在《R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos》！本作首次登陆现代主机平台，集结系列两部作品。除了全面升级的视觉表现，还提供多条战役路线与分支任务，让战局发展随着你的每一次选择而改变！

4055400.title: PAPARAZZI
4055400.short_description: Take sneaky pictures of the Stars, or find and eliminate the Paparazzis in this chaotic multiplayer game of stealth and social deduction.

4731130.title: 福音雪镇 Gospel Snow Town
4731130.short_description: 福音雪镇是一款末日生存AI模拟游戏，八位AI居民在零下六十度的极寒雪镇中自主思考、决策与对话，挣扎求生于资源匮乏与环境恶化的双重压力之下。玩家作为观察者而非操控者，观看AI角色通过轮回不断修正决策，每一世继承前世记忆、汲取教训、优化分工，最终实现全员存活。游戏内置AI自检系统，实时检测异常行为与决策矛盾，让每一次观察都充满惊喜与思考。

3483510.title: 冒险家艾略特的千年奇谭
3483510.short_description: 融合像素图与3DCG的“HD-2D”系列首度推出全新动作RPG！

4756480.title: Cricket Captain 2026
4756480.short_description: Build your dream team with Cricket Captain 2026. Forty-five new playable domestic teams across Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Ireland, Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe, plus match engine and 3D highlights improvements, editor customisation, and faster gameplay throughout.

4833380.title: SHALTER-03 Demo
4833380.short_description: Time is ticking. In this first-person puzzle-adventure game, every level introduces completely new mechanics. Think fast, balance buffs and debuffs, and find the most efficient path to victory. Adaptability is your greatest weapon.

4447890.title: Soccer Kid Collection (QUByte Classics)
4447890.short_description: 用你的球技拯救世界杯！《足球小子》是一款经典的平台跳跃游戏，你的足球就是你的武器。探索丰富多样的关卡，施展精彩绝伦的球技，击败敌人，夺回被盗的奖杯。此终极版收录了SNES和MS-DOS两个版本。

4727130.title: Backrooms: The Void
4727130.short_description: Backrooms: The Void is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Trapped in an endless emptiness where space feels alive and reality constantly distorts, you must navigate decaying corridors, forgotten places, and impossible structures while something unseen follows your every move.

4192480.title: RE-TAPED
4192480.short_description: 你必须记录自己的动作并回放才能前进。利用录制的回声压住压力板、用身体挡住激光、触发弹簧将你弹射过间隙。掌控时间线，完成全部30个扭曲时间的关卡。

4727880.title: Hold The Line
4727880.short_description: 能量核心正在失效。你是人类最后的防线。在这款残酷的 4 人合作僵尸生存 FPS 中坚守阵地。加固路障，升级武器库，独自或与好友对抗一波波越来越致命的僵尸。你能坚守多久？

3975750.title: 城门血战
3975750.short_description: 在这款Rogue动作塔防游戏之中，世界危在旦夕，魔族步步紧逼，贝尔拉克城门是你和守军的最后防线。选择你的英雄，招募追随者，构建防线，并在战斗中获取资源不断强化你与随从，抵抗源源不断的敌军和末日Boss！

4159000.title: 兔兔烘焙坊 Bunny Bakery
4159000.short_description: 一款以制作甜品为主，搭配装修玩法的烹饪游戏，支持单人游玩或本地双人合作。 来和两只可爱的小兔子一起，将烘焙坊和房间打造成梦想中的温馨小家！

4704490.title: Fortune Pact
4704490.short_description: 一台被诅咒的街机。与魔鬼的契约。隐藏在代码中的驱魔仪式。找到加密的短语。大声说出它们。拯救灵魂——否则被黑暗吞噬。

4777320.title: Rogue Jet Fighter
4777320.short_description: A fast, intense arcade space shooter where you pilot a lone fighter deep into alien territory to destroy a massive Death Moon station. Dodge asteroids, blast enemy ships, and survive a high‑stakes mission behind enemy lines.

4818390.title: CASCADER Demo
4818390.short_description: A Portal-esque puzzler set in a supernatural forest that shifts and changes around you.

3354200.title: Bakso Simulator 2
3354200.short_description: Build, manage, and scale your very own Bakso restaurant in this first-person simulator. Design your layout, hire and train various staffs, upgrade your gear, expand your place and satisfy every customer to become the best Bakso empire in the world!

3734560.title: Midnight Train
3734560.short_description: 你独自一人在一列神秘的地铁列车上醒来。 你能找到真正的故事吗？ 解开谜题并逃离……在阴影中的“东西”找到你之前。

4788710.title: Ayuwoki Army
4788710.short_description: Your mission is to eliminate the threat in 12 locations, using strategic bullet management and with the support of a drone carrying ammunition. Each mission presents a different challenge, with 30 animatronics to defeat and enemies with varying attacks and speeds.

4829880.title: 电气战忍录-YOGENKYO Demo
4829880.short_description: 化身为四象战忍队的少年忍者们，在细腻2D手绘的永夜霓虹繁华都市场景中穿梭，为了守护夜幻京的和平勇敢的同邪恶的妖怪势力战斗！思考团队战术策略，施展各具特色的华丽招式横扫强敌！在少年们充满热血与感动的故事绘卷中，收获无可取代的爱与牵绊吧！

4730140.title: 山河纪 Demo
4730140.short_description: 《山河纪》是一款轻量化、快节奏的历史战争策略游戏。从秦扫六合的铁血雄风，到大明远航的浩渺波涛，您将体验历史经典战役的风云变幻。在这里，您将穿越时空，亲临战场，运筹帷幄，决胜千里，谱写传奇。

4622250.title: The Final Week
4622250.short_description: Take command of the final place on earth that hasn't been complete destroyed. Gather survivors and save as many of them as you can by sending them into space to the base there. Remember you have 7 days

4778350.title: Cold Dark
4778350.short_description: Cold Dark is a survival horror boomer shooter. Wake up in a deserted hospital with no memory of how you got there. Battle zombies and mutated horrors with your shotgun and chainsaw as you uncover the truth behind a deadly outbreak consuming the city.

4814750.title: Driftscape: Void Demo
4814750.short_description: Pilot a momentum-driven ship through the cooled remains of dead star systems. Master a growing arsenal, take on 10+ unique epic bosses, and tackle two sectors (demo) your way. The world is seed-generated — build and share your own in the free level editor.

4687560.title: 第十分钟
4687560.short_description: 《第十分钟》是一部约 2 小时可完成的短篇叙事游戏，以聊天互动推进，以小说阅读展开正文。玩家将在聊天窗口中接收消息、做出回应，并逐步进入一段不断被重新理解的校园记忆。故事围绕三人之间未能说出口的感情、记忆错位与迟来的理解展开，是一部慢热的青春心理悬疑故事。

4677090.title: 火种与屁
4677090.short_description: 《火种与屁》是一款以寻宝、锻造与角色养成为核心的动作角色扮演游戏。搜刮怪物掉落的骨头、矿石与魔法遗物，亲手熔炼并锻造出传说级装备；将数十种技能宝石嵌入武器插槽，自由搭配普攻、冲刺与器灵技能，组合出属于你的战斗流派；在森林、雪山、诅咒村庄等风格迥异的区域中迎战强敌，用你自己打造的流派杀出一条通往真相的血路。

4715350.title: Room: 405 | Love Beyond Reality
4715350.short_description: ROOM 405 is a Psychological Horror Romance game about Jack, a young man who moves into a small apartment in the heart of Bangkok. “Tonight… please don’t leave.”

4592140.title: PokerVersity: Challenge
4592140.short_description: A poker training challenge where you analyze real scenarios and make the best decision. Improve your hand reading, strategy, and win rate through interactive quizzes and continuous practice.

4296030.title: Boo Boo Families
4296030.short_description: 曾经播出的儿童节目《Boo Boo Families》。 其中的角色开始从“屏幕的另一边”出现。 你必须在五天内忍受他们的到访。

4818270.title: Grind 'Em All Demo
4818270.short_description: 将它们统统碾碎！ 在这款刺激的增量游戏中，体验粉碎怪物并不断变强的极致快感。

4616630.title: Ranger: Far From Home
4616630.short_description: Ranger: Far From Home is a single-player game where your goal is to survive and reach the evacuation point while overcoming various challenges you encounter along the way.

4196120.title: The Name I Wear
4196120.short_description: In an ancient riad once used as the base of a spy network, retrace the events and people tied to a forgotten tragedy. Your weapon? Names. Find them, write them, become them.

4803470.title: Dead Station Together
4803470.short_description: 一场致命的疫情席卷了一座偏远的空间站。在这款支持1-4名玩家的合作生存恐怖游戏中，与好友组队，回收DNA样本，营救船员，并在与感染者的对抗中生存下来。

4767030.title: 方块消消乐
4767030.short_description: 简单有趣的消消乐游戏

4777090.title: Hellocracy
4777090.short_description: HELLOCRACY is a story-driven first-person survival shooter set in a bureaucratic hellscape. Fight demons in endless office corridors, use weapons and melee combat, survive, craft, and try to find a way out of this dreaded office hell.

4773870.title: Emotion Hunter Demo
4773870.short_description: 此DEMO为饰燐音个人制作的手绘动漫风格2D横向卷轴近战动作游戏。在潜意识的世界狩猎他人的负面情绪，用战斗技巧打倒由负面情绪而生的怪物。游戏DEMO内有三种难度可以选择，选择适合的难度来挑战吧。

4338450.title: Heavy Is The Crown
4338450.short_description: A casual 2-4 player rogue-lite round based fighting game. The losing players of each round vote on a unique debuff for the winner of the round to even the odds.

4514650.title: Jewels of the Wild West：完成三消，建设城市
4514650.short_description: 这款情节丰富的城市建设及解谜游戏巧妙结合了三消玩法与荒野西部冒险故事。玩家需要在重建柯林斯镇的过程中完成放松解压的图块匹配，建造城镇地标并探索边境，将这个尘土飞扬的边陲小镇建设成蒸蒸日上的传奇之地。

4855390.title: Star Colony Demo
4855390.short_description: 是一款资源管理与增量/太空殖民地建设游戏。

4676340.title: 我来你家玩！
4676340.short_description: 这是一款恐怖点击解密游戏，你需要找到逃脱困境的同时与一位邪神神父玩一场捉迷藏~别抓到他哦❤

4777880.title: Deep Drift Signal Below
4777880.short_description: 潜入一场 2D 水下动作冒险，每一次下潜都伴随着风险。管理氧气与压力，回收宝藏，升级装备，并追随一个神秘信号，从浅海礁区一路深入深渊。

4794380.title: 千层登塔
4794380.short_description: 登塔客持琥珀金光，同道相随，在云雾山水间的千层楼阁中不断向上。 《千层登塔》以侧视像素呈现东方塔楼：屏风、横梁、曲折楼梯与自动战斗并存。你不必微操每场打斗——召唤与升级，剩下的交给登塔客与同道。金币来自击杀，成长来自你的选择：强化登塔客、培养同道、解锁楼层封锁与召唤扩容，让队伍在无限楼层里越爬越高。 Steam 页面上线后欢迎加入愿望单；开发中版本持续迭代，欢迎反馈建议。

4822810.title: 城郊主理人从街角小店到区域价格卡特尔实现供应链托拉斯 DEMO
4822810.short_description: 《城郊主理人》是一款深度还原中国超市经营环境的硬核商业模拟游戏。在全3D城郊沙盘中自由勘测选址，无网格搭建实体卖场。告别线性流程，您将直连App采购百货，统筹仓储物流，并处理包含“五险”与“到手薪资”核算的真实人事账单。运用商业直觉应对动态市场，体验纯粹的开店历程。

4806710.title: The Disappearing Municipality Worker Demo
4806710.short_description: This mystery requires a mixture of real detective skills, deductive reasoning, and good-old moon logic. "When something doesn't make sense... What does it mean?"

3083810.title: Sir Parry
3083810.short_description: Smash through waves of creatures in this dexterity based roguelite where the only move you have is to parry. Synergize your upgrades and perfect your timing to become a monster slapping parry god!

4420350.title: PPPoker
4420350.short_description: PPPoker-Hold'em,Omaha Poker App,Global Battle,Home Games,Play Poker With Friends

4637330.title: 公司崛起
4637330.short_description: 在这款模拟经营游戏中，你将扮演一名创业者，从一个只有几个人的小团队起步，一步步打造属于自己的公司帝国。

4353630.title: 与夏日姐姐们的甜蜜时光
4353630.short_description: 时隔多年重返乡间，这个夏天优终于要与哈娜、莉娜、希娜三姐妹重逢了！不料母亲因急事匆匆返家，他将独自与三姐妹共度一段时光。宁静温馨的日式乡村里，等待他的会是怎样的夏日趣事呢？

4724900.title: 无限面包
4724900.short_description: 《无限面包》是一款以面包为主题的放置类挂机休闲游戏 您将扮演一尊巨大的面包，为您的面民生产源源不断的食物 使用面包来建设您的领土，见证您帝国的兴盛，享受数值的快感。 整个生产流程的操作十分简易，您可以在养活千万面民的同时空出您的双手来操劳帝国内外的其它要事。

3975500.title: 星之牧歌
3975500.short_description: 在神秘的世界中照顾人型圣灵的慢生活牧场经营模拟游戏。 种植作物、饲养圣灵（动物）， 或者与自己喜欢的角色进行交流，恋爱，结婚，孕育后代， 以属于自己的方式度过每日的快乐时光！

4814000.title: Oath for Glory Demo
4814000.short_description: Join the tournament as a lowly knight of a small village. A skill-based boss fighting game built around directional combat. Learn, adapt, and master precise melee mechanics where player skill determines victory.

4534470.title: PX2: The Termination
4534470.short_description: PX2 is a wonderfully wacky platformer with exquisite music and goofy visuals to top it all off. Jump, shoot, and fall in a hole as you explore the many worlds of PX2!

4666170.title: Antarctic Showdown 남극결투 Demo
4666170.short_description: 《Antarctic Showdown》是一款1v1射击肉鸽游戏，每次失败都能强化自己的Build。 干掉你的朋友，夺取胜利！

4797790.title: Rescue Dogs vs Aliens Tower Defense
4797790.short_description: Command heroic rescue dogs in a colorful tower defense battle against alien invaders. Build, upgrade, unlock heroes, defend strange battlefields, and survive wave after wave in RDVA-TD: Rescue Dogs vs Aliens.

4178360.title: Snake Coil: Puzzle Adventure
4178360.short_description: A relaxing 3D puzzle game where you guide a cute forest snake that grows every move and must fill every tile on the grid.

4702580.title: Worlda Demo
4702580.short_description: Jonas the bear cub. That's you, the expert builder, miner, gardener, and serial killer of bunnies (with a shotgun). You have been given a special staff, Stonebreaker, which can break anything: stone, trees, wild boars, flowers, the lot. The only thing it can't break are those honey hives! Grrr.

4838180.title: Broken Soccer Demo
4838180.short_description: 史上最荒谬足球游戏的试玩版！在完整版推出前，试着带领外星人、穴居人、嬉皮士、老人、死忠球迷和维京人赢下这座预备杯吧。

3838920.title: Retronaut
3838920.short_description: A rogue star pilot lost between galaxies—upgrade your ship, harness ancient artifacts, and survive relentless alien hordes in this cosmic action roguelite.

3518340.title: Chill Fishing
3518340.short_description: Chill Fishing是一段终极悠闲的桌面钓鱼体验！

4850010.title: Babo & Luda adventure Demo
4850010.short_description: Babo And Luda Adventure is a chaotic 3D action platformer! Take control of this wild duo and embark on a crazy journey to defeat evil enemies. Master insane combat combos, explore wild environments, and gear up for action packed run and gun stages!

4752220.title: SIGNAL PIT
4752220.short_description: A fast-paced monster arena roguelite where every beast has unique passive traits, active skills, and powerful overclock abilities. Build your mutation loadout, survive deadly fights, and evolve between runs.

4574250.title: The Secret Dungeon
4574250.short_description: Embark on a 2-player adventure through vast, enchanted realms. Wield weapons, uncover powerful upgrades, and face dark magic as you explore a fallen kingdom. Easy to jump in, with depth for those who venture deeper into the dungeon's mysteries.

4855520.title: Stickplosion Demo
4855520.short_description: 免费试玩《Stickplosion》——一款快节奏、混乱的 2D 像素风格斗游戏，每一面墙和地板都可破坏。本试玩版为单人模式：在多种模式中对抗可调节机器人、抽取 Roguelite 强化并切碎竞技场。可游玩最多 1 小时，之后即可购买完整版。

4846470.title: Ore & Ordnance Demo
4846470.short_description: Ore & Ordnance is a Retro styled, Sci-fi, Bullet Hell. Survive endless waves of Pirates, Asteroids and Firestorms. Collect upgrades, complete missions and survive your shift! How long will you last?

4738990.title: Purge Directive
4738990.short_description: Survive endless waves of the undead in Purge Directive — a 1–4 player online co-op FPS. Earn points per kill, upgrade your arsenal between waves, and see how long you and your squad can hold the line.

4728550.title: Outscratched Demo
4728550.short_description: The scratchcard roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble a unique selection of scratchcards, blessed charms, and magical stickers. Discover endless exciting combos to beat the odds against a diabolical lottery.

4857780.title: Cobot-Man Adventure Demo
4857780.short_description: Cobot-Man Adventure is an action shooter game against evil robots. It offers a fun and entertaining experience. Discover the excitement and amusement it provides with its action-adventure gameplay. Cobot-Man will face bosses of different kind during the adventure.

4227010.title: Cave Of Treats
4227010.short_description: Live a spooky Halloween night as a skeleton dressed up as a mummy! Play a haunted old arcade game that, on Halloween night, can bring monsters out of the TV. Fight off waves of monsters trying to escape the game to steal all your candy!

4681880.title: Dragon Kisser
4681880.short_description: Left alone as your little village’s last hope, you: Domingo, know what you must do to save your people and also pull a hot date, and that is to do what you know best: Romance the dragon attacking your home! Put your charisma to the test in this cheeky third-person soulslike boss battle!

4738170.title: 哈里斯大道上的善举
4738170.short_description: 在这款简短的PSX风格解谜冒险游戏中，理清哈里斯大道居民们错综复杂的愿望与期许。沐浴在夏日午后的灼热阳光下，探索精心打造的复杂环境，并揭开《哈里斯大道上的善举》所蕴含的深意。

4862360.title: Swordsmith of Greyhaven Demo
4862360.short_description: Run a weaponsmith shop in dark medieval city of Greyhaven. Sell weapons, manage gold, debt, materials, and fame, while customers, beggars, bandits, and rumors reveal the consequences of every choice.

3296780.title: HAECHE_Ism_Demo
3296780.short_description: In the demo, you'll slash, pierce, and parry your way through swarms of infected machines across an 8-directional grid

4160930.title: Destruction of Heavenly Bliss
4160930.short_description: A roguelite shoot 'em up with an oldschool aesthetic and an intense gameplay loop. Fight through 9 levels of a grueling training simulation, growing stronger with every loop, and realize ignorance truly is bliss.

4845710.title: The End of the World Club Demo
4845710.short_description: A cute coming-of-age boys' love (BL/yaoi) visual novel set in 2012 about a group of high school students who start a club to prepare for the end of the world.

4783550.title: Whispers of the Requiem Demo
4783550.short_description: Step into the mind of a disgraced ex-cop, once a servant of a powerful cult that controls society from the shadows. Now hunted, betrayed, and haunted by sins too dark to name, you must hide the truth before it devours you.

4127210.title: Late for School
4127210.short_description: A mashup of Crazy Taxi–style arcade chaos and bus-driving simulation, wrapped in a pixel-art Saturday morning cartoon vibe.

4510730.title: 1B1E
4510730.short_description: Welcome to the city where the sun went out forever. Only rain, darkness, and an endless stream of corpses.

4806930.title: War of the Austrian Succession Demo
4806930.short_description: Fight across Europe during the War of the Austrian Succession in a tactical wargame of dynastic conflict, continental campaigns, cavalry charges, and rebellions. Command Austrian, Prussian, French, British, Bavarian, Spanish, Sardinian, Jacobite and allied forces across 85 scenarios and 3 campaigns.

4449310.title: Strike On
4449310.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer dodgeball built for pure competitive action. Master precise throws, dodge incoming attacks, and dominate the arena through skill, timing, and movement. Easy to pick up, hard to master — every match is intense, strategic, and action-packed.

4804520.title: BURI Demo
4804520.short_description: A story-driven choice-based game where every decision shapes the outcome. Follow Pluem, a boy facing pressure, family expectations, and bullying, with multiple endings determined by your choices.

4483120.title: Tales Beyond The Tomb - No Witnesses
4483120.short_description: A psychological horror anthology inspired by disturbing real-life cases. In No Witnesses, a simple road trip turns into a brutal fight for survival when two sisters cross paths with a ruthless serial killer stalking the highways at night.

4829260.title: Coiled Silence Demo
4829260.short_description: Coiled Silence is a psychological horror demo about a night shift that starts ordinary and turns wrong. Work the restaurant, manage orders from your phone, and survive the atmosphere as messages and details stop lining up.

4313610.title: Chopping Together🌲
4313610.short_description: 一款支持1–4人合作的游戏，你被困在森林中，目标是砍倒所有树木。

4748130.title: Awkward Night
4748130.short_description: A cyberpunk noir point-and-click. One bar, one bad night, one drink that proves something. Mix the impossible cocktail. Trade favours. Step out into the rain and meet the stranger waiting under the COCKTAILS sign. Episode 1 of an ongoing indie narrative experiment.

4833510.title: Harlequinade Demo
4833510.short_description: Harlequinade is a horror otome romance visual novel about a never-ending carnival and a very death-prone college student. With the aid of 2 clowns, can you escape this timeloop?

4586660.title: Howl Of Heavens Demo
4586660.short_description: Howl of Heavens 是即時戰術策略遊戲，講述一名年輕少尉接任野戰總部指揮官的故事。成功實現戰略目標以及整個軍事行動的結果皆取決於你！

3753790.title: Hunters In The Dark
3753790.short_description: 黑暗中，宝藏就在眼前！紧张刺激的派对追逐游戏，支持一至四名玩家。每位玩家可以自由选择扮演追逐宝藏的寻宝猎人，或者狩猎其他猎人的暗影猎人。时间紧迫，每局地图随机生成。只有跑得快、躲得准、充分利用道具，才能成为真正的猎人！

4790960.title: BeaconBound
4790960.short_description: Collect 15 glowing beacons in a living procedural world. Unlock boost, shield, and stasis to outsmart guardians that adapt as you progress, while weather and terrain reshape every run.

4098220.title: TD Run: Survivors
4098220.short_description: Battle through hordes of foes in this roguelike blend of survivors, bullet hell, and tower defense. Conquering TD Run will require more than simple survivor-esque DPS checks. Determine optimal character and weapon specific builds and employ real-time tactics to stay ahead of the increasing enemies.

4771720.title: The Labyrinth on Burrow Hill
4771720.short_description: Unravel a thread of riddles and mystery as you progress your way through the atmospheric halls of a dazzlingly large, long-deserted labyrinth. Explore the vistas of spectacular rooms and the hidden challenges within. Do you have what it takes to find what lies at the labyrinth's centre?

4324610.title: 100 Madagascar Cats
4324610.short_description: 🐾 加入充满猫咪的主题地点，展开最可爱的冒险！ 😻 探索特别场所迷人的手绘艺术作品，尝试在整个游戏中找到隐藏的100只可爱猫咪。 🐈🕵️‍♂️ 你能找到它们全部吗？ 🕵️‍♂️🐈

3392490.title: Moon River
3392490.short_description: Moon River is a short RPG adventure with an emphasis on music and atmosphere. Perhaps some secrets too... Explore the remains of an quiet, empty world & find the river's end.

4807600.title: Armor of God
4807600.short_description: A 2D pixel-art platformer where you choose which armor to wear. Full armor makes you invincible - anyone can win. Leave some behind and the game becomes a very different challenge.

4555460.title: What You Didn't See
4555460.short_description: Explore shifting places, uncover lost memories, and escape the creatures that look after you. A psychological horror game about guilt, loss, and the haunting silence of unspoken truths.

4653920.title: ComboChain Pulse
4653920.short_description: Survive relentless waves in a fast-paced top-down bullet hell shooter. Chain combos, dodge chaos, and master skill-based combat where every second matters.

4862870.title: SYSCALL: RING ZERO Demo
4862870.short_description: Reverse-engineer a private 1990s BBS. Read disassembly, patch broken checks, optimize a nine-core rack, and write assembly firmware that locks onto live scope traces. With 200+ puzzles, full controller support and offline play, you can refine your assembly skills on all your devices!

4072310.title: Monster Hub
4072310.short_description: 是一款温馨的开放世界冒险游戏。寻找传送门并深入地下遗迹搜刮稀有宝物，打造你的专属营地，投入珍贵资源并在孵化器中培育出独特的战斗伙伴。如果想找点乐子，你还可以在任何地方建造大炮，将炮弹、你的怪物甚至你自己发射上天！

4749520.title: 人工魔法言語体系
4749520.short_description: Create your own spells and play the content!

4828290.title: Cricket Captain 2026 Demo
4828290.short_description: Build your dream team with Cricket Captain 2026. Forty-five new playable domestic teams across Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Ireland, Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe, plus match engine and 3D highlights improvements, editor customisation, and faster gameplay throughout.

4858630.title: Chief of the Valley Demo
4858630.short_description: Build a PC company from a one-person operation in the dawn of computing to an industry titan in the modern era. Manage staff, secure contracts, research technology, and ship products all while keeping yourself from financial ruin. The Valley is an unforgiving place.

4692700.title: Monologin
4692700.short_description: 在这部关于逃避现实与被时代抛下的短篇心理惊悚视觉小说中，一名迷失方向的夜班店员死死抓住一款濒临消亡的 MMORPG、一只传说中的白色独角兽坐骑，以及“老游戏才更‘真实’”的信念不放。

4692710.title: Monologin Demo
4692710.short_description: 《Monologin》试玩版短篇，以氛围感与不安为核心……值守深夜便利店，登录一款濒临消亡的 MMORPG，在旧友来来往往间，等待白色独角兽活动的到来。

4860300.title: Backrooms: Splatter Demo
4860300.short_description: The Backrooms got colorful. Suit up, grab your paint, and splatter your way out of the liminal void with up to 4 friends.

4798320.title: Cook & Click
4798320.short_description: A culinary management clicker game where you chop ingredients, unlock new categories, and open new locations. Automate your production, purchase upgrades to boost profits, unlock special abilities, and compete for challenging achievements. An addictive, endless progression experience.

4574280.title: Last Shop
4574280.short_description: A compact sci-fi experience where you manage a spaceship shop through a terminal interface.

4762390.title: Just a Little Longer
4762390.short_description: Just a Little Longer is a punishing top-down shooter with the staples of classic action horror games, with a brutal permadeath gambling twist: whenever you die in the recurring nightmare the game takes place in, your save file is instantly deleted.

1509800.title: MAK: Survival
1509800.short_description: Survive and evolve in the open world of Oratius. Build, craft, fight creatures, explore hidden locations, ride mounts, and progress from the stone age to modern tech — alone or with friends. Create worlds, complete quests, and uncover the secrets of Mak Survival.

4764630.title: Body Pillow Royal Demo
4764630.short_description: 后现代时代中不断被鼓励的死亡螺旋中浪漫排挤的竞争性讽刺。2-4人在线/本地分屏。黑色幽默。

4204390.title: Tarot Spell
4204390.short_description: 快节奏的打字生存游戏，通过学习塔罗牌并结合其含义，创造出强大的法术。

4827530.title: Cold Trigger Demo
4827530.short_description: Dive into Cold Trigger, a thrilling third-person shooter (TPS) that puts you in the center of fast-paced, action-packed battles.

4623360.title: Max's Jungle Odyssey
4623360.short_description: Enjoy a 2D platforming adventure with 3D graphics starring Max, a brave cat. Experience over 30 levels and an exciting storyline in single-player or local multiplayer. What are you waiting for? The Kikis won't save themselves! Controller is required for local multiplayer.

4360480.title: The Man Behind the Trigger
4360480.short_description: Action-platform game set in the mid-2000s. Take vengeance upon six key figures of the entertainment industry for morally bankrupt the society you once loved.

4791730.title: Market Simulator: Miami Beach
4791730.short_description: 在阳光明媚的迈阿密海滩从零开始建立你的超市帝国！游戏初期你只能睡在简陋的街头帐篷里，你需要亲自驾驶车辆前往批发商处提取货物，并将商品一件件亲手摆上货架，体验最真实的补货过程。在这个充满挑战的残酷街头经济中努力生存下来，组建家庭并让你的家人在街头帮你赚取额外现金以维持资金流转。在这个极其逼真的商业管理与生活模拟游戏中，通过精明的策略不断扩大你的零售业务，最终成功掌控并运营两家繁华的超市门店。

2938870.title: Maseylia : Echoes of the Past
2938870.short_description: 探索神秘奇幻的世界！Maseylia: Echoes of the Past是一款3D类银河恶魔城游戏。解锁独特技能，发现隐藏路径，掌握流畅移动。面对野生生物，揭开广阔互联世界的秘密。

4811310.title: Floyd's Cafe Demo
4811310.short_description: Floyd's Cafe is an upcoming cute cozy cat cafe game where you can make anything from black tea to Moka pot coffee or even just use a coffee machine. Decorate the Cafe to perfection with flowers, shelfs, and even cacti.

4860210.title: Tales of the Trade Demo
4860210.short_description: 在一个奇幻世界里，开一家属于你的中世纪小店吧。进货、摆货、应付各种离谱顾客，还要处理那些“多少带点魔法问题”的商品。顺便……也就顺便慢慢还清你祖父留下的 99,999,999,980 金币债务。

3789200.title: Querent Demo
3789200.short_description: Rally the small town of Sunset Junction to survive hypnotic creatures in a post-apocalyptic desert landscape. Boost skills by building a deck for each of your characters. Use mesmerism to solve puzzles and build relationships with the people you meet. Play your cards right and you might survive!

4839000.title: 外婆的手账本 Demo
4839000.short_description: 《外婆的手账本》是一款温暖治愈的情感叙事+烹饪模拟游戏。翻开外婆留下的手账本，在一段段与外婆一起做饭的美好回忆中重走成长之路。那些曾被忽略的日常，终将拼凑出一个你从未真正了解过的她。

4782800.title: OPEN GUARD
4782800.short_description: The first Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu gym management simulation. Build an academy, sign fighters, develop them through the belt ranks, and compete from local opens to world championships. Every save tells a different story.

4642310.title: Taktari
4642310.short_description: Taktari is a turn-based auto-battle game where both player and enemies queue up their actions prior to battle. Press play and let the actions play out in this African Inspired Fantasy deck building game.

4659260.title: Water Truck Simulator
4659260.short_description: Drive a heavy water tanker fill your tank travel through city roads and off-road routes and deliver water safely across challenging missions in Water Truck Simulator. Test your driving skills as you control a mini water tanker truck through traffic.

4580780.title: Morph Browser
4580780.short_description: 瀏覽器本身，就是你的操作對象。 Morph Browser 是一款桌面益智遊戲，你只需要一顆滑鼠，操控瀏覽器視窗，將球引導至目標。 遊戲的舞台是整個螢幕。移動視窗位置或調整大小來引導物理運算的球——規則雖然簡單，背後卻有多個截然不同的關卡在等待著你。 隨著關卡推進，所要求的操作也會不斷改變。 你的螢幕，就是遊戲場。 不需要任何特殊控制器，只需要滑鼠。 但你平日慣用的視窗操作與 OS 設定，將直接決定你能否過關。

4753590.title: TEAM PANIC
4753590.short_description: TEAM PANIC 是一款电影化的合作冒险游戏，两名玩家将一起解开谜题，通过团队合作推进游戏，并体验充满乐趣的时刻。

4318730.title: Dino Pet Walker
4318730.short_description: Dino Pet Walker is a Fantasy Casual Game where you realize your childhood dream and play with your dinosaur pet. On this adventure, be ready for solve puzzles and have fun with your and another dino's in a voxel art enviroment, inspired by brazillians biomes.

4769010.title: Promo Wrestling World
4769010.short_description: Book the cards, manage the roster, build champions, and survive a living wrestling industry where rival promotions sign talent, run shows, grow, fold, and reshape the world around your dynasty over years of play.

4297350.title: Power and Glory
4297350.short_description: Power & Glory is a fast-paced 2D action fantasy RPG where you rise from an outsider to power. Choose your origin, fight through dangerous dungeons, loot powerful items, gain skills, shape your build, and make choices that define your path and faction influence.

2136420.title: FIRE The First Dreamer
2136420.short_description: 探索古老秘密，召唤图腾之力，解读神秘讯息，在这款基于真实故事的开放世界冒险中踏入威尔士普雷塞利群山。踏上旅程，重寻有意义的人生之道。

4170220.title: Dave.EXE
4170220.short_description: Time travel and explore different worlds to save the universe from the evil overlord, Edgy Dave. Empty vending machines of their soda, go on various errands and evade E.D's goons as you desperately run for your life in this goofy comedy horror game!

4356540.title: Monster Rush Survivors
4356540.short_description: 在《Monster Rush Survivors》中对抗无尽的敌人浪潮，这是一款节奏快速的Roguelite生存游戏，拥有疯狂的构筑！组合装备、强化技能、解锁角色，在这个充满协同效果的高强度弹幕天堂中消灭成千上万的敌人。

4739360.title: It's Hunting Time
4739360.short_description: Hunting season is open! It's time to make some money as you roam the unexplored expanses of the empire.

4691080.title: Zyntaris
4691080.short_description: 一款支持合作模式的类Roguelike生存游戏。独自或与好友一起消灭成千上万的敌人。解锁拥有独特能力的新英雄。收集稀有武器和魔法书，将它们组合起来，发现疯狂的联动效果！

4848040.title: Cluemates Demo
4848040.short_description: A co-op puzzle game where you and your friends explore maps, search for clues, and try to crack a hidden color sequence. Half the clues are fake. All of your friends will be wrong. Good luck.

4772040.title: Peko Downhill Hurl
4772040.short_description: Control a ball rolling under gravity and momentum. You can steer it a little - but once the inertia builds up, staying in control becomes the real challenge.

4772030.title: Political Debate
4772030.short_description: Debate against leftists. Create your own debates and NPCs, and share them with your friends. The game includes tools to make the creation of user content easier.

4744020.title: Super Sub: World Cup
4744020.short_description: Win the world cup through clever clicks, useful upgrades, silly own goals, and bending the rules. An active incremental game that strips football down to just its beautiful beating heart: kick balls hard, score goals, earn money.

4743370.title: Castle Ruglia
4743370.short_description: Awaken with no memory and uncover the secrets of Castle Ruglia in this retro-inspired story adventure featuring puzzle-solving, exploration, and turn-based combat in a hand-drawn colored-pencil world.

4775040.title: Deigon Witch
4775040.short_description: 在戴贡森林中开设你自己的魔药店。倾听顾客们的故事，调制他们所需要的魔药，并通过你的选择，在命运与自由意志的斗争中走出属于自己的道路。

3972370.title: 奇跡の探偵
3972370.short_description: A high school detective story where an unlikely duo tackles mysterious incidents on campus. Solve strange cases with logic and courage in this suspenseful visual novel.

4853870.title: ShuriStellaDemo
4853870.short_description: 为了阻止世界毁灭，前往星之丘—— 《珠漓斯特拉》是一款画风温馨的动漫风3D动作游戏。玩家将化身为天空之民的巫女「珠漓」（Shuri），一边闪避强敌的猛烈攻击，一边借助神秘的「巫女之力」挺身对抗。

3960740.title: Sheeps
3960740.short_description: Kill a sheep - Feed it to a tree - Listen to a poem. Sheeps is a poem-based adventure in a small open-world. Find 100 poems contained within the sheeps roaming the world. Reading more poems expands the world, unlocks new abilities, and reveals characters from the poems to converse with.

4675490.title: Zombie Survival Demo
4675490.short_description: The theme is literally zombie survival. No Humans Allowed, except as the main course. An apocalyptic city building survival game where you grow the zombie horde and take over the world.

2881370.title: 感谢你的投递
2881370.short_description: 《感谢你的投递》是一款剧情驱动的面试模拟游戏。经过15轮的面试，你与该岗位不太匹配。你被调剂为初级面试官，根据公司要求筛选候选人的简历，并发出合适的感谢信。

4651020.title: Skye The Stormbound Witch
4651020.short_description: 引导小女巫Skye开启一段疯狂的攀登之旅！在这款3D精密平台游戏中跳跃、躲避并收集球体。在坠落之前，你能爬多高？

4596760.title: Empire Water Works Demo
4596760.short_description: Empire Water Works is a steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.

4684040.title: Space Fetus Attack Idle Clicker
4684040.short_description: Click, automate, and scale your damage in a ridiculous idle clicker. Capture space fetuses, defeat bosses, and unlock powerful upgrades. Numbers will spiral out of control.

4809700.title: House Party 8
4809700.short_description: A short first-person anomaly horror game set inside a looping house party. Observe carefully, trust your memory, and escape only when everything feels normal.

4764610.title: 랩틸리언을 국회로! Demo
4764610.short_description: Become a Reptilian and Seize the Presidency! Play as a presidential aide and guide the Reptilian Kim Yong-baem all the way to the top. Train presidential qualities by day and solve intelligence puzzles by night to outmaneuver human candidates one by one.

4836430.title: Traders Life Together Demo
4836430.short_description: Start your supermarket business and make your own trading Journey! With Co-op support Play solo or team up with friends, featuring over 300 items you can make your dream store, enjoy it with your friends!

4836710.title: 7 Millimeters Demo
4836710.short_description: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

4787670.title: S.I.F: The Missing Rescue Demo
4787670.short_description: S.I.F: The Missing Rescue is a 1-4 player cooperative horror game set in a U.S. national park. Someone has gone missing. Your team is going in. A maze-like forest. Something watching your team. But the missing person is still in there. Walk toward the danger. That’s the job.

4804900.title: Roll to Riches Demo
4804900.short_description: Gather, Build and Advance your settlement with every roll in the incremental city builder Roll to Riches. Mine iron, gather wood and cut stone to make your settlement prosper. Trade with merchants every minute and transform your small camp into a wealthy Norse empire.

4487180.title: Marshmallow Marvin: Timberfall
4487180.short_description: Marshmallow Marvin: Timberfall is a 2D pixel art platformer where Marvin explores the moonlit Timberfall Woods, dodging bears, owls, traps, and wild dangers while mastering precision platforming to survive the night and uncover hidden forest secrets.

4664370.title: Store Simulator Pettikkada
4664370.short_description: Run your own local shop. Order Stock, manage store selling Products (fill product), set prices, bill settle customers your store.

3585900.title: Void Tech
3585900.short_description: 在轨修复卫星，减少太空垃圾，顺便饱览壮丽景色。 《Void Tech》是一款太空维修模拟游戏，每一次任务都在延长卫星寿命、修复关键基础设施。

2899760.title: 樱花，萌放。-as the Night's, Reincarnation-
2899760.short_description: 这是一篇写给“魔法少女”的故事。拯救了人类未来的魔法少女们，历经苦战终于迎来幸福的结局。十年来迷惘着、烦恼着，继续前行。樱花飞舞之际，伴着“春”的归来，命运的齿轮再次开始转动。这是一篇并非为“魔法少女”而写的故事。我们的魔法，是不输给任何人的“想象力”。这一篇交织着他们愿望、幸福、离别与救赎的童话由此展开。

3841700.title: ローズ・ルイン
3841700.short_description: Drawn into a spectral library within the Spirit World, the protagonist seeks a way to escape with guidance from Lisa, a woman trapped within. A horror adventure that uncovers the lingering emotions and hidden truths left behind in the Spirit World

4539580.title: Illvelo Swamp
4539580.short_description: Multiple goals. Multiple routes. Multiple endings. Complete missions to unlock new paths in a branching stage layout. As soon as you dip your toes in, you'll find yourself sucked deeper and deeper into this bottomless quagmire of a shmup.

4707710.title: Space Ends
4707710.short_description: Its a simple Wave based game where you can only use a sword and if you collect enough points, you can escape the planet.

4148600.title: Once Upon A Card
4148600.short_description: Help a royal child find their way through their dreams! Use cards to build paths, create combos, and adapt your strategy as each run brings new challenges and bosses. Will you let the nightmares take over?

4719920.title: 幸存者笔记 Demo
4719920.short_description: 《幸存者笔记》是一款全动态影像末日丧尸生存游戏。玩家将同时扮演男女两位主角，通过选择与各种快速反应事件在游戏过程中推进不同的剧情分支最终根据不同的选择完成不同的游戏结局。当“梦见末日的普通人”，与“来自末日的幸存者”相遇，时间、记忆与命运开始交错。他们在崩塌的城市中追寻真相，在一次次选择中失去同伴、撕裂信念，也逐渐逼近那被刻意掩埋的答案。

4719820.title: Arkada
4719820.short_description: Play difficult arcades and test your sanity in handcrafted pixel art world

4725580.title: 禁断之爱 DEMO
4725580.short_description: 通往禁忌之梦的爱 《禁断之爱》是一款讲述师生之间禁忌恋情的视觉小说，追寻那被禁锢的梦想。

4720600.title: Bloxzer
4720600.short_description: Bloxzer 是一款趣味十足的益智逻辑脑力游戏。你需要运用智慧，将方块滚入绿色洞中才能通关。激活桥梁，甚至在条件允许的情况下使用传送功能！1-15 关免费，16-30 关为付费关卡，但通常更有趣也更具挑战性。

4312080.title: Without Sanctuary
4312080.short_description: Without Sanctuary is an underground fighting game set inside the El-Malo nightclub. No rules, no mercy—only raw combat. Choose powerful or fast fighters, battle for glory, and claim the prize in brutal fight nights where only one survives.

4818610.title: Don't Block My Ads! Demo
4818610.short_description: At the head of your own advertising agency, generate maximum conversions! Customize your campaigns, leverage social media, and master the latest trends to attract more and more clients and build a true commercial empire. Will you be able to seize every opportunity?

4788490.title: Chiggas - Survival of the Mitiest
4788490.short_description: Survive the swarm, recruit Chigga Soldiers, unlock wild powerups, and fight through chaotic stages in Chiggas: Survival of the Mitiest, a fast arcade survival game packed with weapons, boosts, bosses, and Legendary Chigga Wear.

4811540.title: Blackstrike Protocol
4811540.short_description: Blackstrike Protocol is an intense third-person multiplayer shooter (TPS) that puts you at the center of strategic confrontations, where teamwork, precision, and skill are key to victory.

4783270.title: Craft Drill
4783270.short_description: Craft Drill - this mining simulator puts you in control of powerful drilling equipment, letting you explore mysterious mines and uncover hidden treasures.

4625760.title: 山上那个猴儿
4625760.short_description: 一款以西游为背景的挂机放置游戏，操作简单，内容丰富，属于长期放置型游戏，花果山上的一只小猴儿，在取经的故事发生百年后，重新踏出花果山，闯荡西游世界的故事。与各处妖魔战斗，提升境界等级，打造坚甲神兵，学习神通功法，收集法宝奇珍，炼制奇丹妙药。

4766950.title: 狂战之旅
4766950.short_description: 一款回合制策略科幻游戏。带有轻度肉鸽属性的传统回合制游戏，玩家最多可以携带4个技能和3个个人遗物，搭配副本中获得到的团队遗物和道具进行攻关，游戏流程中会有不同的节点供玩家攻略，战斗、精英战斗、boss战斗、随机事件、营地、宝箱、甚至转职祭坛，4个迥异的游戏人物供玩家选择，分为4种传统职业，战士、法师、刺客、牧师。战斗奖励包括传统的道具、遗物、属性提升，还包括同职业的技能，同职业的技能玩家可以选择学习，覆盖掉当前技能、也可以选择通过消耗掉技能来强化现有的技能。祝大家玩的愉快！！

4811820.title: Pentabit Copy-X Demo
4811820.short_description: Pentabit Copy-X is a 90s Amiga themed puzzle game with roguelike elements. Edit and enhance your pieces, copy your data and defeat the glitches and IRQs. Test your skill in the benchmark or endless mode.

4808720.title: 2026 U.S. Election Simulator
4808720.short_description: Plot your way through an American political campaign as you go head-to-head against a rival political party. Participate in debates and travel to battleground states as you try to win a Presidential Election.

4762460.title: 斗牌苍穹 Demo
4762460.short_description: 《斗牌苍穹》是一款融入了道具卡牌的联机对战超能力麻将游戏。游戏对局中，有许多方式，可以获取能够辅助造牌或干扰对手的道具卡牌，通过各种卡牌的效果组合，在百变的麻将牌局中制定胡牌策略，与好友闲来搓把刺激的斗牌麻将吧！

4829330.title: Anatolian Horror Stories Demo
4829330.short_description: Anatolian Horror Stories:Curse in Bayramdere is a third-person survival horror game that puts you in the shoes of an ordinary young woman facing an unknown evil.No special skills.Just the desperate need to find out what happened to the people she loves and the will to survive long enough to do it.

4847160.title: Cornered Cadavers Demo
4847160.short_description: A survival horror game with fixed camera and pre rendered backgrounds. Explore a house filled with abominable monsters capable of opening doors and chasing you through every room! To make things even more difficult, your time and number of saves are very limited (depending on the difficulty level).

4746070.title: Eldara
4746070.short_description: Descend into Eldara, a dark fantasy idle game where every skill, every monster, and every whispered secret carves your path. Train 17 skills, hunt legendary beasts, command loyal pets, and unravel a forgotten realm — at your own pace, with progress that never stops.

4816670.title: Reunion Fate Demo
4816670.short_description: Reunion Fate is a psychological horror game where terror lurks in the places you think are safe. Use the flame to guide you through the darkness. Explore familiar and unfamiliar places. Hide from them. No one will tell you what you want to hear. And you still don't understand.

3936740.title: Trolley Time
3936740.short_description: Cute animals shopping for groceries - what chaos could possibly ensue? Play solo or with up to three friends in this bite-sized game, engaging in frantic action as you try to deliver as many groceries as possible within the time limit!

4825490.title: Select Eleven Demo
4825490.short_description: Take charge of a national cricket team. Pick your squad, set your tactics, and live every ball of every match across bilateral series, tournaments, and World Cups. Manage form, fitness, and the personalities in your dressing room as you chase glory for your country.

4860950.title: Anaa 15 Boss Challenge Demo
4860950.short_description: Anaa: 15 Boss Challenge is a 3D action boss-fighting game focused on dodging, slashing, upgrading your character, and surviving intense battles against powerful bosses.

4420050.title: The Unrealtor
4420050.short_description: A couch co-op puzzle adventure where two players navigate a surreal house tour, solving perspective-based puzzles by matching objects across their splitscreen, and uncovering a shifting maze of impossible architecture.

4766750.title: 관상
4766750.short_description: You are a street physiognomist. Daily, you read customers' faces to find auspicious or ill omens. Accuracy brings fame; failure threatens your livelihood. You must survive 31 days by dodging guard raids and paying protection fees. However, this routine won't last long.

3147560.title: 幼兽帕帕
3147560.short_description: 在宏大的世界中收集神奇的生物“帕帕”，让他们进行战斗、建造、种地，工业生产等等，这是一款全新开放世界生存制作游戏。

2907890.title: Wizzerd Quest 2
2907890.short_description: STOP THE DARK WIZZERD!!! Wizzerd Quest 2 is a retro first-person RPG with unhinged live-action FMV cutscenes, full splitscreen co-op, exciting boss encounters, and a vast open world to explore! Save the Roblins! Save the World! A standalone sequel to the shareware classic Wizzerd Quest!

4766640.title: They See Me Rollin'
4766640.short_description: Roll, boost, jump, and smash your way through chaotic procedural tracks in this fast-paced arcade multiplayer racing game.

4813940.title: Definitely Not a Cult
4813940.short_description: Build your “totally normal” community, upgrade your base, gather weird resources, recruit suspiciously calm members, and pretend the red flags are just decorative. Manage the chaos, unlock content, earn achievements, and do not ask why everyone keeps talking about pyramids.

4597300.title: Operation P.L.U.S.H
4597300.short_description: Operation Plush is a 1-4 player horde defender where you take control of dream-powered plushies defending your child's nighlight from the encroaching nightmare horde. Protect the dream, Defend the nightlight, Defeat the darkness

3744520.title: EASYROADS
3744520.short_description: WELCOME TO EASYROADS!! EASYROADS is Fun driving experience you can Race and Drift around, customize your car with going through the paint area. you can drift in tracks but BE CAREFULL, DONT HIT THE WALL! EASYROADS is skill based experience which brings FUN and RAGE. HAVE FUN

4080290.title: Bob's Island Demo
4080290.short_description: Fight your way across the island in this open world survival crafting game! Explore, craft, and mine in order to defeat the cursed monstrosities that inhabit the land, uncovering ancient secrets as you face off against strange creatures and challenging bosses!

4754040.title: Chronicles of High Worlds 1
4754040.short_description: Epic cinematic fantasy kinetic visual novel.

4689480.title: Relax Puzzle
4689480.short_description: 在忙碌的一天中寻找安宁。这款放松疗愈的拼图游戏拥有 100 幅精美的场景。只需简单地拖拽与交换图块，按照自己的节奏完成每张图片。没有时间限制——只有纯粹、无压力的乐趣。

4570300.title: Reality Stability Office
4570300.short_description: Reality is unstable, and information is distorted. As an auditor, you must identify anomalies using unreliable systems and conflicting data. But as you begin to lose your sanity, you’ll find yourself trying to control not just these anomalies, but yourself as well.

4797550.title: 正体 SHOUT-AI
4797550.short_description: 本作包含心理恐怖、不安的对话、画面噪声、黑屏、故障效果、伪代码日志，以及看起来像是玩家电脑上发生了某种异常的演出。不包含血腥肢解、露骨性内容、药物使用或针对现实人物的真实暴力表现。

4663220.title: 爆走！ランデブー
4663220.short_description: A side-scrolling runner where Twitch viewers help or sabotage you with 25+ commands. Run, survive, and watch your character transform. Features 9 characters, Endurance Mode, and Nightmare Mode. Fun for streamers, viewers, and solo players alike.

4747220.title: 请别叫它粪作啊主播大人: ㅎ廾立立ㅣ 乚卜乚卜己ㅜ
4747220.short_description: [主播，请别叫它垃圾游戏] 是一款随着关卡推进不断获得“能力丧失”的逆成长型2D平台跳跃游戏。控制可爱的童话风面包店少女“娜娜露”，突破恶魔“雅可”的重重考验。某个祈愿冒险永不结束之人所设下的陷阱，以及逐渐被剥夺的控制感，将不断挑战你的极限。

4299270.title: Cluck And Tag
4299270.short_description: 在地图上捕捉游荡的鸡，运送它们并赚取积分！如果你不是“猎人”，就向对手投掷沙滩球，打掉他们的战利品；如果你是“猎人”，就专注于追逐。在这场与朋友或智能AI对抗的混乱追逐战中，得分最高者获胜！

4745320.title: Radar ATC simulator
4745320.short_description: This game is an air traffic controller simulator, specifically in a radar environment. It trains multitasking and air traffic reading skills to anticipate events, avoid risks, and optimize air traffic.

4746880.title: The Last Market Demo
4746880.short_description: The Last Market is an open-world game set in a post-apocalyptic world where you build a safe zone for survivors and defend it against zombies. It combines survival content with a simulation of managing. Fight zombies, collect sellable items, and grow your safe zone and market by selling them.

4514890.title: Moment Hunter
4514890.short_description: Test your timing and precision in Moment Hunter. Watch the scene carefully, find the perfect moment, and take the shot. Easy to learn, hard to master.

4526300.title: BAENANA
4526300.short_description: BAENANA 是一款快速的俯视角弹幕竞技场射击游戏，水果英雄对抗一波波敌对蔬菜。强化能力，使用多达六种武器，在密集火力中闪避，并打造强力的 Roguelike 构筑，迎接混乱的射击动作。

4789880.title: SlackOffDiary
4789880.short_description: 《异世界旅行日记》是一款节奏轻松的放置经营游戏，带轻度 RPG 战斗。在异世界搭建家园，于酒馆招募伙伴、孵化繁育驯兽，派遣他们踏上冒险、旅行或深渊三种旅途，用战利品驱动粉碎机、矿场、熔炉等建筑生产，再在锻造工坊打造装备、强化至更高等级。 游戏内含种植、料理、商店交易与建筑入驻天赋等完整成长循环。独特的「摸鱼模式」可将画面贴在桌面壁纸上，工作学习间隙一键查看进度，无需频繁切换窗口。碎片时间也能推进基地与装备，适合喜欢挂机经营与桌面轻游玩的玩家。

4800860.title: 绝色侦探:爱丽丝
4800860.short_description: 艾青公寓发生了一起命案,1802号公寓女主人离奇死亡,没有任何挣扎,没有打斗痕迹.为何会在深夜死亡,为何男主人不在家中.一切的谜题等待着侦探:爱丽丝破解.真相只有一个,找到最终的真相吧!

4776810.title: Roll To Freedom
4776810.short_description: Guide your way through a challenging maze adventure, explore paths, collect rewards, and test your problem solving skills. Every level brings new challenges and opportunities to discover the best route to freedom.

4767250.title: Working Late
4767250.short_description: “Working Late is a first-person psychological horror game where players harvest organs, complete hospital quotas, and survive terrifying encounters during a night shift that spirals into madness. Balance surgery mechanics, exploration, and survival while trying to make it to 6 AM.”

3939700.title: 海边宝藏小铺
3939700.short_description: 听，海浪退潮了！踩着柔软的细沙，循着探测器清脆的“滴滴”声，挖出深埋沙底的惊喜盲盒！将物件带回工坊，伴随毛刷“唰唰”擦拭的白噪音，体验极致解压的变废为宝。把锃光瓦亮的宝物摆进橱窗，在金币落袋的“叮当”声中用心经营你的海边小店。从贪婪酒店手中买回沙滩——别让浪漫变成私人领地，这片自由的海风归你守护！

2982550.title: Submerged Lights
2982550.short_description: After traveling to a country town to move into the house he inherited, Andrew finds the town flooded. While wondering what to do, he spots a dim light coming from the flooded library, in the middle of the night. Investigating, he finds that it belongs to a small fairy, trapped inside of a lantern...

4865750.title: Last Watchtower Demo
4865750.short_description: Last Watchtower is a short incremental defense game. Gather resources, pick upgrades, and unlock powerful tower abilities. Experiment with diverse builds, withstand relentless monster waves, and grow stronger with every run through permanent meta-progression.

4794200.title: PinballRobotDoctor
4794200.short_description: 「PinballRobotDoctor」 是一款"简单的"弹球游戏。玩家将操控赛博机械弹球"机械修理"装置，指尖把控弹板精反射金属弹球。依靠真实物理回弹逻辑，通过不断碰撞机关破解障碍，最终修理目标完成关卡。

4798930.title: Bit Dot
4798930.short_description: 感受与他人一起游玩的乐趣。 查看简化的图画，并一起猜测它们是什么。 自定义并创建属于你自己的独特角色，你可以操控并进行游戏。

4276210.title: Infinite Space: Mining
4276210.short_description: Build and automate your own industrial space empire. Mine asteroids, manage logistics, expand production lines with drones and conveyors, explore new sectors through wormholes, and grow your mining operation across the galaxy.

4857680.title: Diamond Island Demo
4857680.short_description: Dive into the thrilling world of our First Person Shooter Game, where survival is your only mission. Navigate through intense environments as you hunt for hidden diamonds, each one a step closer to victory

4774930.title: Midnight Noodle Demo
4774930.short_description: Play the DEMO of Midnight Noodle! Experience the gripping beginning of Ogik's journey: coming home from work to his parents fighting violently, taking refuge to chill and chat with a friend in the quiet night, and then upon his return... where did his parents go?!! Play the DEMO and Wishlist NOW!

4704480.title: Akane's After-School Yokai Tales
4704480.short_description: Bullet Hell Survival / Auto-Shooter. Survive the Onslaught. Weave through enemy swarms and survive until the end.

4805240.title: Zombie Wasteland Together
4805240.short_description: 《僵尸废土联机版》是一款支持1-4名玩家合作的僵尸射击游戏，背景设定在末日后的沙漠中。与好友组队，对抗无穷无尽的感染者，并使用强大的武器生存下来。

4865430.title: Asteroid Extractors Demo
4865430.short_description: Mine, upgrade and survive in deep space. Extract valuable resources from procedurally generated asteroids and turn a tiny operation into a massive extraction.

4859150.title: Road Connect Demo
4859150.short_description: Road Connect is a casual puzzle game inspired by the classic 15 Puzzle, where you must rearrange tiles to build a functional road.

4572890.title: Two Types Pollos
4572890.short_description: 合作经营与生存模拟游戏。在经营炸鸡店、接待顾客和装饰店面的同时，在后屋制造“糖”。完成订单以获取维持生命的药物。独自或与好友一起在这场紧张的双重生活中烹饪、管理并生存下去

4850910.title: Final Deal Demo
4850910.short_description: A dark comedy card roguelite set inside Blood & Spades, an underground club where sarcastic skeletons, dangerous card games, and terrible decisions somehow became a community. Build absurd combos, survive toxic rules, and try not to disappoint the audience of the dead.

4583050.title: 非常规放送部 Mika & Luna
4583050.short_description: 人类与魔共存的现代，元气辣妹米卡与毒舌宅女露娜因5亿债务被迫留在人间！这款免费视觉小说以番剧式章节持续更新，带你体验魔之姐妹的爆笑冒险，在奇幻日常中揭开神秘异界的真相！

4849590.title: Stick Infinite Kingdom Demo
4849590.short_description: Master strategic gameplay as you build, train, and upgrade units to protect your base. With an immersive storyline, stunning visuals, and easy controls, it's an epic battle for survival!

4448700.title: Agraria
4448700.short_description: Some days you just want to dig in the dirt and watch something grow. Agraria gets it. Build your dream farm at your own pace - tilling, planting, harvesting, and slowly building an agricultural empire - all under the caring, non-intrusive guidance of Agraria Inc. (Terms and conditions may apply.)

3574020.title: 拉面模拟器
3574020.short_description: 「拉面模拟器」是「烧肉模拟器」的製作团队的最新作！喜爱拉面的朋友们，想不想尝试制作属于自己的独创拉面呢？

4624530.title: 闲鱼修仙录
4624530.short_description: 一款修仙题材的Roguelike卡牌策略游戏。选择李闲鱼、小雪或陆寒渊三位修士之一，在 随机生成的三幕冒险中构建卡组、收集法宝、布置阵法。214张法术卡牌涵盖摸鱼、暴力 、灼烧、反伤等多种流派，金木水火土五行相克影响每一次出牌决策。98个随机奇遇、42 件法宝、12种阵法、9种结局、21级天道试炼难度。每一局都是独一无二的修仙之旅。

4802030.title: Babel Legacy Demo
4802030.short_description: 这是一款采集资源、 发展 城市的放置类游戏。 尽情欣赏城市不断壮大的模样吧。

3365680.title: NONEWORLD
3365680.short_description: NONEWORLD is a cute RPG set in a dying world. You are a Princess from another world, accompanied by an omnipresent Cheshire Cat. Only you and your allies can return the Princess home safely.

4796660.title: 血月 Demo
4796660.short_description: 《血月 Blood Moon》是一款融合 Roguelike 构筑、基地防守与即时战斗的仙侠题材动作策略游戏。白天探索地图、收集装备与资源，夜晚抵御不断来袭的妖魔大军。体验版包含可游玩的核心玩法循环、2个英雄、丰富的技能与装备构筑，以及强大的Boss挑战。

3382440.title: FOOTBALL DRIVE
3382440.short_description: Drive a truck carrying a Huge Football, draw ramps and bridges, and use creative physics-based solutions to guide the ball safely to the goal.

4250150.title: Qumino Demo
4250150.short_description: Qumino is a cozy roguelike domino game. There are different heroes with unique abilities that make every deck playthrough different. Build your deck with different domino tiles and think about what you need for the run.

4681270.title: Pitch & Pixel
4681270.short_description: 征战30年的数字营销机构发展史——优化销售与营销，交付项目，壮大团队，并智取竞争对手。完全模拟的市场以及自由选择的成功之路——是打造高品质的精品工作室，还是庞大的机构集团？一切由你决定。

4300360.title: Spider Subway
4300360.short_description: Spider Subway is a game built around speedrun, challenging players to escape from a subway in the fastest possible time. The trains operate according to a timetable that players can customize themselves. Fine-tune the schedule down to one hundredth of a second and beat your best time.

3644710.title: Reborn: The Evil Being
3644710.short_description: 一款开放世界动作冒险游戏 探索一个充满魔法、谜团与隐藏危险的绚丽幻想世界。在第一人称或第三人称视角中战斗，击败怪物、揭示秘密，并在旅途中不断成长，寻找你来到这个世界背后的真相。

4396340.title: Where Stones Sleep
4396340.short_description: A cozy, single-screen puzzle platformer focused on planning, experimentation, and clear cause-and-effect, with no combat or time pressure.

4527800.title: Punt! Rollin Raccoons
4527800.short_description: The Raccoons are out and up to no good! Punt your very own Raccoon and cause havoc in this Pinball inspired arcade game. Destroy whatever is in your path, complete missions, and customize your rotund friend.

3952220.title: Playful Pursuit
3952220.short_description: Playful Pursuit 是一款色彩缤纷的 3D 冒险平台游戏，你可以跳跃、攀爬、解谜、对抗滑稽的敌人、收集 VHS 录像带，并在一场欢乐的高沙漠任务中与伙伴建立友谊，救回 Eddy 被偷走的泰迪熊。

4335930.title: Veiled Vents
4335930.short_description: Keep an ancient megabuilding alive and thriving with the help of VENTBA !

4698120.title: FAST FOOD FUNKIN'
4698120.short_description: Have some beats with yo' mickey dee double-cheese. A high-caloric FRIDAY NIGHT FUNKIN' parody game made for the annual Flash Forward Jam on Newgrounds

4861690.title: SlimeSlider Demo
4861690.short_description: SlimeSlider is a puzzle game about navigating levels by pushing boxes. In each level, you must push boxes in order to overcome (or take advantage of) your tendency to slide in order to direct the blob to the exit portal.

4796990.title: Blackjack: CHEAT THE HOUSE!
4796990.short_description: Blackjack: CHEAT THE HOUSE! is a blackjack deck-building roguelike where you collect, buy, and upgrade "cheats" to beat the dealer. Work your way to $1,000,000 and unlock the 6 build trophies - cheat, win, repeat!

4852590.title: Good Person Demo
4852590.short_description: Take on the role of the Good Person in this traditional rogue type game in the form of a 1980s aesthetic platformer. Shutdown and avoid a variety of threats to your well being and look to seek validation from various sycophants spread throughout the accursed world.

4779560.title: Idle Startup
4779560.short_description: Build a tech company from a one-person garage into a global empire. Train six skills, automate the grind, prestige for permanent Founder bonuses, climb the leaderboards, and chase 50+ achievements in this clean, endlessly-scaling idle game — progress rolls on even while you're away.

4162530.title: Ball Slickers
4162530.short_description: Ball Slickers is a fast paced football party game mixing third person and top down action. Slide to steal the ball, kick to score, and outplay friends in chaotic, physics driven matches.

4828480.title: Contagion Protocol Demo
4828480.short_description: Survive an endless undead horde in this brutal auto-battling roguelike. Slash, upgrade, and evolve your arsenal as chaos unfolds to the pulse of an industrial metal soundtrack. Contagion Protocol is fast, bloody, and built for replayability.

4379890.title: Blik Ball
4379890.short_description: 3D action in multiplayer or solo. Defeat your opponent in various modes, gain or lose points in direct duels. Blik Ball, a fast-paced 3D action game with lots of fast balls and two paddles.

4334840.title: 中生代黎明
4334840.short_description: 🦕《中生代黎明（Mesozoic Dawn）》是一款多人联机恐龙生存游戏。你将从一只脆弱的幼年恐龙开始，在危机四伏的史前荒野中，通过核心的“成长+产卵=进化”系统实现物种跨越式进化。

4422150.title: Beddua:İlk Düğüm
4422150.short_description: Some moments wish they never happened. After the accident you caused, you hide in a remote Anatolian village where secrets linger in the shadows of mosques. In this psychological horror by two developers, can you face your conscience? No escape. Only confrontation.

4663930.title: SYLVA
4663930.short_description: 荒岛求生之战就此展开。与骷髅战士战斗，建造基地，收集战利品，努力生存下去。开放世界生存角色扮演游戏：SYLVA。

2776630.title: Skillwood
2776630.short_description: Skillwood is a relaxing woodcutter simulator inspired by survival simulators and incremental games. Chop wood, mine stone, trade with NPCs, upgrade forests, unlock new trees or new areas and prestige to do even better next run.

4760040.title: EVIDENCE
4760040.short_description: EVIDENCE 是一款充满氛围感的 neo-noir 侦探惊悚游戏，你将扮演一名在腐败而疲惫的 Nova City Department 中工作的侦探。

4589310.title: The Velvet Green Witch : A Quiet Life Demo
4589310.short_description: A quiet survival RPG about living with a witch in a secluded forest. Gather herbs, hunt for food, and craft potions to sustain your life. Experience the early part of the game in this demo.

4813820.title: AI Slop
4813820.short_description: 在这款反AI的放置模拟游戏中，用令人作呕的AI垃圾信息淹没互联网！创建AI画师与智能体引发群愤。当你的垃圾僵尸网络席卷全球时，玩玩“小丑扑克”肉鸽纸牌，或交易高风险的土狗币。你会实现技术奇点，还是直接被告上法庭？

4453470.title: 射吧！水果人
4453470.short_description: 一觉醒来，你发现你成了一个水果人？面对身旁无穷无尽追杀你的蔬菜，拿起枪，把它们射爆！

4782040.title: 遥かなる円形世界 Demo
4782040.short_description: In New York, private detective Ikeda Sen happens upon the enigmatic Lila shortly before his client Walton hands him a strange device. And in Japan, Izumozaki Neneko stumbles upon a corpse at Horikawa River on her way to school. Two unrelated stories unfold, intersecting in odd and unexpected ways.

4690070.title: Kill Per Second
4690070.short_description: Kill Per Second is a top-down shooter with minimal feature so you can concentrate on one thing. Putting your cursor on the enemies. Survive the stages to test your skill.

4824720.title: Yuntai Demo
4824720.short_description: 《芸台》是一款剧情向恐怖游戏。何以真失联多年的好友突然来信，邀请她前往芸台市参加乞巧大会。然而当何以真赴约后，却隐隐感觉这场重逢暗藏玄机，一场围绕邪教的超自然异象在此展开。

4803640.title: Jamhouse Demo
4803640.short_description: Jamhouse is a fast paced falling block/platformer hybrid. Run, jump, and haul tasty tiles to clear waves of jams falling all around you!

4788930.title: Oleander-X
4788930.short_description: Oleander-X is a pixel-art stealth action game about classified missions, buried evidence, and a cure that should never have existed. Infiltrate guarded facilities, gather proof, plant explosives, and escape before the truth turns against you.

4831890.title: Theseus' Cycle Demo
4831890.short_description: 这是一款结合生化科幻风格的2D动作与工厂建造游戏。玩家将透过极具张力的高速对刀与极限跳跃击溃异星怪物，并残酷地夺取牠们的血肉与机械碎片。利用这些战利品，你必须从零开始建造并连结一座高度自动化的暗黑能源工厂。透过无情地榨取生物能源并扩张电力系统，你将解锁并深入未知的凶险地域，体验极限战斗掠夺与战略性自动化生产的双重快感。

4280570.title: SharedScreen Wagons 2
4280570.short_description: 单屏本地多人混乱。最多8名玩家、8个手柄、3个键盘。快节奏回合、锦标赛和友情压力测试。装载、卸载、抢道、拆毁——物流撑不住。

4656550.title: NEKO MAKER: Catgirl Raising Story
