4825860.short_description: 经营你自己的二手电子商店，你可以完全自由的摆放货架和货物。赚钱，扩展店铺，升级商店，购买更加稀有的旧货箱，开出更稀有的商品，感受真实的开店体验。你也可以在二手市场淘到宝贝，但也可能血本无归。

4696150.title: Membrane of Y
4696150.short_description: 《Membrane of Y》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，玩家通过在战斗中平衡攻守、调整状态并推进角色成长，在稳定而连续的单人流程中体验以策略控制为核心的回合制玩法。

4828780.title: Ningming County In Chongzuo
4828780.short_description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

4756690.title: KNOCKOUT ARCADE Demo
4756690.short_description: Fight to save the KNOCKOUT ARCADE in this stylish 2D pixel art fighting game! Battle with a cast of 6 hand-drawn characters in both local VS and a side scrolling campaign mode, featuring simple controls with a unique twist on motion inputs.

4459850.title: NAMCO LEGENDARY Mountains
4459850.short_description: Namco经典街机名作，以3D益智游戏形式登场！ 80年代的经典角色们，以全新形态重新回归！

4144680.title: DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round
4144680.short_description: 策略性十足的游戏系统、华丽必杀技与动态演出，以及个性鲜明的角色阵容——魅力满载的激斗盛宴，3D对战格斗动作游戏《DEAD OR ALIVE 6》震撼重启！

4803600.title: Girigirin
4803600.short_description: Girigirin is an action game where you control a robot and fly toward the goal. In worlds such as dungeons, jungles, and fortresses, you must dodge everything in your path and focus solely on reaching the goal.

4654060.title: Mellow's Garden
4654060.short_description: Build your dream garden as a cute cat in Mellow’s Garden, a cozy and stress-free farming game. Plant crops, harvest them, earn money, and customize your space however you like.

3217050.title: Rental Store Simulator
3217050.short_description: Run a store in the nostalgic world of video rentals. Manage inventory, serve customers, and customize your store to create the ultimate rental store experience. Purchase a range of movies and consoles. Hire and train employees. Upgrade and design your store.

4794370.title: Let's Aim! Crane Game
4794370.short_description: The hugely popular crane game series is back and better than ever! Aim, grab, and hook your prizes! Master a variety of crane arms and win tons of prizes!

1218230.title: Rhythmic Retro Racer
1218230.short_description: Rhythmic Retro Racer 是一款以 90 年代神秘复古房间为背景的音乐节奏游戏。在强劲的合成器波（Synthwave）配乐中，挑战专业打磨的精准节拍。随着紧张感弥漫，你将逐渐意识到：这不仅仅是一场游戏，你正处于一项实验之中。体验音乐、精准度与不安感交织的独特氛围。

4867430.title: Cow Heard Demo
4867430.short_description: Welcome to Cow Heard! This game is about a father and a daughter traversing some old back roads trying to find their way back to the city. As they are looking at the beautiful farm land, suddenly they crash! The daughter wakes up to find her father unconscious and climbs out to look for help.

2940150.title: Kill Cast
2940150.short_description: Born from classic arcade top down shooters like Smash TV and 80’s action thriller The Running Man! Welcome to Kill Cast Show! An FPS bullet raining shooter where you must survive endless wave of mutants. It's the gameshow of the future where contestants fight for survival.

4584830.title: Shop of Deals
4584830.short_description: Manage your own shop, buy and sell products, negotiate with customers, and grow your business by balancing risk, trust, and profit. At the same time, uncover the truth behind your father's disappearance.

4747900.title: Tower & Invasion
4747900.short_description: A fast-paced PvP tower defense where you must defend your castle, send enemy waves, and use powerful abilities to overwhelm your opponent.

4669470.title: Idle Keep
4669470.short_description: Wyverns have stolen the Kingdom's Light! Rebuild the Keep, grow stronger and gear up to defeat the Wyvern Queen and restore magic to the Kingdom.

4757460.title: ThouSandSand
4757460.short_description: Expand the cavity, trigger the collapse. A sand-physics puzzle game.

4661730.title: Monkey Do Demo
4661730.short_description: Escape a crumbling zoo as Mak, a stealth-savvy monkey who dismantles robot Keepers, springs traps on them, and recruits fellow animals to stage his ultimate breakout. Will the malicious owner be able to stop him or will Mak be the monkey wrench in his operation?

4735480.title: BAND MATES Demo
4735480.short_description: Band Mates is Rock Band meets Garage Band. Create your band. Create your music. Grab your friends. Be awesome together.

4826740.title: Pedals in Panic
4826740.short_description: Pedals in Panic is a small physics-based bike game where you control each pedal separately, steer with the mouse, jump over obstacles, and survive chaotic procedurally generated platforms.

4826370.title: BLORBIT
4826370.short_description: 翻转重力，向上攀爬。BLORBIT：可爱生物竖向平台游戏，穿越6个生态群落，从草地到深空。翻转平台仅在重力匹配时稳固。无尽、每日任务、禅境或10人在线竞速。你能爬多高？

4820990.title: Hangin' Off!
4820990.short_description: Lean deep into corners, race against the clock, and battle rival riders in a retro-inspired arcade motorcycle racing experience where every corner asks you the same question: do you brake, or do you believe?

4851500.title: Lost Ages Hunting Demo
4851500.short_description: Hunt across time itself. Track dinosaurs, Ice Age beasts, modern wildlife, and creatures from future eras in a unique hunting simulation spanning multiple worlds.

3814090.title: Rakete
3814090.short_description: Every button is a thruster. The rest is physics. Land your rocket without crashing. Play solo, or put a friend on each thruster and watch teamwork turn to chaos.

4878250.title: Solace Demo
4878250.short_description: Solace is a fantasy turn-based rpg. Learn a variety of skills and passives to aid you in combat as you explore the world of Alisare. Experience a narrative focusing on the bonds between people and the things we leave behind.

3698440.title: Half Dead: A Zombie Story Game
3698440.short_description: 在一个人类正在消亡的世界里，丧尸Alex在看到Sienna后开始发生改变。这是一个交织着爱情、喜剧与悲剧的故事。观看互动FMV视频，探索漫画，做出选择，达成正确的结局。

4778940.title: Styxton Demo
4778940.short_description: "Styxton" is a nonlinear horror visual novel. Sometimes, salvation is the worst curse. You are alive. Now find out who needed it.

4586760.title: Sphere TD
4586760.short_description: Sphere TD is a deep tower defense strategy game where you build every tower from scratch! NO presets! Route mods through grid layouts to fire projectiles: split, bounce, chain, pierce, multiply. A true one tower with 1,000,000 build combinations.

4007040.title: 爆盛食堂
4007040.short_description: 堆叠！盛满！还能继续！挑战极限边缘！ 不管是松饼、拉面还是寿司，只要不掉出盘子，怎么放都行！？ 以堆积如山的美食为目标，一路堆叠到极限的爆量益智游戏！

4484690.title: Mini Raid Leader
4484690.short_description: Mini Raid Leader is a single-player Action RTS, in which you command an ever-growing party of heroes to take down powerful bosses.

4078380.title: Cryptoria
4078380.short_description: Cryptoria is a 2D pixel dungeon crawler where every step and every coin is a decision. Greed is punished. Hesitation can be fatal.

3954990.title: S.A.N.D.Y. - Beach Cleaner
3954990.short_description: 在这款简短、轻松又阴郁的游戏中，清理海滩上的垃圾！回收废弃物，升级你的机器人。探索新的领土。清理石油泄漏并拯救动物！

4276110.title: Rogue 21
4276110.short_description: 庄家永远会赢……除非你重写代码。 在这款以二十一点为核心的 Roguelike 卡牌游戏中，你不只是出牌 —— 你在破坏系统。 叠加非法 Exploit，扭曲概率，让 Gamble-State 破产。 要牌。停牌。利用漏洞。活下去。

4833550.title: Vision Quest: A New Ascent Demo
4833550.short_description: Vision Quest: A New Ascent is a challenging twin-stick action-adventure shaped by nature. Survive 2-hit death combat with well-timed critical hits to restore your Health and rise above failure with a generous respawn system. The summit is waiting.

4750230.title: Medieval Fantasy
4750230.short_description: 在这款融合征服、外交、派系斗争与战术战斗的回合制策略游戏中，统治分裂的奇幻世界。管理军队、城市、将领与魔法，对抗敌对帝国，让你的旗帜屹立不倒。

4245190.title: Bartender Life Simulator
4245190.short_description: 对您来说，酒吧老板是什么人？是经理？调酒师？室内设计师？心理咨询师？或者，也许这些角色集于一身？与客人互动、进行采购、调制鸡尾酒、改变装潢风格，以赢得最佳酒吧的称号。

4815720.title: Portalborn
4815720.short_description: 探索或打造属于你自己的传送门诞生世界，融合强大的职业，斩杀奇异怪物，并在这款为无尽冒险而生的复古文字 RPG 中一路搜刮前行。

4469100.title: Cosmo Crush
4469100.short_description: A fast-paced 2.5D & 3D arcade space shooter where you dodge, blast enemies, and conquer intense planetary battlefields.

3529670.title: FULL METAL COFFIN
3529670.short_description: FULL METAL COFFIN is a 3D co-op submarine simulator. Crew your vessel with up to 4 players. Load the torpedoes, dodge incoming fire, and eliminate the enemy.

3989690.title: Glorpotron
3989690.short_description: 一款结合塔防与 Roguelike 元素的游戏，主题围绕机器人与黏液。支持单人或本地多人游玩，守护果冻冻，击败咕噜怪。

4619190.title: The Last (Hotdog) Stand
4619190.short_description: Run your own hotdog stand in this food cart simulator game! Take orders, make dogs, and keep customers happy as you work to grow your hotdog empire, and restore hotdogs to their former glory. Upgrade your stand, unlock new ingredients, and expand to bigger, busier locations!

3594680.title: Battle Food Mania
3594680.short_description: "在这款混乱的动作游戏中，扮演古怪有趣的食物角色！作为守卫递送订单，或作为小偷进行破坏。角色切换，武器变化，混乱升级！在充满障碍、汽车和食物大战的疯狂城市中，单人游戏或与朋友组队玩耍！

3558120.title: 伊利斯之梦Ellixir's Dream
3558120.short_description: 《伊利斯之梦》是一款融合东西方玄学与心理学主题的单机乙女向剧情冒险游戏。玩家将扮演伟大的炼金术士的女儿，在航行旅途中，与不同信仰与追求的角色相遇，通过选择对话，一步步揭开自己的身世，踏上属于自己的命运之路，自主选择多种结局。

4797870.title: Babitonga: Puzzle Attack
4797870.short_description: 如果您喜欢： • 俄罗斯方块攻击/Panel de Pon • 益智联盟 • 噗哟噗哟 • 俄罗斯方块对战模式 您会感觉宾至如归。

4539680.title: Mini AirHockey
4539680.short_description: Turn your undocked Steam Deck into a Mini AirHockey table for two. -- Mini AirHockey can only be played on an undocked Steam Deck.

4323990.title: EMPULSE
4323990.short_description: EMPULSE 是一款即将上线的高速6v6移动射击游戏。跑墙、钩爪、Holojump、驾驶机甲、用 P.A.I.N.T. 征服 Freehold 的垂直街道。比对手跑得更快，否则只能被打倒。

4755780.title: Are you human?
4755780.short_description: 一款荒诞短篇解谜游戏。你将在复古韩国网页中通过随机 CAPTCHA 小游戏、注册流程和身份验证，证明自己是人类。

4665490.title: 你的蛋蛋
4665490.short_description: 让你在你兄弟面前玩你兄弟的蛋蛋。 蛋蛋黑暗森林法则开始了。 你不玩他的，他就要玩你的了。

3656230.title: Aces of Avalon
3656230.short_description: 翱翔于2334年！驾驶尖端战机，与外星入侵者展开激烈空战。单人或本地合作，用信用点升级战机，称霸天空。

3296530.title: The Rise of the New Han Prince 2
3296530.short_description: At 22, you are the absolute ruler of a nation with billions in reserves—what does it feel like to hold total power? With the country’s top innocent-faced actresses and their sultry friends flocking to your private island, the question is: who will you invite into your palace tonight?

3653230.title: Virtual Perspective
3653230.short_description: 虚拟视界是一款第一人称视角的动作解谜平台游戏，你需要利用视角操控能量核心，解决空间难题

3920990.title: Blood Welkin
3920990.short_description: Shoot, smash, and eviscerate abominations in BLOOD WELKIN - an FPS roguelite with dozens of unique kit-building items and a gripping story for you to discover. YOU. ARE. NOT. CRAZY.

4294100.title: 简单的小游戏
4294100.short_description: 在这款简单而纯粹的跑酷小游戏中，你只需专注于“一路向前”。使用键盘上的 W、A、S、D 控制角色移动——前进、后退、左右闪避，按下空格键即可轻盈跳跃，跨越地形或躲开障碍。旅途中，各式各样的障碍物会不断出现在你的前进路线上，考验你的反应与操作。不过完全不必担心失败重来带来的挫败感——游戏贴心地在每通过一段路程后设置了保存水晶，一旦触碰，你的进度就会被安全锁定。即便中途失误，也能从最近的水晶处无缝重启，毫无压力地继续冒险。清爽的操作、循序渐进的挑战、温柔的容错机制，让每一次向前都充满探索的乐趣，而非重复的苦劳。准备好了吗？用流畅的移动和精准的跳跃，冲破重重阻碍，奔赴终点吧！

4593150.title: Closer than Allowed: After the Bell
4593150.short_description: 以 Greenfield High School 面向18岁以上转学生的特别项目为舞台，邂逅四位女主角的成熟恋爱视觉小说。你的主角背景、选择与隐藏关系标记，将影响第1章以及之后的路线走向。

4019820.title: Beatlow
4019820.short_description: A fast-paced rhythm game where every mistake costs a life. Hit the right keys in time with the music, survive escalating mutators, buy power-ups, and push your run as far as possible.

4818790.title: CORE.SYS
4818790.short_description: 《CORE.SYS》是一款激荡脑力的动作解谜游戏，玩家需要运用快速思考的策略，突破层层数字安全防线。

4871660.title: The Cursed Day - Demo
4871660.short_description: The Cursed Day is a 2.5D action RPG with Soulslike elements. Explore the ruins of our world, improve your abilities and uncover the truth in this journey filled with magic and adventure

4631110.title: Trashy Cashy
4631110.short_description: 一款流程约为 3-6 小时的短篇增量游戏，靠出售垃圾打造属于你的商业帝国。成为神秘的“Trashy Cashy”连锁品牌合伙人。拆开垃圾，将其发货，然后赚取高得离谱的利润。别问太多。听起来很简单，对吧？

4487840.title: Hard Truck 2: King of the Road
4487840.short_description: Hard Truck 2: King of the Road 是一款2000年的开放世界卡车游戏，属于早期塑造该类型的重要系列之一。运送货物，与其他司机竞争，并建立属于你自己的运输帝国。

4798010.title: b-Run
4798010.short_description: b-Run is the first game released with native, full support for DualSense controller audio features via Bluetooth; Immerse yourself in a claustrophobic first-person horror experience. Navigate through dark ruins and narrow corridors where tension is constant.

4816650.title: Roulette Salon - The Ultimate Casino Roulette Simulator
4816650.short_description: The most complete roulette simulator ever built. 24 tutorials, 8 variants, 30+ bets, the racetrack, croupier calls, and the Luck Lab — force any pocket, bias the odds, simulate hot and cold tables. Deep stats, interactive report, CSV export. A roulette table with an X-ray machine attached.

4754800.title: Aura Farming
4754800.short_description: Aura Farming 是一款增量式爬塔游戏，玩家扮演不朽战士，拯救伙伴并提升灵气（Aura），以到达塔顶并拯救公主。

4550820.title: 极线赛车
4550820.short_description: 《极线赛车》是一款俯视角极简风格的街机竞速游戏。在单屏可见的赛道上驾驶不同风格的赛车高速跑圈，压线、贴边、甩尾过弯，挑战更快单圈、更高星级评价与全球排行榜名次。

4446010.title: The First Million
4446010.short_description: 在这款放置类卡牌构筑游戏中，不断解锁新卡牌和升级，接二连三地发现颠覆游戏的制胜策略，赚到第一个 100 万，然后是更多个百万！

4768660.title: Slice To Meet You
4768660.short_description: A cozy idle incremental game about the satisfying rhythm of chopping ingredients. Unlock new produce, upgrade your knives, and grow your earnings — all at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

3601160.title: Fortune Fragments
3601160.short_description: 在《Fortune Fragments》中，你将经营一家属于自己的店铺，化身“占卜师”，通过解读灵魂来指引顾客的命运！置身于繁华的现代奇幻都市“澈空城”，沉浸在视觉小说RPG与六角格符文构建玩法完美融合的独特体验中。

4328290.title: 鹰道：末日崛起
4328290.short_description: 这是一款基于“弱肉强食”丛林法则的开放世界3D枪战游戏，同时也是一款以任务为中心、基于经验升级的战斗游戏。它融合了角色扮演、战术策略和经验升级等元素。

4694980.title: Axiom Of Echoes: Proof Refactor
4694980.short_description: Axiom Of Echoes: Proof Refactor is a story-rich logic puzzle game where you build mathematical rules to reconstruct 2D and 3D memory fragments, solving precise spatial puzzles as a cold sci-fi mystery unfolds.

4870730.title: Turnbuckle Hearts Demo
4870730.short_description: Turnbuckle Hearts is a visual novel set in the world of professional wrestling. Forge friendships, find romance, and fight for your future as your choices shape the story.

4023970.title: Scriver: A Word Game
4023970.short_description: Score points by playing words that complement your finely-curated art gallery. Come up with the right words to win over even the most challenging critics. Can you make it to the final exhibition?

4828380.title: Fantasy Air-Sea Battles Showdown Demo
4828380.short_description: 《Fantasy Air-Sea Battles Showdown / 幻想海空大决战》是一款高节奏俯视角海空战斗射击游戏。玩家将驾驶多种幻想战机，在海域、岛屿与密集火力交织的战场中高速机动、锁定敌机、规避导弹、释放火力，并呼叫友军协同作战。你可以解锁不同性能与战术定位的机体，根据敌方编队和关卡节奏选择突破、压制或持久作战路线。游戏主打爽快射击、战场压迫感、机体成长与海空协同作战的乐趣。

4758140.title: Spirimonz
4758140.short_description: Spirimonz is a game in which you hunt down evil spirits and capture various ghostly companions who will help you and follow you on every new mission.

4245630.title: Bastion of the Eldritch
4245630.short_description: WARNING: This game is fair, but difficult. Keyboard is supported, but gamepad/controller use is strongly advised. If you're looking for a retro, pixel art style survival horror challenge, this is for you. This game doesn't hold your hand and game mechanics are deeper than they seem on the surface.

4733710.title: Totally Normal Ramen Demo
4733710.short_description: Cook ramen across the galaxy as a rogue robot chef! Explore planets, trigger wild events, battle dangerous customers, and build your ultimate space food truck.

4874890.title: Teckel Adventure Demo
4874890.short_description: Teckel Adventure is a charming 2D platformer: play as Luna, a little dachshund on a quest to recover her stolen ball across forests and villages. Jump, dodge enemies and collect tokens in a fair, accessible adventure. This demo covers the first 3 levels.

4420570.title: 地狱森林
4420570.short_description: 《地狱森林》是一款电子桌面游戏，你将在这里扮演时局的执棋手，主导一场波澜壮阔的无烟战争，在有限的资源中运用你的智慧，去赢得一个又一个地区的胜利。游戏采用极简桌面风格，尽可能的将关键元素抽象成棋盘。

4829340.title: Nights at the Convenience Store
4829340.short_description: Nights at the Convenience Store is a first-person horror simulation game where you work the night shift at a 24/7 store. Scan groceries, restock shelves, take out the trash — and try not to think too hard about what's lurking in the back.

4513640.title: YGGDRA: SURVIVOR
4513640.short_description: 与32位战斗少女并肩作战，挑战吞噬世界的黑塔！这是一款 Roguelite 区域防守弹幕生存游戏，依靠走位求生，通过召唤与卡牌构筑打造每一局截然不同的战斗体验 ⚔️

4816850.title: Neon Sector
4816850.short_description: Neon Sector is an isometric extraction shooter where you fight enemies, collect valuable loot, and escape to upgrade your hideout for the next raid.

3112420.title: Deep in The Mine
3112420.short_description: In a fantastic universe, form a group of up to 5 dwarves. Choose a class then set off on an adventure in mines. Be careful, one of you will have become a monster, born to hunt you. Your goal is to extract materials there. Survive by working as a team but also using many gameplay features

4710460.title: 四方行
4710460.short_description: 一位行商走遍山河，以货易货，以诚服人。议价、制造、鉴宝，从大同边塞走到番禺南洋，书写属于你的商路传奇。

4876880.title: Cube Fold Demo
4876880.short_description: Cube Fold is a relaxing minimalist puzzle game where every move unfolds the cube into new shapes. Solve handcrafted levels filled with teleporters, jump tiles, moving platforms, bridges, and clever mechanics. Easy to learn, challenging to master.

4526410.title: 功德无量
4526410.short_description: 一款佛系放置休闲游戏。玩家通过点击敲击木鱼获得功德值，积累功德可解锁12款生肖主题木鱼和6款神兽木鱼，以及与之搭配的木鱼锤。游戏采用全局键盘鼠标钩子技术实现挂机功能，玩家即使将游戏窗口最小化或切换到其他程序，也能通过预设快捷键继续进行敲击操作。游戏内置36项成就系统，从初学者到资深修行者，陪伴玩家一步步走上功德无量之道。每当达成成就还可获得点数奖励，用于解锁更多精美收藏品。游戏支持简体中文和English双语切换，满足不同语言玩家的需求。

4527180.title: Rift Diver
4527180.short_description: Rift Diver is a punishing 2D hack and slash with souls-like elements. As the "Unforgiven", descend into the chaotic Below to slay the Reaper! Master the dash, upgrade your unique class, and crush relentless swarms across a 4-level campaign or the Endless Dungeon.

4536380.title: Corelith
4536380.short_description: Corelith is a wave-based roguelike top-down action game. Explore the Corelith Dungeon, craft Skill Cores, and create your own unique build.

4600140.title: Hexara
4600140.short_description: 旋转六边形方块，创造强力连击，在这款节奏紧凑的益智游戏中冲击高分。易于上手，难于精通，拥有无限重玩价值和全球排行榜。

4667580.title: 飞刀大师
4667580.short_description: 飞刀大师是一个欢乐的飞刀游戏.玩家使用飞刀击中目标.在你通关之后你一定会哈哈哈地笑出来

4298720.title: 宠我一生：桌面宠物
4298720.short_description: 《宠我一生》是一款温馨治愈的桌面宠物养成游戏。把可爱的虚拟宠物养在电脑桌面，陪伴你工作、学习与休闲。喂食、互动、装扮、布置小屋，看着小宠物每天的陪伴，收获满满的陪伴与治愈感。

4201600.title: 以富之名(In The Name Of Fortune)
4201600.short_description: 一款类大富翁的休闲游戏，每个房屋都有独特技能，每个角色都有独特的技能。再加上暗标竞争提升物价，股市等额外玩法。

4254900.title: The Cursed Ward
4254900.short_description: A system-driven psychological horror game where every threat has a pattern and every death has a reason. Each run is unique and will be timed.

4272230.title: Verto
4272230.short_description: 下落方块、匹配颜色、旋转一切。这款益智游戏在经典玩法基础上加入了令人费解的棋盘旋转机制。选择限时挑战或无限制模式，争夺高分。易上手，难精通

4667920.title: Richer than the King
4667920.short_description: 在这款中世纪经济策略游戏中，积累巨额财富，建立叛军，推翻王权。进行日常贸易，明智投资，贿赂皇家斥候以隐藏行踪，并团结其他贵族，在与国王军队的冲突中求生。

4278600.title: IronWood
4278600.short_description: IronWood is a First Person Shooter that takes inspiration from many of the older games that first popularized the genre, like Blood, Quake, and Unreal. Travel across a variety of levels, find powerful weapons and artifacts, and use them to your advantage against the enemies prevalent in each area.

4785880.title: 我是妖王：阻止孙悟空 Demo
4785880.short_description: A reverse Journey to the West roguelite — play as the Demon King, stop Sun Wukong. Draft monsters, place 24 magic traps, and defend your Demon Throne across 10 escalating stages.

4817090.title: BitBuddy
4817090.short_description: A lofi pixel desktop pet on your screen. Your cat types as you work, shows local weather and time of day, pomodoro focus, chill lofi music, gentle reminders, and skins—always on top, out of the way.

4813130.title: NECHTO: Infection Protocol
4813130.short_description: 一款 4–12 人的卡牌聚会游戏，带有隐藏身份和感染机制。一台笔记本电脑作为共享大屏，手机当手柄。无需安装——只要浏览器和 Wi-Fi。

4672470.title: Missing: A Kid(s)Nap
4672470.short_description: Every Child's Dream has come true for you. Your parents are gone for the weekend and left you home alone. But instead of Fun and Friends, some unexpected guests pay you a visit. And slowly they're turning your dream into a Nightmare.

3779440.title: Deluge
3779440.short_description: Deluge is a horror-centric JRPG where you play as the resurrected warrior Hudson, a corpse tasked with infiltrating a battered community. Bound to a tyrant’s will, yet haunted by your own past, you must make choices and battle your path forward to either redemption or ruin.

4818780.title: 苏菲亚的谎言与代价 Demo
4818780.short_description: 透过监控摄像头看到的是五个人格的罪恶与记忆──这是一款悬疑推理游戏。涉嫌谋杀总统候选人的少女苏菲亚，玩家通过揭开她内心黑暗过往的秘密，逼近事件的真相。

4831190.title: 染上你的颜色
4831190.short_description: 《染上你的颜色》是由屿临个人制作发行的一部百合向视觉小说。游戏通过沈眠眠的视角展开，与另一位少女林舒桐因画画而相遇。这是一个关于模仿、嫉妒与错位之爱的故事。当仰慕变成执念，当爱意沦为占有，两个少女在互相吞噬中渐渐染上了彼此的颜色。

4793760.title: You Are The Loading Screen
4793760.short_description: The loading screen never ends. Solve bizarre challenges, survive fake system failures, defeat corrupted software, and uncover the truth behind a self-aware progress bar in this meta-comedy puzzle adventure.

4781480.title: No Exit : Anomaly Demo
4781480.short_description: 单人心理生存恐怖游戏。在平凡的一天结束时，熟悉的地铁将你带入一个怪诞且无尽的里世界。利用周围的环境，在压倒性的恐惧与超现实的存在中努力活下去。

4858870.title: Team Rush Demo
4858870.short_description: Team Rush is a fast-paced multiplayer beat-'em-up built around fluid movement, creative combos, and high-energy battles. In this beat-'em-up choose from a diverse cast of fighters, each with their own unique abilities, special attacks, and playstyles.

4195180.title: Super Free Play Demo
4195180.short_description: Chow down and POWER UP! Super Free Play is a classic 2D co-op metroidvania platformer where super-powered Turbo Twins Jay and Dasha bounce on baddies, portal surf and fight bosses across the Multi-World. Fun for 1 or 2 players!

3872760.title: 吞食三国
3872760.short_description: 动作+多人+RPG，以蜀汉的视角，玩家将经历许多三国名场面：关云长千里走单骑、赵子龙长坂坡之战、诸葛亮草船借箭、周瑜打黄盖、赤壁水战、庞统落凤坡之败、关羽大意失荆州等。获取装备，使用计策或阵法，最终是接受历史的宿命？或是开创新的篇章？等你来玩！

4827660.title: Purrfect Bliss Demo
4827660.short_description: 亚历克斯走投无路了。为了拯救生病的母亲，他接受了玛丽莲时髦的猫咪咖啡馆的工作。但五年前，他的父亲和其他人在这里丧生。端上咖啡，遵守规则，在夜班中活下来，揭开咖啡馆完美形象背后的黑暗真相。

4867380.title: Into Black Demo
4867380.short_description: Explore, mine, craft, & fight for survival in the dark depths of this solo or co-op VR action adventure.

4834610.title: 仙途放置：无尽天梯和完美装备 Demo
4834610.short_description: 一款修仙题材的放置RPG。你将扮演一名初入仙途的修士，通过挑战无尽天梯、收集神兵利器、修炼功法秘籍，逐步突破境界，最终九转成仙！ 【核心玩法】 无尽天梯 ，一亿层关卡，挂机自动战斗。九转成仙 - 9次转生系统，越转越强 🏭 生产技能 - 冥想修炼、采药炼丹、离线自动生产 【特色系统】 · 怪物梗技能 - 55种怪物各有专属热梗技能，20种Boss各有独特大招 · 异宝系统 - 不灭金身、天赐暴击、玄武真身等传说级装备 · 道树天赋 - 修罗道/玄武道/太虚道三大路线，自由搭配 · 装备评分 - 智能评分一键换装，轻松管理装备 · 多存档 - 最多8个存档槽位

4582850.title: DOO DOO VILLAGE
4582850.short_description: Battle through relentless dungeons, earn gold, and build your own trading empire as a mage who turns magic into wealth.

4347810.title: Hunt And Peck
4347810.short_description: Turn your index fingers into the brave Eagle Brothers! 'Hunt & Peck' is a typing defense game where you don't type words—you strike keys. Smash the specific keys where enemies appear with speed and precision to defend the cyber world.

4817490.title: Bounce Arena Simulator Demo
4817490.short_description: 《Bounce War Simulator》是一款专为直播和观众打造的自动战斗模拟器！12种武器在竞技场中疯狂弹跳碰撞。你可以在大厅自由定制个人/团队战、地图和倍率。集成Discord让观众用聊天参与胜负预测并冲击排行榜，还能通过Stream Deck触发陨石、黑洞等突发事件，将直播间气氛推向高潮！

4593710.title: 魔族公主打搜撤
4593710.short_description: 「打」倒敌人、「搜」集资源、「撤」离地图，运用你的巧思，用最少的魔力，走出最难缠的逃跑路线，创造属于玩家自己的逃跑奇迹！

4735070.title: 伏煞3 夜诊
4735070.short_description: 用文字冒险的方式，在深夜医院中度过生死未卜的可怕夜晚，《伏煞3 夜诊》有着大量支线选项及二十多个结局，任何选择都可能会触发令人难以直面的恐怖，最终你是否能够做出正确的选择，躲避致命的危险，逃出这场死亡的诅咒？

4484010.title: Im Gonna Be Evil Demo
4484010.short_description: Hey, Breaking news! I heard they found a new Cupid already! Do mortals believe in love? You don't know? I hope they don't because even if their expectations are in rock bottom, they'll still be disappointed. I heard she's evil.

4290390.title: 恋狱～月狂病～
4290390.short_description: 以东京上野为舞台，侦探高城秋五卷入连环猎奇杀人案之中。这是个近乎偏执疯狂的，爱恨交织的故事……

4732680.title: Drumfire
4732680.short_description: An RTS roguelite about missile warfare. Build factories, scout with drones, stack cards and flatten the enemy Hub. Play against AI or your friends in up to 4 player multiplayer. Mutliple gamemodes including wave based Survival and mutli stage Escalation.

4761340.title: Peristeria Demo
4761340.short_description: An atmospheric 3D metroidvania with heavy emphasis on platforming and exploration. Use projectiles, grappling, and dash to discover hidden ruins and secrets beneath the surface.

4698860.title: Lord Of The Trough
4698860.short_description: LOTT is about getting to the desired girth and claiming the superior oats. Enjoy the pastures of Svinwald with up to 5 other players. Live to impress the tall skinny ones. Compete in a range of mini-games to determine the superior pig. Serve up a range of undesirable slop to your ungirthed brothers.

4731670.title: REMinal
4731670.short_description: REMinal is a non-euclidean, procedurally-generated horror game. Run from your shadows, seek out cursed curios, and build safe spaces in an endlessly sprawling house. Can you escape with your soul intact?

4868490.title: 记忆收藏家 · The Memory Mender Demo
4868490.short_description: 你经营着「拾光馆」——存在现实与遗忘之间的旧宅。帮来访者潜入记忆深处，修复那些破碎的瞬间：把光点拼回空画框，从暴雨杂音里调出那句被盖过的话。没有失败，只有温柔的告别。

4875900.title: 天狗花牌 Demo
4875900.short_description: 《天狗花牌》是一款以日本花札为核心的 Roguelike 策略卡牌游戏，通过不断叠高小判与倍率来推动得分。你在试炼中出牌凑役、突破目标分数，再用金币进入神社商店购置天狗牌与星宿升级，为整月贴御札、抽御神签试手气，并向钱箱奉纳换取永久成长。还可净盆删牌、绘马加牌，搭配上百张妖怪天狗牌与不同角色，每一局都能走出截然不同的构筑路线。

4756670.title: STEEL SERAPHIM: PROVING GROUNDS
4756670.short_description: STEEL SERAPHIM: PROVING GROUNDS: Play as Aster, a lonely young pilot as he controls a colossal mech to fight off volcanic monsters. In between missions, romance your fellow pilots aboard the massive Faraday Station. Find love, survive in this hybrid third-person shooter/visual novel.

4659450.title: PUPILLARY
4659450.short_description: Pupillary is a short surveillance horror game where you monitor live camera feeds, report anomalies, and try to survive until 6 AM. 10 anomaly types and over 100 different anomalies from subtle object changes to intruders and jumpscares. Use your memory and drawing tools to track what has changed.

4869820.title: Re.がんばりみのりこ ～お姉ちゃんの試練～ Demo
4869820.short_description: 土佐研究所的首部作品以完全重制之姿强势回归！ 携全新系统、全新动作与全新关卡，穰子的修行再次展开！ 用农具横扫敌人！用蔬菜将敌人击飞！体验焕然一新的秋穰子强力2D动作游戏吧！！

4875740.title: galaksia online Demo
4875740.short_description: Experience 2 hours of unrestricted gameplay in Galaksia Online, a massive multiplayer sci-fi MMORPG! Command your ship, engage in epic PvP & PvE battles, craft gear, and build clans. Purchase the full game to seamlessly carry over your progress and continue your endless space adventure!

4833820.title: 我的悟空 Demo
4833820.short_description: 这是一款透明背景的桌面宠物，根据玩家的键盘和鼠标行为，表现出Q版的动画动作。玩家可选择不同的宠物形象以及相关配饰，也可使用绘制工具进行自定义的调整

4876640.title: Jammed Demo
4876640.short_description: You are a traffic engineer. Draw roads and bridges, connect growing districts, and watch your city come alive. Design efficient interchanges and avoid traffic jams.

4774850.title: Who Murdered My Empress? Demo
4774850.short_description: “Who Murdered My Empress?” is a time-travel romance visual novel set in a fantastical realm inspired by 19th century Vietnam. Assume the role of an Empress with a lavish harem of captivating men as you navigate intrigue, love, and mystery.

4880710.title: The Crystal Atelier Demo
4880710.short_description: Try a cozy crafting RPG about restoring rough gems by hand, fulfilling guild requests, and growing a humble workshop into a rising atelier. This demo includes the opening stretch of The Crystal Atelier through the end of Act 1.

4796150.title: Console Cafe Simulator Demo
4796150.short_description: 设置游戏机，管理游戏，设定价格，为顾客提供服务，雇佣员工，发展你的咖啡馆，成为城市中最受欢迎的游戏中心

4617260.title: Nano CODE:X
4617260.short_description: A small 2D game where you sneak through a lab simulation, collect parts, and rebuild your drone companion with multiple possible looks.

4631200.title: Bring The Rift
4631200.short_description: Bring the Rift is a competitive puzzle-matcher blending frantic strategy with a Visual Novel narrative. Master unique skills to warp reality, launch attacks at rivals, and uncover the portal mystery in an epic story mode or intense local multiplayer duels.

4643000.title: 箱舟キバウ
4643000.short_description: 余命1日の主人公によるちょっと非常識で不条理なADVノベル。 解像度の低い隔絶された世界で揺蕩う。

1771320.title: Project XZ
1771320.short_description: PROJECT XZ is a high-octane fusion of platforming, action, and tower defense strategy. Shoot, brawl, and upgrade your arsenal of skills to tear through anything in your way and decide the fate of the future.

4557340.title: Dead Reckoning: The Long Drift
4557340.short_description: A dream among the stars — or a nightmare. 1,000 colonists in the dark between stars. Every pragmatic decision rewrites who they are. Discover what your choices mean for humanity, for better or worse.

4546210.title: Bitvania
4546210.short_description: Bitvania 是一款混乱的动作平台游戏，你一开始完全没有武器。捡起你能找到的任何东西——从匕首到榴莲再到拖鞋——管理体力，并期待在关键时刻触发罕见的1%暴击，造成巨额伤害。

3665510.title: DogPunk
3665510.short_description: DogPunk is a high-octane FPS where you play as a prototype dog soldier escaping confinement and uncovering the mystery of your creation. Move fast with fluid parkour, fight relentless enemies, and upgrade your loadout as the challenge escalates.

4877630.title: A Roguelike Tower Defense Demo
4877630.short_description: Build a unique defense every run in this roguelike tower defense. Choose a hero, discover new towers, collect upgrade cards, and create powerful synergies to overcome increasingly difficult enemies and bosses.

4594460.title: Mall Simulator Together
4594460.short_description: 《Mall Simulator Together》是一款多人购物中心经营模拟游戏，你可以与好友一起开设商店、管理货物配送、摆放商品、雇佣员工，并逐步发展属于自己的购物中心。

4698720.title: Huntsman Against Darkness
4698720.short_description: A dark roguelite action experience where you fight through endless hordes of corrupted creatures, free your family and rebuild the village. Survive brutal arena battles, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat massive bosses, and rebuild a fallen medieval village one run at a time.

4812340.title: Sparrow Country Demo
4812340.short_description: A limiting version of the full game.

4832800.title: ECHOLASH
4832800.short_description: Slash through procedurally generated dungeons to the beat of real-time dubstep. Time your attacks with the spatial indicator for devastating combos. Rebirth, grow stronger, prestige — the echo never dies.

4725600.title: Ore & Ordnance
4725600.short_description: Ore & Ordnance is a Retro styled, Sci-fi, Bullet Hell. Survive endless waves of Pirates, Asteroids and Firestorms. Collect upgrades, complete missions and survive your shift! How long will you last?

4317240.title: Jamie and Marley Die A Lot
4317240.short_description: A short visual novel inspired by RPG Maker horror. You and your sickly best friend are trapped in a supernatural cave system, and it seems like the only way out might be past a series of puzzles. Assuming you don't die along the way. But with 14 endings, that might be hard to pull off.

3868760.title: Exofinity Clicker
3868760.short_description: 在《Exofinity Clicker》中探索新世界，开采传奇的无限水晶（Infinity Crystal）并赚取积分吧！点击以提取稀有宇宙矿物，升级您的建筑，扩大您的影响力，从一个小哨所发展成为一个跨行星的强大帝国。

4761480.title: Grid Wars: Last Stand
4761480.short_description: Command a growing army in a fantasy tactical auto-battler. Place warriors, archers, monks, and heroes on an expanding grid, defend your keep against enemy waves, and conquer a world map filled with quests, rewards, and boss battles.

3210260.title: Dark Descent
3210260.short_description: Dark Descent is a 4 player multiplayer cooperative horror game where you and your friends venture into an old elevator, aiming to reach the deepest levels. However, the journey won't be without it's challenges.

4020320.title: STARVAULT
4020320.short_description: Starvault 是首款真正的 VR MOBA 射击游戏，将经典 MOBA 策略与爽快刺激的英雄射击玩法融为一体。组建队伍，掌握各具特色的英雄，解锁炫酷皮肤，投身紧张激烈的 5 对 5 战斗。踏入竞技场！

3788070.title: Tiny Terra Spaces
3788070.short_description: Build your own cosy medieval island with historical inspired 3D buildings. Relax in Sandbox Mode or set sail in Island Hop Mode, shaping lively communities inspired by the beauty and history of Scotland.

4476000.title: Remagotchi
4476000.short_description: 忠于90年代经典的复古虚拟宠物游戏。像素风养成模拟玩法，包含多种角色与稀有宠物，你的选择将决定宠物的进化与成长。

4804670.title: Floor 12
4804670.short_description: A horror-infused walking simulator inspired by the classics of anomaly hunting. Watch the lights closely, listen to the sounds, and trust your intuition. One wrong step and the journey begins anew. How many floors separate you from freedom?

3438130.title: Dynasty Protocol
3438130.short_description: 指挥你的太空舰队，开采小行星，在这款沉浸式即时战略游戏中征服殖民地。建造强大的太空站，通过战斗经验升级你的舰船，管理重要资源，将你的王朝扩张至整个星系。

4270020.title: Survival Quest Dungeons and the Beasts
4270020.short_description: In a realm where you craft your way forward, hunt to survive, and cook your food to keep you from starving to death. You will go on many adventures. But along the way you will meet up with beasts that are constantly trying to take you out. Survive quests in Survival Quest Dungeons and the Beasts...

4339080.title: Slot or Die
4339080.short_description: 一位骑士迷失在一座被诅咒的城堡中，他借助一台形似圣物的老虎机，直面恐怖的威胁。停止转轮，连击并触发奖励，管理你的物品栏，在这款黑暗的Roguelite游戏中生存下来，每一次旋转都决定着你的命运。

4867040.title: Polychoron Explorer Demo
4867040.short_description: Tired of 2D and 3D games? Check out this puzzle game and sandbox for people curious about Euclidean 4D space. Solve Magic Manycell puzzle inspired by Magic Cube. Explore all 6 known regular polychorons (4D figures made of 3D bodies for faces), or create your own.

4675480.title: Food Idle
4675480.short_description: In Food Idle, build the ultimate automated kitchen! Discover over 2000 ingredients and dishes as you level up, earn gold, and expand your operation!

4442710.title: Spirit Dungeon
4442710.short_description: 队伍编成×卡组构筑×自动战斗。作为召唤师收集精灵，选择卡牌，挑战深林迷宫的Roguelike RPG。

4252830.title: Type or Die
4252830.short_description: 在一部中世纪手稿的深处，一匹马挥起武器，为战死的主人复仇。通过打字发动攻击、收集卡牌、探索活跃的棋盘，在这个每个词语都能成为武器的肉鸽游戏中努力生存。

4769580.title: The Ferryman's Trial
4769580.short_description: Death is searching for a successor. To claim his mantle, you must judge the souls of the dead during a surprisingly short, strange and unsettling job interview where every choice shapes the fate of humanity, including your own.

3859750.title: Lawn Care Simulator
3859750.short_description: Take Back the Yard in Lawn Care Simulator! Grab your mower and bring unruly lawns under control. From overgrown backyards to massive estates, cut through the chaos one blade at a time. Satisfyingly slice, edge, and clean your way to perfectly manicured greens — all in a day's mow.

3298910.title: Once a Pawn a King
3298910.short_description: Chess is broken. Gather the Black Army, build a party of chess pieces, and battle through fractured boards in this asymmetric turn-based roguelike. Empower your army, adapt your strategy each run, and unravel the mystery behind a world trapped in an endless match.

4162290.title: OK👍 Boomer
4162290.short_description: 这是一款4人合作生存恐怖游戏，你将与一群热爱模拟技术的伙伴们，一起探索网络中那令人胆寒的深处。使用老派科技清除故障，守护你的数字理智，在深网中潜伏的诸多怪物手中生存下来。

4801080.title: Wetline - Fire Break
4801080.short_description: Fire spreads through everything it touches. Pilot your water bomber low to refill, and lay wetlines that cut the blaze off before it reaches town. Ignite controlled fires when water isn't enough. A fast, tense firefighting puzzle where every second feeds the fire. What will you save?

4670670.title: Cronus' Tomb: First Quest
4670670.short_description: Descend into Cronus' Tomb and revel in the spoils of being on the forefront of discovery. Explore a labyrinth of ancient chambers, fighting monsters from forgotten corners of Greek mythology, and maybe even uncover why no one has been there before.

4695000.title: The Lumberjack's Routine
4695000.short_description: 砍树、收集木材、雇佣工人并提升自己，在这款温馨的像素风伐木工日常游戏中努力前行。你砍下的每一棵树，都会让你离还清债务更近一步。

4191950.title: Crown Control
4191950.short_description: Crown Control is a top-down roguelite survivor where you equip powerful crowns, unleash an arsenal of attack skills, and survive wave after wave of increasingly unhinged enemies. Pick your wannabe hero and enter the battlefield to prove your worth.

4806570.title: Pages of Zite Demo
4806570.short_description: Create the city of Zite one Page at a time in this rogue-like deckbuilder. Expand your city with cards and hand-drawn roads, discover powerful synergies, and resist a spreading darkness threatening to consume the journal and return its Pages to shadow.

4873100.title: Harvester vs. Zombies Demo
4873100.short_description: 在乡村、小镇和城市的道路上碾碎成群丧尸。躲避障碍物，购买升级，解锁更强大的载具，完成任务，收集卡牌，获得成就，并与来自世界各地的玩家在排行榜上一较高下。

4784740.title: Pages of Zite
4784740.short_description: Create the city of Zite one Page at a time in this rogue-like deckbuilder. Expand your city with cards and hand-drawn roads, discover powerful synergies, and resist a spreading darkness threatening to consume the journal and return its Pages to shadow.

4672520.title: Impulse Response
4672520.short_description: Engineer Cadence Quinn wakes from cryo sleep to blaring alarms. What happened to the crew? What's wrong with the ship? Use echolocation to navigate the darkness, solve the puzzles and uncover the mystery... A first person, blind accessible audio only experience.

4218510.title: Enarian Online
4218510.short_description: Dive into a fast paced, text based ARPG experience that fuses classic adventure with modern action-packed gameplay. Through 5 classes, 50 levels, 9 realms and challenging bosses, fight using over 100 skills and collect almost limitless loot and upgrades whilst perfecting your characters build.

4684810.title: DICEPATH
4684810.short_description: 《DicePath》是一款每一步都需要消耗行动点的解谜游戏。规划路线，收集骰子以维持生存，并在行动点耗尽前抵达出口。50个精心设计的关卡。仅有一种资源。容不得半点失误。

4879440.title: 1997 Reloaded Demo
4879440.short_description: A free 15-minute taste of 1997 RELOADED. Dive into an alternate 90s analog mystery, test the vintage answering machine mechanics, and feel the pulse of the Roxyverse before the first major cliffhanger hits.

4626000.title: Left Fore Dead: Zombie Battle Golf
4626000.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer golf game where zombies keep showing up and your friends make everything worse.

4123060.title: Saga Onirica: Angelic Engine
4123060.short_description: Saga Onirica: Angelic Engine is a top-down shooter featuring experimental control schemes and mechanics, where you fight endless waves of demons by crafting the ultimate loadout from firearms, magic spells, and advanced technology.

4873580.title: Cytokine Storm Demo
4873580.short_description: Cytokine Storm is a retro survival horror set inside a coma patient's body. Battle parasites, viruses, and a defective immune system to wake yourself up. Explore a surreal biological world where you must use your wits, weapons, and unique costumes to survive grotesque locations and puzzles.

4860900.title: Braveforce: The Lost Dominion of the Void Demo
4860900.short_description: A retro-inspired RPG that blends classic simplicity with modern convenience.

3429340.title: Bittersweet Blossoms
3429340.short_description: A lesbian romance set in England shortly after WWI. The story centres around Dot, a young maid who begins to work in the crumbling stately home of Bly, and her young mistress: the devious, devilish Patience.

4453880.title: Neon Hole
4453880.short_description: 潜入无尽的、程序生成的霓虹虚空。以超音速躲避障碍物，通过技能树升级你的飞船，并在跳动的电子音乐节奏中生存下来。你能黑进系统多深？

4616690.title: Outta Space
4616690.short_description: 你的小猫现在飞到哪里了呢？ Outta Space 是一款放置类游戏，一只小小的猫会在你的桌面角落里静静探索宇宙。 你工作、打字、点击的每一个瞬间，都会成为宇宙飞船的燃料。 从月球出发，飞越太阳系，直到遥远的恒星。 回来看看吧，你可爱的小猫已经飞了多远。

4774920.title: Herald of Moira Demo
4774920.short_description: Explore the region of Rosevale, craft potions through alchemy, lead an investigation against five suspects, and uncover the truth behind a massacre in this semi-open world gothic fantasy RPG.

4785060.title: Magic Never Stops! Demo
4785060.short_description: A short incremental game about using magic to kill enemies, collect souls, and grow your magical powers.

4848800.title: Labyrinth of Doom Demo
4848800.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler. Fight, scavenge, and outwit a friend or AI rival in procedurally generated labyrinths — Battle Royale for two, with the full game unlocking up to 10 players, Legendary Artifacts, and Co-op mode.

4656840.title: Gamba God
4656840.short_description: 下注、加注、赌上一切，在这款 Roguelite 扑克游戏中挑战 7 个抽牌扑克关卡，踏上成为“赌神”的道路。每一手牌都至关重要，每一次冒险都伴随着风险，而每一次升级都将影响你的最终目标。

4636080.title: Samurai Pets
4636080.short_description: Take on your friends & players from around the world in lightning-fast duels where timing is everything. Tap at the right moment… or lose instantly. Samurai Pets is a fast-paced arcade game where one button decides the outcome. Duel locally or online—extreme reflexes, mind games, & chaos guaranteed.

4746280.title: Galactic Retribution Vol.1
4746280.short_description: They’re back! And this time, they brought backup. Blast your way through waves of vengeful aliens, dodge their bullets and cosmic insults, and defend our solar system in this retro-inspired arcade shooter.

3513850.title: Invisible Ascent
3513850.short_description: A rage-inducing memory platformer where the path disappears before you jump. Study the platforms, trust your memory, and climb upward one painful mistake at a time.

4789260.title: Never Ending Hero RPG
4789260.short_description: 永无止境的英雄角色扮演游戏是一款免费放置动作角色扮演游戏，你的英雄的属性会无限增长。探索区域地图，自动战斗怪物，升级神秘军械库的装备，并获得永久奖励的声望。可选宝石包。免费帐户可实现云保存。

4798180.title: Sawedoffriddler: Human Handshake Mode
4798180.short_description: 🧩 Solve brutally hard handshake riddles in a dark gothic pixel-art world. Decode Sawedoffbuddy, Sawedoffsob, and hidden phrase variations to unlock secrets, discover the true handshake, and conquer the mystery. 🔐🕯️👁️

4211460.title: SherloCAT Nonogram Bahia
4211460.short_description: 挑战 120 个数独谜题，开启夏洛克·福尔摩斯在巴伊亚的冒险之旅。您可以选择轻松畅玩的经典模式，也可以挑战极限的挑战模式。无论您是新手还是解谜高手，都能在这里找到乐趣！

4847130.title: Meander Demo
4847130.short_description: From random squiggles to silly creatures, doodle anything in this cozy crochet-inspired drawing game. Save your drawings in your scrapbook and decorate them with stickers and notes. Meander lets you relax and unwind, and create fun art while you're doing it. (100% AI-free)

3730570.title: Pixel Empires
3730570.short_description: 一款会自己打仗的像素挂机塔防。村民自动采集，大军自动迎战无尽夜潮，法术自动施放——你只需拉弓瞄准、串联连招、决定升级什么。首领、泰坦、飞升轮回、100+ 成就在此等候。长夜无尽，此弓在你手。

2588750.title: All one click
2588750.short_description: "All one click" is an Action-RPG that reduces player input to the most exciting part of every RPG: the level-up. Prove yourself against thousands of enemies in seemingly endless waves. Use the power of magic spells to assert yourself against the countless enemies. But be warned: every click counts!

3098680.title: Ancient Wonders Atlantis
3098680.short_description: Dive into Ancient Wonders: Atlantis, a hex-grid match-3 puzzle adventure where you link tiles, break obstacles, uncover lost treasures, and build the legendary city.

4356420.title: Wheel Balance
4356420.short_description: Wheel Balance is a hard and fun physics-based game about balancing on two wheels. Master controls and beat all locations, compete with your friends. Try not to fall far away down!

4841010.title: No Beer Left Behind! Demo
4841010.short_description: 2D sokoban puzzle game with pixel art and an 8-bit soundtrack. You play as a dwarf tidying up his cellars. The goal is simple: get every barrel onto its marked spot, and the level is solved.

4788480.title: Heroes Of The Eclipse
4788480.short_description: A fast, colorful fantasy action game where you command powerful heroes, battle dark forces, and reclaim the mystical Eclipse Islands from the evil lord Skrimir.

4729520.title: Apestin Explorer
4729520.short_description: Monsters roamed among us, wearing masks of wealth and status. In the early 2000s, disturbing crimes were hidden behind power and influence. Explore, gather evidence, connect clues, and expose a web of corruption. The real monsters are never supernatural, they are people protected by power.

4341280.title: LetMeSee
4341280.short_description: 有趣又轻松的益智游戏合集。

1862950.title: 苏打队长
1862950.short_description: 变身为你心目中的终极苏打英雄，用闪闪发光的苏打 “武气” 消灭外星军队！《苏打队长》是个充满独特苏打口味“武气”、本领和激烈挑战的平台射击游戏。气泡战将起炮！

4237700.title: Wings of Aviora
4237700.short_description: Become an aviator on the planet Aviora. Build unique aircraft. Fight mechanical beasts in various missions located in open world. Collect blueprints and improve your aircraft.

3562500.title: Soccerboy vs Aliens
3562500.short_description: Play as Soccerboy, a plucky little soccer fanatic in this 2D action, puzzle platformer. Honing your ball skills, you must take on an alien invasion to save the galaxy and your soccer idol Bro-naldo, in this fun take on the platforming genre.

4735230.title: Pile 'Em High Episode 3: Convalescence
4735230.short_description: Deep in Colorado’s Rocky Mountains, a secluded estate becomes ground zero for terror. Pile ’Em High 3 throws you into nonstop action‑horror mayhem—cultists, zombies, abominations—all standing between you and the truth behind the world‑shattering Pandemic

2466790.title: KIYO：暴兔之城
2466790.short_description: Kiyo曾是一只猫科捕食者，被困在一个霓虹灯闪烁的反乌托邦城市中，这座城市被沉迷于智能手机的兔子们所统治。拿起武器，潜入兔子集团，揭开它们深藏的秘密，并在这场潜行战斗的冒险中，将所有动物从它们的残暴统治下解放出来。

4624060.title: Mortar and Malady
4624060.short_description: A medieval apothecary simulator where you brew, grind, and sell remedies to earn your place in a wary new town. Solve intricate recipe riddles, manage your resources, and grow your mastery of herbalism to heal the sick and maintain your reputation as the local healer.

4833850.title: Underegg
4833850.short_description: Underegg is a precision climbing platformer where you help an egg ascend unstable terrain.

4877990.title: The Pawn Broker Demo
4877990.short_description: The Pawn Broker is an economic survival and atmospheric horror game. Wake up behind the counter of a cursed pawn shop. Inspect every item, spot the signs, survive the consequences of your choices, and stay profitable. This Demo includes access to two complete weeks.

4799700.title: Critter Quest
4799700.short_description: 一款复古的虚拟捉妖RPG！探索广阔的大地图，与强敌训练师对战，收集所有章节徽章，并捕捉300多种独特的物种。当您升级您的Critters时，它们的属性会直接同步到您的Steam库存物品中！

4852270.title: Overtorque Demo
4852270.short_description: A time-bending action shooter where you freeze combat, deflect bullets, steal enemy weapons, and leave levels drenched in destruction and gelatinous remains.

4524810.title: Pirate Treasure Hunt
4524810.short_description: Pirate Treasure Hunt 是一款简短的渐进式寻宝游戏。探索岛屿，发掘稀有宝藏和古老文物，升级您的探险队，成为大海上最富有的海盗。

4575280.title: Snowball Party
4575280.short_description: 一款多人休闲体育竞技游戏，最多可供10个玩家一起游玩。玩家将化身红蓝两队雪人，在漫天飞雪的梦幻球场中进行球类比赛，提供多种球类玩法供玩家选择。

3992580.title: 7 Nights with Vroombi
3992580.short_description: Play as Vroombi, a brave little robo-vacuum who needs to keep Lily's house nice and clean! Clean away dust, dirt and debris in this satisfying twist on an interactive cleaning simulator. What awaits little Vroombi at night? What is Lily scared of?

4781910.title: Tragidle
4781910.short_description: Tragidle is an addictive idle game where you take control of a slot machine. Spin the reels, collect rewards, and amass massive fortunes. Invest your winnings strategically to level up different fruits, increase your luck, and unlock powerful perks in the skill tree to make your riches grow.

4832690.title: LAST RITE TD Demo
4832690.short_description: Command humanity’s last defenses in a cinematic sci-fi tower defense demo. Build towers, deploy soldiers, choose your nation, and fight back against VAELRA’s hostile AI forces in the first mission of LAST RITE TD.

4771060.title: One More Adventure Demo
4771060.short_description: One More Adventure is a hexcrawl roguelike inspired by Nethack and Castle of the Winds. It is part of the Old School Renaissance (OSR), and has heavy influences from TTRPGs from the 1970s and 1980s. Each world map and dungeon is new, allowing for a high amount of replayability.

4148410.title: Cubic Spree
4148410.short_description: Cubic Spree is a fast-paced 2D shooter - Play locally and online with your friends, choose your weapons, and blast your way to victory with colorful chaos!

4815820.title: The Ultimate USA Road Trip 2026
4815820.short_description: Experience the ultimate American road trip. Drive across the country, visit iconic cities and landmarks, manage fuel and vehicle condition, face changing weather and road hazards, and complete an unforgettable journey from coast to coast.

4808100.title: Depths
4808100.short_description: Depths is a cooperative multiplayer game where you and up to three friends​ delve into procedurally generated caves, collecting items,​ going deeper, making sure to meet quota every dive. Avoid the monsters that dwell in these caverns​ if you and your friends hope to make it out alive.​

4733510.title: 旷野怪兽
4733510.short_description: 旷野, 怪兽与训练家的故事。挑战不同的怪兽并捕获, 使用各种怪兽出战应对不同敌人, 前所未有的战斗体验正在《旷野怪兽》中等候各位训练家的到来！

4703570.title: Blood Park
4703570.short_description: 一款第一人称 VHS 恐怖游戏，被遗忘的录像带将带你穿越废弃地点、恐怖生物以及隐藏其中的噩梦。

4830980.title: BAFF B
4830980.short_description: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

4830940.title: Chronime Puzzle: Girls
4830940.short_description: Chronime Puzzle: Girls is a relaxing puzzle game featuring beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork.

4830920.title: Eightfold Blocks
4830920.short_description: Rotate, place, and rethink every block in a focused 8x8 puzzle game. Solve 1,000 spatial boards, keep finished solutions visible, reset freely, and use optional hints when one stubborn piece refuses to fit.

4762830.title: Guard Her
4762830.short_description: A classic tower defense game. Build 6 unique towers, upgrade them to level 3, and convert them into support towers. Strategically place towers to redirect enemy paths. Defend against Normal, Fast, Tank enemies and a Boss every 10 waves. 5 difficulty levels, full keyboard controls, save & load.

4820610.title: Project Threshold
4820610.short_description: You are a participant in Project Threshold, an experiment designed to force people to confront their deepest fears. Pass through sets of blue and red doors, survive what waits beyond them, and reach the end, if escape is even possible.

4850960.title: The King Got Too Much Gold Demo
4850960.short_description: Your royal fountain spits out more gold than anyone could ever spend, and cleaning it up is somehow your job. Sweep coins, sell them, draft upgrades, hire goblins, trolls and a cat, unlock a big web of skills, then feed your whole fortune to the Glutton King. You can never lose. The gold never stops

4821680.title: 出马Spirit Rider
4821680.short_description: 一款快节奏的第一人称射击游戏，以第一人称射击来击溃怪物，无需思考太多，真正的快餐游戏。 以中国东北城市，乡镇，农村地区为背景创作，结合贪嗔痴的佛教概念，奇异的玄幻扮演第一人称射击游戏

3924280.title: Pat the Cat
3924280.short_description: Your very own kitty — right on your desktop! A cozy idle game where you pet, feed, and play with a fluffy friend to earn purr points. Spend them on hats, toys, and cozy spots to sit. With hundreds of customization items, you can create a kitty that's truly yours — always by your side.

4196150.title: Kinetic TwinZ
4196150.short_description: In this Motion Control party game, turn volleyball into an act of defiance! Seize your Joy-Cons, dodge powerful attacks, and coordinate with your duo to defeat the "Anti-Fun" police.

4049910.title: 核纪元
4049910.short_description: 《核纪元》是一款融合建造与战术射击的开放世界生存游戏。在这个后末世的世界中，玩家可以与好友一起探索广阔的废土，建设属于自己的庇护所基地，收集资源打造独特的武器装备。 游戏的核心玩法围绕高风险高回报的副本挑战展开：组建小队深入随机生成的危险区域，搜集珍稀物资并安全撤离。但要小心——死亡意味着失去所携带的全部装备，每一次探险都是勇气与策略的考验。 游戏最大的特色在于完全自定义的装备系统：所有武器的性能数值都由玩家亲手打造决定，没有固定的装备模板，每把武器都是独一无二的。

4779190.title: Duel of Gaia
4779190.short_description: 《盖亚决斗》是一款基于卡牌的自动战斗策略游戏。选择独具特色的牌组，投身战场。用卡牌发动强力技能或召唤怪物，在自动战斗中运用最佳策略击败对手，征服大陆。

4505490.title: Mechanical Defense Line
4505490.short_description: 这是一款塔防卡牌肉鸽游戏，可组装改装炮台、搭配装备挑战关卡、体验剧情。通过多种功能强化自身，战斗中选择不同天赋取胜，每次战斗可获得不少于 10 件装备，更多内容请在游戏内体验。

4741550.title: Ship of the line
4741550.short_description: Command legendary fleets across 240 years of Age of Sail warfare. 19 historical scenarios — Trafalgar, the Nile, the Armada. Real wind physics, three-layer damage, and full PvP. Your fleet. Your tactics. Your history.

3413000.title: 你的可爱老婆
3413000.short_description: 你邂逅了一名研究巫术的女大学生，与她一同进入北纬30度神秘幻境，从而开启了一段浪漫奇幻的冒险旅程，然而你知道，这不过是个开始...

4784230.title: Deeper
4784230.short_description: Deeper is a short horror management game focusing on stress and being stuck in a submarine

4557560.title: Necromancer Delivery Service
4557560.short_description: A 3D physics-driven action racing game where players take on the role of a struggling necromancer forced into a delivery job in a chaotic city. Deliver packages, collect money and souls as tips, and use chaotic spells.

3631710.title: The Crimson Contract
3631710.short_description: A gritty top-down co-op zombie shooter where every mission is a high-risk contract. Battle the undead, earn your payout, and survive long enough to uncover the truth.

4688810.title: The Long Way Round
4688810.short_description: Follow Detective Richard Wadd on his search for 6 missing people who have seemingly vanished over the last 3 years. Experience reality bending events and try to uncover the truth in this first-person puzzle thriller.

4792500.title: Monke Brain Demo
4792500.short_description: His monke brain is bored, needs stimulation. Use your superior brain to design the perfect deck of cards that makes number go up. Monke sees big number, monke stays happy.

4762860.title: Warrior's Memory The Hollow Strata
4762860.short_description: In a world where countless warrior vessels lie dormant, a wandering soul fights for freedom. Build your 20-card deck from over 1,000 cards, then collect, fuse, and upgrade cards as you conquer the Hollow Strata.

4393110.title: Dice Beauty: Roguelike Tactics
4393110.short_description: Dice Beauty is a turn-based tactical roguelike where battles are fought with dice and elemental strategy. Face beautiful elemental heroines, exploit strengths and weaknesses, manage risk, and survive unpredictable runs where smart decisions matter more than luck.

4791840.title: 摸鱼悟道
4791840.short_description: 末法时代，天道崩塌，灵气枯竭。唯有在「脱离俗务、心神游离」的瞬间，方能偷得一线天机。《摸鱼悟道》是一款 桌面宠物 + 放置修仙 游戏：你照常上班、学习、刷网页，桌上的小修士会根据你 当前正在用什么软件 实时反应——打开 Word、Excel，KPI 锁链缠身，灵气封印；切到 Steam、B 站、聊天软件，青光汇聚，正常悟道。Alt+Tab 是你的遁法，带薪的每一分钟都是你的丹药。养五行灵根、突破八境、闭关洞府、观星抽箓、鼠标画符——把工作日，慢慢炼成修行。心镜只读应用名，数据全在本地。不想自动检测？纯手动模式随时可用。

4846130.title: Dungeons & Dummies Demo
4846130.short_description: Descend alone or drag up to 7 friends into a deep, ever-changing dungeon that does not care about your feelings. Chase loot, quests, and power while insisting “one more floor” is a great idea. Greed is encouraged. Survival is optional.

4196110.title: WOBBLY HEIST
4196110.short_description: Take control of three capybaras infiltrating a fashion event in this stealth puzzle game. Stack under a disguise to blend in among humans, split up to solve puzzles, avoid suspicion, and steal a legendary jewel. But be careful: one wrong move could reveal what’s really under the coat!

4389960.title: Forward Assault
4389960.short_description: Forward Assault is a modern strategic tactical multiplayer shooter game. Play in teams either as the Counter Terrorist, or the Terrorist team. Pick from a variety of unique weapons and go online in PvP combat to either plant or defuse the bomb.

4546900.title: KILL LOOP
4546900.short_description: 反弹！击杀！加速！这是一款极简高速动作游戏！在无尽的反弹和循环里不断杀戮，在极简的世界里感受击杀带来的快感吧！

4851900.title: 和躲在酒馆里的黑色JK一起喝咖啡 Demo
4851900.short_description: 在一天风平浪静的日子，一个名叫洛小米的少女突然闯入到了主角的生活当中，她自称从未来而来，并为了拯救未来已经死亡的男主 起初，男主还以为这是句玩笑话，可在通过自己的能力读心之后，才发现她似乎并没有说谎 这次我的好奇心作祟之下，他和这位神秘少女进行了同居，并开始了每天的工作日常

2748770.title: Dala and the Cursed Forest
2748770.short_description: 融合卡牌。进化牌组。打破轮回。 《达拉与诅咒森林》是一款以东南亚神话为背景的Roguelike卡牌构筑游戏。每一次卡牌组合都将重塑你的战斗方式。在森林将你吞噬之前，解除诅咒。

4880010.title: Val'ty Demo
4880010.short_description: Assert dominance in this Retro Reptilian oriented First Person Shooter. No humans allowed! GET VAL'TED!

4817600.title: The Colors of Love - Re-Colored
4817600.short_description: A romantic visual novel about connection, choices, and the colors of the heart. Features an animated Live2D love interest, multiple endings, English and Spanish support, Steam achievements, and hidden secrets to uncover.

4872570.title: Gem Party Demo
4872570.short_description: Match 3 or more gems to channel their power into your cute animal party. Defeat the endless bosses charging toward you.

4874710.title: Chucho Demo
4874710.short_description: Gay romance and demon slaying, the perfect recipe!!

3756080.title: 意识传送侦探
3756080.short_description: 《意识传送侦探》是一款开放世界的侦探游戏，你将扮演大侦探比尔森，在开放的世界中侦破奇案。游戏不止有主线破案情节，还有更多丰富的额外内容供玩家探索。游戏内拥有职业系统，在破案的闲暇之余做一些兼职，赚一些外快也是不错的。

2804240.title: NEODRIVE
2804240.short_description: Master deep, technical arcade driving in NEODRIVE. Chase ghosts, manage a rewarding optional manual transmission, and hunt medals across 64 tracks in four difficulty classes.

4774660.title: Book Organizer
4774660.short_description: Book Organizer is a cozy 3D simulation game where you become a library volunteer to mindfully organize cluttered shelves. Without stress, it delivers a satisfying visual and auditory experience as books snap perfectly into place, offering pure relaxation and deep immersion.

4749170.title: Puzzles Desert
4749170.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

4292440.title: The Minesweeper
4292440.short_description: The classic game of minesweeper from a fresh new perspective. Play alone or with a friend in this third person puzzle game, where you toss grenades, plant flags, and math a path to victory. Enjoy the calm of nature, chill tunes and chaotic reveals.

4602730.title: 这张不算 This One Doesn't Count
4602730.short_description: 《这张不算》——你活了40年，每天都在买彩票，一次都没中过。临死前上帝告诉你："其实中奖的人，都是作弊的。"重生再来，用一切手段，在女儿高考前凑齐学费。刮刮乐 × 肉鸽。

4400980.title: Blood Gauntlet
4400980.short_description: Blood Gauntlet is a fast-paced, pixel art action platformer where you’re constantly bleeding out. The only way to survive is to keep moving and destroy everything in your path!

2732590.title: Item Collector Ball
2732590.short_description: Physics based family fun for all ages. Vibe to original tunes as you roll your way through dynamic levels.

4814590.title: Isekai Rift Demo
4814590.short_description: 在被邪恶实体传送并与兄弟分离后，Yuji必须掌握裂隙能量，探索被其扭曲的未知世界，战斗敌人，克服平台挑战，并收集跨维度星星，展开一场受经典3D游戏启发的冒险。

4610800.title: Wizards 95
4610800.short_description: Wizards 95 is a retro-themed multiplayer chatroom-focused game about being a wizard! Drink wine, collect spells, level up and gamble to increase your net-worth so you can show off! (or just hang around and paint if that's what floats your boat.)

3778780.title: Interaktivně o Liberci
3778780.short_description: A first-person interactive film where you decide how the day unfolds during a visit to Liberec with someone you haven’t seen in ages. Choose your path, shape the experience — and be careful. One wrong choice might end everything.

2974020.title: Codex Combat
2974020.short_description: Create a legendary spellbook to battle history's greatest mages in this arcane autobattler! Pick a hero, fill your codex with powerful sigils, cast mighty spells, discover ancient relics, and fulfill your destiny in this turn-based online PvP arena.

4692340.title: Coastal Summit Sports: College Athletics 27
4692340.short_description: Become the Athletic Director in this deep collegiate sports management simulation. Build a multi-decade dynasty by allocating budgets, directing NIL funds, upgrading facilities, and hiring coaches across a massive roster of simulated sports, from football to rowing.

4438740.title: Persuasion RPG
4438740.short_description: A game of logic, faith and perception. A Victorian roguelike mystery. Explore a haunted manor, gather clues, interrogate suspects and solve the disappearance of the Bishop before madness or darkness claims you! Can you see through the veil of fear, or will you be the next body found in the parlor?

4101110.title: B.O.B.Y's Journey
4101110.short_description: Follow a robot’s journey to find the Spiritual Island, seeking the key to offering genuine emotional support while healing and transforming within, a story of resilience, self-discovery, and inner growth.

4802340.title: Agricola - The King's Farmer Demo
4802340.short_description: Agricola - The King's Farmer: A classic, challenging economic simulation game. Manage your own farm - cultivate your fields, raise cows, train horses, and manage your forest. The goal of the game is to become king. Will you succeed?

4870580.title: CUEQUENCE Demo
4870580.short_description: 体验 CUEQUENCE 试玩版——一款以 Q-LAND 为背景的单人 Roguelite 台球卡牌对战游戏。精准瞄准，构筑你的卡组，使用魔法卡牌，并在三个可游玩的章节中迎战越来越强大的对手

4887060.title: Handwalk Demo
4887060.short_description: 《Handwalk》是一款高难度物理受苦游戏，你需要分别控制每只手，用双手走路爬上山顶。

4522710.title: Swarmbound
4522710.short_description: Unleash pixel-art hell in a high-performance bullet heaven. Command 5 classes against massive 1,500-unit swarms with zero lag. Loot, level, and spec your way to Wave 30 with chain lightning and spiral hammers. Fully moddable, Steam Deck optimized, and built for pure retro destruction.

4877270.title: One Dice Dungeon Delve Demo
4877270.short_description: One Die. One Life. Infinite Delving. From a single d6 and a paper prototype at my desk, ODDD is a tight, focused roguelike where every roll matters. Master meaningful class abilities and watch your hero visibly grow with every piece of loot. How deep will you delve?

4889490.title: Hyper Profit Pets Demo
4889490.short_description: Hatch. Train. Sell. Repeat. Become the ultimate pet mogul in this idle incremental! Collect over 100 types of pet with dozens of special effects!

4888450.title: Cursor Flux Demo
4888450.short_description: Add motion blur, trails, and glow effects to your cursor for a smoother, more stylish pointer that fits your setup without changing your workflow.

4888220.title: 赢麻了 Demo
4888220.short_description: 《赢麻了 Mahjong Rush》是一款水墨风格的麻将 Roguelike 构筑游戏。用吃碰杠、花牌、符牌与宝物搭建得分引擎，靠「筹码 × 倍率 」一击收割。穿越六巡节点路线图，挑战妖怪 Boss，每一局都不重样。一砚浓墨，一桌好牌。这一局，看看你能不能真正——赢麻了。

4681970.title: The Naysayer
4681970.short_description: Disprove the accusations a seditious knight has brought against your rule. Find a way to defeat your foe in the arena, or refute his words in this text-based souls-like.

4885530.title: Keep Drawing: Webtoon Tycoon Demo
4885530.short_description: 从一名单打独斗的网漫作者起步，打造你的工作室帝国。画出读者喜爱的章节，培育热门连载，聘请专业人才，并在长达25年的职业生涯中谈判出版协议。一段惬意的创作之旅，兼具经营大亨游戏的深度。

4854190.title: Redline Protocol Demo
4854190.short_description: Redline Protocol is a fast modern-retro helicopter combat game built around low-altitude attacks, tactical objectives, wrap-around battlefields, and escalating chaos.

4794930.title: Balance It!
4794930.short_description: A physics based side-scroller game about balancing objects.

4829000.title: Alchemist Business Simulation Demo
4829000.short_description: 忘掉那些温馨的店铺吧。在《炼金术士商业模拟》中，你需要掌控危险的配方、变幻莫测的市场以及致命的洞穴探险。精通炼金术，利用市场趋势，在实验室爆炸前建立你的商业帝国。坩埚总会赢，证明你有能力驾驭这一切混乱。立即下载。

4520500.title: Puzzle
4520500.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

2890650.title: Never Trust a Fox
2890650.short_description: 一部融合疯狂、狐娘与禁忌之恋的百合恐怖视觉小说。

4821000.title: Sepulchre Machine
4821000.short_description: Pilot a mech through the dark unknown, upgrade it in-between expeditions, and ensure the mech's safety until it reaches extraction. Your own safety is optional.

4614780.title: [MFTK: Survivors] Mortemforge: TekaRenzen's Konquerax: Survivors
4614780.short_description: Conquer and pillage planets as a one-man army in this brutal action roguelite set in a bizarre and dark Technofantasy universe. Battle hordes, plunder your enemies, forge devastating arsenals, and carve your path through endless intergalactic god-wars under the watchful eye of a mysterious goddess.

4818930.title: The Tartarus Loop
4818930.short_description: Play as a copy of Theseus. Run around in a maze, having to defeat the very Minotaur in Tartarus after it perished by the hands of the original Theseus. Over and over again. The soul of the Minotaur can't rest. All it can do is chase the player and try to outsmart you.

4885290.title: Paint Gal Adventures Demo
4885290.short_description: 一款充满活力的3D平台游戏，你可以在其中探索多彩的世界、解决创意挑战并发现每个精心设计的关卡中隐藏的魔力。非常适合寻求迷人且易于访问的游戏玩法的玩家。

4783160.title: Signal
4783160.short_description: 无教程的终端操作员模拟。路由消息，从失败和重复中推断规则，在循环中存活。

4867020.title: 万象战略 Demo
4867020.short_description: 《万象战略》是一款回合制策略游戏。你将扮演一个国家的统治者，在由城市、乡村、资源与人物共同构成的世界中经营政权、调配人才、发展经济，并在战争、饥荒、疫病与难民潮之间寻找国家的生路。世界局势会随着各国行动不断变化。你可以通过控制城市、稳定民生、解决难民危机、建设粮食体系、发展谍报网络，或单纯让国家熬过漫长乱世来达成胜利。

4867830.title: Ironfields Demo
4867830.short_description: 在这款复古单人 RTS 中，直接指挥装甲单位，占领战场建筑，进行战术性防御塔部署，并以更慢节奏掌控战场。没有传统基地建造，也不依赖快速反应——只有计划、压力、升级，以及在手工设计的任务中发动关键推进。

4808800.title: Naked Man
4808800.short_description: A pixel art platformer where you swing upward through the jungle using vines and ropes — all the way to outer space!

4309120.title: Unquiet Grey
4309120.short_description: You can't save him... but what if you could meet him again? Unquiet Grey is a heartbreaking timeloop visual novel about a troubled young woman and the kind-hearted musician she loves through countless lifetimes.

4870250.title: Soma Cube Demo
4870250.short_description: Soma Cube is a focused 3D puzzle game with seven pieces and 12 shapes to solve. Rotate, move, and combine the pieces to build each model. Test your spatial reasoning, and solve every shape at your own pace.

4450300.title: Solderia - Fall of Kings
4450300.short_description: Build your kingdom, train armies, forge alliances, and fight for the throne in Solderia: Fall of Kings, a medieval strategy game where every decision shapes your rise to power.

4808170.title: Skirmish
4808170.short_description: Skirmish is a real time strategy card game where you use cards to summon units to fight each other.

4738420.title: Lil' Quests
4738420.short_description: Where every Quest ends in Laughs and Chaos. Lil' Quests is a sandbox, adventure, co-op game with wacky physics, funny moments, and horses!

4820220.title: Worm Life
4820220.short_description: Play as a worm and live your Worm Life while sharing resources with other worms. Grow and evolve to make sure you are the dominate worm of the area.

4300190.title: THE ANOMALY UNIT
4300190.short_description: 你被迫在一座太空仓库中担任异常观察员，必须探索环境、仔细观察，并汇报异常情况。赚取点数购买升级，但要小心——可怖的存在正潜伏在黑暗之中。

4153770.title: Origins Of Teco
4153770.short_description: This 2D platformer and adventure game features Teco, a one-eyed orange guy with laser beam powers, and now this little guy must face creatures trying to take over the world. The game features a great story that you discover as you progress.

4535970.title: Dungeon Dilemma
4535970.short_description: A Dungeon Builder and Crawler Roguelike where you can construct your own dungeon or raid one designed by your friends. Vie for victory, defeat minions, and evade traps as a party of up to 4 Challengers, or create the most diabolical dungeon imaginable as the Dungeon Boss!

3572060.title: Raining Cats and Dogs
3572060.short_description: It’s literally raining cats and dogs. In this game you platform, overcome about 100 unique obstacles, fight 3 janky bosses, find comments added from YouTube Shorts and make it stop raining cats and dogs by fighting Jeff in the end. Here's a message from Jeff: "YOU WILL NEVER STOP ME YEEEHAWWW"

4717940.title: Pinguino Demo
4717940.short_description: Slip & Slide Your Way Through Each Level While Eating as Few Fish as Possible!

4879430.title: Skeptikos Demo
4879430.short_description: Skeptikos is a solo game taking place in a strange formation center. Resolve the puzzles, find the secrets around here.

4808270.title: Till Midnight
4808270.short_description: TILL MIDNIGHT is a narrative-driven management simulation game with world-shattering consequences, inspired by true historical events. Navigate a darkly atmospheric vessel gripped by critical communication failures, trapped hundreds of meters below the surface.

4395790.title: Eyes of the Forest
4395790.short_description: A third-person stealth adventure set in a quiet, post-human woodland where survival depends on patience, observation, and restraint. Towering ruins, tangled roots, and dimly lit paths create an environment where every movement matters and safety is never guaranteed.

4544610.title: Unlucky Day
4544610.short_description: 一款关于在讨厌你的日子里努力生存的点击游戏。面对糟糕透顶的概率，Mika 能连续挺过十场灾难，并最终在酒吧见到她的朋友吗？

3184290.title: Interrogator 2
3184290.short_description: Step into the role of a detective skilled in the art of interrogation, solving complex criminal cases through dialogue and deduction. Work alongside your partner Charles, question suspects, connect the dots, uncover lies, and shape each investigation to reveal the true nature of the crime wave.

4746640.title: Radial Chess
4746640.short_description: Radial Chess is a chess game that preserves all traditional rules and mechanics while reimagining the board as a radial spatial structure, where players compete against AI or locally in a transformed geometric interpretation of classic chess.

4724410.title: Altus Chess-Archaic Beginnings
4724410.short_description: Classical chess plays one move at a time. Altus plays in resonance. Link pieces through quantum-inspired entanglement and trigger cascading resonance reactions across the board. A premium single-player chess experience that preserves every classical rule while dramatically raising strategic depth.

4692930.title: The Hidden Library Demo
4692930.short_description: Uncover secrets in this dark academia-inspired 2D point-and-click adventure. Solve puzzles, explore atmospheric locations, and engage in immersive mini-games as you piece together the mystery of a hidden library filled with forbidden Soviet-era books

4587630.title: Sky Sword Strategy
4587630.short_description: An RPG adventure with strategic gameplay. Recruit an army to repel invaders in a war-torn land. Reunite with your family and help people along the way. Survive long enough to unlock your special abilities. Awaken the power of the Sky Sword.

4211370.title: Battle Live! The Idol School Collection
4211370.short_description: Welcome to Pride Park! Experience six main stories and several bonus stories centered around the staff and students of this eclectic idol school in this episodic, slice-of-life visual novel!

2944670.title: Rapta
2944670.short_description: 15 minutes and a terminal. Your sister's life in your hands. Navigate the Silicon Sneaky system, explore the digital underworld to secure $20,000, and make irreversible decisions. Your choices define her fate.

4844160.title: Neo Tokyo Rush Demo
4844160.short_description: Neo Tokyo Rush is a Synthwave retro arcade racer set in a neon-drenched future Tokyo. Hit the gas, own the streets, and prove you're the king of the neon underground.

4847250.title: All But Weak Demo
4847250.short_description: All But Weak is a Couch Coop Roguelite for 1 to 4 players. Mix elements, stack crazy weapon modifiers, and try to survive the madness with your friends.

4385820.title: Station Nexus
4385820.short_description: 一艘驶向 84,000 公里外目的地的调查飞船。 在调查一艘被摧毁的飞船时，你遭遇了一种无法解释的空间异常现象。 管理电力与资源，继续你的航程，并揭开一种正在缓慢侵蚀现实本身的现象背后的真相。 Station Nexus 是一款将探索、悬疑与系统驱动玩法相结合的科幻剧情冒险游戏。

4616880.title: Chemp Physics
4616880.short_description: Chemp Physics is a multiplayer VR sandbox game where you are only limited by your imagination. From advanced contraptions to shooting ranges to cute tea parties, the environment is your canvas.

4465460.title: Arcanion: The Mekanos Invasion
4465460.short_description: The sequel to Arcanion: Tale of Magi, and Magi Side Story, where the Warriors of Arcanion face their greatest foe yet, the Mekanos Army. And it'll be a fight for their lives as they defend their home against these new invaders. Play as Magi and take part in missions to defend your home!

4882110.title: Copter Dude Demo
4882110.short_description: Short one level demo of the Copter Dude game. This level is not in the full game and its purpose is to show the main action and to put a funny start to the story - find and save the dude's wife. The game is 2D action arcade. You fly a copter with just a hook - every crash is fatal.

4750850.title: Colorace
4750850.short_description: It will be an extraordinary ride! Drive your car through walls made of colored blocks, collect useful power-ups, avoid obstacles on the road, and compare your skills with other players.

4008040.title: Starmageddon
4008040.short_description: Break the rules and join the fight in Starmageddon! A high-octane, team-based, online multiplayer space shooter, where survival is not enough. Dominate the battlefield through teamwork, split-second decisions and constant action!

4510260.title: Pixelords
4510260.short_description: Solo or with friends. A co-op roguelite auto-battler where you deploy units and stack blessings against ever-stronger floors. How far can you survive?

4831070.title: Proper Puzzles
4831070.short_description: A relaxing jigsaw puzzle game with 250 included images and support for custom uploads. Build at your own pace with 20 to 500 pieces, multi-select and lasso tools, and puzzle trays to keep your workspace organised.

4853750.title: DAWN CAR Demo
4853750.short_description: “Pixel art” is too soft a word! This is the story of the Pre-Pixel Age… A dazzling world built entirely from 8×8 character graphics— the vibrant construction set of a Digital Tangram World.

4826940.title: Moonlite - 1975 Demo
4826940.short_description: Get ready for a cosmic getaway with Moonlite - a lunar looting exploration expedition launching 1975. Grab your trusty shovel & spacesuit and start digging! The current version is Early Access v0.5 - pre-alpha - and includes a single map and game mode called 'Treasure Hunt'.

4717330.title: Cubic Demo
4717330.short_description: Explore a mysterious post-human world. Solve puzzles by combining and rearranging cubes. Find your other half.

3191170.title: Clover's Quadrants
3191170.short_description: A challenging puzzle game where you are what you eat - and you have four stomachs. Your four directions of movement are also inventory slots, and items in those slots will affect only that direction of movement.

2629550.title: Threshold of Awakening
2629550.short_description: In 1960s USA, Jane Ferguson, a New York restaurant owner, receives an information on her CIA agent husband Mark, who had vanished mysteriously during a Tibet mission. To uncover his hidden secrets, she follows his trail, delving into the enigma of his disappearance.

4439050.title: Curling
4439050.short_description: Build a deck of curling stones with abilities so broken they should be illegal. Face random opponents in the tour with or without friends. A roguelike deckbuilder unlike anything else.

4824460.title: Cards of Bellum Demo
4824460.short_description: 一款中世纪策略卡牌游戏，幸运的骰子掷出可将必败之局转为辉煌胜利... 带领独特英雄，如巫师或具名骑士。构筑你的牌组。突袭首都。夺取王座。

2562040.title: Code, Solve, Revolt!
2562040.short_description: 《Code, Solve, Revolt!》是一款益智游戏，你将通过直观的拖放式编程来解决工厂任务。为你的机器人编写代码，完成每个关卡的特定目标，深入工厂，邂逅全新的谜题概念和数据结构生物，并揭开真相。

3379320.title: powerless Demo
3379320.short_description: Powerless Demo is a game that blends RPG elements and mini-games. You play as a teacher guiding a robot on an important mission, solving puzzles, and uncovering the mysteries of the world.

4875140.title: Mandate of Galactic Empires Demo
4875140.short_description: A logistics-focused turn-based space 4X. Govern through Administrative Nodes, connect systems with wormhole infrastructure, assign population to production and research, and expand only as far as your empire can support.

3273380.title: Shadow of Ancients
3273380.short_description: 与渴求控制权的远古恶魔共生，艾登的旅程已不再属于他自己。探索充满活力的世界，揭开最深层的秘密，在与内心心魔抗争的同时决定存在的命运。你会掌控黑暗，还是任由它吞噬一切？

4839830.title: Greed Slash Demo
4839830.short_description: Fast-paced stylized sword fighting game where timing and prediction decide every duel. Mirror your opponent’s attacks with precision parries and finish them with brutal cinematic finishers. Easy to learn, hard to master.

3690760.title: 牛仔镇杂货铺 | Wild West Supermarket Simulator
3690760.short_description: 在狂野西部经营一家杂货店。自定义并扩展你的商店。满足顾客不断变化的需求。你可以亲力亲为，也可以雇佣员工来补货或进行收银工作。体验在狂野西部经营超市的感觉。

4567710.title: 恋因天赐!! Present From Angel
4567710.short_description: 充满欢笑的王道日常 ADV 视觉小说《恋因天赐!!》4K 超高清重置版现已正式登陆 Steam！本作是一部将「二次元经典套路」玩到极致的青春恋爱物语，讲述了主角樱井空良意外获得奇妙体质后，让各种离谱的「王道展开」在现实中疯狂上演的故事。在接踵而至的突发状况中，他与伙伴们就此展开了一段反转不断、啼笑皆非的恋爱喜剧。

4771600.title: Soccer Kick-ups
4771600.short_description: Take on the challenge and become the king of kick-ups. Put your skill and precision to the test in Soccer Kick-ups.

4506350.title: Normal Dev Guy - Inside Kenney World
4506350.short_description: Norman 只是个普通的独立游戏开发者，直到有一天他决定亲身进入自己的游戏来测试它——现在他必须用最出人意料的方式修复 bug：在代码里玩疯狂的小游戏！

4740190.title: Tome & Tile
4740190.short_description: Tome & Tile is a roguelite deckbuilder where you spell to survive. Build tile racks, place words on a power-square-strewn board, then chain tomes, enchantments, and lexicon levels into score-explosion combos. 12 characters, 181 tomes, eight chapters of escalating chaos.

4437550.title: 角落之人
4437550.short_description: 你搬进了一间老旧的出租屋，霉味弥漫、窗户吱呀作响，屋内昏暗的灯光映出墙角的阴影。起初，这里似乎只是一个普通的房间，但随着日子一天天过去，你开始听到微弱的敲击声、低语般的窸窣声，甚至会在梦中看到不可名状的幻影。 是一款心理恐怖与悬疑探索相结合的剧情模拟游戏。你需要在每天的选择中平衡休息、探索和心理承受力：是去检查窗外的动静，还是安静地整理房间？是独自面对阴影，还是逃避它？每一个决定都可能影响你的理智值，进而改变结局的走向。 本游戏使用AI技术生成部分事件与角色行为，用于增强游戏的随机性与沉浸感，不涉及玩家数据采集或生成不受控内容。

4775980.title: 3D拼图：破碎之心
4775980.short_description: 《3D拼图：破碎之心》是一款温暖治愈的3D修复拼图游戏。移动、旋转并拼合散落的碎片，修复房间里的旧物，让空旷的房间一点点恢复生机。

4257370.title: Operation Obliteration 2
4257370.short_description: Op Oblit 2 is a lightning-fast WWII shooter with zero hand-holding fluff, just pure hardcore carnage. Tear through 22 handcrafted environment's crawling with relentless enemies. Zero safe spaces & zero mercy: just pure retro carnage. All levels unlocked! Free 73 page PDF war manual available.

4856830.title: Lost in the Fest Demo
4856830.short_description: LOST in the FEST is a musical RPG where swords are guitars and potions are beers.

4521680.title: Painting PC
4521680.short_description: Think you've got what it takes to become a famous artist? Start with one brush and absolutely no followers. Take on commissions, gain fans, unlock new tools, and build your reputation one painting at a time. Will clients happily pay the full amount, or wonder what they've just spent their money on?

4734090.title: Terra Lapsa: After Ragnarök
4734090.short_description: Survive the ruins of Second Germania in an alternate history zombie apocalypse where Germany won World War II. Build a shelter, craft armor, weapons, and tools, and fight against the infected in a fallen world.

4819080.title: Top Bins
4819080.short_description: 一款放置类游戏，你需要射门击中移动球门来赢取金钉。用金钉进行强力升级，这样你就能获得更多金钉，并在任意球挑战中击败守门员 Boss，从而提升联赛等级！

4328580.title: 弾幕病の特効薬
4328580.short_description: Parry action only top-down shooter! Explore body and destroy pathogens!

4823640.title: Sudoku Bigger Picture
