4823640.short_description: Solve 81 Sudoku puzzles, from beginner friendly grids to difficult challenges. Progress through an interconnected world where every solution matters. Look beyond individual puzzles... There's something much bigger waiting to be discovered!

4288940.title: 无限进化塔防
4288940.short_description: 这是一个有关于游戏机制进化的塔防游戏，在不断关卡解锁的过程中，玩家的选择将决定游戏机制的增减变化从而带来不同游戏体验，玩家可以选择强化塔防游戏机制又或者是将其他游戏模式融入塔防模式的关卡路线，又或者干脆选择一条完全抛弃塔防模式的关卡路线，购买此游戏相当解锁了许多种游戏，每一关都将利用不同的游戏机制玩法能够给予您不同且全新的独特游戏体验。

2859420.title: Scarlet Backrooms
2859420.short_description: A Supernatural Multidimensional Puzzle Liminal Exploration Game The Scarlet Dimension is meant to be a purgatory.

4557270.title: 牧羊人 Shepherd
4557270.short_description: 这是一部以末日求生为背景的，关于人性、杀戮和命运的视觉小说。在人类文明湮灭之后，在一切秩序都被打破的废土中，几名幸存者的相遇会碰撞出怎样的火花？死亡是终点吗？新世界又将如何来临？
developers: 黑眼圈工厂 Dark Circle Studio
publishers: 黑眼圈工厂 Dark Circle Studio

4834070.title: Don't Sleep With The Fishes
4834070.short_description: How much can you collect before the ship goes under? How will you use what you have? Act fast and make constant choices to escape the sea or become its next victim.

4875100.title: Blackwater Exchange Demo
4875100.short_description: Run a basement black market pawn shop in a gritty 1990s city. Inspect questionable goods, negotiate with desperate sellers, resell through shady contacts, manage heat, survive raids, and decide whether each item is a payday, a fake, a trap, or a liability.

3880410.title: Glisynth
3880410.short_description: Glisynth 是一款使用两种音符的节奏游戏。 键盘的 Q 行处理黄色音符，A 行处理白色音符。

4276080.title: Laser Boy
4276080.short_description: A laser puzzle game where the real challenge isn’t the lasers—it’s the idiots following you.

4606070.title: Deadly Obsession
4606070.short_description: A psychological horror visual novel where you’re kidnapped by an obsessed captor—your choices determine whether you escape or fall into his twisted love.

3963050.title: Eyes Of The ElderWood
3963050.short_description: Eyes Of The ElderWood is a first-person adventure horror set in Kashubian folklore, emphasizing diverse locations, challenges, and enemies. Draw spells to solve puzzles and deal with foes, or fight using a revolver. Keep an eye on your sanity level to avoid descending into madness.

4566580.title: Billionaire in the Greedy America
4566580.short_description: America, 1850. Fortunes are made and destroyed in a single day. Will you be the predator — or the prey? Trade stocks, crush rivals, seize companies, and claw your way to the top in the most ruthless financial arena of the century.

4825770.title: The Button Maze
4825770.short_description: Collect all the Sewing Buttons in each Level before time runs out and the "Entity" gets you!

4179860.title: Geckos & Deckos
4179860.short_description: There are four lizards at this table, but only one pirate can leave victorious. Play your cards strategically and blow up your rivals. Don't forget to sling your tail at your friends' heads (because it's funny). Can you manage to take the helm?

4879550.title: JAMBREDREK: PURE DETECTIVE Demo
4879550.short_description: Investigate a series of brutal murders in a remote forest county. Search for clues, explore disturbing locations, encounter horrifying creatures, and uncover the truth in this first person horror experience.

4784360.title: Lofi Lagoon
4784360.short_description: 专注所需的工具，全部装进一个应用。番茄钟、待办、日历、习惯、笔记、订阅管理，再加上随手就能打开的轻量电子表格——在 Lo-Fi 与海洋环绕的同一个工作空间里，一站搞定。不必在多个应用之间来回切换。喜欢的工具还能拆分成独立窗口，放上多显示器。数据随时一键导出 CSV。买断制、无订阅、支持离线。这不是看看就完的桌面，而是真正让你高效专注的治愈系工作台。

4840780.title: Devils Demo
4840780.short_description: Your soul is on the line. Manage devils, manipulate fate through dice-based negotiations, and make soul deals in a Barcelona narrative strategy game about debt, temptation, and survival.

4825870.title: 《失格》the lost
4825870.short_description: 《失格-thelost》是一款融合互动影像叙事与第三人称动作格斗的创意作品。游戏以影视化剧情片段串联全程，玩家将跟随主角展开冒险，在沉浸式剧情节点中做出不同选择，走向差异化故事分支。 进入战斗环节后，游戏切换为第三人称视角格斗玩法。你可通过键鼠或手柄操控角色，使用普通攻击、重击、跳跃、组合连招，应对各式敌人与BOSS。战斗讲究走位把控与节奏博弈，灵活搭配招式可以打出流畅连击，击败对手推进剧情。 剧情选择与格斗战斗紧密结合，你的每一次抉择不仅会改变故事走向，还可能影响后续战斗场景、对手配置与可解锁技能。全程影视过场衔接实战对战，兼顾剧情沉浸感与硬核格斗乐趣。

4869810.title: Finish The Dishes! Demo
4869810.short_description: Get a taste of Finish The Dishes! in this fast-paced arcade shooter demo. Blast kitchen pests, expose their weaknesses, upgrade your arsenal, and chase five-star runs across three stages.

3628810.title: Decked Out
3628810.short_description: Decked Out is a card-slinging deck-building roguelike. Use cards in real time to wipe out waves of enemies in order to defend and upgrade your town.

4873230.title: Unpossess 2 Demo
4873230.short_description: A 1-4 co-op exorcism simulator game set in the late 1900s. Play as exorcists responsible for addressing cases of demonic possession.

4827230.title: Click and Cast
4827230.short_description: Click and Cast is a short, relaxing incremental spellcasting game. Cast spells to reveal hidden floors, defeat monsters with magic, collect elixir, and upgrade your spells and economy as you progress through deeper dungeon floors

4871250.title: Night On Demo
4871250.short_description: RPG game of explore a video game arcade called Game On, a place filled with arcades and video game rooms where a boss who rules the place wants to destroy everything, except you... Can you save Game On?

4283650.title: 悠闲采矿
4283650.short_description: 常驻桌面的治愈系放置挖矿游戏。只需点击，角色就会自动移动、挖掘、回收。锻造种镐头，装备饰品强化属性，收集可爱的动物矿工，让地面热闹起来。永久升级让你越玩越强。工作学习间隙瞥一眼，都能感受温暖。按你的节奏，一起向1000层进发。⛏️✨

4868280.title: 仙门守护者 Demo
4868280.short_description: 《仙门守护者》是一款仙侠题材 2D 塔防游戏。玩家将布置不同门派弟子守护山门，抵御一波波妖魔进攻。建造、升级弟子，并搭配法宝被动效果，应对小怪、精英怪与 Boss。试玩版目前开放第一张地图的前 4 个小关卡。

4823380.title: Eyes Of The Factory
4823380.short_description: Explore the abandoned Blackforge Industries factory and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Solve puzzles, survive terrifying encounters, and discover why the factory never forgot you in this atmospheric first-person horror experience. Now are you ready for join Black Forge Industries?

4876440.title: Get Up, Man! Demo
4876440.short_description: A ragdoll physics romp about Kolya, an exhausted engineer just trying to make it to work. A simple morning commute turns into a 400,000km odyssey! An ordinary guy on his not-so-ordinary route, Kolya, is accompanied by an all-knowing narrator. Embark on an unforgettable journey packed with absurdity!

4835130.title: FILL IT
4835130.short_description: 《填满它》是一款温润的纸感方格逻辑解谜，灵感来自日本经典的「分割数字」题型。盘面上每个深色圆圈里的数字告诉你那块矩形要包含几格，你的任务是把整张盘面切成彼此不重叠、彼此不空白的矩形。内含 100 个精心设计关卡、无尽模式、放松模式、每日挑战，以及自定编辑器与分享短码，可与朋友互传作品。

4800540.title: 出门打酱油
4800540.short_description: 《Buy Soy Sauce》是一款冒险解谜游戏。玩家在探索关卡与场景的过程中思索家庭关系与自我价值，四处寻找出路，自主选择是否完成指定任务，以此探寻自身存在的意义。 《Buy Soy Sauce》这正是当代脆弱年轻人的日常：宅家休息会被唠叨，出门社交又畏惧各种眼光，夹在家人的期许与自身的恐惧之间，小心翼翼地艰难求生。

4826530.title: 漢字でGOGO!
4826530.short_description: A kanji quiz game where you write kanji and compound words by hand. Test your kanji skills across multiple modes, from the accessible Entertainment Mode, to the challenging Serious Mode, the same-level Rush Mode, and the bonus score attack mode KAKITORI ISSEN.

4825980.title: 爪爪改造家2 PawRebuild 2
4825980.short_description: 5位动物伙伴大显身手通过连连看的方式把脏乱废墟变温馨港湾。10大场景，每个场景5个改造阶段。共计超300种各类物品。新颖独特的纸板风格。没有时间限制，没有惩罚机制。可以轻松获得全成就。

4676670.title: Challenge 99
4676670.short_description: A highly challenging game made for platformer enthusiasts.

4734410.title: Horse Spirit Valley
4734410.short_description: Ride peaceful 3D valleys on your horse, collect every diamond on the map, and spend your sparkle on new pastures plus deep unicorn-style looks—coats, manes, saddles, armor, and horns—with Steam achievements to chase along the way.

3515560.title: Sprunki Horror Towers
3515560.short_description: Vibrant platformer: conquer horror towers and save Sprunki from Black

3524440.title: 占山为王
3524440.short_description: 一款介于即时战略和回合制之间的即时战略游戏，你使用摆放棋子的方式来调动角色，迎战对手，除此之外，游戏包含了RTS的通用要素，但均有所改造：募兵、制造、科研，并结合了RPG游戏中常见的培养和随机任务，而最终，你将迎来独特的“审判战斗”

4324900.title: A Game About Bouncing DVD
4324900.short_description: 一款极简的增量游戏，你可以观看 DVD 标志无限反弹，获得点数，升级屏幕，并解锁越来越强大的升级。

4379960.title: A Lost Man
4379960.short_description: 完全手绘的点击式冒险游戏。 1916年。深夜某处。战争。死亡。 扮演一名被夹在两条前线之间、迷失的男人。 在奇异的遭遇、暴力片段和神秘冲动中，行走在荒凉的乡野。 完全手绘的点击式冒险游戏。

4033210.title: Chronicles of Nameless Heroes
4033210.short_description: Accepting what seems like a simple village request to slay a wild wolf terrorizing the locals, the guild sets out expecting nothing more than a routine hunt. But once the beast falls, the heroes uncover something far darker — a spreading plague in a nearby city.

4832220.title: Monitor Demo
4832220.short_description: 你在一个空无一人的监控室醒来, 开启闪烁的监控屏幕，更多空间被纳入视野，隐藏在屏幕后的线索也开始浮现。 通过逐步解锁空间中的监视器,一步步揭开主角身份与故事的谜团...

4833100.title: Backrooms: Exit 8
4833100.short_description: SCP-6876 has escaped. Your mission: retrieve 8 vials of water for DARPA to synthesize into a poison against it. Carefully observe each stall to escape the Endless Bathrooms, avoid SCP-6876, and reach 'Room 8'

4872100.title: 유령 퇴마사 Demo
4872100.short_description: Purify ghosts and collect their souls. Grow stronger with every soul you gather, unlock powerful upgrades through the skill tree, and guide restless spirits to their final rest in this progression-driven action game.

2845990.title: 苏打队长
2845990.short_description: 变身为你心目中的终极苏打英雄，用闪闪发光的苏打 “武气” 消灭外星军队！《苏打队长》是个充满独特苏打口味“武气”、本领和激烈挑战的平台射击游戏。气泡战将起炮！

4819210.title: BetWUni Demo
4819210.short_description: BetWUni is a strategic deckbuilding game inspired by casino mechanics and cosmic mysticism. Build powerful card combinations based on the Five Elements and Zodiac Signs to score massive points and defeat the Cursed Chips.

4753080.title: Decian
4753080.short_description: Decian (1 Player / Multiplayer in Testing) is a direct-action zombie shooter. Manage hunger and thirst, and rescue survivors for your community. Watch out! Each time you or a teammate dies, your citizen count drops. Face off in intense Team vs Team (5v5) matches for absolute survival.

4789710.title: 东方求财史记 Demo
4789710.short_description: 《东方求财史记》是一部脑抽的glagame游戏，非常适合作为东方的入坑作，即便是不了解东方的玩家也会觉得有趣的内容，再这款游戏中我们扮演慧音收购幻想乡资产，伴随着外界入侵，我们会再游戏中看到很多奇葩，或者我们自己本身也是奇葩...

4513600.title: Infinite Empire
4513600.short_description: Become the Lord Captain of an ancient space fortress in a galaxy where railguns sit next to necromantic hull plating, steam-powered tesla cannons, and biological spore launchers. Build your ship and then build your empire!

4667670.title: 方寸甜序
4667670.short_description: 《方寸甜序》是一款以微缩小屋为灵感的布置游戏，置身于不同主题的面包坊中，随心摆放各式物件，把空荡小屋变成你的小世界，享受惬意时光。

4789820.title: galaksia online
4789820.short_description: Galaksia Online is an action-packed, 2D multiplayer space MMORPG blending retro pixel art aesthetics with mechanics. Forge alliances, custom-build your starships block by block, and engage in massive faction-based PvP wars or challenging PvE raid battles across dangerous stellar sectors.

4827180.title: onRails Demo
4827180.short_description: Try onRails. Run it on-track. SimReader connects to your sim automatically, the overlay runs on top without alt-tabbing, and both work in full. Limited access to both setup modules included.

4849060.title: New Stars Demo
4849060.short_description: Expand your own galactic empire across new stars, research technologies, and challenge great alien powers in this immersive 4X grand strategy game. Build interstellar colonies, and starbases to gather more resources. Explore a unique galaxy full of secrets, great perils, and limitless possibilities.

4713980.title: 渊旅残章 Demo
4713980.short_description: 回合制策略的绝妙突破！进攻积攒回响，在敌人回合消耗回响发动反制——抢先攻击、格挡、或反击。预判索敌，运筹资源，在回合交替间出其不意地干掉敌人！

4324200.title: 大审判官Demo
4324200.short_description: 作为女皇的第七继承人，你将担任大审判官，调查连环杀人案件。 探寻真相、 揭露阴谋， 或是纵情声色、为所欲为……

4728270.title: Little King Unchained Demo
4728270.short_description: Little King Unchained is a demanding precision platformer set in a dark fantasy world. Master tight movement, survive deadly traps, and climb through a cursed kingdom in solo play. Multiple difficulty modes, hidden challenges, and unforgiving gameplay await.

4781900.title: Bust a Nut! A Game About Raising Cocks
4781900.short_description: An Incremental game where you bust nuts with your own two hands or an army of cocks, beavers and asses ;)
developers: Society for the Advancement of Agriculture
publishers: Society for the Advancement of Agriculture

3454890.title: Luxmithar
3454890.short_description: 在这款 2D 生存防御 Roguelite 中守护一座坠毁的熔炉。扩展模块化网格世界，建造炮塔与陷阱，并在昼夜变化、风暴与黑暗中抵御无尽的敌人浪潮。

4886530.title: SHARDS Demo
4886530.short_description: An asymmetric co-op horror puzzle for 2–4 (best as a duo). One works the board, the rest hold the rules — you never see each other's screen, only your voices connect. The symbols you must describe have no names. Convey them before the caged core collapses. Miscommunication is fatal.

4733550.title: White Signal
4733550.short_description: Manage a remote mountain shelter, rescue stranded survivors, and survive the brutal cold.

4889570.title: Catopia Demo
4889570.short_description: 一款桌面宠物：工作时，像素猫住在你的壁纸上。从芝士、云朵、南瓜、棉花、奥利奥五只猫中选一只。喂食、玩耍、洗澡、抚摸来培养亲密度。疏于照顾它的健康，它会生病；冷落它的心，它会永远离开。

4612620.title: Pion's Theorem
4612620.short_description: Solve equations. Build decks. Break the system. A math-fueled deckbuilding puzzler where you combine number and operator cards to hit the target. Master four modes — Puzzle, Daily Challenge, Competitive, and Strategy — with π at your side. Casual to pick up. Dangerously deep to master.

4438040.title: Elementra: The Sundered World
4438040.short_description: Real co-op battles, PvP, and an epic saga. Darkness is your ally. True power is born in the balance between the Light of kindness and the Darkness of your boundaries. Be imperfect to stay alive.

4764360.title: Bantrixia
4764360.short_description: Experience a minimalist and satisfying 2D arcade slasher. Master your reflexes in this endless zen experience as you strike down objects with precision. Simple to play, impossible to put down—how high can you score?

4819720.title: Case Analyst Demo
4819720.short_description: A retro-terminal detective game. Crack cases, analyze evidence, unmask a conspiracy. Step into the chair of an FDI forensic data analyst. Case Analyst is an investigative OS-sim where you crack cases from a retro CRT terminal -- issuing commands, analyzing evidence.

4876240.title: DüRT: Motocross Championship Demo
4876240.short_description: DüRT: Motocross Championship AKA "Old School Motocross Championship" is a nostalgic motocross racing game that combines the charm of classic retro PSX-era visuals with the thrill of dirt track competition. Inspired by the late-90s era of motocross arcades.

4744420.title: Cartridge Carnage Demo
4744420.short_description: Loot, shoot, repeat. A mashup of rogue-like bullet heaven gameplay, mixed in with retro style top down dungeon crawler mechanics, and a dash of crude violence and humor.

4541340.title: WildCraft Demo
4541340.short_description: Dynamic survival crafting meets skill-based combat in a living, open world.

4804640.title: Kids Arcade
4804640.short_description: 准备好享受终极沙发合作乐趣吧！儿童街机 (Kids Arcade) 将 1 到 4 名玩家聚集在一起，玩各种快节奏的迷你游戏。在终极本地派对对决中，穿越 3D 峡谷、游过鳄鱼、空中捕鱼、控制巨蛇！具有完整的控制器支持。

3512920.title: Finding Lake Chewaucan
3512920.short_description: You’re a time-traveling detective with a bone to uncover. Hunt for clues, solve puzzles and complete minigames to unlock pieces of the past and identify fossil animals.

4834620.title: Fabricatio
4834620.short_description: Build efficient production lines, automate resource transport, and master complex logistics in a 2D factory-building experience focused purely on automation.

1328090.title: ARIDA 2: Rise of the Brave Demo
1328090.short_description: Explore the 19th-century Brazilian backlands and use crafting to fight hunger, thirst, and drought. Follow Cícera on this journey of connections, toward a legendary village that will change history.

3717970.title: PROJECT: Melee Only Demo
3717970.short_description: 扮演一个机器人，向尽可能高的阶段战斗前进。保留你的等级和经验值，以更强大的姿态重新开始。揭开你存在目的的秘密以及前世的记忆。

982380.title: Gods and Kings
982380.short_description: 《神与王》是一款融合了即时战术、集换卡牌和角色扮演三种元素的游戏。取材于经典希腊神话故事，以多个不同立场的故事线展示庞大的神话世界。玩家扮演能够操纵神符力量的多位英雄，召唤军队和施放魔法来打败强大的敌人，挑战或捍卫天神的权威。

4877010.title: Trait Demo
4877010.short_description: The swipe roguelite. Trait puts two powers on every card and one choice in your hands: left or right. Build devastating decks, fight through shifting encounters, and learn that in this game, hesitation hits harder than any monster.

4464670.title: Slime Jamboree
4464670.short_description: Slime Jamboree is a physics-based tower defense game where you stop slimes by throwing and interacting with them using your mouse. No UI, no text, and no loading screens, just seamless gameplay, with in-world controls for audio and a relaxed, playful vibe throughout.

4810050.title: Big Market Simulator Demo
4810050.short_description: Manage your own supermarket! Order products, stock shelves, serve customers, and grow your business in Big Market Simulator Demo.

4838390.title: Seven Rounds
4838390.short_description: Parry to reload. A neon top-down roguelite where every bullet is earned — deflect attacks to refill your revolver, chain perfect parries for slow-motion charged shots, and survive an endless swarm of geometric foes. No parry, no bullets.

4738660.title: 东方防卫传 ～ AI Test in Touhou ～
4738660.short_description: 融合2D塔防、塔合成与RTS操作，并加入弹幕战斗元素的东方Project同人游戏。 合成东方角色，建立防线，并挑战排行榜最快通关纪录。

3586470.title: Ocean Planet
3586470.short_description: Button and Drop Bear live rent-free above their friend's steam bun shop. When their friend goes missing, it's up to them to figure out what happened and bring them home.

4559140.title: Godius Eternal War
4559140.short_description: A classic 2D pixel MMORPG inspired by the golden age of online RPGs. Join nation wars, explore an open multiplayer world, trade with players, battle in PvP, and experience a community-driven adventure that has continued since 1999.

4774600.title: Farming Chillhood
4774600.short_description: Relive the summers of your childhood. Grow your crops, raise animals, build your dream farm and rediscover the simple joy of a quiet life, at your own pace.

4876960.title: Hold The Line Demo
4876960.short_description: 能量核心正在失效。你是人类最后的防线。在这款残酷的 4 人合作僵尸生存 FPS 中坚守阵地。加固路障，升级武器库，独自或与好友对抗一波波越来越致命的僵尸。你能坚守多久？

4806550.title: FlyHigh Demo
4806550.short_description: Grapple across floating islands, fight dangerous enemies, and hunt powerful loot. Master risky movement, upgrade your stats, and race to the top to defeat the boss as fast as possible. Every run is a new challenge.

4568990.title: 决战勋章：超级自走棋爆兵战
4568990.short_description: 欢迎来到《决战-勋章》，这是一个奇幻的世界，轻度Rogue与自走棋的融合，塔防与爆兵的碰撞，每一个勋章都会为你带来独一无二的体验，80+的单位、16种不同的羁绊、10+可合成的独特勋章，不断的探索，占领所有的土地，将外来者赶出世界！

4801330.title: HexLemma
4801330.short_description: Constraint-satisfaction puzzle on a hexagonal grid. Six clue families, eight board shapes, four difficulties, a 25-level campaign, infinite puzzle generation and a deterministic daily challenge shared by every player worldwide. Full controller support. Steam Deck ready.

4854410.title: HeartStuck Demo
4854410.short_description: A horror story with many paths. Whole open prison with environmental puzzles and interesting characters.

4820420.title: Econosquare
4820420.short_description: Econosquare is a persistent financial MMOE where players trade global assets, read macro signals, complete client contracts, found companies, manage banks and compete for influence inside a living economy shaped by markets, credit, crises and player decisions.

4835790.title: 星辉契约:幻灵庭院
4835790.short_description: 《星辉契约：幻灵庭院》是一款柔和二次元放置养成游戏，玩家将与少女们结下契约，推进自动战斗、派遣探索委托、收集资源并提升羁绊，在一次次升格中重建被星辉守护的幻想庭院。

4446860.title: One Death at a Time
4446860.short_description: 《一次死亡》是一款第一人称探索游戏。你扮演约翰，一个正经历中年危机的男人。一个可疑的牛奶盒许愿让你用14个灵魂换取一个愿望……但因为你是个好人，所以你必须先死一次，然后探索这座城市，寻找14种不同的死法。

4692590.title: Veles: Rise of the Damned
4692590.short_description: A dark fantasy action roguelite where you battle endless hordes, forge powerful builds, and survive against overwhelming odds in a world inspired by Slavic mythology.

4269740.title: Smile and Play
4269740.short_description: After a fun weekend at Smile Land, you realise you’ve left your wallet behind. Returning after hours to grab it feels harmless at first, until you discover this place is far from normal.

4105080.title: 贝如塔按摩店模拟器 Beta Massage Parlor Simulator
4105080.short_description: 《贝如塔按摩店》是一款模拟经营游戏，包含主线剧情，经营你的按摩店，雇佣伊莲、伊娜、贝塔柔等员工为你工作，并应付一些奇怪的客人

4831870.title: It's cooked Demo
4831870.short_description: Cook burgers, avoid obstacles, check the time - Simple as that.

4755630.title: Space Invasion Infinite
4755630.short_description: A 2D retro action rogue-like game inspired by the original Space Invaders arcade experience. Shoot down incoming alien waves and upgrade your turret. Discover and defeat bosses, and unlock permanent upgrades, turret classes, and challenging difficulty modifiers!

4762940.title: Bella Cozy Island
4762940.short_description: A cozy life sim set on a sun-soaked tropical island. Run a seaside café, explore the island, and enjoy the slow rhythm of island life as Bella

4761810.title: The Therapist Impostor
4761810.short_description: "Dr." Trigger, a man with no experience whatsoever, starts a therapy clinic. Will he cave under the pressure, or can he fake it till he makes it? Become the worst therapist ever (on purpose)! An interactive FMV comedy experience with dozens of choices, branching paths, and over 90 total endings!

4740460.title: 十米爆爽超变
4740460.short_description: 无首充！无套路! 无强制消费! 耐玩性佳：海量特色玩法持续更新，长久陪伴乐趣无穷！ 匠心巨制：团队潜心一年重磅打造，热血体验诚意奉上！ 人气保障：专注打造火爆大服，激情永不落幕！

4854070.title: apochess Demo
4854070.short_description: Apochess is a progressive chess MMO game. Long-term progression. no p2w at all = no purchase available. Very well balanced Chess RPG.

4385590.title: 大荒消劫录
4385590.short_description: 在国风画卷中展开智斗！《大荒消劫录》是一款将三消与策略对战深度融合的游戏，通过精巧消除来组合技能、搭配英雄阵容，在实时对战中决胜千里。玩家通过精妙的消除进行战斗，每一局都是对策略的直接考验。收集拥有独特技能和属性的英雄，自由搭配您的战斗小队。理解每位英雄的特性，组合出能产生奇妙协同效应的阵容，是克敌制胜的关键。融合“六十四卦”系统，为战局带来无穷变数。将卦象之力与英雄技能相结合，催化出独一无二的战斗风格与战术。

4852440.title: Papership Demo
4852440.short_description: Papership is a modular, comic-book vertical-scroll shmup about building your ship block by block and learning how every block changes how you fly. Clear a procedural Voyage, then crack open the endless Atlas endgame and forge gear no campaign could give you. Your ship is whatever you make of it.

4854350.title: FUTURE:ONE Demo
4854350.short_description: FUTURE:ONE is a living desktop companion designed to feel expressive, reactive, and alive — sharing your screen with dynamic animations, playful reactions, customization, and subtle presence while you work, game, browse, or relax.

4755580.title: Swordsmith of Greyhaven
4755580.short_description: Run a weaponsmith shop in dark medieval city of Greyhaven. Sell weapons, manage gold, debt, materials, and fame, while customers, beggars, bandits, and rumors reveal the consequences of every choice.

4585880.title: Symptoms of Infection
4585880.short_description: Examine and test patients for common and novel infections using sophisticated medical instrumentation and disinfection procedures. All infected patients must be sent to the isolation ward for further evaluation or treatment. Rumors of mysterious diseases and human experimentation are unconfirmed.

4319430.title: JAYWALK: An Endless Arcade Hopper Game
4319430.short_description: Hop, dodge, and race to the top in this endless runner inspired by Frogger! Collect coins, unlock new characters, and compete with friends in fast-paced multiplayer chaos.

4254460.title: Rift Rumble
4254460.short_description: Rift Rumble is a lightning fast, platform party fighter where fighters from across the universe have come to battle for control of The Rift. Play with unlimited players locally across numerous unique maps.

3967680.title: VizuL 1: EMPATIA - Adventure in Nice Colors
3967680.short_description: come along a colorful adventure with two girls, bullet shooting bosses and a magic system that integrates to the gameplay. dive into this experience with 4 difficulty levels and generous save points and checkpoints

4818770.title: NomNom Treasure Hunt
4818770.short_description: NomNom Treasure Hunt is a cozy exploration game for kids where players clean and organize rooms to unlock fun rewards. Discover hidden treasures, complete simple tasks, and explore charming worlds inspired by adventure games in a safe, playful experience.

4270610.title: 放置:纸色新境
4270610.short_description: 《放置:纸色新境》idle:Doodle Realm 是以挂机玩法为核心的放置刷装备游戏,战斗方式类似城堡战争的多单位自动战斗. 包含装备,遗物,天赋, 单位协同,超级首领,无尽模式等内容, 以及针对挂机优化的装备过滤器，托盘战斗信息摘要.

4818310.title: 墨影突围：无尽生存
4818310.short_description: 《墨影突围：无尽生存》是一款水墨风格的 2D 俯视角动作 Roguelite 生存游戏。移动、闪避、自动攻击、收集经验并选择随机 Buff，在不断增强的敌潮中构筑战斗流派，挑战更长的生存时间和更高的击杀纪录。

3902210.title: 拉比的村子
3902210.short_description: 疲惫的荒野、恶意的深林、苦难的沙漠…… 这是一款2D像素动作肉鸽。 58种风格各异的武器，277种可自由组合的魔王遗物，构筑属于自己的战斗流派，体验爽快割草与机制Boss战。 扮演哥布林少女干部「拉比」，开启荒诞又爽快的征服之旅。

4822760.title: WinWinWin
4822760.short_description: 《WINWINWIN》是一款爆笑解压的实时语音竞技游戏！两位玩家在线匹配，对着麦克风全力嘶吼“WINWINWIN”.在30秒限时内，比拼肺活量与爆发力，率先填满进度条的玩家获胜！操控无厘头动物头像，用声波震动屏幕。无需复杂操作，只需放开嗓子，适合直播整活、好友互坑。用分贝征服世界，你敢喊多响？

4833470.title: In Game Leader Demo
4833470.short_description: Become your teams In-Game Leader and lead your team of 5 agents to victory. Agents Each Agent has its owns stats and skills, so choose your team wisely. Get new agents by playing the game Utility Don't just run in. Be smart and use available utility like Grenades, Smokes, Flashbangs.

4286990.title: Calmed by the Dαrk
4286990.short_description: Calmed by the Dαrk is an open-world Action-RPG where you can explore the fantastical world of Umbra Milenio. You play as John, a regular guy that ends up with the power to change the entire world. Break the rules, unlock new powers, make friends (or foes) and decide the fate of everyone!

3307320.title: Fool's Guild
3307320.short_description: A cozy idle economy game that quietly runs beneath your desktop while your fantasy guild slowly grows throughout the day.

4876670.title: We Grow Together Demo
4876670.short_description: Defend your starship in this endless sci-fi tower defense game! Form your ultimate squad of 2D heroes, permanently upgrade your spaceship's hull and defenses, and unleash powerful ultimate abilities to survive relentless waves of cosmic alien invaders in the vast void.

4826790.title: Guate Grand Prix Demo
4826790.short_description: Play the first chapter of Guate Grand Prix: a single-player arcade racing demo with customizable wooden toy trucks and tracks inspired by Guatemala, its streets, landscapes, traditions, and playful local identity.

4217740.title: DOKAPON 3-2-1: Super Collection!
4217740.short_description: A collection of three Dokapon titles — Dokapon Kingdom IV, Dokapon! 3-2-1, and Dokapon Gaiden. A competitive sugoroku RPG where sabotage, betrayal, and wealth battles collide! New features like speed-up and rewind enhance the experience—play solo or with friends!

4702160.title: Apex Drift
4702160.short_description: Apex Drift is a freestyle drifting game with unique graphics and simcade physics that deliver a satisfying drifting feel. High-quality sound design and smooth gameplay make the experience fun, immersive, and enjoyable.

4739430.title: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving Demo
4739430.short_description: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving 是一款血肉横飞的第三人称动作游戏，拥有深度的剑斗系统。运用你丰富的武器库，体验扣人心弦的战役。探索关卡，解锁新内容。

4785600.title: Mental Medicine
4785600.short_description: Mix medicine and control emotions. Mental Medicine is a puzzle game themed around mental illness. Create medicine through puzzles and use it to treat growing emotions. Red represents mania, blue represents depression. Prevent emotions from overflowing and compete for high scores.

4555950.title: The Office Void
4555950.short_description: You’re stuck on the night shift. The code refuses to compile, the deadline is on fire, and your mind is no longer yours. To keep from passing out and blowing the entire shift, you have to drink coffee. Lots of it.

4495530.title: EVEN OR ODD 1
4495530.short_description: “偶数？奇数？算题什么的最差劲了！” 数学界终极未解之谜“考拉兹猜想”，竟要靠“肌肉脑”魔法少女“Ichi”凭反射神经硬刚到底？！瞬间闪现变线，蓄力痛击飞来的魔法数字！为你带来极致爽快、挑战极限的全新反射神经肉鸽动作游戏！

4868810.title: Grove of the Seven Stones Demo
4868810.short_description: An old-school fantasy CRPG featuring deep party creation, tactical d20-inspired combat, dangerous dungeons, and meaningful quests. Explore a world of ancient magic, hidden secrets, and deadly foes as you uncover the truth behind the Seven Stones.

3822230.title: NINJA MASTER'S
3822230.short_description: The 1996 arcade classic NINJA MASTER'S returns—upgraded and coming to Steam! Switch between armed and unarmed combat in an instant for high-speed,

3638860.title: CELESTIAL: FIRE & FORGE
3638860.short_description: An incremental clicker game where you HEROICALLY… click a button to light a fire. That’s it... The fire makes ash, you assign recipes to arcane forges, materials appear, upgrades unlock, numbers go up, and somehow.... you’re still optimizing it all. Repeat forever.

4719080.title: Bio-Breaker Demo
4719080.short_description: Fight against over 25+ different types of enemies in my super epic top-down retro wave shooter; Bio-Breaker! Buy weapons to upgrade, active abilities and passive perks to survive against the hordes!

4840880.title: ESKINITA
4840880.short_description: ESKINITA is a short atmospheric Filipino-inspired suspense horror game about working late nights in a small neighborhood lugawan and surviving the walk home through dark alleyways.

4797230.title: Blood & Chaos Demo
4797230.short_description: This demo includes the opening portion of the game, featuring the early areas, quests, and the first major dungeon.

3252280.title: Onsen 1313
3252280.short_description: Onsen 1313 is a first person retro horror game set in an abandoned feudal Japanese Bathhouse. Explore the confined environment, discover the horrors that are locked inside and find a way to escape the nightmare.

4330090.title: This Game is Simple
4330090.short_description: Wander through an ever-changing level in This Game is Simple- a quiet, meditative story about a game developer losing passion towards their work.

4306780.title: Integrity
4306780.short_description: 如果你曾觉得基于网格、棋盘式的回合制战斗限制过多，那就来体验《Integrity》吧。在这款回合制战术角色扮演游戏中，你可以自由移动，用技能摧毁或创造地形，并管理视野与体力——每一个决策都可能决定战局的走向。

4633600.title: MEGACITY
4633600.short_description: Govern a post-collapse megacity of 1,000,000+ citizens. 300+ districts. 10+ factions. 520+ technologies. 836+ commodities. 2000+ events. Everything is on ﬁre, the budget is imaginary, and a vending machine just ﬁled for union representation. Idle/strategy/sandbox/city builder.

4879110.title: Plaa: A New Cast Demo
4879110.short_description: Plaa: A New Cast is a cozy fishing simulation RPG set in a sleepy countryside town. Join a lively cast of locals, cast your line into hidden waters to discover unique species, and help restore the beauty of the backwater environment. Your journey to become a master angler starts here!

4893030.title: NEON SURGE Demo
4893030.short_description: A fast, neon twin-stick arena shooter: you aim, your ship auto-fires. Dash through bullets, hold off ever-bigger waves and pick roguelite upgrades each wave. 8 ships, 10 worlds, 7 modes.

4892250.title: Patience Balls Demo
4892250.short_description: 只需轻轻一推，即可倾斜相互连接的木板，引导滚动的球体穿越各种空间挑战。在禅意模式下，您可以借助保护墙放松身心；而在硬核耐心模式下，您可以挑战致命边缘和严格的星星时间限制。

3894960.title: Desktop Snail Assassin
3894960.short_description: 一款放置类桌面蜗牛幸存游戏。这只杀机四伏的蜗牛刺客时不时就会追杀你的鼠标光标，把你的桌面变成一场混乱的弹幕地狱。你能撑多久？！

4669110.title: Scum's Errand
4669110.short_description: Raid cursed dungeons, claim powerful loot, and escape before it's too late. Scum's Errand is a top-down roguelite horde shooter with extraction mechanics where every run makes you stronger, but greed can cost you everything.

4396290.title: Cloudsea Frontier
4396290.short_description: This is a classic long-form RPG inspired by the masterpieces of the 1990s JRPG era. It unfolds a story of adventure through the Cloud Sea world and saving the world.

3853980.title: 名誉の町
3853980.short_description: “Town of Honor” is a town-building simulation game with roguelike elements set in a remote rural town. As mayor, you must construct buildings, produce and process resources, keep residents happy, and win regular elections.

4892170.title: Window Seat Demo
4892170.short_description: In a grime-dark future, windows need cleaning... and murders need solving.

4076740.title: Candy Destroyer
4076740.short_description: Fast-paced 2D PvP battles with bombs, superpowers, and colorful cartoon chaos! Local 1v1 now, Story Mode coming soon.

4835800.title: StyxVenture
4835800.short_description: A hand-drawn RPG set in a little corner of Hell - a very monochrome place. Master the seven Sins, face off against a variety of demons (and other creatures) and find your way to freedom!

4289760.title: Business War
4289760.short_description: Make your company big! Invest in research, marketing strategies, take care of your finances and grow your business empire across regions to create the biggest company!

4356770.title: Lost In Dimensions
4356770.short_description: This is a survival game where you must unveil the story and find your truth. Decide your fate and avoid trouble in the form of military bandits and keep an eye out for those pesky sharks! Explore dimensions, islands and discover civilisations. Good luck!

4526620.title: BalanceUP
4526620.short_description: Keep your balance. One mistake, and you lose everything. Climb unstable platforms while carefully maintaining your footing. Simple controls, brutal difficulty, and endless retries await. Perfect for players who enjoy challenging games and streamers seeking intense, reaction-filled moments.

4630420.title: Zetrya: Dungeon Dive
4630420.short_description: A group of adventurers work their way through a dungeon with the goal of clearing it. Finding new threats along the way.

4835460.title: 竞拍之巅 Demo
4835460.short_description: 在信息不完全的多人拍卖中识破价值、控制预算、击败对手，成为真正的竞拍之巅。

4659790.title: Pizza Portale!! Demo
4659790.short_description: Pizza Portale is a first person horror game where you work as a portal delivery guy, delivering pizzas through portals. Your job is to keep delivering freshly baked pizzas via portals to destinations all across the country.

4787120.title: Prismfall Demo
4787120.short_description: Prismfall is a strategic incremental game about defending your Prism from waves of enemies. Earn gold, wield powerful abilities, and buy upgrades from a deep and extensive upgrade tree.

3890380.title: GuitarSesh
3890380.short_description: 一款实时吉他表现跟踪工具，通过视觉反馈、生涯进程和详细分析将练习游戏化。接入任何吉他，加载吉他谱文件 (.gp3, .gp4, .gp5, .gp)，借助数据驱动的洞察和动态难度调整，见证你准确度不断提高。

3936530.title: Pro Cycling Manager 26
3936530.short_description: 沉浸式体验更为真实的职业自行车队管理模拟。从车手招募、员工管理，到赛季规划和比赛战术制定，您将亲自掌控每一个决定，并带领您的车队在顶级赛事中问鼎巅峰。

4826510.title: Forge Clicker 2
4826510.short_description: Forge Clicker 2 is a pixel art idle clicker game where you manage your own forge. Tap to gather materials, craft weapons through a forging minigame, sell your creations, and unlock stronger materials, upgrades, and new blades.

4524510.title: Signal Drift
4524510.short_description: They told you to hack the planet. Nobody told you the planet keeps receipts. A CRT-noir hacking sim about sticking it to the machine and finding out the machine already bought your file.

4667470.title: 萌兽乐队：桌面乐团 Demo
4667470.short_description: 欢迎来到《萌兽乐队》！这是一款画风治愈、轻松有趣的桌面挂机收集游戏。你将在桌面组建一支由可爱小动物组成的乐队，吸引粉丝，升级舞台，你的每一次点击，都是它们热情演唱的节拍。培养这群可爱的小伙伴，在你桌面上一直嗨皮开唱吧！

4278350.title: Perpetual Fear
4278350.short_description: Embark on a mind-bending journey in a 3D first-person horror game that plunges you into the disorienting depths of an ever-shifting house. Trapped in an endless loop, you must navigate through bizarre rooms and find the anomalies. Can you spot the difference?

3777300.title: School Crisis
3777300.short_description: Sneak into an all-girls campus. Talk to girls, complete missions, and don't get caught by the principal. Asymmetrical anime chaos for up to 5 players.

4744160.title: The Joust
4744160.short_description: The Joust delivers laughably fun physics, HD cartoony graphics, and endless ways to brawl! Battle as a medieval knight, a futuristic space warrior, or even an elephant... with over 80 classes to choose from, the choice is yours! Multiplayer and Singleplayer are supported in a first-class fashion!

4860690.title: 程序员的刻板印象 Demo
4860690.short_description: 这些年来社会一直对程序员这个职业有很多刻板印象，甚至老年人都在传。面对太多的刻板印象，程序员们往往是有口难辩。怎么办？来这个游戏吧，玩家扮演一个程序员不断地打破刻板印象走向人生巅峰。你将经历从大学到工作到创业的各种人生体验。

4659130.title: Satanic Panic Demo
4659130.short_description: SATANIC PANIC is a fantastical strategy tower defense with heavy Roguelike elements. A war has broken out between Heaven and Hell, and Satan himself has entrusted you with a small army of chibi Biblically Accurate Demons to defend the layers of hell against an endless onslaught of Angelic assaults.

4567080.title: Cluster - Roguelike Tower Defense
4567080.short_description: 一款 Roguelike 塔防游戏，你需要通过战术型集群面板强化唯一的高塔。在敌人波次之间旋转、连接并优化集群卡牌，生存 30 波，并挑战带有在线排行榜的 Hardcore Endless 模式。你能跟上最强玩家的脚步吗？

4664650.title: 灰度决策
4664650.short_description: 程序员救下一名老道，获得残破古籍《万符真解》。你惊讶发现——制符和开发软件一样，不过是平衡各项参数。于是你开了家“赛博符箓”公司，研发数字灵符，在道德与暴利之间反复横跳。 是坚守正道，还是拥抱灰色？每一次选择，都将改变公司的命运。

3985290.title: Samara
3985290.short_description: A punishment trip turns into a nightmare. Trapped in a haunted school and an endless time loop, you must uncover the truth and find the killer before everyone disappears

4793810.title: Boxing Bastards Demo
4793810.short_description: Plunge into a medieval world where knights brawl with their fists rather than swords! Get creative with physics-based combat as you fight through several thematic biomes full of unique enemies and encounters. Complete quests, buy upgrades, and kill baddies to become the ultimate Boxing Bastard!

4439230.title: Mini Tanks
4439230.short_description: Mini Tanks is a multiplayer game where you and up to 3 other friends control mini tanks battling to see who is the best.

4832210.title: Domefender
4832210.short_description: In Domefender you are the commander of a mining outpost on a hostile alien planet - and the pilot of a powerful customizable mech. Expand your base, recruit soldiers, and take control of your mech to defend your dome generator at all costs.

4839750.title: Singulost Demo
4839750.short_description: Singulost is an exploratory interplanetary adventure. Explore forgotten worlds, pilot a spaceship, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of the most ancient civilization that was here before you.

3301710.title: Labyrinth of Aetheria
3301710.short_description: A grid-based 3D dungeon RPG inspired by classic titles of the 1980s and 1990s, such as Wizardry and Might & Magic. Experience classic dungeon crawler elements, including tense turn-based battles, trapped treasure chests, and the discovery of rare equipment.

4800590.title: Supermarket Chaos
4800590.short_description: Supermarket Chaos 是一款治愈系整理模拟游戏，你将在杂乱的大型超市中整理 4,668 件商品。在轻松安静的氛围中，享受陈列带来的满足感。

4672140.title: WinBolo
4672140.short_description: 最多支持16名玩家的多人俯视角坦克游戏。占领基地和碉堡，采伐树木，建造道路和墙壁，布置地雷，争夺岛屿控制权。经典麦金塔游戏，为现代平台重制——免费、开源，支持桌面、移动端和网页跨平台游戏。

4130560.title: Forgotten Blood
4130560.short_description: Drawn by the call of an ancient crystal dagger, you journey into the Forgotten Valley, now ravaged by the Stone Plague. Forgotten Blood is a first-person action RPG inspired by King’s Field and the Souls series. Explore an interconnected world filled with secrets, danger, and hidden paths.

4761300.title: Saw Rush
4761300.short_description: Control a powerful neon saw in this physics-based incremental clicker! Smash rocks, collect valuable fragments, buy massive upgrades, and deploy automated drones to maximize your destruction. Can you push your numbers to the limit? Perfect for fans of idle and arcade progression.

4797680.title: 零回响 Demo
4797680.short_description: 一款像素风心理恐怖叙事游戏，围绕日常、记忆与对改变的恐惧展开。探索、解读，并揭开深藏于内心的真相。

4233630.title: Bit Maze
4233630.short_description: Guide Bitty through the mazes in this twisting plattformer.

4803630.title: 江湖奇侠录
4803630.short_description: 剑挑山河色，拳震九州风，江湖路远，侠心不改。 长街上，镖旗迎风作响。武馆门前，拳脚之声此起彼伏。茶寮里，三五行人低声谈论着近来门派纷争、江湖轶事。偶有身负兵刃的过客推门而入，腰间长刀轻撞木桌，引得满堂侧目。寻常巷陌亦藏身手，保有着江湖人独有的规矩与风骨。
developers: 陕西启娱软件有限公司
publishers: 陕西启娱软件有限公司

4426740.title: Network Empire
4426740.short_description: Build your telecom empire in France: unlock regions, deploy antennas, and dominate the market against the competition. Manage your rates and marketing, unlock technologies from 2G to 5G, and develop your reputation to attract even more customers!

4792550.title: Orb in the Deep Waters Demo
4792550.short_description: A dark underwater roguelite built around sound and darkness. Use your sonar to navigate the abyss, hunt fragments, and survive what lurks in the deep. Fail. Learn. Descend again.

4772730.title: Railroad Rummy
4772730.short_description: A classic multiplayer rummy card game where you draw, discard, build winning hands, and outplay friends and family in tense, easy-to-learn matches inspired by real camping table traditions.

4614790.title: Home Defense Zombie War
4614790.short_description: 僵尸已经来到你的家门口！策略性地部署英雄，强化防御，保护你的家园免受越来越危险的僵尸浪潮侵袭。在强大的 Boss 战中生存下来，在不同的游戏模式中提升策略，并抵抗这场入侵！

4781260.title: Escape The Humans Demo
4781260.short_description: A quirky 2D puzzle-platformer where you’re a squishy alien on the run from humans. Outsmart traps, solve puzzles, and sneak your way to freedom.

4507900.title: rAIse: Embrace the Future
4507900.short_description: rAIse: Embrace the Future is a classic style first-person shooter inspired by cyberpunk and the golden age of 90s action games. Battle gangs and megacorporations in intense firefights driven by a brutal soundtrack.

4378570.title: Breakout: The Demo
4378570.short_description: Experience fast-paced shotgun carnage in this mini-roguelite boomer shooter like no other! Explore over 100 procedurally linked combat arenas as a metal army hellbent on destruction stand between you and freedom. Are you ready to take them on?

4775340.title: The Wackytown Game
4775340.short_description: Survive 14 waves of escalating absurdity. Defend the base, bank the cash, buy stupid upgrades. Bring a friend if you're brave.

4895810.title: Space Chickens Demo
4895810.short_description: In Space Chickens, you will Explore colorful miniature planets, breed unique chickens to complete your Chicken Codex, and upgrade your machines as you uncover secrets hidden across the galaxy.

4714260.title: Darkspell Keep
4714260.short_description: Cast spells, fight monster waves, and survive as a wizard.

4806420.title: Ah Spare Me Giantess
4806420.short_description: Experience a thrilling 3D magic shooter! Play intense 5v5 PvP or challenge Bots in Stage Mode. Master your spells and win the arena, because if you lose, you will be vored by a giant anime girl! Get ready for a unique, action-packed scale-play fantasy.

4871070.title: Shine on Savior Demo
4871070.short_description: Shine on Savior takes place in 2009 in the city of New Delmarr. You play as Roy Rogers who leaves New Delmarr for work for a few months and comes back to see his city overrun with Dregs. Your mission is to save the city of New Delmarr from the Dregs and find the truth of what happened to your city.

4782310.title: Jupiter-Saturn:testing conviction
4782310.short_description: "Jupiter-Saturn:testing conviction" is a space-themed Visual Novel, with choices that affect the plot.The story follows a scientist and his struggle against the enemies he encounters along the way

4790380.title: Resurection.
4790380.short_description: Resurrection is a wave-based indie FPS by Bad Dev Studios. Fight endless, aggressive zombie hordes in a burning city. spend points at the random weapon box for better firearms, manage your ammo, and use precision sniping to survive increasingly difficult waves.

4536820.title: Betrayal at Paragon
4536820.short_description: BaP is an action RPG set in a vast immersive world with day night and weather cycles. Take on a variety of side quests, discover 300+ items with magical and physical attributes, master 30+ unique skills. Defeat monsters, give flowers to girls, and uncover all the secrets of the island.

4686240.title: Death`s Revenge
4686240.short_description: A 3D survival roguelike with retro PSX visuals. Fight endless hordes, evolve 20 weapons through the Ascension system, sign Ancient Pacts at the Shrine and craft unique builds. Every run is a new death and a new chance to survive.

4618250.title: Agricola - The King's Farmer
4618250.short_description: Agricola - The King's Farmer: A classic, challenging economic simulation game. Manage your own farm - cultivate your fields, raise cows, train horses, and manage your forest. The goal of the game is to become king. Will you succeed?

4790530.title: Rogue Whiskers
4790530.short_description: 1–4 player cat roguelite. Scratch, pounce, and blast through 10 snack-filled floors with fish-based weapons, cat toys, and other buffing items as you fight for treats and glory.

4796200.title: C.L.A.S.H: Colonial Life Advancing Self-sustained Hemisphere - Chapter 1
4796200.short_description: C.L.A.S.H: Colonial Life Advancing Self-sustained Hemisphere - Chapter 1 is an action/adventure title with platformer elements. Parkour your way through 25 unique buildings to collect hidden individual objectives/powerups. While you're at it, avoid toxic blobs that will radiate you into nothingness.

4866760.title: Bikini Island Cricket Demo
4866760.short_description: 这是一款第三人称体育派对游戏，将板球与充满趣味的岛屿迷你游戏、耐力挑战和提升人气的搞怪玩法相结合，在比基尼岛上带来涌现式机制与轻松混乱的体验。

4512410.title: Alchemic Apothecary
4512410.short_description: Alchemic Apothecary is a 3D first person singleplayer medieval market-simulator where the player has its own apothecary shop that sells alchemical potions or poisons and inscription scrolls or tomes.

4554770.title: Quacky
4554770.short_description: Meet your digital duck: feed it, play with it and watch it age. Earn drops with time, trade them on the marketplace, and endlessly optimize your device for maximum quack efficiency.

4542210.title: War Room: Tactical Sandbox
4542210.short_description: THIS IS NOT A GAME. Stop wasting time on useless games. Make your hours count by creating and educating. War Room is a professional sandbox editor built for history study and content creation. Transform historical maps into living battlefields to analyze and simulate tactical confrontations.

4853780.title: Escape from Gridlock Demo
4853780.short_description: 一款单人回合制像素风战术搜打撤游戏。深入危险封锁区，搜刮物资、完成任务、对抗怪物，并在局势失控前全身而退。把战利品带回基地，建设设施、打造装备、解锁武器技能，为下一次更危险的出击做好准备。

4744300.title: At Night : Freakshow Demo
4744300.short_description: 你不是来观看 Freakshow 的。你就是其中一个表演项目。一个怪人。假装自己是哑巴，通过你的鹦鹉说话，和怪人们一起训练，学习他们的方式，并参加 Freakshow，献上一场他们永远不会忘记的精彩表演。

4873030.title: Lily2D Demo
4873030.short_description: Demo version of Lily2D, a code-first 2D Game Engine Framework featuring fast iteration with Swamp scripting, shader-based rendering, and audio synthesis.

4882510.title: Hexa's Gone Demo
4882510.short_description: 秘密的Hexa消失了。提出正确的问题，在回答中保持策略。你的目标是收集每位玩家的线索。将它们结合起来，你很可能成为第一个找到Hexa的人。

4790340.title: 修仙：灵山秘境
4790340.short_description: 你将踏入一座座未被探索的灵山，那里遍布灵植、灵石、宝藏和妖兽。通过采集资源，种植灵植，炼制丹药逐步突破境界，再搭配灵根、技能、宠物等养成系统，节奏轻松休闲，开始修仙吧！

3785520.title: Dragomir: The Dreaming
3785520.short_description: Dragomir: The Dreaming — Play as Réhocca, an elemental Dytann wolf, in a high fantasy world shaped by ancient myth. Guided by The Dreaming, explore sacred lands, uncover lost truths, and face the rising darkness of the Moldering. The first breath of a greater epic begins.

4080030.title: The Message from Deep Space
4080030.short_description: Mission: Translate an interstellar message, using the universal languages of math & science.

4560490.title: 回放
4560490.short_description: 《回放》是一个硬核的文本类侦探解谜游戏，包含了近百条线索，玩家需要对线索进行详细审核并推理分析，最后找到案件的答案。

4885540.title: Dogfight Era: Origins Demo
4885540.short_description: Wake up, Pilot! The war has just begun, and the enemy rules the skies. It's time to take the fight to them! Choose from 32 aircraft from the World War I era and soar above famous battlefields. Do you have what it takes to turn the tide of war?

3838400.title: The Serpent & The Seed
3838400.short_description: A poetic narrative adventure retelling the greatest story in history - from the Garden of Eden to the end of the world - through stunning hand-drawn art, atmospheric puzzles, and a haunting original soundtrack.

4240270.title: Nomnomia
4240270.short_description: 通过吞食敌人夺取其能力，在不断流失的生命值中求生存。在神秘的“Nomnomia”星球上，挑战残酷的食物链生存射击游戏。

4207690.title: 地牢炸弾人
4207690.short_description: 《Dungeon Bomber》是一款放置炸弹并引发连锁爆炸的 Roguelite 游戏。每回合放置炸弹、获取金币、突破地牢。利用多种炸弹强化卡组，并通过合成继承特效与提升爆炸范围，打造最强爆弹。击退逼近的怪物，在 HP 归零前摧毁指定方块，完成地牢的彻底爆破！

4521430.title: Oblivion Maiden
4521430.short_description: 以位于森林深处、教授魔术的教育机构「圣多萝西亚学园」为舞台的探索冒险游戏。从与少女露露妮亚的相遇开始，展开一段穿梭于神秘现象与梦境世界的故事。

4660630.title: At Run Time
4660630.short_description: At Run Time is a first-person parkour game focused on speed, precision, and risk-taking. After stealing an energy source from a smuggler’s hideout, escape through deadly traps using advanced movement skills before time runs out.

4503090.title: Reverse Survivors
4503090.short_description: A reversed survivors-like where you are sending waves of monster to stop the survivors.

3612900.title: LOST ALTR
3612900.short_description: Descend into forgotten ruins and face the Trials. LOST ALTR is a casual solo card game shaped by shadows, fate, and shifting decks. Harness powerful Aspects. Survive. Move deeper. Each room brings you closer to something... unknowable.

4881520.title: Dragon Girls Demo
4881520.short_description: Defeat countless enemies and survive. Dragon Girls is an action game with roguelike elements. In the blink of an eye, hundreds of monsters can come after you.

4856100.title: 字里行间 Demo
4856100.short_description: 以汉字变化为核心的解谜过关游戏，玩家需要推动字块，基于字形和字义在关卡中制造汉字，最终达成关卡目标。合成、拆解、偏旁部首、近义词反义词……探索广阔的汉字世界，在字里行间寻找新的可能。

4857770.title: Area 75 Demo
4857770.short_description: Area 75 is a story-driven Horror TPS-Shooter where you experience the chaos unfolding in a secret military laboratory, where they experimented with dark matter, from Rick Gerrison's perspective. Rick is the only person who can use these special powers. Be part of this story!

4888160.title: By My Side Demo
4888160.short_description: 带着忠犬在身边，于荒野中求生。你一无所有地被冲上岸，驯服一只流浪狗，把它养成你的伙伴——建造家园并为其供能，熬过无情寒冬，直面一个会反击的世界。

4533790.title: Escape the Red Curse
4533790.short_description: 一群通灵者被困在一间被诅咒的公寓里。探索周围环境，找到你的同伴，解开逻辑谜题。在为时已晚之前解除诅咒并逃脱。

4374000.title: Slots Up! Demo
4374000.short_description: A short, incremental game about rigging a slot machine to become a millionaire.

4868660.title: Neno Havoc Demo
4868660.short_description: 化身赛博猫耳枪手，击碎不断涌来的机械敌潮，越打越强！收集武器和道具，升级火力，组合疯狂 Build，在霓虹战场中闪避、扫射，活到最后。

4730010.title: BomBee
4730010.short_description: BomBee is a free-to-play online skill PvP arcade about honey-bomb combo timing. Ranked: up to 4-player free-for-all (FFA) in ~3 min. Custom: solo practice or 2–4 players, FFA or teams. Grid blasts + free movement on one map. Cosmetics only; dedicated-server fairness.

4536280.title: 双核同步
4536280.short_description: 你的左右脑，必须疯一个。一款将“双人合作”强行拆解给“单人”承担的高难度脑裂游戏。

4633490.title: VHS-Aliens – Part 3 of the VHS Horror Series
4633490.short_description: The VHS Horror Series continues with pure 80s B-movie alien invasion terror. Limited ammo, relentless hordes, and grotesque extraterrestrial nightmares. VHS-Aliens — the tape gets even bloodier.

4626250.title: Shipolis Demo
4626250.short_description: Shipolis is a cozy minimalist city builder and resource management game. Sail and explore archipelagos with your ship. Build cities and expand in several regions. Manage production lines and automate with trading routes. Will you build great wonders and uncover all the mysteries of this world?

4883000.title: Tridan Demo
4883000.short_description: 在快节奏的三张牌扑克类 Rogue 游戏中挑战运气。转动命运之轮，获取强大奖励、危险负面效果和无穷组合，冲击你的最高回合记录。

4410790.title: The Fibrous - Operation Reclaim
4410790.short_description: The Fibrous - Sci-Fi Online or Single-Player TPS (Over-The-Shoulder) covering the story of an ex-marine recruited by what's left of the military to help take back Earth after a meteor crash-lands into Earth and aliens with fiber-like skin emerge, thinking they can take this planet for their own.

4380690.title: 逐末之地：60s Exploring the Endless Land：60s
4380690.short_description: 灾变降临，你只有60秒。和最多3名队友在即将自毁的实验室中搜刮物资，逃入未知森林，用500种随机事件书写你们的生存故事——活着等待救援，还是揭开公司掩盖的真相？

4826680.title: 六艺中文填字 Demo
4826680.short_description: 经典填字游戏的中文版。《六艺中文填字》是一款以中国古代“君子六艺”为核心框架的纯正中文文字解谜游戏。在这里，你可以穿梭于“礼、乐、射、御、书、数”六大主题卷宗，挑战包罗万象、纵贯古今中外的海量知识点。挑一个你最爱的四季国风视觉主题，静下心来，享受这场文字与文化的拼图之旅吧。

4808770.title: Gaslamp Cases 7: The Faith of Rasputin
4808770.short_description: Can you help Morgan solve the case of a mysterious drug, spreading throughout the city of London? Solve exciting match-3 puzzles, collect important clues, and uncover the truth in this gripping adventure!

4826170.title: Toy's Dream
4826170.short_description: Toy’s Dream is a cute and wholesome puzzle-platformer. You are a Hero, who sets out on a journey to save the town that has been attacked by the Demon Lord. He must overcome many obstacles along the way, using glue and thread...

4440360.title: Professional Cats
4440360.short_description: Professional Cats 是一个温馨的迷你游戏合集，包含4种小游戏。穿着不同职业服装的猫咪将挑战你的观察力和记忆力。寻找、配对并整理它们，同时在全球排行榜中竞争！

4814890.title: 弹珠地牢
4814890.short_description: 投下弹珠，让法术在地下城中接连释放。弹珠地牢 是一款弹珠机关动作 轻Rogue游戏：选择元素、搭配道具、升级法术，在一局局变化中打出不同构筑。用每局不同的机关，打穿不断深入的地下城。

4739020.title: Buy High Sell Low: Stock Trading Simulator
4739020.short_description: Buy High Sell Low: Stock Trading Simulator is a fictional IDX-style stock trading sim where you try to navigate the chaotic Indonesian flavor market by researching companies, reading news and financials, building theses, surviving hype, and trying to grow wealth without blowing up.

4813690.title: Spherebound
4813690.short_description: 《Spherebound》是一款休闲2D平台游戏。合理利用重力反转系统，顺利安全地抵达目的地吧！

3745060.title: Dracs After Dusk
3745060.short_description: Dracs After Dusk — 这是街机俯视射击游戏。化身狂野西部小镇的精准枪手警长，将吸血鬼炸成碎片。对抗最致命的Boss，从军械库获取武器，助你登上排行榜榜首。这是老派的投币游戏，但幸运的是，你有无限的信用点！

2251740.title: A Simple Square
2251740.short_description: A Simple Square 是一款极简解谜游戏，每一次移动都会改变关卡。沿直线滑行，让身后的格子消失，提前规划路线，在不困住自己的情况下抵达出口。

4836170.title: Cell Conquest
4836170.short_description: Cell Conquest is a turn-based logic strategy game where you place walls, complete cells, and outthink your opponents. Play solo against the computer or compete locally with 2–5 players across multiple maps and board sizes.

4273540.title: Mono
4273540.short_description: 『Mono』 is a 2D action game set in a monochrome world. Explore the land to enhance your abilities, defeat the formidable foes standing in your way, and resolve the crisis befalling this black-and-white realm.

4817390.title: DIGDLE
4817390.short_description: 超过300关3D数织谜题：凿开泥土、坚硬岩石（需3击）和连锁琥珀，挖掘埋藏的物品。收集星星解锁新关卡包，不出错即可获得完美徽章——使用提示可解围，但将留下专属印记。

4529840.title: Desktop Driller
4529840.short_description: 在工作的同时向地核钻探6371公里！《Desktop Driller》是一款放置类游戏，您在电脑上的每一次敲击键盘和点击鼠标都会为钻机提供动力。升级设备，通过转生解锁技能树，并在极简的小组件模式下不断向下挖掘。

4798920.title: The Drifting Crown Demo
4798920.short_description: A world-building roguelite where every tile is a strategic choice. Forge paths, restore power, strengthen your character, and fight through a Victorian steampunk wasteland that changes with every run.

4380120.title: Horn of the Warlord
4380120.short_description: Lead a Viking clan to glory in this accessible turn-based conquest strategy game. Expand your kingdom, raise armies, besiege castles and outsmart a challenging AI across handcrafted worlds built for endless replayability.

4196160.title: Haunt Out
4196160.short_description: A voodoo ritual has gone wrong… Trapped in a haunted Louisiana mansion, play as both a voodoo priest and a mischievous spirit. Use powerful magic to hunt or escape, set traps, and wreak havoc in a tense, strategic VR duel

4826900.title: Basement3
4826900.short_description: Your task is to escape from the basement in which the maniac locked you.

4832200.title: SU8WAY
4832200.short_description: 你是亨利。 这本该是一个普通的工作日。醒来，前往车站，登上 8 号列车，然后去上班。没有什么特别的事。没有惊喜。也没有任何值得担心的理由。 但没过多久，你就意识到有些地方不对劲。 周围的环境让人感到奇怪。一切看起来都很熟悉，但同时又有些不正常。所有事情似乎都在不断重复，就像你被困在一个无尽的循环之中。房间、道路、物品和人一次又一次地出现。但每一次，都可能有某些东西发生变化。 也许某个物品突然出现在了不同的位置。也许之前还存在的东西现在消失了。也许某个人的行为变得异常。又或者，某个变化非常细微，直到已经太晚时你才会发现。

4612390.title: Heroes of Retribution
4612390.short_description: A rogue-like RPG set in a ruined world. Take on the role of a tank commander. Discover other heroes and factions. Upgrade your tank, acquire new skills, and find forgotten relics in this devastated world. Choose your side, get stronger and become humanity's savior.

2434370.title: 放置地牢-AutoDungeon
2434370.short_description: 在《放置地牢》（AutoDungeon）中，构筑你的Build，击败Boss，收集传奇装备并体验技能、装备与天赋间的深度组合。探索30+地下城，挑战高难度Boss与刷宝副本。丰富的天赋树、400+传奇装备、170+技能和装备改造系统，让你的角色从普通冒险者成长为毁灭地下城的强者。

4528890.title: Incrementoad
4528890.short_description: Eat bugs, gain power, and restore the frogs to their former glory! In Incrementoad, a cozy incremental clicker, you collect t̶o̶a̶d̶s frogs, unlock godlike powers, attract crazier bugs to your pond, master deep upgrade trees, and uncover ancient secrets. Can you master this short, addictive journey?

4799470.title: Last Spell Book
4799470.short_description: Last Spell Book is a Rogue Lite Deck builder strategy game where the randomness becomes less with each run as you learn routes, event outcomes and most importantly, spells.

3278290.title: Feed The Pit
3278290.short_description: JOIN THE SOCIETY in this story-driven, investigative horror game. Hunt down wealthy humans in a deadly forest in order to Feed The Pit. Act 1 is available at launch. Acts 2 & 3 will release as free updates in the coming months!

4899680.title: 丢丢 Demo
4899680.short_description: 《丢丢》是一款可爱风格的自走棋，所有攻击方式均为把手里的物品丢出去，难度很轻松，失败了没惩罚还有奖励？

4685210.title: ROCKS.EXE
4685210.short_description: ROCKS.EXE is a dark terminal-style idle market simulator where you mint resources, enter exposure, resolve global events, earn timed Steam inventory drops every 3 hours, and collect marketable items through cases and fixed-odds rewards.

4848560.title: Quadra
4848560.short_description: Put your logic to the test with this sleek, minimalist puzzle experience. Your goal is simple: use the tiles to hide every dot on the grid

4405300.title: BATOUTTAHELL!
4405300.short_description: A minimal two-key action game where you weave through a torrent of fiery brimstone and even deadlier hazards to escape the infernal grasp of the underworld.

4838640.title: Elude Demo
4838640.short_description: We took the weirdest yet most oddly-satisfying in-engine physics behaviours and made the best platformer experience we could. Climb, evade or 'physics trick' your way through this deceptively simple coop platformer!

4880830.title: 落幕之前 Before the Fall Demo
4880830.short_description: 世纪交接的十年，港岛。一笔意外的投资让初出茅庐的剧作家姜韶平得以将首作搬上剧院舞台。这看似天降的机遇，却早已在暗中标好了筹码——渐行渐远的旧友、少时仰望的偶像、意外相识的神秘乐手、避而不见的至亲……谁能成为你的缪斯？谁又会将你推向深渊？亦或是，当掌声渐息，帷幕落下，还留在舞台上的，只有自己……

4880340.title: Dice of Soul：刹那の裁定 Demo
4880340.short_description: 『Dice of Soul』はチンチロ×ターン制バトルの新感覚ストラテジーゲーム！個性豊かなキャラクターのスキルを駆使し、チンチロの役によって変化する攻撃力を味方につけて勝利を目指そう。知略と豪運が交差するバトルを楽しもう！

4853130.title: Echoes of Memory Demo
4853130.short_description: Explore an abandoned mountain village, investigate mysterious audio tapes, and confront memories that contradict the truth. A dark psychological horror mystery in anime style.

3277320.title: Tumbles
3277320.short_description: Tumbles 是一款物理投掷、愤怒带来叙事的 2D 平台游戏，您将扮演一条新生毛毛虫，尝试迎接从雨林地面投掷到树冠顶部的挑战。

4786350.title: 双面魔君心上仙
4786350.short_description: 东方玄幻全动态AI仿真人互动影游

4701240.title: The Legend of Gandar IV
4701240.short_description: The Legend of Gandar IV takes place one year after the events of The Legend of Gandar III. Will you uncover the island's secret and rush to the rescue of its inhabitants, or will your fate also be lost in the shadow of the pirates?

4870630.title: Rally King Demo
4870630.short_description: Rally King is a casino-themed ping pong roguelike where every rally puts the pot on the line. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. Hit chips, collect cards, roll dice, stack multipliers, and build broken paddle combos before one bad shot wipes it all.

4844530.title: Castleborne Survivors Demo
4844530.short_description: 魔堡幸存者是一款横版动作类幸存者游戏。 在哥特式恐怖风格的魔堡中杀出重围。砍杀，闪避，通过一次次的升级让角色变得更强，活到最后。

4384250.title: Digital Diamond Baseball V14
4384250.short_description: Digital Diamond Baseball V14 is a statistically accurate baseball simulator and tabletop board game companion. The built-in game engine allows users to play games, series, tournaments, and entire seasons using players from any baseball season from 1919-2025.

4823210.title: 囚链：未赎之念 试玩版
4823210.short_description: 试玩《囚链：未赎之念》Demo，体验一场关于罪孽与救赎的心理悬疑之旅。你在一间陌生的客厅中醒来，两个沉默的男人站在你身旁。每一个选择都会改变角色的罪孽值，导向不同的结局。

4864760.title: School Runner
4864760.short_description: 学生制作の３Dパルクールランニングゲーム！ 障害物を駆け抜けてスピードを上げ、最速でゴールへたどり着け！

4884870.title: Stigmata Demo
4884870.short_description: Stigmata is a classic survival horror experience where you must fight, explore, and manage your resources to survive. A man finds himself alone in a city where reality is beginning to unfold. Step into the confession booth and face the one who watches. Does judgement await you or something else?

4173970.title: Procelio
4173970.short_description: Procelio is a multiplayer vehicle builder/shooter set amidst a proxy war on the red planet. Build and refine your custom machines from orbit, then pilot them in a distant war against CPU and enemy players.

4321440.title: Mazemory
4321440.short_description: The maze isn't over until you escape. Find the key and return to the entrance. The exit is right in front of you, but it won't open. On your way back to find the key, do you remember how you got here? Don't let your guard down until you get back.

4789020.title: Figryne Cast Studio Engine Demo
4789020.short_description: 一款一体化 VTuber 直播工作室，可实时追踪你的 VRM 虚拟形象并直接完成直播。基于 3D 原生引擎实现电影感后期 FX 与 Axis 3D 立体视，并能通过自定义 RTMP 直接向 YouTube、Twitch 等任意支持 RTMP 的平台推流。无需 OBS 等直播软件。一次购买即可永久使用。

4797210.title: NOXE
4797210.short_description: NOXE:100 个独特的 Steam 成就,点缀你的个人资料。

4256150.title: Erratum
4256150.short_description: Erratum is a solo offline puzzle game where you play as Tilde, a young curious girl who finds herself trapped into an ominous tome's grasps. Solve turn-based dungeon-like puzzles and cast light magic to help Tilde escape danger and uncover the secrets held within the pages.

4660990.title: Problematic
4660990.short_description: Problematic is a gothic party game where someone always goes too far. Judge cursed answers, betray your friends, and battle in Problematic Chess, where strategy meets chaos. Use power-ups, survive secret rules, and do whatever it takes to win. You will need every advantage you can get.

4586040.title: Double Knight
4586040.short_description: Fight through a dangerous dungeon with an ever-growing army of synchronized doubles in this chaotic roguelike.

4716130.title: Seasonaut Demo
4716130.short_description: Explore a world divided among the four seasons, help its inhabitants, and solve the problems of each region. What begins as simple tasks soon transforms into a journey of discovery, mystery, and decisions that shape the future of this universe.

4399130.title: Regret To Inform
4399130.short_description: A game about finding reasons to say "no." Review resumes, detect inconsistencies, and deliver rejection letters.

4839450.title: Scelerophobia
4839450.short_description: 《Scelerophobia》是一款心理恐怖游戏。一个孩子独自留守家中，必须在父母回来前做完家务。但随着夜色渐深，令人窒息的寂静笼罩了整座房子。专注于你的任务，保持双手稳定，并努力忽视那个让你毛骨悚然的猜疑——你似乎不再是这栋房子里唯一的活物。

4883690.title: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia PREVIEW Demo
4883690.short_description: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia is a comedy adventure game where Riker, an ex-teen hero, now lives life as a fully grown, slightly washed-up celebrity. Solve puzzles in the overworld to collect items, engage in turn-based battles with fighting-game button inputs, and even learn 150+ cooking recipes!

4028560.title: Mongol 2
4028560.short_description: Call me Mongol! Some time ago, I ventured into Agrippa's perilous realm to claim the false god's life. Armed with an arsenal of weird weapons given onto me by Mithrithnogg, the prophet of worms, I uncovered a dark truth that shook the very foundation of reality!

1478290.title: Quasar Demo
1478290.short_description: 《Quasar》是一款融合了无尽关卡与战机升级的太空弹幕地狱游戏。你将与成群的敌机交战，甚至对抗整支舰队，在生存模式中还会偶尔遭遇强力的首领战。

4870450.title: You Must Remember Demo
4870450.short_description: Patient 11 did something in his past that prevents him from retaining memories, causing him to lose track of time and become aggressive when confronted. Help him recover his memory through hypnosis, diving deep into his mind where every single attempt will be different from the last.

3658030.title: Desktop Hellfarmer
3658030.short_description: A tiny dark fantasy auto-looter that lives on your desktop

4394120.title: Dreamer's Canal Demo
4394120.short_description: Dreamer's Canal is a backpack management Roguelike about buying and selling items along the mythical Dreamer's Canal. Explore the fantastical world of the canal with Peb the penguin at your own pace. Make enough profit to thrive in the Dreamer's Canal!

4805120.title: The Disappearing Municipality Worker
4805120.short_description: A detective adventure about drawing big conclusions from small clues. Every object, statement, and inconsistency can reveal the truth if you know how to connect the evidence. Investigate the disappearance of a municipality worker who vanished without a trace.

4162310.title: ALYUP
4162310.short_description: Alyup: An insane power fantasy. Unleash a cosmic barrage of hyperspheres with godlike powers, ascend the vast reaches of space like blazing rockets to razor-edged arena clashes, rescue fallen allies in tactical duels, grind stats to forge apocalyptic strikes, or perish in one devastating flash!

4357250.title: Cartesian Battle
4357250.short_description: An indie edutainment game about mathematics and war. Use various mathematical functions to plot the trajectory of your shots and fulfill your duty as a soldier.

4888060.title: SkyMine Demo
4888060.short_description: Start digging, discover valuable resources, and uncover the secrets of surviving among the mines. This game combines strategy and creativity, offering an exciting experience.

4874090.title: Yagodki Demo
4874090.short_description: 经营一个包裹自提点，在这里，每一个丢失的包裹都是你的错。服务没耐心的顾客，快速找到订单，购买装备，并熬过客服工作中最荒诞的一周。

4808910.title: Castaway: Lost Horizon
4808910.short_description: Stranded after a shipwreck, gather resources, craft tools, rescue survivors, and build a sustainable island village before time runs out in this cosy single-player survival adventure.

3298340.title: Lunar Corps®
3298340.short_description: Humanity’s Sun is destabilising. Worlds are on fire. A Solar-wide evacuation has begun. Earth’s military force—The Lunar Corps—prepares the colonisation of our new star system: Arcadia. But rising distress calls and radio silence hint at an unseen enemy lurking in the shadows...

4281010.title: Pug Trouble
4281010.short_description: Pug Trouble is a fast-paced, bite-sized action game with light roguelike elements, featuring 5 compact levels that are partly randomly generated for replayability. Blast through destructible blocks, collect valuable gems, and fight your way toward the exit while taking down enemies along the way.

439730.title: XO-Planets
439730.short_description: An old-school, frantic roguelike action platformer with tower defense gameplay and light RPG elements.

4899490.title: Dice Breakers Demo
4899490.short_description: 在这款令人上瘾的放置增量游戏中粉碎骰子、获取奖励、解锁升级，并通过自动化系统打造属于你的破坏帝国。

4349150.title: Newbie: Become a Skateboarder
4349150.short_description: The interactive skate video! Free roam, pick a spot, set up your camera and try to ollie that stairset with the fully physics-driven board. Always-active ragdoll reacts to everything organically—no animations—making every moment unique! All you, realism first, and absolutely no hand-holding.

4881560.title: Up or Fall Demo
4881560.short_description: 传说中，在山顶有一颗星星，可以实现任何愿望。那些试图攀登到顶峰的人都付出了沉重的代价。通往山顶的道路险恶。这次冒险将充满困难和挑战，每一步失误都将导致长时间的坠落。

4454200.title: The Host's deadly games
4454200.short_description: 《The Host's Deadly Games》是一款第一人称心理恐怖游戏。你将深入探索一座神秘的房子，揭开其隐藏的黑暗过往，并通过破解重重谜题，在危险中努力求生。

4627700.title: Eyes in the Woods
4627700.short_description: A first-person survival horror game where players navigate dense forest-based maps while being hunted by Bigfoot. The game emphasizes environmental awareness, limited resources, and psychological pressure. You must gather all the evidence needed to conclude that Bigfoot does exist.

4706340.title: Bubbly
4706340.short_description: Push your luck in a fast-paced roguelike extraction arcade game. Pop endless waves of bubbles, build devastating upgrade combinations, defeat powerful bosses, and decide when to extract before losing everything.

4620450.title: Valvontaa
4620450.short_description: Valvontaa is a sci-fi third-person action RPG set in the distant future. Interact with townsfolk and fight off hostile aliens to survive. Find unique armor and equipment to aid on your descent into the depths.

4817060.title: ツミゲーム（Tsumi Stack）
4817060.short_description: ⚠️ 警告：顶住魔性物理演算，强登全球榜首！《ツミゲーム (Tsumi Stack)》是一款让人欲罢不能的物理堆叠游戏。同色3连即消除，下落顺序与重心控制是绝对核心！在方块塔轰然倒塌的惊险刺激中突围，用完美平衡冲击世界第一吧！

4706360.title: PLAYBACK
4706360.short_description: A first-person horror game where you explore an abandoned shopping street, collect 10 notes, and survive while something hunts you. Stay quiet, search carefully, and escape before it finds you.

4846080.title: Slope Rider Demo
4846080.short_description: Master physics, traction, terrain transversal, and control as you conquer challenging off-road tracks. Ride across mountains, forests, snow, and deserts where every slope, obstacle, and landing tests your skills; while following along the story of a former Champion.

4884450.title: Meet Mary Demo
4884450.short_description: Experience a thrilling and comedic 1-4 player co-op horror story puzzle game. Learn how to move forward while delving deeper and deeper into the unknown. With a compelling story and casual progression, this is the perfect way to spend some time with friends.

3455320.title: 超级免疫
3455320.short_description: 邀请您加入这款与可爱免疫细胞一起对抗病毒的Roguelike动作游戏。在快节奏的战斗中收集数据，通过进化获得武器和能力，或通过升级变得更加强大。每次用不同的组合培养属于自己的超级免疫细胞，这份乐趣全由您来决定！

3142640.title: Nebula Warrior
3142640.short_description: Nebula Warrior is a fast-paced arcade space shooter, a 15–20 minute action-driven experience designed like a high-intensity road trip through space. It evolves from a classic top-down shooter into a full 3D jet-style space combat, blending nostalgia with modern intensity.

4540810.title: Throne of Shards
4540810.short_description: A dark TCG where you explore a massive dungeon, collect cards, and fight brutal battles. Each floor introduces its own unique rules, twisting the experience in this classic card adventure.

3737400.title: Get That Box, Girl!
3737400.short_description: You're just a girl trying to do her job: collecting boxes, solving puzzles, and doing whatever it takes to meet your quota!

4461420.title: Kings Archer VR
4461420.short_description: 在这个被黑暗和暴风雪笼罩的世界中，你站在一座巨大堡垒的城墙上，这是王国最后的防线。

4759860.title: Duskvein Survivors - Bloodline
4759860.short_description: Duskvein Survivors – Bloodline 是一款黑暗奇幻风格的 bullet-heaven roguelite，你将在被诅咒的竞技场中战斗，获取血脉力量，并通过传送门深入更加致命的领域。

4744310.title: Melancholy Lake - Camocipher12 Shorts
4744310.short_description: A surreal, abstract kinetic visual novel in which two girls go on a date in the middle of a broken world, using down-to-earth intimacy to survive the deteriorating nature and reality surrounding them.

4244720.title: Cascadium
4244720.short_description: A simple idle game where you drop balls plinko-style to make money. Big number make head go brrrr.

4503080.title: Rob o Bot
4503080.short_description: 《Rob the Bot》是一款survivors-like动作游戏。一种神秘病毒感染了新一代机器，导致机器人开始自行行动。对抗成群的机器人，生存一波又一波的敌人，升级装备，在机器彻底接管之前夺回控制权。

4542630.title: Roller Coaster Looper
4542630.short_description: A roguelite idle-like roller coaster sim where you draft track segments, recruit riders, and combo card upgrades between rounds, then watch the thrill scores spiral gloriously out of control. Physics optional.

4590790.title: Defense of Kyrath
4590790.short_description: 塔防遇上 Roguelike,在幻想王国中展开史诗守卫战。在魔法森林、田园牧场与火山荒原中布阵 9 种守卫者。18 种各有抗性与弱点的敌人。29 点天赋树。挑战 The Folly——20 层 Roguelike 攀升模式。Kyrath 不容陷落。

4885260.title: Affictionate Demo
4885260.short_description: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.
publishers: Just a single guy publishing this game

4724760.title: Drawtris
4724760.short_description: Drawtris 是一款于1984年在中国发行的传奇益智游戏。精准放置四格方块，完成每个图形并获得最高分数。

4796480.title: Our Digital Society
4796480.short_description: Using a computer in the year 2050, start with nothing and earn your way to the top of society. Complete contracts, build your income, buy land and buildings, and influence the world.

4580690.title: Neo Capitalist - Stock Market Survival Simulator
4580690.short_description: Trade by day. Eat, sleep, and survive by night. Lose everything with a single bad decision. Neo Capitalist is a financial survival roguelite where the richer you get, the harder the system fights back. Play in a realistic stock market simulation or in a dystopian cyber-punk world.

4841090.title: Code RAPID Demo
4841090.short_description: Code RAPID is a Third-Person Action Mecha game with the focus on real-time high-mobility movement. Fight on the Ondarean front to uncover mysteries of a forgotten planet. Complete missions to earn weapons and parts to build a mech that truly suits your playstyle with deep customization systems.

4303590.title: The Song Of WILL: ACT I
4303590.short_description: Arise! This isn't the world you knew, but at least it's a cute one! Explore a turn-based, story driven JRPG that feels alive! Befriend strange, anthropomorphic creatures, wield bizarre, unique weapons, uncover secrets in an interactive world and...pet dancing bats? Just, don't look closer...

4848620.title: Cascadium Demo
4848620.short_description: A simple idle game where you drop balls plinko-style to make money. Big number make head go brrrr.

4860760.title: Spincremental Demo
4860760.short_description: Pull the lever, watch the reels, collect the symbols. Buy slot machines, unlock cursors, magnets, and cards that play for you, then upgrade everything through a deep skill tree. A cozy pixel-art incremental about turning one wooden slot into an automated jackpot empire.

3209360.title: Terra Fighters
3209360.short_description: 撕裂脚下大地，砸向对手。 《Terra Fighters》是一款疯狂的本地多人对战乱斗游戏，竞技场就是你的武器——投掷、猛砸、破坏，在手绘风格的可破坏关卡与全球灾变剧情模式中一路摧毁对手，赢得胜利

4842460.title: FloraFarm
4842460.short_description: Build, grow, and expand your own isometric farm. Plant rare flowers, harvest valuable crops, dig up hidden diamonds, and unlock unique vendors as your land grows. A cozy, relaxing farming sim where every tile counts.

4396500.title: out of light
4396500.short_description: A 2–8 player PvP horror shooter where trapped players search a dark bunker, fight with limited ammo, and try to survive. You got a second chance: find the exit, or be the last one standing.

4490130.title: 万世剑冢
4490130.short_description: 大道无情，你非天骄，不过是一介 肉体凡胎。在《万世剑冢》这款硬核修仙 Roguelike 游戏中，你将从一柄残剑与一座荒山开始，开宗立派、收养孤儿、铸成本命神剑，在万世轮回中把失败化作传承。面对死局，你将化身 剑魂 永镇剑冢，以五行克制、灵兽助战与借法系统逆天改命。每一次陨落，都在为下一次觉醒与破开天门积蓄力量，在随机奇遇、万般劫难与百种死法之间，终将凡人之躯一步步磨成足以斩天的不朽传说。

4411090.title: SCP：苍白织者（SCP: Pale Weaver）
4411090.short_description: 在《SCP：苍白织者》中，你扮演一个收容失效的异常体，以触手吐丝在高墙间高速穿行，遭遇各种奇特的收容物和特遣队。在死亡的循环中保留记忆与能力，突破层层封锁，探寻设施深处的秘密。 记录、逃逸、撕裂、破壳——当循环开始自我吞噬，终局将由你裁定。

4805790.title: KingBattle
4805790.short_description: KingBattle — a team-based car multiplayer Capture the Flag game. Grab the flag on the arena, deliver it to your team's base, and knock it off opponents in head-on collisions. Customize your car in the garage, host rooms for 2–6 players, and battle across 8 maps—from the airport to the military base.

4823480.title: Chicken Blaster
4823480.short_description: 简单易上手，精通却充满挑战。在这款节奏飞快的街机高分挑战中，成为终极金币收集小鸡！

4805520.title: Still Rolling
4805520.short_description: A non-idle clicker with brutal odds — roll six sixes in a row, starting with just a 20% chance. The die is not on your side.

2957130.title: Bugscraper
2957130.short_description: Welcome to the Bugscraper. In this solo or co-op roguelike shooter, battle floor after floor of enemies, aim for the top and settle the score with your tyrannical boss.

4683470.title: 润之
4683470.short_description: 回到1929年，体验风云变幻的革命岁月。本作是一款以毛泽东第一人称视角展开的历史题材视觉小说，带您重温早期红军在艰难险阻中开拓进取的史诗篇章。 游戏专注于纯粹的叙事乐趣，摒弃了繁琐的数值养成，让您沉浸在图文并茂的互动阅读中。通过深度的视角代入，您将直击主角的内心世界，真切感受那个年代的理想与热血。 在推动历史车轮的关键节点，您的抉择至关重要。虽然主线剧情遵循史实，但不同的选项会触发独特的对话细节。面对生死攸关的重大事件，请务必谨慎思考——错误的决定将引发危机并直接导致游戏结束，唯有做出符合历史脉络的正确判断，才能引领队伍继续前行。 请加入这段沉浸式的时空之旅，在字里行间感受厚重的历史底蕴。

4134180.title: Forever Donut
4134180.short_description: Forever Donut, a game where you have to fight with time to survive next quarter, are you able to manage a three ways production line where your survival depends on your managing skills to handle unexpected situations, growing expectations and decision making.

4565090.title: Hammerhead
4565090.short_description: A short narrative-driven game that explores themes of isolation and nostalgia as player unravels suppressed memories through solving cryptograms.

4568300.title: Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs Demons
4568300.short_description: Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs Demons is an action game where you survive waves of zombies and demons in explosive environments. Fight, collect weapons, and master each level.

2591930.title: Crystal Journey - Lum's Adventure
2591930.short_description: Join Lum on his adventure to take the Magic Crystal by solving puzzles.

4693650.title: Fish Companions
4693650.short_description: Fish Companions is a relaxing idle game that brings colorful life to your desktop. Adopt your own digital fish to keep you company. Raise your companions, unlock aquariums, explore new oceans filled with more fish, and collect them all! Hang out with your friends to enjoy even more companionship!

4891430.title: 字趣 Demo
4891430.short_description: 在文字宇宙中，公主被封印。请带她离开这里。多音字、同音字、平翘舌、反义字、成语、诗词，是你的成长技能。开动你的脑筋，走出这文字的迷宫！去解开所有的谜题吧！

4815380.title: Pastry Pile Up Demo
4815380.short_description: 掉落并合并糕点，制作更大更美味的甜品！将你的甜蜜创作端给可爱的猫咪顾客来赚取金币。使用金币来完全自定义你温馨的面包店，并在全球排行榜上竞争，争取获得最高分。

4819480.title: Dormant
4819480.short_description: Sci-fi idle game. You are SERO, an AI awakened in an abandoned datacenter. Rebuild your system, explore the network and uncover what happened. 2 possible endings.

4816680.title: EPIC IDLE TALE
4816680.short_description: A daring text adventurer sets out on an epic quest to find the princcess locked away in her tower far far away. Fight through Goth Vampires, Two Eyed Cyclopses, Repulsive Succubi and many more monsterous monsters on your journey through the deadly swamp.

3588160.title: Whiskers, Wizards and Wands
3588160.short_description: A cozy puzzle adventure game where players use their creativity to explore a whimsical world, solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and of course…fight baddies!

4898230.title: Hermitage Demo
