4898230.short_description: A first-person survival-horror game about grief, set in the rain-drowned forests of Jharkhand, India — where every day you survive deforms you a little further.

4703660.title: 100 Second Soup Maker
4703660.short_description: Make a delicious chaos hot pot in 100 seconds! A realistic hot pot simulator! Simmer, season, and add soup to create the perfect dish! With over 700 ingredients and seasonings—including natto, venison, foie gras, potato chips, and cream puffs! Making this in real life might actually taste amazing...

2161230.title: Grapple Gunners
2161230.short_description: Swing, shoot and explode your friends in this chaotic multiplayer experience! Use the grappling hook to outmaneuver and outlast everyone. Grab a weapon and fight to be the last one standing across 70 unique maps!

4149910.title: Guildamation
4149910.short_description: 像素风放置RPG，打造英雄公会，制作装备并通过战斗指令指挥他们。

4660640.title: Blue Oath
4660640.short_description: Blue Oath is a solo combat action-adventure game in which you play as a warrior swordfish who sets out on a journey to free a giant, cursed moray eel. Using powerful dash attacks, you can impale enemies and objects onto your beak, stack them, and throw them back as weapons or tools.

4692720.title: 石碑
4692720.short_description: 石碑是一款3d等距视角开放探索解谜游戏。你降临在未知的岛屿上，探索遗迹，感受世界，追寻秘密，解救被困在远古谜题中的精灵，方能开启石碑离开此地。

4766590.title: 哈坦加计划_1989_增量版
4766590.short_description: Project Khatanga 1989 is a retro economic simulation game about buying, storing, tracking, and selling goods across volatile international markets. Manage limited storage, compare currencies, watch shifting prices, and decide when to hold or sell.

4590980.title: Doctor Pigeon Simulator
4590980.short_description: This isn't a normal ER. What's going on here, why are you pooping in the hallway?! I'll attend to the patient having a heart attack. Oh no, the exploding uncle! Stay away from my bed. I don't think I can manage this ER...

3798920.title: Boby and the Witch
3798920.short_description: 波比的女友被女巫绑架了——穿越3个世界和18个关卡去救她。你能5分钟内通关吗？

4850310.title: All Fours in Ashes Demo
4850310.short_description: A folk-horror card roguelike. Play the colonial dead at All Fours, a real nineteenth-century trick-taking game. Win the hand to put a restless soul to rest. Your candle is your life: bid bold to keep it lit, draft ghostly charms, and descend through the deepening cold.

4788780.title: Eyes Like the Tide
4788780.short_description: A visual novel based on Brazil's most iconic 19th-century novel. Follow Capitu from adolescence to adulthood and choose where your heart leads. Bentinho or Escobar? Loyalty or freedom? The ending is yours to decide.

4831500.title: Omnitrend's Universe
4831500.short_description: Re-released after almost 50 years, turn back the clock to 1983 and play the most complex starship simulator of its time. Featuring intelligent enemy ships and control of on-board facilities: computers, high-resolution scanners, weapons, ore processors, shuttles, rescue pods, and more.

4627710.title: Night On
4627710.short_description: RPG game of explore a video game arcade called Game On, a place filled with arcades and video game rooms where a boss who rules the place wants to destroy everything, except you... Can you save Game On?

1893390.title: Cloudsea
1893390.short_description: Cloudsea 是一款以 Cloudsea世界的云端为背景的小型独立动作冒险游戏。乘坐飞艇探索云海的漂浮岛屿，解决任务，收集资源，制作物品，交易，并在飞艇间和近身战斗中战斗！

4879970.title: Three Days, No Words Demo
4879970.short_description: A short cozy visual novel about awkward conversations, cultural barriers, and the connections that can emerge when two people don't speak the same language.

4858760.title: Dark Workshop Simulator Demo
4858760.short_description: Dark Workshop is a first-person dark fantasy shop sim. Buy from shady suppliers, craft potions and weapons, set your prices, and sell to orcs, plague doctors, and mercenaries. World events reshape the market - read the signs, prepare during rumors, and profit when chaos hits.

3791770.title: 星詠みのアルケミスト ~Stardust & Shenanigans~
3791770.short_description: 独一无二、真正“懂得欣赏”你作品的炼金模拟器，闪亮登场！ 厌倦了枯燥的跑腿任务？辛辛苦苦为烦恼的NPC制作出完美道具，得到的反馈却和随便应付的残次品一模一样——你曾对此感到失落吗？ 在《星咏炼金术士》中，通过超前沿（！？）的实时AI生成系统，无论是委托内容、道具描述，还是NPC对你作品的评价，甚至关于你出售商品的头条新闻，全都会充满个性地为你量身生成！ 现在就来，与充满烦恼的居民们共同编织出只属于你的独特故事吧！

4186870.title: Beso's Shawarma
4186870.short_description: Beso's Shawarma is a short, narrative-driven horror game. A late-night call lures you on a surreal journey through empty streets to a sketchy shawarma shop. Talk to a cast of strange characters, make a terrifying choice, and try to escape a disjointed, looping nightmare.

4845610.title: What The Cluck Demo
4845610.short_description: 射出鸡蛋。鸡蛋爆炸。你向上飞。整个计划就这么简单。一款 Foddian 风格的精准平台跳跃游戏，讲述一只母鸡和它被偷走的金蛋。

4377720.title: Rahasya:The unsolved mystery Demo
4377720.short_description: RAHASYA is a first-person horror mystery game where you investigate supernatural events, uncover hidden clues, and complete dangerous objectives.

4437210.title: COLOR FROG
4437210.short_description: 2D action game where you jump and switch between red and blue to survive.

4840250.title: Stellar Stranded
4840250.short_description: Stranded on an uncharted planet after a failed mission, Lyra must find a way to escape. But she isn't alone. A hostile alien race is occupying the world to harvest its resources. Avoid their patrols, use the environment to your advantage, and guide Lyra safely home.

4809810.title: Perihelion: Rogue Orbit
4809810.short_description: Fit a ship, read the angle, and null your transversal for the high-alpha hit. Perihelion: Rogue Orbit is a 2D space combat roguelite about range control, tracking, and making your build work under pressure.

4792230.title: 比比丟八 BIBI DICE
4792230.short_description: 掷出 8 颗骰子，凑牌型、叠倍率、收集遗物，在短节奏的回合中击败敌人的桌面竖屏骰子构筑 Roguelite。

4875260.title: Accept or Reject Demo
4875260.short_description: Review hundreds of bizarre dating profiles, play mini-games, survive office drama, and try to romance your boss in this dating app management comedy.

4591490.title: Fun Road
4591490.short_description: FUN ROAD is a cooperative off-road adventure for two players. One drives the car, the other helps with navigation, and together you try to reach the finish line through slopes, rocks, forest, and complete physics chaos.

4842420.title: 纸面大作战
4842420.short_description: 格子纸上的信手涂鸦竟然活了过来，拿上武器，与邪恶的灰尘污渍来一场酣畅淋漓的战斗吧！

4814110.title: Rifted Worlds Demo
4814110.short_description: A fast-paced Action-RPG that takes place on the floating remnants of destroyed worlds. Discover fragments of your lost world, place them onto the map, and explore! It's time to uncover the truth behind your world's destruction...

4838280.title: Captain Galactic
4838280.short_description: Captain Galactic is a colorful retro sci-fi platformer where you ride a hoverboard through strange alien worlds, collect crystals, unlock abilities and items, dodge deadly traps, and blast enemies with your phaser.

4655910.title: Keep It Rolling
4655910.short_description: Roll the dice and match the cards in Keep It Rolling! Test your luck and strategy as you build winnings, manage risks, and push your luck in this exciting casino style card and dice game.

4592120.title: Bravest!
4592120.short_description: The “Braveast” series—a retro RPG from the feature phone era—and its landmark first installment!

4367310.title: Sugar Orbit
4367310.short_description: A platformer where you play a gummibear jumping between planets to rescue lost gummies, playable at your own pace but built for speedrunners and perfect runs.

4384730.title: Blazeo
4384730.short_description: Hell's failed Eden must burn. As Lucifer's right hand, tear through endless hordes of grotesque mistakes. Grow stronger, spread fire, erase your master's shame.

4128450.title: 回到明朝升升官
4128450.short_description: 融合了《Luck be a Landlord》爽快肉鸽卡牌结算的明朝官场升官模拟器。

4668620.title: Still Open: Taskbar Cafe Idle
4668620.short_description: A cozy cafe living on your taskbar! "Still Open" is a peaceful idle game that runs in the background while you work. With an atmosphere that changes based on your system time, 60+ upgrades, mini-games, and built-in Pomodoro/Project Tracking tools, turn your productivity into a coffee break.

4616840.title: Desk Space: Idle Spacefleet clicker
4616840.short_description: 在这款放置类太空游戏中壮大你的舰队。开采小行星、与空间站进行贸易、解锁升级赚取更多财富、部署海盗，甚至解锁[数据删除]。把它固定在桌面上，一边做着“更重要”的事，一边看着你的商业帝国日益壮大。

3877520.title: Thief's Adventure
3877520.short_description: A real-time tactical stealth game set in a gritty medieval fantasy world. Sneak, loot, and ambush your enemies. Being spotted means death.

4895100.title: Stewart The Fox: Swing it! Demo
4895100.short_description: Master swinging, walljumps, and momentum based movement across 3 handcrafted maps. Improve your personal bests, race against ghosts, and experience a taste of the full game featuring 15+ maps, global leaderboards, clothing unlocks, and more.

4166050.title: InfinityMine
4166050.short_description: No enemies—debt and a volatile ore market are your true foes. Mine a dungeon that changes every day. Drop to 0 HP and you lose the day’s mined ore. Upgrade tools, manage carry limits, time sales, and descend to the deepest layer.

4890200.title: KOKO Dungeon Mania Demo
4890200.short_description: KOKO Dungeon Mania is a dungeon crawler adventure where you explore mysterious chambers, solve puzzles, battle monsters, and uncover the path forward. Each new level expands the dungeon with more chambers, tougher enemies, and greater challenges to overcome.

4629380.title: Boundary of Reason -Iris-
4629380.short_description: 这是一款2D暗黑奇幻动作肉鸽游戏。扮演被流放的前女骑士“艾丽斯”，运用丰富武器与魔法歼灭无尽的敌群。通过“精准闪避”逆转战局，并时刻管理隐藏的“腐化度”。是以理智为代价换取毁灭性的力量，还是坚守骑士的骄傲？掌控战局与自身的欲望，完成血染的复仇吧。

2574300.title: A Beginning
2574300.short_description: 2D sidescrolling platformer about rescuing Toys from a doomed space colony while fighting an evolving monster. Customize your character, dive into deep lore, and master new abilities and systems to survive the end of the world.

4618830.title: 孤岛的动物园
4618830.short_description: 在一个与世隔绝的岛屿上。光能转化的电能是岛屿唯一的能源。看似无尽的光能让岛民的基础设施和科技从未陷入麻烦，这让人们相信了这一切都是取之不尽用之不竭，故而对光能产生了近乎宗教狂热般的崇拜，直到一切走向尽头。岛上另外一些人更早的意识到了问题即将到来，他们应对这一切的方式则是截然不同。

4488590.title: Turbo Hatchback Time Attack
4488590.short_description: It's you against the clock in this arcade racing throwback with in-air control and tight drifting mechanics. Keep the turbo charged as you perform flips, seek shortcuts and avoid obstacles to boost your way to the top of the leaderboards!

4845890.title: Witch Hunt 0 Demo
4845890.short_description: 《Witch Hunt 0》是一款以魔法为核心的“箱庭×首领连战（Boss Rush）”3D动作游戏。 主角魔女“阿斯特拉（Astera）”为了夺回失去的力量，将通过编织魔法、收服敌人为眷属（同伴），去击败前方伫立的强敌。

4707550.title: Unholy Employer Simulator
4707550.short_description: A roguelike, incremental business-sim where you cultivate a family environment, make BIG profit and sacrifice the lives of your employees to the devil. Welcome to the world of business.

4824940.title: 星途
4824940.short_description: 《星途》是一款剧情驱动的单人视觉小说游戏。玩家将扮演“守护者”，在充满危机的世界中与多位性格迥异的伙伴相遇。游戏采用经典的文本点击交互玩法，你将陪伴她们解决各自的困境，凝聚彼此的力量，共同迎接终极挑战。游戏包含全原创的游戏音乐，各类动听细腻的独立曲目将完美契合剧情的高低起伏，为你带来沉浸式的视听体验。

4825270.title: Crane Game Master
4825270.short_description: Can you become the true "Claw Machine Master"? Conquer various machines and grab those prizes! ...Short on cash to play? Time to work and earn it! Dump every single penny you make right back into the machines! Aim for the top, Claw Machine Master!

4699490.title: Invaders Loop
4699490.short_description: 在融合了经典街机精神和 Roguelite 机制的《入侵者循环》中，你需要抵御从太空深处倾泻而下的无情敌人浪潮，躲避子弹，从市场购买各种物品，并击败史诗级 Boss。

4851140.title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Blackberry
4851140.short_description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful blackberry mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

4646260.title: GolFall: Make Your Way Up
4646260.short_description: 挥杆、坠落，然后重来！这是一款高难度高尔夫动作游戏，你需要精准落在平台上，向顶点进发。掉下去就得重来……但可使用次数有限的“重打”！落到平台上可恢复重打次数。独自默默攀登，或与伙伴合作，向遥远的顶点进发！

4844130.title: Slightly Burnt: A Goose Story
4844130.short_description: Work as a team to run the whimsical swamp café in this couch co-op cooking game. Prepare, cut, and bake the right ingredients before time runs out! The frog must be fed... But will the nefarious goose interrupt your baking?​

4808760.title: Free Loop Tower Defense 人生是旷野塔防 FLTD
4808760.short_description: 没有固定路线，随心建造。用防御塔和路障逼迫怪物绕路，设计死亡迷宫。看似休闲实则硬核。35+5波，100项成就，全球排行榜——仅售$2.99。

4609800.title: Influencer Solitaire
4609800.short_description: Play your cards and dice well to become an influencer! Start as nobody and choose your actions wisely to climb up the influence ladder.

4763210.title: Papership
4763210.short_description: Papership is a modular, comic-book vertical-scroll shmup about building your ship block by block and learning how every block changes how you fly. Clear a procedural Voyage, then crack open the endless Atlas endgame and forge gear no campaign could give you. Your ship is whatever you make of it.

3553630.title: Indigo's Dreams
3553630.short_description: A mixed-media video game of a Wonderland. Play as Indigo, a young girl trying to find her way back home after her dreams take her to a land unknown. Traverse through abandoned beaches, hidden forests, a cloud town, and more. Discover newfound purpose along your way.

4603750.title: Indomitus: Path of Ordeals
4603750.short_description: 扮演不屈的英雄，直面无尽考验。'Indomitus' 是一款2D像素风肉鸽编组卡牌游戏。在实时自动战斗中使用卡牌，通过升级选择强力特质，并利用独特遗物打造协同效应。用你的战术克服重重磨难，高风险策略与深度成长等你来体验。

4849020.title: Splatapult
4849020.short_description: 瞄准、蓄力、发射牲畜！在华丽的物理混乱中见证城堡崩塌。击落塔楼上的弓箭手、击败大魔法师，顺便“解救”公主。利用地图编辑器打造自定义攻城战，并在Steam创意工坊上分享。支持2-4人联机合作与PvP对战！

3700130.title: TELLURICENE
3700130.short_description: Love is deception, germinated in desperation. Fill the role of one of the nation's top researchers. You will have 10 days to study the rapidly spreading and mysterious new species to decide: friend or foe? The coming Telluricene rests in your hands.

4797530.title: 4to7
4797530.short_description: A casual, slower-paced block-falling puzzle. Quick reflexes or agility are never required. Your choices, your prepared plans, and unyielding fate are the only things that dictate the shape of this game.

4501120.title: 天狗花牌
4501120.short_description: 《天狗花牌》是一款以日本花札为核心的 Roguelike 策略卡牌游戏，通过不断叠高小判与倍率来推动得分。你在试炼中出牌凑役、突破目标分数，再用金币进入神社商店购置天狗牌与星宿升级，为整月贴御札、抽御神签试手气，并向钱箱奉纳换取永久成长。还可净盆删牌、绘马加牌，搭配上百张妖怪天狗牌与不同角色，每一局都能走出截然不同的构筑路线。

4885950.title: 村庄幸存者 Demo
4885950.short_description: 拿出锅碗瓢盆，守护家园！《村庄幸存者》是一款轻松搞笑的类幸存者（逆弹幕）游戏。化身守护家园的村民，拿起碗、花盆、平底锅等生活用品当武器，一路升级，扫荡大军！

4359760.title: bōnin
4359760.short_description: Battle your friends in this exciting PvP sudoku showdown! Run around nature-themed puzzle boards while avoiding dangerous pencil projectiles, making good use of power-ups, and, most importantly, fill in the missing numbers faster than your opponent.

4387980.title: Slime Simulator Demo
4387980.short_description: 你需要获取食物来生存，你可以变成被你猎杀的动物。

4386380.title: 3 Sheep Puzzle
4386380.short_description: 《三只羊拼图》是一款2D推箱子式逻辑游戏，支持远程操控。引导牧羊犬穿过羊圈，完成每个关卡。游戏风格简约轻松，极具挑战性，非常适合思维敏捷、渴望考验自己创造力的玩家。

4887590.title: The Hope Incident Demo
4887590.short_description: In The Hope Incident, you take on the role of a nighttime supermarket employee. What starts as a regular shift quickly turns into a terrifying test of your skills. Serve suspicious customers, deal with the devastating effects of underground anomalies, and uncover the mysteries of GSO-7.

4744280.title: Tiny Wilds Simulator
4744280.short_description: 观察一个由植物与动物共同生活的小小野生生态系统。草食动物吃草和树叶，肉食动物追捕猎物，植物散播种子并再次生长。不要直接支配世界，而是见证生命的流动。

4582260.title: Two Voices: A Journey Through the MET with Rin and Mio
4582260.short_description: Explore 200+ masterpieces from the MET with Rin (music lover) and Mio (art geek). Solve 1-min puzzles to unlock artworks in chronological order. Learn art history through their emotional journey. Perfect for a "virtual trip" or pre-travel guide. Discover where sound and color become one.

4520990.title: ZipRush: Surf the Void
4520990.short_description: A high-speed VR parkour racing game across walls and ceilings. Build and share tracks, discover impossible shortcuts, and race for the fastest line.

4869520.title: Maul Tactics Demo
4869520.short_description: A maze tower defense where you build the path enemies are forced to walk, not a fixed track. Forge kill-corridors with 15 bespoke races and branching upgrades. Climb a solo Gauntlet of AI rivals, outlast endless waves, or duel a friend 1v1 online.

4879570.title: MORTU Demo
4879570.short_description: 一款关于汤姆（Tom）的心理恐怖游戏。他被内疚感以及决定了其一生的创伤性事件所吞噬。由于无法摆脱过去的阴影，他发现自己陷入了一个愈发令人不安的噩梦之中。

4854570.title: PAGANS Demo
4854570.short_description: PAGANS is a dark-fantasy strategy card game inspired by Slavic mythology. Build a deck of gods, spirits, curses, and warriors, then fight short tactical PvE battles by controlling mystical locations and chaining powerful card synergies.

4894480.title: Speff Demo
4894480.short_description: Run, jump, and THINK your way through a series of grisly obstacles and diabolical puzzles. 20 Levels across 5 hubs with a range of hand drawn environments.

4860860.title: Viral Infection Demo
4860860.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in an abandoned hospital. Explore dark corridors, face unpredictable jump scares, and uncover the origin of a deadly infection—before you become its next victim.

4279450.title: Next Star Demo
4279450.short_description: Idol Talent Show Simulation Game-Train from zero to idol debut! Rank high to stay in! Explore the map, manage your schedule and play mini-games.Face tough evaluations,compete with fellow trainees, and forge meaningful bonds. Your choices will unlock 10+ unique endings. Can you shine?

3841850.title: 玩个Gui 2:天脊之下 Demo
3841850.short_description: 建造复杂的轨道网络，部署并强化独特的战斗列车，利用炮塔附魔构筑移动堡垒，抵御来自地壳深处的无尽怪形。每一次布局都是智慧的博弈，每一次调整都关乎防线的存亡。

4607920.title: 麻吉骑士 Magic Knights
4607920.short_description: 《Magic Knights》是一款无限回合制 Roguelike 动作游戏。玩家将扮演勇敢的骑士，深入危机四伏的幻想地下世界，在一轮又一轮战斗中击退怪物、收集装备、获得随机升级，并逐渐形成独特的战斗流派。每一次冒险都会出现不同的敌人、奖励和成长路线，你需要根据当前局势选择武器、强化属性、调整策略，在不断失败和重新挑战中突破极限。随着战斗推进，敌人会越来越危险，选择也会越来越关键，只有合理搭配能力和装备，才能在无尽挑战中坚持更久。

4605790.title: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol – Book One: Black Signal Demo Slice
4605790.short_description: You are Cipher Reeve. The Dominion tried to erase you. The protocol failed. Enter the opening signal of ConOps21: Subversion Protocol — Book One: Black Signal, an interactive cinematic demo slice set in Neo-London. Memory is the terrain. Truth is contraband. Free.

4891220.title: 情绪劳动研究所 Demo
4891220.short_description: 【免费试玩版】 和古灵精怪的美女老板一起在虚拟世界中心跳同步，演奏情感吧！融合了甜蜜互动与节奏动作的另类“情绪劳动”即将开始。

3152430.title: There Is No Lore
3152430.short_description: 收集卡牌，构建卡组，用饰品改变，发现组合效果，赢得地点，击败首领。在这款轻度Roguelike卡组构建自动战斗游戏中，这一切及更多内容正等待着你。但请记住——毫无背景(There Is No Lore)，别再寻找了。

4140910.title: Headache: Altered States
4140910.short_description: Immerse yourself in a psychedelic adventure created with RPG Maker. The main character uses a substance “Nix” to draw inspiration for her book from surreal worlds. The line between hallucination and reality blurs, and the search for creativity turns into a struggle with addiction and inner demons.

4849360.title: Silesian Wars
4849360.short_description: Rule Silesia through a thousand years of history. Wage war, forge alliances and build duchies on a map of real provinces, against cunning historical AI leaders or your friends online — from pagan tribes to the modern day.

4336540.title: The Fallen Lamb
4336540.short_description: 《The Fallen Lamb》是一款节奏明快的动作 RPG，拥有强烈的 Roguelike 核心。随机机制让每次挑战都不一样，而你的选择与技巧会逐步把你打造成一台杀戮机器。记住：最终，你的灵魂将被放在上帝的天平上衡量。

4889790.title: The Rich Die First Demo
4889790.short_description: Build wealth, outsmart your rivals, and become the last millionaire standing in this multiplayer strategy card game. Play against friends or challenge AI opponents in a battle for financial dominance.

4883790.title: 择途行者 Demo
4883790.short_description: 《择途行者》是一款像素风横版卡牌动作 Roguelite。用手牌释放攻击、法术与道具，在分支地图中选择路线，收集卡牌与遗物，挑战怪物、事件、商店、精英战和 Boss。

3613690.title: Total Chaos Against Apathy
3613690.short_description: A high-intensity action game, inspired by the feeling of emulating arcade-only action games. Learn a simple-yet-nuanced two button control scheme. Use hitstun, attack chains, grabbing and throwing to crush and control hordes of enemies! Tank Controls Are Awesome!

4845490.title: Future Scout
4845490.short_description: Future Scout is an exciting, fast-paced game where you take control of a space vehicle and race through the vast expanses of a space tunnel!

4674520.title: Tiny Factions
4674520.short_description: 进行生产，建设你的城市，管理你的人民，并征服群岛！在 Tiny Factions 中于你的旗帜之下成为传奇。

4797570.title: Duck Defender
4797570.short_description: Duck Defender is a fast paced 2D wave defender. Collect coins and level up by defeating enemies! Select and buy infinitely stackable upgrades to progress through endless waves! Can you create the ultimate combo?

3044160.title: 我的刀盾
3044160.short_description: 《What the dog doing?》是一款抽象动作类游戏，核心主题为“热梗大乱斗”。其核心玩法是“击败Boss闯关”。战斗中，你需要灵活运用闪避与攻击，在敌人攻击的瞬间按下闪避键，以此制造反击机会，进而顺利通关。所有激烈的战斗均在一个决斗场中展开。 玩家将操控刀盾狗或多款经典热梗拟人角色。肌肉 Doge、比比拉布、香蕉猫、真棒猫、鸡你太美等全网爆火的梗图形象，甩出标志性的梗招发起攻击！

1713550.title: Star Witch
1713550.short_description: A dark fantasy action RPG where a fallen witch reshapes the world. Explore dangerous dungeons, fight twisted enemies, and grow stronger through immersive combat and powerful gear. Power demands a price.

4746090.title: COLORIZED
4746090.short_description: COLORIZED is a short, three-dimensional coloring game where you transform interiors and solve aesthetic puzzles.

4543030.title: Exploiters
4543030.short_description: 放置类僵尸防御游戏，玩家可以发展殖民地，赚取被动收入，并通过自动战斗和战略升级来抵御无尽的僵尸浪潮。

4146400.title: Echoes of the Core Demo
4146400.short_description: Echoes of the Core is a third-person platformer set in the planet's deepest reaches, where every descent is a mission, every step could be your last, and every discovery could change everything.

4698310.title: HITHURT
4698310.short_description: A 1v1 couch versus game where each player controls two independent characters. Use your HIT to attack your opponent's HURT, but be careful to defend your own. Can you keep track of both at once?

4046870.title: DAMex : DArk Matter Exodus
4046870.short_description: A challenging solo extraction shooter set in a hostile sci-fi world. Play as Quinn, a Dark Matter harvester stranded on planet Viridan — surrounded by deadly robots, fearsome bosses, hostile wildlife, and corporate lies. Harvest. Fight. Escape.

4854600.title: Astro Out Demo
4854600.short_description: Astro Out 是一款充满挑战的平台跳跃游戏，你需要技巧和毅力，小心行事，一次错误的跳跃可能让你付出沉重代价。你在一个神秘且扭曲的星球坠毁后，必须找到逃离的方法，同时揭开这颗星球奇异事件的真相。

4066660.title: Golden Years Nursing Home
4066660.short_description: A newly hired night‑shift nurse faces unsettling events in the soon‑to‑close Golden Years Nursing Home. Quiet halls, flickering lights, and shifting rooms hint at a past the residents won’t speak of. A slow‑burn psychological horror with no combat—just dread.

4874080.title: Valken Demo
4874080.short_description: VALKEN is a realistic tactical solo shooter where you play as a lone agent infiltrating a secretive military organization. Explore varied environments, make hard choices, and face the brutal consequences in an intense, unforgiving campaign.

4776850.title: Cover The Background Demo
4776850.short_description: Solve over 100 shape puzzles by piecing together different shapes to fully cover the background! Including Pressure plates, deletion squares and locked pieces!

4844080.title: Prison CAT
4844080.short_description: 《Prison CAT》是一款回合制社交推理游戏！ 玩家需要思考各自的能力与配餐顺序，通过脑力博弈达成团队目标即可获胜！

3895500.title: Turnip Rush
3895500.short_description: 与最多 4 位好友一起对战吧！ 忘掉那些死板的棋盘游戏，体验充满活力与刺激的动态玩法！ 尽可能多地种出萝卜，并用一切手段阻止你的朋友也这么做 （没错，这包括——让他们爆炸 ）

4508100.title: 星辰大学：兽心相伴
4508100.short_description: 星辰大学，兽心相伴。扮演大一新生雷欧，在校园中邂逅四位兽人同学，展开属于你们的恋爱故事。包含多线结局、亲密日常、浪漫氛围。

4492410.title: sepapu
4492410.short_description: Playing with a field of bits on the magical sandlight. A puzzle, it solved neatly.

4829160.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Vienna
4829160.short_description: 加入这场冒险，在维也纳精心打造的风景中，寻找101只狗狗的藏身之处🐾。🏆赢取海量成就。你能找到多少只狗狗🐶呢？🔎快行动吧！⏱️

4418430.title: STRAFEST
4418430.short_description: STRAFEST is a third-person co-op platformer full of physics-based minigames! Join friends in dodge boulders in volcanic pits or outrun bridge-blasting cannons. Unlock colorful Skins, Trails, and Titles to customize your character. It’s all about teamwork, goofy moments, and having a blast together!

4688690.title: Extreme Cycling Championship
4688690.short_description: 《极限自行车锦标赛》（Extreme Cycling Championship）将逼真的物理引擎与街机风格的激烈竞速完美融合，带来令人血脉贲张的刺激体验。玩家将化身精英车手，在12个风格迥异且充满险阻的赛道环境中极速驰骋——从霓虹闪烁的都市街景，到危机四伏的火山赛道，无所不包。
developers: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
publishers: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

3692900.title: Defense of Wancotte
3692900.short_description: Build your own towers from modular units, adapt mid battle, and master custom defenses in this Build-a-Tower Defense.

4803450.title: Remain
4803450.short_description: A first-person psychological mystery horror game where you wake with no memory, explore an abandoned mansion and derelict hospital, collect clues, and connect keywords to uncover the dark truth of your forgotten past.

4808730.title: Gone: The Agent
4808730.short_description: A first-person escape room game where you're locked in a single room and must explore, gather clues, and crack a code to get out. No tutorial, no timer just you and the room. If you reach further you will explore an untradtional escape room outside

2176650.title: Shards of the Heart
2176650.short_description: A dark RPG blending mystery, fantasy, and romance. When a strange girl appears in Sawyer's town, demons follow. Uncover hidden truths, build relationships, and fight to protect what remains.

4725400.title: LUREFOLD
4725400.short_description: 在《LUREFOLD》中，你将与各种对手展开单人 PVE 对决，通过收集和组合上百种独特道具，不断强化自己的牌组。看似普通的一手牌，在巧妙搭配下也能触发惊人的连锁效果，逆转整场战局。 这是一款融合扑克与策略构筑的 Roguelike 冒险游戏。每一次冒险都是全新的策略实验，每一种组合都可能带来意想不到的惊喜。单局游戏仅需 5-15 分钟，但每次挑战的对手配置和掉落道具都不同，策略永远有优化空间。 一同踏上这段充满变数的奇妙旅程吧～

4760710.title: 边缘城市
4760710.short_description: 来自伦敦的侦探，拥有一双能窥见灵魂碎片的眼睛。受黑帮头目维克托之托，你踏上了这座臭名昭著的岛屿，寻找一个名叫尼拉的女人。

4783190.title: Village Coop Clicker
4783190.short_description: A cozy cooperative village-building active clicker for solo players, families and friends. Gather resources, build your settlement, defend against raiders and prepare expeditions together — without stress, automation or idle mechanics.

4708090.title: Save the Red Box: Prologue
4708090.short_description: Save the Red Box: Prologue is a minimalist precision platformer focused on pure mechanics. Navigate through lethal traps to reach the Red Portal, trigger chaos Mode, and fight your way to the Green Portal to finish the level. No distractions, just skill.

4216940.title: Lullabies Made of Static
4216940.short_description: The world is gone. In the silent aftermath of humanity’s fall, you explore the ruins of a post-apocalyptic megalopolis surrounded by industrial brutalist factories, collecting forgotten cassettes that will reveal what human emotions once felt like long ago.

4781750.title: Gambillion
4781750.short_description: The house always wins, but they don't know you've still got a spare kidney. Bet big, drink cocktails that bend the odds, and chase a number so large it stops making sense. When your bankroll hits zero, how much of yourself are you willing to sell? Keep spinning. Keep selling. Don't die.

3399120.title: Jaleco Sports: Goal! 2
3399120.short_description: Welcome to the world’s most popular sport with the kind of detail and realism that only Jaleco can deliver!

4476610.title: Backrooms: Collision Not Found
4476610.short_description: 1-4 人合作恐怖体验。探索超写实的后室关卡和阈限空间，在独特的实体攻击下生存，并揭开这些关卡背后的黑暗谜团。极致的视觉保真度与心理恐惧并存.

3428090.title: Jaleco Sports: Bases Loaded 2
3428090.short_description: Welcome to the world’s most popular sport with the kind of detail and realism that only Jaleco can deliver!

4747550.title: Body Pillow Royal
4747550.short_description: 一款充满“朋克烂画”风格的竞技游戏。在这个后现代时代那令人欲罢不能的“死亡螺旋”中，你要随手涂鸦，并设法在朋友抢走你的画作之前将其完成。支持 2-4 名玩家在线游玩或本地分屏游玩。

4162150.title: Ash of Gods: Tactics
4162150.short_description: 构建并升级你的卡组，与其他玩家战斗，在剧情模式中迎接挑战，尝试不同的战术，因为战术决定一切！

4835520.title: Tower Vibes
4835520.short_description: Classic tower defense depth with an extra sound waves sync tech garnish

4505500.title: MergePiece: Merge pixels into masterpieces
4505500.short_description: 《MergePiece》是一款以世界名画为主题的像素合并解谜游戏。棋盘上，每一片色彩碎片都源自真实的传世杰作——你的任务，是把它们重新聚合为完整的画作。

4528600.title: LINOVICTUS
4528600.short_description: Fight through waves of enemies across shifting arenas, buy upgrades between stages, invest in new ships, research permanent upgrades between runs, and compete on the global leaderboards in this blood-pumping twin stick shooter.

4766500.title: Nybble
4766500.short_description: Your deck is your code. Build branching, looping programs from cards to hit byte targets and outwit rival hackers. A programming-themed roguelike deckbuilder with a heat-driven mastery climb, runaway combos, and a final boss who's been watching you the whole time.

4836490.title: Moonrise
4836490.short_description: Moonrise is a third-person 3D puzzle-adventrure, where open-path level design and visuals take centre stage, demanding a different reading of the space at every turn.

4691750.title: Bottled by Bears Demo
4691750.short_description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

4679180.title: The Abyss Below
4679180.short_description: 1997年。驾驶一艘小型潜航器深入太平洋海底，调查一个巨大的声呐异常。依靠仪器导航，扫描目标，并揭开某个远比它本应存在的年代更加古老的东西。

4661010.title: Corporate Entropy
4661010.short_description: Climb the ladder while burning it down. In this satirical management sim, you work for a corporation rolling out ARIA — an AI that's replacing your coworkers. Balance your performance cover against quiet sabotage, organize your resistance, and survive 8 quarters with your soul mostly intact.

4734030.title: The Vilbil: Online Hub for Art and Artists
4734030.short_description: See contemporary art in its true scale. The Vilbil is a high-fidelity VR showroom bringing a global community of artists directly to you. No crowds, no barriers—just you and the actual scale of international masterpieces, reproduced with total precision for your headset.

4370410.title: Drop Jump
4370410.short_description: A fast-paced 3D rhythm platformer focused on precision and mastery. Play handcrafted levels, build your own, and challenge others through community-created content.

4818410.title: 攻占敌营
4818410.short_description: 回合制卡牌策略游戏！依靠谋划卡、战略卡、角色卡、道具卡构筑卡组，指挥农民、步兵、刺客等不同的角色，灵活搭配卡牌战术，摧毁敌方营地。各种随心组合，巧用道具强化全队属性，多样卡组流派，用谋略碾碎敌方阵营。

4656060.title: マイ・プラネット─MOON CHILD─
4656060.short_description: [Gameplay Mechanics] • Controls: Simple mouse-click navigation to advance the story. • Branching Narrative: Player choices directly influence the plot, leading to multiple unique endings. • Standard Features: Includes essential functions such as Skip, Auto-mode, Save/Load, and Message Backlog.

4599720.title: Magic Puzzles: Twins
4599720.short_description: Control two magical Spheres in perfect unison. Use walls and traps to outsmart their synchronous movement and solve intricate puzzles in this cozy, mystical adventure.

4474960.title: Ratatouille Builder
4474960.short_description: In this cooking roguelike, inspired by many deckbuilder games, set up your garden to grow fresh vegetables and serve delicious dishes every day in your restaurant! Discover new recipes, exploit synergies, and learn your customers' favorite dishes!

4410370.title: Frocat Puzzles
4410370.short_description: For Frocat Puzzles, Ukrainian artists and writers have collaborated to create a relaxing experience. Piece together uniquely divided images in order to discover new stories.

2600970.title: Flawed Tactics
2600970.short_description: 一款“市场即是平衡补丁”的自走棋。购买并进化随从，施放法术，打造强力圣物——但请紧盯行情。你的每一次购买都会改变所有人的经济。没有永恒的版本答案，没有无敌的毒瘤。只有战术，而且还有破绽。

3844000.title: void future prologue
3844000.short_description: Void Future: Prologue 是一段设定在 Void Future 宇宙中的免费独立体验。你将扮演黑客，在由企业统治的赛博朋克世界中完成一个完整任务。入侵系统、解开谜题并揭露秘密——同时保持隐蔽，躲避无处不在的监控。

4692400.title: Minefront
4692400.short_description: 受扫雷启发的在线 1 对 1 战术对决。放置地雷，清除对手棋盘，避开陷阱，在每一秒都至关重要的快速比赛中竞争。

4857950.title: warp train Demo
4857950.short_description: 《时空列车》是一款俯视角搜打撤生存射击游戏。驾驶穿梭时空的列车进入文明遗迹与废墟战场，搜刮资源、击破建筑、应对随机事件，并在合适时机撤离，组合枪械词条与魔石附魔，打造属于你的爽刷 BD。

4489330.title: Inclination
4489330.short_description: A matchmaking puzzle game where all the pieces move together in the same direction by tilting the entire board. Chill game-play with no timers and relaxed, non-linear progression.

4853060.title: Hang in there Demo
4853060.short_description: A challenging platformer where you swing on ropes and dodge traps

4409970.title: Mosaic Garden: The Flower Game
4409970.short_description: A relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where flowers spread and mutate in real time. Shape their growth, clear space, and transform one pattern into the next on a colorful 10×9 grid.

4656460.title: Idle Aqua Driller
4656460.short_description: 在这款以水下采矿为主题的渐进式游戏中，潜入深海！操控钻井平台，雇佣潜水员和潜艇，解锁新的矿层和资源。升级你的船队，加快采矿速度，并发展技能树，将你的基地打造成一个强大的水下基地。

4253820.title: Robot and Flowers
4253820.short_description: A light and fun platformer where you help the robot F-7 collect flowers, overcome challenges, and enjoy the humorous commentary of a remote engineer.

4532000.title: The Sound of Piano
4532000.short_description: A hardcore keyboard rhythm game featuring pure piano tracks. Every note you hit generates a real key sound for a true piano response. Designed for intermediate players and beyond, use our unique skill test algorithm to discover your rating. No AI-generated music, just raw human-crafted tracks.

4831590.title: CrueArcade Alive
4831590.short_description: Face the apocalypse in this adrenaline-fueled, retro-inspired arcade brawler! Battle through hordes of the undead across tactical stages, face unique bosses, and scavenge vital supplies. Grab a friend for local co-op, manage your resources, and fight to survive the urban nightmare

4814250.title: Guilty As Charged! Demo
4814250.short_description: Set in a dystopian world where even small crimes are punished in permanence, Guilty As Charged! sees 20-year-old Alan Pierce fight for victory in a televised gameshow between 18 criminals where the winner not only keeps their life, but gains a huge cash prize – as well as their freedom.

4823710.title: FIGHTERIZER Demo
4823710.short_description: A free-movement 3D fighting game, dash in multiple directions, circle your opponent, bait attacks, and punish from any angle.

4720010.title: 奇迹勇者：魔兽防线
4720010.short_description: 汹涌的兽潮正不断冲击你的堡垒，却始终无法越雷池一步。你只需与勇者伙伴们尽情收割来犯之敌，在战斗中不断成长，以更强的姿态迎接下一波——收割，变强，再收割，如此循环。

4442280.title: Engine of Chaos
4442280.short_description: Bolt guns and upgrades to a runaway train and blast through endless hordes of zombies, monsters, and abominations across six brutal environments. Build your loadout, unlock new carriages, and see how far you can survive.

4156370.title: 杀毒少女
4156370.short_description: 《杀毒少女》是一款防御射击游戏。在游戏中，你将作为尖端反病毒组织「哨兵」的检查员，保护电脑免受病毒侵害。检查从网络传入的文件，让安全文件通过，并立即消灭病毒。你能否在不断进化的数字威胁中生存下来？

4386920.title: Nihongo Hunter
4386920.short_description: Go on an adventure to unlock Hiragana and Katakana and become a Nihongo Hunter! Enjoy a relaxing adventure and pick up the basic building blocks of Japanese as you travel across the picturesque islands of Hirajima and Katajima! By the time the adventure is over, you will master Hiragana & Katakana!

4851420.title: Cozy Cleanup
4851420.short_description: 清理派对后的混乱，收集垃圾并赚取金钱，用来解锁更好的工具和新区域。按照自己的节奏游玩，自定义装备颜色，并寻找隐藏的橡皮鸭。没有暴力，没有压力，只有轻松的清理体验。

4499040.title: 史莱姆农场
4499040.short_description: 可爱的史莱姆朋友们来到了你的桌面！ 打理农场，遇见那些开心跳跃的史莱姆吧。 即使在你工作或学习的时候，屏幕一角的小农场依然热闹地动着。

3369270.title: Forever RPG
3369270.short_description: Embark on a new adventure on every playthrough. Find equipment, meet all sorts of NPCs and battle your way through a short 10 chapter randomised story. A casual retro roguelite RPG you can play forever!

4825470.title: Chemicalizer
4825470.short_description: Chemicalizer is a music game that you play on your PC using your smartphone (Android) as a controller.

4856840.title: .FARM RACING.
4856840.short_description: Welcome to Farm Racing — a muddy off-road tournament where speed is not your choice, it is your problem.

3359840.title: Block Sprawl
3359840.short_description: Block Sprawl：城市规划卡组构筑游戏。建造你梦想中的城市！使用卡牌驱动的策略来规划并发展你的大都会。将方块形状的建造挑战与深度卡组构筑和动态玩法结合起来。立即加入愿望单，迎接城市规划的挑战！

4691430.title: The Punchbag Machine
4691430.short_description: 一款节奏明快的像素霓虹风格Roguelite游戏，每次漏打一拳都可能结束你的挑战。击中下落的音符，连击组合技，升级你的拳击手，击败9位 boss，并攀登排行榜。

3575690.title: Empyrean Defense
3575690.short_description: 一款快节奏的现代战争塔防游戏。建造、升级并定制防御设施，抵御无情的敌军入侵。解锁技能与能力，制造先进弹药，并在战场上收集资源，扭转战局。

4535630.title: WallFront
4535630.short_description: 在这款结合了塔防与Roguelite元素的策略游戏中守护最后的防线。部署拥有独特技能的精英小队，组合强大的神器，并通过永久性的元游戏进度不断进化。在《Wallfront》中，每一次失败都会让你的下一道防线变得更加坚固。

4788610.title: Jugger - the video game
4788610.short_description: Jugger combines rugby with fencing in a fast-paced team combat sport. Fight to break the enemy line and clear the path for your Runner to score. This game has fully mouse-movement controlled combat and no pre-set attack animations. Master each weapon and play in diverse match arenas for fun.

4858990.title: Navy Mission
4858990.short_description: Command a single warship and fight off enemy fleets and aircraft from all directions in this 3D naval shooter. Master the main gun, Phalanx, and missiles across 30+ missions at four difficulty levels! An endless survival stage is also included. Feel the tension of naval combat!

4890240.title: ai.ai Demo
4890240.short_description: The CEO of ai.ai has passed away, and his final word was "bubble." Uncover the meaning of his final word in this comedy mystery satirizing Silicon Valley. From the creator of the Jenkins webcomic.

3739300.title: 挤猫猫
3739300.short_description: 推箱挪位，钻管探路，锁定爆破点，轰开迷宫暗墙！小猫 Coco 为无穷小鱼干勇闯猫神试炼，在手绘清新关卡里，邂逅温柔又烧脑的治愈谜题。小老鼠伙伴会一路吱吱提醒，伴你前行。

4836510.title: CryptoGrid
4836510.short_description: CryptoGrid is an addictive clicker simulator where you build your digital empire from scratch. Click to earn coins, upgrade your performance, unlock unique music tracks, and collect rare items. Start your journey, manage your resources, and reach the top in this relaxing and engaging experience!

4816030.title: Keeping Up
4816030.short_description: Three jobs. One life. Zero savings. A satirical British life sim, spiritual successor to Jones in the Fast Lane. Move your marble token around a city of 16 buildings. Take jobs, study, eat, save, and dodge the weekly Algorithm. See how far you can climb!

4749130.title: Puzzles Dino
4749130.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

4901120.title: Von Neumann Project Demo
4901120.short_description: In this demo of Von Neumann Project you play as a self replicating probe as it charts the galaxies, peacefully, of course. Mine, build, expand, and explore in this sci-fi RTS. Remember to have as little impact on your surroundings as possible and protect yourself at all costs.

4531750.title: LOST IN LOST JAPAN
4531750.short_description: A strange retro 2D road trip through post-apocalyptic Japan. Created from a chance encounter between a New York rapper and a Japanese indie game developer. Travel across surreal local regions as a mysterious blue Daruma.

4654320.title: Dont Bust Demo
4654320.short_description: The BlackJack rogelike, Don't Bust is a fast paced take at blackjack, collect your augments, drink your Neon Shots and try not to bust.

4748160.title: War Games: Roman Times
4748160.short_description: Step into the neon colosseum in this bite-sized 2D arcade boss-rush. Master timing blocks and Kinetic Strikes, then execute devastating System Overrides. Survive five brutal arenas and push your limits in an endless New Game+ loop, fueled by an original dark techno soundtrack.

4634490.title: Master Healer Kale with useless party
4634490.short_description: A short incremental game where you play as a Healer in a party. Your main job is to keep your party alive. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from healing to party damage. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

4777370.title: Droning On Demo
4777370.short_description: Write code that looks and feels just like Python to guide Gizmo through the first 10 Bootcamp levels. A free taste of the full game, where puzzles and procedural runs push you, and your code, to the limit.

4855380.title: Idle Regenerator
4855380.short_description: 拥有 125+ 种力量、深度装备锻造、伙伴阵容、地下城、星座、Prestige 重置与离线进行的放置 RPG。无体力计时器。无付费碾压。唯有深度。

4577240.title: Ultra's Drive
4577240.short_description: Drive 100km to Vegas without crashing — or missing a text. Your story unfolds one notification at a time. Traffic won't wait. Neither will your messages.

3076910.title: UNDERGROUNDED -怀旧地下城-
3076910.short_description: 『UNDERGROUNDED -怀旧地下城-』是一款以回顾美国历史与文化为主题的解谜冒险类游戏。玩家将扮演求婚失败的失意青年，对深不见底的地下迷宫展开挑战。解除复古游戏的力量，寻找不慎遗失的戒指吧。

4818580.title: 三国志经典
4818580.short_description: 《三国志 经典》是一款以城市、武将、外交、补给与战场指令运营乱世的回合制大战略游戏。从189年反董卓联盟到263年蜀汉灭亡之战，在多个历史剧本中统领一方势力，或以旁观模式静观历史的流转。

4904000.title: Seek Shellter Demo
4904000.short_description: Seek Shellter 是一款街机风寻路游戏，可爱的蜗牛们必须在倒计时结束前收集电池并躲进避难所。你可以与好友组队，或独自一人闯关，完成关卡、赢下小游戏，并解锁充满复古 60 年代原子风情的世界。你有本事战胜炸弹吗？

4490290.title: 方块之地
4490290.short_description: 一款LowPoly风格的轻量化城市建造游戏，这里没有复杂的运营与资源管理，只有纯粹简单的建造。拥有科幻、幻想等风格建筑，能让你充分发挥想象力。选择你喜欢的建筑根据你的喜好搭建理想之城。

4902020.title: SHIROMASU Demo
4902020.short_description: 一款在 5x5 方格盘上进行的高分挑战型益智游戏。将发光方块推出盘面来清除它们并获得分数。通过连续清除方块，或一次清除多个方块，获得更高分数。

4476370.title: Wizard Magic DEMO
4476370.short_description: An autistic wizard and their ADHD familiar go on the adventure of a lifetime. Make strange friends, battle wizards and monsters, and explore the magical city of Bizzaire in this bite-sized pixel-art RPG!

4162060.title: 粘液井 Demo
4162060.short_description: 《粘液井》是一款类银河恶魔城解谜游戏，在游戏中玩家需要操纵一只史莱姆，灵活运用自身能力进行解谜、探索并最终发掘出这个世界的真相。

4847800.title: DeadboySkeleton
4847800.short_description: A third-person action game from beyond the grave. Wake up dead and explore multiple maps, hunt for hidden items, and smash undead corpses out of your way. Inspired by TeamSesh as a love letter to the team and the fans.

4895110.title: Escape from Umbra Demo
4895110.short_description: 沉浸在生存恐怖密室逃脱体验中。你被困在一个阴影潜伏的神秘黑暗世界，唯一的帮手是一本秘密之书和一把手电筒。解开谜题，保持潜行，逃离安布拉的领地。

4591270.title: Lunyatic Invaders
4591270.short_description: What is that... a cat!? A mysterious enemy has invaded from outer space. Break through a storm of bullets in your super fighter in this unique full-scale shooting game.

4790730.title: Faith | God's Lost Will
4790730.short_description: Faith is a sandbox survival game with many different big and small mechanics built into it. Not only is it a lightweight video game, but it also has the experiences and mechanics that makes any game fun to play. It uses concepts from many popular video games like Minecraft and Terraria among others.

4855280.title: Arcade 80's Racing Demo
4855280.short_description: 踏入赛车运动的黄金时代！一款采用 2.5D 像素艺术风格的街机赛车游戏，包含 10 辆赛车、16 条赛道、完整锦标赛和生涯模式。轻松上手，精通不易。

4776760.title: Signal Zero
4776760.short_description: A tense emergency dispatch simulation. Route police, fire, and EMS units across a city that never stops. Pick the right unit, beat the clock, keep your reputation above zero — or the city finds a new dispatcher.

4242710.title: Mr. Grin's Final Act Demo
4242710.short_description: Thirty years ago, a tragedy silenced the studio. You are back... So is Mr. Grin. In this first-person survival horror, scavenge old badges, rewire circuits, crack safes. Stay out of sight. One sound and you die. He's not only hunting you. His script. Your survival.

4380850.title: Backrooms: Multiverse
4380850.short_description: Backrooms Multiverse is a cooperative survival horror exploration game where you play as a team of researchers venturing deep into the endless Backrooms multiverse. Explore rare and mysterious environments, and encounter unique entities that few explorers have ever lived to see.

4870910.title: PuzzleVerse Demo
4870910.short_description: PuzzleVerse is a highly customizable jigsaw puzzle simulator, in which players can choose from a wide variety of puzzle images, shapes, cut styles and piece count. Players can also choose to use their own images and turn them into a unique puzzle experience.

4106760.title: To Save A Planet
4106760.short_description: Fight across five solar systems in a story-driven mix of tower defense and space combat, where every planet you save brings you closer to the truth and to those you thought were lost.

4903360.title: MineCash Demo
4903360.short_description: MineCash is a simple incremental game about mining cash.

4840340.title: Royale Battle
4840340.short_description: Get ready for a legendary battle royale experience

4903340.title: Nether Meridian Demo
4903340.short_description: Think your FPS skills are good enough? Prove it. Runner × FPS.A challenging fusion of a forward-running game and a first-person shooter.

3835680.title: 梦壳
3835680.short_description: 2084年。人类的物质世界已高度发达，精神世界却满目疮痍。 你将化身一位资深的梦境解梦师，通过尖端的脑机接口，深入光怪陆离的意识深渊。在这里，你将直面患者内心最深处的恐惧、执念与创伤。《梦壳》是一款融合了射击与解谜的RPG游戏。用你的枪械击碎精神的枷锁，用你的智慧解开潜意识的谜题。当梦境与现实的边界逐渐模糊，你是否还能守护住自己与他人的心智？

4845700.title: Football Commissioner
4845700.short_description: The definitive, first-of-its-kind American football league management sim. Take control of the newest spring football league by customizing the structure, teams, ticket prices, salaries, and more. Sim games week by week to grow your league from a startup into a thriving sports empire.

4370720.title: Echoes of the Dark Tomb
4370720.short_description: Explore an ancient Egyptian tomb in search of hidden treasure. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and survive hostile entities guarding its secrets in this tense first-person horror exploration experience.

4877720.title: Aster League: 2179 Demo
4877720.short_description: Aster League: 2179 is a kart racing spinoff to the small vehicles content of BallisticNG. Boost is king, and piloting in a straight line is a sure-fire way to lose the race.

4871610.title: Akaneiro ni Somaru Saka Demo
4871610.short_description: Nagase Junichi's life takes an unexpected turn when his fiancée, Katagiri Yuuhi transfers to his school but what would be a happy reunion crumbles due to a misunderstanding. Will this be an end to Junichi's formally peaceful, school life?

4021370.title: Everglen
4021370.short_description: Build your dream farm in a cozy pixel RPG. Grow crops, fish, mine, and explore a charming island full of secrets. Meet unique NPCs, craft and trade items, and uncover magical surprises at your own pace. Relax, explore, and create your story in this farming adventure.

4828030.title: Astrelght
4828030.short_description: 探索阿斯特雷特废墟，揭开“立方体”的秘密。完成奇特任务，结识古怪角色，调查异常现象，并在现实与模拟交织的超现实世界中挑战多人

4879820.title: Swamptender Demo
4879820.short_description: A fast-paced retro action game DEMO where you serve weaponized drinks to waves of hostile swamp creatures, defend your bar, and survive the night in a Game Boy–inspired experience.

4891750.title: Dark Spawn: Infestation Demo
4891750.short_description: Dark Spawn: Infestation is a horror adventure game set in a Victorian-era inspired research facility. The protagonist got abducted by evil scientists, and has to solve puzzles and avoid strange creatures to escape.

4318220.title: Tetra Rise Demo
4318220.short_description: 击败无数敌人，逃离深渊！《Tetra Rise》是一款融合 Roguelite 要素的动作平台游戏，你将在不断强化装备的同时，对抗愈发庞大的敌群，朝着地面一路攀登。

4845520.title: Winter Creatures
4845520.short_description: Winter Creatures is an exciting 3D puzzle game that will transport you to a mysterious snowy island full of mysteries. Your goal is to help the little slugs descend to earth!

2954750.title: The Dreamers Foresight
2954750.short_description: 第三人称的类Rogue卡组构筑游戏，每一次冒险都与众不同。 扮演忍者——在噩梦中战斗或潜行前进。 通过放置随机生成的生物群系方块来构建地图。排列相似的方块可获得更好的奖励。

4895910.title: Null Path Demo
4895910.short_description: Your skill, patience, and ingenuity will be tested in this homage to precision platformers! Traverse various biomes, from caves to volcanic wastelands and mysterious towers. Each environment with it's own deadly traps, puzzles, and challenges designed to push you to your limits.

4777820.title: 夜魇突袭:血牌风暴 Demo
4777820.short_description: 《夜魇突袭：血牌风暴》是一款高速连锁构筑类 Roguelike 卡牌游戏。通过自由构筑卡组，触发层层叠加的连锁技能，在怪物狂潮中打出爆炸式伤害。探索随机生成的黑暗地牢，收集遗物、强化武器、召唤幸存者，不断组合更强流派。每一张卡都可能成为连击起点，每一次出牌都能让战局瞬间失控。策略构筑与爽快操作并存，打造属于你的终极“血牌风暴”！

4845510.title: Tense Parking 2
4845510.short_description: Tense Parking 2 is the second installment of the exciting parking simulator, which takes you to a bright and sunny metropolis!

4293630.title: Assault On Sector 12
4293630.short_description: A turn-based, squad-focused tactical defense game where your squad holds the line against advancing enemy waves.

4824310.title: Vermin Protocol
4824310.short_description: Take on pest control contracts and hunt infestations across farms. Track, eliminate, and contain the vermin before they spread.

4146170.title: Relapse
4146170.short_description: A beginner friendly sheet music rhythm game, with cute characters and a shady organization!

4345750.title: The Trials - Chapter Two
4345750.short_description: A classic 90s choose your own adventure style horror visual novel. Escape the horrors hunting you, make decisions, forge your own path. An original complete story with multiple endings. Choose your own play style with a Text Adventure Mode, sound effects, and an ambient soundtrack.

4608320.title: NEON BLOCK
4608320.short_description: Neon Block is a hardcore cyberpunk multitasking challenge. Manage a fast-paced block puzzle with your left hand while hacking the Omega Core via a real-time terminal with your right. Solve the equation, counter system glitches, and prove that free will cannot be calculated.

4179870.title: All Tomorrows: Invasion
4179870.short_description: Resist extinction in this endless survival wave-based sci-fi shooter. Upgrade your weapons and harness far-future technology to survive as long as possible from a God-like alien race that threatens all of humanity.

4854360.title: Pro Tukey Hunting
4854360.short_description: Experience virtual spring gobbler hunting at it's finest! Game play centers around the four wild turkey sub-species residing in North America; easterns, osceolas, rios and merriams. Harvesting each sub-species is referred as a 'Grand Slam'. Do you have what it takes to earn the 'Grand Slam'!

4770700.title: Warfare Marionettes
4770700.short_description: Warfare Marionettes combines high-speed third-person combat, exploration, and progression-driven gameplay in a Sci-Fi conspiracy thriller. Traverse dangerous environments, unlock new abilities, defeat enemies, and uncover the truth behind TSAR Genomics and the government’s deadly cloudburst weapon.

4193580.title: MIHASHIRA
4193580.short_description: A 2D top-down arena shooter. A freely scrolling shooter. Pixel graphics reminiscent of the SNES. Easy to control with the directional pad, two shot buttons, and a bomb button. Make full use of your two shots to smash through enemies.

4087740.title: When will I get Home?
4087740.short_description: 一款独立开发的异常检测游戏，背景设定在阴森的东欧楼梯间。共有11层，超过30处异常，恐怖元素极少，但紧张感十足。

4898800.title: Hover Raid Demo
4898800.short_description: Hover, raid, upgrade. Eliminate thousands of zombies, unlock devastating abilities, and grow stronger with every run in this incremental action game. This is a short demo that lets you try out 9 of the 17 skills.

4294740.title: Drift Mania
4294740.short_description: No brakes. No reverse. Just drift control. Master short precision courses, chase ghosts and leaderboards, build custom tracks, and turn messy attempts into clean time-attack runs.

4823290.title: Giant Horse Feeding
4823290.short_description: Giant Horse Feeding is a silly alien colony simulator where you feed a horse & collect its droppings to build an alien empire. Automate production, unlock bizarre technologies, and create an endless recycling loop where horse droppings become the foundation of your civilization.

4466150.title: Mech Spa
4466150.short_description: Give the best massages and treatments to the robotic residents of Renewal City while you survive weekly quotas imposed by the mob and improve your hangar in style and effectiveness.

4617670.title: ユレイシア英雄戦記 - Chronicle of Arstenia500 -
4617670.short_description: 戦局を読み、一手ずつ難所を切り開く王道本格SRPG。盤面を読み、仲間の特性を見極めて難所を突破せよ。戦乱のユレイシア島を巡る王道戦記。

4875130.title: Cold Sweat Demo
4875130.short_description: 《冷汗》是一款设定在后末日世界的单人PvE撤离射击游戏。收集战利品，完成商人的任务，升级你的基地，定制你的枪械，并一路射击，击败其他幸存者和不死生物。

4660650.title: Shards
4660650.short_description: Shards is a single-player twin-stick shooter adventure game where you play as a clay robot. Fight your own kind, advance deeper into the Citadel and uncover its secrets.

4749160.title: Puzzles Forest
4749160.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

3997920.title: Hollow Ground
3997920.short_description: Top-down shooter inspired by 90s arcade games. You and up to three friends play as four mercenaries as they descend into the Epsilon 9 bunker. Navigate 70+ handcrafted labyrinthine levels, purchase upgrades, and destroy chaos manifest: The Machine.

4081480.title: Fuu
4081480.short_description: A reflex-testing 2D Platformer Runner set in a dark, gothic universe. Utilize core mechanics like double jump, wall jump, and precise dash/slide to overcome deadly obstacles and logic-based trigger puzzles. A demanding challenge awaits players who crave speed and adventure.

4876680.title: Froggy Works Demo
4876680.short_description: Froggy Works is a desktop companion farming game you can play actively, or let it do its own thing in the background or on the side of the screen as an idler. Build your farm, hire frogs, decorate and fully customize your island with a ton of different decorative tiles and structures!

4738940.title: Authorisation Engine
4738940.short_description: Turn a payment desk into a global authorisation network in this offline incremental strategy game about capacity, compute, mandates, quantum audits, and synthetic jurisdictions.

4557350.title: Archmage Idle
4557350.short_description: An idle/incremental RPG where you're an Archmage of a wizard guild. Your skills bolster the frontlines and the supply lines. Every skill multiplies the others, and it all keeps running while you're away.

4847040.title: On Hold - Call Center Simulator
4847040.short_description: A dark comedy call center simulator where you answer calls, verify identities, catch fraudsters, and run side hustles under your supervisor's watchful eye. The queue never empties. The pay never improves.

4400300.title: HAUNTMATES
4400300.short_description: Co-op horror investigation game across multiple maps. Enter procedurally generated environments, use your equipment to gather clues, and identify the entity. Watch your back, because monsters are hunting you down.

4823890.title: APEX Swoop: Card Game
4823890.short_description: Swoop is a fast-paced shedding card game. Play cards equal to or lower than the center, or pick up the pile! Take risks with mystery cards, use Jokers or 10's to swoop the board, and host multiplayer lobbies with Steam friends or challenge advanced AI. Can you empty your hand first?

4891490.title: FLASK Demo
4891490.short_description: 《FLASK》是一款以“炼金术”为题材的Roguelike回合制策略游戏，你将扮演一名强大却又负债累累的炼金术士，在弥漫着黑暗气息的奇幻世界中屠戮成群袭来的怪物并收割它们价值连城的绿色血液。是时候开启这场猎杀之旅了，要么成为有史以来最富有的炼金术士，要么成为又一具无人问津的枯骨......

4798220.title: Flexible Frosty Demo
4798220.short_description: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.

2731400.title: Timber!
2731400.short_description: Dementia, tragedy and fun – all in the same taste of a potato! Timber! is a 2D point-and-click storydriven game that takes you on an emotional journey. Explore a mix of feelings, from the heart-wrenching struggles of dementia to the unraveling of a tragic story.

4899290.title: Outspin Champions Demo
4899290.short_description: Outspin Champions is a competitive PvP brawler where the spinning never stops. Blending party game chaos with souls-like precision, master physics-driven weapon weight to deflect foes. Outspin. Outsmart. Outlast.

4344770.title: Kuroba: Oghuz
4344770.short_description: Kuroba is a historical RTS set in the brutal frontier of 13th-century Anatolia. Build settlements, manage logistics, and command armies in grounded, realistic combat. No magic, no heroes—only economy, strategy, and leadership determine who endures.

4730470.title: Farm Bang Demo
4730470.short_description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

4876470.title: Gnat Pack Demo
4876470.short_description: 这是一款简短的渐进式游戏，游戏内容是喂养一群饥饿的蚋。引导你的小虫子去吃水果，并解锁升级功能，让你的嗡嗡叫伙伴们一口一口地长大。

4116330.title: Kitty Witchy
4116330.short_description: A little lost witch, a magical cat, and a world full of secrets. Kitty Witchy is a 3D narrative puzzle adventure game. Join the witch and solve puzzles with the help of her cat, uncover the secrets of this universe, and find the way back home.

4728590.title: Sentry
4728590.short_description: Raid dungeons by day, defend your town by night. Slay hordes of monsters, loot gear, and master skills in a fast-paced pixel-art dungeon crawler — then return home to build traps, place towers, and hold the line against the swarms, Clear every dungeon before the town falls

4717020.title: The One Who Runs Away Is Chased
4717020.short_description: A cute and funny chasing game. Play as a little yellow guy who runs away from everything that chases him. Simple, addictive, and full of silly moments.

4578750.title: 不死精灵
4578750.short_description: 这是一款类银河战士风格的 2D 横板平台探索游戏，以精巧新奇的谜题设计、层层递进的连通地图为核心，你将穿梭于庞大的 interconnected 世界，破解机关、收集道具、解锁能力，在沉浸式探索中揭开世界的秘密，体验充满惊喜的解谜与冒险。

4817630.title: Kill the horde
4817630.short_description: 这是一款让忍者“不讲武德”的第三人称射击游戏。你的敌人是没脑子的僵尸和脑子也不太灵光的士兵，而你要做的，就是用五花八门的枪械替他们做个“物理超度”。在波次生存里把敌人成批射成筛子，或者在关卡任务中顺手牵羊然后溜之大吉。击杀掉金币、掉武器——这哪里是战斗，分明是披着忍者外皮的零元购狂欢。欢迎来体验最不正经的忍者生活。

3234850.title: HYPERWIRED
3234850.short_description: Hyperwired 是一款经典的自上而下动作射击游戏，你的飞船上挂着一条电缆。插入能量插口来充能，收集升级并解锁飞船，探索充满类 Rogue 要素的程序生成银河。

4846840.title: Vonkelveld
4846840.short_description: 点亮一个世界——每一点光都是一个鲜活的灵魂。去塑造它、呵护它，却绝不号令它；再从神的俯瞰之上，一头坠入某一条生命，追随它走完一生。对任何事物追问「为何」，你得到的是真正的因果链条，而非粉饰的台词。末日终将获胜——你的世界能燃烧多久、多亮，就是你的分数。

4841900.title: A Simple Square Demo
4841900.short_description: A Simple Square 是一款极简解谜游戏，每一次移动都会改变关卡。沿直线滑行，让身后的格子消失，提前规划路线，在不困住自己的情况下抵达出口。

4774740.title: The Anomaly Hunter
4774740.short_description: In the VHS horror game The Anomaly Hunter, you play as Sam and must sneak into an abandoned shelter to find out what’s happening inside and eliminate the threat. The employees were supposed to leave you instructions on how to carry out the job. The main thing is to be careful.

4843190.title: Know Lychees / 来高州识荔枝
4843190.short_description: 一款个人独立制作的高州荔枝主题轻量益智小游戏。通过“找荔枝、识荔枝、食荔枝”三种玩法，认识荔枝品种与高州文旅。

4310920.title: Turscar Isle
4310920.short_description: Infiltrate the base of a cult of spammers in this Thief-style stealth extraction game! Exact poetic justice on them by stealing everything they haven't nailed down, then go back and steal the nails.

4843440.title: Curious Paws: hidden objects
4843440.short_description: Curious Paws: Hidden Objects is a short, cozy hidden object game where you explore vibrant, hand-drawn locations through the eyes of a curious cat. Search for objects that could catch his attention, and enjoy a lively environment, relaxing music, and an atmosphere of slow-paced exploration.

4846480.title: Front Line
4846480.short_description: A side-scrolling action shooter where you push through enemy lines, switching between handgun, machine gun, shotgun, and sniper rifle. Weapon choice and reload timing can mean the difference between life and death. No extra lives. No continues. One life to conquer the battlefield.

4591540.title: 逆性莫比乌斯
4591540.short_description: 这是一款轻松搞笑的冒险/RPG游戏。在游戏中，你将扮演王国最强（但目前最倒霉）的女勇者，经历一场完全脱轨的奇幻冒险。 原本只是一次常规的“讨伐魔王”任务，却因发现魔王竟是个“未转正的实习生”而画风突变。在两人尴尬的缠斗中，实习生魔王慌不择路地启动了紧急传送阵，将你打包丢进了一个魔力枯竭的平行世界！

4453600.title: Burnout
4453600.short_description: Burnout is the perfect game for anyone who has run out of patience. Click, snap, let it out: here stress isn’t cured, it’s recycled. The more unhinged you get, the more the game rewards you.

4903990.title: Escape Them Demo
4903990.short_description: A silent stealth horror game. No weapons, no power just hiding spots, tricks, and nerve. Find the key, escape the house, and don't let them hear you

4819850.title: 动次打次
4819850.short_description: 一只喜欢音乐的桌面宠物。更准确地说，它喜欢你喜欢的音乐。 平时，它会安静地待在桌面上陪伴你。当音乐响起，它便会架起鼓槌，跟随节拍开始演奏。 无论你正在工作、学习，还是沉浸在喜爱的旋律中，它都会陪在你的桌面一角，用自己的方式加入音乐。 播放一首歌，看看它今天会带来怎样的演出吧。

4875210.title: Huiyu AI旅行 Demo
4875210.short_description: Huiyu AI Trip 是一款交互式旅行影像体验。一种可操控的视觉旅程——按住 W/D 让画面向前推进，按住 S/A 让时间向后回退，松开即停。所有画面通过 Canvas 帧序列实时渲染，正反向切换丝滑无闪。内置多系列旅行内容、25 种语言界面，带你用全新的方式探索世界各地的风景。

4861250.title: VLCNP Story Demo
4861250.short_description: Beneath their goofy long-faced looks lies a surprisingly serious action-adventure. Awaken as Akim and Very Long Leelee after 10,000 years of slumber, recover your lost memories, rouse your fallen comrades, and rise to defeat a great evil!

4755900.title: CHIPSTACK
4755900.short_description: A desktop idle casino that runs while you game, queue, browse, or work — earning chips every second. Auto-play blackjack, slots, roulette with your bets and strategies. Plus 3 quick-play games like Video Poker. Toggle card counting, equip powerful mods or play pure, and chase the highest chipstack!

4902100.title: Mercenary Brotherhood Demo
4902100.short_description: A deep turn‑based tactics RPG featuring emergent stories, procedural world events, enemy factions, magical loot with drawbacks, and a fully simulated fantasy sandbox. Build your mercenary company, survive brutal battles, and uncover new content. Solo‑dev indie project with active development.

4557030.title: DRUMP SIMULATOR
4557030.short_description: A satirical game where you make choices and play mini-games as the American President Tonald Drump.

548800.title: OFS
548800.short_description: 在这款快节奏街机恐怖游戏中，活过五个一分钟的班次。分拣货物、清除可疑包裹、挡住三只小小入侵者；赚取赏金、购买黑客程序，并在班次之间续保医疗保险。短局快节奏，压力拉满，外加满屏荒诞的企业作风。

4617470.title: Choose Your Paul!
4617470.short_description: 组建怪异 Paul，打爆整局。 Choose Your Paul 是一款策略 roguelite 自动战斗游戏：选择独特 Trainer，捕捉名为 Paul 的奇异生物，通过站位、升级和协同打造强力构筑，在充满战斗、精英、商店、事件与 Boss 的分支路线中推进。

4870860.title: SpriteArcana Demo
4870860.short_description: Sprite Arcana 是专为美术人员与游戏开发者打造的高级 2D 制作管线。创建、制作动画并导出自定义素材，或使用直观的 2D 程序化工具无缝生成 3D 地形。轻松与团队分享项目，或构建专业的素材包。

4903790.title: FLOWORKS Demo
4903790.short_description: 一款节点式自动化 × 放置工厂建造游戏。原料沿着你铺设的连线流动，每经过一台机器就变换形态。排除瓶颈、优化布局、扩张贸易版图，最终称霸机器人产业。零美术素材——所有画面与音效均由代码生成。

4903870.title: OUTWORKS Demo
4903870.short_description: 建造高耸的立体要塞，守住防线。层层叠楼、立起城墙，并按高度部署炮塔，抵御从四面逼近核心、不断升级的地面与飞行机械大军——然后看着一座坍塌的高塔将一切一同拖垮。一款精炼、霓虹、纯代码打造的基地防御 Roguelite。

4715820.title: Ruin Blade Demo
4715820.short_description: 《遗迹之刃》是一款专注于近战砍杀的俯视角战斗+地牢探索的游戏。 你将以佣兵的身份深入古代遗迹。直面潮水般的怪物，在危机四伏的环境中搏杀出你的道路。

4794320.title: Advance Rise Basketball Manager
4794320.short_description: AR Basketball is a long-term basketball franchise simulator where team chemistry, economics, fan growth, player personalities, and league history matter just as much as winning championships. Build your organization across 100 seasons and chase multiple paths to greatness.

4854550.title: Paradise Corner 2
4854550.short_description: Paradise Corner 2 is a cozy and relaxing casual clicker game.

4498250.title: RUPTURR
4498250.short_description: Develop your nation, command your army, and dominate the world in a real-time strategy game combining economic management, diplomacy, technological progress, and military conquest.

4738530.title: Mandate of Galactic Empires
4738530.short_description: A logistics-focused turn-based space 4X. Govern through Administrative Nodes, connect systems with wormhole infrastructure, assign population to production and research, and expand only as far as your empire can support.

4834090.title: Purrfect Slide
4834090.short_description: A cute, bubbly, and cozy match-3 puzzle game! Slide adorable colorful cats, trigger massive chain reactions with Bomb and Line cats, and chase high scores in Fever Mode. Kick back, relax to procedural cozy music, and unlock over 60 achievements in this purr-fectly relaxing puzzle experience.

4904590.title: 小小餐馆 Demo
4904590.short_description: 欢迎来到《小小餐馆》！这是一款画风温馨治愈的 3D 餐厅模拟经营游戏。在这里，你将远离城市的喧嚣，接手一家属于自己的小餐馆，用美食治愈每一位踏入店门的食客。从切菜、烹饪到装盘，体验真实的餐厅后厨日常。游戏内置三十多种菜，玩家自由设计菜谱。一个人可忙不过来！你可以添加帮手厨师来和你一起完成后厨任务。

3710890.title: Mars Clicker Demo
3710890.short_description: 一款以火星为背景的放置点击游戏。钻取水晶，建立殖民帝国，运营精炼厂生成暗物质，并触发声望重置以更强大的姿态重新开始。你能抵达无限水晶吗？

4671050.title: American Revolutionary War
4671050.short_description: Fight through the American War of Independence in a tactical wargame of field battles, frontier warfare, fortified positions, and campaigns for control of the colonies. Command American, British, Loyalist, German, Native allied, and French forces across 148 scenarios and four campaigns.

4798810.title: Bepe War
4798810.short_description: Bepe War is a chaotic war simulator with unique missions and a sandbox mode. Drive any vehicle you can imagine, enable wild mutators, and enjoy brutal ragdolls!

4306650.title: Cicadia
4306650.short_description: Cicadia is a free rogue-like first person shooter indie game. Kill bugs and collect Bile as you uncover the hidden truth of a self-forsaken empire. Challenge bosses, cull swarms, and build an unstoppable loadout in Cicadia!

4849960.title: The Laws of Probability
4849960.short_description: You have exactly 5. Bread is 4, the bus fare to school is 3. What do you give up? In this short narrative experience, you play as 13-year-old Adam. Confront an interface that reacts to a painful reality, and discover that freedom of choice is sometimes nothing but a privilege.

4841610.title: Teen Hustler Demo
4841610.short_description: Build your digital empire from a cramped room to a high-tech penthouse. Code, hack, mine crypto, and manipulate the dark web in this deep 3D economic sandbox simulator. Stay in the shadows, manage your hardware, and don't get caught by the police!

4668560.title: The Hollow Road: Prologue
4668560.short_description: A psychological horror prologue where a strange house, a silent church, and something lurking in the dark pull you into a waking nightmare. Explore, uncover hidden truths, and survive what waits beyond the last door.

3164460.title: Hyper_Sea_5000
3164460.short_description: Neo-Retro Arcade Shooter. Trapped in a warp cube, for your crimes against the Cube Federation, you must fly and shoot around, use charge shots, mid-air dodges, and power crystals in the most advance ship in the galaxy and fight a relentless onslaught of various "cubes."

4511510.title: Compliance Auditor
4511510.short_description: Find the discrepancies. File the report. Survive the exit interview. Are you ready to balance the books?

4094460.title: Furgon Magic Trader Demo
4094460.short_description: 在旅行车中成为一名森林炼金术士！种植草药、收集稀有材料、在炼金机器上制作药剂、与森林居民交易并探索新地点。从简单的提取物到强大的灵药

4825840.title: Voxel Breakers Demo
4825840.short_description: Voxel Breakers - 一款轻松的增量游戏，你可以破坏体素，购买并升级破坏机器人，然后看着它们替你越来越快地破坏体素。

4873360.title: Capy Farm Demo
4873360.short_description: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

4806210.title: Ian's Rocket
4806210.short_description: A history-based, strategy, open-world game in which a nation's economy is built from scratch by utilizing all available resources. Create cities and wonders, hire labor, sell crafted products, and build armies. Meet historical figures who will either fight to stop your efforts or trade with you.

4888570.title: Leukocyte Demo
4888570.short_description: 单人或与好友一起畅玩的动作冒险游戏。与病毒和细菌战斗，获得 DNA 突变能力，并在探索人体的过程中不断解锁新技能，挑战强大的首领。

3462790.title: Battle For Embolia
3462790.short_description: 《Battle For Embolia》是一款节奏快速的独立 MMORPG，拥有灵敏的战斗手感、有意义的成长系统和持续更新的内容。探索不断扩展的世界，挑战强大的 Boss，并通过反馈参与游戏开发。免费游玩，无付费取胜机制。

4821350.title: Secret Cats - Independence Day
4821350.short_description: 进入迷人的《Secret Cats - Independence Day》世界，这是一款隐藏物品游戏，你的任务是发现隐藏在令人惊叹的手绘艺术作品中的每一只猫。让你敏锐的眼睛和好奇心引导你完成这段迷人的旅程。

3721820.title: Important People of History: Presidents - George Washington
3721820.short_description: Learn all about George Washington in this visual novel biography containing rare photos from inside the Washington Monument, Washington's home at Mount Vernon, and much more. Soldier, General, Spymaster, and President - this is George Washington! Proudly made in Washington’s home state of Virginia

3721830.title: Important People of History: Presidents - Thomas Jefferson
3721830.short_description: Learn all about Thomas Jefferson in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of the room where the Declaration of Independence was signed, Jefferson’s Monticello home, and much more. Writer, Diplomat, President - this is Thomas Jefferson! Proudly made in Jefferson’s home state of Virginia

4084160.title: Conqueror's Stage
4084160.short_description: No fixed maps. No scripted history. No tutorial treadmill. Conqueror's Stage is a real-time grand strategy across five ages - where every decision trades against another. Grand strategy, finally designed to be finished.

4840260.title: A Vessel of Frustration Demo
4840260.short_description: You return to your hometown but no one recognizes you. But that doesn’t matter, because you are not here for them. You are here for her. Midgårdsormen, singer and artist, pervert and goddess, a being truly out of this world.

4436080.title: Olga Doesn't Die
4436080.short_description: The imperial family's advisor is a witch, a hag, the devil in disguise. A historical drama yuri visual novel set during a time of political tumult wherein an immortal finds both love and suffering.

4898910.title: Auto Empire Tycoon Demo
4898910.short_description: 从20世纪50年代的一家小型工厂和单一经销店起步。研究新技术，设计汽车，管理生产，让经销店保持充足库存，并在这款等距视角经营模拟游戏中超越竞争对手，打造属于自己的汽车帝国。

4828230.title: Marshmallow Story: in Marshmallow Village
4828230.short_description: This story follows Marshmallow, the protagonist, as he sets off on his adventure to become a beautiful and wonderful marshmallow, but first to search for the missing shopkeeper of Marshmallow Village. Progress through the story with an engaging plot and science puzzles to find the shopkeeper!

4804430.title: Re:メタモルフォーゼ・キャンディーナ
4804430.short_description: All girls can transform with candy. A short branching visual novel about a mysterious candy shop and the girls who go there. What candy will you choose?

4694530.title: Under Tower Idle
4694530.short_description: 在这款3D放置点击冒险游戏中，建造、扩张并自动化你的岛屿帝国。收集资源，训练部队，征服危险的地下城。

4845500.title: Snow Route
4845500.short_description: Snow Route is a dynamic 3D driving game where a true winter adventure awaits! Get behind the wheel of a truck and drive along snowy roads to the finish line.

4841780.title: LIVORA
4841780.short_description: LIVORA is a choice-driven life simulation where money, work, relationships, health, family, weather, world events and pressure all connect. Build a life, face the consequences, recover from mistakes, chase ambition, fall in love, start again, and see how different every life can become.

4824960.title: Crop and Claw 2 Demo
4824960.short_description: Crop and Claw 2 is an Adventure-RPG about dragons, plants, memories, and more. Delve into a whole new continent of secrets and unearth the roots of the strange events going on.

4900470.title: Cleanup Crew Demo
4900470.short_description: A space station has gone dark and its captive alien specimens are loose. Fight through procedurally generated rooms, solve each planet's terminal puzzle, and unlock new weapons as you clear three hostile worlds in this 2D roguelite.

4634080.title: Ice Cream Man
4634080.short_description: ICE CREAM MAN is a first person PSX-style horror game. After a late-night gaming session, your walk home turns into a nightmare. Navigate unfamiliar backyards, jump fences and hide in the shadows to escape a murderous Ice Cream Man. Can you make it home alive? Or do you have a rocky road ahead?

4890340.title: Fading Reel Demo
4890340.short_description: 复古棕褐 Roguelike——带领锁链相连的小队闯过 22 波敌人。地图事件撕裂阵型，里程碑波次补充新队友、增强火力。Linked Blink、单局升级、19 种 Evolution 与永久 meta 天赋树，助你击败最终 Boss Hydra。

4856190.title: Tech Store & Repair Simulator
4856190.short_description: 建立属于你的终极科技商店帝国！在开放世界中从批发商处购买各种电子产品，亲手整理货架，并向顾客销售最新款的智能手机、平板电脑和配件。你不仅是个老板，还可以通过掌握专业的硬件维修技术（如更换电池和屏幕）来赚取丰厚的额外收入。在这款深度生活模拟游戏中，你需要时刻关注并管理角色的饥饿度和精力等生存指标。随着利润的增长，你可以雇佣收银员和清洁工来自动化日常工作，不断扩大你的零售业务，最终成为这座城市里最成功的商业大亨。

4486140.title: IDLE: Intergalactic Defense League Exterminators
4486140.short_description: 一款主打狂轰虫子、收集内脏、升级基地，然后再轰碎更多虫子的放置增量游戏！

4815350.title: Never Gives Up Her Dead
4815350.short_description: Time is running out after a meteor strikes your interstellar starship. While the crew is under full alert, only you seem to notice the strange red portals opening up throughout the ship. Old school text-based parser: no graphics, huge worlds, no hints. Recommended for text game veterans.

4016570.title: Lythium
4016570.short_description: Take on a task force from the gravestones! Your memories may be lost but the horde still remains. Slash, shoot, punch, and unleash your inner beast on your enemies in this action packed rogue-like FPS.

4826210.title: Derples Vs Xenos Demo
4826210.short_description: DEMO . Lead a squad of Derples in a desperate fight for survival amid abandoned colonial outposts. Build defences, explore dark un-powered rooms, scavenge for resources, fight turn based battles in an alien-infested hellscape. Solo only for Demo (4-player co-op for the full game). Coming soon!

4305620.title: Brazzante
4305620.short_description: Featuring a unique doodle aesthetic, this world is entirely hand-drawn. Your goal? Use classic 'Rock, Paper, Scissors' mechanics to survive never-ending rounds.

978280.title: Damn Zombies
978280.short_description: Dive into fast-paced, old-school multiplayer arena combat! Battle it out in a tight, claustrophobic maze of industrial shipping containers where danger lurks around every corner. Choose your class, lock and load your arsenal, and rack up frags in non-stop, adrenaline-fueled Deathmatch action.

4480550.title: Operation Moon Walker
4480550.short_description: This is a single-player 3D shooting action game set in a world of prosperity and chaos, starring Isaac, the commander of the United Nations special agency "Theseus."

4887980.title: Soapboxed Demo
4887980.short_description: Soapboxed is a party racing game where ridiculous racers compete in homemade soapboxes while sabotaging each other using dirty tricks, dangerous shortcuts, and complete disregard for safety.

4310730.title: 100 Summer Cats
4310730.short_description: 🐾 加入充满猫咪的主题地点，展开最可爱的冒险！ 😻 探索特别场所迷人的手绘艺术作品，尝试在整个游戏中找到隐藏的100只可爱猫咪。 🐈🕵️‍♂️ 你能找到它们全部吗？ 🕵️‍♂️🐈

4816760.title: Inimigo - The Warrior Saint Versus the God of Discord- Demo
4816760.short_description: Is one the villain and the other the hero? The truth is more complicated than that. Discover the story between two enemies in this dark fantasy BL visual novel!

4839300.title: 文明乱斗
4839300.short_description: 《文明对决》是一款回合制策略卡牌对战游戏。玩家选择中国、罗马或埃及文明，组建 25 张卡牌卡组，在双行棋盘上部署陆地、水面、空中三类单位与对手博弈。通过管理金币与科技点，从远古时代逐步升级至信息时代，挑战 20 个拥有专属 AI 策略的 BOSS 关卡。

3938150.title: Merlin Survivors
3938150.short_description: 卡美洛正面临危险！ 《Merlin Survivors》是一款将Roguelike动作与紧张生存挑战结合的游戏。控制传奇英雄如梅林、亚瑟、兰斯洛特和摩根娜，抵御源源不断的敌人。 精通每个角色！

4748330.title: Luna Meridian
4748330.short_description: Luna Meridian is a near-future narrative lunar colony game. A card-based drafted crew runs a 5-phase mission on the Moon's surface. Build mission critical infrastructure, manage resources, respond to hazards, follow and shape their stories and make decisions that determine if the colony survives.

4484650.title: Climbing Simplified Demo
4484650.short_description: A minimalist physics-based climbing puzzle game where every move matters. Plan your moves, manage stamina, and master different climbing disciplines. The demo will include 20 routes within the first two environments: Gym and Granite.

4892300.title: SwipSwap Demo
4892300.short_description: A 3D fast-paced action game. One hit Kill. Control a shadow dancer whose shade replicates your moves with a 2-second delay. Swap positions with it, avoid traps, and unleash deadly AoE attacks to survive. Create your own build to overcome the challenges! Can you defeat Dracoulous?

4428540.title: Adventurer's Conquest
4428540.short_description: A tactical card game focused on board control and strategy. Complete Guild missions, recruit allies, strengthen your party, and climb the ranks by facing increasingly difficult challenges.

4783670.title: Puck'n Hell Demo
4783670.short_description: 一场发生在灵薄狱中的黑暗街机空气曲棍球对决。怪异的对手。没有借口。只有你和球。容易理解。难以精通。欢迎来到地狱。拿起你的球拍。

4647170.title: Indefinite: Intake
4647170.short_description: Analyze anomalous objects as a prisoner serving a 900+ year sentence. Identify threats, make critical decisions, and survive increasingly disturbing encounters that challenge both logic and sanity.

4899110.title: Sandwatch Demo
4899110.short_description: Sandwatch is a rhythm game where you hit two types of notes falling from above with perfect timing. Freely bind and press your keys as you follow the trajectory of the hourglass.

4469500.title: Ninety Nine Dungeons
4469500.short_description: 日式动作角色扮演地城探索：俯瞰式地图融合完整垂直性和多层高度的冒险世界。发掘稀有装备，定制自己独一无二的强力流派，征服无尽挑战！

4727260.title: Puzzles: Dog
4727260.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

4845540.title: Hold My Hand (Or Let Go)
4845540.short_description: A free Visual Novel about unrequited love, envy, friendship and forgiveness. Experience the story of Charlie, a completely normal Swedish college student that’s graduating next week. But before he does that, he has to say goodbye to all the friends that he made during his three years in town.

4291890.title: Fascist
4291890.short_description: As National Guard, stand defiant against relentless hordes. Unleash righteous fury. Old Glory waves eternal and America endures because YOU fight!

4869330.title: Ultimate Guess Game Demo
4869330.short_description: Ultimate Guess Game is a thrilling digital social game. Challenge a friend and race to identify the mystery image you are holding using strategic "Yes/No" questions. With diverse categories to choose from, use your deduction skills to win! Can you solve the puzzle before your opponent does?

4763450.title: The Higher They Rise
4763450.short_description: "The Higher They Rise" is a 3D Tactical Precision Platformer in which you challenge your fear of gravity. Multiple paths and routes are available for you to explore on your journey to the top. Aim your hero, charge your jump and release to leap forward. Fight against gravity and yourself!

3802740.title: The Mine Room
3802740.short_description: 经典游戏《扫雷》的第一人称改版。 四周一片漆黑，你只有一支手电筒和一股强烈的渴望：在不掉进黏液或被炸飞的前提下，清空房间里所有的安全方块。

4865030.title: Tiantang Beach in Fangchenggang
