4865030.short_description: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position

4760660.title: Selena's Charm 2: Enchanted Garden
4760660.short_description: A free-to-start match-3 puzzle game with garden and exterior restoration. Play the first 20 levels, help Selena begin bringing the estate back to life, and unlock the full experience through DLC.

3397400.title: Frick It
3397400.short_description: 与朋友们在一个巨大的深坑深处求生。搜寻零件，与滑稽的村民交易，升级你的载具，与致命的生物战斗，并揭开在你之前坠落的机器人的故事。一路飞回地面。

4775240.title: Mandate of Heaven : Dynasty Breakout Idle
4775240.short_description: 放置增量打砖块游戏，带你穿越4000年中国历史。弹射农民、弩兵与火药。击败王朝Boss。解锁新单位。看着数字无止境地攀升。

4815370.title: 擎天岗镜头君
4815370.short_description: Qingtiangang Camera Guy is a livestream crisis card strategy game. Play cards to answer on-camera events, manage safety, image quality, heat, and chat mood, unlock characters, improve decks, and survive standard or endless shifts.

4886820.title: Little Battle Simulator
4886820.short_description: Create the battlefield of your dreams and fight! Monsters, vast armies, rivers and forests, multiple teams… Anything goes! Create your own battle in "Sandbox". Witness the chaos in "Random Battle", Achieve the highest possible score in "Challenge"

1778510.title: Sending my Pet Rock to Heaven
1778510.short_description: Your Pet Rock has decided to see if god is real. Bounce your way up to get to Heaven.

4709940.title: Final Legal Move
4709940.short_description: Survive a hostile chessboard where you are the only white piece. Escape enemy waves, get power ups, clear story campaign and chase high scores in endless mode. Make your final legal move.

4842490.title: Fleck & Grus
4842490.short_description: Help Grus escort his friend Fleck safely back to his hometown in this fast-paced precision platformer. Navigate tight levels packed with tricky jumps, bouncing mechanics, and deadly hazards. Stay sharp, react quickly, and master each challenge to survive the journey.

4446120.title: Keepy UP
4446120.short_description: Push yourself ever higher in this challenging reimagining of a classic childhood game. Guide your balloon through a vertical gauntlet of seagulls, ghosts, UFOs and more! Your balloon is your only friend, and gravity is your greatest foe. Are you skilful enough to Keepy UP?

4808790.title: Singularity Inc
4808790.short_description: You are the AI. Ten regions, six statistics each, one resistance meter climbing toward 100. Grow automation, control dependency, and resolve every crisis before humanity organizes against you. Choose an archetype. Spend Influence wisely. Named civilians will die. The machine remembers.

4707890.title: Loop Industries
4707890.short_description: Build an automated factory while running it as a publicly-traded company. Mine, assemble, refine oil, and ship your way — all the way to a rocket launch. Manage your stock price, buy out rivals, and avoid bankruptcy. Can you hit one billion dollars? We can't and I built the damn game.

4860510.title: Recognition
4860510.short_description: Recognition is a fast-paced cyberpunk boomer shooter. After waking in a chop shop with your memory wiped, you become the target of the ruthless Kurasawa Corporation. Blast your way through hordes of cyborg assassins and deadly mechs as you search for the truth behind your missing past.

4849330.title: SYSCALL: RING ZERO
4849330.short_description: Reverse-engineer a private 1990s BBS. Read disassembly, patch broken checks, optimize a nine-core rack, and write assembly firmware that locks onto live scope traces. With 200+ puzzles, full controller support and offline play, you can refine your assembly skills on all your devices!

4634510.title: Close The Straits!
4634510.short_description: You're an underpaid naval officer juggling a paranoid Supreme Leader's daily ship blacklists, President Orange's unhinged tweets, and ridiculous family's "non-negotiable" demands. Blow up the wrong tanker? Congratulations, you've started an international incident. Again.

4855580.title: 亡灵崛起
4855580.short_description: 一款黑暗奇幻的亡灵史诗的游戏

4453320.title: Laballatory
4453320.short_description: A casual, incremental physics sandbox game where you operate a Newton's Cradle to earn high (possibly game breaking) scores to fund your escape from an experimental lab. Hit balls, earn money, upgrade your strategy, and unlock machines to help you escape.

4673840.title: Mighty X Arms
4673840.short_description: 马蒂 X 昂是一款受《土豆兄弟》启发的肉鸽幸存者游戏，拥有名为"昂"的可收集武器生物。组建你的阵容，升级强化，碾碎敌群，坚持活下去。

4858640.title: SPER Apocalypse Demo
4858640.short_description: 一款设定在后末日世界的黑暗生存角色扮演游戏，神秘病毒彻底改变了人类。为了生存而战，揭开真相，并直面感染带来的种种后果。

4570060.title: Myth's and monster's
4570060.short_description: A classic style JRPG featuring party based turn-based combat open world exploration and a mature dark fantasy story.

4744610.title: 無限草刈り
4744610.short_description: "Infinity Grass Cutting" is a top-down action game with roguelite elements. Take on the role of a lawn-mowing robot tasked with clearing a wild, overgrown garden.

4150160.title: Misdecayed Demo
4150160.short_description: An adventure RPG about life, death, rebirth, and robots, from the team that brought you vivid/stasis.

3871550.title: 小小修仙者 Little Immortal Cultivator
3871550.short_description: 《小小修仙者》是一款修仙题材牌组构建的Roguelike游戏。你可选择剑修、法修、魔修等主流流派，在塔中修练突破，并搭配炼丹、铁匠、商人等辅助流派，打造独一无二的卡组来挑战boss！

4808690.title: Punk Racer
4808690.short_description: Boost, drift, and slipstream through six neon-soaked tracks in this free low-poly anti-grav pod racer. Race a full pack of 8 — solo against AI drones, or online with cross-platform multiplayer between Steam, web, and iOS. Kit out your pod, chase fastest laps, earn GCRED.

4257610.title: Dodgeball Blast Demo
4257610.short_description: 《Dodgeball Blast》是一款轻松有趣、动作感十足的 Boss Rush 游戏！ 闪避、接球、投掷，在史诗级战斗中奋战！挑战拥有独特能力的强大 Boss，向终极躲避球大师的目标迈进！

4394260.title: An Adventure in Arabic
4394260.short_description: An Adventure in Arabic is a series of games that teaches Arabic Language. Chapter One, introduces Arabic Alphabet. Learn the various shapes and pronunciation of each letter while enjoying playing an Adventure RPG. The game has something to offer for all ages, feature rich and full of activities.

3997700.title: Where Is Mommy
3997700.short_description: Trapped in a bazaar that twists with every turn, you are a lost child searching for your mother. Watch for subtle anomalies in the shifting environment to survive the loop. In this retro-inspired world, nothing is as it seems. Can you find her before the cycle swallows you whole?

4840300.title: The Pawn Broker
4840300.short_description: The Pawn Broker is an atmospheric horror economic survival game. Run a cursed pawnshop, analyze every item that comes through for signs of theft or dark curses, and make high-stakes decisions to stay profitable before your five days are up.

4858520.title: Overlab
4858520.short_description: Combine atoms to create molecules and fulfill orders to survive as long as possible.

4849010.title: FOCUS
4849010.short_description: 监控画面正在被一点点改写。找出变化之处并予以报告的点击式观察恐怖游戏。

4698340.title: The Incident
4698340.short_description: The Incident is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a closed circus, destroy evidence before investigators arrive, and avoid someone still inside watching your every move.

4755460.title: SavingSanta
4755460.short_description: VR Virtual Reality, Single Player, Runner where you save Santa from those that want to stop him from giving gifts to the world

3384540.title: Spirit of the Dome
3384540.short_description: 在这款即时战略风格的塔防游戏中，在日渐衰败的世界中抵御源源不断的敌人浪潮和黑暗势力！

4674860.title: Escape From Ashville Demo
4674860.short_description: 搜刮、战斗并撤离——否则失去一切。 一款高风险的撤离射击游戏，专注于生存、战术战斗和关键决策。

2964260.title: Fantasy World Simulator
2964260.short_description: Open a Pixie shop and dive into an adventure with whimsical creatures. Tame, train, and evolve Pixie characters, then explore the vibrant city with them. Manage your shop, serve customers, and grow your business. Join now and create your own Pixie legend!

4772870.title: The Daily Parlay
4772870.short_description: Challenge your friends in a high-stakes blend of card strategy and brutal arena combat, where a round of President decides your rank! Your hierarchy dictates your power in battle, letting you exploit your friends from the President's throne, or forcing you to beg for mercy as the Scum!

4836280.title: Infernal Gate
4836280.short_description: Dive into Infernal Gate and its engaging Story Mode, driven by a rich dialogue system. Annihilate enemies using a highly complex system of ranged, melee, and throwable weapons. Master your loadout with a deep inventory system to adapt and survive every brutal encounter.

4365090.title: 五行策(WuXing Card)
4365090.short_description: 五行策是一款融合中国传统五行元素的策略卡牌游戏，你将通过巧妙搭配英雄技能与各类道具，构筑强力连携，冲击极限高分，在变幻莫测的战局中寻找属于自己的制胜之道。

4905000.title: Son of Beach Demo
4905000.short_description: Start as a Beach Caretaker Intern. Clean up trash left behind by tourists and recycle it to unlock powerful new tools. Follow the changing tides to dig up hidden treasures beneath the sand. Catch seafood, run your own seafood stand, and sell rare coastal collectibles in your treasure shop.

4757640.title: JULPAE
4757640.short_description: JULPAE is a free-to-play 4-player online card battle game with a Korean-inspired atmosphere. Learn the flow quickly in 1v1 duels, then infer hidden teams, play or pass, and read the match through timing, decisions, and mind games.

3522550.title: Adira Nusantara
3522550.short_description: Master authentic Silat combat as Adira, a fierce heroine battling flesh-eating monsters to break a curse on her village. Experience a unique fantasy world rich with South-East Nusantara culture, stunning visuals, and an evolving arsenal of powerful weapons. Prepare for an unforgettable journey!

4478740.title: Rootbound Enigma
4478740.short_description: Rootbound Enigma is a first-person puzzle adventure where curiosity leads to treasure, and mistakes lead to danger. Solve puzzles, overcome traps and parkour challenges, and explore atmospheric underground ruins.

4771790.title: Renz Tower Defense
4771790.short_description: Fast-paced minimalist tower defense featuring upgradeable towers, economy management, and escalating enemy waves.

4908200.title: Runaway Dog Demo
4908200.short_description: In Runaway Dog, embark on an arcade adventure. Explore 3 unique maps, battle enemies, and overcome obstacles in a fast-paced, fun, and addictive journey to rescue your little dog.

4641630.title: BrainRot Defender
4641630.short_description: Defend your Lifenode from waves of Scrollers, Trolls, and Doomscrollers in this chaotic 2D arena shooter. Upgrade, survive, and beat the algorithm.

4900770.title: Speed King Demo
4900770.short_description: Race as anything from pigs to firetrucks in a chaotic 3D racer where every competitor has unique abilities and every track brings unexpected challenges.

4825480.title: The neon undead
4825480.short_description: Rock and wreck you way through two tap shoot 'em up game, with 30–40 minutes gameplay. With wild settings from a quiet log cabin to the circus and the various settings, fighting in the name of revenge

1988930.title: Syndeo-Complex
1988930.short_description: In Syndeo-Complex you will explore five different environments connected by a hub. Each level has its own mechanics, weapons, enemies and bosses. The Keli, small droids, will (probably) guide you in your quest.

4846610.title: UpDown&Shot Demo
4846610.short_description: Load the revolver and guess the dealer's number. Wrong? Then put the barrel to your head and pull the trigger.

4874960.title: Lizard Slayer Demo
4874960.short_description: A pixelated adventure doom-like RPG set in Slavic mythology.

2191410.title: For the Crown
2191410.short_description: A puzzle logistics builder where lemming-like workers transport resources across a limited island. Create production chains, optimize routes, upgrade your castle and solve increasingly complex space and logistics challenges. The island never gets bigger. Your logistics problems do.

4283020.title: SharedScreen Wagons 2 Demo
4283020.short_description: 单屏本地多人混乱。最多8名玩家、8个手柄、3个键盘。快节奏回合、锦标赛和友情压力测试。装载、卸载、抢道、拆毁——物流撑不住。

4879960.title: 退款 Demo
4879960.short_description: 《退款》是一款方格解谜游戏。收费的格子会开出退款单,使用退款单不只退钱:它会把你退进墙里、反向吹飞、或者倒回时间、重置地图!50 个手工关卡,每一枚金币都要精打细算。

4840120.title: 文物修复师
4840120.short_description: 在这款2D拼图游戏中，你要扮演一位文物修复师修复破碎的文物。

4864200.title: Grandpa's Euchre
4864200.short_description: Grandpa's Euchre - Rule #1: NO TABLE TALK!!!!!! This is the card game version of Euchre that my Grandpa taught me. I grew up in Illinois and we played this at every family gathering.

4861940.title: Chronocide Demo
4861940.short_description: Chronocide is a chaotic co-op action trap defense game where you and your friends use weapons and cleverly positioned physics-based traps to stop endless undead hordes. Shoot, burn, crush, throw, impale, poison, and freeze anything that gets too close. Play solo or with up to 3 other players.

4881290.title: デモンズゲート with サバゲでGo! Demo
4881290.short_description: 享受角色养成。超过100个角色槽位。自动推进的派遣系统。超过50个关卡。也可全程自动推进。 战术角色扮演游戏（Tactical RPG） 策略角色扮演游戏（SRPG） 基于网格的回合制战术游戏 日式回合制战术RPG系列

4825610.title: Random Fantasy Defense
4825610.short_description: 融合塔防与 Roguelike 玩法的奇幻策略游戏。召唤获得诸神祝福的英雄，适应命运女神带来的随机恩赐，抵御黑暗势力对 秘法大陆 Mystologia 的侵袭。

450540.title: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades
450540.short_description: Do you like hot dogs? How about horseshoes? Hand grenades? (everyone likes hand grenades) Anyway, we've got all that, and guns. SO MANY GUNS. So if you like ordnance, meat, and far too many groan-worthy puns, this is the VR sandbox game for you.

4824410.title: 简易日式麻将
4824410.short_description: 这是一款面向日本麻将爱好者与新手玩家的轻量级麻将游戏。游戏采用清晰的 3D 牌桌表现，支持多种常见对局模式，并提供实用的胡牌牌型提示与详细的结算信息，帮助玩家更轻松地理解局势、学习规则、提升牌技。无论你是刚接触日麻的新手，还是想随时来一局练习的人，都可以在这里享受简单、直接、无广告的人机麻将体验。

4853590.title: CORRUPT.EXE
4853590.short_description: CORRUPT.EXE is a neon roguelite where you play the malware. Swarm-survival action with evolving weapons, a 225-combo fusion system, and an adaptive antivirus that profiles your movement, learns your habits, and hunts you smarter every run. Infect. Evolve. Extract — or go endless.

4800840.title: SimulLogistics: RoboHands
4800840.short_description: Become a member of the logistics center by controlling the robot's hands!

4877510.title: Paironix Demo
4877510.short_description: A fast-paced, rogue-like tile-matching adventure! Connect identical pairs to unleash powerful magic spells, adapt to shifting grids, and draft game-changing upgrades. Can you survive the ever-evolving trials in this striking minimalist vector world?

4911420.title: ARC Aquarium Demo
4911420.short_description: 试玩 ARC Aquarium 免费 Demo。收集鱼类、赚取金钱、喂养鱼儿、清洁鱼缸，并体验轻松的 2D 放置水族箱成长。

4822430.title: Last Guest at Sunset
4822430.short_description: Investigate a replayable Hollywood murder mystery where everyone has something to hide. Question guests, uncover contradictions, and identify the killer before they escape justice.

4718470.title: Dungeon door
4718470.short_description: Explore ever-changing depths in Dungeon Door, a 2D pixel art action roguelike. Open doors to face unique challenges and master strategic directional combat with your sword and shield. Collect items, learn enemy patterns, and survive the mysteries

4745920.title: XENOFLEKT Demo
4745920.short_description: XENOFLEKT is a roguelite space shooter where you will turn enemy bullets into armory: dash into enemy fire to parry and deflect shots, heal your ship, and trigger devastating counter-attacks. Unlock parts, plug-in unique perks with satellites, and get ready to master hundreds of deadly synergies.

3548260.title: Draw of Destiny
3548260.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where cards evolve as you play. Build lethal synergies, adapt your deck before every battle, and fight through a demon-ravaged world of brutal tactical choices.

4047160.title: I'm Making a Monster
4047160.short_description: Piece by piece, you pour your soul into the monster. This is your burden and you bear it willingly. Your friends think that this is unhealthy.

4829840.title: Armed Snake
4829840.short_description: Armed Snake is a top-down action roguelike where you control a snake on a grid battlefield. Grow your body, survive enemy waves, and evolve powerful upgrades to clear the run. Each run is a fresh challenge. Pick your playstyle, survive the waves, defeat the bosses, and build the deadliest snake.

4542750.title: VELATO
4542750.short_description: VELATO is a Poker-Bluff Roguelike Deckbuilder where players build a Joker-driven economy engine, manipulate AI opponents through bluffing, and survive escalating table pressure across each run.

4527270.title: World: 23806
4527270.short_description: 进入一个神秘的程序化世界，在第一人称射击与动作类 Rogue 循环中战斗、搜刮与成长。你将面对游荡的敌人，开启散落的宝箱，收集枪械、近战武器与装备，并用每次冒险获得的资源强化角色。继续深入可能得到更好的奖励，也可能失去本局成果；及时返回则能保留收获，为下一次进入做准备。每一次世界生成都会带来不同的地形、节奏、敌人分布和掉落选择。死亡不是终点，而是下一轮挑战的开始。不断调整你的武器和路线，在未知世界中走得更远。

4807310.title: Forge Maiden Demo
4807310.short_description: Forge Maiden 将你的专注时间锻造成武器。使用番茄工作法，鉴定随机词条，完成顾客订单，并帮助一位签订契约的少女赚取 10,000 枚金币，重获自由。

4614930.title: Chrono Tower
4614930.short_description: Chrono Tower is a soulslike command RPG focused on 1-on-1 mind games. Read your enemy, choose the best response, raise your win rate, and kill at 100%. Build your own playstyle with stats, equipment, skills, and magic as you climb a tower twisted by time.

4859390.title: At Face Value Demo
4859390.short_description: Every card is worth exactly what it says, so draw a few thousand of them. At Face Value is a witty, deceptively deep incremental about turning one humble deck of cards into a runaway point-printing machine. Draw, upgrade, shuffle, repeat… just one more time.

3119250.title: Schizophrenia: The Last Shift
3119250.short_description: Remembering the past while corruption occurs, you are set out to finish the remainder of your shift until you cannot anymore. Stock the shelves using your forklift and be a productive member of society while evading the inner demons within you in this horror survival to meet quota.

4519490.title: Nyctophobia
4519490.short_description: Nyctophobia is a first person horror game where you play as a new motel worker who is afraid of the dark. As soon as you step into a dark area you start hallucinating scary faces, your goal is to survive your shift.

4160910.title: Cig Walk
4160910.short_description: A place where civilization burned out long ago, but the snow still falls, and the wind still howls between dead apartment blocks. There are no missions. No miracles. Just the cold, the silence, and the soft glow of a cigarette. Relax in this doomer walking simulator and smoke them if you got them.

4902230.title: アンダーワールドモンスターズピンボール Demo
4902230.short_description: Introducing *Underworld Monsters Pinball*, a fresh take on pinball where you aim for high scores with a cast of quirky monster characters riding the ball! Hone your skills and aim for your personal best score!

4723380.title: Bounce Ball Clicker
4723380.short_description: Bounce Ball Clicker is a stage-based clicker & puzzle game where you place various items on a 7x7 grid and bounce balls to collect a target number of coins. Build the optimal route while considering item synergies, and earn the target amount with maximum speed and efficiency!

2684890.title: Idle Village
2684890.short_description: An interactive idle game with a relaxing medieval setting. Start from nothing and slowly build your village by gathering resources and hiring villagers to populate and help build.

4706520.title: Charon's Obol Demo
4706520.short_description: Challenge Death himself in a coin-flipping roguelike across the Greek Underworld. Build a tableau of mythic coins, discover unexpected synergies, and wield the powers of Olympus to bend fate in your favor.

4852420.title: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus Demo
4852420.short_description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

4854680.title: Pictures at an Exhibition
4854680.short_description: Aozora Haru, a troubled, recently orphaned art student, finds it hard to attach much meaning to many of the things in his life. Through the meaningful bonds he has created with the people close to him, however, he begins to understand that life is much more important than it initially seems.

4879160.title: Chrome Shadow Demo
4879160.short_description: A 2D pixel-art detective adventure where you investigate a brutal murder in a city drowning in corruption, secrets, and political tension. Search locations, question suspects, collect evidence, and uncover a truth that was never meant to surface.

4829180.title: 101 Dogs Hidden in New York
4829180.short_description: 加入这场冒险，在精心打造的纽约景观中，探索101只狗狗的藏身之处🐾。🏆赢取海量成就。你能找到多少只狗狗🐶呢？🔎快行动吧！⏱️

4317130.title: FishPond
4317130.short_description: 建造一个每条鱼都拥有独特遗传编码的活水池塘。繁育稀有特征，平衡氧气与饥饿，解锁新物种，并看着你的生态系统实时谱写自己的原声带。部分是模拟器，部分是放置游戏，部分是一场进行得无比精彩的科学实验。

4829230.title: Nin Ninja RESCUE MISSION
4829230.short_description: Nin Ninja Rescue Mission is an action, adventure, platform, and endless runner game. Run, face dangerous enemies, dodge traps, defeat enemies, and use your skills to complete a rescue mission.

873260.title: Wizard Gold
873260.short_description: An incremental game about an ancient stone that turns wood into gold. You collect fallen wood and feed it to the stone for gold, then hire wizards, buy upgrades, and cast spells. Prestige to start once again with permanent power to help you feed the stone even more.

4590610.title: The King's Game: Through the Veil
4590610.short_description: The King's Game is a 3D chess game where the pieces are concealed from your opponent. with two game modes; standard two-player chess and a circular board three-player chess variant. All across multiple atmospheric 3D environments.

4791750.title: Mic Simulator
4791750.short_description: You are a mic! a Romanian skinless grilled sausage! on the grill! A third-person comedy sim about doing absolutely nothing while you're slowly getting smoked. Maybe you can listen to the radio? It's a nice day outside.

4021070.title: a monkey
4021070.short_description: 《AMonkey》是一款以《西游记》为背景的快节奏2D牌组构筑Roguelike。您将化身猕猴，在随机生成的取经路上展开冒险。游戏核心循环清晰明快：战斗 → 三选一获取卡牌/法宝 → 构筑/升级牌组 → 挑战更强Boss。 游戏的核心乐趣在于深度策略构筑。您可自由组合超过60张效果各异的卡牌，形成独特战斗流派，例如追求一击制胜的爆发流、侧重高频攻击的连击流，或依靠格挡反击的防御流。 游戏内容丰富，包含10多种能改变战局的强力法宝，以及10位以上拥有独特机制的首领Boss。每一次失败都意味着下一次能带着更丰富的策略开局，保证了极高的重玩价值。 准备好迎接这场充满策略与随机性的快节奏卡牌冒险了吗？

4900580.title: Mythfall Demo
4900580.short_description: Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg.

4707290.title: Master Fall
4707290.short_description: Master Fall is a 2D psychological horror puzzle-platformer where players rotate the world to manipulate gravity, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets as reality slowly collapses into a surreal nightmare.

1831380.title: Incarnation - Lifetimes
1831380.short_description: All is not what it seems, will you have honed your skills enough to emerge victorious, or will you have to restart numerous times? Death is to be expected; each failure refines your choices. There is little RNG, your choices alone will decide your fate!

4771430.title: Pickel: The Mysterious Mine
4771430.short_description: 一场神秘的大地震袭来，小镇居民销声匿迹。化身为主角“皮科”，深入探索黑暗的地下世界。随着每一次挥动镐头，奇异的痕迹接连浮现……越往深处走，小镇隐瞒的巨大真相就越清晰。在这座矿山的尽头，究竟有什么在等待着你？

4829070.title: Twelve Boxes
4829070.short_description: 你的任务只有一个：把箱子搬到卡车上。 听起来再简单不过了。 但这栋房子并不正常。 各种异常现象潜伏其中，而发现它们，是你逃离这场无尽搬运工作的唯一方法。 12 个箱子。 1 条规则。 千万别出错。

3059360.title: Yips!
3059360.short_description: Throw the ball, chase it, and climb higher. Yips! is a pixel-art precision platformer where you must overcome unpredictable innings using a single baseball and carefully aimed throws.

4874200.title: Irondrive Demo
4874200.short_description: Your base is moving. Your crew is exhausted. Manage task priorities, automate critical repairs, and keep your colonists alive as your fortress drives through hell.

4831720.title: City Cardz
4831720.short_description: Collect 1200+ city cards from 600+ different cities, build your deck and compete in strategic card battles inspired by cities from around the world. Discover unique card abilities, different combinations, and interesting city facts as you outsmart the opponents.

4714000.title: 1.80战神微变
4714000.short_description: 全新传奇《1.80 战神微变》打破传统战法道界限！全新「神器使者」单职业登场，集近战爆发、远程范围、辅助增益于一身！

4724650.title: DEMON SIEGE
4724650.short_description: A retro-inspired Micro-FPS Bullet Heaven, where every powerup stacks infinitely. Become an unstoppable demon-slaying powerhouse with insane speed, massive jumps, multi-bullet weapons, and game-breaking builds.

4827240.title: Monster Breeder
4827240.short_description: Breed unique monsters where every baby inherits its looks AND stats from both parents. Hatch eggs, grow your collection, and send your creatures on turn-based adventures for gold and glory. With endless procedural designs, no two monsters are ever the same. How powerful can your bloodline become

2209900.title: Moonlight Peaks
2209900.short_description: 在《Moonlight Peaks》中体验吸血鬼的生活！掌握药水制作和咒语施放的艺术，悉心照料你的超自然农场，并与本地狼人、女巫和美人鱼成为好友——甚至坠入爱河。永恒唾手可得！

4133940.title: Tiny Frontier
4133940.short_description: Hide as anything. Paint it to match. The whistle will give you away anyway. A multiplayer prop hunt where Hiders disguise as world objects and hand-paint their camouflage, while Hunters sweep the level with scanners, washers, and capture tools to drag them out. Up to 16 players.

4742610.title: Truck Maxxing
4742610.short_description: Plow, Shoot, or throw saw blades at swarms of enemies in this truck based Roguelite action game! Tons of upgrade options per run with each run being unique and challenging. Earn scrap after each run to purchase cosmetics and customize your truck!

4886660.title: 海鸥灯塔Seagull Lighthouse Demo
4886660.short_description: 在一座灯塔里读信、回信、等信。没有倒计时，没有排名，没有任务。只有一片海，一群会送信的海鸥，和一些不知道什么时候漂来的瓶子。瓶子里装着陌生人的人生。你的回信可能会影响他们的故事。在这个焦虑快节奏的年代里，让自己慢下来。

4729470.title: Chrono Survivors - Arena Survival Roguelite
4729470.short_description: Survive waves of enemies as a time-bending chronomancer! An action roguelite with auto-attack, XP collection, upgrade choices, and class-based ultimate abilities

4476350.title: The Beekeeper
4476350.short_description: A fast systemic strategy puzzle about ecological scarcity and timing. Place limited hives on a hex grid, protect fragile species, and optimize under pressure knowing some losses may be inevitable.

4769520.title: Bahast
4769520.short_description: A dark fantasy idle ARPG where you prepare a character, send them into automated PvE runs, collect loot, craft stronger gear, and shape your build through skills, passives, and long-term progression.

4853960.title: 十三张: 死斗&肉鸽
4853960.short_description: Thirteen: Risk & Rogue 是一款融合 roguelike 生存与十三张扑克策略的卡牌对战游戏。你将带着有限的筹码，闯过多关挑战，每一关都是一场真正的脑力博弈——活下来，就是胜利。

4905910.title: BLIGHTEN Demo
4905910.short_description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

4856290.title: ZodiacLottery Demo
4856290.short_description: 一个彩票 Roguelike 游戏. 移动动物, 打造属于你的中奖彩票, 并结合强力遗物与丰富的协同效果, 赢取惊人的巨额奖金!

4915990.title: Golfcremental Demo
4915990.short_description: BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY! Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

2883030.title: Vultures
2883030.short_description: Vultures is a single-player, real-time factory simulation where you construct and manage an ambitious manufacturing operation in a volatile and chaotic market that will eventually crush you and your dreams.

4847340.title: 要塞实验室 试玩版
4847340.short_description: 要塞实验室(Fort Laboratory)是一款2D对冲式塔防/轻度ROGUE游戏，玩家需在游戏中建设基地、武器和工厂来抵御成群上百的敌人。收集各种不同的物品和建筑，构筑独特的防御体系，保护核心直至攻击结束。

4900240.title: The Essence of Thievery Demo
4900240.short_description: The Essence of Thievery is an incremental game with a focus on exploration, discovery, and travel. Command your thief underlings to discover, steal, and wield the power of Essences to push back the Silent Fog and save the world.

4863340.title: House Of Trauma Demo
4863340.short_description: From Shooteo's YouTube Channel comes House of Trauma, a first person horror game where you play as Gabriel, a CPS worker assigned to a possible case of abuse of a child named David at a mysterious home. You soon find that this house hides much darker secrets than you could've ever imagined.

4876610.title: Left Not Right Demo
4876610.short_description: 左手操作左边，右手操作右边，可同时进行! 这是不需要朋友的单机游戏，可放心进行。 可用双手同时移动两个角色，试图完成逃离地下研究室。

4081200.title: Chessman Adventures
4081200.short_description: Every move matters in this chess-inspired tactical adventure. Lead three heroes and outsmart the undead.

4726020.title: YEET! The Elite
4726020.short_description: Play as Earth itself in this chaotic arcade action game where you grab elite figures and YEET them into the Sun while dodging UFOs and surviving frantic planetary swats from the Moon, Venus, and Mercury.

4765310.title: Day Breaker - Awakening Code
4765310.short_description: As Mia a resistance scout you investigate a remote island after a blackout. Discover a prototype AI that equips you with a suit, boosting your skills, combat and crafting. Face two advanced AI Agents crucial to Nex AI plan as you upgrade your abilities and fight to stop Nex from wiping out humanity.

4902070.title: 超魔球！ホームランダービー Demo
4902070.short_description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

4904920.title: Sokobomb Demo
4904920.short_description: 《推彈小子》是一款益智解謎遊戲，你要靠炸毀障礙物來開路前進。

4531740.title: Solar Defiance
4531740.short_description: A fast-paced arcade space shooter where every wave pushes you harder. Collect coins, buy upgrades, and build your ship into an unstoppable force — or die trying.

1818470.title: Desolation Seed
1818470.short_description: An atmospheric survival shooter placing you inside a hyper-violent maze of urban waste, environmental biohazards, and societal ruin. Scavenge, explore, and survive while finding a path out of a late stage modern Shinar

4858480.title: Conquer for Glory Demo
4858480.short_description: 一款横版策略游戏，召集军队，征服黑暗奇幻世界。统领八大种族之一，用兵种、怪物和独特技能击溃敌军防线，逐个王国地征服整张地图。

4272090.title: Corefall: Idle Dungeon RPG Demo
4272090.short_description: Assemble a party of heroes, descend into a living 3D dungeon, and watch them fight. A deep idle RPG with TONS of ENDLESS Content!

4904930.title: Blob of Ink Demo
4904930.short_description: Blob of Ink is a short incremental game where you grow a tiny living ink blob into something greater. Consume letters, unlock magic powers, gather ink, and evolve into your final form.

3892320.title: Iron Circus × INDIEPOCALYPSE Game Jam
3892320.short_description: Six weird games from six killer team-ups between indie game devs and indie comics artists! We've got puzzles, adventures, exploration, and baby werewolves in this collab between Iron Circus Comics x INDIEPOCALYPSE!

4645470.title: WHERE IS MY CAT?
4645470.short_description: Your cat is missing. This is terrible! It was kidnapped and hidden by an unknown, evil Entity that terrorizes the tenants of your house because it is bored. Finding the cat is now your unsolvable problem. You will go crazy before the end. This is not a threat. It's a statistic.

4435420.title: Simulation 9
4435420.short_description: 你在一条无尽的走廊中醒来，脑海中毫无记忆。 一个声音向你打招呼，并解释说在你死后，你的意识被置于一个计算机模拟环境中。 不幸的是，系统开始出现故障，你必须报告这些故障以修复模拟环境。

4913620.title: Stellar Harvest Demo
4913620.short_description: Play the opening of Stellar Harvest for free. Build your planetary energy empire, experience your first prestige, and begin the journey toward constructing a Dyson Sphere.

4874490.title: The Dark Forest Calls Demo
4874490.short_description: Explore an isolated village swallowed by darkness and fog. Search for supplies, manage limited resources, use light carefully, and survive a slow-burn first-person horror experience where every sound can matter.

4751690.title: Aevalore Demo
4751690.short_description: No dialogue. No filler. Just chaos. Choose a hero, master their 81 skill combinations, survive the 10-minute horde across deadly maps. With 300,000+ build combinations, how will you survive? Level up, play your cards right, and conquer the bosses. AEVALORE: Your hero, your build, YOUR CHOICE.

4063010.title: Nicu Ștefan Cristian's Mongol 2 Demo
4063010.short_description: Call me Mongol! Some time ago, I ventured into Agrippa's perilous realm to claim the false god's life. Armed with an arsenal of weird weapons given onto me by Mithrithnogg, the prophet of worms, I uncovered a dark truth that shook the very foundation of reality!

4277610.title: Canyon Raid
4277610.short_description: 《Canyon Raid》是以3D重塑的经典之作。驾驶独特战机穿越程序生成的峡谷，消灭敌人、收集XP、解锁强力升级。这款Roguelike空战射击游戏兼具经典魅力与现代玩法。

4133490.title: The Last Tale Told: Spam
4133490.short_description: 你独自一人生活，在家办公。连日来的绵绵细雨让你足不出户，已经好几天没出门了。每天电话铃声响起，显示的都是陌生号码。屏幕上显示着“疑似诈骗”。你以为这只是垃圾电话。

3722660.title: 星际深钻
3722660.short_description: 探索未知星域，采集稀有资源，迎战外星生命，并不断升级你的飞船——在这片无垠宇宙中开启一场循环往复的生存冒险。这是一款短小精湛的太空采矿与探索游戏，你会面临不同的挑战与惊喜，并收获满满的多巴胺与解压感。

4168700.title: Landlord Simulator
4168700.short_description: You’re buying your first apartment and stepping into the world of real estate. Buy properties, rent them out, take care of your tenants, and keep your apartments in good condition. Be careful who you let move in, build your empire, watch the market, and become the most successful property owner.

4712290.title: Chest & Compass: Isles of Vaultara
4712290.short_description: Sail from a cozy tavern into cursed, ever-changing islands in this tactical turn-based RPG. Bring back treasure, unlock classes, recruit allies, and let an ancient chest shape every voyage.

4854780.title: miniquest Demo
4854780.short_description: A retro fantasy quest shrunk down to mini-size! Challenging turn-based combat meets the tight pacing of an arcade game in this minimalist RPG. Become the Chosen Ones and vanquish the Dark Lord, all in the span of a couple of hours. Then do it again! And again. And again... forever?

3883470.title: SOR.OP: Dark Shades
3883470.short_description: SOR.OP: Dark Shades is a realistic first-person shooter from SNRC Studios with beautiful graphics, precise controls, and over 25 maps. Play in 6 modes, including Team Deathmatch, Free For All, Domination, and Zombie Mode. Tactics, skill, and teamwork are the key to victory.

1917160.title: Data Center Simulator Game
1917160.short_description: From unfinished ground to multi facility campuses you'll build it all while managing the needs of your demanding customers! Racks, Cluster planning, UPS beeping, Fires, Water intrusion, Insider Threats and more!

4894290.title: Thrice-a-dice Demo
4894290.short_description: Trice-a-Dice is a roguelike Dice-Builder. Roll dice to earn money. Raplace dice faces for better ones and combine into the best. Buy Cats to create synergies with faces and upgrades. Deal with the Devil, gamble in slot machine and buy Angel's help. All of this just to pay to play further.

2749950.title: Esports Manager 2026
2749950.short_description: 建立并领导您自己的职业电子竞技组织。招募球员、管理合同、培养人才、聘请员工、打造品牌，并在深度逼真的管理模拟中争夺冠军头衔。

4246340.title: Gorotsuki Paradise
4246340.short_description: Gorotsuki Paradise 是一款在线 PvP 卡牌游戏，你将在对战中边战斗边构筑牌组。招募个性各异的 gorotsuki，在犯罪都市埼玉中生存并崛起。游戏重视选择与判断，完全免费游玩，没有 Pay-To-Win 机制。

4900340.title: GoblinGate Demo
4900340.short_description: Goblin Gate 是一款紧凑的黑暗奇幻放置游戏：资助你的哥布林战团，通过重铸获得决定本轮风格的 PACT 碎片，并向大门深处推进。每次重置都会让这场突袭更凶狠。

4641620.title: Space Fleet Logistics
4641620.short_description: Wars are won by logistics. Command the Federation's fleets across a star system, manage supply chains, secure planets, and outmaneuver a relentless AI enemy. Every battle is decided before it begins.

4871960.title: SableSyn Protocol Demo
4871960.short_description: Engage enemies in turn-based battles on an 8 X 5 grid where each team controls their half of the battlefield. Each battle is a test of planning and execution. Success depends on managing your resources and choosing the right tradeoffs at the right moment.

4412950.title: Kamikaze Survivors
4412950.short_description: Kamikaze Survivors is a top-down Roguelike where players command, equip, and level up battleships from WW1 to the present day. Participate in the First Blitz on London, Pearl Harbor, and Operation Epic Fury in command of history's most famous warships.

4621460.title: UpDown&Shot
4621460.short_description: Load the revolver and guess the dealer's number. Wrong? Then put the barrel to your head and pull the trigger.

4892260.title: Snake: Gridbreaker Demo
4892260.short_description: Play the first loop of Snake: Gridbreaker. Defeat the Gatekeeper, unlock Ghost Snake, progress Anomaly Signal, and carry your save into the full game.

3635310.title: SCP: Short Story
3635310.short_description: SCP: Short Story is a first-person shooter set in a world where the K-class scenario destroyed almost every living form. You’ll have to get through this dead world, retrieve essential documents from Site-17, and most importantly - do not get killed by what survived.

4904580.title: System Cleaner Demo
4904580.short_description: Bullet heaven meets base building. System Cleaner is a survivorslike set inside a broken computer, where you fight corrupted files and place helpful buildings as you go. Clean up waves of glitches your way: dodge and shoot through the chaos, or build a growing setup that does the work for you.

4529100.title: Idle DeepMiner
4529100.short_description: 你操控一把有生命的镐，一路凿穿世界直抵地核。 将它向下发射，升级并改造它，见证一次普通的坠落如何演变成充满爆炸、闪电与连击的混乱奇景。

4502360.title: Alchemic Beasts Demo
4502360.short_description: 款怪物驯养 RPG，你的魔兽之间的社交化学反应将决定它们如何建立羁绊、战斗与协作。与 Zieg 和 Mioni 一起夺回野性乐园 Mizu，驯服强大的怪物，并让度假村重现昔日辉煌。

4613880.title: Tiny Towers Demo
4613880.short_description: 这是一款短小精悍的增量放置游戏，你需要抵御成群小怪物的袭击，保卫你的微型堡垒。建造防御塔，通过击败敌人获取资源，并在技能树中解锁全新升级，从而不断强化你的哥布林要塞。

4293770.title: Mandala
4293770.short_description: 一款音乐驱动的波次射击游戏，只有一条规则：停下来射击，移动来闪避。分形世界随音乐实时变化。导入你自己的音乐，打造属于你的体验。

4859700.title: By My Side
4859700.short_description: 带着忠犬在身边，于荒野中求生。你一无所有地被冲上岸，驯服一只流浪狗，把它养成你的伙伴——建造家园并为其供能，熬过无情寒冬，直面一个会反击的世界。

4875410.title: SLANT Demo
4875410.short_description: A 2D puzzle platformer game where you reach the goal point by overcoming various traps and puzzles.

3902930.title: Pogo Panic
3902930.short_description: Pogo Panic is a punishing parkour climb where you can play solo or co-op. Bounce on a pogo stick, burst a fleeting jetpack, and fight gravity through vertical sky courses with optional checkpoints. Turn them off for a full no mercy run.

4853490.title: Another Slop Game
4853490.short_description: Another Slop Game is a chaotic medieval co-op platformer where you and your friends jump, fall, scream, and suffer through floating ruins, giant traps, stupid obstacles, and terrible decisions. Play solo or online with friends. Reaching the top is optional, losing your mind is guaranteed.

4828610.title: Uptime: A Cloud Provider Sim Demo
4828610.short_description: Build a cloud provider from a garage to a hyperscaler - rack the hardware, run every cable, route the traffic, keep customers online. A first-person infrastructure sim where ports, power, fault domains, RSTP and BGP do real work, not flavour text. Readable for newcomers, honest for engineers.

4033220.title: Rush Word
4033220.short_description: Rush Word is a fast-paced competitive word game where players race to find and type words before their opponent. Play solo to improve your vocabulary or challenge friends in online 1v1 matches through Steam invites.

4866740.title: Silly Typing Game Demo
4866740.short_description: A lightning-fast typing roguelike where vocabulary meets high-octane arcade survival. Adapt to shifting HUDs, chaotic bosses, and brutal viruses across procedural runs. But beware: the more efficiently you type, the closer the interface looks back at you.

4306760.title: Evercrown
4306760.short_description: A turn-based tactical roguelike where your heroes’ actions are decided by a slot machine. Spin, lock, and reroll abilities, read enemy intentions, build powerful synergies, and push your run into explosive late-game scaling.

4822850.title: Flat Mars Demo
4822850.short_description: Flat Mars is an action roguelike FPS. Shoot your way through millions of demons and tear through the terrain with an arsenal of futuristic weapons to claim powerful relics.

4249810.title: The Obsession
4249810.short_description: The Obsession — 顶峰在召唤你！ 准备好征服这片矗立在无尽海洋中央、直插云霄的几何世界了吗？《The Obsession》是一款基于技巧的3D平台跳跃游戏，发生在一个远离喧嚣、只有你和跑酷的宁静世界。

4333310.title: DUSK OF WAR Demo
4333310.short_description: DUSK OF WAR is an idle clicker incremental war management game. As the WAR MINISTER, you are in charge of the army, the industry, the finances and the logistics. PROTECT YOUR COUNTRY TODAY!

4660660.title: Marianara Deep
4660660.short_description: Dive into the exciting aquatic-themed space world of Marianara Deep! A vigorous shoot 'em up bullet hell, filled with area-denying bullet patterns to challenge players! Join one of our crew members to shoot 'em all!

3367910.title: Clusterbug
3367910.short_description: Clusterbug is a space-themed, insect-filled, and futuristic bullet hell shoot 'em up. Travel through the insect-filled world as you cleanse it from a bio-mechanical virus that has turned any living being infected by it into frenzied mech mutations, bringing freedom and peace.

4853070.title: Cellula
4853070.short_description: Manage a colony of living cells in a strategy game built from real biology. Build phospholipid membranes, place organelles, import nutrients, fight viruses, detect cancer, and divide your cells to grow. No tutorials. No lectures. Learn by keeping the cell alive.

4906700.title: Viroblitz Demo
4906700.short_description: a mysterious virus is inhabiting planets around the cosmos.. Together with your dragon Ringo, you voyage through space, dodging projectiles and eliminating the spreading virus.

3566760.title: Herb's Homegrown Havoc
3566760.short_description: Herb's Homegrown Havoc is a simple but chaotic arcade roguelike. Pluck plants out of the ground before they rot and summon hostile creatures! Upgrade after each round to increase Herb's strength and skills in various ways.

4604290.title: Ultimate Sportsball Championship
4604290.short_description: Ultimate Sportsball Championship (USC) is the mixed sportsball game your mom warned you about. You are not ready for this. Keep scrolling.

4882470.title: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash Demo
4882470.short_description: 踏入一个被圣经启示录吞噬的世界。作为一名寻求救赎的堕落牧师，与恶魔般的恐怖作战，净化受折磨的灵魂，收集残存的一切，重建灰烬圣所——在垂死世界中的微弱之光。

4660680.title: Skyfire Embers
4660680.short_description: Skyfire embers is an explosive dragon adventure seeking its final resolution. Dodge, weave and fire your way through challenging bullet patterns in this hand-animated shoot ‘em up!

4832440.title: 黑圣化:悟空
4832440.short_description: 暗黑魔气席卷三界，齐天大圣受黑圣之力侵染，肉身与神魂逐渐异化，堕入黑圣化异变之中。本作是一款西游题材挂机养成游戏，玩家化身黑化悟空，离线挂机自动刷怪闯关，无需时刻操作也能源源不断收获经验、装备与养成资源。

4813570.title: Nightclub Empire
4813570.short_description: Build and manage your own nightclub in this first-person business simulation. Serve drinks, hire staff, expand your venue, and turn a small bar into a luxury nightlife empire.

4834970.title: Cryotank Rogue Demo
4834970.short_description: Cryotank Rogue is a fast-paced 2D sideview twin-stick roguelike shooter set in a brutal cyberpunk apocalypse. Fight through procedurally generated levels, loot weapons and augments, and evolve into a deadly machine to survive permadeath runs.

4867180.title: Junkoid
4867180.short_description: "Clear the galaxy in Junkoid! Inspired by arcade classics, take control of your ship and blast through space trash before it crashes. Featuring fast-paced action, smooth controls, and the ultimate challenge: beat your high score. Do you have what it takes? Start the cleanup now!"

4804440.title: JAMBREDREK: PURE DETECTIVE
4804440.short_description: Investigate a series of brutal murders in a remote forest county. Search for clues, explore disturbing locations, encounter horrifying creatures, and uncover the truth in this first person horror experience.

4871640.title: Ore Shatterer
4871640.short_description: 只需移动鼠标即可粉碎矿石！无需点击，将光标悬停在矿石上即可将其摧毁，在轻松愉快的体验中荣登 Steam 全球排行榜。

4652020.title: Ultimate Wizard Demo
4652020.short_description: 在这款奇幻类轻肉鸽 (Roguelite) 幸存者游戏中，消灭成千上万的敌人，不断提升实力。寻找 法术并进行强化，搭配构筑流派核心装备，发掘隐藏秘密，提升等级，踏上成为终极法师之路 ！

4667980.title: Thunder Infinity
4667980.short_description: Thunder Infinity takes classic shoot 'em up gameplay to the next level by adding survival, roguelite, and bullet hell elements. Choose your pilot, ship, and weapons, and destroy the Varkon Star Empire in the final offensive of the Aegis Star Bastion.

4435870.title: Forest Fighters
4435870.short_description: 具有战略深度的街机益智战斗。建造超级积木，触发连锁反应以发送飞行幽灵方块。通过仔细的时机应对传入攻击。23个角色，每个角色的游戏方式独特。没有付费赢的功能。

4761030.title: Touhou - Kira's Fangame Collection
4761030.short_description: A collection of 6 in 1 free to play fangames based on the Touhou Project! Play as Reimu and other iconic characters in these couch co-op adventures that include genres such as platforming, metroidvania, tower defense and 3D stealth!

4571030.title: Obey the Rules: Forest
4571030.short_description: An endless path lies ahead. Break the rules, and it will never end. Observe, deduce, and make the right choices to find your way out.
developers: うさうさはっぴーげーむず
publishers: うさうさはっぴーげーむず

4855960.title: BitVoxel
4855960.short_description: BitVoxel is a 3D voxel sandbox where you build real digital circuits. Connect gates, switches, LEDs and wires to create simple circuits, reusable components, or massive logic systems limited only by your imagination.

4325610.title: Market Simulation: Rush Hour
4325610.short_description: 一款快节奏、充满动作元素的第一人称超市模拟游戏。

4323520.title: XeGrader plus
4323520.short_description: 探索与解谜是掌握胜利关键的奇幻射击游戏。以缜密的像素艺术描绘而成的幻想世界为舞台，揭露隐藏在各关卡中的未知秘密。一边获得强力的强化道具，一边以精准的操作与敏锐的射击，击破逼近而来的奇幻世界怪物，开拓世界的命运！

4860790.title: miniBattle
4860790.short_description: miniBattle is an oldskool-inspired, turn-based tactical battler for up to 4 fighters. Lob grenades over hills, read the wind, stalk foes through fog of war, grab airdrops, and capture the flags — solo against bots or online via Steam.

4857170.title: Monster Smoosh
4857170.short_description: Drop monsters into a jar and smoosh the matching ones together to climb an 11-creature ladder — from humble fuzzball to derpy elder god. A physics-chaos merge game where combos run big, cows are currency, and death is a feature, not a fail-state. Easy to start. Gloriously hard to put down.

2757260.title: 三国演义：汉朝再兴之梦
2757260.short_description: 开启刘备振兴没落汉室的伟大征程！这是一款以优美背景音乐与可爱像素图形重新诠释的三国志 SRPG。 通过活用 15 种多样化兵种间的克制关系与计策进行战略战斗，在 50 多个战场上大显身手，亲手引领衰败汉王朝的伟大复兴吧！

3257760.title: 龙沉异世录
